This is a popular family spot and this spot draws a consistent clientele but I've never been here when its been packed.  Other than pizza the only other items available here are salad and spaghetti.  If you find yourself in Metairie and in the mood for pizza this is one of the better choices in the suburbs but there is better pizza to be found in the city.    Tip:  If you need Saints gear you can combine your shopping experience at the Black & Gold shop with your pizza experience as Tower of Pizza is in the same strip mall.  Tip 2: Cash Only  Tower of Pizza video review:  https://youtu.be/a8Q-y4jAXIk

This is a great old school neighborhood eatery with classic New Orleans Creole and Italian dishes.  They offer classics like turtle soup, gumbo, red beans, fried chicken, pasta and po boys along with more ambitious entrees (and for the Texans that crave it yes they have a chicken fried steak for a lunch special).  The fried chicken is a bit on the bland side and it could use some spicing up but it is fried to perfection with the chicken being moist and delicious along with a perfect crunchy crust. They have a fantastic roast beef poboy with delicious chunks of garlic and a nice thick gravy (although on my last visit the gravy and garlic were missing).  The ambiance is more 70's style than classic New Orleans architecture and the crowd certainly trends more towards the geriatric but this place is more hip than any hipster could ever dream of.  The menu selection is excellent while portions are generous and prices make this place a good value (although with pandemic inflation the poboy was getting on the expensive side on my last visit).  This is an authentic locals joint with most of the folks working here being locals that give it that extra bit of local soul that many places have lost over the years.  My video review of Mr. Ed's is here:  https://youtu.be/Ol7v8EnPLrk

Charlie's is a bit less fun than it used to be when they would just come up to your table and say "ya want a medium or large... wait never mind we're out of medium so you get a large."  Then they would just bring you onion rings whether you ordered them or not and then you better had eaten them all or else!  They are a bit less set in their ways since Katrina and they cleaned out a lot of the awesome built up funk of accumulated decades but it mostly still tastes the same.  You still get your meat sizzling on a metal platter so hot that it will permanently brand you if you touch it.  The selection is much expanded and now you actually get to have some choice in the matter of your steak and it seems to be a bit better quality than previously.  Definitely not the best steak but definitely a classic New Orleans experience.

I emphasized multiple times that I didn't want my hair cut short and that I only wanted it trimmed and neatened up.  What I got instead was a short haircut that was far shorter than I like in all areas.  I don't like it when my explicit instructions are ignored as I'm not trying to look stylish or contemporary as I never left the 80's preppy style and that's where I'm staying.  I liked the location and building but it seems you've really got to be careful with which stylist you book with.

Charlie's Steak House was opened up back in 1932 by Charlie Petrossi and Charlie's Steak House was one of the last places I ate at before Hurricane Katrina hit and that was back when Charlie's daughter Miss Dottye was still working and in those days she told you what you were ordering and not the other way around.  Charlie's was closed after Katrina due to flood damage until Matthew Dwyer who had worked as a bartender in Charlie's was able to purchase the business with his father to repair and re-open the business 3 years after the storm hit.  The last time I ate at Charlies was in March of 2020 right before the pandemic lockdowns closed most restaurants and then tragically in June Matthew Dwyer, the owner, died at the age of 49 leaving the future of Charlie's uncertain again.  We learned in December that local chef and restaurant owner Aaron Burgau had taken over Charlie's and it would soon be re-opening and so a group of my friends were excited to have Charlie's back open and we recently went to enjoy a great dinner.  Charlie's is a bit less fun than it used to be when they would just come up to your table and say "ya want a medium or large... wait never mind we're out of medium so you get a large."  Then they would just bring you onion rings whether you ordered them or not and then you better had eaten them all or else!  They are a bit less set in their ways since Katrina and they cleaned out a lot of the awesome built up funk of accumulated decades but it mostly still tastes the same.  You still get your meat sizzling on a metal platter so hot that it will permanently brand you if you touch it.  The selection is much expanded and now you actually get to have some choice in the matter of your steak and it seems to be a bit better quality than previously.  Definitely not the best steak but definitely a classic New Orleans experience.  See my video review of Charlie's Steak House here:  https://youtu.be/KUURdq0JB7Y

Sunday brunch was a real disappointment here as the menu had a lot of pork and I don't eat the dirty pig along with not being the biggest fan of breakfast food in general.  The burger and the crawfish benedict were the contenders for my choices and I was leaning towards the burger except it was so overpriced I just opted out and went with the mistake of the crawfish benedict that ended up being even more overpriced as it came with MAYBE only 2 teaspoons of crawfish so I paid a good deal of money just for some potatoes, 2 eggs and a biscuit essentially. The service was really good about keeping my drink filled but they were playing just terrible and unpleasantly LOUD music.  I have been wanting to come back and try a lunch or dinner here but when I look at the menus they seem very pork centric and then the seafood options seem rather expensive for what they are.  So the hipster vibe with bad loud music and high prices with the pork in most things really adds up to put a damper on my desire to return after my less than stellar brunch experience.  So I guess I shall wait and see awhile longer to observe if anything develops that grabs my taste buds.

This was a nice experience for a Yelp perk with a nice selection of items. For the experience I got a shrimp spring roll, shrimp banh mi and I purchased a chicken banh mi. I have been to nearly all the Vietnamese restaurants in the area but this is one I had never visited before this experience.  Overall it was nice to be able to visit a new to me location to sample their food and the ambiance of the space.

This is a great deli and a great po boy shop in addition to being a grocery!!!  They have a fantastic selection of available meals and sides in their deli counter and a large selection of various po boys and other sandwiches.  I don't know if I will ever be able to make it through everything they have on the sandwich menu much less the deli counter but I've made a good effort over the years.  Great place to grab some picnic food and head over to the dog park or river to enjoy the food and outdoors.  They also do some pretty good catering options I've had at parties as well (I really like their mini strombolies).

Well I made multiple trips to the Dixie Brewery and really enjoyed myself and thought this was a fantastic joint to enjoy some beer.  I did find it a bit curious that they charged more for regular Dixie beer than I can buy it for at the grocery store though.  They have been doing some very interesting things with their limited craft beer and seasonal selections.  They have been having some really great swag promotions and other deals during these crazy pandemic times that has really generated some jazz for the new place.    Sadly they announced they are killing the Dixie brand and with that they just spit in the faces of all people with long time connections to the city of New Orleans.  Due to this ridiculous brand murder which has Tom Benson spinning in his grave I will not be returning to this brewery or buying anymore of their beer.

Mmmm this is some very tasty food.  This is a classic New Orleans Italian Creole restaurant that does some great NOLA seafood along with the usual Italian delicacies.  The location is great BUT generally do expect to wait awhile to get to your table and eat (fortunately there is a well stocked bar to keep you entertained).  This is a great place to go out on a date or with a group.  I've always had outstanding service and always had a really great time with some great food!

I've eaten here many times on my own and with many different groups.  The quality and price equation have seemed to get a bit out of balance in recent years and I've found myself here less and less frequently.  For the price of what you get here there really are many better options in the area with many better steaks.  The ambiance of this restaurant is also not anything special as it seems you walk into a ground level entrance and then step down into an almost basement type dining room and you could be in a dining room just about anywhere as it is "nice" and all but without any NOLA soul to it.  I've often had some good times here but in recent years those events have greatly dwindled.  In fact during a recent "Meat Fest," that a group of my friends and I engaged in, Dickie's Steakhouse wasn't even brought up as an option on our tour of area steakhouses before Lent.  I've also got it on good authority that Dickie eats at Mr. John's Steakhouse quite a bit these days.  The food here is certainly good it just isn't as good as the price point would demand at this point.

The brisket here is ok and the sides are decent.  The portion size for the plate was too small for the price and not a good value.  They had three sauces available that had good flavors.  My friend I ate with found that the brisket was far too fatty for him while I found the consistency of the meat to be a bit too soft for my taste possibly from overcooking or reheating.  The Joint, NOLA Smokehouse, NOLA-Q and Whole Foods offer better brisket to my palate while the Joint is also still the best value as they still give you the most brisket for your money.  The brisket here is better than McClure's, Squeal and Hillbilly's.  If I'm in the area I will try it out a few more times and I hope it improves.

This location is a bit further from my work than the other Brothers on this service road but they have a better selection of convenience store items but have a puny number of gas pumps.  So it is a great place to get a better selection of coffee along with having fried food items like chicken, fish, crawfish pies, meat pies, french fries and various other items.  It is a terrible place to get gas so I would skip on down to the other location if there is a line here for gas.

This is a great old school neighborhood eatery with classic New Orleans Creole and Italian dishes.  They offer classics like turtle soup, gumbo, red beans, fried chicken, pasta and po boys along with more ambitious entrees (and for the Texans that crave it yes they have a chicken fried steak for a lunch special).  They have a fantastic roast beef poboy with delicious chunks of garlic and a nice thick gravy.  The ambiance is more 70's style than classic New Orleans architecture and the crowd certainly trends more towards the geriatric but this place is more hip than any hipster could ever dream of.  The menu selection is excellent while portions are generous and prices make this place a good value.  This is an authentic locals joint with most of the folks working here being locals that give it that extra bit of local soul that many places have lost over the years.

This place is really three different places in the same space with Melrose Billiard Parlor, The Sutler Saloon and Rambler Cocktail Bar. My experience here was mainly all down in the basement bar which is Melrose Billiard Parlor and it was packed during my visit while The Sutler Saloon and Rambler Cocktail Bar didn't seem to have much going on at the time I visited.  I found it interesting they had "No Smoking" signs in here while lots of people were smoking and the smoke was hanging very thick in the basement so I couldn't stay very long as the smoke was really getting to me as a non-smoker.  This looks like it could be a cool and fun spot but if they are going to allow smoking they really have to get better ventilation in here as it was far too smoky for me in the Melrose Billiard Parlor while upstairs there didn't seem to be any smoking.  The Melrose Billiard Parlor definitely seemed to draw a much better crowd later at night and seemed to stay open later than the spaces upstairs which would have been great if it wasn't so smoky in the basement. Overall it seems like a cool spot but with so much smoke hanging around I just can't handle that.

The Quarter View Restaurant has great daily lunch specials and some nice drink specials.  This is a larger venue with a lot of space in their dining rooms and their bar.  The interior of the establishment is painted to resemble the French Quarter.  They have quite a wide variety of food choices here and most folks should be able to find something they like here.  Overall this is a good place to grab lunch during the week with some good specials that provide a good value.    My video review of Quarter View Restaurant is here: https://youtu.be/OueCfM6HcOw

I have had two visits here with both being enjoyable for the bar and one being a disaster for the food.  My first visit here was during Veteran's day when they had a nice discount for military vets so I really appreciated that gesture and had couple of beers and enjoyed the amazing rooftop bar view.  I then decided to sample some of the food and got the duck confit grilled cheese sandwich which arrived cold and the duck was so full of gristle it was inedible then to add insult to injury I was given a paltry amount of fries with it.  My next visit was as a part of a Yelp Elite perk and this visit went much better and the bar seemed to be far better organized than during my first visit.  I told the manager about my last experience and he comped me another duck confit sandwich that was delicious and the complete opposite of the last one I had been served.  The only other thing that seems a bit off to me here is that they don't offer parking validation for customers of the bar which is standard practice at most of the other places like this in the area.  Overall the view alone is worth the cost of a visit here and that view does come with a premium on the price of the drinks here.  My food experience here would give me some caution but they did make up for the initial bad experience I had and the crab beignets were also very nice.  The portion size of the "sharables" section of their menu here I also would say are NOT sharable for the normal appetites of most men I know but maybe they would be for some ladies enjoying snacks and cocktails at this establishment.  I would emphasize "snacks" as I don't think most folks would make a full meal out of most of the "sharables" menu selections here.  My video review is here:  https://youtu.be/jV7y9oeKjxk

Cherry Espresso Bar is located inside a building that is more than 100 years old. New Orleans coffee shops are often special places and this is another unique spot to enjoy your coffee and tea. This location next to Wisner Park was previously the old Laurel Street Fire Station and then it later served as a New Orleans Recreation Department Community Center before the city auctioned it off which led to us being able to enjoy some great coffee at Cherry Espresso Bar.   They serve some great coffee, tea and other tasty beverages along with a selection of baked goods.  This is a great spot to enjoy your caffeine and it has a good variety of seating options both inside and outside.  When you find yourself in the mood for some tasty hot beverages you should check this place out.  My video review of Cherry Espresso Bar is here: https://youtu.be/iV1AQiz7wc8

See's candies is California base bakery reach Florida. I know about this candies when my wife living in California. Their chocolate is very soft and tasty.   In Tampa, the International Plaza Mall has this temporary store from Thanksgiving to Easter. They located very close to H&M clothing store. You can have samples before you buy it. I got the lollipop candies. I also bought one assorted chocolate candies. They are very good. The store clerk was kind enough to let us try their assorted chocolate other their typical sample candies.   You can go with chocolate with nut, mint, toffee, milk, white or dark chocolate. All are good. Guilty pleasure with a touch at sweet side. Mail order through the web also available. If you close to the mall, just go to buy one without shipping.

We have big group of 12 for the office outing lunch. I would said for the number of people we have, the service is not the best but good enough. Only one of our members get the food late. The close out may need to work on it. Tip was added since we have large group which may my bill easy.   I have order the lamb kebab (Shish Kebab) plate. It come with two choices of side. I got the rice and the babaghanoush. The rice was well cook and nice aroma. The babaghanoush was well prepared and great with extra olive oil. The presentation of the dish is pleasant. However, the meat did not measured up. It was too dry and the marinated is not over the top. They need to improve on this area.   I have been here several time. My previous experience is better. During the month of Ramadan, they serve the buffet that are plenty of choices and attractive. I would said try them during this time. The buffet of Ramadan usually start at 8:30. Go early because is a lot of customers.

I could not find a pelican there today. At least not the rusty pelican. But if I sit long enough and I will become one since the view is nice and make you feel relax and still. I can be one.   This water front property has the killer bay view for the people who dine there. I would said it has nice sunset view. Price range is at high side for the food. The interior is well decorated. The dinning hall has the bay view. They have ball room can easily fit 200 people with bay east view.   I was here for a society meeting. We was done in this ballroom that is beautiful for wedding. Our entrée is not in the regular menu. It is shell pasta with stuff cheese in side. It accompanied with green beans and carrots. The food is good. This place is good with seafood and steak.   The service is good and attentive. Overall the welcoming host and restaurant do a good job.

The tire plus here is better than the one at new tampa. They are performed the tire change, balance, rotation or alignment better. I have come to here for my tire replacement.  I always find a 40,000 mile warranty tire here and change them almost every two year or more since tire do not last. What is the point to buy the good tire. The tire may be miss alignment once you hit the curb unintentionally.   They tire plus here have the life time alignment and balance if you buy the tire here. I already got my money worth since I have been here for more than tree time due to their life time program.  I suggest you do the same. Right now they have the tire in 59 minutes or you are free program if you make appointment. A smart way to come here is to make appointment and there is less wait.   They have wifi if you want to bring your computer while you wait for your car. Other than oil change, tire, and tune up please go to your dealer.

I would said this restaurant is unique in many ways. The cuisine, the setting of the restaurant, the attention of owner make the place great to eat. There are gluten free item and grass feed beef as their advertisements of the material of the food.   I like to mention a little about their sound system. It is front row seat to the concert. The restaurant invest a very good sound system that is pleasure to the ear. They also hide their speaker very well. Imagine they play the Star Wars music. May the force be with you.   We have order the taste of the islands and the blacken mango salmon. The taste of the island include curry goat, Ox tail and jerk chicken. The goat is a bit heavy smell. The jerk chicken is great with the seasoning they have. The best is the Ox Tail. The Ox tail with Caribbean spice make this dish special.  The blacken salmon is prepare with Caribbean blacken spice. It is very nice. It serves over cook pineapple sauce. The fish is tasty. This dish accompanied with a side salad. The desert we have is the coconut cake. The coconut cake has layers of coconut cream. It is guilty pleasure.   The greeting of the owner from the restaurant make this place special. The decorations is modern and it is gear up for upper class power lunch or dinner. Nice touch. Service is great and the cook is the owner wife. It is family run with attention to the details.

#700 review. Rare Ethnic food 1 - Guatemalan cuisine.   I choose Rincon Guatemalteco to start my 700 series in yelp review. I will start my ethnic review for next several reviews. The restaurant name meaning "in the corner of Guatemala." If you like get inside of this corner, please check them out.   The food is an authentic, special flavor, fantastic prep work, and unique. I was surprised by taste. Today we order the Tostadas de Frito. This is an appetizer. It is tostadas top with black bean paste and sprinkle with dry cheese. My wife mistaken the black bean as chocolate. You can smell the heavy fermented cheese smell before you eat.   The tamale we have is wrap around chicken pieces. The tamale paste is different than many tamale. The taste is more to rice paste than the bean paste texture.   We have the main dish as Carne Adobada. It is marinated pork with rice and black bean. I would describe the best black bean paste that I have. It cook with garlic and make this bean paste stand out from other black bean preparation.   The two drink that we have are Rosa Jamaica and  Tamarind. Rosa Jamaica is the best drink in the Bay Area. I have try many place for this drink. But this one stand out.  Please call before you go. Close on Wednesday. Tuesday close early. Weekday 9am to 6 pm. Weekend 9am to 7 pm.

The new remodel Gator Dockside looks a lot better than the old one. They have change the carpet floor to wood floor look more elegant. From the old projected TV to digital large screen TV. The renovation is welcoming the patron to the new football season.   I like to come to this restaurant mainly is their chicken wings. First, select the way you want it - Grill, breaded, wet sauce, or boneless. Second, select number of wings. Third, select the flavor. Tonight we have tried 12 different flavors. My top three I like most are grill chipotle BBQ, grill Thai chili, and the grill Yucatan. If you dare, try their 4 alam wings. This wing is super hot that one of our friends tries it and burn the mouth. I also like the peanut butter flavor with unique taste.   This sport bar is family oriented bar. Many families bring their kids. They have the children menu. The restaurant service is good and the food came out fast with 100 wings.

Cafe style. I have the take out all the time. This place have all kind Spanish food from fried whole fish to teriyaki chicken. They gave selection of small or big plate. Range from $4 to $6.50.   They also have devil crab, chicken or ground beef empanadas, stuff potato. They also have freshly make Cuban sandwich.   Compare to fast food change, cafeteria style is a better option. I always come here for for the guarapole ( sugar cane juice). They prepare the fresh squeeze on the site. It is good.   Please be aware the lunch crowd build up after 11:30 am. Please come early. If you come after 11:30 am, the line is already to the door. Friday night, music and fun is happen here. People gather after work for music.

Very establish bar. Every weekend is party at the front porch. People are gathering on the outside and have a good time with a boo. Independent has it character of the neighborhood bar. Very lively there.   We were there for the Nate Najar Quartet jazz music. This jazz team is well known in the Bay Area. Our share table has some people from St. Pete came here just for this night. This bar has many musicians performed here before. This is my first time to Independent and I like it due to their crazy bar tender. Nothing better to sat at the bar and see all the drink fly out from the bar. Sometimes you can chat to your neighbor and enjoy the music. I like it not too loud but the music is still can be appreciated.   They have some of bar food and good selection of local draft beers. I like it they post the percentage of the content of alcohol. You can know your limits when you order it if you have to drive home.

My wife's pick this place since we have a coupon to use. Like RJP said "blame it to the wife". Love to do it when you can get away reasonable doubt by saying wife pick the place. A lot eye candy in the restaurant with my wife. Strange.    My wife was at the restaurant first and she order ahead. I follow to the restaurant in 10 minutes. She order the lunch special with Chinese stir fry. Chinese food in winghouse? May be not. Her food came out like frozen section ready to cook meal from the Publix. I would not go for their Monday special.   They have two selection of fish sandwich in the menu. Grouper cousin or Mahi Mahi. Grouper cousin is one type of white fish. I definitely go for the real name fish- the Mahi Mahi. It can be grilled, blackened or deep fried. I have it grilled. The blacken Mahi Mahi is not the spicy type I like but it do have a good taste. This sandwich is better than their daily special.   The service is average. However, I think they need to be faster for lunch. Most people only have one hour.

Holiday shopping has big sale. The entire store with 25 % discount with purchase. The Black Friday sale make a lot people happy. It include me. It is huge with 25% of savings and back to the pocket. Although is Mc Donald value meal saving for each pair of shoes, I am happy too.   I got a pair of Nike Air Visi pro VI. It is very lightweight. It is only 2.4 lbs light weight basketball shoe. I always choose basketball shoes to prevent roll of ankle. This show normally run $56 to $150. But I got mark down and 25% off. I end up paid only $40.   The checkout line is long when they have good sales. I may be number 30 in the line. However they open two additional remote registers in additional to 6 registers they already have. I check out in 8 minutes. Customers care is great with long line.

My go to Walmart. It has most of the thing I need in great price. I like this Walmart in three different way. Grocery, daily use, and pharmacy. This is a super Walmart. So it has more items than regular Walmart.   Start with grocery. They have bakery, fresh produce, deli, meat and seafood, frozen section and many more. Price is acceptable. I like the Parmesan chicken wing. This is my favorite in the deli section. I like the cream pop at the frozen section. They do have Ahi tuna grade fillet. It good for seared or sushi.   Daily product includes clothing, sport items, electronic, art and craft, bicycle, jewelry, and more. I like the most is their eye glass center, you can get good pair of glass with lesser price with insurance cover. The pant and shock is my frequent item.   The pharmacy has the beauty product I need, it also has my daily care product like tooth paste, shampoo and mouthwash. Well. They are definitely very convenient for me.

This all you can eat sushi place is a lot better than the one they have in Carrollwood. Tastes, ingredients preparation, mix of rice are better. I would said lunch has the best value here.   We arrive on the early and seating is not a problem at week end. Through out the meal time, we still can see some seating is available on lunch.   We have order the spicy tuna, rainbow, saki, Mexican rolls. The sushi includes escolar, surf clam, salmon. We also order some items from habachi and stir fried.   The roll I like is the Fuji roll. It has spicy tuna and top with salmon and drizzle with eel sauce. The steak and shrimp hibachi is my favorite on the cook side. I also like the appetizer as Gyoza and the dessert with fried banana with chocolate dip.   Overall the service is great. The food is attractive. The serving speed is acceptable.

This is USF students hang out location. The bar has pool table and dart games. The pub is lively at weekend compare to weekdays. At weekdays is divey. However, they have killer wings.   If you come to this bar, try their wings. Many of the Tampa Bay Area wings are deep fried and sauce. I really don't like that way to prepare the wings. I prefer you either add a step like grilled it, marinated over night or breaded with flavor coating. This restaurant take a step further, the wings are marinated, slow smoke then baked per the menu. I think they at lease marinated with dry coating. I like their wings. Please try my favorite Parmesan and lemon pepper. You might want to look at their daily special combination that will save you some money including a game of pool.   The place has some draft beer dispensers on the left of counter that is not visible. So, please look for all local draft before order. The place is three stars base in ambient and furniture. The wing is five stars. I would say this is a 3.5 stars place. I am giving them 4 stars since there is no half star.

Keyword: Authentic, Northern Thai, Unique   I believe the above word define this restaurant. They are the best Thai now in my book in the Bay Area. This restaurant just open less than a month but it does have all the unique food that you will not find any where. One thing I have to warn you is their food is spicy when you have the chef select the medium hot. For me I like very hot.   They serve street food that only can be found in the northern kingdom of Siam - Khao Soi. This is a unique dish that only this restaurant have it. The  dish include crispy and egg noodle with chicken in coconut milk curry. The chicken include the breast and chicken drumsticks.   They also serve Pla Koong that I like. I have this dish when I am in Miami from an authentic Thai restaurant. I have try many Thai restaurant but non have come close. Now I found my favorite again. This is broil shrimps in very spicy mixed of lemony base spices. It include lemon grass and kefir lime leave. Yum. Very spicy. Love it.   We also order the crispy duck in basil leave. The spice they use is difficult to describe. Very good dish. We order a drunken noodle. But this time the noodle is too soggy. I have this noodle at their lunch before and it is better. We also order another northern Thai  - ginger curry. It is pork shoulder in long hours braised cooking. This is a sweet dish. For the rice you can order the white rice or the sticky rice. I never thought the sticky rice go very well with curry.   I hope all yelper make an extra mile to support new and unique restaurant. The menu is still evolving since they can cook many northern dishes of the Thai cuisine. This restaurant do not serve alcohol but they allow you BYOB. I brought my sake. Very convenient and saving.

Base on the affordable price, great food, and good service, this is considering 5 stars restaurant.   We have yelp group enjoy our time and food here. Since we have 7 in the group, we have ordered the Family Dinner. It is a whole chicken with salad, fried yuca, and cilantro rice. The salad is fresh with vinaigrette dressing. I like the cilantro rice with spice in rice. The chicken is marinated and slowly roasted with the skin is crispy outside. We have added the tostones - the flatten fried green plantain for other member to experience the food.   We also ordered the Cuenellis Special - Palomilla Steak with fried egg. The steak is well season and tasty, however, the steak may need to be tenderizing for better chewing. The dish also come with fried yuca, 1/4 chicken and fried sweet plantain. A lot food for affordable meal.

Before catching the flight, we like to have a catfish dinner. This restaurant locates 5 minutes from the airport. As a result you can time your meal before the flight.   The restaurant is affordable compare to any seafood restaurant in New Orleans. We have order a dozen of raw oysters and they are only $8. It came with reddish and cocktail sauce. The oysters are fresh and big.   The main course is the blacken catfish with Creole sauce with rice.  The catfish in New Orleans is great no matter which restaurant we went to. This restaurant also has the good catfish. I like the Creole sauce with smaller size shrimp in tomato base sauce.   The second dish is grilled tuna skew over rice Creole sauce. The tuna is assembling in the skew along with shrimp, onion, and bell pepper. The tuna is lightly season and grilled open flame. The shrimp along the skew is not as fresh as the tuna. The dish presentation is impressive with skew bridge over the Creole rice.   The service is good. The restaurant may need to renovate to newer furniture. I saw a lot of the local eat here due to good pricing.

Tonight is happy night to see my pal. Over the weekend I was able to meet up with Anna. But today I am meeting with three yelpiest friends to try the 7 course beef dish from my last review.   I have seven beef dishes on other Vietnamese restaurant before. The first course is the raw slice beef in the vinegar onion broil. Then beef is wrapping in rice paper with veggie. The sauce inside the wrap can be hoisin sauce and dip it on the fish sauce.  The second course is herb marinated slice beef to be cooked in butter. Then it is wrapping with rice paper with vermicelli. The third course is the slice beef in peanut. The first three courses require some work to wrap it. Some is skill with the wrap. The trick is not to over fill with material.   The fourth course is the ground beef in tea leave. The ground beef is marinated then grill on the frying pan. The fifth course is the beef balls with shrimp chip. The beef ball is cook with clear vermicelli. This ball can be break into pieces and pickup with the shrimp chip. With the crispy of the shrimp chip and ground beef, it create the sensation of the crispy and meat flavor. The sixth course is the Sherrard beef with porridge. It top with some fried onion and the parsley. By mixing it provide some mixture of the flavor. The seventh course is the slice pork on the outwardly roll around the raw green onion. The slice beef is marinated and grilled outwardly. This course can be improved if they caramel the onion first before the slice beefs rolling will be better. It will take away the onion spiciness.   Overall the food is good but challenge. It is a good meal to have when your group likes to have the long and good conversation. It will take time to finish. The two people for the seven courses are $35 and the 3 people are $45.

This is a restaurant when I travel and having coworker or boss with me. Chain restaurant is an easy obvious choice for the agreement of the selection. We were here for lunch and it is Wednesday.   Wednesday in any outback have special in their menu. I have tried their $12 three course menu. The first course is the Caesar salad. The lettuce is fresh and crispy. My entree is the glaze grilled pork tenderloin with a size. I have chosen the grilled asparagus as my side and I have added an up charge item shrimp in the Barbie. The pork was grilled wonderfully with tender meat. Each cut of the pork has preserved their juice in each piece. The shrimp is grilled and maintain the size of the shrimp. Seasoning is well prepared in this case. The tomatoes are cut to half and well cook for mouth watering enjoyment. The asparagus is not dry after grilling.  Good technique.   The third course is the carrot cake. The sweetness is well mix that not loses the ingredient taste of the carrot. This is the restaurant that I have repeated when I am go to Bartow or Orlando and need the meal before meeting. Wednesday is always the best day since they have good deal for the three courses or four courses.

This restaurant is recommended by my client. He grew up from Puerto Rico and he has indicated the food is close to his mom cooking. The Spanish music play in the background with lively atmosphere.   This the first time I try Puerto Rican restaurant in USA. I have Puerto Rico cuisine at Puerto Rico before. I can said the restaurant at La Casona has interesting Puerto Rican menu. It include traditional Mofongo. Mofongo is a fried plantain-based dish from Puerto Rico. It is typically made with fried green plantains mashed together in a with broth, garlic, bit fried pork belly. It can be filled with vegetable, meat or seafood. This restaurant open since 1999. It have Spanish base customer.   Today we have the seafood Mofongo and churrasco. The seafood Mofongo came with half of the lobster tail, shrimp, salty fish, muscle.  I was impress of my Mofongo serve with a bit wine base seafood broth. When you bite the olive they have cook with it, the wine juice came out and it is tasty and left wine fragrant in the mouth. This normally different than the Wikipedia description to prepare it. The broth base mix with the fried green plantain neutralize the salty of the broth. The two materials balance each other is the beauty of cooking. Good chef skill. The churrasco is ok. It can be better. Churrasco is Argentina food. Most of the time the Cuban restaurant prepare this dish better than anyone in Miami. You have choice with rice and bean or salad and sweet plantain.   The service is good and friendly. However, the close out and bring the check is slow. This restaurant customer tender to speak louder due the natural of the Spanish customer. Food is good portion. Most of time you will have enough to take home for the remained meal.

This is my second time here. They are open at the Christmas Day night. Not too busy compared to many other restaurant open at that day. The interior of this place is beautifully set up. I like their decorations.   We were sit immediately on second small room. Including us is about three tables of customers. We have ordered Black pepper basil crispy duck and Spicy noodle with squid. Food delivery is on time. The black pepper basil squid is average. The spicy noodle seem like not cook in high heat because I cannot taste the burn oil. Both dish is actually made for American Thai flavor. The local may like it but I am looking for good Thai which is average.   The service is not measured up. We were not able to get attention of our waitress. But the other two tables was able grab her attention. Some how we got ignored. The three stars for the food and the service we have experience.

Fancy fast food chain. A lot of choice for the sandwiches. Today I have the shave prime rib basket with upgrade to onion ring ($1 more) and my wife have the Atlantic cod basket with upgrade to shake ($2 more).  They give you a number and the food was brought to the table. This is plus that you don,t need to wait for your order at the counter. The food came in 5 minutes.   The shave prime rib is a bit salty. The onion ring and the cod came with a thick fried beard coating at the cover. To do the coating for deep fried have two method. The wet flour with material then fried or dry flour with material then fried. This restaurant chose the wet coating. As a result there is oil in the coating if you don't sit the food for a while and serve.   The service is good. However, I am not a fan for the wet coating. I believe the restaurant can improve on this front.  I not against the fry food but against the oily food due oil residue can be tasted at the onion ring coating.

The Seminole Hard Rock Casino of Tampa has a lot activity. It has the biggest hotel in the Bay Area. I am not much of the gambler but I come here often for their restaurant.   The casino is not smoke free place. As a result, it is stink to walk at the casino floor. Your cloth also will be stink due to the trap cigarette smoke. Ventilation has to be improved to improve the quality of the air.   If you feel lucky at night. Put some bating on slot or table games. Or you can test your skill of card games, poker or pi gau the Chinese domino.   The bars is every where. Drink never be a problem in this place. There is live performance on the casino floor or restaurant. But compare to Vegas, they need to have big auditorium for show. I think this is the area they have lack off.

September 11, 2001 I was at Miami working in the office before I move to Tampa. It was normal working day for a structural engineer. My coworkers rush in and said the World Trade Center has an explosion. We all went to conference room where the TV was showing the incident. That was about 9:00 am the news was broadcasting. We were wonder why.   At 9:03 am another plane drove into south tower and create big ball of explosion. Now we know our country is under terrorist attack. At that day we all are heavy heart to watch the news of this incident.   I has seen some people jump off the window due to no exit below the damage floor and smoke and fire below floor. Later the south tower falling. There is smoke all over the place. And many people has lost their live including the emergency responders. White dust everywhere and cover the whole City of New York. The north tower was fallen following that.   There were 4 planes hijack that day. One to the pentagon and the other fall into the ground with the awareness of passengers fight with terrorist.   These attacks have change our nation protecting our border. It created the homeland security department to further prevent this kind of attack. The tall tower building design also changed the approach to account for explosion force.   This memorial with a piece of World Trade Center has reminded me during that day. We owe many thanks to emergency responders including the police and fire department, hospital emergency responders, and many heros.

I am here because of Johnathan review that they really put out a good Thai Hot restaurant. There is no hold back. So if you ask for spicy, watch out. There is no American Hot.  The restaurant has good ratings. The interior is open seating hall that most efficiently for maximum seats. The owner pay attention to the customers. And the wait staff is alert enough. They have extensive menu for your choice.  We got the Drunken Noodle and the Lad Na Noodle.  The drunken noodle is a bit wet. I like it dryer. But they did a Thai Hot for me. The spicy of the chili extended to my throats. The spiciness stay at my mount at least good 7 minutes. The Lad Na noodle is crispy noodle with beef. Food is good. We also got the stuff chicken wing. This is a dish that not normally serve. This actually the best dish. Like the staffing with pork.

The gimmick sushi. I have been conveyor belt or rotation sushi in Miami 10 year ago. Now Tampa got their first rotation sushi. The seat booths are well decorated. This method is already popular in Japan. I saw quite a few when I visited Hokkaido.   This type of food stand supposed to provide quick sushi for short lunch time or snack with no wait. Tonight we came in late at 8:30 pm. I would said come in at weekday not weekend and late or early of meal time is better. One- don't have many people. Two-easy attention from waiter. Three-most important is order the fresh items that is not there and fresh to eat. Since the time we arrive is late, the chef start not adding dish in the conveyor belt. This actually better for me that I can order the fresh items. I would suggest the same thing if you want to try this place.   We have order the spicy tuna, blossom roll, spicy pepper calamari, masago. I like their spicy tuna since it is all tuna meat in the roll, no added cucumber to occupy the meat space.

Rare Ethnic Food 5 - Viennese cuisine.  The food serve similar to German cuisine due to the country next to each other. We know about this restaurant when we were at a casual conversation with Michele D. husband. He mention to us this hidden location that serve a good similar German food.  We were here for their early bird special. The special is a good deal for this restaurant. They have seven items to choose from. It come with a choice of salad or soup. I have the Sauerbraten and my wife has the Pork - Weiner Schnitzel. I like me Sauerbraten. This is pork tenderloin in wine sauce. It come with red cabbage and the Spaetzle. The red cabbage is like pickle veggie. The Spaetzle is like starch short noodle. My appetizer is the tomato soup. A bit sour for me but it is good after add pepper and salt.   The ambient is very nice. I like it old school represent the country of the cuisine. Kuku clock, bear ceramic cup, the flag.  The service is very good. I love this mom and pop shop. I will be back.

Cute little store in Gulfport small town. It located at Beach Blvd. if you need a home deco of small pieces art, this store may be your choice.  It has very good selection of the designer lamps. They are very colorful if you like the unique lamp that cannot be found in typical furniture store, here you have plenty.   The wall art pieces are Floridian style. They are contemporary. All this lamp and wall art are the work of the local artists.

The Shop of Wiregrass Mall offer shopping, dining, exercising, kid club, community for the people of Wesley Chapel and New Tampa. I have been there many time and enjoy every time. They have Kid area for the activity. It is great to walk at the mall by the window shopping.   This mall is very lively due to farmer market, Christmas event, spring fair, and now the Easter event. This mall has line up event to keep it sales up. You won't believe they have Yoga at the lawn, Kid Club and many other event. Please check their web site. They also have stage area for the performance and gather the community together.   The restaurant selection also very good. I know most of my friend go there for evening walk or dog walk. They also have the bookstore with coffee and music store with lesson. If you asking for activities, they have ton of it. One thing I like the most is their paseo drive. It is almost like the Rodeo Drive. Although not fancy but very pleasant.

This is my special review for a single vender in the French Market. The reason that they need special attention is due to the unique food that they are prepared. If you visit the French Market, do not miss up the opportunity to try their food. Their vender stand is located at the last vender stand of the food venders at first open air structure. It is very much at the middle of two open air structures.   They occupied three vender stands and a front open air stand. You will not miss it. The front vender stand offers the roast cone and broil peanut. They roasted their corn in the enclose smoker. Once they receive the order, they will peel off the skin and show the ear. Then they will dip the corn to the hot butter, and season with salt, parmesan cheese (yum), Cajun spice (wow). My wife loves this corn. The inner vender stand serves the deep fried corn, crab cake, gator bites, and frog leg. They also serve different type of fruit drink and icy. We were curious the deep fry corn did not turn to pop corn. The vender owner assures us it will not happen. Evidently, it does not and coated with thin cajun coating. I have concluded the deep fried corn is a boy food and the roast corn is girl food base on the preference.  We also order the home made crab cake. The surprise is not the crab cake; it is the side dish that comes with it. The deep fried kale. I have the deep fried kale at the Cool Bean restaurant in Tallahasse FL. I did not expect they are as good as the restaurant grade. The Kale is deep fried for 30 second then season. The best thing is when you put on the tongue and the kale melt like cotton candy. The vender did a very good job.

Mei World Pizza has pizza and something that you not imagine they have it - The Taiwanese cuisine. I was able to take picture of the whole Chinese menu for the patrons who look forward what they are cooking. They are very flexible and they can cook to your order - meaning not in the menu.   Mei World Pizza has another name in Chinese. The beautiful food World. Which mean the great food of the world. The specialty include noodle that is home made by hand from the kitchen. These noodles are not buying from grocery store. As a result, it creates the specialty of the restaurant with the fresh made noodle. Every Saturday weekend has fresh made dumpling. They are not frozen. They will made and cook at the spot. In winter, they cure their own meat and sell it on the February, March and April.  During that time you find the cure meat food that is not in the menu.   The secret is out. Go enjoy the beautiful bowl of soup noodle or have them cook a special cuisine for you. I will be back to try their different food.

#900 Review. Rare Ethnic Food No.11  Small business with hard working people deserve to be recognized for their success. Not only for their home feel cooking but also for the very good rare items they have served.  Before we were there, we check the people who posted the review. Many people who posted has less than 2 reviews. And only 9 were posted. No elite has posted until me and my wife visit. They have been open since last November and they have not catch attention of elite Yelper.   Little Angel (Angelito) is bringing the love of food in our area. They are Puerto Rico and Latin cuisine. We have the pork shoulder with rice and the rotisserie chicken with mofongo. Both dish is excellent. The pork marinated very well the chicken is excellent. The mofongo is the best I have taste with garlic base. The rice dish have a choice of side. Since they run out of the sweet plantain, they give me a choice of their special made salad -  ensalata guineo en escabeche. This salad I have never seen before. It is chicken gizzard with plantain. The sauce or the dressing is out of the chart.   Other than their regular menu, they have hot deli food that are cook ready to serve only on weekend. They showcase the special salad I have mentioned above. The pig feet also in Friday only deli dish is excellent. The skin and meat fall off the bone.   Service is excellent. Now the secret is out. Go enjoy it.

We were at St Pete on the Shine Mural Event. This is the one mural we did not see because it is hidden. When you think you are at the destination from the map they given to us, it actually below us.   This tunnel is cross under the 1st Avenue South to connect the Tropicana Field and Ferg Sport Bar & Grill. It is cool to walk there when the sun is set with black blue light of the tunnel is on. I grew up with Nestle coffee in my home. This is rather a memory for me when I am young. Nestle products always is my favorite before the wold has Starbucks. I am still go for my number one choice the Nestle coffee mix with red tea and milk in ice.   The Nestle Toll House offer many food items. It include hot item like flat bread, paninis, wrap, quesadilla. The cold treat includes ice cream scoop, real fruit smoothie, ice cream sandwich, and other frozen treat. They have hot coffee like latte, white mocha, turtle mocha, and more. The cold coffee includes mocha frappe, butterfingers frappe and more. Come to check it up.   This store just open not long ago. I will be back to try other products. When you come to the Tampa Premium Outlet, please check them up.

Marble Slab or Maggie Moos are the same company. We use to have a Maggie Moos near our neighborhood then it was close. They are the few ice cream chain who started mix the ice cream on top of the frozen marble. First select your ice cream, then select your so call topping. They will mixed the ice cream with select topping into your ice cream. It is kind cool.   The price is base on the cup size. It doesn't matter how many flavor you want, as long as it can fit in the cup. This time I have the rum and cotton candy flavor. Instead of mixed the toppings into the ice cream, I have requested just sprinkle on top of the ice cream. I like their cotton candy flavor. It has very great taste. There was non other ice cream store have this cotton candy flavor. It was very hard to describe. I have so many of the cotton candy flavor, this is the best.   The clerk is friendly. The ice cream can be sample before you have decided.

I am using this restaurant to mark my 100 review. This will be the restaurant I will likely repeat when I come back to New Orleans. This is one of my favorite restaurants in New Orleans. Each reservation or walk in is allowed for 1.5 hours dining in the prime evening by the restaurant. The restaurant offer blue music while eating. The musician is very good and talented. They can kick into high gear or take it slow like Big Easy.   This restaurant located Marigny area. This is a hypies area. Many people around this area are care free. But the restaurant is considered a high end even though they are located in this area. We love the performance by the musician. The guitar and harmonica have their solo highlight display the talented tune. The singer also great and the song is about the daily life.   Tonight we have order the Two Run Farms Lamb Sliders, Beer Braised Kurobuta Pork Belly, Bleu Cheese Stuffed Dates, Seared Scallops, Crab Dra Diavolo Cannolloni and Deviled Yard Egg. Most of the dishes have a choice of small or large quantity. Our first dish is the Deviled Yard Egg. The egg filling include seasoned egg yolk. It garnish with seasoned chop vege and top with deep fry broccoli flower. You will experience with crispy, sweet vege, and salty paste taste. The second dish Bleu Cheese Stuffed Dates. The Dates wrap in bacon and drizzle with sweet vanilla balsamic vinaigrette. The Bleu Cheese is stuff in the Dates and the combination allow for salty first then sweet (bacon to sweet dates). The third dish is  pork belly. This is my favorite dish in the restaurant. The pork belly is slice in rectangular cube. They pork belly is actually braise to soft the texture then slightly sear at the outside. It place on Chinese flat bread and garnish in the pickle cucumber. When you place the pork belly at your tongue, you can feel the pork belly fat actually melt away. This is actually a Chinese technique to cook the pork belly in pressure cooker and braise in slow fire. This is a dish should not miss. The fourth dish is the Crab Dra Diavolo Cannolloni. This is fresh pasta with spicy crab meat filling. It is cook with tomato sauce with caper.  The pasta is refreshing. The fifth dish is the Lamb Slider. The lamb meat is grounded and seasoned. It cooks over the open flame and top with tomato creamy sauce. The last dish is the seared scallop. The scallop is seared and serve with charizo, red lentils and bok chai.   Overall we enjoy the great music over the meal. I have order the local brewer beer - southern pecan beer. It is great to go with the meal. The service is great. I am award this restaurant with five star to start my 3 digit review.

Great museum in Carmel, Indiana. It is worth the money to visit. Plan at least 1 hour for the visit. It took us 1.5 hours. They have seven room of miniature items. They also have on sale miniature item if you want to build your own miniature house.   They have many types of houses. Southern house, many northern houses, Central America house, and more. Most house has front opening, some has roof opening, some has side opening for you to peek inside the house. I can said some of the item is really small but still captures the details. I saw one tea pot is less than 1/8 inches but it has extraordinary detail.   The fabric of the furniture is great with detail printing. Some even has stitch flowers. Some of the southern cloth is detail to the flowers, edging, ribbons. Can you believe they have quilts in detail.   I would said give them a visit if you are at Indianapolis.

Auntie Anne's provide quick and easy outlet for little munchkin. Every time I past by the Auntie Anne, they are doing something. One time they spinning the pretzel dough, this time they butter the bun and dipped in the cinnamon sugar.   I was here for a thirsty drink. They have the old fashioned lemonade and the combination lemonade with added strawberry ice drink. I am traditional guy, so go with the old fashioned lemonade.   The service is friendly. In the making of their bread, the bread smell in oven flow out and did trigger your thoughts of food.

I am not a coffee person since the caffeine do nothing to keep me awake. Basically the coffee is just the pleasure drink. I wanted to try this place since our CM podcast interview with the owner. They have good wide space in this coffee shop. It is also in historical district of YBOR.   They have coffee brewing class. If you use Yelp check in, they will have the 50% of the class. Every season they have special coffee features. For summer there are features the ice coffee, and same for the winter they reverse to hot coffee. Somethings for everyone.   Today I have the Dirty Thai Jer. It is the Thai tea with condense milk, two shots of espresso. It is interesting drink. The wait for the mix is quick since not many people drink coffee after 7:30 pm. This coffee is concentrated with good enough tea. In Asia call it yin yang.

This supermarket is doing the customers attraction sales right since it is just open. They are many sales items make people visit this place many time during the opening week. Price is the lowest in the area for many items in the area. Please go before the honeymoon period is over.   I was reading many reviews indicated this place like a zoo. We were there during the Oscar Red carpet show. There is no crowd and easy access. This prove many of the shoppers are ladies who love Oscar:)  The supermarket has many to offer. Hot deli, fresh make pie and bakery, juice up. Because of the current promotion and pricing, I could not really rate this store. The promotion price are low as a result the material which tie to price is very acceptable now. What happened the full pricing in motion will be determined at later review.

I like this new location for Goodwill. It is new and clean. You can find the seasoning decoration here. Especially we are close to Halloween. There so many discounted Halloween costumes on display. Fake hair, pirate hat, big tie, superhero outfit, cape and more. Very much like party store. Many of this items was donated from people and the party commercial left over from last season.   Other items including use clothing for men and women. I saw some recent thick bottom shoe here. Why not wear to the party once then donate back and buy another pair for the next party. That way you don't need to keep full closet of shoe the seldom wear.   They also vary some use decoration for seasonal. The kitchen department has many plate and cup. This item definitely can be reused.

Many can go wrong with technology that sum the restaurant problem.   Like - I like restaurant has opening look. Good wall art. Nice party look of the bar area. Seem like everyone have a good time.   Bad - Service less restaurant. The order is made at the counter. An electronic buzzer is issued to let you know your food is ready. Then you pick up the food your self. Yes it save a lot of money to hire service people. Is you food cheaper? No.   I have order to go and issue a buzzer. When I pick up the food, there is brown bag of your food is ready. I ask is this buzzer 18. The service people in the kitchen said yes. I took it home and they are not my order. Do I drive back round trip 18 miles for exchange. Probably not. I eat what is in the bag. And it is bean with ground beef burrito. The bean and ground beef below average. It is bad that I not even want to post the picture of the food. With food order wrong, now they have two not happy customers. Customer that have the wrong order and customer did not have the food.   Below can be improved. Put some service waitress. 1. Do not have the customers to pick up the food themselves at the counter. I cannot tell how many other customers has touch my food. This is not professional. Please hand the right order to the right person. 2. Put identification on the brown bag since each order look alike. Identify the right order staple with order ticket. 3. Train the kitchen people with proper order is make.    Too confusing. Burrito is below average

It is nice Marriott at the airport. It is convenient for any traveler for short duration. You can spent a tire there in airport or you can get a rental car to go to your destination. This Marriott is close to everything.   We were here for the meeting held here. They have a conference room to hold more than 500 people. Most conference has complimentary parking below the building. They have two levels of parking garage below. Also includes the none cover parking site.   Our conference cater the hotel food. We have choice of diet like fish, veggies and grilled chicken. The veggies is the sautéed corn and tomato in tomato sauce. The chicken come with sautéed mixed veggies. The chicken breast is grilled over rice. A creamy sauce was top at the chicken. Chicken maintain it moisture. Tasty. But lack of salt.  I like the dessert. Our cheese cake have good crust. Services is medium.

Extreme Taco bring the taste to the Water Ave Sulphur Springs area. I saw many good comments from my Yelp friend. And my wife brought back a taco for me to try at home. I decided to try at the store.   Parking at this area is challenging. Very limited or you can park at K-mart at walk across. There is a lot people even it is 4 pm of the day. The owner is very personalized and provides good service.   I have order the steak, pastor and grouper tacos. I like my Taco naked to see the true taste. When you order extreme, it cover by other ingredients. The grouper and the steak is average for my experience. But the pastor is tasty and well seasoning.   Overall their price is at the high side. Naked taco is about $2.79 each. The extreme taco is $3.79. For this price I usually treat them at restaurants level. Which they are not. Overall they are good.

Big smoke house. Be prepared to wash your clothes and wash your hair after visit. The Korean BBQ smoke will stick with you. So you know what you need to wear. If you have a group that join you, they will smell like BBQ when you you hug them good bye :)   66 QPot restaurant name if I guess it right, it mean 66 Street BBQ and Hot Pot. Nice name. It tell you what they serving before you walk in. I would said it is 4.5 stars restaurant. I also would said this may be the best money can buy for hot pot and Korean BBQ combo in Tampa Bay Area.   Plenty of selection for the buffet. The buffet hot pot is $23, Korean BBQ is $27 and combo is $30 per person. Good meat, seafood and veggies selection. A lot fun to eat it with friends. Don't go by yourself. They have 4, 6, 8 and 10 people table.   To eat this, you may need a bit of cooking skills. You need to broil and grilled technique. There are also plenty of sauces that you can mixed for dipping. Choose your soup base to start for hot pot. Limit three BBQ meat at a time. Once finished, you can order more.   It is good place to pass your time. Skip dessert and salad bar first. Enjoy!

The revisits of the burger joint by select the different items in the menu make me feel they are better choice. I would suggest not go for the shave prime rib, Atlantic code, or onion ring. These are the items I am not recommended. Go for the burger.   Since we have sign up for the e-club. They have given us a coupon of but one get one free value basket. We have order the double cheese burger with bacon. We have up the cost from our value basket to a strawberry shake and curb cheese ball. The up charge is only $1.60. Our total price for two burgers and the upgrade side is less than $11 with coupon. Talking about the saving, this is a good value. The burger patty is ground beef smash into thinner piece and over hot plate grill top. The meat is seared to crispy since they are thin. As a result, the burger is great on taste. Because the patty is so thin, you may wonder when you have order double and it look like single.   Please sign their mailing list and you can receive the coupon. Great services have put them in the 4 star. They are people constant check on you and take away the trash from your table.

When we first visited the Ice Centre, we know there is a restaurant going to be open in the Centre. It take them a year for this restaurant to be open. When we know about the news for opening this month, we decided to stop by and check. I also invite couple of Yelp friends to join us.   Judging the price of the menu, it is about 10% more than regular restaurant. However we were no regrets that because the food measured up with the price we paid. It still has some bump to iron out, our waitress is still don't know which beer is happy hours. They offer happy hours item from 4 pm to 7 pm Monday to Friday. The app is 25% off from the pregame section. The draft beer is $2 off.   We started with Ybor egg roll. It has mojo pork, ham and salami wrap together. Who can resist it. I also get the tuna bowl. It seared blacken Ahi tuna over rice and Asian slaw. It has the honey soy ginger sauce. It was quite good. Lastly we have the Top Shelf wings. This is must have item. It is about $0.20 more than normal outside restaurant wing place. However, it worth the money. This wing is marinated in mojo sauce, then grill over the open flame and top with the house sauce. It was delicious.   Overall is good experience. The place has TV. But who actually watched it when you can see live hockey from the high school competition. Love the game, love the food.

The Sundial St. Pete has a lot of activities. We have participated two free activities here. One is Argentina Tango and the other is Lindy Hop swing dance. Both event is fun and great. You have a chance to dance with different partner.   The Sundial decorated with 4 giant artificial trees for shade. There big giant Sundial in the middle tell time. This is very much one of the attraction with shops and movie theaters. The restaurants include Locale, Sea Salt, Ruth Chris, Farm Table Cucina. You also enjoy the movie at AMC theatre.   The design in plan view with four trees with blue tile just shapes like river through rain forrest. The plaza surrounding the courtyard make is a shield from wind for any outdoor activity. The second floor out look the courtyard make it leisure and relax while enjoying your food.

Desi located at telecom park. Which they can get a lot Hindu customers who work on IT at this commercial park. They located at the end unit of the plaza which allows them to have some outdoor seating. During the weekday, they serve Tali plate. Weekend they serve buffet for lunch.   The buffet have a lot meat selection. I like the mutton curry. Among the meat curry, I also like their chili chicken and the chicken curry. Tandoori chicken is also good there. They have served different biryanis. But I like the noodle. One thing special I can said is the shrimp curry. It is interesting.   Overall the price is at the high side. I do not get the wow factor. But I can tell you they don't make it less spicy because of Americans. They did spicy the food which suppose to be. I would give them 3.5 star f

I have book mark Honu for some time. Honu is Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle which is remarkable creature. They have plenty of the decoration about this type of turtle at their wall. Those are cute turtle picture on display.   We were there New Year eve and they are the only few still have space for 6:30 sitting. We were plan to eat there and go to the New Year show. We start with the Musubi - sautéed spam in seaweed and rice. Very interesting. The second dish is the special of the day with salmon poke and thin piece rice cake. This is interesting dish too. We have the stack - slow cook pork on sushi rice top with claw slaw. The rice is not my liking. The pork are sweet. The final dish Mauna Kea Keck II - slow cook beef on the spinach with twin scoop of rice. The beef is average. The rice definite needs improvement.   Overall the service is very good. The dishes presentation are well design. However the food seasoning and taste is not there. I like the live music and dollar champagne for good New Year celebration.

Very prominent sushi place for the purpose of small night snack. Unfortunately during pandemic, they still don't allow dine in. I would definitely like to do that. I like this sushi place because the restaurant is good for late night snack with sake or beer.   The food is affordable and the takeout is busy. The walk in order take about 15 minutes to prepare. We wait at the car and they deliver to your car. I got the goyoza, spicy tuna, and unagi eel. The roll at medium size. The spicy tuna with good ahi. The flavors good. The goyoza also crispy. Great snack for the night. The unagi has enough eel sauce to sweet it up.   Overall my experience for the take is great. I will like to visit them at night when they start the dine in again.

Rare Ethnic food 3 - Salvadoran cuisine. It is located in the Latin area of MLK. The most recognize item is pupusa. Pupusa Loca is a corn tortilla wrap with cheese, ground mix meat, refried bean. This restaurant serve this dish for $4 and come with stir fry cabbage. Very good dish.   I have the churrasco with rice, veggie and salsa. Their churrasco is thin cut and grilled. Top with lemon juice. A bit sour. The meat is not the best of skirt steak but it is good enough. I like it a bit burn end on the meat to make it tasty.   We have the tamal salvadoreno. It is Salvadoran tamale. This tamale is bean base.   What impress me is the drink. I have order the cashew drink-maranon. This is the first time I have this drink. It smell very good and help on the thirst.   The service is average.

It is about 3.5 stars, not a four stars. Some of the original items in the restaurant opening was removed due to lack of interest. Especially the fish cheek. This Ichicoro has the best layout. I like it partition to many room. At least they have chair with back support.   We started with the chicken karaage and GYU Bao. I like coating and the sauce of the Karaage. It is delicious. But the GYU Bao is just below average. The meat of the GYU is just not feel it.    We also has the GYU yakitori. I like this one better. The meat is well marinated. The quantity of the skew is tiny. Can be larger. We have the Tako Amiyaki. This grilled octopus dish is a mush have. Very delicious. Our final dish is the Tekkadon. The tuna poke on the rice. Good amount of food. The rice seasoning is great.   The service is good. The price for the food is at the high side. The quantity need to be more.

Thai 5 is certainly match the top 100 of Yelp list that just recent published. Their kitchen is still in the food truck. I have seen the previous food truck move out this location and become a restaurant. I believe one day they will too.   We have order the Tom Yum Soup. I would say this is the best I have taste. For this restaurant medium hot is too hot for many people. For me is just right. This restaurant definition of hotness is bring the heat. So be careful what you asking for. You may have difficult time to kiss your date after burning lip and past the caliente heat kiss to you love one.   We have order the crab fried rice and duck noodle soup. I have order the Thai hot and it came with it. I like it very much for this fried rice since it is different than other cuisine fried rice. The dish do have chunk of crab meat. The duck noodle is street type vendor flavor cooking. The duck is deboned and easy to enjoy. The curry base soup is yummy to eat.   I give them 4 stars is they pricing is in the high side for food truck (value vs. restaurant setting) and they run out of material for certain dish. The food is 5 stars.

This restaurant located in the Hilton Garden Inn near airport. This is interesting to see a restaurant in the hotel. We were here for lunch. The food is not cheap for lunch and dinner after we look at the menu. As long they can provide a good food. We are good.   We order the chicken panini and the Margherita Classic. The panini is good. Chicken was grilled. Accompanied fries was crispy. The Margherita is a flatbread top with chop steak with mozzarella cheese. It very good. Overall the food is good. The wait is a bit longer for the food.   The reason is three stars is due to waiter didn't pay attention to the table. Even we try to flag him down. Lunch during office hour usually is short. They need to paid attention we try to paid and get put. It take us ten minutes to finally get his attention.

Place is new and clean in the neighborhood. Restroom also clean to use. We stop here after pumping my gas station next door. The Dunkin is connected to plaza. Easy access fro US 301. Their coffee was on sales that day. We walk on the right time.   I have blueberry coolata. It is a bit sour but bearable. Is is sweeter will be nice. I like it to be refreshing. My wife have coffee with hazelnut flavor. It is also good enough for just a fraction of price.

Gas today 1-14-2015 is $1.85. I have went inside the store but has not buy anything yet. The whole facilities is less than one month old. This is not the biggest Wawa like the one that next to the Hard Rock Casino. However, due to the newly open Wawa, they are running low gas price. If you happen to pass by I-275 and Bearss check out the northeast corner for Wawa. The price war for the new Wawa properly run for another month.

I think their quality is dropping compared to my previous visit. Since they open the new store at St. Pete., the taste of the food drop. May be now they move their best cook to the new location. The meat is not as tastier. The shrimp taco is just above average. I would rather they burn a bit outwardly.   Price also more expensive than my last visit. I think my fantasy of the first place on the join has move to other taco place.

This restaurant is evaluating for their food not their local brew beer. The two star was given due to after food experience. After dine their food I have to go to restroom several time. It take me a day to clear my stomach pain. Some of the food is not up to the quality.   The restaurant do have a lot of customers. Seem like a good joint. Especially the private local brew beer. It has the brewery just next to it with tour. I did not try it. I am straight to the restaurant.   I got the blackened rock shrimp and the Belgium Blonde. I like the Belgium blonde beer. The rock shrimp dish include the spinach fettuccine, mushroom, andouille sausage, yellow bell pepper. The sauce is creamy. The rock shrimp is firm. Not sure which item did not measured up cause stomach diarrhea. May be the sauce. Anyhow my experience is not good with the food.

Chris W check in here often. It is almost like his gone home to his mom cooking. As a result I have to check it myself. First thing to do is not to follow the google map. It take you close to the location but still one block away. They are at the intersection of Tampa Bay Blvd and Tampania Ave. They are not at the Armenia and Tampa Blvd. they are one block west of that intersection.   At Friday night they serve the special of Spaghetti in Crab Sauce. This is a very yummy dish. It is sauce with crab meat with it. I would said lump crab meat. I saw the cook carefully put the sauce in the plate. They already premix the spaghetti sauce for you. You just need to dig in. It also come with good fried veal cutlet. It is a meal for two or one hungry person.   This is an authentic Italian restaurant. The only thing I can find wrong is the restaurant need to ventilate the food oil in the restaurant. It will not be good after the meal and try to hug your date. It smell like food. And it make you hungry again and want to eat your date:). I would said this is a very good value meal.

Great jerk food. Fist one at New Tampa Area. I have read many reviews indicating this place is slow, as result, I came here at 11:15 am before everyone showed up. I was the second in line and the food is not much of wait. During 12 noon, I can see the line building up. May be that is the reason why most reviews don't like wait.   I got Jamaican traditional dish. The Ackee and Salt fish. The Ackee is fruit from West Africa. And now is widely planted in Jamaica. This dish is Jamaica National dish. The salt fish was clean an diluted with water before add into it. This dish is $17.   Our second dish is the fried chicken. I like this dish very much. They have great coating outside. It is like some curry or cumin. It come with rice and plantain. I would recommend this dish. It is lunch special. Good deal.   Our experience is great here. Definitely go for the oxtail. It has great flavor when we ask for the gravy for the fried chicken.

To begin my 1800 series, Sushi Sho is legit on tasting the good sushi. It is a good show on the sushi they made. I would said this restaurant is 4.5 stars in my book. Not yet 5 stars. Since no 1/2 stars,  5 stars is given.  I got the $80 nigiri omakase. I believe this is the best value of all. It is actually good to have about $5 a piece sushi for good quality ingredients. My omakase is 17 pieces and includes a appetizer and dessert. The topping is actually enhancing the taste. Since this is trade secret, I only going to tell you, the topping including citrus family sap, Perilla, scallions.   The sushi was perfectly arranged. It has wasabi hide underneath the fish and many already has the whiskey barrel soy sauce. These sushi has been sauce right amount of sauce. As a result, you no longer use any soy sauce that over dipping kill the fish taste. That is the art for this restaurant with some of citrus family sap, soy sauce and wasabi. This is where a great sushi chef be.   My 17 pieces include fish from Japan, local catch and international catch. The local catch has baby amber jack, gulf shrimp. It is good to prepared to the specific pieces of good sushi. I also like the surprising piece not in the menu such as Isaki. This is a tree trunk Japanese fish.  Very interesting fish with the skin attached.   I like the Hokkaido scallops, medai, king salmon, and big eye tuna. I also like the appetizers with big eye tuna carpaccio with special ponzu sauce. The service is good. Very attentive sinc

I have a late lunch here. I walk into the restaurant at 2:20 pm and they have two table occupied. I was sit immediately.   The furniture is a bit old. The table is a bit sticky. The waiters were nice and courteous. I got the steak taco with rice combo. It is $9.95. The food came out in 10 minutes. The tortilla is a 8 inches flour tortillas. It is big and they have to stick the tortilla with toothpick. The steak is regular steak nothing fancy. No special cut section. It is definite good with fill up you stomach. They guacamole, cheese and salsa for the add on.   The rice is nicely cook and typically prepared. Before the meal come, they provide the chip and salsa. The salsa came in a small dish. It is easily finish with less than 10 scoops. I have to ask for more.   Overall is not the five star restaurant. Service is good. It is done that check off deal.
