If you looking for meat, they have deal in the store. I got beef flank steak only for $4.95 a pound for the special of the day. It has many types of beef and pork cut.   The meat market serves hot deli such as empanadas, tacos, fried chicken and more. The price of those deli food are affordable. It has package deal. For is ok since the price is low no complaints. They do have the seating area if you decide to eat there.   The veggies section just like normal supermarket and same as the can good and un perishable food. They do have special soft drinks. Some from drink still at original bottle packaging.   This store just like typical supermarket but is local own. The advantage is the meat they have sold here. If you have huge party at your home and hosting a BBQ, this is a good place to purchase your meat.

This restaurant is open space bar near airport. It is also next to strip club. As a result their operated hour to late night or early morning. It is good place for snack or late supper.   We were here at their happy hours. The appetizers selection is decent. The price also decent. We started with old forester bourbon. I have it straight. The first appetizer is the Hellcat Wing. The wing was fried with choice of dipping sauce. The second app is the chicken and waffle slider. The fried chicken has good coating. The waffle need some work. The third app is the wildcat shrimp. I recommend this dish with good shrimp. The fourth app is munition mussel. I like they way prepared the sauce in the mussels. It is decent. Out last app is the prime rib slider. This dish I also recommend. The prime rib was well prepared.   Overall our visit is positive. Very close to 4.5 stars. Definitely worth a visit. Service is good.

GUAC has a good thing go with it. They just need to have more customers. The time we have visited was Saturday evening. It is half fill with customers during our visit.   We were here for the Taco Week. At the bar, there are two person man the station. One paid attention to what we need and the other just not engaging. I am glad at lease the one not take our order still paid attention to us.   I would said the quality of the ingredients is there. We got the shrimp, steak and specialty shrimp taco.  As I said good quality of the steak and shrimp. But need salt on the meat and shrimp. The shrimp was blackened, but the taste is not there. I think the restaurant has potential. Price is about right. But the food need to savory.

It is good start for the poke work. They are ready on first day. The entire crew able to serve customers at the first day. Method and ingredients are correct. Pokeworks located at the mall near the food court.   I did take advantage on their grand opening special but one get one free. We have free samples of the sorbet ice while we wait on the line. I like their choices on the base, ingredients, topping. At the base they have a choice that no poke place has it yet - the kale noodle. It is delicious. On the topping, they have and item like fried slice lotus root. That is unique at it on way.   In addition, they mix the ingredients separately with sauce or flavor. Their worker are well train and costume to your order. They ask you you want light, medium or heavy sauce. It give you adjustment for not too sweet or salty of your food. Great choice. I am a fan for this poke. Many other poke store need to learn from them.

I think the rating here is a bit overrated. I think their poke is at the middle in comparison with the poke stores in Tampa Bay Area. This restaurant has some good thing and not so good thing.   Let begin what they do well. The protein selection are excellent. This is the item they do very well. Their protein included Tuna, Salmon and especially the Scallops. Their scallops are sea scallops with giant size scallops. Do you know Tarpon Springs has scalloping your. The shrimp is cooked with seasoning and very nice. Other worthy mention is the octopus protein.   Now, the bad side. The base. The rice is too soft and not hard enough. Like old people food. Seem like too much water to use for cooking the rice. The sushi rice not really taste like sushi rice preparation. Very limited of the mixed in. Second. They only allow number of choice for mixed in. Compare to other place, many offer unlimited selection. Third. The sauce like ponzu, soy sauce, eel sauce all are too watery. Fourth, I can see when they pick up the mixed in, the water from the mixed in containers are drip into your poke.   One thing for sure, their poke is fresh enough.

This Froyo- frozen yogurt - is intriguing. If you are for that, they have the many flavors of frozen yogurt. It includes many toppings such as fresh fruit and candy. They also has smoothies with fresh fruit.   There is one item you may want to try if you have not. It is yogurt Thai tea popping. I have the Thai tea mixed with regular yogurt. Then bottom with the mango popping. It is like Thai tea smoothies with boba. It is interesting to try.

This fresh market is nice and clean. I like the most are the ready to eat food by pound. It make life a lot easy. When you walk in, it is timber like covering floor which make shopping like home. The first section is flower just reminds you do you have love one to buy the flowers for love or forgiveness.   The ready to eat food just need to reheat or simply eat them. These food included scampi shrimp, preassemble sandwich, Korean salmon, and more. I like the coffee bean by weight. The wine selection is a bit less choice but good enough for the evening.   Pastry is freshly made for your pickups. Many organic item in the fresh produce includes the veggies. The aisle is wide enough to maneuver your card. Most of the cart is a lot smaller with two layer of container.

Yes. Small event but it attracts a lot peoples. I like to be there early to see the preparation of the fruit. I am helping the store to set up so I can try some of their tropical fruit. The event takes place at Jene's Tropical Fruit Trees.   They sell fruit tree, flowering plant and more. I start the day trying the Caribbean dip. I start with the spiciest to sweet section to cool the fire in my mouth. I have chutney that prepared by the store. They have the papaya chutney is good for a sip. The mango crisp has the crispy to over it is very good. I have tried their fried banana, jack fruit, and mango. They are very good. I went outside to get their tamarind and cherimoya snow cone. All tropical flavors.   The fruit testing section have many type of mango, jack fruit, longan, ripe guava, and more. My favorite is the frozen Lychee. They also have the fruit salad that I enjoy.   People are friendly and I like small event like this to showcase. I bought some limited amount fruit like Mamei and Nam Toc Mai.

Keke's new location at USF area is less than 1 year new. We been want to visit for some time. Parking is very convenient. The line for weekend breakfast is not bad. At 8:20 am, there was no line at all. Lighting design and space is very welcoming with bright to see your food.   We got Pina Colada with egg and bacon. The piña colada French Toast is French Toast stuff with pineapple, cream and spread with powder sugar and coconut flake. The food presentation is very nice. Colorful. The bacon is thick enough with good quality. The sunny side up egg was cook to order. Food is delicious.   The food is a bit pricey. But it does show the potential for good food. Service definitely excellent in this place. The waiter is knowledgeable to recommend a dish.

A very nice contemporary setup restaurant for Peruvian cuisine. It is kind of hidden in the plaza. Dinner has table cloth service may be good for romantic night. They have good appetizers and deserts for your selection.   This is our second restaurant stop of the night. It is after the swing dance class and we are ready for quick nibble. But when we saw the menu, we decided to try two app and one entrée. We started with famous Peruvian grill beef heart. It serve with Peruvian soft corn and roasted potatoes. The beef heart was not over cook or become too fiber with too much heat. This is good dish with good chef technique.  The second app is the grilled octopus medallion. The octopus tentacles was slice and grilled. It come with Chimichurri sauce and creamy garlic sauce. I never have the tentacles grilled this way. However, I think it is clever of the chef do that way.   Our entrée bear the name of the restaurant which is the paella with seafood and chicken, beef and sausage. This is good to share.   Our night turn out well with good service and the food is good.

We have a take home for the meal. The food here is very affordable. The amount of food given is also good. It is cafeteria style food with sandwiches for order.   We have the white rice, roast pork, gizzards, yucca, and sweet plantain. All that for less than $14. The roast pork is well marinated. The skin is crispy and crunchy. The gizzards are cook in tomato base sauce and the cook for some time. They are soft and not chewy. Bite size pleasure. The yucca is not my favorite food unless it is fried. But the steam yucca is my wife favorite. Plantain is well cook.   Overall the experience is not bad. We also has some crocket which is tasty.

Great bakery at the Hillsborough Ave and Sheldon. This bakery is kind hidden at the corner and very difficult to find. It is on the south east corner or the plaza. It has an outdoor red umbrella and Columbia flag in front of the store.   If you are here, got to try their ice coffee. They use whole milk or 2% milk to stir up with mocha coffee. It use food processor to grind the ice and coffee and milk. Very delicious.   The pastry is another best. Got to try their sweet corn and cheese item. The pastry includes beef and chicken fluffy pastry. Other than it. It has many pastry to select. Some thing sweet or salty.   Price are affordable. Many Columbian has done here. The store server know a little English only. So point you finger. Don't worry about price. You will love and they are affordable.

Capricho is breakfast and lunch place. It has Dominican food all day with Saturday special to include seafood. It located at plaza's NW corner. A lot people came here for breakfast and sandwiches because of the affordable price.   We got the Saturday special with seafood paella and the fried meat. The fried meat is very generous. The best thing is the numbers of type meat. It includes the ham, pork lion, sausage, fried cheese, chicken and plantains. It is good to share. The seafood paella has mussels, shrimp, octopus, squid. Both dishes are good.   Check them it if you in Temple Terrace. It is good Dominican food.

This is a licensed Japanese chef with the diploma on sushi. You can see a truly train chef knife skill is different than non actual train chef. Raj piece of fish is carefully sliced. Rice is make from the palm of hand. They have typical roll but I would encourage you go for the nigiri.   Ask for what they carry not in the menu. That will surprise you of their selection of the day. I have order two torch salmon and yellow tails. This item requires a bit time to marinated before torch with open flame. The fish cut is large pieces in comparison to many sushi places. I like he pay attention to the detail.   I also have sea urchin and the sea bass nigiri. This is good pieces. I like their freshness of the fish and good quality. I also has the spicy tuna which consider good flavor.   Overall experience is good in compare to many Japanese restaurants here.

It very convenient too have a rest area before the long bridge. It not just to provide the facilities but also have great view to the bay. This south end facility is a lot more beautiful view than the one on the north. It curve into east to allow a great view to the sunshine Skyway Bridge.   However, the restroom is now t the best in the area. It is a bit dirty. It has the picnic area in the area. The parking is the best view to the bay. The exit connects to the old sunshine Skyway Bridge and now is the fishing pier.

I am exited Pena open their fast food store in the Amateurwork. I look at the menu and select the most expensive in the menu. The Mediterranean Salad. This salad has prosciutto, hummus, tomatoes, arugula, little bok Choy, and bread. If I count the prosciutto and the veggies they kind not measure up to the price. But I do like their medjool dates and the marcona nut. The salad just ok not impressive.   I did see my friend post on the sandwich is better. I would not recommend the salad. Just go for sandwiches, they are better.

This restaurant is actually part of bigger franchise in the nation. They are located in the major cities. Tampa was lucky enough to have one. It was easy to locate Tampa restaurant because it is just not too far from the highway.  I think they have tone down the Indian spice here. They more gear to American taste. The restaurant is busy. It has some dishes worth for a try. We got the Shrimp Manchuria for start. It has marinated in coating them deep fried. Lastly stir fry the chili sauce with onion and bell peppers. It has 5 to 6 large shrimps. Good appetizer dish.   Our main dish are the Lamb Boti Tikka. This is cube lamb marinated in spice, yogurt, garlic and ginger. This lamb grilled in tandoor oven. I usually has the tandoori chicken. But tandoori lamb is the first. Or second dish is the Gongura Chicken with high nutrition leave and spice. This is one of traditional dish. This not typical American Indian red curry. The color is dark green.   The only complaint about the restaurant is the rice come very late after the main dish was set on the table. I don't know they try to have you eat the main dish first so you won't ask for too much rice. Curry dish need to go with rice. Although is not intentionally but execution need to be corrected.

Sushi burrito is new thing in the recent food world. Basically is poke in a wrap. This handheld is new to people as comfort food. It has good attraction to many people try to catch the trend. I am also one of them.   I got the original sushi burrito. It has tuna, tempura shrimp, asparagus and more. You can choose the sauce. It is wrap with very soft skin eatable wrap. This burrito to me is like something you need it quick. It look like blue color lunch but cannot be made for hours wait and eat due to raw fish.   I also got durian boba. The cup indicated Ha Long Bay. I am guessing this restaurant is relate to the Ha Long Bay restaurant. Not much of service. Basically order at counter and wait for your food.

Ava is well decorated to match the younger generation. I like the decorations. However I don't like chair with cross vinyl support seat cushion. I like the bar area is well lid in color. This restaurant is selling atmosphere.   We have ordered the seared duck breast and the spaghetti e vongole. The duck breast is with the cherry sauce on top of the pistachio goat cheese. The combination is ok if you like goat cheese. It will better with grilled veggies. The spaghetti e vongole is spaghetti with little neck clam. It is white wine sauce. I have this dish at elsewhere. The current experience is not top that previous experience. The wine sauce can be better.   I can see that why they are not above average. The portion of the food is small compared to many restaurant. It is almost need additional food after we have finished eating. Value is not there and the taste not measure up to the price is charge.

Via Italia has street food in Italy. Mainly the the pizza by the slice. They display their gourmet pizza behind the counter, you just need to point and pick the one you like. The pizza look good. They also has entire menu with pizza. The crush flour includes white, multigrain, and gluten free. All these pizzas are wood fired. At their vegan section including a impossible meatball. It is something.   We started our lunch with the Le Bruschette. It is bread with prosciutto, arugula and fig jam. The prosciutto was great and the fig jam accompanied well. Our second dish is the Cavatelli Con Brocolli E Salsiccia - sweet Italian sausage and broccolini pasta. This dish is just good. The last dish is the Spaghetti Con Zucchini E Gamberetti. It is sun dried tomatoes with shrimp. The shrimp is big enough. I changed the spaghetti to Pena pasta.   Our dessert is the dessert is the rum corn bread. I thing the corn bread can be softer. But the rum was good. Service is good. Food has fresh ingredients.

It neighborhood support ice cream joint. Just across the library. This ice cream place established since 1958. Very old store. You can tell they are very successful with many come to visit. It is a dairy joy to people here like it's name.   I got the vanilla dip cone with butterscotch. Only few ice cream place has dip cone. This is one of them. The banana split here look very good. One day I will try it. The small cone we have is good quantity of the soft serve. They have good technique to swirl it up higher. Keep up the good work which attracts people here.

I have been to many 4 river smoke house. I also been to their original smoke house that was replace with newer building in the Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park. No many can said that. I like several thing they have served. Santa Maria Tri Tip and Brisket is the two I like the most. Not to mention their bacon wrap jalapeno chees fill is my favorite too.   The South Tampa store is my first visit. I have only try their classic brisket and burn end sandwich. We walk at 5:45 pm Tuesday and there was no line. By the time we finish our sandwich, long line was there. I have ask my brisket moist and it definitely is the best piece. I love the brisket with a little fat and tender moist. My wife burn end taste like beef jerky. I think this recipes need some improvement.   The setting and dining hall is a sense of community dining. They have the hand washing station next to the soft drink station which make easy for the patron who finish the food and wash the hand. Great addition. This location is better than the Carrolwood store in term of grill technique.

This restaurant has the seven beef courses for $35 for two and $45 for three. We did not go for it since I want to eat light tonight. Their seven beef course is probably cheaper in Bay Area.   Tonight we have order a grilled quail for appetizer, combination beef pho and the Hu Tieu Nam Vang noodle soup. I have try many restaurant grilled quail, each one have their differences. This restaurant added a sweet sauce on top make it very nice and juicy. I like it when the hot sweet sauce eventually cooks the lettuce below and it is great to eat it.  The pho is average in the Bay Area. I like the rare slice beef when they cook it. In Canada, they have the rare beef on the side for you to add. This is better since you don't want it to overcook. Unfortunately none of the Bay Area Vietnamese restaurants have prepared this way. The Hu Tieu Nam Vang is noddle soup with clear both with fried garlic base. I like they add the liver, quail egg, shrimp, squid and ground pork into the soup. This is a good soup when you are sick.   Overall the restaurant is busy. The service is average; the waitresses are able to speak English. Food quality is great. I like the grilled quail here. The rainbow drink is with ice cube instead of shave ice. I prefer shave ice.

It is 3.5 stars restaurant. Not yet 4. One good thing this is a restaurant not food truck. Better quality controls when food is prepared in a building rather a food truck. The place is small but good enough to handle the lunch crowd. This place under $13 you can get a good meal. Better than fast food chain.   We got the burrito del Rey. This is big burrito. The meat is steak chop not ground grilled perfect flavor. This is huge burrito at 12" long. Under $10. I got the carne asada. The skirt steak is thin slice. It has good seasoning. Love the burn of the meat but not charcoal. It come with a lot of side. It is a meal to fill a big person.   Service is good. I also like the pineapple drink. I am not sure if they make the their own. But is good taste. Food come out quick too. Not much of wait.

This is my go to wine store. It is located off interstate 275 and easy for me to pick up a bottle or two. Especially they have coupon send to me for discounts. The only negative thing is the left turn off Dale Mabry to plaza alway has a line for the car to turn into due to busy plaza.   I can said that I am wine person but specific way. I like the Pinot noir particularly. Especially the Russian River Valley (RRV) Pinot Noir is my region. Not all year grape is good but most Year is above average in that region. I always try every Pinot Noir. I like Lost Canyon, La Crema, River Road Stephanie, Deloach - roughly $20 to $40 a bottle. The total wine has this option and many other too.   The check out alway easy. If you have to many bottles, ask for box with slot to carry so it do not damage during transfer.

Must be a poke love explosion. We have seen so many lately. This one will be the first few at Wesley Chapel. Island Fin has found love by the local community. I would said they are just a bit above the  average poke restaurant for the reason they are generous on the topping.  I choose the protein as tuna and octopus. They mixed the mixed in and the protein with the sauce. Which is good and make it flavorful. If they have sesame oil will be better. Not all the mixed in are included. Some has up charge. The time we have visited, the people who have the mixer is a bit heavy on sauce.   The other thing like it here is their dole whip with mango and pineapple soft serve. It is delicious. I thing this will bring them to the top. This unique soft serve is the first in Bay Area.

During pandemic, you can check in to the store online and get in line to wait. It is easy to check in. Usually the given time in the web is 10 minutes more than the actual wait time. Unless you did not show up on time and they give you spot to the next person. You just need to wait for the next turn.   I have my hair cut without sideburn. The hair dresser did a good job for the to keep my hair short and not spiky. Good technique especially for the oriental hair. I got my cut within 15 minutes. It is definitely good to have it finish quick. Payment is easy. The hair dresser do have mask to cover.

If you need a tow truck while you can wait, this may be your option. We have to tow one of my car. We call the tow center and they responded immediately to the call. Very detail ask what type of car we have. It is to know your car is front wheel drive and the back of the tire is flat. This information eventually save you a trip for wrong tow truck. When you have that situation, the lift and two wheels tow will not work. Because they have to tow from the back due to your bad tire cannot contact the ground to protect from damages to the car rim. But the front wheel drive prevents the tow from the back not to dame the engine. Only way is use the flat bed tow truck. This is important to know which tow truck to use.   I would give them a higher star if they on time. The promise time was delay 2 hours. You don't want call other tow company because by the time you call them, the wait will be the same.

The items I like about this gas station including wide driveway between gas pump. It allow easy access to to pump and leaving as well. It also has 16 gas pumps which make the empty pump availability is higher.   This gas station has two security camera facing the pumps. This security feature help the safe environment for the customers. The main building has dunkin donut which make more customers to visit.

This food chain is found by Tampa Metropolitan Ministry. They train the homeless to be self sufficient and transitioning out from homeless. Any bit contributions or buy the food is for the greater good. My review for the food stand is not because of the charitable contributions they have. Just the food and service.   They are a unique sandwich store. My friend order a porchetta and it look really good. So I order one for myself. I search what is porchetta. It can be done many way. Some has the Pork Belly outwardly and pork lion inward. This store probably use only pork lion when I saw they display the porchetta. Nonetheless, they are delicious. For the sandwich alone, it is five stars. The melted cheese, the crust edge, and the veggies was perfect harmony. I also like their home made pickle cucumber.   The only thing is my dish missing a chip while friend has it. The wait can be improved if they can text us if the food is ready when this is giant food court.

The fishing pier was the remnant of the damage old skyway that connects the Bay Area. Now is park of the fishing park. The 1980 tragedy has abundant the bridge as transportation to fishing pier after the main span was struck down.   It has been fisherman heaven when they changed to fishing pier. There fees collect if you want to fish here. This fees basically go to the bridge pier repair. I like the two lane pier with place for pull out to park your car. Many people has come to here to fish.   The facility include so often distances with a restroom. It also has a bait shop. I think this place is great for sunset and sunrise view. The pelicans and seagulls rest on the other side of the non fishing bridge pier. It was awesome to observe their behavior. The pier is clean since most of the fishermen dispose the un-use line properly.

Rare Ethnic Food 10  We have select the Creative Loafing Restaurant night to gather some Yelp friends after a long trip away from Tampa. We have try many Mexican restaurant and never list them as rare ethnic food because it is common in Tampa. Why this restaurant is listed. It because they use the St. Miguel Cuisine.   The restaurant ground their sauce from raw Ingredients. That the reason they are unique than many Mexican restaurant. Their selection margaritas are huge. Especially the gold tequila is a long list. I have Besito Patron Margarita with pomegranate juice. Nice touch.   Our appetizer is Flautas De Pollo. It has two different sauce over it. Ok tasting. I have the Enchiladas mixtas. It mix meat type of enchiladas. Our dessert is chocolate cake. Overall is good.   At the end of the day, each of us got the Mexican doll for take home. Good service.

I only been to cinema twice a year since the the DVDs are so convenient. I only gone to movie if I feel it is worthy to be on big screen or group of friend want to do it.   During the Christmas Day first show usually is the best while many people are just wait up and open the gift. Not too many of people in the seat and there is plenty of selection where you want to seat. We are watching the stars war 3D movie with good technology. I can see now the movie making is in the 4K technology. This is very nice. The 3D glass also improved and easy to wear and no headache.   I cannot believe this cinema is now belong to carmike group since my last visit. There is no pre commercial before the schedule showing. Everything commercial or preview is after the schedule time in the ticket. Which wastes at least 20 minutes before the feature movie.   The popcorn and drink is pricy mark up. Seat is ok but they need to lubricate the squeaking sound of the rocking chair.

It is good German cuisine restaurant. Considering this area is a popular restaurant. During this time, it is just like October fest. Many love to sit outside like beer garden. In the good weather, you may need to come early if you want to sit outside. The restaurant serve German food and gyro. Interesting. The chef can handle two types of food.   We got the Jagerschnitzel. It is breaded pounded pork gravy with mushroom and bacon. The side is potatoes salad. This dish is good when you are hungry. Love the coating flavor on the pork. We also get the Doener Bowl. It is shave lamb with rice and one special sauce. This dish we added a knockwurst with sauerkraut and falafel, the wurst is good and brown finish outwardly. Falafel also tasty.   Overall the food is good. Good thing we arrived before the big crowd. They only has one waitress. With their business they may need two. Many come here for the beer.

This Venezuelan food here is almost like street food. The cooking is very authentic. This is mom and pop store with good chef. It has special of the day you may want to try, because it is not on the regular menu. The Hispanic Society often order food here to feed their group.  We saw they have special tamale on today special. It look good and very affordable. However, we did not go for it. We have order the Asado Negro. This is a roasted black beef serve over white rice and fried sweet plantains. I have never have the black beef before. It sauce is black and interesting. It is well accommodated with the rice. The plantain was well prepare and are not black and over fried. We also order the soup of the day. It has a lot of thing inside. It has some tendon and potato and other veggie. The soup semi clear but very good. The dish also include a side salad and arepa. It go well with the soup.  I am surprise that the restaurant is kind of empty. The food is good and the price is very affordable include dinner time. We added sweet pineapple flan. It was delicious. The close up is good and the service is good.

Authentic Cuisine #69 -  Guyanese Cuisine   This grocery store has an kitchen who serve West Indian with Guyanese cuisine. It is interesting to see the curry is a touch different than most. I have been book mark this place for years, finally I was able to visit one of my 1700 bookmarks. I like grocery setup. But I like their bakery and the food they provided.   Bakery  I got the the pine tart. This tart is pineapple filling with good crust. I also got the the curry chicken and jerk chicken pastry. Both of them is good. Especially the the jerk chicken pastry.   Food We start with the Pholourie. This Guyana snack food is a fried dough with tamarind sauce. Very interesting. It is popular item and only available Saturday. We also got the Doubles. This is a street food that serve there. For me is ok. We got the chicken chow mein. The fried noodle is good but I prefer Chinese fried noodle. The chicken was marinated with good sauce. A bit dried. The last dish is the goat curry. I like this the best. It come with dhal puri which is Indian bread with split pea stuff inside.   Our experience here is good. The price is reasonable. Love to try different item in the bakery and food in the future.

I have to agree with Mark on this taco truck. We have try variety of tacos but this truck is average. I would said the Bay Area certainly step up on the taco food. The tacos have growing interest in this bay area.   We have order 8 different taco. Including shrimp, lengua, tripa, carne, chorizo, pork. The food is average. I would said the sauce has over power the ingredient. If they can lightly season and still make it taste good, that will be the key. May be I not use to this type of taco with overpower sauce.  We also order the ceviche. The ceviche is better. The crispy corn tortilla go very well with the ceviche.

This deli is order at the counter and issue an order number.  Then you a fix you number to table stand. That how they identify your order and deliver to you. Table and seat is pick by you. It has freedom of your table choice. I like that concept of fast food order. They bring the food to you.   The menu is very simple. Mainly is the sandwich. Nothing fancy. We got the Black Angus Beef Club. The club sandwich come as four pieces of bread cut in triangle with beef slide sandwich. The bacon can be improved to a bit crispy. This item may be one of the most expensive items. Taste is ok.   We waited about 8 minutes for our food to deliver to our table. Not much of service

It is huge improvement when there is staff members help you to get the right order. A beeper was given when your food is ready to pick. At least they no longer let the customers to figure out the food on the counter.   We were here for the taco week to celebrate the administrative day. Most of my guest got two tacos and a drink with about $10. I got the grilled fish and grilled shrimp. It is tasty for the two tacos I have selected. I like the grilled shrimp better. It has some blackened seasoning on it.   I got the margarita for my combination deal. The margarita start light then feel the alcohol effects later. We enjoy our time there.

I have seen one of the elite member friend review this restaurant and want to come here to check it out. The restaurant is far away from any interstate. However, it is worth a trip for taste and unique of the food.   This restaurant only has three elite members review including me. This restaurant needs to make know. I would say this is a very creative on taste and combination of the ingredient.   We have Ahi Poke, Out of Control Roll, Tampa Roll, and Spicy Tuna Roll. The Ahi Poke is Ahi tuna seared with shichimi pepper and tossed w. hot sesame oil, sriracha sauce, scallions, and masago. Served on crispy wonton chips, and avocado. It is a bit spicy but the preparation of the roll requires time in cooking, chopping, assembling, and decorating. It top with eel sauce and set on the fried wonton skin and make a beautiful presentation.   The out of control roll is never out of control. The flavor is well control and sophisticate. This roll is tuna, salmon, kani & avocado inside, tuna, salmon & yellow- tail w. mayo & seared across, caviar on top w. eel sauce and scallion. This roll require dear across the roll top with eel sauce and masago. This is another creation of the chef.   I would recommend order from the Uchi special roll section if you are here. The service is good. This place is a bit pricy but worth the money to try special roll.

Authentic cuisine number 59. Philippine cuisine.   This restaurant is close to low side of 4.5 stars. I see many potential potential for this restaurant. They have many good things going on this food truck. I round them to 5 stars.   If you come here, you got to try their halo halo. Their halo halo is different than most Philippino cuisine. The bean and jelly are home made. The juice is jackfruit juice. Very special. Best halo halo in town.   This food truck is popular here. A lot of customers. They do have the seating area. But I rather take it to go during pandemic. The menu changes every day. When they sold out they will not continue make it until next day.   We got the Bistek. It is sirloin beef steak simmering in soy sauce. The serve with rice and lumpia. I would only give them an average on this dish. The second dish is much better choice. It is the sautéed mung bean. It serve with the fried scad fish. The bean is one of the kind. I would recommend this dish. Fish is good. You have to chose tail or head section.

I like Nam Viet for several reasons, they have good grilled pork and boba tea. The restaurant is 4.5 stars for reasonable pricing. I would said it is recommended.   The restaurant has side boba Machi drink. I have the Monster, Red Guava Jasmine, and the Delicious drink. All drink are delicious. The Monster is with sweet brown sugar boba. The cream milk on top, and the wall of the cup is plaster with brown sugar. It is very traditional Taiwanese preparation. I highly recommend this drink. The red guava has the different  jelly include noddle jelly andd basil seed. The "Delicious" is boba and red bean. All drinks are amazing.   We have the caramel fish. Good garlic shrimp in clay pot. My wife have Banh Canh Thap Cam. It has combination meat including pig liver. I have the seafood Hu Tieu, this dish just ok. I like the appetizers with sugar came shrimp fresh roll. I also like the the item we have to go. The grilled pork is delicious and good BBQ.

This is 3.5 stars restaurant. It is conveniently located at downtown Clearwater. Somehow they are not serving dinner. It make difficult to try this restaurant after hours.   Today I have a day off and finally make it to my book mark restaurant. The restaurant has a modern look with area with the couch or table. It is certainly a young people interior decoration. The food is order on the counter brought it to the table.   My wife order the conch salad with the salad made from softer section of the lotus stem. It is interesting for the dish. But, it is not the food the normal people are use to.   We also order the Malaysian noodle. Well. It not to my Malaysian standard. Sorry. Malaysian mee goreng is much better than this. We also try their pork Banh Mi. It is just ok. But my friends short rib Banh mi is great.   Overall this is check off restaurant from my list.

I am glad they finally think about northern Tampa. Zoe's new location definitely will bring a lot revenue to the company. Because Dale Mabry Carrollwood area is definitely a restaurant pocket. With that said, I think will be a good contributor to the community with great food with easy selection.   I like the new restaurant with outside seating that allow many dog owners gladly visit the restaurant. This is a plus in many way just by sacrificing a few parking space with outside seating.   The restaurant Mediterranean cuisine has a lot to offer. You can have kabob, bowl, sandwich, pita, salad, and piadinas. We got the salmon bowl with Mediterranean Salad Trio. I am good with that. The best is salmon kabob with roasted veggies and quinoa. This is very good dish. The salmon is fresh and grilled very well. I like roasted veggies with a lot flavor. I would go for double roasted veggies incomparable to quinoa.   The manager did make around our table to see how is our food. I also like to suggest the Mediterranean Lamb Kafka as starter if you happen to visit them.

Plato meaning dish or plate in Spanish. The name of the restaurant is perfectly named. The Latino Dish. It identified the the cuisine immediately if you know the meaning of the restaurant.   This small restaurant get a lot of attention during lunch time. We were there 11:40am. The crowds start coming at 12:00 noon on weekdays. We have order the bistec and the pepper steak. The bistec is grilled steak with two choices of side. Since we have two dishes, we got the yellow rice, white rice and sweet plantain. The steak is a bit tough but is is good grilled steak. The pepper steak is cut into pieces and flat iron plate grilled.   We like the devil crab which is not smell too fishy. It has full crab meat inside. They also have hot deli with ropa veja, roast pork and more. Food is affordable and service is order at the counter.

Great rich ice cream and many creative flavors for selection. This sum the store best thing can be found. The ice cream store located in the plaza close to T J Maxx. At night time in winter, they still get a lot customers. This tell me they have good regular customers     Their flavor includes something you cannot  imagine. I got eggnog and rum raisin. The ice cream as they have advertised. Creamy. Not bad at all. They do have milkshakes and sundae available if you want to that route.

Brisket shoppe is open limited time only. Only Saturday they serve Dino Bone. Price is above average BBQ restaurants. However, they did use the good quality meat.   We have the two different links of sausage and a few slice of brisket. The link sausage come with pickles cucumber, cube of cheese and slice of bread. This look like wine worthy dish. The brisket was slice with lean meat and slice edge fat. It is perfect. The seasoning is good. The meat is delicious due to slow hours BBQ.   Overall the food is good. Seating only at the outside.

Among the three MD, this may be the least favorite. This MD under the major face lift and added many footage to the store. They has increased the good carrier and display with close to 100%. A big applause to the owner.   Adding is good. But renovation is still needed. The live seafood section need to clean their tank often. The MD in this location employees training need to know how heavy a bag can carry. Today I have two break bag due to the over weight of the bag can carry. They should learn double bag or less items in the bag.   It is good to see the fresh produce. I like the different fruit items. I like them added the bakery items. This place is more complete now.

Little Lamb sounds very gentle like the Mary the Little Lamb song. However, the food speaks a loud volume. The food serve here is really good. Their website is still under construction to add more thing.   They have small plate like pub food, salad, entrees and sweet stuff. We have order the Beef Tartare and the Grilled Market Fish. The beef Tartare are the tenderloin chop up. The food garnish with fried crunchy chips which I think is potato but a bit different taste since they are slice, marinated and fried. The Tartare has good taste. A bit salty. I like the garnish veggies, they are very good pickle.   Our entrée is hamachi fish which I could not tell what kind. It top with fennel herb salad. Like this dish. Fish is premium grade. The salad is very creative.   The reason is four star due to the wait is 30 minutes. But the food is good and the chef has some skill.

They actually do not have the buffet. We were there thinking they have the buffet. But they have the tali plate. Which is better to my opinion.   We got the meat tali. It has a lot of chamber to fill the plate. I like it because the appetizers also meat. My two entrees is the mutton curry and the fish curry. These two curry were very good. Especially the mutton curry Kat fresh out the kitchen. Tasty. I also like the fried chicken curry. It has a lot character. The rice has biryanis rice and good chicken in it.   Not much of service. When yo finish the plate, they ask you dump it your self. By food is excellent.

We have brunch here during one of the Sunday. I like beach community restaurant because of the Pass A Grille beach. This restaurant is basically at the Main Street. The restaurant decorated modern contemporary. Decoration color mainly white.   We have group of people. I got the eggnog waffle that top with strawberry and syrup. The waffle also come with the roasted walnut. This dish is decent. I also has the bowl of soup with southern clam chowder. Not much of clam. And the clam is tiny. My friend order the tuna melt. It was not melt at all. The cheese still at the room temp shape. Never melt. Then why call tuna melt.   Service is a bit slow here. I would give them an average among the restaurant.

Grand opening on the new store front. It has been a while they say about the opening. But it was delay for a while. Finally it is open for business. Every visit  customer fill out the card have a chance to win a free guitar on the opening day visit. Cross my finger.   The store front original cover by paper before unveil to the public. Definitely they try to make a big bang for the opening day. The guitar is beautifully displayed. They sell electric guitar, bass guitar, classical guitar, acoustic guitar, ukulele and more. They also has amplified, electronic mix board, accessory. Come to check them out.   The sound proof room can test out the electrical guitar you like. The store is big. Price is average range. It has many visitors on the opening day.

This park is in the middle of St. Pete. It is very close to Sundial. Occasionally they have the concert for the residents to enjoy. The park lay out is simple. Amphitheater on the east, center fountain, west veteran memorial. Surrounding the fountain red bricks are the name of the donors who contribute to the cost for building it.   The park is clean. See a lot of police patrol at the area. There many homeless people there hanging around. Basically they have no place to go and the park provide tree shade and benches.   There are concrete sidewalk around the park for leisure strolling. A lap on the park is 0.24 mile. If you want to go a mile is 4 laps. Some did bring the dog out. But I am not sure it is a good dog park. It is a simple Square park in the middle of the city.

This is a difficult one. Among the wine bar or kitchen they are in the passing grade. Very close to the 3.5 stars but not there yet. I think the food need to step up among the wine bars. Selection of the wine is just average.   There are several thing they can improve. The portion of the plate is small compared to the Bay Area wine bar kitchen. Food pallet is at the sour side. If they can improve this two, it may be great attraction to the customers. Food price on the small plate is at the high side. Flavor and taste still need big improvement.   I have the blacken octopus and seared tuna. The octopus is one tentacles. Which is small for the price they charging. The sauce can be more complicate by not stay on one sauce. May be grilled a bit better. The seared tuna coating can be improved. Not impressive. It is almost like Japanese tuna sashimi. If the outside is seared, it can include some awesome seasoning. May be smaller cute but more piece which provides more are of the seared outward tastes.   Overall, they are try to sell the wine which the taste of the food need to be more attractive.

I have been to this Zeko before but have not try their chicken wing. Zeko is a Mediterranean restaurant. They have variety menu. From vegetarian to meat kabab. Their extensive menu includes Greek salad, falafel, fried seafood including shrimp and fish, different kind of shake, beef and lamb kabab, gyro, shawarma, chicken sandwich and wings.   The restaurant operate like fast food fashion. Order at counter and ready to pick up. After 8:30 pm, most order are take out. I got the honey BBQ wings. The wings is fried and toss over the BBQ sauce. The wing value is $1 a piece is at the average in the Bay Area. Toss sauce with fried wing is not my most favorite. They are just average.   Overall experience is good. It is definitely better than the fast food in Busch garden.

Rare Ethnic Cuisine No. 67 - Laotian Cuisine.   Sap Sap just have Grand Open. My Yelp Friend Anna told me about this restaurant and we have try them at the second day of Grand Opening. This restaurant over take previously Vietnamese restaurant. Now it has Laotian cuisine. Time to have changed in this restaurant.   They sold out the food first day and force them to open their restaurant at 1pm second day due new kitchen work for preparation the ingredients. I would said they are not smoothly open yet. Order, food delivery, and service are not really on track yet. Fortunately the taste is there. We waited our food for 1.1 hours. Obviously they mixed up our order. Service did get to us the beginning, was not check back later. These are the item they need to improve. One thing for sure my wife has said is to simplify the menu call out. It is difficult for the American to call out the Lao food name and it can be easily mixed up.   We start with the chicken wings and the Laap Beef. The wing is really good coating. The laap beef has good spicy item. It is good spicy to me but my friend said is too hot for them. But the restaurant did offer to lower the spiciness at the end for my friend to take home. We also has the Thum Mua Sap Sap Style - it is the salad with vermicelli noodle, shrimp and the beef meat ball. It was delicious. I like the style. We also have the the Laotian sausage. I like this the most. The last dish is the homemade fried pork jerky. The pork is slice with marinated sesame seed. I like this dish too.   Overall they need be on track. Need to simplify the order, need to improve the speed of food delivery. I give them a pass today since they are new restaurant.

We were here for the restaurant week at Saturday. For Saturday night this restaurant is average busy. The tap house has good collection of whiskey. They have quite a selection if you want some southern whiskey. They can consider sport bar. I would they may need to add a few more in order to compete as sport bar.   The service is good. I like the appetizers and the dessert. Their entree need to be work on it. We started with the knockout shrimp. This is fried shrimp with spicy creamy sauce. This serve over the cabbage salad. Our dessert is the chocolate bourbon cake. I also like this dish. The cake has good flavor with ice cream.   Our entree are the 6oz filet mignon. The meat taste like sirloin instead of filet mignon. It is not soft enough. The meat also has no seasoning. We also has the grilled mahi-mahi. Again no seasoning. Both dish are not impressive.

Who can deny healthy food. It is best for your body, your mind, and your spirit. Fitlife food provide option for the ready to heat food and easy to use.  They have choices from breakfast, regular meal, to dessert. The meal including bison meat. I like steak Asada with the unique sauce to accompanied. I can eat two or three box. By the way, the box meal come small, medium or large. Price varies depend which dish you have selected. The selection include vegetarian or fruit.  They also have the gluten free items.   The smaller box is roughly $7. I can see to use it for the night time snack compare to 6 chicken wings. You can design for your weight loss. For me, I am going for the taste. Thank for the chef demonstrate the cooking of the wild salmon with quinoa for the free sample. It was good taste.

Rumfish Grill is a huge investment for the restaurant. The restaurant is originally a conference room for the hotel. The ballroom or conference room is alternated to a restaurant later. When Tradewinds Island Resort bought this place, they think big to give a wow factor for the patron who eat there. They designed this restaurant with gigantic aquarium that enable people to swim on it and the outsider who not eat there can enjoy the view without walking into the restaurant. This multi million project make an impact to the customer who eat there.   The lunch is consider affordable and good to eat here. We have order the creole BBQ shrimp and chargrilled oysters. The shrimp is fresh and jumpy. They top with nice creole sauce. The grilled oyster is top with Parmesan crust. Nice touch. Overall the service is real good. Food came out ok.  Please come to this restaurant a bit early at 11:00 am. You can enjoy the touch tank experience in the hotel before lunch. They have the sea creatures touch from 11:00 am to 12:00 noon

This restaurant has good potential. They do have a lot of visitors during weekdays. It is a good sign that the restaurant is pack during Thursday. We came in with no reservation. Since we don't like to seat outside, the only seat available is the two couches chairs. We don't mind. It is just not our normal eating height.   We have order the Carne Asada Street Taco. This taco come with skirt steak, Cotija cheese, and pickle. We don't know the Cotija cheese is. Very similar to goat cheese. This kind of cheese either you love it or hate it for the taste. I think this is a wrong move for the restaurant. Because you may have 50% of people don't like it. Steak is a bit over cook.   Our second dish is the Chimichurri Steak Frites. This dish is a lot better. We order the medium rare. A few thing can improve on is the temperature serving below warm. The dish is serve over wood cutting board is not my standard. I know they try to create the impression. But for me I don't like to eat with cutting board already being cut through with a lot of cut mark below. Even though the board is clean but never guaranteed if the cut mark is fully clean. I prefer it to serve of the plate.   With that price charge for the dish, we will have high expectations. However it was not met. Services is great. Good attentive service. I like the decoration and atmosphere. Parking very limited when the place is full.

Yelping No. 2500.  This one go to local restaurant Harvest Bowl. I believe they have very good potential. The place is great to to visit since they converted fro paint store to restaurant with huge space. This place includes eatery and food market. I like the concept. The only down side is not much of seating area. Very limited due to space fill with groceries items.   I got the Asian fusion bowl with grilled salmon. The salmon was excellent. The sauce in the bowl is tasty. I like mixture of ingredients. My wife got the building your own bowl with BBQ chicken and pull chicken. She like her bowl. She like the Brussels sprouts. We also got meat pie. I recommend you get that if they have it. We also got the cheese cake. They have many selections of cheese cake. The cheese taste light which is the way I love.

Krewe of Chewbacchus is one of the most unique parades for the Mardi Gras. This is the one that I like the most. This parade took place at the eastside of the out skirt of the French Quarter. This side of the town is more hypies and biker look.   The parade theme is Intergalactic hero Chewbacchus in the Star Wars movie. It is about intergalactic movie series. The parade people dress like the character of the movie. You almost can say you are in the star war convention. This is an up close parade. You will be at an arm length from the parade. Before the parade, people are party at the street of the intersection of Frenchmen and Decatur Street. There are ladies walk by selling shot of alcohol in tube or Jell-O.    When the parade start, People are pushing each other try to get to front to watch the parade. This parade is making up from the local people using the card board cut out and make into the shape. The floats are bicycle, golf cart, dune buggy, or man power push cart. The parade people dresses in character in Star War are Captain Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, a lot of Princess Leia, Dark Vader, Obi One Kenobi. The other movie themes are Star Trek, Guardian of the Galaxy, Super Mario, E.T., How to Train the Dragon, Zombies the Living Dead, Ghost Buster.........  Data in the Star Trek look real as the movie. This will please a lot of Treky. The Zombie is Kid friendly scary. Princess Leia has shown the two hair round bundles that is cute like movie. I cannot say enough, please experience yourself. Be prepare the crowd will get excited and push from behind. This is not a bead route but occasionally they give up the bead like items. If you want to avoid the crowd, please stand at the quarter point of the route. However, the most action is at the intersection of Decatur and Frenchmen Street. Please be early in that intersection for the front row.

This food truck located in a low income neighborhood. They have an empty lot with food truck and the seating area. The circular driveway make it easy for access to the corner lot. There are plenty of space for parking.   This food truck carry variety of menu. They have taco, burrito, tostada, Gorda, cheviche and more. It is typical street food from Mexico. I got five different tacos. I have steak, pastor, barbacoa, trips and buche de Pork. I like the most is barbacoa. It has the most marinated beef taste. All five tacos were big compared to many place. It is worth the money. For single person just 4 tacos is more than enough.   The wait is about 10 minutes while they cook your food. They close at 10 pm which make it perfect for the night time snack. They seating area is big enough to host 4o people. They even has TV for entertainment while you eat there.

I always see Twennie checkin here and she is frequently visited this place. This is her hood. Soon I also checked out this place and I also  hook on their desserts. Cool dessert is served here. I mean cool in cold and also good.   I have been here for some time but never give them the former review. I have not try their cooked food but plenty of desserts. They are famous on their shave ice. Once you have their shave ice, you may not want other types of shave ice. The shave ice is very fluffy and soft. It is almost look like a cloud. They come with different flavor. If you have been order with toppings, you might want to try the ice along with selected flavor. Try that way you can feel the goodness of the ice. Yummy in the tummy.   I have many way. Some time I have with mix jelly and basil seed. Mix your own toppings with your own creation.

Finally there is Total wine near me less than 6 miles. This newly open wine store has variety of wine. Because it is new, most wine still on the shelf. There was no sold out items. It make shopping easier.   During the opening week, there is a lot of wine tasting, spirits tasting and music. The floor is in full capacity, you can find help every where. The display case is well organized and beautiful.   I got their summer special and Pinot Noir. I always got the Latimer Ranch Russian River Valley Pinot Noir. But this time I added the Carmen Grand Reserve and France D'Autrefois Reserve Pinot Noir. I also have the France Corte De Provence Rose. Light go with Indian curry.   Experience is good. Love to shop here. I no longer travel 15 to total wine.

Food still good. However, the ventilation need improvement. I like to sit in the dining hall and smell the fried garlic. But the food smell stick to the clothing. So don't wear or bring any leather cloth or purses. The food smell will difficult to get rid off.   We got the pollo ala romana and spaghetti grouper Mediterraneo. We did change the grouper dish from spaghetti to angel hair pasta. The skill for the pasta is very good. It has some form noodle bouncing but not too soft. My wife say the grouper is a bit fishy smell. The chicken dish come with vegetable medley and top with prosciutto. It is delicious.   Overall the service is good. The food come out a bit slow. It take 30 minutes wait. In addition they need to improve the dining room ventilation. I would still give them 4 stars until next visit. If this not changed, I will lower the stars on next visit.

It is above 3.5 stars and a bit above average Bay Area poke restaurant. I like a few things about this poke place. Let talk about that.   I like they mix the ingredients separately before put in the base. Which is an extra step than most poke place. By doing it the sauce is not mix in the base and have good flavor. Good going. The second is they have the sweet potatoes noodle as a base. It is delicious. They also has the premixed menu if you cannot build your own. It is good for those have no sense of using the cook sauce.   Now about the negative side. The mixed only allowed 5 item. Which is now most poke place allow as many topping they have. I also don't like pick one sauce. It is too boring. I would suggest add some oil base sauce. It will help.

My first visit is five stars and my second visit is 4 stars. They should be around 4.5 stars. Not a try 5 stars restaurant. They restaurant seating capacity is a little to less. They do have back door outside seating area and front outdoor seating area. This is a chain restaurant originated from California. It combine many cuisine street food and on display in single restaurants.   Who thought changing the shape of the churro and add topping bring may like customers. We have chocolate sprinkles churro. It was interesting. I like the popcorn chicken. The five spice coating is really nice. We got our entree as garlic noodle shaken beef. The beef is really shaken for the first time visit. Bit repetitive second time visit they over cook it. The fillet mignon pho is more torn down from Vietnamese version. But still good. Pad see ew is good but it in Thai standard. Overall food is good.   The fruity booty slush is highly recommended. The other drink pink flamingo is good too. Overall service is good.

This old restaurant in Brandon has some character. I have visited this restaurant twice. One before COVID-19 and one during the epidemic. During the lock down of Bay Area, they have the roasted prime rib buy one get one free. Such a good deal.   My writing of this review is before the pandemic. We arrive here before 6 pm. The place already pack due to early bird special. We got two seats at the bar area so we don't need to wait for 45 minutes. The restaurant average age is high. Many white hair customers. They definitely like this place.   We got the grilled chicken and the grilled prime rib. The chicken is ok. But the prime rib is excellent. Early bird special make this a good deal. I highly recommend to come at early bird. The accompanying clam chowder is too creamy. Not much o

My visit is much improved on service and the food. This Cracker Barrel is the closest to my home. I saw the have some outside seating. It is great to have outside seating for this time of year. It is also good for the dog.   We were here for lunch. They do have under seven dollars lunch special. We got the bacon glaze grilled chicken. The chicken is juicy. The bacon also nice and thick. My kid ordered the fried chicken fried. They brought the country fried steak. At the end they give additional fried chicken fried. We end up to take it home. We also order regular fried chicken. It is just ok.  May be need to work on coating flavor.   The service is excellent. We were checked on several time. It is definitely good experience on regular visit. There is a lot retired or old generation eat here. Very popular.

I was looking for fix up my windows bay bar. The bar has a little clip the connect to the windows frame. This item cannot find in any hardware store. Some big name hardware store do not even carry it.   Accurate Window & Screening is a old windows store in Tampa. They open since 1961. They have some stock put away or old manufacturers that make the spare part that is not make anymore. I found the item I need in this unique store. Not cheap but at least I have to part to replace and repair them.

Popeyes recently has a promotion of $5 Cajun shrimp box. It is good deal I want to check them out. Popeyes always is my favorite fast food chain for fried chicken. When I was at Louisiana for my college year, this is my often visited place. Love the Cajun spice.   The best part are the dirty rice. It is very tasty. Their spicy fried chicken with Cajun spice is wonderful and has the southern style cooking. The new Cajun shrimp is good too. Shrimp size is very good size to have. $5 deal will not last long, catch it while you can.   I visited this store and the manager really step up the game. She saw I spill my drink when I walk to the car with my food. She replaced a new cup for me. I give them a good service rating due to pay attention to the detail.

This restaurant is 3.5 stars. There some good and some average items. I am glad we have the hand pull noodle restaurant. If the can have glass window to the kitchen to show the hand pull noodle, it will be more attractive to the customers.   We started with the lamb BBQ skew. I like the northern China spice seasoning. The skew probably the best thing we have. The second appetizer was the beef burger. It is beef in pita like item. The pita can be improved and the beef can be more juicier.   Our entree is the their Lanzhou Beef Noodle. There is 8 pieces slice beef. The soup base is good. Food is good not wow. My wife braise beef is average. She feel the beef is less in quantity. At least this restaurant is a bit above average compared to some other noodle place.

This my neighborhood Chili. Very Caliente. When we walk out at 8:30 pm, there are people waiting to get a table. Popular for the local resident.  I always like chili fajitas. But lately they have change about the meat cut. The seasoning is still there. Today the flour tortilla is about a bit dry. Which mean they have not steam it completely. This just need a few second more and they will be ok. My wife have the chicken pasta. It is good taste.   I always start with strawberry lemonade with my soft drink. At the refill, I am asking to change to blackberry ice tea then change to mango ice tea. Sometime they have watermelon lemonade. I have 3 different drink in one order. The strawberry lemonade also dilute down. They use to have the strawberry seed. Now they don't.   The service at the bar area is quick.

We always love to go to Cracker Barrel on thanksgiving day. Because they are the few restaurants that open that day and serve thanksgiving meal. This year we did not do the sit down lunch due to pandemic. We know the restaurant probably pack. As a result we order to go.   They have make adjustments for the pandemic for how to pick out the the food. They informed you that there is a tent outside for the curb side pickup. When I arrived I went to a line for the pickup sign. Soon realized they do have two different line. One for the large meal tray pickup and the other for to go pickup. This area they need to improve. At to pickup, I ask if I should stay in the car, the told me line up at tent area will be faster. I think they really to to be effective and efficient which they did not do it. I still have wait at 15 minutes on line to pick up food where my food was ready sit on the counter. They could have changed ready pickup line and order to go line.   Food is good with a lot of side for the thanksgiving meal. I like my tradition with the restaurant. They do need to improve the online order which crash that day.

This review has five stars only because of their lunch special. It is actually an 4.5 stars. It is good value on weekday lunch special. Most roll is about $5. Even they are $5, each roll come with 8 pieces. The lunch special is from Monday to Friday. During lunch time, they have quite number of customers.   I got the vegetable roll, Cougar roll, Lava roll, Mexican roll and eel cucumber roll. The best is cougar roll. It is spicy tuna with sweet seaweed and top with smelt roe. The tuna grade is excellent. The next one I like is lava roll with spicy crab on California roll top with shiracha sauce.   They may be not five star if I come at night time and pay more because I expect better. Obviously the dinner is still needed to be evaluated. The service is just right. Did not make me jump up my seat. But the quality of the food is good.

H20C open not long ago. Our first time here the line is long. After the honeymoon period, they are back to normal line wait. I like the way they present the drink container. They have the cup shape like light bulbs. In the same time, the shape of the cup also a bit smaller than regular 16 oz cup. It also has limitations to fit in your car cup holder. However, this light bulb shape cup is their trade mark, it will be difficult to change from unique shape. I would keep using it, because the cup is the differential from other boba place.   I got the taro milk shake. The only thing I don't like is the use regular milk. I wish they can use b1 milk which can help on people who cannot take milk. The taste is good. I think is more like power flavor mixed. Overall is interesting. I would at least just to try it once for collecting the light bulb cup.

In search of Taco in the Bay Area. Taco is thriving in this restaurant. The name really attract many people to be here. I just wonder who will be the taco father. I like the name of the restaurant reflect their food of serving.   Tonight we did not try other combination but just taco. Since tonight is week night, we order the taco on the board. The steak, grilled pork, cow tongue, pork in green salsa. I like the steak taco. You know they have good taco because the steak is not pre-cook and re-cook when people order (the meat will be too dry). As a result the meat is tender and juicy. I heard they have the shrimp taco special on Friday. I will be back to try that.   They are about 4.5 stars restaurant in my opinion. I award them to five stars due to a lot of meat is pack to one taco, juicy, great taste, nice garnish. I like the meat is likely season not over power and still can taste the steak is the important key factor. This review only for their taco not other combination dish. I would try their quesadilla next time I am here.

Lan Zhou is one of the few exceptional restaurants improve on their food from my previous visit. I am applauding their restaurant still maintains a good price with good quantity of food. In fact, their taste is way better than they just open the door. It is big improvement.   This restaurant is about 4.5 stars to my book now. I few I fill my stomach compare to my last visit. The soup broth also getting better. Quantity also improved. All this is good especially during pandemic. I can see a lot customers in the restaurant. This is a good sign. They definitely in the right track to restaurant.   Service is good. Food is better now, quantity improved. What else can you say.

They have the big board indicated the brewery on the tap when you walk in. Some beer is interesting from other states. BJ has been open for business not long ago. I have their food at Gainesville before. Now they are close to my neighborhood.   We have ordered the pan seared salmon with quinoa and seared tuna salad. Their R and D did a good job to come out the menu. It is very likable. The tuna is seasoning and seared outward. The salad has good dressing and good selection of ingredients. Crispy wonton skin and pickle ginger add the flavor to the salad.   The salmon is almost like blacken outside with good spice. The quinoa is well cook. I like this dish the most. At the end we added the monkey bread with ice cream. Like cinnamon roll top with two scoops of vanilla ice cream.   Call ahead for putting your name in the wait list will cut down wait time by half. Paying process is quick close up.

It 3.5 stars. The ambient is definitely top notch for a brewery. If I need a beer with friend, this is definitely the place to be. For sure one thing they do it right is make this place family oriented. The food have kid menu. The also have arcade games area for kid. If need a sip with your family, this a way to go.   The outside seating is very nice. Comfortable to get together. They also have private party room. Other than dining area, the have upper class dining room too. The entire compound set up is nice. Spacious to walk and good for kid. The happy hours is from 3 to 5:30 pm with discount price on certain items.   We got the Florida Avenue Larger to sip. I like the light brew beer especially if you are thirsty. We also got the FL Ave Wing to try. We have the brown sugar bbq sauce. This wing is ok. The price of a wing two dollars a piece is in the high side. I would go for the blackened dry rub.   Overall is good. May be food need to rethink how to price. Otherwise they area fun place to be.

Dream of ice cream and you found it. This newly open ice cream shop at grove village. It is easy find because they are at the corner of the plaza. We have been to the same ice cream shop at the lutz area. They are expanding to Wesley Chapel grove area.   The flavor is divided to three different categories. The traditional ice cream, over 21 alcohol ice cream and the vegan ice cream. We got the Rum Haven and the PB Fudge. The rum haven have some kick at the beginning but the PB fudge finished it off. Because the PB fudge has whiskey in it. Both flavor are excellent.   Definitely is must go place to visit. The clerk are friendly. The hour may be adjusted depending on the customer visit.

Rare Ethnic Food #73. Ethiopian Cuisine.   Queen of Sheba is the best African restaurant you can find in Tampa Bay. Love it. The mixture of the spice and taste is very harmonious good. Expect waiting for the food because is popular. The owner is very friendly. Treat you like her family.  We got the sampler to share and add a lamb tip. The sampler has three meats and three veggies. The three meats including two chicken and one beef. We add Queen Lamb Tip. All the meat is cook with different flavor. I like all of them. The lamb is good. I also like the veggies. Very good use of spice in each veggies to create the dish. Love the creativity of the veggies. You also can ask the share plate to be all veggies.   The best way to eat it is by hand. Use the injera to pick up the food. My cheated with requested folk and knife. Which is not normally done.

Very hip place. Plenty of space to have gathering. There are noisy sections on the front or more quiet place at the back building. This place attracts a lot younger group of customers. I feel old when I am walk in but in the same time I am juvenile myself with the younger group.   The bar has cocktails mixologist which can make some cocktails. We got the Happy Buddha Beer, hotdogs nuggets, fire that pig skin burger. This burger is burger week burger. It has Wagyu beef patty top with smoke pull pork and onion ring. It is using Texas toast as bun. Very good burger. They should keep this in their regular menu. The hot dog nuggets just like the Somali corn dog. Come with special dipping sauce.   We enjoy our time here at the bar. Service is good because we got all the attention from bar tenders. Food is good and so is the speed to deliver the food to table. The game machines is classic which is fun enough to play.

It is about 3.5 stars. Not 4 stars yet. This place open before the pandemic business close. Now it open back up for customers is a sign of the returning to business. It is considered a new restaurant near Cross Creek. The previous restaurant close down due to lack of customers traffic. I hope they do well.   I got the full chicken with tax is about above average price grilled chicken around here. If they they can adjust a little bit for their price, may be can be more compete with neighborhood rotisserie chicken. I would said they have good marinated sauce into the meat and bone of the chicken. This I give them an A.   If you order takeout, you may want to call ahead. Because they may not be ready for you on time. The reception need to improve in speed for dealing with customers order. Seem like need improvement.

Nicks is fried seafood place. They have good deal on fried shrimp. The place look like a take out place. They do have a few table if you want to dine there. Parking is available on the plaza lot.   We got seafood combo with fried tilapia and shrimp. It come with 10 shrimps and two pieces fried tilapia. You can choose different types of fish. The coating is crispy. It is also light seasoning. We also got 1/2 pounds fried gizzards. The coating is medium seasoning. I actually like their gizzard seasoning. Both dishes are good to have. Love munching on the gizzard.   Wait time is bearable from the start of order. You can call in to save time.

At southern county, we were able to find a clean, modern look, and contemporary interior decoration for Vietnamese cuisine. Due to Covid-19, the restaurant charge extra dollars for cleaning and serving. Restaurant has big wide area dining hall. Table set six feet apart.   We start with with grilled pork spring roll. The pork is not the slice grilled pork. It is ground pork like sausage wrap with vermicelli noodle. It serve with the house sauce. But I think the table special house hot sauce is much better to go with the spring roll.   Our entree is Spicy Hue Style beef noodle soup. This soup base is the best in Bay Area. The dish come with typical raw veggies for Vietnamese noodle. Beef brisket, slice beef, fish cake and more. It is recommended to go with this dish if you like a bit spicy.   Service just average.

Great historic building to be use as theater and play. I have been here numerous time for concert and symphony. It has good waiting hallway lead up to second floor the main theater.   The seat is a bit uncomfortable but good for an hour show. We were there for Tampa Bay Symphony perform some folk song. It was very interesting since the theater has good acoustic sound to project the music instruments.   The also has third floor for better viewing of the stage. The AC is blow a bit stronger and bring a jacket for your comfort.

Solid 4 stars restaurant. We were early on the dinner. We're were the first customers. Most of the customers come around 7pm. If you looking for a romantic dinner, this may be your place. They have live music at night during weekend. Price is medium range at dinner, weekday lunch have better deal. Time change a bit for pandemic so call ahead.   I got the Pesca Alla Griglia - grilled grouper with Italian herb and drizzle with balsamic vinegar. This dish come with two sides. It is sautéed veggies and potatoes. The sides are excellent. The grouper is fresh with good seasoning with grilled mark.   Our second dish is the Pollo Scarparella. This is chicken breast sautéed with Italian sausage. It sauce with mushroom, roasted red pepper, onion in white wine with balsamic vinegar and Demi glazed sauce. The sauce is wonderful. This is a good dish to have.   Service is good. Very attentive. Food has good taste and flavor. It is good for romantic night.

Rare Authentic Cuisine 63, Xi'an Cuisine   Finally, I can say there is a great hand pull noodle in Tampa. And!! It is at my neighborhood. Finally the wait is over, and I was able to eat in the restaurant. The restaurant name in Chinese is "Old Taste". I believe it old method long pass through generations and come to US. Xi'an cuisine is famous on flat noodle, beef rougamo , or hand pull noodle. Love it.   We start with the beef rougamo - beef pita. The beef is slice beef shank with spicy marinated. I've the beef. I may not necessarily like the pita. We also got the Yummy chicken nuggets. The coating is panko crispy with a bit of Cummings.   Our main dish is braise beef hand pull noodle. This is the one I recommend. The beef was well marinated and keep the juicy meat taste. The hand pull noodle has very good texture. By the way, it is spicy. The final dish is the chicken with dry chili. It has good high BTU wok technique. Next time, we will order the broil fish with bean sprouts.   I can say the restaurant is 4.5 stars. Items can improve is provide the menu to read instead scan bar code and find the menu in the phone. I rather have real menu. They are still on try out. The speed of the food delivery to the table may need to be faster.

Jeni has ice cream flavor that not found in many place. I like the all flavor they serve. They also charge the flavor most often to keep me interested.   During pandemic the inside seating is not available. But they do have outdoor seating. It is good to have ice cream and eat it there. This store may face lack of customers due to location. Don't know if the customer at Amateurwork will come here to enjoy the ice cream. We like the trio ice cream with three flavors. We got brambleberry crisp, rainbow buttermilk, and blackout chocolate cake. This three flavor is interesting.

I have been to this place several time. If you in search for Italian product, this is your place. The store is part restaurant, part grocery and part wine store. They do carry good bottles of Italian wine. I like the rose wine here.   The sandwich is decent here. I have couple of different sandwiches here. I have Cuban and European classic. Both sandwiches are tasty. They also have pizza that I have not try it. One thing for sure, the cold cut prosciutto is good here. I like to have a few cut and go with the rose.  I got a bottle of Italian wine. It is good enough. They do have other Italian red. But I am interested on their rose.   The store also has series of refrigerators that selling home made item. You should check it out.

For fast food, this is a good model. In term of food, kitchen, and customer relations. This criteria was use to rate their quality and value. They are about 4.5 stars to my experience. It is good fast food model. I have been to their sister restaurant in the mall, and now the independent building, it is a lot better setting compared to the mall.   Food- I think they have good high end food with medium price. The choices also better than other location. Food is tasty. We got the shrimp poboy. Good number of shrimp.
