One thing surprised me is their fried chicken strips have very good coating.  Kitchen- it bigger kitchen than mall food court. Output of the food was in good rate. Food come out quick. Chef also better. Please keep up the good work.  Customer relations- the have good service. Very friendly from order to food delivery to table and check on customer need.   One thing strikes me is they have a hand wash station. I like that feature if you need to wash your hand without going to the restroom. It is convenient. They host movies night on the lawn for family which is a plus.

For food vendors in the heights market, they have a line during lunch time. The popularity bring good business to them. The food is good in compare to all vendors in the market. I know their breakfast sandwich is popular. Many people get that item.   I just want to try their top item. The Palomilla Steak. It is most expensive item in the menu. The steak is good. But base on my previous stay in Miami for 11 years, this dish need work. That do not measure my taste buds. The steak needs to be thinner and more flavor. Need some burn taste too. The side item is better. Other than that. All is good.

Very interesting Mexican Bakery. It is tuck away at the strip plaza behind a building. You need to pay attention to find it. This bakery offer many interesting pastries, cake, jello, churros. The price is good.   We got tamales there 4 for$5. The tamales is bean base with pork. It is quite good after heating up. It will be cheap lunch if you go with it. I also got some churros and dusted sugar pastry. These items are delicious. The cake is moist and great flavor. I have pound cake and coffee cake both are great.   They sell the new year six cake Rosca de Reyes to celebrate the Epiphany. It is ring cake for sale. It is great to have a Taste of the cake. They also has the coconut pastry with cherry on top. Great dessert. Don't forget their refrigerator jello. Please check them out.

We were here to buy a registry gift. It is next to the sprouts market. I wonder the parking will be pack during the shopping time because of the adjacent popular store.   It was not hard to find the items that we were looking for when there was help on the floor to point us the direction. We also went to get some fruit since they are super target that carry groceries also. It convenient to make this one stop destination.   We were assist on the removal of the registry item we brought. The only thing they miss is the two items we bought for registry, the clerk only remove one. But we found a way to remove the item online when we use the receipt number below. As a result we don't need to return to the store to remove it. It was good thing we have online solutions.

I like the new establishment of Zukku. The new restaurant set up is beautiful with high ceilings with beautiful wall decoration. The chair also decorative and fit the entire restaurant interior. This is something they were not able to do at Armateurwork. I have to give them an A in the interior.   They welcome us with expandable hot tower. It is a good show to begin the meal. We started with the Centipede roll. It is a spicy tuna top with hamachi. It look delicious but I think their spicy tuna need some work. May be mixed in the sesame oil and quail egg to mixed in will better.   I do like grilled hamachi collard. It has good large pieces. The dressing is good and complemented the collard. We also has one chicken and one steak Yakitori. Those have good flavor. The bake mussels is the one I recommend and the have good topping and baked seasoning.   I would said they expanded the appetizers very well. Service is good. It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars.

Review 499. Closing the 400 series review, I have chosen the Italian market since they are true 5 stars location in my book. It has been honor to write this review to be one of my best 400 series review. The Italian market become my joy to visit or pick the items before go to picnic.   Lunch here certainly is a must if you visit old St. Pete downtown. This market not just makes you forget you are in America, it feel like shopping in Italy. Everything is so real and fresh. We have a chance to visit this market for a test drive and we fall in love immediately.   Not only this market have hot sandwich, it have hot Italian sandwich. Most "Italian" sandwiches I have is cold. This hot Italian sandwich is the best seller in the sandwich menu. We have pick up couple slices of seared tuna and couple pieces of scallops. They help us heat up the scallops in oven and eat at their garden dining area.   They have many tasting station. They even include wine and cheese room. Try some of the cheese there. Mamamia. They are good. Instead of you read about my review. You need to experience yourself.

Kapok Event Center is also the home of Players School of Music. This school is located next to Sam Ash Music store which make very convenience to the student if they have a broken string. Many student oversea has study here. Choose your instrument of study. Bass, Guitar, Keyboard, Drum, Horn or Vocal. They have it all. The provide practical and principle of music of study. Event is hosted for their student.  Most of all, this very beautiful event location. Waterfall garden, little angle, mermaid, Greek garden, courtyard, nice ball room. Sound like good small wedding location. Picture perfect photo location. You can take it many angle and they are different. It can produce ton of nice photo back ground. Wedding, Anniversary, Reunion, Recital, Holiday party is ideal in this location. The ambient is nice and wonderful. They have many room to choose from. Or you can pick one of their garden.  They have bar inside. During festival, they serve all kind of drink. From beer to mixed drink like margarita.

New method of the ice cream making. Icesmile catch my attention immediately after Mark review. I told my wife that we are going to try something new that night. If you want the fresh made ice cream, go no further.   Icesmile just open less than a week when we visit. The procedure is choose you flavor then the three toppings. We have chosen tropical storm - mango, peach  pineapple flavor. Our toppings are lychee, blueberry and kiwi. It start with the vanilla liquid with the chop up fruits. The start to mixed on top of the ice frozen metal top. You can see the liquid start getting thicker in the process. The final is to spread over the plate in thin layer. They scooped it up in the roll format. Toppings then to be added.   The taste is good. Not too sweet. Since they just opened, they are still make some decorations when we visit. They are more expensive than the regular ice cream scoop since they are make fresh from the beginning. It is worth to watch the ice cream form.   There are some suggestions that the store can improve. More toppings selection included tapioca or jelly. Some snack items, may be free wifi. May be included drink item. Water for customers.

This Target is convenient if you need to to abandon Westfield mall and shop at Target. It is one stop location for the surrounding town center. The only bad thing is if you want to shop on target only, you must face the mall traffic.   The Target here is super Target with the groceries. The place is nice and neat. I like the Target dog as a prop for the display. Star way DVD is under promotion to be on sale soon.   They have enough counter open and self checkout which help the speed up the check out process.

Rare Authentic Food No. 24  This restaurant is about 4.5 stars. It will be an adventure to find this restaurant in the neighborhood drive. The Yelp map is accurate when you ask for the directions.   The cuisine is island Jamaican. Mrs Hazel is the chef and she can take good care of you. We have a group go there 1.5 hour before it closed. The menu is on the board and you have try to understand they serve. I would said picture print out along with the name is quicker and faster. But if the menu change often, picture may not work.   We have order a bunch of food to try. Oxtail, jerk pork, red pea soup, and more. I like the oxtail and the red pea soup. The soup go well with yum banana dumplings. The Oxtail fall off from the bone. We even have some Jamaican dessert.   It was fun to be there. Experience the hidden Safety Harbor section.

Rare Ethic Food No. 17  I have come to here often because they have oriental bakery. Oriental bakery is different than French or American bakery. Material and ingredients is a lot different. The sweetness is really tone down compared to Latin bakery.   Fortune Star is famous fruit sponge cake. It is definitely different than traditional sponge cake. It is fluffy and very lightly sweet. In between the cake layer is the fruit filling. Cool whip topping with very nice and beautiful design. The basic 10" sponge cake is $25. Need minimum one day before order. Average they make 20 cake a day. So call early to order. The different filling such taro filling is extra.   Other than their famous cake. They sell cut off pieces if you like to try. The also have Chinese bake bun. They include BBQ pork bun, curry bun, egg custard bun. Other than the bun, they have wife bean cake, sun cake and red bean cake. Go check them out.

Rare Authentic Food No. 23  I Ai Sushi is authentic Japanese street food. Of course the sushi is available. But there are other dish available. Since this is mom and pop shop. The owners are the waitress. I saw some reviews in the past. I think they have changed their system a lot since then.   Before it they have menu in Japanese and customers take a lot of time try to understand what they eat. Now they just have pictures at the entrance and you order and paid at the entrance. Easier and cut down the time try to explain and make the process slow.   We have order the Ramen and grilled squid. The squid was slice after grilled and go with their home made sauce. The ramen is close to what we have eat in Japan. As a result we like their authenticity.

I was looking forward for to try this restaurant happy hour items for long time. This will be our progressive dinner stop 3. When I walk into the restaurant in Sunday, they still serving the happy hour items. Since this is stop 3, we order the appetizer. They has this deal 4-7 Tue to Friday, Monday all day, Sunday 2 pm to close and Saturday from noon to 7 pm. Very extensive.   We got the grilled oysters and the clam casino. The oyster is top with cheese. I said is just average. The clam is better. The clam bacon, pepper and onion. This dish worth the try and drive from far distance. I notice their happy hour items included fillet mignon kabab and other interesting app. You also can go full meal for $15 with crab cake, fillet mignon kabab, coconut shrimp and more. Good deal.   Sunday they have brunch for $20 including two drink. Not bad. The place is nice with bar. Seating area has it own TV. Nice treatment.

This Walmart has clear sign everywhere. I agree with other reviews this is a much mini superstore. The store is well organized. Typical Walmart. We are here for pick up a small thing.   The deli has the wings I like. It is Parmesan flavor wing. They also have other flavor wings is attractive to try. Deli section is complete. The bakery section is available. Not sure the sandwich is good here. The food grocery carry a lot of need for any housewife cooking.   Clothing for man and women is average for the fashion. Seem like the need some color. They do have sales items at the center aisle. Pharmacy is available in this location. Pick up thing or two is good here.

This restaurant is a 3.5 stats restaurant in my book. We were here at their anniversary where they have free baklava for the customer. Today we are using the groupon to try the restaurant first time in this location.   We have order the lamb, chicken and beef kabab. We also order extra meat on the gyro and added the falafel. Going big on order for this visit. Today the best chicken kabab. The lamb and steak is a bit chewy. I order meat with medium rare. The marinate is on point except the meat quality need to be better. The falafel is a bit below average. The baklava is excellent. The gyro also excellent since they shave of the main skew and cook it one more time to make this crispy.   Overall the food is above average. Service is better than good. The place is well decorated.

This is the place I take my car for wash and oil change. I have been here several time. It is a quick thing to do. Sometime the line is too long that I have to come on other day.   Today is Tuesday and they have the lube and oil change special. It is $19.95 include out side wash (normal is $29.95). The oil change service include the compliment wash. The price is a steal with two things accomplish in less than half hours. Alway inform them to use hand tight for the lube nut to avoid damage to the car.   I have only car wash here before. They did an ok job for the price paid. Usually you will see some dirt in the trim line that difficult to get out. Overall they are clean. They have different wash or wax or cleaning the inside or steam clean with leather amor. The bug removal is extra.   They also have the reward card if you come here regularly. Every dollar you spend you get 10% back in reward. It work for me like 10 wash get one free. Do not expect extremely clean. But is clean enough. It is good in winter since you don't need to wash in cold weather and someone take care for you here.

This is our neighborhood Dairy  Queen. We always receive the coupon in the mail. We alway like the coupon for the buy one and get one free coupon. The best thing about them is they run the manager special.   Just a note, I am guessing they love to have the store at high visible area at the Main Street such as Bruce B Down to get more traffic with customer. It is great to have the store across to cinema. If you have a scary movie you need to have the ice cream to calm your heartbeat. If you watch a love movie, you can share the ice cream with your love one and continue in the love pool.   I love their blizzard the way they have prepared it. They with mix the ice cream, milk, choices of mix and scramble together. Then they will show you the upside down mixed product in the cup to tell you how well they mix it. I love their cappuccino flavor with Heath bar. My wife usually cannot have any caffein after noon time. I am usually finish the cup myself. The Heath bar crunch make the blizzard more flavor increase the coffee flavor. Chocolate and cappuccino - get it together like the superglue in flavor.   I can see their business is getting impact by nearby ice cream store. Competition among them getting stronger. I will continue to support them when I can.

I have been many Latin Cafeteria, this one is average. However, they do have a few items that is stand out. The pig stomach soup and the whole pig Lechon - roast pig. The roast pig is good here. The skin is crispy if you for a piece to try. It must roasted in the long hours. The marinated sauce when inside the meat. Consider this is a must try dish if you visit. They may be the only one who serve the pig stomach soup I found in Latin cuisine. It is good and soft. The Chinese cook it with whole black pepper, the Latin cook it yellow base soup. It take some skill to cook this dish.   The reason they are three star is the rest of the item do not stand out. The rice is under cook. The plantain is not soft enough which mean the did not do a correct selection of how ripe it need to be. The octopus Ceviche is blend. Need more spice. Service is average since is cafeteria style.

This restaurant first day opening for business is Chinese New Year. We were looking for Chinese food after the celebration event. We didn't know they actually just opened for business that day. After checking for the menu, we decided to tryout the new restaurant.   This is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Since they just open, the are some kink need to workout. The restaurant use to another Chinese restaurant. They have redecorated the interior and it is mor brighter than previous restaurant interior. I like the current lighting better.   We have ordered the scallions beef, fried calamari, three cup chicken, sweet and sour ribs, and seafood fried noodle. The three cup chicken is compose of three different sauce in same measurement. This is chop up chicken with bone. I like it. I like the most is the seafood fried noodle. The noodle taste very good with the sauce. You need to mixed the sauce in and soak the fried noodle to soft and eat it.   Overall our service is Average. Food is good. We enjoy our time there.

The Macy locates at the center of the Shop Wiregrass mall. They strategically located at the main attraction of this mall. Any big event of this mall is happening around this area.   Macy is pleasant to shop due to wide space walkway and any good selection. They often provide discount when it comes close to any holiday. When you sign up the mailing list, they mail the coupons to your home. Although they are in the high side on many items, when it is discount, the price cut is deep. I often get discounts on top of another discount. Some of the work long sleeve dress I have purchased is only $12 of the 50% discount with another 30% off.   The home good is at the second floor which is I often visit.  The bathroom is clean in Macy if I come to this mall.

The fish house is hidden secret for the local. Thanks God we have Yelp to locate this restaurant. This is favorite of the Ruskin residents in this remote area. This restaurant is buried deep inside town. If you didn't drive to this location, you would not notice it.  They have fresh fish and shrimp. But their signature dish is the smoke mullet. They serve limited fish for the day. If you come late, you may not be able to get one. However, there is plenty of other seafood you can choose. The choice included the shrimp, oyster, catfish, or soft shell crab. I got the mixed and match with shrimp and catfish. This dish is fresh and good. Two sites come with it for $12. Good deal.   This place is open air with high ceilings. During the summer time, it is still cool breeze with fan blowing.

Top Golf is top of the world at third level bay. It is gorgeous beautiful golf outing. Thanks to yelp friends invite, we have experienced firsthand 3D golf with games system. This is one of the golf courses you can know about your driving golf ball distance.   It doesn't matter it rain or shine, this place can handle both conditions. We were there when Tampa has been rain for a week. I actually like to play when it rain in summer time. Summer in Tampa for outdoor is brutal even with the sun down. Rain actually cools it down for this cover open air activities.   We like the food there with bite can be share with many people. We have steak flat bread, Mushi, and buffalo chicken slider. The Mushi is chicken roll in jalapeño tortilla. They have many pieces to share. I would consider they have many selection of the party food.   My friend shows me the games system of the golf. I am just a recreation golfer may be golf 1 time every three years. You will know I am not the skill golfer. My friend indicate to me that is better for me since I am not the serious golfer and I will enjoy more in Top Golf games. Serious golfers loose the fun of this place since they ask for their perfection of their skill.   They also have games indoor with pool table, games console with motion and more. The games are free inside.  However, the price of golf is double after 6 pm.

Great indoor club. The first sentence describes all. I enjoy our time there with three other friends. It was not mean for the father day's celebration, but I did it anyway without kid. During the same night, We saw the next table have the engagement party over 15 people. They are crazy enough to celebrate together in surprise.   The story started with a selfie stick of that day. After we have some of the food, we decided to give the picture with the band. Fortunately I have brought one selfie stick that night. We have taken some selfie with band and the waitress. While we have selfie, our neighbor table customer came and has the video bomb. There where everything begin. We start going to their table with our selfie stick and take the picture of the engagement party. It's how the people there are very nice and party.   Tonight we have the shrimp cocktail, chipotle BBQ wing, pull pork nacho, peanut soup, chicken and crab cake nacho, slice skirt steak. The only thing I not a fan is the shrimp cocktail. The shrimp must have sit in the refrigerator for some time. Freshness is not there.   Tonight the band for the Amanda Drake and the barnburners provide a great country with blue vibe music entertain the crowd. Barnburners - I wonder how many barn they have burn. The music is mixed to current popular song. We enjoy it. Service is great. We have Xena the princess warrior serving us. We will be back to have fun since they have the indoor vibe. I would suggest come at 7pm enjoy two hour peaceful meal then enjoy the blasting music for another two hours.

Lee House is Center located in Brandon . They have dim sum menu but we did not try it. My neighbors table order the Hong Kong style egg noodle wonton soup. They seem to enjoy it very much. I also notice they run out the last bowl of this soup that night.   We select the item at the last page menu with three courses for $25. Not a bad deal. We have the salt and pepper squid, grouper with XO sauce, and beef chow fun. The dishes is big and good for hungry people. The squid is in wet batter coating  which I am not a fan. But the other two dishes did a good job.   I notice they have delivery. I have read one of friend review about 2.5 hour delay story. I think their delivery is not reliable. So come to eat at the restaurant. I can see not consistent in this restaurant since they run out of material. The day we visit is ok service.

The New Orleans Jazz National Historic Park is a unique place. This park is run by National Park Service. I definite like the ranger position here. They are located in the big easy and the work is much easy - no forest fire to worry, big animal attack tourist. The park has ranger program free tour around the French Quarter to the Old US Mint. Now I think more of it, I like the ranger assignment here. May be I should be apply for the special language tour guide.   The park hosts the indoor and outdoor concert. Some concert in the Historic Park, some in the Old Mint, Some in the French Market. Today they have listed two concerts, one in the Historic Park and One in the Old Mint. We have gone to the Historic Park since our time has conflict with the parade for the other concert.   The historic park is hosting a Cajun children Jazz concert. The performer is Johnette Downing. She is author for the children book, children jazz song, and performer of children jazz. It was rewarding that the song actually from food of the children eat in a week. Song like Monday red bean, Tuesday Po-Boys, Wednesday Gumbo, Thursday Jambalaya, Friday Cat Fish, Saturday Crawfish and Sunday Beignet. She also has song like Mississippi River, Cajun Dance Bonjour, Chef Creole, and Crawfish Song. It makes you think about Louisiana Cuisine.  Please check at the park for the schedule of the day with variety of free concert and location.

I like to thank Nick S. for the notice to this restaurant. It located at Temple Terrace northwest corner of Whiteway Drive and 56 street the Temple Terrace Village Plaza. This is Peruvian restaurant. The restaurant owner are Elizabeth and her husband. Her husband is the cook. The restaurant just started December 26 2014. Elizabeth is from Columbia and her husband is from Peru. Peruvian grilled meat is very tasty.   The lunch and dinner menu seem like the same. We have order the Falda and Lomo de Cerdo - grilled skirt steak and grilled pork chop tenderloin. The Falda is equivalent to Churrasco in Argentine dish. The meat should be at the low section of cow a long flat cut of skirt steak from the "plate" of the cow. The skirt steak is actually diaphragm muscle of the cow but in low section. Some one may serve you the skirt steak on the upper section which not as good as the low section. This restaurant also serve the upper section skirt steak dish call Vacio. Which is internal flank plate. Today the Falda came with the home made chimichurri sauce. You also allow to select one side. I have select the sweet plantain. All dish came with salad in the plate. To eat Falda, cut along the meat to the direction of the meat grain with small strip. You will enjoy more with cut since the Falda come in strip against the meat grain. I can finally said I found a reasonable price churrasco that comparable to Cuban churrasco that serve in Miami ($18.95) at Tampa. My wife dish is the grill pork chop. Seem like the preparation is first fried then grilled. The pork chop is marinate with rosemary, salt and pepper. This chop is good since they are sealing meat juice when they prepare it.   Overall the restaurant is not busy and you get the service from the owner. A few thing they may be able to improve is have the lunch menu price that can attract more customer. Adding the pre-meal item such as bread or soup. The decoration of the restaurant display the mozaic of the local Peruvian art and painting. The restaurant back door is open to ventilating the food smell. So pick the seat close to the front to avoid food smoke.

Interesting setting of the restaurant that show the picture of musician. They have live music on Thursday, Friday and Sunday. We were very lucky that we have a seat immediately. We were here when Genghis Flan playing here. Parking is challenge since the restaurant have a lot of traffic. If you come after 7:00 pm, you can park at the value pawn shop after they close.   Tonight dinner we have begin with crab stuffed butternut squash. Butternut squash is a very difficult cooking material to be use, however, the chef did a very good job to prepare it with crab meat and citrus hollandaise source. The squash filled with crab meat area is extremely soft and sweet to eat.   Our main course is chicken mole and beef tenderloin. The chicken is very juicy in curry source top over comb read arepa. Who can think about the combination of the dish. It is getting better with the preparation on the beef tenderloin. The dish come with 2 pieces of 4 oz tenderloin in port wine source. It grilled to perfect with beef juice seal inside. This dish also come with bacon wrap asparagus. Bacon is good with any food but who can think the combination of crispy bacon wrap with bacon juice drip into the asparagus. It also come with mash potato cake. The mash is well season and the top is bake to crispy.   I am usually not given out 5 star. The cooking and the mixture of the material and taste is well balance. The food give me a wow and unique factor.

Very nice restaurant located between the two counties. It has very nice light green color theme. It has outside seating that is pleasant to the customer.   They are Mediterranean restaurant in Greek cuisine. They have good veggies dish. It include the grill veggies plate. The daily special for lunch is under $10. Kid menu is available also with little people pricing.   I have grilled lamb feast. It came with salad and basmati rice. The lamb is not cut in cube at stick. It is big piece lamb meat. As a result, there is a lot of fiber in the meat and it is not tenderize. It is tough to bite. The salad is nice. The food smell good. I would try other dishes if I visit again.

This restaurant has nice interior and they furnitures are looked better than most of Latin restaurant. It was not busy during the weekday dinner time. They open for dinner but until 9pm.   I have ordered a Vaca Frita with extra crispy. I specifically ask them stir fry them and make the outside crispy. This Vaca Frita when is burn outward crispy is very tasty. It is flank steak with potential for shredded beef. It bring out the burn meat taste. It take them some time to do it. The difference from other place that I like it is this place put too much oil and ultimately make the inside crispy. I would recommend the lemon on the side instead of add to the meat directly. It make to order but too oily.   Food is average. Service is good. Close out can be faster since not much of customers there.

I walk in this place try to compare with the one in Brandon. Surprisingly they were not busy at Friday night. I remember the Brandon location take about 4 months to slow down from crazy line to normal busy line. This place is not very busy at all as they told me on the phone when I call to check. The dog house is still there if you want to have the picture.   We have coupon for a free fried. I have order the half slab baby back a la carts and fried halibut. The baby back is below average. The temperature is warm and is not right. It is dinner standard compare to many wood grilled place. The halibut is definitely disappointed. The fast food fish sandwich place can do better on the crispy coating than this place. The accompanying lettuce is soggy. All food temperature is not good other the fried is right.  The food delivery is way behind schedule. Too slow at a slow day.   Am I going to return. No, done from my check list. Not even the coupon can bring me back.

Dry Rub BBQ. That is the key. Memphis BBQ is one of the kind BBQ that different from many in the bay area. I learn a lot from the owner of the restaurant how Memphis BBQ is different than most BBQ. Memphis main focus is on the pig. While Kansas may be Florida BBQ are focused on the cow meat.   We have sampler plater with a choice of two meat. We have selected their famous baby back rib and the BBQ wings. We also order a pull pork Sammich. The owner told me the pull pork from the good part of the pig that carry a bit fat but contributing to the taste. The pull pork is slow cook over 12 hours. The rib is smoke for about 7 hours. It is fall off the bone. No knife is needed. Both of the rib and pull pork are very delicious.   The wings is grilled with sweet sauce. Very good. The side is amazing. We have grilled corn. Mmmm good. We have the collar green and fried okra. Good southern food. Corn pudding is yummy.   Blame Andrew for hiding this place for long time. This is best in the bay for me now.

I have visit this place many time. After a year, they finally have some good sales. During this thanksgiving season, the Black Friday sale has some good discounts. Parking lots are full of cars. Hopefully this is a prosperous year for the mall. The Christmas decorations is not much in the mall. But the light colors is adjusted to green and red.   Currently the mall has built up their surrounding with some good restaurant. It is good for the shopper who went there. There are some unique store such mimmic. There is a food court in the middle if you want to get something to eat.   The mall has a lot of choices to shop. From small items to big ticket such as coach handbag. All has some bargains in the mixed.

By living in Miami for 11 year, it train you tongue for the Cuban food. We have been to this restaurant many time and we like the food here. Compare to other Cuban restaurant, this top of my list. I like to thank Steve E organize the UYE. This is the first time that I have come to this restaurant in large group. It poof the service can keep up with group.   Today I have order the Vaca Frita. Vaca Frita is flank steak in thin pieces. It is first deep fried and then hot plate grilled. I specifically ask them to make it crispy.  Which mean make the outside burn a bit. The Vaca Frita is easily separate into shredded beef with folks. They usually top with grilled onion. A twist of lemon juice can be added to enhance the flavor.  My dish comes with sweet plantain and I have added fried yucca.   I have been here many times but have not give a review. I like to give them 5 stars due to service, very affordable pricing (under $10 for my dish), and good cooking in Cuban style.

Finally some decent BBQ in Wesley Chapel wireglass mall. This is a good BBQ joint. We were there when they give away some goodies. We got a free drink jug and T shirt.   We were surprise they are not busy during 6:00 pm. May be they just open a few days ago and not many people know about it. We have ordered the Far East sandwich and the brisket. Because it is dry rub, it generated the crispy outside crush. This Brisket was grilled for 12 hours according to the manager. The meat is ver juicy. They have two cut available for you choices. Either chop or slice. Slice is the best to preserve the juiciness. Our two side are fried whole okra and bacon mac and cheese. The side is a bit blend but the BBQ is tasty.   The Far East is the surprise. The use of the sauce is awesome. It is pork with kimchi, toasted sesame seed and cilantro. Yum sandwich. I would recommend this sandwich. The service is very attentive. I also order the craft soda with grilled lemonade. Very sour. Ok.

We saw this posting in yelp for this old ice cream store. There are limited parking spots near the store. Fortunately we came to the store when it rain and 9:00 pm at night. Not many cars.   We are thinking about the dip top ice cream that was posted in the Yelp site. My wife has the Dip Top and I try the snow cone. The snow cone has the choice of Orange, Blue Raspberry, Grape and Cherry. I have them infuse all four flavors. The taste flavor is good but the shave ice is not to the standard. This store shave ice is big pieces compare to many snow cone venders. The correct way of the shave ice is tiny pieces like puffy cotton. I believe they can adjust many revolutions with slightly press to create that. Unfortunately, the store tries to save energy, and make the shave ice not delight to eat. With that, they should have 2 stars.  However, the Dip Top did the best job among the menu and save the day. The soft serve with the Cherry dip top is handsome looking and delicious to eat. I think they are the best in town. If I come back, I will have the dip top only. The soft serve can be vanilla, chocolate or swirl of two flavor. The dip top can be chocolate, cherry or butterscotch. I bite the dip top of my wife and they are excellent.

The restaurant is located at the plaza was plan to be the china town 20 years ago. However the china town was not happen in tampa. It came close to the planing.   The restaurant sales Chinese BBQ food such as pork, duck, crispy pork. You can buy it by the pound. This restaurant was here before along the Ding Ho oriental grocery store.   The best value is the beef noodle soup. The beef is stir fry and then add to the soup. The soup broth is chicken and bone base. The noodle is the Hong Kong egg noodle. The are thin and great to chew. Compare to Mc Donald. I will pick the value ($5.99) of this noodle soup anytime. It is more nutrition and fun to eat.   They also serve traditional Chinese dishes. If you like fried rice try their dry scallop fried rice. It stir fried with dried scallop and slice asparagus. The other dish are the beef with Chinese broccoli with beef in hoisin source also a good dish. This dish is more to American style dish but still kept the Chinese cuisine technic.  The surprise dish is the Taro Crispy Duck. The duck is deboned and marinated. The duck meat then lay on the bottom and top paste with ground taro. They are deep fried and chop into pieces. The accommodate with sweet soy sauce and garlic and scallion. They are crispy on top and bottom. The top is a crispy taro create the net type crispy good. The bottom is duck create slightly burn crispy. This is a killer dish.

Hillsborough library system is one of the best in US. They paid attention to local need. Sometime they are hosting the music concert, book reading. The J F Germany is one of the beautiful Hillsborough county libraries with the water fountain entrance.   This is a 140,000 square feet library hold the Tampa genealogy collection. They also have two story of book. I normally not walk to the back separate building on the second floor. It has a bridge connect to the parking and to the performance art center. The most impressive is the movie, music CD renting for free. You can check out the Sundance festival awarded movie to oriental martial art movie. We have enjoyed many nights with their movies and they are freeeeeeeee!!!!!!! You also can get HBO miniseries and they have those collections like games of throne.   At the back of the library, there is a acoustic stage hold for Tampa Volunteer Orchestra. You can check their schedule when they performed here. I would suggest visit them after six because the street parking then is freeeeeeee!!!  They have 4 weeknights open late to 9 or 8 pm. Visit our library and it is your tax money. Make a good use.

Happy hour at Saturday??  Un heard off. This restaurant offer the happy hour sushi is at Saturday from 2 to 4 pm. The rolls are $4 each. They also have the reduce price appetizers.   It is perfect to go there when I just finish my Saturday noon time badminton session. Compare to many places with happy hour sushi, their sushi rice is seasoning with good flavor before wrapping. In my book, only one happy hour place sushi rice is comparable to this place. I got six different roll for $24. I also get half price sangria sake. Good deal.   Other than their happy hour sushi, they also have chef signature sushi roll. They are very attractive. The service is good, the ambients are nice. Can you believe they are the few pioneers who serve gourmet sushi in Bay Area.

Recently I was invited to the restaurant special Korean BBQ meet. The meet design a menu of $20 per person. It was very good deal. I have been to rice before but I have not given them a review.    It is hard to see Korean BBQ that grilled in tradition charcoal. And we have it that night with charcoal and enhance gas grilled. I have to compliment to restaurant believe the traditional.   We start the meal with kimchi pancake. It is interesting to see pancake with kimchi and they are delicious. Our side dish include the glass noodle in mushroom, grilled beef, spinach. The spinach, mushroom and grilled beef are cook separately then mixed together with sauce. This is my favorite dish. We also have typical Korean side dish that came with it but the glass noodle top everything.    Our grilled meat include kalbi (short rib) bulgogi (slice beef) and spicy beef in sizzling plate.  They are very good indeed. We have a lot of food that night and we enjoy our company. Previously we were here, we have grill mackerel also a good dish if you know how to from bone.

I only I can said I like The Lure. But why they are three stars on my updated review. The reason is they charge you 18% tip on the final bill with two people dining. Although we are there at happy hour reduce price. I think the move is afraid the customers only paid the tip at final price not the initial original price. Afraid of tip reduction. I think this move has make up my mind why I revisit their restaurant if they just want to protect the waitress tip. The menu did not indicate if you eat there at happy hour will include the service charge. That may be the end of the revisit to this restaurant.

This food truck is strategically positioning themselves next to Futbol 5. It generates some business from the soccer player who play there. The night time soccer allow the food truck to open till late in the hour.   This truck sell arepa, cachapas and weekend special. I have the shrimp arepa. You have a choice of cold or hot arepa. The hot arepa is the skin will be fried. I have the hot arepa with shrimp. The shrimp size is big and they many count of them. The arepa is $7. However, the vinegar is overtop the good taste. I actually don't like too much vinegar on food. They should ask the customers if they like it.   The special of the night include black beef, quail egg, and some other stuff that is very interesting. The food need to eat immediately to gain the maximum enjoyment.

Happy cow come with happy people. The store provides pink setting matching their logo. People come here more often when the sun was hot during the daytime and enjoy a ice down during the night.   The store will give you a few sample cups to allow you sample the ice cream flavor they have during that day. The system here is to buy by weight. You can eat as little you want or fill the cup high as you go. Don't forget the topping. Yap topping. They have variety of topping include fruit flavor bubble pop. If you added the bubble pop, it will be pop inside your mouth and the fruit flavor enhance the experience.   If you are checking in with yelp, you will have a free waffle cup. The store offer seating in the store with limited capacity. Buy by ounce is idea of how much you want. People stop by this store to have social time with each other. The only down side is the parking in front is very limited due to so many restaurant have to share. You may have to park far away and walk to store.

Curtis Hixon is prime real estate of City of Tampa. It connect the people and keep the business by host many event. The event include the Margarita Festival, Mayor O Green, Beer Festival, Food Truck and many music venue. It also has the Christmas series with ice skating rink.  What make this park successful as below: 1. The Tampa River Walk that connect the prime river bank estate create downtown living more attractive. 2. The Hillsborough River attract people like to come to the park have water. 3. Spectacular view of the University of Tampa with the old glory of the hotel look in the pass. 4. A dog park nearby that many bring animal friend to walk.  This bring the thrive living of the downtown more color full. Several apartment near the downtown make this attraction as a close by walking distance. What can you argue with this type living.

This is one of the closest Avis location near new tampa area. They use to have one location near Bruce B Down and I-75 but is was closed after two years. The Avis mainly cooperate bound. Our company prefer car rental is Avis.   This Avis is near university mall. I am the Avis First member after 15 rental a year. The benefit is they upgrade you to next car grade with the same price of the original class that you have rent. When I pick them up they usually has issued a car waiting for you. You also can advance paid with a discount.   If you rent agreement early there is no drop off fees on other location especially I pick up at airport elsewhere and return to this location. I have use them for the pass ten year due to business requirement. I have seen three owner change in this location. Seem like every time it change owner they have offer of the car discount change. The previous owner have 6 rental and get a free rental.   The Avis generally is great. When I pick up my car at airports, they have the additional award system to allow to add point into my frequent flyer miles or hotel point.

This restaurant close at 3 pm at weekday that I only can visit at my off day. They even open at Christmas Eve until 12 noon. We got there at 10:50 and they are very busy.   We have ordered the lunch special with grilled steak sandwich and soup. We also added a breaded steak sandwich for the lunch. This is good Latin steak sandwich since they pay attention to make the edge of the meat seared well. This will release the meat burn taste.   The soup is Caldo Gallego. White bean with collar green and tiny piece of ham. I believe the soup is meat base and they are good. The breaded steak make you feel hungry. They are very good.   I like the floor is service by a young group of waiter and waitress. They are fast and effective. I wish there is restaurant like this with affordable price in New Tampa.

This restaurant is 4.5 stars in my book. They may be the new comer of the Holiday, Florida, but they have something May wow you. When we were there, the food, service, food delivery is great. We did not find anything to complaint about. In fact, it is on timing.   The food - base on the name, it is a seafood and steak place. Some of the chef are Greek, as a result, it has bit tend to Greek spice. We have order the Clam Casino. It is top with bacon, bread crumbs, bell pepper and sweet base sauce. It is desirable. I have not have this dish before.   Our entrees are the special of the day. 10 oz rib eye with stuff mushrooms. The mushrooms stuffing have crab meat. The rib eye is tender and good. My wife has the Atlantic Salmon top with shrimp and octopus. The octopus is perfectly grilled.   Food won't considered the best but the selection of the material is fresh and top quality. Price is reasonable. We spent less than $50 for two. Since it has somewhat wow factor. They deserve to great in my book.

I like Lowe's better than other home hardware store due to store is well organize. The aisles are alway clear and not messy. I can in and out the store generally less than 30 minutes if I know the items I need.   They are well stock and great selection of the items. I always can find the screw or bolt size that available. Hand tool or electric apparatus that fit my home can be located. I alway find the decorated ceiling fan that is easy to install and allowed me to switch on the light above or below the fan blade for lighting the room. The remote come handy to change the speed or reverse the direction of the wind flow depend on summer or winter.   There are items bargain at each week. I found my appliance there with bargain most of time. Some time they selling the floor sample for a good pricing. The brand of the appliance ranging from May tag to the kenmore. I bought my no center blade washing machine there. I also bought my touch sensor faucets for my kitchen sink. It come very handy when your hand had soap or oil and you can open the faucets just a touch of the body part.   I got most of the gardening flowering bush from their gardening section. Their selection is great or you can specific order any thing that is not in store for gardening and they arrange with their nursery.   I alway love their power tool. It give me a right tool for the home project. It have wide selection of paint and color that create your interior setting like double tone color. Imprint pattern apparatus that can print on top of base coated color to create elegant interior setting.   Lowe card come with 5% discount. If you just apply, they have special 10% discount when you buy the appliance with big ticket item.

Almost 3.5 stars restaurant but not quite. This restaurant do have excellent reviews but my experience did not match up the rated stars.   The Sun City has a lot Mexican restaurant that you can pick. Los Amigos is the popular one at local. I think they are highly rated because of the local.  We were here at 1:20 pm and they are still 80% full. People still coming in after we have sit down.   It was difficult to get the wait staff attention for getting a menu or initial an order. I have decided to take manner at my own hand to grab one of the staff and ordered immediately. After my order, I saw at least three tables customer walk out the restaurant without order. This is a sign of either not enough staff or lack of attention.   We have order the beef rib with green enchiladas and breaded steak. My friend breaded steak is average. My beef rib come with three pieces. At least 1.5 pieces is over cook or charcoal. I can see why they are popular because their food is good deal.   A few things they can improve. Increase number of wait staff. The kitchen staffs may need to paid attention on cooking.

I have pass by this boonies place and decided an adventure to try this restaurant. It locate at I-4 exit 22 and just north of the exit. When I was there they just opened the door for business.   The interior design like a country kitchen. It have the old grandpa chairs at elliptical table. The menu selection mainly seafoods with fish. They call themselves the Catfish Shack but I am changing the norm to try their grouper. I have order the blackened topping. The way they cooked the fish is to provide black pepper and herb over the fish and broil in the oven. It is not open grilled. This is the first time I have eat the blacken fish this way. Because they broil it the fish juice came out and is quite good.   My sides are the collars green, corn bread and hush puppies. The corn bread go well with the fish juice. I like the collars green cook in traditional southern style with pork crump.   This restaurant is middle of nowhere but it provide exciting meet location for the biker or back country boy. I will try their cat fish next time. In their menu, they also offer the gator meat.

Is it Post Office, a Bazzar, souvenir shop, art store?  It is interesting place to visit. It has the charming character of the town. Definitely worth a spin around the store. It is a store for many trade.   Hoping from station to station and you will see different thing is displayed. They do have some maze and narrow walkway may be rubbing shoulders with fellow shoppers.   Great to visit.

Cool temple. Very colorful. I remember when I was at the Chiangmai, the Buddha is plated with actual sheet of gold paper. I wonder they do it here.   We were here many time for the Sunday morning Thai market and eateries. I like this place because it serve my home country neighbor country food. It is very similar to my country. The food here very similar to the vendors of Friday night market in my home country. Only different is you have to wait on line to order.   Always come here with two people or more. You need to divide and conquer. The noodle line is long. Here one person in line while the other person go to buy other food. Always put your name down on the coconut ball and it will be ready before you leave the market. Once you got some of the food, feed the person in line for noodle then go get the drink for Thai tea, longan drink or coconut drink. Once got the drink go back to the noodle line to help the bowl of soup noodle. This is always our strategy for this market.    The soup noodle is the best. It is very light food. They have thin, medium or widest noodle size to chose. You can chose beef or pork base noodle.   I also like their dessert. Many to chose from. Grill chicken, steak or pork stick is grilled on the spot. The also have wok cook food like the curry, pad Thai and more.   The best time is November to December and March to May. When it is not too hot. The weather is pleasant. At special event, they perform the Thai traditional dance.

Ya Boys is about 3.5 stars. During pandemic, this restaurant mainly is take out. They do have few table inside, but the patio is big. Right now only one picnic table in patio.   The reason there are 3.5 stars is from order to pickup requires 40 minutes. It is take too long just to serve 7 customers. This need to be big improvement especially for the first time customer who just order there.   I got the two pieces chicken. I think their chicken is too dry. Seem like out of smoker and to the grilled for long like. The rib sandwich was good. I like the dry rub. It has good flavor. The devil egg is something, you can get three egg with different meat. The sausage sandwich is the best deal and good bite. It is long enough. Smoke wing is better.   Mostly the food are smoke flavor.  The smoke did the good job into the meat. The store clerk is friendly.

I always enjoy Fred's Market. This is my second Fred's Market I have visited. We were here for the Father's Day. At 6:30 pm, the hostess tell us the wait is 25 minutes at Sunday. About 12 minutes, pur names already call.     Compare the Fred's Market here to the one I'm Riverview, this one is cleaner and nicer. However, I think the one in Riverview has larger buffet table and more selection. I love southern food here. Especially the fried catfish. It also has good bake chicken and ribs. The southern fried chicken here is delicious. The collar green is my favorite.   At the end of meal, they have dessert station for you to request any assembly. I got the bread pudding at below top with the butter pecan ice cream and finish the touch with the strawberry. Yummy tummy. Service was great. Definitely recommend to visit.

Zukku is one of the popular food vendor in the Heights Public Market. The lunch time is constantly build up the line. I would consider them is food court partition restaurant since they share the common area. This is trendy location for high end food.  A few things I like. The deep red color of Ahi tuna. They have good chef knife skills. They can cut the avocado in very thin slice. The decorations for the sushi is attractive.   I did not go for the sushi. I order a big poke bowl with two proteins. However, they run out of yellowtail. So go for the tuna only. A few things I don't like. The price is about restaurant price for food court mentality. You have stand in line to get food. The portion is small compared to many of you pick poke. The quality is in the mix review. The meat has good quality but it has a lot of tuna tip end. The meat is not cube size.   For the price. I expect more. As a result, they are three stars.

Doug Nation is part of the Metropolitan Ministry. I am applause to their mission to do good for the community. It is unique in a way they have the ice cream concept to attract people. I like it when they have taken something simple to add on other thing and create something new.   This ice cream store combine the cookie dough and the ice cream and create something new. The best thing is not just have different ice cream flavor but also include the different flavors of cookie dough. I have the s'more cookie dough with marshmallow. My ice cream is pecan with caramel ice cream. I like the combination. The only thing is after you have through with the ice cream, you have to work on the cookie dough. The entire combination is very sweet. Good for the sweet tooth person.   The clerks are very friendly. I like the taste try. You choose any flavor to try. Since it is located on the downtown, parking is a challenge. Parking after 6n pm is free. However they close at 8 pm which did not give you much time to have it after work.

This Evo serve the Soho neighborhood. It is healthy choice for the people. However the shop is kind of empty when we visited. Not sure this neighborhood is up to the healthy food.   We got Mediterranean Lemon Chicken. This dish is a bit plain. The chicken is well cooked but lemon grilled is just average. I like their mahi mahi better.   Food come out quick. Basically is warm. But I like to be hotter. Not much service. I always like their air fries. It is crispy.

My first visit is about 4 stars but my second visit is 5 stars. This make this restaurant is about 4.5 stars. The first visit with spicy tuna and salmon is grind meat. I really not a fan of it. I like many choices of the ingredients to be add on. Only a few need additional money. Which is I can skip.   My last visit is the restaurant did give me freedom to separate the rice from the ingredients and sauce. Allow me just to mixed the ingredients only. I also like just select the Ahi tuna and salmon without add into premixed spiciness. This is much better quality because the tuna is dice close to a inch cube. Big size for mixed your on poke. I give them an A in this matter. By separating the ingredients from rice make this mixed more flavorful. Now I can combine many sauces with the raw fish and ingredients. Some of the ingredients included crab salad, corn, mango, red cabbage, cucumber, edamame, masago and more. These are the ingredients included part of the bowl price.   I would love to have the sweet eel sauce, ponzu sauce and poke sauce to add together. This is my favorite mixed sauce. At the end you add the fried onion and fried garlic to add the crunchy and extra taste.   Overall experience is great. We have party of eight and enjoy our moments of poke. This place also has hibachi and sushi burrito.

I have pass by this area many time but never have a chance to step in. Follow Anna M Holy Tac-O-Moly review, I have book mark this place for month. I finally have a chance to visit it last night.   You never think a Mexican Grocery store with and delicious kitchen at the back. No wonder many people like it. This place serves Mexican Street Taco where they bring Mexico to Tampa Bay. They serve regular taco with beef steak, chicken, sausage. What them street vender like food is the intestine and beef tongue. They cook to the over the hot plate. This type food is not for to go order. You will enjoy more when you eat it there. They have two hot sauces that you can add. The green one is avocado hot sauce. I cannot guess what the orange color hot sauce is. The taco also accompany a bowl of lime on the side of you want to add it.   The taco is extremely affordable - $1.75 to $2.50 each. If I hang nearby there I may come in for snack. The best taco is Chorizo and the Tripa (sausage and intestine). These two tacos make the meat crispy and have slight burn meat sensation. It is very good. I will come back to check them out again.

The Treasure Island Beach Sanding Ovation have 11 sand sculpture. It is located at the Gulf Blvd. and the 104 Ave at Treasure Island Beach. The competition is over last week but they will left the sculpture until begin of December.   The parking there is difficult unless you park at the public beach parking area. The business make thing difficult to park and require small fees. Even the Walgreen only allow 30 min parking only.   We visited at night time before 10 pm. The sculpture is lid up and stand tall at it own. The sculpture draw a lot night vacationer from the nearby hotel to visit. Visit at night is interesting. Wear a light jacket since the wind blow strong and cool. I like a few sculpture with front and back of the sculpture change. Some show three way sculpture look on three different angle.

This Grain Berry is open. But the seating area is limited due to pandemic. They layout their existing chair to form line with one way entrance with six feet social distancing. Worker wear mask and gloves. They keep the customers safe.   I got the Vacation Smoothie. It is mango, banana, and pineapple smoothie. The smoothie is expensive than normal smoothie place but it give you a large cup. It was delicious. The store clerk recommended this choice and I not disappointed.

My revisit is much better. It still has kink on the tuna protein. May still need to make sure the tuna is good to serve. All other proteins are excellent. This restaurant is improving to better. Management is paying attention to the customers suggestion.   We went through the as it has stated beyond this line is 8 minutes to eat. It is accurate to keep the line moving and limiting number of bowls per person. This is a successful operation on the line que to sit down.   The bowl was improving from my last visit which I can see the bottom of the bowl. This time they fill up the bowl with food. The quantity has been met.   I like the steak and the BBQ chicken. The glass noodle is the best if you choose the base. The add on is great too such as the guacamole and the plum tomato.

Sushi Maru is very easy to located at SR 60. They are visible from the main street.  They have happy hour from 5 to 8 pm Monday to Thursday. The happy hour roll is $10. It is a good way to loots people in.   We are here for the happy hour roll. The menu does has over 16 different rolls to choose. We have the Caterpillar, Miami Hurricane, Sake Rotika. These rolls are eel, white fish with lobster salad, white tuna. Among the many three rolls, I like the Caterpillar. The eel did a good job. The other two is just average.   If they want to compete in the happy hour, they have a lot of work to do. They are many restaurant has lower price roll than this restaurant. This restaurant does have some creative roll. Still have some work to do on the rest of the rolls.

Coffee is good. Have a lot of flavor. I like they making cinnamon bun in front of the customers. I love the cinnamon sticks. It easy snack. If you are sugar cravings, they have a lot. Don't get use to it, because 5 sticks may not enough. They do have the classic roll or the mini roll for small bite.   Their ready to pour drink is what you going for. Try their cinnamon pack. It come with many types. Good luck.

Beef O Brady is local love. I see a lot customers come here for affordable drink. They do have attractive cocktails. Unfortunately the cocktails alcohol level is not enough in the level of cocktails drink at nearby bar. I think this restaurant is about 3.5 stars.   I start with Pineapple Express Cocktails. It is good looking drink. May need to have more alcohol in it. We order the blackened dry rub wings. Wing size has small to average size. It was good. The main entree is the Friday special. Surf and turf. At these this is affordable dish and special of the night. It is sirloin steak cook to order temperature and grilled or fried shrimp. This dish only on Friday. I think this is the dish to get.   Service is good. Nothing fancy. Food come out at right time. I would said 3.5 stars but rounded up to 4.

Tampa do not has many documented history. In 14 century the Spanish does touch down at Tampa. They discover the safe harbor in this area.   Then the Cuban cigar factory thrive. A lot of building turn to cigar manufacturing. Today we can find them around the downtown and YBOR city. Cigar rolling bring a lot of business. You can find some of the cigar rolling in YBOR for live demonstration.   Then the McDills Air Force just celebrate the 75 year anniversary. Which make this museum with another milestone.   The entrance have a symbolize restaurant Columbia Restaurant which the original store open at 1905. This one located in the museum has a nice decoration.

If you have never walk into the Russian grocery store, you may want to try this. This is located near Dale Mabry and Water on Water Avenue. The store is well pack with many Russian delicacy. My wife was not able to locate the blood sausage but able to find many interesting items.   The Dadu chocolate ice cream was one of the heavy milk and cheese processed together. The one I have is vanilla with poppy seeds. It is quite good. I saw some Russian meat marinated spice. I don't know what is it but look interesting. I believe is their BBQ marinated sauce.   They also has Poland raspberry wine. Which go very good with the caviar on display. They have good grades caviar range from $13 to $68. The most expensive is the Black caviar of malossol. Not sure this is Beluga Sturgeon black gold. The Russian home made dumplings is also can be get here.

Ichiban is an oldest sushi restaurant before any other sushi restaurant around USF. They have been here very long time ago. The owner is a Taiwanese. They start the restaurant by wrapping their own sushi.   This restaurant has three major part of menu - the tempura, sushi sashimi, and teriyaki. They also have the rice and noodles bowl section. They have offers the variety of sushi. I always like their bento boxes and the boxes are the best values. They have teriyaki, sashimi, and tempura bento boxes.   Today I have the sashimi bento box with added shrimp tempura for extra $3. I love shrimp tempura. The correct way is slight dip the shrimp in wet bread and deep fried. Then drip a bit of tempura next to shrimp and create the crispy effect. However, this process needs to finish in less than 3 minute before over cook the shrimp. This restaurant has the technique for it. The box came with 9 pieces sashimi, cucumber salad, tuna roll, California roll, and imitations crab salad. The sashimi is fresh. Love the shrimp tempura. The shrimp tempura has to eat there. This is not a takeout food.   The customer make out from local businesses and students since it is close to the USF. The service is good and the food come out quick since they have enough sushi chefs.

Yummy chain has extended to the south Tampa area. The new building is beautiful and nice. However, the parking is a nightmare. It take a lot of time to circle the neighborhood before find a spot to park.   The food is very similar to the chain menu. Since they just open, not all items may be served due to availability of the ingredients. We were there for duck raisins fried rice, but they are not available. We got the Hong Kong style sweet and sour pork and the scallops fried rice. The dried scallops need a bit crispy. However, the taste is there.   The portion is normally match the chain standard may be a bit smaller. The service need to pick up. We have to wave to get attention. They are still new and try to work out their bump. May be give them another month.

For Brandon area, this is good enough Italian restaurant. Local like this restaurant because of the cuisine and affordable. I see many regular of the restaurant because the waitress know them.   The special of the day usually listed on the black board. I got special Julienne Cocotte. It is sautéed chicken, mushroom, in creamy sauce in a hot clay pot. It come with garlic butter bread. It is a light dish to have. The second dish oven roasted chicken. This dish is a half chicken with lemon and spice. The chicken was well prepared. Seasoning is great.   This restaurant to my book is 3.5 stars. Main is the the wait staff need to be more patient and polite. This is the area that the restaurant need constant improvement.

This is interesting Peruvian restaurant. They serve a special dish of the beef heart. It is a delicacy item that slice into pieces and grilled. Ana M is kind to let me try this dish. Be brave and order this appetizer. It tastes like regular beef meat. Thank to Steve to organize the UYE Latin Crawler to get to know this restaurant the first time.   The ambient is nice and the restaurant is pack with people during lunch time. We have the free sample on the appetizer with potato or fried yucca in cream cheese sauce. I like the yucca with cream cheese.   My entree is fried fish top with shrimp, mussel, and squid in fish broth. The restaurant did a good job on the on the fish broth. If you use the can fish broth, you need to be careful on the saltiness in the mix. This restaurant is balance their broth with a good technique not to overpower the taste and maintain light level of salty. The squid is well prepared with the softness of the texture. The shrimp count may be in the range of 10 to 15 counts a pound which means larger shrimp. When the restaurant prepares seafood you are looking for the fresh material. The seafood is really fresh and keeps in the quality.   This is a restaurant serve a lot ceviche, Peruvian stir fried or deep fried. I would said they are definite are very good on this end. I have not tried their grilled meat dish and that is yet to come. Service is a bit headache since we have a group of 30. They may be able to improve at in this end when they facing busy condition.

It is a real studio. It is. In fact, it is the music studio, dance studio, art studio, music instruments store and a cafe. I like this concept. It is almost like one stop for the parent. This kid go to practice dance lesson, this one go to music lesson and the other go to painting practice. And the mom go to drink a coffee in the studio cafe while waiting for the kid.  In fact, the patents can drop off the kid and go shopping. The studio has some music instruments for sale. With internet ordering that is so convenient, not many people want to make a deal through actual music store anymore. I would encourage you visit them and keep the store open. This studio has other edge with the bistro cafe, music lesson, art class, dance lesson to attract more people. It has it way to thrive their business without all egg in one basket. I applause the new concept.

This restaurant took over the space of old bistro restaurant. It provide the local area with option for dining. Mainly the Mexican comfort food. The comfort food includes Tacos, Tostadas, Chimichanga, Burritos, Antojitas, Tortas and more. They do serve brunch at Saturday and Sunday from 9 am to 2 pm. May be the the brunch is interesting.   We got a grilled shrimp taco and a quesadilla. Since we have the shrimp on taco, there is an up charge $0.75. This make the tacos $3.5. It is on the high side as taco. I got three grilled shrimp medium size. By the way grilled shrimp is not in the menu only the fried shrimp. You have to ask. Taco is good on average skill. The quesadilla is come out warm and good cheese melt. There is a $2 up charge for carne Asada. They use the braised carne Asada. If grilled Asada will be better.   Overall our experience is good. The food probably in the middle of the pack. Price after up charge, I expect more. They don't serve pre-meal item. Chip and salsa is extra.

Umai Sushi has great deal at lunch time. Their lunch special stop at 3 pm. The lunch special included hibachi and tempura under $10. They also have roll lunch special with $7 for two selected rolls or $10 for three rolls. They also has happy hour beer 3 to 6 pm with domestic beer for $1.99 and $2.99 for imported beer.   I got a piece of surf clam sushi, one escolar roll and one chef special roll Fantastic Spicy Tuna roll. The surf clam is big and cover the entire rice ball. The escolar roll is still feel a bit frozen. The Fantastic Spicy Tuna is good. It is spicy tuna deep fried then add the special mayo and ell sauce. Then top with shredded imitation crab meat. This is good.    Service is very attentive. Food is good. I like the decorations but can improve.

I have been here many time. I am here most of the time is for the snack and happy hour drink. Usually is about 3 pm. Their happy hour dollar drink over at 5 pm. The drive through is easy since the road construction was finished.   The wait for the drive through is good. Easy access. Not much of wait in the line. If you are at the westbound of the Ulmerton. You need a U turn to get to the location.

It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet truly 5 stars. It is one of the best BBQ in Bay Area. This food truck hold it place of many BBQ I had. It has very interesting side order. The selection is very special.   The order I got is a three meats combo. This dinner come with sides. The two we have is the blue crab yellow rice with shrimp and collard green. Other side that in menu choices are truffles Mac n Cheese, Yukon potatoes, baked bean, smoked candies yum, dirty yellow rice. All the choices is great selection. The three meats are the smoke rib, pull pork, and corn beef brisket. The corn beef brisket is moist and tender.   The food truck is popular, many customers. It is popular place for the local.

The festival is big at the park. It does get a lot of attention since there is so many people showing up. Generally the festival has a lot of food truck. But I did not try anything.   The artists are from many place. Some of the art displays were very interesting. Can you imagine put all the shopping cart in pattern and took a top down picture. The hanging motion plate showing the moving animals or human when the wind blow.   There were an artist make famous people painting at the skate board. Many welder create their art pieces. Some even put Crome on it.

We were here for their Tuesday special. Their Tuesday is value day. I recommend you joint in. I like to sit at the bar. Because they have good service. If you need anything, there is a person in front of you can help.   The Tuesday special includes a bunch of list at slider and tacos section. We got the the blackened grouper taco. The grouper is big piece with good blackened. The second item is the poppy meatloaf slider. I think this slider is interesting. The third item is the carne Asada taco. I think this one is good. The fourth dish is three little pig slider. Good BBQ pork. I like the Tuesday special because each item is fractions of the price.   The happy hour also includes the $2 beer and more. Service at the bar is great. Love to be there.

Cool park to be. This park located at downtown Safety Harbor. It is not too far from downtown Safety Harbor Main Street. This park is close to inner bay of the Tampa Bay. Every year it host the Seafood Festival. When they have the downtown parade, this become the staging area for the parade to be started. during the festival, live music from different band was performed on different day of the weekend.  The park is surround by the bay waterfront. Many jogger come to this area to take a break. I saw many people walk into this park to relax or get away from busy downtown. It is connected to safety Harbor Pier. As you can see many people can get deeper to the bay water. It also provide the parking if the downtown parking is full. It also has some boat parking nearby.

Munchie is good ice cream at the mall. It has a lot topping choices. That is the major reason they are solid 4 stars. It is love by Wesley Chapel residents. Many have come here. I feel that 1 clerk is not enough.   The soft serve is by weight. But the toppings are impressive. They include hot fudge, strawberry dip chocolate, sweeten cherry, sprinkles, . Since it is by weight, the toppings become burden to weight in for additional cost. However, since they have good topping, customers don't mind.  There is positive outcome for good or popular soft serve flavor. I will encourage them to continue to strive for the best interest of customers for this matter.

This BBQ place is busy event is 3 pm in the afternoon. A lot of people are here to pickup. If you don't want to wait, you can call ahead.   They have chop pork, rib, chicken and sausage. The best is their special sauce on the BBQ. Their sauce is orange tangy taste. It got some flavor on it. I have the four meat special for $16. The pack all the meat at on box almost cannot close the lid. Plenty of food.   This is neighborhood BBQ. They only have a few table. Many come to have the take out. The also serve pineapple ice tea. It something different than most of the BBQ place.

This newly open restaurant is serving Japanese street food. Basically the name of the restaurant is alcohol house. Many come here not just have good beer and cocktails, they enjoy the time here.   We start with seafood sunomono. The seafood is assorted. It has imitation crab stick, octopus, and shrimp. I think this dish is over price. For the amount of food is little, too much of cucumber. The chicken gizzards skew was nice. It is the food to go with sake. We also has the yellowtail collar. This collar is good not the best but good enough.   We also has the tonkutsu ramen. The ramen most value is having a good soup base which they got it. The charshu is good also. The veggies they have is just the bamboo shoot. I wish they have more stuff to attract the customers. Service is good and attentive. They did give out the surprise gift at the end to loot back the customers.

Rare Ethnic Food 4 - Malaysian Cuisine.   Finally we have some restaurant actually represent my country well in Tampa. There are three claiming Malaysian restaurants in Bay Area. This one may be the best representing. Although the restaurant introduce a lot of pan Asia food, but predominantly is Malaysian street food. The Chinese has immigrated to Malaysia long time ago. A mix marriage with local Malay people and create a generation call Nyonya. This people combine the Chinese cuisine and Malay cuisine and ultimately have this mix cultural food.   Laksa is one of the good example. This spicy soup base rice noodle dish is created of the combination of the Chinese rice noodle in the use of Malay lemon grass material. The Prawn Mee is another example. The soup base is spicy Malay spice from shrimp shell and head. The noodle, pork, slice of shrimp are Chinese touch.   Char Kway Teow is stir fry flat rice noodle. In Malaysia you can ask them to add the sambal - spicy shrimp paste in the noodle. It make more interesting. Have you try the Roti Canai. In Malaysia, this item is a hand craft. The chef actually has to stretch this dough to thin piece and pan fried on the hot plate grill. In Malaysia you can ask them to add egg, goat meat, onion. Can you feel the gulai (Malay for curry) of the Roti is different then any curry. It is different from Indian or Thai curry. The spice for Malaysian curry is sophisticate because they use wet curry powder.   I would encourage you step out from your comfort zone to try this Malaysian dish including the mee goreng, Hokkkien mee. Unfortunately the satay here is still not close enough per Malaysian standard. I was able to give them 5 stars is to make sure the Orlando kitchen crews have left and they can stand their own ground to support this store. They did not disappoint me. They are quite good. Food came out in amazing speed.

Not bad, no bad at all. They are quite good restaurant after listed in the golden spoon. The Mill is very creative in the cuisine. I never thought I would said visit their restroom. It is must see for the visit.   These is a creative restaurants with correct pricing in the menu. Tonight they have St. Pete restaurant night with special design menu for three courses with good price. Some of the items they serve on this prefix menu are not in the regular menu and they are quite good.   My first plate is the Short Rib En Croute. The short rib is braise and cook in pastelitos skin. Almost like beef Wellington. It accompanied with Arugula salad. This dish very enjoyable. Love how they cook and mixed the salad well.   The second plate or main dish is the Braised Pork Belly. The three part harmony cooking is there. The pork belly fat is pretty much melt with your tongue. It accompanied with the crispy scallion hay,broccoli Gruyere strata and real honey mash. This is my favorite. The honey is appear like just removed from the hive and shape like it.   My final plate is the honey black pepper cheesecake. The taste is very smooth. This restaurant certainly deserve a 5 stars rating. The only improvement they need is to let out the kitchen food smell from the dinning area.

A lot people visited this place after church. This restaurant seem like a popular place for after church gatherings. One thing notice these restaurants mainly white people. So you know their food is American taco.  However they have the way to attract these type of customers.   I like some of the Taco but my wife love the cracked corn. I got the chimichuri steak taco and my wife got the blacken fish taco. The steak taco may need to be improved but the fish taco is very good. The cracked corn is top with spice and cheese that make this corn very desirable.   I would said this is Baja type taco place. It has it specialty. I like the interior design to show the beach look. You may choose one of the flint stone car booth to eat you taco. It is almost like movie.

I cannot jump in joy wagon to give them five stars. Basically this place is a food court with trendy atmosphere. It is an high end food court if I have to classify them.   Plus area - Parking is the best in the area. Plenty of the parking place. Variety of the food to attract people is very good.   Down side - Giant food court. Line everywhere. The price of the food is not cheap. Restaurant level price. It is about 20% more than average. Only one water station. I don't like the table setting. A lot of share table. The table is not clean. We have to clean ourselves.   This place is a big warehouse for a lot of food vendor. It is a new vibe for the area. I wonder what the summer like in this area.
