It is going to be hot for the design and set up of the building. I guess we will find out.   I would pick a place has sit down and order the food. Not sure about line standing wait for your turn.

B's Caribbean food is love by local. They only have one table. This is a take out place have a lot of customers. During my visit, at least 4 customers ahead me with multiple orders. You can see the popularity of local.   They jerk chicken and some traditional Caribbean dish like Ackee with salty fish. The selection includes large or small portion. I got their popular dish. The oxtail. The marinated sauce went into the bone. The meat is soft but have not fall off the bone yet. I prefer fall off the bone cooking. My dish come with good bean rice and braise cabbage. Both side are great.   The wait for the food is not bad. I got my food 15 minutes after order. It is considered fast with so many order ahead of me. Parking is free with lot in front of plaza.

This restaurant is a landmark. Local have eat here for long long time ago. Even today, many families bring their children and grandchildren to eat here. Many memories was in this restaurant with the picture plastered their entire walls.   It is not my regular visit restaurant due their odd hour and distance away from my work. I come here when I have an off day. We walk in at 1:40 pm and they are still very busy. If you see a gringo walk in 50% may be tourist. Obama visited this place in 2012. As a result a "Obama" Cuban sandwich in the menu with the way he like Cuban sandwich- add lettuce and tomato.    We have order the Vaca Frita fried shredded beef and the Tripleta Sandwich. The Vaca Frita is prepare good. Only one thing if they can make the edge of the meat burn a little bit to create the burn taste over pan grilled is better. Compare to many Vaca Frita I have, this is below average. The Tripleta sandwich is good taste. I like the little fried in it. It come with three different meat - ham, pork and shredded beef. This is how it get the name.   Overall my experience is average. I think the servers are run out of the energy to serve us. They seem tire at the last hour before closing. The whole store seem chaos. Not much to organize. Long line for to go order. Not much of parking space. I believe a lot improvement need to be done. However, the price here is very very affordable. That is how they got their customers.

This is food truck turn restaurant. I am applauded for their success transformation. They have a big menu for selection. The restaurant has big table shareable. The order is at the counter and bring to your table.   The menu selection includes classic sushi roll, sushi and sashimi, special sushi roll, and appetizers. This is our second stop, so we only go for the appetizers. We got the Flaming Escolar and the Baked Green Mussels. The flaming escolar is torch with open flame and top with avocado. I like burn taste of the escolar. The sauce is excellent to go with it. The baked green mussels is chop and mixed with imitation crab meat. It is delicious after the baked. I like to pick up the small pieces and eat it slowly.   The price is not cheap for the appetizers. But the experience rewards the outcome. I would said about 4.5 stars. Their sushi doesn't need any wasabi or soy sauce. It is already prepared to your likeness.

Definitely pop if you put your popsicle and sit for some time. It great summer to visit this place to cool off. We were going to try their waffles but their waffles machine was down. So we go for the popsicle instead. The price is about a bit above average. Not much of selection. But the selection is good enough to try.   We have the watermelon citrus and salty chocolate Elvis. The watermelon citrus I have tasted some chop up fruit remains. It is refreshing. The salty chocolate Elvis is something good feeling. Soft to bite and easy let it melt. I can hear some Elvis music now from Graceland. Put some sun glasses I will be Elvis myself.   They also offer dip or sprinkle. Dip it is $1, roll and drizzle is $0.75. Like I said they have waffles on the stick but machine was not operate that day. They also have grilled cheese, coffee and regular ice cream.

I like the name Sailing. It is almost sailing to island to have poke. This restaurant is rather new. It has a lot potential. They have poke and ice cream. I would go for the poke.  The poke dish has two protein in regular size or three protein with larger size. The difference is 6" bowl and 10" bowl. I would go for the large. The other thing I need to mention is their unlimited topping of you choice. I also like their protein choice. The have more choices on the protein and different than other poke place. It has the grilled eel option. Other things that attract you is their sauce is thicker and not watery. Which make this poke location a win win choice.   We like the larger size with larger diameter to contain more toppings. Above three reasosn will be the driving force for repeat customer.

The cafe is at American Airlines concourse. It occupies the prime center location. We are glad that finally the airport has some great restaurants for people. Mise en Place is one of them.   The menu is simple. They have flat iron steak sandwich or hanger steak dinner plate. This bring up the standard of the airport dining. I did not order any of that and I got the Mahi Mahi. It is grilled mahi mahi with sweet potatoes, corn and spinach. The stir fry veggies is great. The mahi mahi need work. It need to have burn a bit with less wash sea taste. Unfortunately the Mahi Mahi doesn't standout. If not it can be better.   Service is good since the bar has easy access to food he server. Food came out quick and allow me to boarding with plenty of time.

The restaurant observed the CDC guideline of mask and social distancing for each party. Temperature check was on the entrance. The bar style is open patio with roof covering. I would say they save cost on AC room.   I was here for the taco take over Tampa Bay. However, the counter behind the bar area do not know this promotion. In fact, they run out the Alto Margarita. They point to us they do have a food truck in the compound serve the taco. They also can order those food at the counter.   The food truck is kind tuck away in the corner. The order only take about 7 minutes. We got the blackened fish taco. I think it is a good deal with taco take over. The fish is fresh with nice blackened I want. The three taco provided in good quantity. The accompanying taco material and sauce is delicious.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. The restaurant opened the door 10:00 am. I was the 10:45 for lunch. I was surprised they already serve lunch. They have the stand alone building with a lot of parking.   I got the beef combination pho and the bean and jelly drink. The price is at the mean level. The combination beef noodle is good and refreshing. The soup lack off in compare to other place is the beef tender and beef brisket. These are the item you found on most combination pho.   The bean jelly drink is delicious. The mung bean is great. The red bean is whole piece. I rather it grind like paste. Overall the service is quick because I am the only one there.

Arepa and Pitas make up the restaurant name. This is a new concept of the combination of two country food for the fast food. If they are successful, they can be like other fast food chain selling their franchise.   I stop by for a snack to try them on. I have the arepa with the Shawarma beef. The beef is slice and in shawarma sauce. I have added the hamus, lettuce, and cucumber. The beef is a bit dry for me but the  marinated meat is there. My wife like it however I just it is just worth it. This concept of the selection of assembly may work or may not work. So I cannot fully said the restaurant do not have the right ingredient because the customer makes decision on the assembly.   For the reason above, partly is customer and partly is restaurant I cannot fully make the decision on the food. But base on the keeping the material warm and juicy I am grading it worth a trip with 3 stars. There are thing can be improve such as come out a suggested assemble item that is work and taste good so the customer will not make mistake. This is vital for new concept restaurant to survive and get repeat customer. Good thing is their price is affordable.

This new place has promise future. Great concept for a dessert spot in the New Tampa area. They are in the Pointe plaza. They just open not long ago. I think this is a crucial time to attract customers to repeat visit.   I like the concept of ice cream and cup cakes. They have an item with the mix of cup cake and ice cream together. We did not try that. We did try their ice cream. The price is at the high side of the ice cream per scoop. One positive thing is we like their ice cream flavors whit different taste than most of the ice cream place. We got the strawberry and salted caramel crunch. The flavor is great potentials.   As I said, they just open. The ice cream scoop up is just peeling through not entire scoop. It is kind of small for two scoop with almost $7. The price is at the high side. To attract more customer need to be generous at the beginning. Second, most item is almost sold out when we visited at 8:30pm. They need be able to have customers try everything what they can do. Need to have a good start.

Yelping #1200  One word Excellent-Chef. You can't said two words. But food that good you said in one word.   Lure was in my target for some time. One of my non Yelp friend told me about this place. Plus when you have priority list of the restaurant in you book mark with added distance to travel here, we take me 7 month to hit this book mark. But no regrets and I will return. Blame on Todd and Melissa hidden this place very well :) Can believe I bum to them while I visit.   Now about the restaurant. I like the concept of tapas and open garage. The tapas is very close to small plate. For two people 3 dish is enough but it does not stop you to order more. Instead of spending money for two dish at most restaurant, here you can try one more dish. I also like the open garage drink area with pool table. It make this place lively.   The skill of the chef. We have order the Miller, Kevin and Destin. We started with The Kevin with Blacken Redfish. The fish was handle well. Most chef either charcoal or not blacken enough. This chef make it just right. Blacken spice burn but not charcoal. The accompanying black-eyes pea and grit is good match. The Destin mixer of seared fillet tip, spice shrimp and sausage (soppressata) make this dish over the top. The many step preparation make this dish great to taste and put in the creamy pasta. My favorite is the miller. You can kill for this dish. The duck breast was marinated and blacken. A good duck breast need to cook roughly at medium rare to medium. The reason is medium rare is too chewy and the medium is to well done. This one just right. It has meaty bite but not chewy. Good technique. I am not going elaborate the accompanying side. Go find out yourself.   Service is good. Love the atmosphere and food. Can't wait to return.

I usually can get what I need in this store. Although they are not carry over million selection, but they do have enough to go by.   The store just located at the Fletcher Ave. this may be the closer ABC near USF. Store is very clean and well sign for each category. They do have cigar section in the temperature control room. The have beer in the cold section that you can have a cold one immediately.   The store clerk is friendly. Not the best but is not bad either for consider wine and spirits store.

Healthy food for a change. It is convenient for a housewife not to cook. Or when you have to eat alone. I have visited two fitlife food in tampa. This one just average. We were greeted at the door. I would said the clerk need to paid attention after they walk into the door. What happen to first timer want to know how it work.   I got the miso salmon and the Jamaican pork tenderloin. For large box, I cost $14 each. They are really on the high side. The miso salmon is just average. It come with snow peas quinoa. The snow pea need some work. The string and hard stem need to be peel away may eating pleasant.   I like the pork tenderloin better. It come with mash sweet potatoes and asparagus. The flavor is a bit better. I think they can learn from nearby organic food or fresh food serve store to improve their cuisine. It will help to attract more customers.   Lastly, I have paid up the food but it was not bagged until I reminded them.

This is my first visit to this Jeremiah Italian Ice. Not many customers in front of the building except 4 police officers. They have finished up their Italian ice and remain conversations. This time of year is still considered cold night and not many customers.   I like Jeremiah because they have Italian ice and soft serve as a layer to separate the flavor. I got cotton candy, banana and sea salt caramel. Those are my favorite choices. I love the presentation of the ice with different color. The ice is tasty and playful.

Rare Ethnic Food #34  This Mediterranean Cuisine but specialty on Syrian food. Syrian Cuisine is a bit different than Lebanese. They are similarity but alway minor differences. The Syrian has more heavy spice that I like. It actually marinated into the meat.   The special item we had is not the so call "Babaghanoush", it call Mtable. It is grilled eggplant, tahini sauce, yogurt and garlic. It drizzle with olive oil. I love this dish. We have the mixed grill with Shish Tawook (chicken cube), Shish Kefta (grilled ground beef) and Shish Kabab ( Beef or Lamb cube) I like the marinated, it went deep into the meat. They have the best chicken cube in town. We also have the grilled fish sandwich which is less than $6. Great value. Fish fillet is big. Love it.   This restaurant own by husband and wife. Please give them a visit, you will like it.

It was difficult to find the medium range price for Brazilian Grilled. Most of them are very expensive. But this restaurant offer a way out with affordable price if you want a Brazilian Grilled buffet. Their rotisserie grilled meat is good and beat the chain restaurant because they are less salty.   Rotisserie included the sausage, top sirloin, kabab, chicken drum stick, fillet mignon with bacon, garlic steak, sausage, Pork rib. Those are good selection. On top of the grilled meat, the hot food, salad and dessert also available for the taste. I like their egg plant salad. Food is delicious, it good to go as group and not cost too much.   They close at Monday,  but Tuesday to Friday their web site has a $2 off coupon to save you further. I like the food there.

Mother of all food truck. The best ever. The owner is smart to create the good Hawaiian cuisine selection. I concur they deserve to be Yelp top 100 list. I will vote for them again for next year.   I have seen many of friend great review on this food truck. I finally located them and paid them a visit. My favorite is the huli huli chicken. The chicken is well marinated and grilled perfectly. I like their side with ginger slaw, Mac slaw, kimchi rice, and coconut rice. All in good flavor.   I learn that you can call ahead for your order and pick it up. The food truck in rotation everyday. Please check their face book page for location. I also order the mix plate and the short rib. The food are excellent. If you have not paid them a visit, you are missing it out.

It is about 3.5 stars for the entire experience. They have a affordable price for off site airport parking. This is my first time using them. My experience here has some good and bad in the mixed.   The good - The $5 a day parking is one of the good side. Compare to many airports parking. The service is good. When we were there at the July 4, they have the BBQ cook out. They did invite us to have BBQ chicken and drink. The people are very friendly. The offsite is only 8 minutes drive to the airport. The worst case to miss a shuttle is 16 minutes wait the most. A lot of staff during daytime.   The bad - If you have after midnight arriving, the wait will be increased for them to pick you up. Because after certain time they down to one employee and he has to pull your car out of the lot and to pick you up.  Some things to improve - may be have two staffs until 1:30 am in case of late arrival plane.   Need to know - it is open air offsite parking. It has security cameras. However I still think need to staff additional members until 1:30 am so the other can watch the car and the other to pickup.

It take a long drive from New Tampa to this restaurant just to try it out. Since we're are visiting the Citrus Park Mall, may be a good idea to come here for the book mark we have.   Arrive the restaurant at and the waitress ask us to sit any where you like. After sit down and ready for the order, four of the regular show up. The restaurant waitress came by and said since we have not order, can we move to smaller table. I am ok to move but there is another table can sit four behind me. Just don't understand why we have to move. I would said for this situation, they need to give us a free appetizer if we do a favor for them.   Forget about the situation. Let concentrate on the food it self. Our food come out after the four people who took our table. We have order the the lamb kabab. The food only have six ounces on the grilled lamb. It accompanied with fresh salad, hummus, roasted potato and rice. Among all the rice is the best. Overall taste is good.   I would give a 4 stars for the food. But value is not there for $14.59 dish with 6 ounce lamb. A bit in the high side. Service is below average. Treatment for new customer 2 stars.

Coolest theater in town. Nice architectural feature including the drinking fountain is awesome. If you have seen many picture of the theater, experience yourselves with your own feeling is much better.   The theater has some rich history. Please visit their website for full history cover. I am glad the people of Tampa save this endanger theater from close down.  Now it has hosted many events, music venue, and play.   I can imagine the people watch the movie in this theater must have great experience in late 1920. Now the theater retrofit with air condition and they are comfortable. The best seat may be the second floor balcony middle three front rolls. It is very close to the stage. You can see the action of the show.

4.5 stars in my book. Not yet fully 5 stars. This Italian restaurant is frequently visit by movie stars who is Italian descendants. This tell their Italian food is close to Italian taste. It almost can said "it is like my mom cooking". For for Asian like me I cannot tell what is truly Italian food. I only can judge what is good on the table.   We order the Fratelli Special pizza. It has pepperoni, sausage, meatball, mushroom, onion and black olives. We got the  12" pizza. The pizza was delicious and the ingredients is nice not like typical pizza. We also got the garlic knots. It is dry at the bottom with good garlic and cheese sprinkled all over. We also got the  finger food an old bay wings. The owner was nice enough to give us extra three wings to make up the size is too small.   If you have budget, or just one a slice of pizza ( they by slice too), or good Italian food. You may found your choice.

I have been to the St. Petersburg and this restaurant. Both of them are excellent restaurants. The lure has been successful due to their Tapas dishes. It has more incentive during the the happy hours. During the happy hour, they have selected drink for $5. At menu, they have $5 sushi and Taco.   I was here celebrating a friend birthday. Our waiter was on point today even we have our big party. I got the Miller which is the seared duck breast over string green bean top with bacon piece. It serve with sweet potatoes mash. I like this dish better in St. Pete. The chef there has better skill than this restaurant. I also got spicy tuna and yellowtail sushi. Both of them has excellent taste. For the taco, I have Texas and Action Joe taco. The Texas taco is the sweetened marinated steak and portobello mushrooms. This a good taco. The Action Joe is seared tuna taco.   I like the layout as a bar and some game for the customers to enjoy. The outside seating is available.

This is about 3.5 stars restaurant. This restaurant locate in the Quality Inn. It use to be a Italian restaurant. I like the new look and interior design of the new Japanese Restaurant. It has quite an open space with the bar in the middle.   We order two ramen. One is the King of Ramen Noodle Soup and the other one is Ramen Pork Noodle Soup. This two Ramen is similar with broth. The broth is similar to Japanese Tonkutsu Ramen Broth with pork bone base. I have to give them high praise on the broth, egg, and the bamboo shoots. The broth was top with sesame oil which increases the flavor. I like the charshu Pork. It has a bit marinated pork meat. The let down is the noodle. The noodle was glue together. Obviously the noodle did not go through the clean cold water that cause this to happen. This need major improvement. For a restaurant serve the ramen main ingredients did not done correctly is not acceptable.   Overall. The service was slow in the beginning. But it was pick up. Price is in the medium range. Just ok for my standards.

This review leads me to think about Rachel's dog. I call it Mocha Chocolate. It looks yummy and beautiful to be as a pal. This park has a beach dog park where the dog can run wild and jump into the bay water to bath. I saw a lot of dog there. They have fence quit a beach area just for the dog. Many brought the dogs and they play with each other. The park also has a station with fresh water to rinse away the salt sea water and sand. Very thoughtful. I bet Rachel will bring her dog one day.   The park is like a finger tip next to McDill Air Force base on the map. You have to pass through some of the industry area before you get into the park including concrete prefabrication plant.   The park offer Frisbee golf, children play yard, pavilion with BBQ grilled and more. The area is surrounding by mangrove. They have beach area and boat ramp to lunch the boat. People are using the pier to fish. The natural beauty makes the park for outdoor activities.

Just to open this review. This is a 4.5 stars Indian restaurant. It has good use of spice, good enough spiciness, good enough meat dish, great choice of dishes. Since there is no 1/2 stars, I given them five stars.   It is good to see somethings different along the Bruce B Down. This restaurant come in to replace typical restaurants along this street. Price is reasonable on the lunch buffet. The food is fresh and cook very well. We have the goat curry. They do not have heavy goat smell which is perfect. The chicken masala is good curry to go with rice or the nan. Their nan is not at the buffet tray which is I agree, they bring fresh from their kitchen which is a smart move. Somethings different from the other Indian food buffet is they provide the dosa to the table. It is good.   Service is good and attentive. So far not many people know about it yet. But the crowd is coming soon.

It is good all you can eat sushi place. Now I can said Pinellas has two restaurants delicate the sushi all you can eat. This will be one of them. I like the interior decoration of the restaurant. I also like about the order all you can eat from menu. Basically it is not a pick up your own food. You order and they will bring it to you. It is good ideal during pandemic.   The food includes the sushi, hibachi, dessert, tempura, and more. I like the the summer roll, yummy roll, dragon roll, monster roll. This roll are chef special roll. For sushi a la cart, I like escolar, salmon, tuna and masago. The appetizers, I would go for the pepper sear tuna. It also has regular sear tuna, tilapia slice. In addition we got the spring roll, goyoza, and steamed shiu mai. Those are good choices. We also have the shrimp tempura and chicken Karage. I would not recommend chicken Karage.   Service is good. Very attentive. Taste are on some, some need work. It is a mixed.

Solid 4 stars restaurant. It s close to 4.5 stars. If the dining open, I would consider to dine here. During the pandemic, they only allow take out. There a few review indicated if you dine in, the food take some time to come out. I think it is a easy fix.   We started with the Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wing. We don't like the fry and get the wing a la cart. The wing was perfectly done. I like the parmesan with oil on wing. It is delicious. We got the chicken waffle to star also. I thing the fried chicken strip is nothing special. But it do have good fried. The waffle is soft. May because I have it take home.   Our entree is the smothered pork chop. It has good smothered gravy sauce on top. We also got the oxtail. The meat is fall off the bone. The oxtail was cook for sometime and soft to eat. Very good dish.   From order to pick up is about 20 minutes. Not bad. Considering it is a good southern dishes.

I was here for the end of prohibition anniversary. This day celebrate that alcohol is finally legalized. Bubba has several cocktails in low price to celebrate the day. It also includes some drinks too.   I got the Long Island ice tea, burger, and two different boneless wings. I spend less than $15 because of the special celebration reduced price. The burger has good bacon and meat. The boneless is nice without bone. The sauce is accompanied well with the wing.   Overall is a good experience. This place is definitely a great place for budget drink. During the celebration, the t-shirt was give out as a prize.

About 4.5 stars. Not yet true 5stars. Love the smiling face of store owner. The waitress may need some training. Our order was corrected by the owner of the restaurant while the waitress took the inconsistent order. This is local popular place to be. Many come here to dine in. If not the take out is a lot and busy.   We started with yellow tail roll. It is simple and good. The best is the special of the day. They have high grade yellow and salmon crudo. The dish have 4 slice of yellowtail and 4 slice of salmon. It top with different masago and bed with seaweed salad. It was delicious.   We also has the tempura udon. The tempura was big by it own with fried shrimp. The udon also good. The food experience win us there. I would suggest look for the special at the wall. That will be your best choice.

It is about 3.5 stars. The food is simple and easy to order. During pandemic, the social distancing was observed. The restaurant is located at the prime area of river. May be they can add outdoor seating with river view to increase attractiveness of customers for margaritas and more.   We got two taco, the Lengua and Cabeza. This two taco is good. Portion is small. I like cabeza better. The nest dish is steak quesadilla. It was not fully packed. But the price did match the quantity of the meat. Good melt cheese. The last dish is the mixed fajitas. It has chicken, shrimp, and steak. I would suggest if you order, just the steak is good enough. The steak has good marinated sauce in it. It come with fried bean, salad, and rice.   Overall the price fare to match the quantity. In Chinese saying, one cent price match one cent goods.

$20 per adult is a bit steep for the light display. VIP pay $75. They have advantage of all you can eat buffet, private lot 1 parking, free skate rental, different entrance, VIP line skate rental, free stroller valet.   The main theme is to find all nine reindeers to Santa. Among all find the most popular reindeer of all - Rudolf. It is easy to spot with red nose. The light is everywhere. It is the maze to go around. To identify the exit, just look at the roof for the North Star. It will point to the exit.   The event include the market, food and drink to be paid for additional price. General admission can bring their own skates to skate at the ice rink. Rental is available $10 per adult.   Parking is $10. Security check is required to enter the venue. This event is like been there done that. Very forgettable. It could be cheaper make it affordable to public.

This restaurant was open just before the stay home order during pandemic. I was thinking very much to visit and finally they open for take out. We need to support our local business during this time. Especially good food. Michi is the first ramen near my area (new Tampa).   We got the miso and Tonkutsu black garlic ramen. You can have two other choices such as regular or spicy oil and paste. The soup base is great. The porch egg is well prepared. The charshu pork are thick enough and well braise.   We also got the pork bun and ikamaru grilled squid. The charshu pork bun is a bit pricy. Bun is good not the best in Tampa bay but close enough. The ikamaru probably is the best I have. The squid is a bit small in compare to many place.   This is about 4.25 stars in my book. But I like to support our local ramen and I round up to 5 stars.

I would said the best Italian restaurant for my list.  Please read on why they did not get 5 stars. Do I come back. Hack yes. Hopefully I can give them a 5 stars next time.   Before you come to this restaurant, you need to know a few thing. 1. Do not just show up. Make a reservation. Even though they said is highly recommended, I said is a must. Almost every day for people just walk in they have to wait for 2.5 hours at dinner time. If you don't have reservation,come at the time they open. 2. Go for the menu items. They are match the value of the food. 3. Be patient. They really don't have much help on the kitchen since it always back up on the order.   Today we show up with reservation and we still have to wait for our table to be ready. Not a long wait. While waiting there is a special of the day on the board for your choices. We have appetizer and pre-meal item that come with the entree. The first course is about 30 minutes. But the entree is about an hour wait. I did ask the waiter why. They have accommodated with addition wine and dessert no charge for our situation.   We begin our appetizer with Vongole Marechiara. It is the baby pasta clams sautéed with garlic, basil, and white wine sauce. The sauce is great. Please ask a loaf of bread to go with it. It is excellent dipping the bread in this sauce. The baby clam is about 25 to 30 count. But they are small portion in the big bowl. They taste very good.   My entree is the special on the board. Pan seared blacken Scottish Salmon on top of roasted slice potato with house cure pork belly. The salmon cook just right and the fish is fresh. The cure pork belly is awesome. It is a bit pricy for this dish. The entree come with the soup or salad of your choice.   The restaurant only have the wine and beer for alcohol. We were accommodated with great dessert for the time lost while waiting. Seem like they have a smaller kitchen. This may be the only area they need to improve. Increase the speed of food preparation or bigger kitchen. Don't let the customer wait.   The dessert is magnificent. They brought out the Tiramisu, Cannoli, Lemon Cake, and pyramid chocolate. It look awesome when they are in one big plate. I applause they accommodated the customer long wait time.

We excited for new kid in the block due to our past experience with fresh kitchen on other location. Finally there is one just close to the mall. It make the location easy before I go to the movie to fill my energy. Parking in the front is limited but there are plenty of parking space at the back.   I like the theme with pink color. Pink color stand for sweet, nice, playful, cute, romantic, charming, feminine, and tenderness. This may be why they found their food. I got the six. Which mean 2 protein, 2 bases, 2 veggies. That is the biggest bowl you can get. After that just add addition. I have Ahi tuna poke, Herb grilled steak, green bean, roasted mushrooms, coconut ginger rice, sweet potatoes noodle. I have add on as pesto tomato. You think by now you have big bowl. That was not. It was not even full to the top.   After two hours, I have to run to restroom several time. The food didn't seat well. It is just not fresh. Because this incident,  I think it will be 2 stars. In compare to other Fresh Kitchen, this location need some work.
Mistaken update. See first review

This taco is number three in my list. My list is base on the authenticity, price range, taste of food and quantity of the food. This taco place has make all check marks I have set.   This is a food truck at SR 60 and the Lithia Pinecrest. The location is located on the northeast quadrant of the intersection. Easy to fine. The hour is odd. Only weekend has longer hour. So check the time before visit. During the lunch and dinner time, many people call ahead so you need to be patient to wait for the food because of the take out.   We got the shrimp, Campechano (Steak and Mexican sausage), Babarcoa (BBQ), carnitas, pastor, chicharon. The six Taco was prepared in giant quantity. Roughly $2 each. But their taco meat is enough for two taco in normal taco place. I like the babarcoa and the shrimp taco. Those are very good.   Our wait is close to 30 minutes because it was dinner time. But it was worthwhile. Food is real good.

It's about 4.5 stars restaurant. This restaurant located in Community cannel dock. All seat is outdoor. The restaurant allow dog to accompany their owner in the restaurant. This convenience attract a lot of dog owner bring your dog to the restaurant. It is dog friendly restaurant.  We brought our dog and my family to enjoy the view and food. Since the restaurant is very close to the water, they has a fresh seafood that you can choose. We got the blackened grouper, fried oyster, burger, and fish taco. They did the blacken very well with the flavor that I like. The coating of the fried oysters was very nice. The oysters are also  bigger size compared to many oyster we have eaten.   The restaurant provide a bowl of water for the dog. The only thing that they can improve on is to make the shade and umbrella a little bigger.

Better Byrd is unique restaurant and part of the Fresh Kitchen group. I think their menu is interesting in a way to enjoy variety of the food. The menu selection from dessert, sandwiches, bowls, to taco and wings. It more interesting than the mother Fresh Kitchen which is boring after 4 or 5 visit.   We got the fried Byrd. This sandwich includes Peruvian slaw, fried buttermilk chicken with cluck sauce. The chicken is crispy. The sauce is great. The entire assembly is harmony. We also hot the charcoal soft serve with peanut jam, coconut flakes, and banana slice. The charcoal soft serve is the best we have. Food is great here especially you look for snack. They also has pork bun which match Asian flavor.   Overall we like it. But in winter raining day, the inside seating is impossible due low temperature AC unit. Too cold to seat inside.

This may be third ramen place near New Tampa and Wesley Chapel. It is great to see the mall has this chain in working. More choices to people of the area. The only thing I would said, they need to work on the quantity of the food for the price paid.   We started with the two drink. My wife have the cocoa slush with boba. It is good. But I like my Caramel Macchiato Slush better. Rich in flavor.   Our appetizers is the ninja nuggets. This Taiwanese street food is delicious. My wife have Mega Pork Ramen. There are charshu pork and charshu pulled pork. This may be the best value. The broth is pork bone base. I have the grilled shrimp ramen. It come with 8 pieces pan seared grilled shrimp. Both our broth is added black garlic. Extra $1 for black garlic to be added.   Food is great. Measure the price to value and quantity is 4 stars.

May be it is still new store, all qualities of the food are good. Hopefully they will keep it up. We like lunch box. They do have other selections in the menu such as Kimbob and bibimbob.   We got bulgogi chicken and beef lunch box. The side dish is changed on different visit. We saw side like chicken nuggets, seaweed salad, slice scrambled egg, fried whole egg, imitation crab meat, goyoza, kimchi, and more. The bulgogi spicy chicken and beef is good. I like the beef better.   One other thing is the fish cake soup. My wife like this item. If you eat it immediately, it is delicious. If you left overnight, the fish cake is a bit soggy. Definitely is to eat at the same time you order.

I don't think they are 4 stars. The most is 3.5 stars. The soup base is a bit blend. Their best dish is Tonkutsu black garlic lover. After that all dish are just average. I give them half stars additional due to pandemic and at least reasonable pricing.   The soup base is not total pork bone base. The soup is at the light side now t too creamy. The meat just ok for their charshu. Veggie is not heavily use. The porch egg probably the item worthy. I would give their ramen C grade.   The appetizers fried shiu mai is good enough even they are not in the great category. The fried calamari is just average. Food at least is fresh to have.   The place is big enough for hosting a lot of customers. Service is good may be we are the only customer. I would said they are like the take out restaurant quality. If I am hungry a bowl of soup during winter, I may think to visit. There are a lot can improve on the ramen.

Before any mini donut, this shop has serve Gourmet donut for many years. As today it still serve the famous donut nut just to the high school across the corner, many has come here for the donut. They are famous on the bacon maple donut. This is their best seller.   When we have visited the store, they run out of bacon maple donut. I choose other options. I have the new chocolate banana. It is drizzle with chocolate and the filling is banana flavor. The chocolate touch is ok. The infill is better. I am use to Bavarian creme but banana creme is better.   My wife has the apple fritter. This is a strange donut but interesting. When we visit them, they almost closing up the store. So the donut has been sit for some time. I will reevaluate them when I revisit them. The only complaint is they close at 12:00 everyday. This is only morning business.

This cafe is busy during the Friday lunch. I found a place at the bar since I am solo during lunch. The bar area is where they keep all the sauces. So I can pick any sauce I want for my sushi. I am here because of my yelp friend Mel said lunch here has deal and they are good.  Friday lunch is busy. I got their lunch special sashimi. It has 12 pieces slide. The tuna and salmon slice is thick pieces. The yellow tail is thinner but at lease they provide it with masago. The white fish I don't know. These slices lay on white radish. It is actually good deal for $12. It come with choice of side with miso soup or salad.   The sushi chef is very fast paste. They can roll out the sushi is great speed. The have 4 people in the small space counter but able to work on the tight place. Talking space management, they have good one plus a lot servant.

King of the Coop open in Wesley Chapel is convenient and closer to me at New Tampa. Since I have their chicken, they don't have bone in chicken. Mostly the tender.   We got the tender basket with Nashville Hot coating. It is really good hot and spicy chicken. Love the sweat hot taste. It is a bit spicy sweet taste which ok challenge for a Malaysian who use to eat spicy food. The basket come with tree pieces. Love the spicy of the coating.

This Caribbean Cuisine wine Caribbean attitude. The restaurant menu do not have much to select but I do like their Oxtail. According to their name they are Haitian cuisine.   I have the Oxtail and my wife has fried chicken. Their chicken is fried to very crispy. The chicken tasty. It can come with island spice stew.   I am the fan of oxtail. It cook with island spice in slow braise. The meat is separated from the bone. I like the island marinated sauce. It must has a lot ingredient in it.   This dishes has a choice of side. It come with plantain and I also choose the mushroom rice. It has dark long grain rice. I like this rice very much.   If you come to Caribbean, the time is not matter. As a result, you need to wait for your food to be ready. As I said before. The Caribbean attitude slow and easy.

For lunch it is five stars. Cannot said much about dinner since we have not visited at dinner time. The value at lunch time is perfect for the price and the food selection. It definitely attract more lunch crowd. The scenery to eat lunch and enjoy the outdoors is pleasant during this time of year.   We have order a sunomono salad to start. I thing this better than poke bowl I paid close to the restaurant. The dish includes cucumber with sweet vinegar and the protein includes raw Ahi tuna, salmon, Tilapia and cook octopus. It top with masago and sesame seed. This is best sunomono I have in Tampa since I have search the best similar to Miami.   Our main dishes are grilled salmon and pan seared grouper. The salmon was grilled with sprinkles with herb and lay over asparagus. It serve a cream sauce at the bottom. The grouper is the best. It lay over the sautéed veggies and base with lime sauce. Both dishes is well decorated presentation. Taste is good.   I like service and the speed of food delivery to your table. If come to enjoy the meal in Jackson, the parking below the restaurant is free for two hours.

I like old Channelside better because of more buildings. The ideal with open space is good but the ship container really did not display the beauty of the place. I like the open view with seating and view for the bay water. Some how they have least to offer. It just look cheap with current look. I like the bathroom and security everywhere.   It is great for family with open space but we miss the courtyard. It is try to be hip but not totally hip. Something is missing. Food selection like street food and we have a few spot in Bay Area which compete off. Not sure change for good but definitely not better. May be great for new year eve fireworks. But just one day out of 365 days.

I was attracted by their creative flavor. This is the branch ice cream store from YBOR city. They have the corner lot which is perfect for the customers to hang out and enjoy the ice cream at outdoor side lawn. They do have seat in the store and front of the store if you decide to stay at eat.   Today they have the new flavors with frosty candy cane for the holiday season. I also heard the friend of my like their guava pastelito so we try one of that. I also go with the crowd favorite the chronic popcorn. Because of pandemic, they don't have the taste try. So I order three scoop. Not cheap for the scoops. But each scoop is big. I ask if they can separate it. They said we have to get all three in tiny bowl. If not I have to paid three individual scoop cost. I would said the three scoops mash together is not good. Flavor mixed up. With no taste try, I can tell you 2 out out of three are not my favorite. I would throw away the other two. The best is still the crowd favorite the chronic popcorn.   With above reason, the about 2.5 stars. Next give a bigger bowl when I ask for it to separate the scoop. The request is reasonable but they did not provide it.

Solid 4 stars and most affordable in the street. With the competition of many restaurant at the same street, they have some edge because of their affordability. One thing definitely can improve is their menu. The letter size of the menu is too tiny. May be need to increase the font size to 14.   We start with the Chimichurri Parmesan six wings. The wing was fried, grilled, to with cheese and Chimichurri sauce. I believe this is their best appetizer.   Our entree are Basic and Lima plates and combo. For the basic we have Ropa Vieja and shredded chicken. This combo also come with yellow rice and sweet plantain. The Lima has better rice. It is Peruvian green rice, plum tomatoes and onion. The protein are Chimichurri pork, and mojo pork.   Service just average. But but and price are good. The happy hour is before 6:30 pm. We were there 7pm and many of the happy hour customers left about 7:15 pm. So if you want to enjoy more quiet setting, come at 7:30 pm.

We are trying their lunch instead of breakfast here. Just want to see how it was incomparable to many breakfast place serve lunch.   The store location located in a very busy plaza during lunch. All this due to many restaurants are at the same plaza. Parking is a challenge during lunch.   The line was not long and we got our order in rather quickly. Many have come to here for take out. The food also come out quick. I got the jalapeño cheese bagel with egg, bacon and cheese. The food come out warm. I was thinking if I am eat here, I would at least get temperature hot sandwich. Not so.   I like their ice coffee. I got the vanilla sweet cream cold brew. The size compared with the price to paid  is at the high size. Good coffee.   Overall experience is a par. Can be better if you dine in.

This food truck has some unique item we are going to try. I have or seen many place have it. This food truck is popular among the community. Price is a bit in the high side.   They carry chicken and beef shawarma, lamb gyro, ad chicken wings for the choice of protein. The made of food can be wrap, over rice, quesadilla, over salad or a la cart. The do have interesting item like Italian pie. We didn't get that. They are unique due to their chicken shawarma. I have not see one restaurant like they put the chicken in the grilled. Most restaurants chop in slice and stir fry for you. This one I the gyro grilled like what I have in Jordan. They slice it when you need it. It is good.   The price is not like Jordan street food 1.5 euro. They are American price. But I don't mind it because it really taste like that country.

Ok store to pick up things you need. This is not the super target but it has the thing you need. It is very close to the university area and a lot students actually shop here. They have Pizza Hut located in the store if you want to get a quick bite. We're here for the cleaning solution. They have the twin packs for good price. Even better with coupon. The check out line is a bit small. The have 14 line with double side line. Emergency exit is well label. I wonder if we test their amber alert what will it be. Plenty of parking in front of the store. Customers service for exchange is available.

I like this brewery. It has good beer hall, stage, decoration, art and ambient. Please check their calendar for event and special. I encourage them to continue to do it to attract the customers.   I got their watermelon mint wheat ale. It was interesting to have because of the watermelon flavor. Price is in the median. The stage has good three D decoration with the eyes look at you no matter where you seat. It has projected the fish aquarium on the wall. The art gallery is another way for me to stroll.   We were here for the Asian food truck rally. There people at the bar serving are nice to customers.

This is the most completed oriental market. I have seen Atlanta Hong Kong market, super h, ranch 99, this market cannot be compete with that but hold their own ground. They have carried many variety dry food can food and fresh food.   There six major departments. The Fresh vegetable. The frozen section, imperishable food, deli, fresh seafood, and meat. The deli have the roast duck, crispy pork, BBQ pork, braise pig stomach, pig ear, pig tongue, and soy chicken in the BBQ section in deli. The deli have regular dish like salt and pepper pork chop or shrimp, general tau chicken, sweet and sour chicken, Buddha delight, seafood mix vege, kungpao chicken, fried rice, and noodle.   The meat department you can get special cut such pork belly, short rib cut, beef Shane. I like the most is they allow for smaller piece flank steak less than half pound. The sea food department have live fish, lobster, vancouver crab.   The frozen section have Sahbu Sahbu (hot pot) material that you can assemble. You can get thin slice pork, fish cake, shrimp or octopus ball, meat ball, thin slice beef.   The center section has jasmine rice for various region. They also have the sticky rice, sushi rice, brown rice. The munch area have deferent type of biscuit, mochi, dry squid eat out from bag, fried shrimp chip.....  Got to check out yourself.   The fresh vegetable that I like the most are the Chinese Kailan, hollow stem spinach, Bok choi, Yu choi. There is tropical fruit that you have never seen before like rambutan.   Dessert are the coffee cake, coconut bun, sweet bun, sponge cake. More to offer.   I can get most of the oriental spice here for Chinese cuisine.

Solid 4 star market. We know about this chain market when we travel to Seattle. Finally there is one in Wesley Chapel in the Bay Area. Joining the member ship is free. The benefit of the membership is big because of the discount. I would suggest join their membership before any purchase. There are special discount items for member.   This store has furniture, interior decoration, toy, food, drink and more. My wife like hello kitty. She is a big fan for many year. This store carry many of the item. From candy to bowl. The items that provide in the store are import from foreign country. If you like those item, you may not get it next time because of foreign supply is different.   They also carry some wine, beer, imported soft drink and more. Including many types of syrup. You will items you normally don't see in our daily shopping center.

It is a popular neighborhood BBQ. When I put my order in, I was number 15 in the wait list. The wait is more than 30 minutes. They did warn you it going to take long time before your turn. Since they use the parking lot of an commercial building, they have limited parking space. When they people are getting crowded, they stop taking order until the crowd reduced.   I got the sausage sandwich. They do have a choice how spicy the sausage you want. I pick mild because my wife cannot handle too spicy food. The sausage was well prepared and pack. It was a big link.   I also got the the tree meat combo dinner. You can choose the upgrade meat such as brisket and rib. The upgrade meat is adding $5 to the original cost which I feel is worth the money. I got pull pork, brisket, and rib. The side are baked bean and collard greens. Both side is good. I also like the sweetness of the bake bean.   If they can improve the speed of the order, it will tremendously helping them.

I like this restaurant because they are most affordable in the area. The price is reasonable with amount of food they have provided on each dish. Basically the amount is good mother and a child or two older person. For young adult is plenty. You will not go hungry after visit.   The downside of the restaurant is every thing take too long. It take more 10 minutes after they drop the menu and come to take your order. Often they forget to bring what you need for additional things. The service did take a back seat in this restaurant. It is not they don't have enough help, it just the mentally slow in this restaurant.   I got the sautéed palomilla with Mofongo. The first taste is great when dig the outside of mofongo. After you get to the outer layer, it lost the best taste. The palomilla I prefer it to be grilled instead of sautéed. However, they don't have this option.

I have revisited this restaurant 4 times. I have decided to give the update. This definitely the Peruvian restaurant that is expert with grilled meat. The dishes I like are the Falda, Picanha, Lomo de Cerdo. Several people of my friend have tried their ribs and they like it.   If you come with a group of three, you can order the mix grill platter to share and you will have a chance for each type of meat. The Picanha is a bit salty but the marinated spice is well done into the meat. The best dish is still the Falda.   They have the lunch special now use 10 to 12 dollars. I like the full portion better.   The Chicha Morada is improving from my previous visit. The trick is telling them not to put too much ice in the cup before they pour it. The taste will be more Peruvian bean taste when they did that.

Movie night at the citrus park mall. It close at 2 am in the morning. It offer late night snack and beer. They all day beer special and after 10 pm special. At certain day they have all you can eat wings or tacos.   The night we have visit they have combo special 2 people for $30. Very good deal. In the combo plater, it has 5 types of grilled meat. Pork rib, petite sirloin, smoke wings, grilled chicken breast and sausage. It also come with grilled onion and wedge potatoes. This item serves over the fire grill that keep the food warm. The grille has center plate to heat up the food. I like this way because many BBQ place has combo. At the of combo, the remaining food get cold. However, the device they have in this restaurant keep warm and heat up in the middle of grill.   I would give them 5 stars for the food taste, keep warm on the combo, good service, nice open dinning hall, great price on the alcohol. I got 22oz Miller lite for $5.5.

I was here for a take out. They have BBQ grilled in the store. You can see your meat grilled in front of you. This restaurant is local favorite. Other than BBQ, they also has some southern food in their special menu.   You can get any BBQ meat and add in the rib with each bone with $2 extra. I got the half chicken and extra two bone of BBQ rib. This come to $15 with tax. Not cheap. The chicken I think is to dry and a bit of sit on the grilled for too long. Not juicy at all. But the rib was good enough to have. Our meat come with cob of corn and BBQ baked beans. I like the baked bean because it has southern sweetness. I would only recommend only the rib for this place.   After order take 10 minutes wait.

It is about 3.5 star. Very close to 4 but not yet. I like the new food delivery system. It is unique. All the food is deliver from the electronic bullet train. It is make sense once the kitchen finished prepared the food has immediate deliver. It cut down wait for the waitress to pickup and food may get cold.   We start with Ika Maruyaki. This is giant squid with sauce. If they grilled it. It will be better.   I got the most expensive Slice Beef Belly Hand Pull Noodle and my wife got the Lamb Hand Pull Noodle. My hand pull noodle is kind of stick together. It has slice beef but I think the Vietnamese restaurant near by may be better and half of the price. My wife lamb was very good. It has the good braise. The noodle was well distributed. We did not witness the hand pull. But the noodle is soft.   I am not sure how the tip going to be for this restaurant. Because food delivery is not from them. It is straight from the kitchen. They only serve water, take order, pay. That it. The reason they are three is due to price. For my beef slice is not matching the industry standard.

Yelping 1700. Rare Specialty Food no. 44.   Sweet Soul is new and coming special dessert shop that have variety of great item to offer in South Tampa. I am glad that make good use of that space. Have you heard about bee pollen, goji berry, hemp seed. This is the healthy food that serve in food conscious store.   They have ACAI bowl, frozen yogurt. We were here for the frozen yogurt. Before we come, our friend already recommended this place. I am joining their train to recommend other to try their food. Their yogurt flavor is interesting. They have charcoal vanilla, chocolate, and some time mocha. I was never try charcoal vanilla. It is black color in very good way. I would recommend to go for the bowl instead of cup. Because the give 2 bases, 3 toppings, and one dusting.   Guess what we have charcoal vanilla and. Chocolate swirl. The base is raspberry and dragon fruit. The toppings is bee pollen, ginger sugar, and mocha cookie. The dusting is agave sweet syrup. This combination is exquisite. The moment you taste it, you love it immediately.

It is 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. Mel has a good BBQ and they they located at good spot not too far from the I-275. A lot people here for the ribs and turkey leg. The selection is not much but it does enough for the menu. The main reason they are good rating is they are generous on the meat quantity.   The meat selections are Rib, chicken, thin end, turkey leg, brisket, sausage and pull pork. We got the three meat combo. Although their price is the most expensive in along the I-275, but they make up the quantity of the meat. I got the brisket, sausage and rib. I think their rib is the best. I also like their brisket with good marinated BBQ sauce. I saw some one order the turkey leg sandwich, it was looking good. They will chop up the rib to bite size for easy handling.   Overall my experience with them is great. Sometimes you need to wait for the meat because it is still in the smoker.

# 2200 Review. This one go to the local restaurant has unique features and good way to prepare the poke. Height seafood represent one of the good seafood place in Tampa Bay Area. The store has a few tables you can enjoy your meal there. They also have market side selling the fresh seafood of the day.   Their poke is one of the best. The fish is a fresh catch of the day and it is fresh to have the poke here. Choose the size, base, poke, sauce, topping. I like that they mix the poke and sauce separately. Then add to the base and add topping. This give you well round mixed poke.   Other than poke, they do have conch fritters time to time. It is good. The best is the fish jerky freshly made by the owner of the store. They have the salmon and tuna jerky. This is hard to come by. You need to call ahead if they have it. Usually sold out very quick. I love those jerky.

Finally we can say there is excellent Mediterranean cuisine near Wesley Chapel. Garden Mediterranean is taking over the previous Cuban restaurants. They redo the interior and make it more pleasing. The set up is nicer than the previous restaurant. One important reminder is on weekends dining, they get busy very quick. So you may want to be first one to be seated. We got here 11:30 and first to be seated. The advantage is you got the food before everyone else.   We got the meat lovers kabab for two. It has variety of kabab. I like all of them. The kabab includes Shish and chicken kabab, gyros, chicken shawarma, kufta kabab and veggies kabab. The meat was well marinated. I like the chicken kabab juicy. The gyros did not have deep meat smell. The kufta has good edge grilled. The meat lovers is recommended if you have two or three. Good to have variety of meat.   Service is a bit lack off. This may be the area to be improved. It is about 4.5 stars. The store has too less on service people. It need some help.

Bargain! Bargain! Bargain!  If you look for something temporary and not cost a lot, this may be the place. Many of the item on sales. It is because of the flea. Certainly not.   If you look for costume, they may have some choice. They do not have the vintage clothing, but they do have all other clothing.   The flea market also have two Spanish booths. Food is reasonable. I did not try. There is a fruit vendor at the entrance. The rest of the store is under the roof.

We like the this restaurant and this is the third time we are here. The server is friendly, unfortunately they are not fluent in English. The food is very good. Their famous dish is the grill quail. Each order of the grill quail is coming with 10 pieces. They prepare with very tasty sweet blacken source. It is finger licking good.   The dinner we have order is 7 courses of beef for two. The come with fresh beef slice wrap, beef cute, sesame beef, beef salad, beef congee, beef ball, beef desert. This is serious amount of food for two. The seven way to cook the beef in Vietnamese style open my eyes how it done differently. Of course, they afraid that you order this dis and share with more than three people. Be sure that you have order one more dish if you want to share.   The restaurant is good with group  and couple. At the end the restaurant is in medium condition for the furniture. This is a place going for the taste not for look. The duck noodle soup is another dish that you may want to try if you don't mind the bone. I always like meat with bone because more tasty. If you are boneless food person this is not your dish.

No sure how long they going to run their lunch special lobster deal. But our experience here was good. This Red Lobster joint I have been visited many time. This time the service is good. Some other time is slow.   I have been here for Shrimp festival and lobster festival. This time for their lobster lunch special. They will provide half Tail meal for below $10. I have the lobster roll with fried and Cesar salad with added grilled shrimp. The added shrimp is additional $2. Overall not a bad deal. I like the lobster roll. It has good mixture of flavor. The roll is cut out and toasted with grilled. The grilled shrimp is grilled and chilled in the salad make this cold dish which is good also.   Overall I like the deal. I have been here for many venue and they are decent.

Rare Ethnic Food No. 15  Compare to many Caribbean Cuisine, they a bit above average. In fact, they are Jamaican cuisine. The culture for the Caribbean is more into relax and lay back type. The menu is not printed but on the board. When we were there, many of Jamaican families eat there.   The oxtail is the popular item that people order. So we go with it. The food came out in about right timing. The oxtail is cook in the sweet side. It come with rice with pinto bean and salad. The oxtail can be pick out by the folk which the must cook this meat long time for it to fall off the bone. I have some other oxtail before. This one is in the middle of the standard.   Service is good. This is a 3.5 stars restaurant to me. Since there is no half star. 4 stars was given in this review.

3.5 stars restaurant. However, they carry a dish that I haven't have before. Round up to 4 stars.   This restaurant have sit down and serve. It carry some traditional dish. I have order their special beef pho. It has all the beef ingredients including tripe and tendon. A few things can be improved. The beef need to slice thinner. The pho base soup is at clear and light pho flavor. It may need a bit stronger. But if you like light pho taste, this is the one you can order.   I have the crispy flat noodle. This dish I have not try before. The angels hair rice noodle was deep fried and flatten. It top with stir fry mixed of meat and seafood. The chef has good wok skill. This dish cook at high BTU flame. It bring out the good flavor.   I also has a to go special Vietnamese sandwich. It is assorted cold cut meat assemble. The homemade sweet paste make this sandwich stand out from other sandwich. Service is good. Food come out quick.

This is a specialty store you can get the repair of your gadgets such tablet, cellphone, TV, MP3 and more. They have reasonable pricing for all repairs.   We were here for my old broken phone repair. Since I got new IPhone 6, I decided to see we can repair the IPhone 5. The switch off button is broken. The cost of repairs is $55. Since we check in with yelp, there is a $5 coupon. We also have the factory unlock so we can switch the carrier. It only takes them 24 hour to switch for $49 dollars. We have tested at the store to make sure it has reception. I like local store to do it instead get internet store is I can go back to them if we have problems.   They also sell cell phone case, refurbished TV, computer screen and more. It is good price. They have average service. Sometimes you need to call to check if the part is arrived to fix your gadgets.

Endless sushi is truly endless if you going for the all you can eat. The interior decoration is very nice and modern. This is the place for two person can have the romantic date. This all you can eat concept is a copy from the other Japanese restaurant in New Tampa. They will be judged and compared to the similar restaurant.   Tonight we are trying this restaurant because they are recently open and new in the Bay Area. We have dinner buffet and they limited each person to 8 pieces of the sashimi if you have dinner buffet. The Sunday dinner buffet is $17.99 not $15.99 per the web site. Tonight we have order the following: Spicy Tuna Roll - 2 Stars Spicy Salmon Roll - 2 Stars Shrimp Tempura Roll - 3 Stars Rainbow Roll - 3 stars Crazy Roll - 3 stars Lady In Red Roll - 3 stars Saki Roll - 4 Stars The Coconut shrimp should not be calling in that name. Most recognize coconut shrimp is fried with coconut flake. This is just the wet flour coating fried with sweet mayo. It is different than my friend Rachel M. posted picture. I wonder they start changing their quality. The Hibachi squid is not near to the standard with most hot plate includes the minor burn of the squid. The sashimi is better since they are base on the cut. The best of the sashimi is the surf clam. This is the most value of the dish. The hibachi tofu is perfect for taste and texture. The fried scallop is not the true scallop - disappointed. Age tofu is OK.   This section is to evaluate the chef skill and material. The spicy tuna is process with food processor. As a result, they are lumpy. The correct way is to chop in pieces and mix with correct spice and quail egg. By chopping it create the texture of the tuna and preserve the quality. The food processor just a short cut. Same as the spicy salmon is process that way. After I eat the sushi, I can smell the fish smell around my lip, although they are fresh but they are not the best quality due to the smell. They should not call out coconut shrimp or scallop to give customer a misconception where they are not prepare in those ingredient.   This restaurant will require a lot of improvement not just the chef skill. They also need to improve the flavor of each roll to show it is not too plain. I am thinking this restaurant is 2.5 star bases on the comment above but I am given three stars. I hope they can have dramatic improvement for the next time I am visit.

Seafood time. The pincher usually can host a seafood party. They do have the happy hours menu for a drink and some nibble. The have two for one drink all day everyday.   The seafood is fresh here. I like the clam. The price range is at the high side. But generally seafood dish is higher than any meat dish. The restaurant set up is timber and wood.   The service is good. Our order came out quick. I like the two for one drink. The value of the food without the drink special will add up.

Enterprise is much better than other rental car companies in the New Orlean airport. Other famous rental companies go down hills due to their combine of two other companies with lesser quality car. In order to insure the highest quality and better class. I would recommend enterprise.   The only complaint is the car outwardly not very clean. Especially the mirror area for the side view. Which is very important. Other than that. They car class and the interior is better or one car class upgrade. The check in to get the rental car is easy. Walk to the counter and find your reservation. Then walk to lot where their agents greet you with the car ready for you.   Price is very reasonable and the promised car class is available. Return the car also easy with great fast returns process.

I have been to this restaurant many times. Some time I bring my boss here since he like sushi. We have our office celebration here over the hibachi table. Some time we got good hibachi chef have a lot trick some time it just ordinary hibachi chef. Some time you catch the food that the chef threw at you.   When I come here, I like to have the dancing crab roll, Koizi roll, spicy tuna roll. There is roll call sexy girl roll. This is spicy sexy roll with spicy tuna and tempura shrimp with spice mayo. No sure the name matches the roll. We usually come at lunch because is all you can eat with lesser price compare to dinner price.   The reason I give 3 stars due to current quality of the restaurant drop. Food is still good but they are not as good at the first year they open the restaurant. The service is still good. The hibachi chef is base on your luck. Sometime you get a good chef.

The outside sitting at this month is very pleasant. Blue sky no cloud and you not in hurry while you enjoy your lunch. Our office decided to celebrate a win of project at this restaurant. This restaurant is the seventh series of famous Columbia restaurant. The lunch menu is reasonable price. Since we have a big group, the outside sitting waiter have a lot to cover. He have a slow start to get our menu. Then the food come out faster then I have estimated. The speed of serving is good after the food is out.    I have the Mahi Mahi Cayo Hueso.  It is grill Mahi Mahi with mojo marinated. It is good. The soup of chilled gazpacho is taste better than lunch entree. I also ask a dish to go for the coworker that cannot make it. The order is done in 5 minutes. This mean this is cafe style precook items and assemble on site immediately. The temperature of the food is warm and further evident precook item.  This may not be the cook to your order place.  Friday and Saturday night the y have live music at the river front. This may be the best time to take a sip and enjoy.

This is actually below averages sweet tomato. I have been to several sweet tomato but none has been like this one. We went at night time and realized there not much change in menu from lunch. They charge you $5 more if you come at night.  The salad is the best section. But at night time seem like not replacing with the fresh bowl if you come around 5:30 pm. I am guessing dinner have the same food as lunch. With that said, I like the quinoa, the crispy cheese bread, clam chowder with unlimited bacon crumble to add, and the chicken noodle soup. Those are well prepared.   The service is very good. The table was attend well for clean out the use plate. The serve with a smile which make more welcome. I not sure I am returning but definitely like the service here.

Indian grill has been in my list to visit for some time. We know the best time to visit has to be lunch time all you can eat buffet. I have not have a weekday lunch time to do it until the Labor Day off.   Parking of the restaurant are only a few adjacent to the restaurant. They do have additional parking at the back. The restaurant have a few seat on the outside and some at the inside.   The buffet display great selection of meat which I like. I am not a vegetarian and this is fit my appetite. The stand out dish is the tandoori chicken and the curry chicken. The tandoori chickens is well marinated into the meat in comparison to many restaurant in the Bay Area. I like the curry chicken due to their heavy Indian spice like the one I have in Malaysia.

Been to this place several time but never give a formal review. It is due to undecided what to give this restaurant. Finally settle on the average of the review.   This restaurant located on the main entrance of the sawgrass mall. I have been here to wait for friend or a drink. It has a nice outdoor seating. It is very nice on the cool month.   The food is so so. It is actually not a wow factor nor bad. The service is good which keep this restaurant in business. But to compete with the two neighbor bar, they may need to step up on the menu or some signature drink.

We have a quick dinner before the concert. When we walk into the restaurant, the food smell is over the entire dining room even they have high ceiling.   Today special is the chicken Tawek with Biryani rice. The chicken is marinated with good flavor. The Biryani rice is good enough may be top five in the restaurant I have tried. We also order the falafel. The falafel did live up to the restaurant name. They have a good falafel. Not too dry and great mixture of flavors. The Mediterranean Mixed Grilled dish include all different grill meat of they serve. I believe they have pre-grill these items to reduce the wait time of the customers. However, the meat is a bit dry. This may be the area to improve.   Overall the restaurant is counter order and will bring to the table. The interior design is very modern and contemporary. I like the comfortable furniture. They need to improve to ventilate the food smell that trap in the dining hall.

I have been to this Grill Smith when they just open. I don't like at that time because the chaos and un-organize. I have not been back at least few years. Tonight we have decided to go back to visit. Because our visit time is about 9:00 pm one hour before they close, there is no line. I wonder how this restaurant handles pressure when they have a lot customer.   Tonight is Wednesday and they are Happy Hour all day. Only Sunday and Wednesday is all day Happy Hours. All other day Happy Hour is from 4 to 7 pm. During the happy hour the appetizers range from $5 to $7. It is almost 40% off from the original price. We have order 3 appetizers from happy hours menu and one appetizer from regular menu. They are Spicy Thai Chicken, Crispy Fish Taco, Fillet Tip Egg Roll and we add a Crab and Shrimp Cake from regular menu. After we have order we realize that all items are deep fried. They have their tasty side. I like the crab and shrimp cake the most. I also like the Spicy Thai Chicken dipping sauce with sweet tangy flavor.   Since we have so many appetizers, we only order one entrée from their special - the Shrimp Diablo. It is spaghetti in red sauce with shrimp except they add a kid of spicy. I believe this dish is too plain and not exciting. I think this dish should not be served any more if they try to attract customer. The special is not special at all.  Overall the service is excellent; food came out very quick since there is no other customer this late. Enjoy watching the Hokey NHL game with the TV with Tampa Bay Lighting score a goal at the buzzer to win.

Party!!!  Before you go, please make plan how you are going home. I have my designated driver. You might want get a cab or arranged someone to pick you up. This margaritas festival is very good. The line is very manageable and in fact some don't even have line. They do have some food like munchies, so may be eat a bit before you go.   Drink is good. I like more than half of the margaritas there. I have narrowed to a few best drink. The Hula Bay Toasted Kamehameha with pineapple and toasted coconut is very tasty. Datz Kelly Kapowski with edible flower and ginger beer is very presentable. The District Tavern Chupacabra with watermelon juice is a nice touch. Marchand's Bar and Grill Sandia Silvestre wither watermelon shave ice with blueberry caviar is creative. Catrinas sour sop with pomegrante seeds is very chewable drink. The Surfside Taphouse FloRita cream coconut is very good thick drink.   It was good to party with so many Yelper. It make more fun when you have know so many fun people there. Thanks to each vendors provide the most interesting drink.

What's up Tampa Bay. Do you know there is new kid in the block that serve endless sushi. It has all the vibe to attract young and old. Definitely good for hungry teenager.   This new sushi place has different signature rolls that are very good in my book. I would said this sushi place is the best in Tampa now for endless sushi. I can tell you there are several favorite sushi in my list. The Hawaiian roll is unique and gooooood. The salmon skin roll made the mouth watering. The spicy "white" tuna hand roll is definitely a try item. Don't forget BBQ Salmon hand roll. It is tasty.   The interior designer design has automated color changing lights. They are beautiful to look at. You have a choice sit on the sushi bar or regular alcohol bar. These bars have fancy lighting system. The service is good. No slow down period.

I was wondering why Chris W visited this place so often. This restaurant really match it name - Chicken Salad Chick. I would said it is huge chick magnet. Many ladies enjoy this restaurant more than guys. If you walk in, the girls are more than the boys. It is really ladies choice of food.   Stacy Brown the founder and creator has her story of this restaurant of how it started. Interesting story was it. They have multiple selections of chicken salad type that will be some things for your plate. You also can sample the chicken salad before you make a choice of the ultimate salad you want. We have the jalapeño holly that day. It is tasty and good. We order chicken gourmet dish come with sandwich scoop, pasta salad and broccoli salad. I like the broccoli salad.   The interior decoration certainly the best I seen for the fast food store. They also have the small room can hold 20 people if you like to have the meeting there. Food is definitely healthy side in my book. Service is really good. I will return to this restaurant sometime soon for the chick magnet.

It is close to 4.5 stars. 4 stars is given due the service is a bit slow.   This place have good pricing for taco joint. I have been book mark this place for a while. With less $10 you can get a combo with drink. I have 5 taco combo for $7.50. But adding fish and shrimp taco is a dollar more. My favorite is the shrimp taco. It has very good spice for the shrimp. Very tasty for the bite. We have other tacos such as lingua, tripa, chicharon.   It use to a taco truck. Now they have permanent place with sit down restaurant which very good for the customers. Now they serve margarita. I would said is ok.   We also have fried whole fish. It is a perch fish. It is only $11. Come with two side. It was greatly fried to the bone. The edge and scorn area is crispy. The food is good. I will be back to check them out.

Some like Starbucks and some like McDonald. I will prefer Dunkin Donut coffee. They are most reasonable and provide the best taste and value to cup of Joe. Their reasonable price with right coffee bean is choice of selection. I also like their ice coffee and frozen drinks coolata. Those are my favorite.   Currently they have many types of coolata. One time I got the pumpkin spice coolata at the Halloween. The ice coffee with cream and mocha is my favorite. It is cool like cucumbers. I don't like hot drinks that much. But the frozen drinks and ice drinks are great here. Just like Southeast Asia.   Donut is just ok. Some time I like their french curly donut. Sugar donut is the best. I really don't like the glazed donut. But the Bavarian cream infill is great. You can order online without wait if you in hurry. Once you have the app, everything can be done online before come to the store. Lessen the wait time.

The Pho Kien Giang is a large Vietnamese restaurant can seat many people. The inside of the restaurant has booth on the wall then the rectangular table in line. It almost like the beer garden.   We were here because of Thao review and the Yelp Top 100 restaurant. This will be number 22 restaurants I have try in the list.   The have good selection of pho including the raw beef soup that you can add into the soup by yourself. We were here to try the Ban Hue noodle soup and their unique specialty caramelized fish. The noodle soup is spicy soup base the slice beef, pig blood cube, pork shoulder and flank beef slice. It was great and they good enough.   I like the caramelized fish. It has brown sugar to cook inside. The fish is cook with fried pork skin fat then added the brown sugar sauce. They are very sweet but it go well with the rice.
