We wait the food for 30 minutes but the restaurant make it up with 15% discount due to the delay. I like them to treat the customer fairly.

Fleming is an upscale restaurant with sticker price food. It is measure with the quality, service, chef skill and atmosphere. We are glad to try this restaurant to see what they can offer.   We went to the restaurant without reservation and we got the table in 15 minutes. We were there at Sunday and they are not that busy and we have the table quickly. I wonder weekend and weekday is this situation. We also notice the crowd to eat here slowdown at 8:00 pm.   Most of the entry is $40 and more. By the time you done for the night is about $70 per person with drink. They also have the three course prix fixe meal about $50  We started with the Ricotta Wild Mushroom Crostini with pesto and microgreens. I like the pesto and the balsamic vinaigrette dip on the side. We have our entry as the Prime New York Strip with the Scallops and the Bloomsdale Spinach - tomato, red onion, spiced bacon, almonds, fresh blueberries, cauliflower couscous, chopped egg, chevre fritter, and lemon-truffle dressing. The Bloomsdale spinach with the lemon-truffle dressing is delicious. The spiced bacon makes a twist to the spinach. The herb butter-roasted Brussels sprouts is a bit charcoal that was place below the steak. Seem like the chef did not watch the fire over the grilled. However, the herb spice work perfectly with the Brussels Sprout. The scallop also is a bit burn on the cumin-laced spice. The scallop is a great. Overall the chef needs to watch the burn food. We ended with miniature Chocolate Au Crème with chocolate-dipped pistachio tuile cookie. The dessert is perfect. Overall the restaurant is together for the food. The service may need a bit of attention when customer is not look down and looking for them.

This restaurant serve the African food also. It is a small business with hard working people. I would said a very affordable restaurant around this area.   We have order the fried gizzard and chicken wing. The chicken is fried naked without batter. It come with fried rice. Decent food. The fried gizzard is rarely find in Tampa. If you like tough bite and chewy, this is a good dish to go. It go well with beer while watching the games.   The owner is very helpful. The food is very fresh. They come out hot. Sometime I feel they need to set for 2 minute before going to styrofoam container or plate. Although they have the table for sitting, I will say order to go is easier. They are above average. 3.5 stars restaurant. I wish them good luck.

Good vibe. This restaurant is about 3.5 star in my book. Since there is no 1/2 stars, 4 is given. Restaurant is kind of short of staffs. Food has good marinated spice. At least they have good interior seat cushion. Table length may need to match the booth length.   We have order the stew beef, oxtail, and jerk pork. The best is the oxtail. However, the jerk pork come in second. The meat of the food definitely stew for long time. It is separate from the bone. Good enough marinated to the meat. Price is about mid range about what we have paid for. The side includes rice and cabbage.   As I have said, need more staff. One time the chef come to serve me. There are some take out order, but the food come out right time. Enough volume or size for a grown person.

This is Tampa own nice sandwich store. This is the area they generate a lot crowd during the lunch hour. It is pack most of the time. The sandwich is famous in this area.   We have the Cuban Sandwich with hot press. We order all inclusive sandwich fully loaded. The sandwich is very thick nice cheese. The ham is very juicy. The mojo pork just a few slice in the center. The pork need to be more mojo marinated with better strong taste. Overall, this is a big sandwich for a hungry person.

In compare to all Ichicoro, this location has the least choice. At least they are more comfortable to dine here. The limited menu may be due the their smaller size of kitchen. Among the restaurants in the food court, I like their system better because they will text you to pick up your food while you walk around the compound.   I have Shoyu ramen. The base is good. The ingredients is great. The only thing is the grill pork need some more time to cook to fight off the toughness of the meat. It is not easy to bite. I like their fried garlic and onion. It make the soup tasty. The egg is good. But I like it more liquid instead partially harden. Unfortunately they don't have the tonkutsu base.   The noodle is separated correctly. It not bad to have a bowl of soup in cold weather. Price is bit high for smaller portions than the other two restaurants in their chain.

A night of celebration for a friend birthday. The restaurant did take the reservation and make sure the surprise party is engaged correctly. They did a good job on reservation and the instruction that was given.   Tonight is also the third Friday night that Safety Harbor is a music street night that bring a lot of traffic to the restaurant. When I walk in the restaurant they also have live guitar music. The ambient is very nice. This restaurant is almost many chambers. Each room has three to four tables. Sometimes you feel like private dining when our party is the only table in that room.   The food is great there. Our started are the saganaki - Greek Kefalograviera Cheese. The cheese is well roasted. Harold's Shrooms- Portobello mushrooms cap with red pepper, fresh basil and olive in cheese. It has a mixture of garlic in it and makes it pleasant. My entrée is the Bison Chop Steak with grill onion. It sees with mush potatoes and roast veges. I will prefer this dish not chop or ground bison meat. I will prefer it to be cube pieces that make this dish desirable.   Overall the services are great. The owner is very welcoming. Like the set up of the restaurant.

This time of year supposedly very nice out. However, this year weather is cook up in the high temperatures side. This is a special event to welcome the new year ahead of us. The name is midnight in the garden, it is funny we are actually at the top of parking garage. Nice name to attract. We can said finally see the beautiful people of Tampa who dress up. I would said it is the top 80% beautiful people who attend this party. You know who is included :)   It does have the stunning skyline for the Tampa. A good view to fireworks. You can see two fireworks in the horizon. I would said the fireworks is at least half mile from the city river walk fireworks and 1.5 mile from channelside. The night include all you can drink bar and party live music. The music selection is upbeat and current. This is the positive. My friend warn me about the bathroom and drink line. This year they improve it.   However, the party is a bit over price for the face value. The reasons follow. 1. The drink is not the your typical mix drink place with great mixologist. 2. The drink do not have a good choice. Even for beer and wine. 3. The fire work is actually still far away. 4. No food!!!! 5. Security is lack off. No check on the purse.   I do have the good times with some of the yelper.

Cool festival for third Friday night for musical festival. The Main Street of downtown Safety Harbor is close for the festival. The street musician, bars and restaurants musicians performing make the street is fun to walk.   There are a lot vendors out there put the good or services they have provided. One of the vendors sells the old lid metal signs that were discarded and fixed it up as an art for decoration. The street is flood of people that are curious or music listener. There also some food vendors that you can get food on the street instead of restaurant.   I like city or the chamber of commerce bring business for the local restaurants with event. It also provides people to enjoy the evening. I like one musical band "voice of Jazz". They have multi level talent in the group. The musical night also has saxophone and harmonica musician.

This is very much healthy local bar. The outwardly of the restaurant is nice. It allow the bar to serve outwardly and inwardly. You can choose either side. The have many selection on the cocktail. One particular I like is the smoked old fashioned. They use Bulleit Bourbon, Demerara brown sugar and walnut bitter with a twist of orange peel. It add the smoke essence. They burn the wood and capture the smoke. You also can ask them to smoke your wine glass before they pour it for you.   I have order the Korean Grilled Flat Bread. This bread has 8 big pieces. This flatbread top with fried chicken pieces, mozzarella peppers jack cheese, cucumber, jalapeño and slaw. The slaw is pickle and has Asian cuisine taste. The combination of the ingredients has make this flatbread desirable.   Service is good. Not spectacular. Food prices is medium acceptable. Ambient is nice.

One of the best BBQ at Central Avenue. This restaurant is close to 4.5 stars about 4.3. This is one of the URBAN restaurants along the same street. Setting is unique, one side is bar and other side is restaurant.   The BBQ is best to be eat here. The pork belly is amazing. It has sweet and tangy taste. We got the baby back half rack. The meat is smoke more than three hours. The meat is fall of the bone easily. Marinated sauce deep into the meat with dry rub technique. Love the food taste. It come with three different house BBQ sauces. One of them is a bit spicy but all accompanying well with the ribs. We also have a side with collar green. It is good too with the slow cook break down fiber type.   I got the Sound Czech Pilsner. The beer is good to wash down the BBQ. Service is good and friendly.

#500 Review  I have been saving this review for some time. I chose Nico's Arepas Grill not just for the good food. It has successful Cinderella story that many small businesses can learn about it.   Many yelper know about them for the food truck they have operated. The Arepa that they have served using the imported Venezuela cheese. This cheese is almost like mozzarella cheese. When it melt, you can pull like small string. Thousands yard long. May be not. May be you can make it to Guinness record by single pull cheese string. Good Luck:)  This is a small guy that make it to the big stage. Now they open the restaurant to serve this food. It is truest Cinderella story make it to the big stage. What make them successful is the first impact that make the customer want to comeback after one visit. The success reason are: 1. Nice restaurant interior design to attract young and old crowd 2. Great service that make you feel welcome 3. Vibrant atmosphere created by the people who work there feel the Latino warm feeling  4. Good food for the reason to come back   This was our second stop of restaurant night and we have ordered the Nico Sampler and Sopa de Res. In the sampler, every items are great especially the cachapas. The cachapas is made from sweet corn and they are good. The Sopa de Res is the beef soup and it is very good too. They told me the weekend special is their tripe soup and it usually sold out in the morning.   Our waiter Rafael make our trip special and welcome. I am glad they hire the good personality and vibrant waiter. If you feel hungry at night when all restaurants have closed, they are the few open restaurant in the Bay Area. They open till 4 am in the week end. Go checkout and give them a shout if you like.

I like this theater because of easy access. The rooftop parking has the direct access to the cinema. It has long cover walkway that help you at the raining time.   We were here for the previews of King Arthur. We have a chance to watch this movie 4 day ahead of the actual showings. The movie is certainly a interesting way telling about King Arthur with mystical and magic.   The staff of the theater was very nice. The emergency exit is well lid event at the theater. I like the seat. I hate movie theater with reclining seat. Most of the recliner seat alway bounce back and your back uncomfortable. This theater has fix back seat with good slope back support. It do not require me to fight the spring of the recliner for good back support angle.   Only thing I would said is the bathroom stalls is a bit less. It need to be more. Also, I like someone to sell tickets instead of I walk to automated machine.

It is great to have the friend birthday at a restaurant that I have not been before. I like a sense of adventure for the food. I am not a Laos expert but I am grew up from Southeast Asia and i have some familiarity with the food for the region.   We have Hale Mary Salad, Laab Chicken, Nam Khao and Khao Boon. Khao Boon- a dish in my name. I need a cut from every customer who eat the dish for using my name :). Khao Boon is a out of taste experience from typical American food. It has chicken feet, pig blood jello, fried pork belly fat, mince pork or chicken and sherrard cabbage. It serve with coconut curry.   Chicken Laab is a mixture of stir fried chicken, skin and liver over the lettuce and cucumber. This is a interesting dish. It is a national dish of Laos and go with sticky rice.   This restaurant serve food that not seen often in USA town and city. If you want to try some thing different, come to check it out. The service is slow compared to normal restaurant. This may be the area to improve.

Krewe of Barkus parade is one of the five parades in French Quarter. This is one of the shortest route parades that I have been. It starts near the Louis Armstrong Park and march down to the Jackson square. This is a parade with dog. The dog owner will dress them in different costume, accessory, dog hair paint. Some of the dogs are dress in the character of Star War. Somehow this town is a big fan for the Star War Movie. The parade has names it own King and Queen Dogs that lead the parade. Special beads are giving out when the Queen and King nominated dog pass by.   This a low profile parade compare to all other parade. What I mean low profile is you have to lower yourself by sitting at the sidewalk curb to watch the parade in the same elevation of the dog. Please come early so you can occupy a sidewalk curb. Some of the dog may approach you and you will have a chance to touch them or take a close up picture. This parade is not as good to watch in standing position.   Alone the parade, there are promotion for the dog adoption, dog food, dog manicure, dog costume, dog treat, dog toy...... Some of the owner put a small dog and the baby and push along with the stroller, some of them carry their dog in the arm, movie set push cart. This is a fun parade with our four legs friend. Many children are in this parade. They give up candies and beads at the route. Some children run out from sidewalk curb to touch the dog when they see a cute one. This may be the only Mardi Gras Parade that is suitable for all ages.

ALDI is now voted for value leader. It has surplus over many leading grocery stores. It was the price and value that drove all people to here. Predominantly ALDI like to serve the neighborhood of low income area. It no different that this ALDI is located near these neighborhoods. It also very close to major university or college.   ALDI original is Germany company. The earlier ALDI carry some import goods from Germany. But lately they have hooked up with local companies and deliver the local products. Actually I prefer the imported product. I don't like deposit quarter coin and have the right to use the shopping cart. It has attracted many unwanted people line up at the front of the store want your cart after you have finished shopping. They ultimate goal is the quarter inside the cart. It actually make me feel unsafe and the strange approach you for the cart. I know it is cost cutting for the low price grocery but make me fell uncomfortable.

This is one of the oldest racing track. Indy 500 is race here and so do Brickyard 400. Indy 500 started at 1911. The curators told me the track is make of brick not like what we have it now. The brickyard 400 was started at 1994. Jeff Gordon is the first winner of that NASCAR race.   It is very interesting just find the entrance to the museum. It has to go under the concession area and under the track tunnel. The entrance is at the south of the lap. It take you to the museum yard and parking.   The museum has an scene to look at the track. In the museum has the hall of fame of previous winner. Some of them win the races many time. The display of the race car is timeless. It range with old hunky car to slim aerodynamic design.   The speed way just celebrated the 100 year anniversary not long ago. They has a car for photo opportunities. I learn the flag of racing. Green mean go, white is last lap, blue with yellow stripe is passing, yellow is caution, black is mechanical malfunction, red meaning dangerous to continue and stop.

We have seen many Trader Joes at different locations but never have a chance to go into one. The first Trader Joe's we have seen is at Atlanta near the Ah Ma Kitchen a year ago. We were curious what kind of the grocery store is that.  After the nearby UYE event, we have a chance to actually have the first hand experience in this grocery store. The people who has shop there are 70% skinner than me. That tell me the food there is organic, gluten free, or healthy food. My friend warns me about the parking space. It is better to go there at off hours to get a parking. At the entrance they already have some food taste. When you walk into the store, the herb plants are on the side of the entrance. I like mix herb plant because they are the fresh ingredient for cooking. You just need to plug a few of them when you need it for cooking.  The grocery store is not as big as Publix or whole food. But they do carry enough material for cooking. We have bought the Seasoned Rack of Lamb (all natural), Rice drink, Seasoned Kale Chips and the Bacon end tip. The price is reasonable here compare to many place. The end tip bacon is 3.65. After remove the fat, we still have a lot left for the lean meat. The dessert tasting is provided at some time. Some good some tasteless due to too organic ingredients.   I would recommend this place due to the quality, pricing, and healthy living.

Authentic Ethnic Cuisine #49. Southeast Asia Cuisine. Malaysia and Burmese.   I miss my home street vendor food. I found it here at one of the Indianapolis restaurants. A great Hokien Mee is not easy to find. This may be the only one I can find outside of Malaysia. Mee is in Malay. It mean noodle.   I got the dry wonton mee. Most wonton noodle are wet with a lot of soup. Only southeast Asian prepare it dry. The Mee is egg thin noodle cook and mixed with dark sweet soy sauce and sesame oil. They add BBQ pork and wonton. It is sell in Malaysia street food by Chinese descendent. It is very good here. We also got the wet Pan Mee hand made noodle with Burmese touch. They add some dry fried pork fat on top. Very good.   Lastly is the Malay rice goreng. This is fried rice with Malay shrimp paste. Spicy. Very delicious. I have not seen this dish sold elsewhere in the United state. Our visit here is definitely the best. Love it.

Good Bah Mi store. This store located at 49 street north of Park Blvd. it is very close to dense Vietnamese community. They store front indicated buy five Bah Mi and get one free.   I have try their cold cut special. It is combination of many type of meat cold cut. It includes the pork roll. Most important is the liver paste. It is very authentic with the liver paste. The taste is good. Many Bah Mi place only put mayonnaise but this place put liver paste. That is special.   They have boba drink. But I would encourage you to try their Che. It is combination of the jello and bean. I have the Dau Do Banh Lot Suong Sao. It is the red bean, pandan jelly, grass jelly, coconut milk. They were kind enough to add the red tapioca and yellow bean for me. It was delicious.

"Good" as advertised. This place is actually a distance from I-75. You will see nothing along the way then you see a strawberry farm and the production center. They close at 6 pm.   The farm on the west of the compound has a lot of strawberry is growing. Some of them is green. The farm has wide field of strawberry. Certainly this is not just for public but also for production by the scale they have. The welcome center has strawberry for sell. But they are not in pricing. Some of the strawberry we seen is a bit dark red in the box. May be we arrive about 5:15 pm. All the good one already pick up by the visitors.   The have food stand for strawberry short cake and hot dog. There is a lot visitor come to visit. I am guessing because of the strawberry season.

I have this eyes doctor for over 10 years. I see them grow from one store front to two. I am glad to see they won the small business of the year of 2013. This tell a lot from the customer service to their wonderful facility.   I was greet with smile and offer me a coffee or water while waiting for my eyes exam. It did not take long and they call my name since they are by appointment. I like the new technology they have. They no longer dilate your eyes with chemical. All by eye scan equipment. That make my life easy since I can drive home without the dilate eyes.   Dr. Teske is very professional and knowledgeable on his exam. I got my result of my eyes passing all the test. Can beat the healthy eyes.

I have not been in the IHOP for a while. I mean a while is minimum 5 years. We decide to go there have the snack at 10 pm before the cranky night. We have the coupon with free four pancakes.  What I have use to a dish with fried half hen is no longer serve there. The menu is change a lot. It went to tradition American cuisine. I found myself lost looking at the menu. However, they still have different type of crepes in the menu. I love their crepe. That may be the only thing not change. But they did add chicken florentine crepe. I got to try that and they my new found love here. The crepe is cook along side with the wrapping ingredients. The ingredients are chopped chicken breast, spinach, mushroom, onion. These ingredients are stir fry and add on top of crepe then top with Swiss cheese. The cheese melt away and the crepe top with hollandaise sauce. This is creeeeepy day for me. But they are good.   Overall the pricing with the food some good value and some are not. Service is great.

It was great to see new kid in the block. The name of the restaurant is sound interesting. This is actually a fast food set up. The six major things they are serving is wings, fish, shrimp, Philly cheese, burger and fried rice. Food price is in the middle of fast food chain.   There are three different fish you can choose. Whiting, Tilapia or Catfish. The catfish will have a dollar difference. I got the fried shrimp and whiting for $9.99 which includes the drinks. Ok deal. My wife have the Philly cheese steak and the six wings with teriyaki sauce. Cheese steak is good. The chicken is fried correctly. Not much can said about the food. They are not wow factor but does the job. No standout taste.   I do like other than food, you can get specialty drink with boba. We have cappuccino and mango slush. It just need to add the upgrade fees. Overall is good.

La Bahia is new bakery at Bearss and Florida Ave. This is a Latin cafe shop. You can get coffee, sandwich, bake goods and more.   We got the La Tripleta sandwich. It has all kind of meat. The sandwich is delicious. The thing I like the most flan. They have good flan. Got to have one of that. We also got some powder guava pastry. The skin of the pasta just like biscuit break away. Interesting.   The menu is simple to order. But don't forget to look at their daily special. It has some good stuff such as rotisserie chicken and fish stew

For assembly food, they are quite good. This is the newest location of this chain healthy food restaurant. It just open and bring a lot foot traffic to the store. I like the open area and large square footage of the restaurant. The do have limited cook food if you like to try.   We got the superfood bowl. I have the mango passion. This bowl has a choice of base. Several bases to choose including Pitaya, kale or yogurt. I pick ACAi. This bowl has mango, coconut shaving, pineapple and honey. It just like dessert. My wife have the Relax, Eat, and Repeat. What a name. It is a bowl to repeat. I like it because it has the Nutella in it. Other ingredients include banana, strawberry, crush nut, peanut butter and honey. It is a good bowl and well decorated.   Food is decent. I would definitely try some other items in the menu.

I have visited Frog Pond before hurricane Irma. This place is serving hearty breakfast with choice. The place is decorated with a lot frog. It frog all over place. There the reason they call themselves frog pond.   The service is very attentive, you alway can get the waiter attention easily. The coffee alway refill without you notice it. I would recommend you visit this place if you looking for breakfast near the beach. They have complete menu with egg and omelette, egg Benedict, quiche, Belgium Waffles, crepe.   We got the lox Benedict. It is porch egg, smoke salmon, lox salmon, caper, grilled onion, bagel. It come with grit with melted butter. The smoked salmon is delicious and come with great quantity. This is good dish to have for breakfast. The porch egg was make perfect with the egg yolks still in liquid stage.

Our revisit has make me to reevaluate this restaurant. I like to change my opinion review to 3.5 stars. It is not a true 4 stars. The revisit show the restaurant step backwards in compare to the first few months they just open. I am some what disappointed. The nigiri has show increasing of rice and thinner fish cut. The sushi roll is still in good shape but not the best as before. I wonder I am going to revisit this place. Although they have good price for all you can eat but the quality drop. Service is still good.

Origami meaning paper fold art. They have good name for a start to attract customers. Origami Sushi may as well meaning the art of folding the sushi. The pictures that were posted and presentation of the sushi is pleasant.  I got the scorch earth, spicy tuna, and eel avocado. Spicy tuna and the eel avocado is the lunch special with two rolls for $9.45. Those rolls are good deal. I like the tuna is dice in big pieces. Then sauce up with some spiciness. The eel was well presented.  The scorch is their gimmick sushi. I like it because they torch the top of the sushi. Some how I don't like the sauce on top. I don't like their spicy mayo. Too much mayo kind of not match the ingredients. I would rather they slice the sushi instead of dice and put on the top. That way the torch has more flavor over the meat.   It is mix reviews for me. The service can be better. The servers are congregate on the their service aisle instead of pay attention to the customers. This can be improved.

Rare Ethnic food 2 - African cuisine. If you heard about fufu, this place serve this items. It is a starch items that can be commonly found I Africa. This material is pound into flour. The texture is like dough. Very healthy.   The first course we have is the coconut rice with assorted meat. We have the goat, beef and chicken. The meat is cooked in similar to curry paste but is not curry. The meat was cook for a long time and they separated from the bone. Good dish to have.   Our second course is the Egusi Soup. It is a mix of ingredient that I not even know. But it is go well with the fufu. It also has a selection of meat of your choice.   We added puff-puff and moin-moin. Puff- puffins a unique fried dough. Very puffy. The moin- moin is the puréed bean. It is lightly glaze on the outside.  What a experience. This is a 4.5 stars restaurant. Since my wife gave 4 stars, I can give 5 stars to make it 4.5 stars.

Definitely good fast food restaurant. In compare to many fast food, this restaurant is may be top of the list. Right their bowl is my top of the list for bowl under $10 list. I glad someone do it right. I hope they still keep the quality and quantity after one year. Then they are truly 5 stars.   It is order on tablet at the entrance. You can add meat if you like. We got the pesto pasta with grilled chicken. It grilled and chop chicken. The pesto sauce is good and high class restaurant quality. We also got the forza bowl. It is power bowl has a lot of grain. We got the manzo. Most importantly is the cube steak. Medium well steak cook very well. The grain included roast corn, garbanzo, farro, veggies and more. I definitely recommend this bowl. Best value and best taste.   The appetizers is Nutella Piatto. Is thin crush Nutella quesadilla. It is delicious. We like the crispy and the good test. Not much of service. Order is by tablet then they notified you with text message to your cell to be pickup at the counter. There is a curb side pickup.

This is a truly five star restaurant. They deserve to be Yelp top 100 list. I think they should be top10. The restaurant is small. If you come in weekend, please reserve before you go. We were doing the spontaneous restaurant hopping. We were lucky to have the last two seats of the restaurant.   When you walk into the restaurant, you will feel the festival atmosphere of Octoberfest.  The accordion music make it nice and pleasant. He play the familiar tune. I wish the whole restaurant can hold hand like we are in Munich and sing along with the beer on one side. The waitress is very beautiful and very nice. Love the super service here. They are from Munich.   This restaurant serves the Bavarian region food of Germany and very similar to the food that we have visit in Black Forrest of Germany.  We have the Veal Schnitzel with mushroom sauce. It is delicious!!!! It come with two side. We have the handmade noodle Spaetzle and the hot potato salad. The potato salad has some ham crump to go with it. Hmmmmmm. Are you hungry now? Go enjoy a dish a meal here. I also have the import beer - Paulaner Octoberfest. It is good beer.

Taco. Yes they do serve that. They also has the mixed in bowl. I would said the mixed in is not the the Mexican anymore. It is more into fusion. It is first new concept for the Mexican cuisine.   I have order the bowl instead go to their taco. Actually I am not a fan of bowl here. The surrounding area already have many bowl systems restaurants. I got the two proteins with fried chicken and fried shrimp. I have guacamole rice and noodles as the base. The veggies are the Brussels sprouts and grilled broccoli. The topping is pineapple and cucumber cilantro.   The restaurant did attract a lot young crowd. The bowl is just average for the quantity. I can see the bottom of the bowl. So it is not cheap either with the quantity they have. Good for quick lunch. Other than that, no wow factor.

All about Taco - the Mexican fast food.   I have seen Anna in and out this restaurant many times. My wife has some take out at this place when she visit West Tampa Library. For me I only eat the take out until I try it with friends a few days ago.   They are certainly above the average taco joint. Other than their typical menu item, they have their special on the board. Today I have the Camaron, Pescado, Barbacoa and Carne tacos. The Camaron is the grilled shrimp. It is good but a bit over grilled. The Pescado is the tilapia fish. This is the best I have today. It is well grilled and season. The Barbacoa is bbq beef Mexican styles. It is a lot of spice ingredients. It is good. The carne is the steak taco. It is above average.   Food overall is good. I like the chip with spicy salsa. This restaurant is cafeteria style and the food come out quick.

During the pandemic, this store put practice of the national guidelines to use. Before you come to fit your glasses, you need to make an appointment. The reason they want appointment is to adhere the Coronavirus guidelines to limit less than 10 people in the store. As a result appointment is important. People who walk in, if the store has more than ten people, they are ask to leave and make appointment. This is an A for the store.   While I waited, the waiting chair is set 6 feet apart. While you waited, they will come to take your touchless temperature check for fever. They also ask the series of questions if you have exposure to Coronavirus. This is an A.   Before you get up to select your glasses frame, they ask you to wear the gloves before touch any glass frame. The frame you touch, they ask you not to put it back. They also disinfect each table counter before new customers. This prevention method should be use for next phrase business opening. Each employee wearing mask.   During this difficult time, this business done a very good job.

This probably my fourth visit to the restaurant. They are very consistent on the food preparation. For all the food we have tasted, other than the grilled meat, the rest of the item are well prepared. I have not try their Jungsik yet - combination of everything. That will be my list next time.   We have group today to try the Korean marinated fried chicken, bibimbob, Kimbab, Seafood Soon-doobu. The best of the night is the Korean marinated fried chicken. The marinated sauce is very interesting. It has the good mixed into the fried chicken. I also like the Soon-doobu. It is soft tofu stew in hot pot. It come very temperature hot with bubble boiling hot. Nice mix of seafood inside. Soft to taste. Bibimbob is rice assembly with beef in hot stone pot.   Overall is very good. Not a wow factor but definitely above average. Very close to Korean street food.

This the most cleanest ALDI I have been to. The neighborhood also nicer. I like to shop here. This is my friend Rachel neighborhood. I like the Italian prosciutto the sold here. It is delicious. The bacon selection has many type. The Appleton bacon is my favorite because they have more meat than fat.   They do have the pink lady grape. It is a good one. Strawberry and raspberry is red and fresh looking. I also like their cheap wine selection for cooking. The hot deli is great.   I like aisle is big and wide. Although the put in the direction, many of the customers did not follow the order. They man the entrance when inside the store get crowded. They should always improve on the number of checkout cashiers. Because the faster they checkout, the wait to enter the store will be faster.

Fancy place to dine. It has a good decorations and great entrance. The salad bar is impressive. With beautiful center decorations arrangement. It is very busy in week day.   We got into second seating. Our dinner start at 8 pm. Which is perfect for all you can eat. I like the salad bar many item including hearts of Palm, shrimp salad, grill pineapple, and more. I have the lobster bisque at the end of meal. But not impress on it. No shrimp or lobster.   The meat went on when they bring it to the table. The sirlion and the skirt steak are the best. That all. The rest are too salty. I could not taste the meat. If you pay $$$$ money, the steak or lamb should be better. No fireworks.   Service is great, meat are below average, salad is good. Been here done that.

I am glad that a just newly opened restaurant reopen for the take out. This restaurant open just before the pandemic. During the pandemic, I was not able to call them for they are open for take out because they not able to reach through the phone. Until recently they announced in Yelp they open for take out.   Although we could not try their in store BBQ on the Korean BBQ, but one day we will be there. In the mean time, we appreciate they proceed with take out menu for us to try their food. We got the bulgogi and galbi plate. This dish come with white rice and four side dish. I like Korean side dish such as the tasty beans sprouts and the Korean fish cake.   The Galbi has great marinated sauce. Well grilled, good meat quality, good enough quantity. The food is good for me to

Come here for the special deal that saw from beach. Their beach banner toll by the plane work. It does attract me to visit. Monday to Thursday and mention the plane advertising got $5 on appetizer before 4 pm. It is a steal. Monday also is $5 margarita. Come Monday is a good day at this restaurant. Restaurant is a walk to the beach. Parking across the street is convenient.  For the special, we got the peel shrimp, coconut shrimp, and wings it. The half pound peel shrimp is boil and top with old bay seasoning. There are about 10 medium size shrimp. The coconut shrimp is six of them. I also like the wings with teriyaki sauce. All items are delicious. Margarita is Hemingway Margarita with top shelf tequila.   We enjoy our time there with less than $25 for all food and drinks we have. Love the deal.

This restaurant was recommended by a friend. I would said they have groove of the food in their menu. They are not typical food you fine. They serve Columbian cuisine with some specialty of their own.   We have the Sobrebarriga and the Pargo Rojo Frito. Sobrebarriga is the Creole Flank Steak in "tio" sauce. It is yellow sauce with yuca and sweet plantains on the side. This flank steak is braise proper and tear the meat in string.   My wife dish is the Pargo Rojo Frito - the fried whole snappers. The fish is very fresh and crispy. The batter that applies to fish has been mix with spice and they are very good. Love the crispy taste with flavors.   Overall our dishes is very good. I also has a Guanabana as a juice drink to go with the meal. It is refreshing.

Authentic Ethnic Cuisine #62. Indian Cuisine.   This cafe is located in the Grocery store. It has it seating area and business location. The place is clean. What I like about is they have the wash hand area if you decide traditional way use your hand to eat. There is a water station for you.   We started with the chicken wing drums stick. It was delicious. We also got the lamb chop. The meat was process and it is not tough to bite. The meat still present some pink area which is great technique to keep the chop delicious. We also got the veggies curry puff. It was delicious too. My friend got the dosa. It has potatoes inside. It also come with curry soup to dip. It look very decent.   Lastly is the mutton biryanis. The mutton is soft and good curry surround it. The rice is perfect. The food may have prepared in one tone of spicy level. I actually like it that way. It is indian food after all.

About 3.5 stars. Since the service measured up beyond the standard, 4 stars is given. Cooper Hawk has good wine collection. We did not try their wine because it was business lunch and need to get back to work. We were here for lunch and surprised the dining hall is almost full. Service is excellent even with so many customers. This is a plus.   We started with their pretzels bread. This is great bread to have. When you hear the name of pretzel, you may think this will be tough bread to bite. But it turn out very good.   My entree is the carne asada taco with tortilla soup. I think they need to work on this dish. The steak feel like cut and sit for some time. You can see the steak is dry compared to fresh cut steak. The soup is good. My friend has the Ellie Chicken Piccata. His dish is better. It accompanying with pasta and asparagus.

It is good to see new branch from Outback Steak House. It want to serve like fast food as for the new concept. Unfortunately their food preparation not fast at all. I have to wait for 15 minutes after order. There is no line on order. But there is a line to wait for the food. This part of business may need to improve.   Aussie Grill open their business in food court of the Brandon Westfield Mall. It has advertisements at the entire hallways of the mall. It does get a lot of attention from mall goers. I got the seared beef tenderloin and crispy volcano shrimp. I got it medium rare. For the beef. The meat quality is a bit better than average. But I don't like the seared technique. I prefer grilled. Grill will enhance the taste. I do like their volcano shrimp. It was done right.

Long Phung open on the thanksgiving day. I have book mark for some time and here I am. If you want to try some Vietnamese food that is not typical serve on normal menu, this may be your place.   I am glad they open at thanksgiving that we can visit. The restaurant did not look much on out side until you walk in the restaurant. They have good size of space. Their menu is huge. Too many item to select. Even the drink menu give you a challenge since there are many selections. I have order a fruit jam with jelly and basil seed. I like this drink since it has many fruits in it and flavor basil seed.   The appetizer we have order the fried chicken wing ($3.99) good value. Tasty too. The main courses include sautéed baby clam with rice chip, 7 combinations plate and the Bun Bo Hue. I like sautéed baby clam and I think they are special. Even the seven meat combination look good. The whole plate have eleven items.

Good Italian restaurant. Just need more customers during the lunchtime. I was here after the project visit nearby. This restaurant seem like old and established. It is the anchor store for the plaza.   I was interested on their grouper. However, they only have cod or salmon. So I got the lunch special cod. It come with soup. I have Italian wedding to begin. Their soup have some green and sausage. It is not the traditional wedding soup but good enough.   The cod is coating with some kind of panko. It has crispy crust. The fish is definitely fresh. It has good separation when break the fish meat. It has the wonderful firmness and not fishy. This dish come with a choice of pasta. I got penne pasta with pesto sauce. It is delicious. I did not know that pesto is also cook with nut in it until my friend told me about.   Overall is good restaurant. Medium service.

It is one of the restaurant want to visit before they may be close in the future. I like this restaurant farm to table using the great quality of material to prepare the food. Great eat come great responsible of the chef. This place is not cheap. However the the food do measure up with the price.   I have the Meyer Farm Prime Skirt Steak. This dish come with grilled veggies- mini carrot, shallot, potatoes. It also has some sweet purée sauce for the steak. The purée taste like sweet steak sauce. The steak was well prepared to the the asking temperature. It is tender. They provide enough cut of the meat.   My wife dish is much better. She has the Squid Ink Tagliatelle. This is pasta dish. The pasta is flat but made with squid ink. Very unique. The sauce of the pasta fennel Sofrito with Florida Pink Shrimp. Sauce is excellent and tasty. I would definitely recommend this dish.

Cool riverside park walk along the park and river. This Hillsborough River flow along the location make the strolling or jogging very desirable. The scenery ever changes along the river make this prime location. The house along the park has clear view toward the river and the park.   We were here because live orchestra music in the park. Because it close to holiday, they play the Christmas and holiday music. Very pleasant. The park also is a home for canoeing and rolling boat area. There was boat parade when we visited the park. Children are roaming like not limit.   There plenty tree cover for open air concert. The gazebo serve as a stage for the presentation. Love the Santa make available to the kid and old kid like me. It was great to see old friends from Yelp in a surprise meeting in the park.

The begin of Sweet Bun I have try is at Gainesville. Since I have been to many oriental bakery, I would place this one a bit above middle of the pack. It is similar to Sweet Hut at Atlanta. It definitely cannot compare to Sweet Hut near Gwinnett Place at Atlanta but it definitely hold it own for Tampa Bay Area.   They have sweet and salty bun on display. It is perfect location near USF. It is great to have bun for breakfast with lesser price. Even if you come for lunch, it is better than the choice of fast food. A bowl noodle definitely better than fast food with same price.   The only thing they lack off is they need special drinks like fruit tea, boba tea, and WiFi. We were here for their pig feet noodle and the wonton noodle. Not the best but good enough.

It is a 5 stars performance. Price, taste, quantity, and quality is reach it perfect condition. I would recommend this restaurant to a friend. Thanks to Brigitte's review and notice this restaurant six months ago. Finally we have a chance to visit. Love it.   I got a fruit juice in water. It was delicious to start. Today they have tripe soup with beef. It is cook till everything is soft. The spice was marinated into the tripe. Our main dish is Breaded steak with rice and fried cassava. The breaded coating has some seasoning spice. It the best Colombian breaded steak I have. It is big piece.   Our next dish is Bandeja di Mi Tierra. It has skirt steak, chicharron, chorizo, sweet plantain, creole potatoes. This is big combination dish. It has great churrasco. The the steak is well seasoning. The chicharron is very crispy and is not tough to bite. I like this dish have a lot to offer.   Server are very friendly. They also serve breakfast.

Good BBQ place for smoking BBQ. Jazzy is one of my friends favorite (Howard and Lori). Thanks to their share that we know about this place. I glad that they still doing well during pandemic. It is definitely a good place to hangout.   We got King of kings. This combo is the best deal. You got to choose 5 types of meat with 2 small sides and sauce. We got the rib, chicken, sausage, pork, beef. It is good selection. The side we have is the collards green and the BBQ baked beans. The rib is is delicious. The chicken is juicy, the sausage is tasty. I like the baked bbq bean. It great to have.   Overall our experience is good. I like the smoky flavor. The did a good job on the meat.

It is better than I expected. Very competitive fried chicken place. The place is newly open and have good interior. The booth seating area was separated by plastic shield glass. Employees wear mask.   I got the farm fried chicken with Baja Spicy fried chicken sandwich. The coating was well prepared. When you order spicy, you can notice the spicy powder between the coating and the chicken. The bacon on the chicken is thick, crispy, and a lot of lean meat. The only comment I want to make is their drink is too expensive. The cup probably 70% ice before they fill with actual ice. I got the pineapple, coconut, cherry flavor drink. I would said skip it if they fill most the cup with ice and not fill to the top.   Food was deliver to table after order. I like service. May be they just newly open, they paid a good attention to the customers.

Pinellas Park has the best MD Oriental Market in the Bay Area. It is as well as best oriental market in center florida too.   The market has some sit down area after you buy the food from the deli and you can enjoy immediately. The deli section is big and the selection do change over time. You can get the oriental bakery from this deli too. The market aisle is clearly mark and wide when two carts are met.   They have great select of the dry goods and starch. If you want to start a restaurant of your own, they have sauces you can get for the Asian cuisine. Of course, please do not discount the yummy munchies.   They also have good selection of rice wine if you want to use it for drinking or cooking. High grade sake sold here with exterior of the rice was removed and fermented.  They have good dessert you can take home or on the road. Try their sponge cake.

This is not you normal Latin food. It has special items you may want to explore. They have something that I don't have before. This food truck also serve some Italian pasta. But their specialty is really the Dominican street food. They have plenty items to try.   We got pinchofongo. It is strange street food. The inside can be chicken or pork. We pick the marinated grilled pork. This dish the pork is wrapped the fresh plantains outwardly. Then it deep fried. This dish is good with finger eating. It was delicious.   Other than pinchofongo, they have the Yaroa, Mangu, and salchipapa. All this are rare ethnic food. If you do go, the area have a lot food trucks to try.

I enjoy the first restaurant found open after the Florida reopen for business. We were at the field project and need to have the meal while we were out from home or office. We drove pass the Bloomingdale area and decided to try any restaurant who are open. Acropolis was open the business after we Korean the door are find out.   I think most of the restaurant who open for business need to mention an Opening word big at their front door. Because we still see 50% of the restaurant still close. The waiter is smart to seat us at the corner of the restaurant to let people outside see the restaurant is actually open.   We got the Athenian fish and kabob. The Athenian fish is lightly bread and grilled. The fish may need a big salt. But overall is ok. The kabob is much better. The grilled technique is good. Well mar

We know about this Japanese restaurant for long time. We did not make it there until now. I have seen friend celebrate her birthday there. Now I know why she choose this place.   This restaurant seem like mom and pop shop and may be a generation restaurant. We were here for lunch. We start with 3 rolls combo sushi lunch special. This dish has volcano roll, California roll, and fried fish roll. All pieces is delicious. It come with great ginger salad. I like the ginger dressing. The second dish is the Tempura udon. The udon and Tempura are separated. Each one can be a meal by its own. The Tempura has the shrimp and fried veggies. The udon has a bit fried bit root in the soup. Make it good dipping sauce for the Tempura. This is my first order combination Tempura and udon in single one dish. Love it.   Overall they are 4.5 stars in my book. Good service. Finish lunch less than 40 minutes. It is make for office hour limit.

This is about 3 stars restaurant.   The restaurant is in the deep side of the Amberly Plaza. The day I visit, they have the Kong Skull Island preview ticket with purchase of food. The restaurant has good capacity for number of people. They have the walk in order or sit down order.   We order the lasagna and the curry chicken. The chicken came with the salad. The amount of food given is a lot. The curry base is almost like middle eastern spice. It not my liking. However, it does have enough chicken. The curry sauce may be need to marinated into chicken. The lasagna sauce is lean into the sweet side.   The service is good. Seem like many people come in today for the same ideal. Get a free ticket to movie. Overall the dinning hall is 80% fill up. Food delivery is on point.

I would said their attractive food are actually at the appetizer. They are located on the new plaza. The place and interior are nice. It has good open space for dining. The thing is lack off is the parking. Even though there are some parking on the front. Most of the diner time, these spaces are taken. You may have to park on the neighborhood street.   We start with fresh house made guacamole. I said this dish is ok. Our second app is the Puerto Escondido Seafood Ceviche. Puerto Escondido is at the south west coast of Mexico at Oaxaca region. The ceviche is good. The shrimp is tiny shrimp. I rather have larger shrimp and chop in pieces. Our third dish is the Ancho Seared Ahi Tuna Wonton Taco. The tuna is seared and dust with pepper corn. It stuffed in the fried wontons skin and top with home made wasabi paste. The fish accompanied with salad will mixed with edamame. Our fourth dish is the Blue Crab Tortilla Crust Crab Cake. It is good crab cake.   My friend has the blue Chan dinner plate. I think they do need to work on the dinner dish. Services is below average. When the waitress want to joke, do not spill water over the table. It is not good impression. It is 3.5 stars in my book.

The actual name of the restaurant is La Gloria Mexican Restaurant. It has Latin dish. But more into Mexican cuisine. The restaurant is quite on the opening hour. During that time, the English communication is limited until a manager show up. But the store clerk is friendly. They allow me to taste what I don't understand in the menu.   I have carne Asada Plate. This dish come with grilled steak in Mexican marinated sauce. It also accompanied with rice and baked fried bean. The bean was well done. The steak is so so. I also got two tacos. One with the grilled tilapia and the other is grilled shrimp. Both of them look flat on taste. Not much of grilled mark.  Food is average. But they do have some other authentic dish. May be try those. They do have their daily specials on the board. Check those out.

It is established Italian restaurant with family style of share plate. Love the way family style food to enjoy with group of friend. It is above the average Italian restaurant but below the Gourmet Italian. However, I like the setting with full bar capabilities. I have been to Maggiano before my Yelp time. This return give me a good excuse to review this restaurant.   They have several private room for family eating. Some of this room has private bar if you want to have open bar. All this room can be link to big banquet hall.   We start with Caesar salads and the Maggiano salad. The Maggiano salad carry more weight and better flavor. They include crispy prosciutto taste like bacon.  Which make this salad the best. We have family style dish including Six cheese, Rigatoni, carbonara chicken, Tilapia. All this dish are delicious. The closing included the tiramisu and brownie ice cream.   Overall experience is good. Love the private room and family style.

Thai and Sushi place. Many variety. It includes the Thai food. This sushi place look like Thai chef prepares the sushi. They are well train for their sushi preparation. The place is big with a lot of seat including the bar area.   I am here during lunch at weekends for their lunch special. They have some good selection for their sushi. I got their Atom Bome and Caterpillar. I forgot the last roll I got. The lunch special is about 70% cheaper than their regular price. However, the pieces also cut to 6 pieces instead of 8 pieces. As a result is not much of saving. Why they need a lunch special then. Might as well said lunch reduce pieces.   Service is good. But I think I always feel be watch during eating. Sushi is just average. Sauce is a bit too much. As a result, they are rated at average.

If you have a dairy problem and love ice cream, you will love this place. It is dairy free ice cream place. It is also the vegan ice cream place. It is a mystery to see what in it and what kind of flavor they serve. We were here walk by and decided to explore. Love the concept with dairy free. I was wondering how it taste without dairy.   We got the matcha latte and the divine chocolate. It proof itself without dairy ingredients, the taste still can be achieved. The matcha latte has good taste with coconut flakes in it. It is delicious. The divine chocolate has good chocolate taste with rich in flavor. Both scoop are delicious. No taste try. But definitely worth the ice cream in every flavor.

If talking about street food. This food truck have it. Most Puerto Rican food are mofongo, but rarely about their street food. This owner of food truck from Puerto Rico, they came to United State for better life. They brought local street food with them.   We got the Alcapurrias. It is Puerto Rico traditional dish with green banana dough with meat. The version we got is the Corned Beef con Amarillos. The outward is corn beef and the inside is sweet plantain. It shape like corn dog. Very interesting. Our second item is the empanadilla jueyes. It is crab meat empanadas. They use real blue crab meat. Very similar to Cuban devil crab but it is empanadas.   Both dishes are great. The order do take some time. While you waiting for your order, you can go visit other food truck.

New Tampa has a new interesting grocery store. Taaza is new kid in the block provide the indian grocery choices to shop other than the typical grocery store. Price is affordable for the people who shop here. This is one of the kind. The space is huge.   They have divided into several sections. The rice section has different rice. Basmati rice is one of the kind. Other included brown rice and Aromatic Kalijeera rice. I never have the Kalijeera rice. It is short grain. The produce section includes fresh veggies, fruit, ground produce like potatoes. They also have long shaped eggplant, baby cucumber, lychee, longan, and more.  They ready to eat section provide convenient for the young people to take home or stop by their cafe to pickup the food you like. The meat market is per your order meat cut. They also has the cheese, ready pre cut food to be cook at home. The sweet section is very tempting.

This Mexican restaurant has inside and outside seating. The outside seating area is to accommodate the customers who smoke or with dog. The bar area is at inside serve extensive drink menu with TV. You can enjoy a gameplay there at football season.  I got the Steak Monterrey. This is skirt steak marinated with and grilled. It accompanied with rice and stuff poblano pepper top with habanero pesto sauce. The stuffing is with shrimp, mushrooms, onion over melted cheese. The stuffing is actually my favorite. However, the main item skirt steak is very tough just to cut. It take me a good 3 minutes to chew a small piece. Meat quality is not that good. It the meat quality improved, this restaurant has potential.   There is plenty server on the floor. You always can get their attention. Service is good. Not sure about the drink. Seem like each waiter prepared their drink order which tell me no set bartender.

I have been to Sanwa Market for many time. It is whole sale store that not required the membership. It big benefits to the people in Tampa. You can find many low cost item for day to day use or cooking ingredients.   Be prepared to walk in the veggies and meat section of the store. It is cool temperature to keep those food fresh. So a sweater may be helpful to shop in there. They have the fruits section in the veggies area. Many to choose from including the dragon fruit.   Many of the drink and daily use cooking non perishable food are coming in big package. Can goods are in good selection. The special drink also can be found here that imported from other countries.   The check out is easy. Bring your own shopping bags is a good ideal. Parking may be crazy when there are a lot patron visiting.

The food may be 3.5 stars, however the price match what they selling. Overall is 4 stars. Cheddar secret is affordable price for many and good enough food. It fit into the demographics of The Wesley Chapel. It is really do not matter about the rating. It is about right price for right food.   I am at the bar area enjoy my dinner for the Sunday night football on TV. I started with the Texas Swirl Margarita. It is beautiful drink with enough frozen frozen drink over strawberry. My entree is the New Orlean Pasta. This dish come with sausage, chicken and shrimp. This dish serve over penne pasta and Cajun Alfredo sauce. It is big dish if you are hungry.   The service on bar is average. Can be better. Food came out quick. Not much of wait. I like the drinks with different cocktails.

Bar Louie is more open connecting to outdoor. But I do not like darker corner when you seat inside. This bar is second stop on our progressive happy hour tour.   We started with fried calamari. The calamari is a bit tasteless because the coating is not interesting. May be make more floppy and spice with be more attractive. The second item is the chicken quesadilla. This is more interesting. But still this two item are not attractive enough in compare to nearby happy hour restaurant. However I do like the martini. Their signature martini during the happy hour is very good. I have the Diva martini. I like that one.   I think the drink is better than the food. They really need to work on the food to attract more customers during happy hour.

About 3.5 stars. We visited at 5:30 Friday, the line has not build up yet. We were able to get a table inside. There is not much of service. The person who take order is a bit slow. He just sit at register for taking order but still slow. The kitchen crew are more alert. They got your order and fried the chicken immediately.   The Nashville style chicken is using wet batter coating systems. Most of the fried chicken place use dry powder battering then fried immediately. This place have coating mixed with spice and wet it with water. The chicken then dip into the wet coating and fried. This system is more challenging. The Chinese fried chicken is like this system. Why they are 3.5 stars is because the coating getting compact and concentrated. Which mean the oil is old and repetitive fried. The fresh oil or change the oil so often will make the chicken better coating.   One best thing is the seasoning and the Nashville hot is very well receptive. This is not like Asian hot that numb you mouth and could not taste the food. The hot is acceptable by many Americans. You still can taste the hot heat and the food in the right amount of chili. This I would give them an "A". Price is about most fried chicken place. But I do like their fried and the pickle. It was good.

Our car was bringing here for tire replacement and alignment. This is their expertise. I would recommend if you need to change the tire, might as well purchase the life time alignment. In the long run, it will save you money down the road. After four alignment, it will worth your money for the lifetime alignment.   They have 40000 to 65000 mile tire. Lower mile tire  usually is 40 percent less price. Which is more value since most tire need to be replaced eventually. You can ask their road hazards protection.   I cannot said for other car repair. But for tire and alignment is good. You can make appointment to lesser the wait time. You also can call them to how busy they are before bringing the car. So far we have good experience with them.

I have been United Airline since I don't know when. Many time is business travel. Only a few time are leisure travel. Most tickets I bought are they have the cheaper among the top airlines.   They are comfortable enough on seat you can upgrade for more room. Usually they give credit for other flight if their plane got cancel. Most of my flight with them are on time. Sometimes they have other airlines combine plane which is out of their control.  I alway like their plane. Today we have Boeing 737 the interior design is very nice. It also has head set retaining so if you fall asleep not leaning to your neighbor. After the plane overhead compartments is retracted, the plane interior room become larger for walking. It has blue overhead light to guide you during the dark hour.

This Apple store open a few day ago. They finally ready for the customers. All walk in will need to be checked for temperatures. A mask will be issued before enter the store. If the line is long. They will set up appointment at the spot and have you come later. Our appointment was 50 minutes later. So we went to eat and come back for the appointment.   We were here to get apple SE with trade in. My wife pick the fire red color. Nice color. The store clerk was professional. While we were in there, six feet is maintained. Our trade in was easy. And we get an unlocked iPhone. With the purchase of iPhone, we got a Apple TV free for a year. We were able to transfer all data before we hand over the phone. The transition was easy.   So far we have good experience on this store. The transaction was easy.

Great sandwiches shop at Wesley Chapel / Lutz area. It is hidden gem in this location. Very close to 4.75 stars. Definitely worth the try and return for more. The restaurant clerk is very friendly. They did give us try on their squeeze juice.   We got the Serranito sandwich. This sandwich come with prosciutto ham on the egg. It also has grilled green pepper which is delicious. This almost like breakfast item but it is eye pleasing. We also got some item from seafood section. The Lobster on Cuban. I have Cuban sandwich before, but a lobster Cuban is the first time. The sandwich did pack with lobster. Then it is press like Cuban sandwich. Highly recommended. The sweet chili sauce accompanied well.   Overall we like this place. It has seafood sandwich, pork, poultry, beef sandwich. Got to try them all. Kid menu also available. Try their fresh squeezed juice. Side item includes conch fritters, cod fritters, empanadas, stuffed potatoes ball are also delicious.

Awesome best walk that the City of Tampa can offer within the city. City planners have the vision since 1970 when they have this prime location. The current finish phase is below Kennedy bridge phase that connect from Water Work Park to the Channelside.   Thank to the people who working in the city and leadership from many Mayors that provide the city with a world class place for the people. Along the river walk create the economic impact, social impact, healthy living, access, cultural and art district in this revitalized waterfront. The restaurant, museum, downtown resident, and park are all connected. It has made the downtown such as successful living area after dark.   The new completed phase below the Kennedy Bridge is best section to enjoy. The entrance can be start from the Curtis Hixon Water Front Park. Other accesses are connected to Sheraton of the Riverwalk and MacDill Park. The MacDill Park has some of the parking spot and they gain access directly to Kennedy Riverwalk section. The parking at downtown after 6 pm is free and you can enjoy the sunset and wait for the deco light turn on. The new section is elevated bridge structure over the Hillsborough River has invited the beautiful scene of the Tampa. I can see people Kayak at night, jogging on the bridge, bicycling, taking pleasure walk. Old and young are enjoying it. When pass under the Kennedy Bridge is bridge under bridge make the change of the scenery from one side of town to the other side.  With many feature that the down town can offer, may be one day I will be the resident in this area. This place is beautiful and breathe taking.

People Dedicated to Quality (PDQ) - what a company mission. This is a concept that actually drawn people to visit. In a way, they also need to measure up with what they stand for.   The PDQ is really clean and pleasant. I like the open space. Everything is in the organized order. Service is nice. The head chef watches quality of food before send out. Very good quality control.   I have their new product - Tropic Sizzle. It is the new grilled Hawaiian sandwich. It come with grilled chicken, bacon, grilled slice pineapple, pepper jack cheese. Mmm good to fit into my mouth. I have the zucchini fried on the side. The meal deal is good. Just the sandwich is a bit small.   We also have 4 pieces chicken tenders. I have ginger berry sauce. This go well. The drink touch screen selection. It with a lot of choices.

Very close to 4.5 stars. The reason behind is their food has good flavor, good chef technique, use balance spice. They are in the right track. Although they have few thing need to be improved, this restaurant is a promising restaurant to make it.   We have group of 5 and the we were second group there because we arrive before 11:30 am just to avoid the wait of previous Yelper comment. I have order the grilled pork chop lunch special and our group each have different dish - pad Thai, Pad see wee, stir fry beef. This very much to try different skill of the chef. My order was not correct provided. They bought out the grilled beef instead of pork chop. I ask them not to change it. The grilled beef is perfect grilled. The chef paid attention on the grilled. My friend their stirred fry dish.   A few things need to improve is read the order back to customer to make sure order is right. Remember the drink order to be bring out and don't wait for customers to remind the server. Lunch hour need to be quick on response because most of the people need to get back to work.

What can I say. My wife favorite store. She feel young when she walk in the store and so as me :). Just get the credit card ready in ice, because it get smoking hot soon.   I would said be a smart shopper. Check out different H&M for different clothing on sale in Bay Area. This may be one of them. I can find $3 to $15 sale in this store easily. The clearance with mark down. That is the reason that you need to check it in different seasons and different stores to look for items you like. I have take some photo on sales items this time. If you want to catch it, now is the time.   H&M originated from Europe. We saw a lot of their store at the Europe street. They have more selection than US. Our area is catching up. You alway can find the bargain in this store. If not, wait till next visit.

It is very interesting bar near the Indian Rock Beach. The day we have visited was the the day of bar crawl. I saw many patrons dressed like pirates. It interesting day see some great makeup.   With Yelp check in, there is complimentary onion ring with beer batter coating. We have order peel shrimp, fried calamari, and grilled haddock. The fried calamari coating is fluffy and good. Is was good enough size to share. The peel shrimp was broil with seasoning. Shrimp is fresh and bouncy. The haddock is just average. It grilled with seasoning on top. I rather it no seasoning. The fish is just ok. I had better elsewhere.   I biggest concern is we can see the food sit on the counter for Good 5 minutes and no one bring it to us. Until we make known to waitress, she has compensated with free dessert. The dessert is the highlight of the evening. We have the sunshine cake with orange flavor. It was wonderful. The restaurant chef skill is just average. Can be improved.

It was great visit when I attend an invite from a friend. The restaurant is situated very nicely at the water. The outside deck area is perfectly facing the west. It is great to view the sunset from here while enjoy your meal. It can be good romantic date night spot.   There is live music on the outside deck area. Tonight we started with coconut shrimp and Calamari which are in the happy hour items. They also have the pork Slider for the special. The Calamari is below average. The coconut shrimp and pork Slider is better.   My entrée is the grilled hog snapper. This dish come as whole fish and debone the center fish bone. Very good chef skill to maintain the whole fish without bone. The fish is like butterfly cut and grilled in blacken.  If they use the Cajun blacken will be more superior. Anyhow, this is already a good dish and come with broccolini and top with salsa.   The service can be improved. Pay more attention to the table will be great. Occasionally check need to be often. This about 3.5 stars in my book.

Mission Complete!!!!  The Grand Opening is great and run smoothly. Although the staff is not familiar the entire menu but they are well train. Smiling at all time and check on you.   The sampler is the best way to tried their BBQ with lesser cost. Pricing is average with the amount of food was given. The sampler allow you to choose two or three meat sampler. Or you can have your own combination by adding quarter pound of each meat items.   Today I have baby back rib and the brisket. The brisket has a choice of moist or lean meat. I would suggest moist is the way to go. The rib cook till fall off the bone. They are still juicy and yummy. I also like their sausage and turkey. Seasoning has reach the inner turkey.   You can make it a combo by adding single side or two sides. All come with drink. I have green bean bacon a southern dish.

This place is always busy base on the yelper photo and review. We were there at 5:20 pm and we were second in the line. I guess, this is the best time to visit. The restaurant has very limited space if you decide to dine in. They only can seat 15 the most.  Since they are number 1 in the top 100 list, we decided to try them. They have good selection of taco. We have the ribeye, campechano, shrimp, pastor, carnitas, chorizo, and lengua. This strange name but who care. The most important is they good or not. The lengua is the cow tongue.   The only complaint I have is they need to caramelized a bit will make it better.  My wife like the most is carnitas. It is sherrard or simmering pork. She indicate to me is better than the mojo pork.   The food do not require to wait for too long to prepared. It is a bit expensive than most taco place. It is cafeteria service order at the counter and they bring it to you.

I think this Thai food has potential. It is at good location. The thing need to improve is the wok technique. Other than that, the interior decoration, furniture and service is measured up to 4 stars.   We started with squid Tom yum soup. Their Tom yum is lean to sweet side instead of sour. The soup is good. We order the Siam Noodle. This is their house special sauce with shrimp and chicken stir fry rice noodle. I think they are just average if this is a house dish. Not attractive.   We also order a drunken noodle. We order Thai hot but it is not measured up the heat. The noodle not even burn the edge show this stir fry is not quite high heat with oil. Basically they need improvement. If the cuisine can improve, they will be good Thai here in compare to Bay Area Thai food.

The wing place is rather new in the Temple Terrace. Their wings is about $0.70 per wing which is considered very affordable in the area in comparison to wing place around that area. Their wing choice includes dry rub and tossed sauce with flavor.    Although the wing is good price but they are tiny on some of them. Not much complaint about it because they charge you less.   I got the dry rub Parmesan garlic, dry rub Cajun, tossed sauce mangonero. Total of 20 pieces for $14.95. It is football season, wings are essential. The tossed sauce I can live without it. The dry rub is a bit better. The dry rub is not the actual rub on the wing. It is dry sauce tossed with the wing. I like Parmesan garlic better than the Cajun. If they actually dry rub and oven will be better.   With the competition around their area is tough for them. They some good wing around the area. They need to do something about the process of the wing and how to cook it.

This restaurant has high ratings. Consider one of the popular in the area. During lunch time, the restaurant is pack. They are not too far from Highway I-275, as a result I stop here for lunch.   I got the traditional dish. I got the Bandeja Paisa. It typical Columbian dish with samples of all cooking. The dish includes grilled steak, sausage, chicharron (fried pork belly with skin), sunny side up egg, arepa, rice and bean, avocado, and sweet plantain. This is to show case the entire cuisine.   Why three stars. The steak not even close to warm. The sausage is powdery. The egg yolk over cook. It is not liquidity. The best of the dish is the chicharron.  It is crispy and good.   The service is great. It is not bad at all for the price of the dish $13.50. The service is good. If the cooking can improve, they can be easily 4 stars.

It is an interesting Lao's grocery store. I was hope to get some cook food deli like it show on the store front. Seem like the deli did not operate. We enjoy our shopping there. We pick up few item we have not seen before.   We got crispy fish chip. Interesting looking. They do have meat department. You can get all pig intestines, stomach or kidney in this store. The store also have some homemade dessert you can pick up. The veggies section is small but sufficient. A lot of frozen seafood.   Overall this market is small. We like some item we have not try before. Good experience.

This is prime location for dog. This area is high visible location to set a dog park. May be due to the prime area near the river, the park was set up as small area for dog. It has an river walk with small park for our four leg friend.   This park close at 10 pm. But still the door is not lock. Dog still can go in and play just no light at that time. It is good to have dog brought in for the big Curtis Hixon park and stroll along the river walk. The ground has some amenities for dog play.

Jimmy is a popular place in YBOR. Many old customers came here for taco. Also, they have have their parking lot which make very convenient to customers especially in YBOR. The restaurant only has out side seating. May in summer is a bit challenging even they have some cover roof.   I have the the three taco two pork Texan style taco. And one flour steak taco. I like both of them. The steak taco is highly recommended. The thin slice the steak and grilled them chop. It is good ideal to do it that way because maintain the texture of the steak.

This is the first gas station exit for I-275 northbound after Sunshine Skyway. If you need gas after the long bridge, this is the place. Price is reasonable by considering this is at the southern part of the Pinellas County. You may guess they can charge arm and leg but they did not.   The total have twelve pump. Enough to handle the surge of demand. It is easy to get in and out here. It also has plenty of space to maneuver your car around their parking lot. Security cameras is pointing to the direction of the pump which makes this place safe.

Largo find Han Way is good Asian Fusion food. Food price is around $10. Their in 4 categories. Small bites, Hot Plate, Bowl and Poke. The small bites main appetizers and the hot plate either stir fry. The poke is create your own poke. Basically select your protein, ingredients, topping and sauce. The signature bowl are mixture of meat with rice.   I got the Korean steak taco. It is steak taco with lettuce on top. The meat was pack well at the bottom. This dish come with three taco. Price is average since they pack enough meat. The taco is flavorful and tasty. It is big meal.   The Han Way rum special at $8 dollars dish for their  bowl item. They stir fry the meal. The Asian fusion side includes Korean, Thai and Chinese. Selection is wide for the choices and includes the Hawaiian poke.

Green food. Healthy for begin of year. Eco provide concept of future. Eat more power grain, green nutrition, natural lean protein and recycled and biodegradable product. This is great concept. I have been here many time. This is the first review.   We were here for their great bowl. They have mahi mahi with Asian Chili sauce. This bowl I have never have before. I think is their best product. It has rice. I believe is brown or purple rice. The grain, citrus, onion and more. The mahi mahi was grilled perfection. I like the way they have the sauce that match the dish. It is a great dish that I would recommend.   I also like their juice. They said the building is use 50% reusable energy. Monday is the meatless bogo day. Atmosphere is good. Food come out a bit slow if you order required cook dish. I don't mind.

The store access may be tough to get there if you come from south of Bruce B Down. One good thing they have parking lot is big enough. Especially during Coronavirus period. This store is busy. Parking is full of customers to visit this store.   The wine and beer may not the cheapest in town. But it has the special may be worth a visit.
