I got two bottle of Pinot Noir from Russian River Valley region. I also got the special deal of the beer - Goose Island IPA. The check out line is long. But everyone keep a distance. When get close to the payment teller, it is set to minimum six feet apart.

It is worthy to save a few lunch money from other restaurants to come to enjoy one expensive food here. By the all the food here is tiny but very delicate. It is very special on each item you have order. The spice does does has a touch from Japan. It is not your typical sushi restaurant.   We start with Hatsu Yakitori. This is grilled stick with chicken heart. Very unique. The sauce go with it is difficult to be described. It has excellent after taste. Out next course is Taru Okada. They don't have kanpachi but substitute with Mackerel. It includes the tuna tartare and salmon. This is make your own roll. I like the sauce that comes with it. There are three different sauces and each combination have different flavor.   Our third course is noble ramen. It do not have the quantity but does have the quality. I wish it has more chashu Pork. Nonetheless, it was quite good. The last item is the Kurobuta Pork Belly. Two pieces for $10. I like the toppings and the Pork Belly. Overall is a wonderful experience.

Tung- Tung is one of the few Chinese restaurant that do deliver. The food is average but the deliver is very convenient. We work late in night and few hungry this is a good restaurant to call. They are few restaurants in Temple Terrace answer a call for delivery.   Many of my friend order veggies or chicken fried rice. Mostly American Chinese food. I actually go for true Chinese food. I got the beef chow fun. It got the sauce and correct wok heat to make it delicious. However some of the noodle has not separated on about 5 % of it. However, they are still good. The beef is flavorful but not tender enough.   Overall they are still good. If we have the delivery again, I will still order the same thing.

Grille One Nine may be the best happy hour sushi. They also has the $1,$2,$3 item during the happy hour before 7 pm. The sushi rice is better than three other sushi happy hour place I have been to.   Tonight we have to pick up our car at dealer and pass by this place. I have seen Stacy visited this place before and book mark it for some time. We have ordered the spicy tuna roll, gator roll, Florida roll, and eel roll from the happy hour and order a surf and turf roll from the specialty menu. The gator roll is the is the yellowtail, tuna, atomic aioli, scallions, smelt, and tempura chip. This is a good roll. I also like their eel roll that serve a good eel.   The specialty surf and turf roll is fried lobster top with seared steak. Mmmm I like this roll. We also added the nigiri smoke salmon and freshwater eel. The service is great. Please call ahead since many come to happy hours.

It is about 3.5 stars. I really could not fully assessing this place, because we came at happy hours. It was third stop of our progressive happy hours. We didn't get any food. The drink of the happy hour is very affordable. They don't have food on happy hour because their food is already in good price.   Because of the happy hour, there was not a live music. One thing we noticed they have open bar widow connected to outside seating which make the inside seating a bit warm. We wonder if the place is full and the temperature is high during live music. This area need to be improved.

I am surprised that no Yelp elite has reviews this place yet. This restaurant plus club open since March 2. It has been many months. The interior was very beautifully decorated. I like the vaulted ceiling with silver cladding. The are salt water fish tanks host the lion fish. You also find the crowd fish and palette surgeonfish.   The restaurant divided into dessert room, dinning room and the bar area. The surrounding sound system is hook up to electronic jukebox. Time to time they have live music.   They are still defined their identity on the food they have serve. I have visited them for the restaurant week. The menu is interesting. My first course is three jumbo shrimp wrap in 16 months dry cured prosciutto. I the shrimp was grilled and the prosciutto add the saltiness to the shrimp.   My second course is the grilled seasoned fillet tip. It is skew Grilled cube fillet. The marinate can be stronger. It also come with two skews of vegetables - shallot, eggplant and mushrooms. The lemon juice was added and soak the basmati rice below. I think they can have the lemon juice aside to let the customers make the decision to add the lemon.   My last course is creme brûlée. The top side sugar was flame harden. The bottom is liquid creaming. It top with cool whip and strawberry. I like this dish. It can be less sweet on the bottom filling.   My sample dish is a spicy chilled avocado soup top with lump crab meat. I actually like this dish. The mixed of jalapeño and avocado is creative.   I like this restaurant and they do have potential. They still experiment their menu. I wonder what they will do next.

Southwest Airline has been on time for all my flight. They are the few airlines I like to use for domestic flight in US. This airline has good discounts when you buy early. The flight can be changed without additional fees within 24 hour if you decided to flight in different time. Just need to pay the difference.   The seat is actually more leg room than most airline. I like the humor that the attendant that flight on board. They always surprise me with a joke of the day. Sometimes I wait at the gate, the gate attendant has trivia question to give out the drink coupon on flight if you got it right. This is a good perk they give out while you waiting on your flight.   I like they don't have assigned seat. Only first register on the flight check in before 24 hour determined you line up of the flight. It is also has early bird check in for small fees.

Very close other big oriental supermarket. Some of my friend like this place due to great price and good amount of veggies. Thankfully they open during pandemic. They do control amount of people can enter the store to avoid crowded situations.   The store have only basic oriental items. Definitely is local favorite. Not for me who are out of town people. It has item I need. I would said it is good carry on the butcher section for type of meat you want.

If you craving for sweet corn arepa, this may be a good place. This Venezuelan place serve variety of dishes. They have a appetizer with variety of taste call Carrusel Siete Estrellas. It has Arepitas Dulces, Cachapas, Pastelitos Andidos. If you don't what it is, I am not going to tell. Go try it and let me know :)  We start with mini Cachapas that a sweet corn arepa top with Venezuelan cheese. Mm good. I like the chewing the cheese.   Our main menu is bistec la plancha. Is grilled skirt steak with sweet plantain and yuca. The side dish of plantain and yuca is delicious but the steak do not stand out.   The restaurant has TV to entertain the guess. Seating is ok and acceptable comfort. I would said this is been there done that restaurant. Since the restaurant is to next door kid playground specialty store, a lot parent come to here and eat after taking their kid for fun time.

This bar is attractive and nicely decorated. Most of the first timer walking through the front door. Many of the regular actually going through the court yard with the side entrance. The counter of the bar is lighted and make it cool.   They have good enough kitchen to put out some good Mexican food. It is a bit pricey if come to taco but they are more unique. I have the surf and turf, pork belly and blacken lobster tacos. The surf and turf is the grilled steak and blacken shrimp. I think this two should not mix. Steak and fish may be. The pork belly is caramelized sweet. It is good taste. The blacken lobster is the best. It is nice with good lobster meat.   The bar may need some help. They are too many sit on the bar at 5 pm. They only have one bar tender. The chip and salsa come out slow. However the food come out rather quick.

One of the yelper friend recommends this restaurant to us when we were at Tarpon Spring. The restaurant has it own parking lot and you are not required to pay the parking when you eat there. We met the owner of the restaurant when we eat there. He also own the restaurant across the street. This a good restaurant with reasonable price.   We order the grilled octopus for appetizer and the lamb chop for the dinner. The octopus tentacles was process and grill over open fire. The minor burn make the whole food smell better. It serve with olive, cucumber and lettuce. It is yum to enjoy.   The main dish is the lamb chop come with two side. We have the salad and the rice. The salad have the purple olive which is tradition to Greek food. The rice is top with tomato sauce with crispy meat crump. The lamb chop is grilled. Most restaurant serve thin cut lamb chop. This is my first time eating 1 inch thick lamb chop. It also bone in. This make the pod have flavor. Love the chop.   The service is great. Constantly some people to collect the empty plate. Can beat this chop any where. Very traditional Greek food.

This is about 4.5 stars in my book. I was undecided if it need to be 4 stars or 5 stars. At the end, I think I can revise it for my revisit next time. This place is big. I definitely like the bar area. It has great tv.   I was here to try out the newest restaurant in the St. Pete area. This is one of the few restaurants has it own parking lot. It is free parking compare to many area here requiring parking fees. It is a plus.   I got the pork belly ramen to start. This ramen come with 3 good pieces of pork belly grilled to good perfection. I would add salt or sugar to the pork belly with better taste before grilled. The soup may want to add some black sesame oil to enhance the flavor. This ramen is good, however I think just need a slight improvement to make it great.   I got the chance to try their category five sushi roll. This is a spicy tuna top with avocado and Kabayaki sauce. In addition it top with imitation crab meat. It is a very good roll. Love the taste. The other roll is the their one of most order rolls- snow mountain rolls. This is a tempura shrimp inside and top with real snow crab meat. I think this is a must order item if you visit them. I would recommend this roll.   Here are the special:  Monday free miso soup for any guest; Tuesday 2 minor rolls for $10, 2 major rolls for $20 and mixed and match for $15; Monday to Friday $2 off on bento box before 3 pm; Wednesday $2 off on each glass wine and 1/2 off for bottle, Thursday lady night alcohol.   My service is great. A shout to Sarah who serve me did a great job at the bar. Other worth mentioning is their sake cocktail, sake whisky, sake sangria, and their whisky flight.

This is neighborhood Panera. I bike to here for morning break. I have been here several time but never review them. During this pandemic, I can see thing have been change to adopt the ease of customers. Surely dine in is not available.   They did set a hand sanitizer at the entrance. The order can be done in the store. Payment using the credit card is safer by using the credit card insert electronic card reader without server though it. Then the food is hand to you without touch each other.   I alway like the bear claw. The creamy drizzle on the top is sweet. The filling inside also enhanced the food experience. The pastry is fresh enough for me to have.

This is the second PDQ that I have visited. It still good on People Dedicated to Quality. The place is clean and neat. The food is still good but not as good as the first one I have been to.  We got BBQ bacon and Hawaiian chicken sandwich.  The Hawaiian is still good. The BBQ just average. It is a bit too sticky. The Hawaiian chicken is still the best.  The side order of zucchini fries was to soggy. It can be better with extra cost for the combo meal. Other than that, everything is good.

The Ruben is busy at lunch time. I was here almost 1 pm and the place is still pack. I come in to the restaurant to get a to go order. The order will take 10 minutes. Next time should call ahead.   I got the palomilla steak. This a thin steak grilled to perfection. It accompanied with cheese, grilled onion, tomato and lettuce. The grilled onion is caramelize. It has enhanced the taste. They give a lot of steak to fill the entire sandwich. The sandwich is delicious.

Tara is not allowed dine in during pandemic. But the take out is available. The store open to customers who want generous on the quantity portion.   I got the the stew Oxtail. This dish come with one side of choices and rice. I have the cabbage as side. The oxtail is stew in high pressure to separate from the bone. Number oxtail given was three big pieces and one small piece. The rice was given generously so you will have full stomach. Great for dinner portions.   Overall experience is at average. Food is ok. Definitely is budget place in compare to many restaurants.

Dominican restaurant that provide a lot vibe and economic dinning for the local. Many people are here for a meal in saving price. We are here to try out the food for the first time.  The restaurant has the two choices for the food. You can pickup by cafeteria already cook or from the menu. We have order two dishes from the cafeteria and one from the menu. The first dish is a soup with tripe, pig feet, and veggie. Most people only cook tripe soup by it own. It is good twist with the pig feet. Good soup.   The second dish is a tomato base whole fish. It look awesome but it not my liking taste. Fish meat is too loose. The third dish is a cook up dish of grill steak with onion. I can hear they pound the steak at the kitchen. I like my steak grilled with no sauce. But Dominican steak has sauce on top but a bit salty.   The food is average. If I choose Latin food, I would go with Cuban style bistec. Service is cafeteria style.

Kwality is try to fusion. There certain things they do well and other things did not carry the load. I would said their dessert is interesting. I have not try their hot food yet, cannot comment on that area. Their store have a huge space. Basically you can buy the food there and eat there. The plenty of table.   Their curry veggie pastry is one of the good one to try. Enough curry spice and fluffy pastry crush. The dessert is one of the better one. It is by weight. We got several one with colorful display. Some of them are very interesting. We also got their juice as sugar cane. However this is a let down. They give you a small cup and expensive in dollar. I can get better quantity with double of the amount they have offer in Tampa Bay Area.   Overall is a specialty food center. You can get a hot plate with good price. But for juice, is a bit expensive.

This an update from the previous take up to current dine in experience. There is no doubt eat at the shop is the best option. The food just prepared and they are good to go. I am considered they are top store for devil crab in tampa.   We order one devil crab and they are huge. The whole ball is stuff with crab meat. They definitely worth for the money. It come with chip and drink. Do you know the breakfast special is only $5.99 and they give a lot. It includes sausage, ham, scrambled egg, and more. Big breakfast to share.   After a true sit down visit, I feel they are one of the best in Tampa. It can be easily one of the most like in the bay. If you visit Tampa, this is one you should try. Sandwiches is famous here too but the devil crab is the jewel of the store.

This is my go to store for glasses. I have been using them for almost 10 years. They use to have buy one pair get one pair of glasses free. After the close and reopen, this deal is no longer exist. Now they have buy one get one 50% off. Still good deal. I am usually need two glasses. One computer screen glass and the other is my daily wear single vision.   Most of the glasses place offer the high index glasses. This place have the high index and high definition lens. Both of them is almost the same which made the lens thin. The high definition is better for me with single vision because I can catch the vision at the corner of the glasses without turning. This lens is tough. Usually take two year to wear off the scratch resistance.   The one I have has the anti glaze, light weight, thin lens and uv resistance.

La Hacienda is popular among the local. The plaza parking lot always pack. Most car come to this restaurant. Parking is rime here. We were here at 2 pm. The place still pack. We were lucky to get a table. People who behind us have to wait.   The food is good. I have Paisa Bandeja Hacienda with upgrades steak. This dish has steak, chicharon, blood sausage, regular sausage, rice, egg, plantains, bean soup. A lot to offer. The chicharron is a little tough to bite de to the skin is or crispy. Like rubber. This can improve by changing the frying oil and keep it crispy. The rest item is a little above average. My wife love her dish. She has Filete de Pescado al Ajillo. The Ajillo sauce is great. I would highly recommend this dish. It is one of the kind.   The reason they are 3 star is the wait for the food is too long. We waited almost 40 minutes. No wonder the restaurant always pack because everyone is waiting for their food. The chicharron is a typical dish which they must master before anything else. I hope my next visit they can improve on that. They have bakery section. To me is just ok. Bit my wife like it.

Lolis at Temple Terrace is a better facility compared to the one they have on other brunch. It has outdoor and indoor seating. It is pleasant to sit outdoors because it's under the tree. One thing they definitely improve one's is to clean the outdoor furniture more often.   This is almost like cafeteria ordering at the counter and then deliver the food to your table. I got the three tacos combinations and my friends got the quesadilla. The three tacos including Carne Asada, pastol, and grilled shrimp. These tacos are pleasant to have. They are in good flavor. The quesadilla has a lot of cheese.  Meat for the taco is in good quantity. The size of three tacos is enough for lunch. This place is very popular due to nearby students visit.

Rare ethnic food # 64. Thai Street Food  This is noodle restaurant has a lot to boast about. It is first Thai street food in the Bay Area. Their menu concentrated on noodle with many different choices. It is a true 5 stars restaurant to my book. I once been to a street vendor in Singapore that received the Michelin Star. This restaurant will be our Tampa Bay Street Food That has Michelin star quality.   We started with Namtok Moo. It is the grilled slice pork with Namtok sauce with roasted rice powder. The marinated was good. The slice beef is great. Our fist entree is the Ba Mee Moo Dang. It is the BBQ pork with egg noodle. It is a dry both noodle dish. Very similar to Malaysia dry wonton noodle dish except they use BBQ pork. I like the sauce at bottom of the dish. So you need to mixed before you eat will help the flavor. The second entree is the Tew Pad Toon. It is the duck noodle soup. The duck is deboned. The duck is cook in the broil herbal soup. The soup base also from that. I think this dish win my heart.   We have a lot love for this restaurant. Although it is too far for me to visit but I will make the effort to revisit. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Great restaurant with low cost. This where you find Mc Donald meal is expensive compare to this restaurant. If they start a chain restaurant, it may be a nightmare for Mc Donald to compete. I believe they are the gem of the Bay Area.   The restaurant get a lot of foot traffic so come a bit early than lunch time. Unfortunately they close at 5 pm so no dinner. Just sad about this situation??? Dummy, you just have to take out and eat at night. However their soup noodle need to be eat there.   I like their grilled pork sandwich. When they are at the old location, they usually run out of pork when it approaches to closing time. They serve many type of soup. I like their grill pork fresh roll. They also have different dessert in package and you just need to pick one.   The reason I have this review now is the best keep secret of all time. They serve the duck noodle only on Friday. They use to have this item in the menu at the old restaurant. However, they have not put this dish in the menu when they move to the current location. The duck is well braised with salt and seasoning into the meat itself. This is not a roast duck. If any Vietnamese restaurant use roast duck, it is wrong for duck noodle soup. The soup base is not regular pho spice. You can feel the natural bone taste in this soup. It comes with bamboo shoot. I like it better here due to the shoots are not sour. I have been to many place for duck noodle but non like this. The duck meat and the soup are the one I love the most. Please remember to come early and only Friday serving only. They have limited bowl. Once they are gone they will not serve it again. You also need to like to eat from the bone for this soup.   I have been here many time but never review them, I have kept this duck noodle soup secret for years in the current location. Only the loyal old customers know about this. Don't forget about the boba drink. They are very affordable. Here you go, the secret is out.

Mott & Hester is a deli food restaurant that serves the community at south Tampa for about 39 years. The cuisine has many interesting selections. Some Italian, Cajun, American and more. They survived this long may be due to their menu variety in different time.   It is not easy to visit this place because they close early and seldom has dinner service. We got the make your own pasta. I started with angel hair pasta, grilled chicken and end with pesto sauce. It is a good dish. Good enough quantity for a hungry person. My wife has the big Tony Sandwich. It has capicola, ham, provolone with Italian dressing. It is a good sandwich. We also got some of the deli section with dirty rice.   Food is good in compare to most deli. No wonder they can survive till now. It is local favorite.

For the take out experience is really good. During the thanksgiving day, they still open for business. We order the turkey special for good price. We order on the online and it was accurate per order when I pick up. The estimate timing to pickup is exact. The time I walk into the door the food just ready to pick up.   It is not fancy turkey lunch. But it is enough for the lunch which help me to have thanksgiving turkey lunch. Since we don't cook turkey during thanksgiving, it is convenient for me to order during thanksgiving day. The meat is juicy. The side is good. It is definitely a plus for my experience.

It is just ok for the BBQ. This place is kind of new at Brandon area. The store front was decorated with Christmas item when I was visiting there. The draw some new paint on the windows showing the Santa clauses and Mrs Clause.   We got the sampler platter. It got Saint Louis rib, pull pork, brisket, quarter chicken and two sides. The chicken meat is too powdery. The pull pork is too dry. Only the brisket measure up to the standard. The rib is average. May be is off day for them. It is not up to par.

Whiskey Cake was our first stop on the progressive happy hour gathering. The restaurant have good menu on the happy for food and drink. We like food they serve. A good solid 4 restaurant.   We started with Wagyu State Fair Corn Dog. The is corn dog you might want to slowly bite to prevent the juice inside spread all over you clothing. I like the corn dog come as 5 pieces to share. The next dish is the short rib poutine. This is beautiful decorated dish. The short rib meat is in it with sunny side up egg on top. It is big to share. The next dish is the duckitos. This a spring roll type duck confit. It is ok dish. My friend got dip and spread trio. Come with three different dip. I think it is ok dish too.   The service is just ok. To get attention of the waiter is a bit challenging. They need to improve on it. I did get a the great escape on the cocktail. I actually like this cocktail. Pineapple fuse with rum. Nice touch.

East Bistro offer stone oven food that is delicious. Under $10 you can filled you stomach with great food. This is small businesses we need to support. I think they are better alternatives than the fast food such as McDonald.   I pass by here a lot but never go into the restaurant. This restaurant has some sit down place. This is almost like cafeteria order at the counter and pick up the food. However, they have good food. I have order to go. I have order the Kibbeh, beef kabab and atayef. The kibbeh is ground beef in cracked wheat shell. It is delicious. The kabab are the kofta with season ground beef and grilled over the open flame. It come with rice, baba Ghanoush and tabouleh. Mmmm good. I also have the dessert that is not in the menu. The Atayef-Arabic pancake stuff with walnut. They fried and dip in honey syrup before it serve.   I gave 5 star for good pricing, good food, fresh ingredients, cook on the spot, and attentive service.

3.5 stars is about right rating for this restaurant. They are popular among the local neighborhoods. We saw many African Americans customers when we visited this place. Fried seafood is one of their favorite food. Parking is kind of limited. The seat down table also limited if you want to eat there. Many people ordered to go.    We got the fried conch as appetizer. This is my first time to have fried conch. The coating is good. We also got the oyster and fish combo box. The oyster is in good pieces. We like the fried shrimp. It was delicious. The fish can have a choice like Basa, tilapia, salmon or mullet. For fried food I like to eat it there.   There is a wait after ordering. I don't mind with fresh fried seafood. It is good to eat there instead of take home.

They new Wawa flex some new kid in the block muscle along the Fletcher Ave. It also has something that other Wawa do no have. It has the Ethanol Free Gasoline. It predominantly use for boat fuel. Most of the marina has this fuel for $3.60 a gallon. They only sales for $2.60. This offer the alternative for the boater who toll their boat. They can pump up their boat before launch to the water.   The only con item for this Wawa is they only have one line of gas pump. Normal Wawa has two gas pump in one row and the space of drive through in the middle.

Rare Ethic Food 9  Brazilian cuisine that has been Tampa for sometime. But this restaurant has it special way that actually attract to me. This restaurant is actually at Waters Ave with a lot Vietnamese cuisine. But it hold it own.   Most Brazilian place like to sale you all you can eat meat. This place is more like home cooking with platter. We have the Grilled Picanha and steak with onion. The steak with onion is marinated and grilled. It is good dish and we paid less than $10. Good deal. The Picanha Steak is a bit different in cut. Since has bit skin and fat, it make the steak juicier.   The side is exiting. We have fried egg, vinaigrette, and fried ground yuca with bacon. The grounded yuca is like crump with bacon go very well with the steak. This is very traditional way by spreading this crump over the steak. And it work very well.   Overall the service is good. I like this mom and pop shop. Please visit them.

Dough is a cute place to be. I like the interior decoration. They comfortable in space and great distance to next table. It is good romantic night or big crowd in a group.   Pink interior design with red chandelier almost like fairy tale. The store have comfortable chair to enjoy the dessert they serve. They also have a walkway connect the next door Datz restaurant. If you cannot find the parking in the front, try their behind building parking lot. It great place to hang out with friend or family.   The store serve the bakery and ice cream. They have donut, cake in different topping, cupcake and more. The ice cream include gelato with very smooth and creamy taste. I have the double cherry whisky and it is good to enjoy. They also serve the coffee and drink which is late for my wife to try it. She will not able go to sleep if she have caffeine after 12 noon.

Pepito's After Dark. It sounds like this restaurant in the dark side of the Venezuelan. It plenty of light in the restaurant, don't be afraid of the name call.   The restaurant is set up like fast food restaurant with service. The food can be order in the counter and deliver to you on the table. We have group of yelpiest people decide to try this restaurant. We have started with Tequenos - cheese wrap dough. This is not bad. We have order the Pepito Basket (grill beef, lettuce and sour cream at corn shape basket), Patacon (pork, lettuce, Parmesan cheese, mozzarella on top on plantain), chicharon de pollo (deep fried chicken), Arepon (chicken at arepa). The one I like the most is the the basket. The beef is well seared to cook and make the taste more desirable.   Overall the restaurant is good. They do have big screen TV here for any soccer game in South America. It is a community restaurant with affordable price. I enjoy my time here when we have a group to enjoy the conversation.

My visit to the dessert place is pleasant. I was there  6:30 pm and there was no other customers. The dessert and sandwich place is empty. They carry the Liege waffles with soft and chewy type. They also has gelato and crepes.   The gelato are more creamy than normal gelato. It is rich. I have try their Greek and Creme orange gelato. Both of them are very good and unique. I also try their caramel gelato. The gelato size 1 to 3 flavor. The one flavor small is $4.50. Each flavor add a dollar on top. Normal ice cream price.   Next time I will go for crepe with gelato. The crepe is $3.50. Adding gelato is additional $3.00. I think is better value.   Beside of the above items, they have Sandwich, coffee, dessert like macaron and cake. This is a new restaurant with nice interior set up.

This is a sister restaurant from the Pinellas Park. Their menu is extensive. They are still brand new restaurant. Took over from previous Golden Phoenix restaurant.   I like their pho. I have the slice beef pho noodle. The pho is to my liking. Pho is personal thing. Some like thick and heavy smell taste, some like light and watery taste. It is preference by each individual.   We have big group with us. The waitress got her handful. Considering this is still under training period and she can handle it. Although they are some mis order but get it right at the end.   Is you bring a cake, there is no cutting fees. Selection is good. The grilled meat may need to improve. The fried noodle is mediocre. Pho is definitely good. Chicken wing is average. Overall, their pho is big.

This is a very authentic Italian mom and pop restaurant. They have their edge for the business because they have chef skill that different than most typical chain store cuisine preparation. We have a group co-worker attending a early lunch there. Since get in before 12 pm, there was no people. Even when we left, they still don't have people visit.   Price is in the medium high side for lunch. I have order the veal piccata with added some prosciutto ham. They have some up charge. The angel hair is nicely cook. The piccata sauce is good. I would rather them to add more material in the sauce such as fried garlic or artichoke or ham. The veal is right easy to cut and bite. Overall is very good. My friend enjoy their dish.   Service is good. There is a sense of old Italian setting in the restaurant including the background music playing.

This Greek restaurant is a chain that just open in New Tampa a year ago. They are best system restaurant in this area. What I mean of that is from the time they receive the order to deliver the food is usually on target. Normally for the grilled food is taken more time especially for the kebab. They have enough man power and operation to make the assembly look easy and fast. Our foods deliver in 10 minutes and they are faster than any mini restaurant. I will not call this fast food since the foods are cook to your order. The cook is well train to shorten the time of deliver.   Tonight we have order on the light side of the menu. By the time we have added on the additional skew, it is not in the light side any more. We have order the lamb kebab and the chicken kebab and added a skew of steak kebab. Good value for dinner under $25 and use the yelp free drink offer by the restaurant. With the coupon, we have the reduction $5 of the total bill.   The kebab came with the side Greek salad and rice. It also comes with pita bread. The Greek salad is very flavorful. It has a potato salad in the middle of all the mix green (lettuce, tomato, red onion, beets, Kalamata olives, pickle green pepper, cucumber). The soft feta cheese is sprinkle over it. Lovely cheese. The skew meats (chicken, lamb and steak) are marinated and cook over the open grilled. They are will balance spice with Middle Eastern flavor. Taste sensation. I like the steak skew the best. If you take the meat from skew, the flavor stick in the finger with finger licking good.   The restaurant has small capacity seating. I like the kitchen crew shaving the Gyro with electric ring cutter. It was smoothly shave. Most of the gyro is shaving by knife which has no control of the thickness. This restaurant using the electrical shave has control over the thickness and allows crispiness. I don't like shave it too thick and cause the smell of the lamb Gyro. Technology has improved on food process. Like it.

Nice bar for the downtown area for hang out. I was at this location before and it was different restaurant. Our friend suggests this meeting place before the free museum tour at Friday night.   The bar is pack and popular. The bar has the happy hours and some of the items are half off. You just need to find them in the menu indicate HH. The beer also has happy hour price. The beer is $3 draft and $3.5 for premium wells. We got our order in before the happy hours end at 6:30.   This place is pretty much set up for after office hour mingle. I see a lot people hang out after long week of work. They have the roof top bar also. I can see the roof top is great during November when weather is not that hot.  Fly bar is open space restaurant. Some time is getting loud when they are pack but the good time never ending. Parking may be a problem. They are some lot they toll the car. Please ask the hostess where you park before you sit down if you are not sure.

Jade symbol high end gem in oriental culture. This restaurant start with the name with Jade is meaning for high society dinning for Vietnamese food. We try out this restaurant since many of our friends have checking in at this restaurant.   We went there for our dinner and we are going to try the non pho items. We have order the grilled short rib and the caramelized pork belly. This two dish certainly look very good when they present to us. Look can be sometime deceiving us. The taste of the short is just so so. It does cook right but not best flavor. The pork belly is a bit tough on skin to bite. But the caramelized does a good job. It have good flavor.   There is no fireworks on the food. There is mix feeling on their food. I just wonder we hit the off night of the chef. One dish material preparation is off and the other with the seasoning is off. The service is good. It has potential to be good on other items but not the night we have visit.

Following Melinda M., I have to check this restaurant.  My wife and I have joined Nick S. in the restaurant and try variety of the menu has to offer. This is a restaurant that next to the market. It has cute interior decoration. The restaurant is close at 8 pm which mean we have to get to the restaurant before 6:30 pm.   We have order two appetizers and 3 main entrees. The first appetizer is the chicken satay. Although the satay is not on the skewer but it have the typical yellow ginger spice for the seasoning. The peanut sauce is sweet instead of mild hot for the dipping. The chicken is well grilled and not dry out the meat. The second appetizer is the dumpling. The dumpling in Chinese is sui mei. The pork dumpling is usually three part components of ground pork, ground or mince shrimp and mince water chest nut. This restaurant serves with two part shrimp and ground pork over slice ginger. You have to eat it with the ginger overlay the dumpling and increase the sophisticate of the taste which this restaurant has provided.  The first main dish is the Tom Yum with mince and slice pork noodle soup. I have asked for the Thai hot.  I can see Nick need a lot of water after he has the dish. I have my head sweat flowing while I am eating. It is sweat good. The mince pork prepare correctly with seasoning ground pork. The second dish is the pad thai. The dish is served with peanut sauce and three jumbo shrimps. The price of this dish is in the high side, however, the three jumbo shrimps make up for the price. This dish is OK. The third dish is the pan seared sea bass. This dish come with fillet sea bass over the soy sauce and accompany with the black bean rice. The sea bass is seared but a little dry. However, it is well season.  Overall our experience is great. The service is a bit slow. However, after all other customers left, we were served in full attention. Tonight, we did not have a chance to try the lemongrass crème brule since they don't have it. This may be the item to try next time.

Centro YBOR has rich history. I have been to this place many time, I think is about time to gather the thoughts for this review. Centro YBOR has been Tampa jewel not just for the tourists but the history for the city. The historic building survived since late 18th century to now. The Cuban cigar was thriving at 1920. You know the Columbia restaurant alway roll back the price of 1905 at their anniversary.   There are Cuban club building is very historic. You can join the historic tour in YBOR. When you see the balcony along East 7 avenue. This may be influenced of French colony. Many parade has been taken place at this street that it provided a good view. Many parades include the snow, new year, pirate, or guavaween parade.   The new face of Centro YBOR has the Carmine cinema, Improv Comedy, Carne Chop House and many more. New comers include Hypo and Asiatic Noodle bar have made good addition to this area.   The chicken has run wild at YBOR which is very unique. Trolley track is at the 8 Ave that connects to downtown.

I have been to Straz Center countless time since my wife love performance art. I have been to the Carol Morsani Hall and Ferguson Hall many time. They even have a smaller hall like Jard Theater that I have not been to.   Our kid is involved in the production of the Opera Tampa in this performance art center. His production include Carmen, Tosca, La Bohime, and The Girl of the Golden West. We had driven him to practice and sit in the actual show. The show has very talented singers and actor. This production take time and they only show for two days.   Recently we have attended the Florida Orchestra with a small section of Madam Butterfly. The lead singer is the principal of St. Petersburg Opera. It is wonderful singing.   The center include a restaurant, education center and more. I glad we have somethings like this in town.

In search of ramen, we decided to try this place base on a friend review and the roll char siu pork.   The place has nice modern decorations with high ceiling. Great dining hall. Plenty of seats. One thing they lack off is customers. It is light traffic consider 6 pm in the Saturday evening. We were easily seat by our choice.   We know they have the Ramen menu. They also have special of the night menu also with different sushi with picture. The pictures of the sushi look good. We are not trying that because we have few more stop for different restaurants.   The ramen soup base have the miso, shoyu, tonkatsu, shio butter or the mix of tonkatsu and miso. Among of all the soup base, the tonkatsu base is the holy grail of the ramen. It is from pork marrow bones depend on how long it was cook. They were kind enough to allow us taste the soup before order.   The Ramen was good and not too salty since they are not the miso base. Overall they are good to try and the ramen came out in 10 minutes. Base on the interior and the people who serve us, they deserve 5 stars. We will be back to try the sushi.

This place is recommended by a spice store clerk for Killer Po-boy in French Quarter. Louisiana is the place to try Po-boy if you come to visit. We were determined not to eat the Po-boy at restaurant but at the food stand or bar.   Erin Rose is a little bar with a small kitchen at the back. The front is the full service bar with TV and stool for sitting. When we arrive around 12 noon, the bar section already fill with people. Wow!!!!  The drinking starts this early. Of course some of them have order the Po-boy and drink. We have to walk through the crowd and order the Po-boy through a small window. This is a small and warm little place when you have so many people.   I can see the waitress bring out ton and ton of Po-boy to bar area. This is good sign if a lot of people order Po-boy. We have order the gulf shrimp and the meatloaf Po-boy. The wait for the food to be cook is 25 minutes. No wonder those people have a drink while waiting for the food.   The meatloaf is grilled and accompany pickle and vege. This is a good sandwich. The gulf shrimp is my favorite. The shrimp is seasoning and seared to cook. It added the slaw in the sandwich for the taste. Yap! This is a killer Po-boy. Got to try.

This restaurant is fast food but not fast. You have wait for them to cook to the order. The burger is 100 percent pure Japanese Akaushi Kobe beef, 2-3 grades higher than USDA Prime. It is heathy burger that you are getting in this joint.   Monday is a special for any patron that show up in the store and get a 6 oz burger for $5. Normal price is $7. A 29% discount. The burger here has many assembly choices. They are dividing into three categories. First is cheese- the choices are American, aged Swiss, cheddar jack, pepper jack, provolone. You also can add premium cheese such as Mozzarella with additional $1.49. The second selection is the sauce - the selections are monger sauce, ketchup, mayo, mustard, honey mustard, grey poupon, ranch jalapeño ranch, A-1 steak sauce, BBQ, attic goodness sauce, chai chipotle chup. I like my burger plain. The third category is the topping - the choice are lettuce, tomato, balsamic tomato, sweet onion, grill onion, grilled mushroom, jalapeño, dill pickle, onion slaw, banana pepper, tomato relish, roasted red pepper. You also can add bacon for $1.49 more.   I like my burger with lettuce, tomato, grilled mushroom, and balsamic tomato. The balsamic sauce drip into the burger created the sweetness and combines with the burger meat burn make this taste heavenly good. I will come for more.

It is located at the empty lot of the corner Nebraska and Sinclair Hill road just north of the Bearss Ave. it is at the southeast corner of the intersection. Look for the red color hut or trailer. Sometime they it has smoke come out the smoke ventilation tube.   If you like the BBQ, this may be your joint. Be prepared the front row seat. What! no seat at all. Just standing and eat or take home :). The BBQ certainly a great one in Bay Area. I have not try the mullet but the meat samplers is great. The samplers have the chicken, pull pork, rib, sausage, beef brisket. It is a big dog dish for one person.   This shack was burn down and now reopen. He take credit card. I would bring cash. Parking is easy, just pull to the front of the shack. You also can buy the rib by the count of bones. They are easy to order base on your appetite. Come check it out yourself. If you don't like it, blame Nick.

It locates at the corner of the plaza which takes me some time to locate it. I have this place book mark for some time. We were happened to be here for other store and decided to check it out. My local guide is yummy man with mustache. He has been to this area for many time and explorer of the Dunedin. Some call him the explorer; I call him senior elite who qualified for Yelp Care (oooold age elite). Just Kidding.  The restaurant does not have the table order service. Everything orders from the counter and the food will be brought to you at the table. They have authentic Mexican tacos. I would go for that since the cost is 2 dollars to 2 dollars and 50 cents per taco. I loves place like this very affordable and provides you a good taste. Although they have other main dish menu, I would recommend just the taco. I have the fish, steak, pork and beef tongue taco. Beef tongue??? There is no such word. Just use Cow Tongue. I actually like that taco.  We have the food to go but it is still good at home after three hours. Be careful about the hot sauce. If you not use to it, it will burn your mouth. They close at Sunday. So save the trip on that day, you already have enough days for the week to enjoy it. For the price you paid, and the quality of the food, they deserve 4 stars.

I was going to try their wing after workout. I came in the restaurant with my sweat shirt and sock with sandals. I was greeted by one of the employees and he will be get back with me. I saw the menu and decided a to go order. A few minutes later one waiter pass me by and said some one will help me. There were three waiter  and waitress pass by me and none of them can help on the take out order. I was there for 8 minutes seem like my money is not good to order. I really hungry and want to go home. Seem like they are not willing to take order I am not willing too. So turn around walk out the door without order. This will be my third one star review out of my over 800 reviews. If you charge your customers $1.50 per wing, the service should be measure up. I end up at wing express with $0.80 a wing and I am happy with it and walk out with the wings I want at 8 minutes.

When Nick said he is at the ice cream store and Patricia. I thought he was with a friend and waiting for us. He is actually mean he is at ice cream store at Patricia street. This store is just 1 mile from the down town Dunedin. Thank God they have air condition. At 2 pm in the afternoon is very important to have that AC under the roof.   After the orange festival, we were meeting there for ice cream and cool air condition. We waited there close to 3 pm to have the ice cream cone special. It is a dollar a cone. We have asked the store to add the flavor in to our soft serve ice cream cone. I have pinacolola and my wife have the amaretto flavor. The amaretto is Almond flavor Italian liquor. The ice cream does not have the alcohol but do have the flavor. The store is running the special between 3 to 5 pm. It is good to come out and support our local store.  Nick went on ask the frequent visit patron what are the best thing about the store. They have indicated their home made onion ring is great here. We did not try it since we just have the mojo cook off food. May be I will try it one day.

Bull Grill is truly the Brazilian Grill in the Bay Area. The restaurant is actually located at the vibrant Hispanic Community neighborhood. It is easy located at Armenia a few block south of the Hillsborough. Love the setting inside. It does not matter dinner or lunch, it is cloth napkin service. The best time and value is the Saturday and Sunday lunch because weekday you have to return to work and you cannot stay long.   The restaurant is my first time try on. I have tried many Brazilian and fell that they are too salty or too much of MSG in the seasoning. However, this restaurant is different in very good way. The seasoning is perfect and not over power. Love the food here, it come with wave. I mean tidal wave!!! Please pace yourself for the meat. There are 10 different cut of beef. In addition to the beef, they have chicken, chicken heart, ham and pork. My favor is the chicken heart. The beef have Picanha, Alcatra...... Forget about the names; just ask the waiter to cut for you if it is look good for you. Love it, eats it; what do you waiting for if they already bring in front of you.   Kim is the owner that super nice to us. Our table got free three different deserts - the tres-leches, tiramisu, and Flan. I like the tres-leches. They make the tres-leches very spongy and soak well with the milk. This is a great desert that make in Spanish recipe. I forgot to mention, there is more behind the all you can eat salad bar. I like the mango salsa. They also prepare the paella, different type of chicken at the salad bar.   The service is good, the meat in good material, the choice is a lot, and the people are nice. Love this place and will be back. They deserve a five star for all the above.

Gourmet or Craft bread. You decide. Either way, they have good bread. This bakery with the name 20 shekels is equal $5.06 USD. I believe the loaf of their bread more than 20 shekels ($7).   We got a loaf of chocolate blackberry bread. They are delicious. It was interesting how they make it. They use sprouts dough. It is compact, jam, dense. Fill you up quick.   Other item they have sold include sprouted brioche fruit tart, sprout lemon cake, sprouted banana muffin and many more. Come to check them out for fresh loaf.   The store sale people are very friendly. They are knowledgeable to answer any questions. I would give them an "A" on the bakery item. Go enjoy yourself a loaf of bread. 20 shekels is very reasonable for the price of the loaf.

This is my neighborhood Publix. It serves well to Tampa Palm Community. This Publix is not visible to main street Bruce B Down. As a result, it is true neighborhood grocery store that convenience to local residents.   I like our Publix due to their cleanest. The fruit is fresh. They have the sushi freshly made every day. The deli sandwich is good selection. Come to lunchtime, the line is long to get a sandwich or cold cut. The deli is easy for the housewife to pick ready cook items such as rotisseries chicken, fried shrimp and more. Bake good are make fresh daily. The frozen section is great to pick up heated items and ready to cook. I have my favorite such as frozen grilled quail and crab cake.  If you want to try your luck, the lottery is available at service station. Flower, Books, or Wine can be pick up easy and variety of choice. Parking is accessible and direct to the entrance. Publix always serve with smile and help on the push cart if you needed.

Tia has the unique way to cook the food. They use less fried or grill in the cooking. Which mean more in the broil bake type food. They are Cuban Latin Style food that make them special.   The interior setting is very modern and contemporary. They have booth sofa round section can seat 6 people. The seat is comfortable.  The menu is simple base on the chef specialty. We have the Palomilla Entree. Most Cuban restaurant grills the skirt steak but they did it a bit different. They broil with sauce that marinated into the skirt steak. The entree come with two choices. We have the yellow seasoned rice and the sweet plantain. The rice has some flavor into it.   The restaurant not just have the regular menu. It has the catering menu if you want to host a party. The service is good. The food came out fast since we only have thirty minutes to eat.

Rare Authentic Food No. 22  Hawaiian seafood cuisine in sushi is gaining popular in the Bay Area. But who can do better than Poke Cafe. Very creative on taste and combination of ingredients. It make desired to have it every day.   The choice is very simple, select you bowl size then the Poke, toppings and then the sauce. They also have individual scoops of each Poke if you go that way. Some other interesting way is Poke in burrito. One of my friends has the burrito with the noodle as starch infill. It actually better than the rice infill.   We have noodle largest bowl with three choices of Poke. We also have noodle base. The pricing is good compared to many restaurant try to do Poke. Love the taste. This is locally run and the owner do take good care of the customers. Food is fresh all time. For the taste, freshness, creativity, they deserve five stars.

I have take out since I am late get home and my wife is away. I have opportunity to pick any restaurant I have no been to. Senor T's is close by so I can try their food.   Over the phone I have order the DrunkenGrille Shrimp. It is 10 grilled shrimp on the skew with cilantro rice, slice avocado and a choice of bean to accompany it. The lady who take my order said is 10 minutes to pick up. When I arrive, the food is ready. It is well presented in the box. So the next thing is to taste it. The food is great. Better than I imagined with the stars they got.   I have joke with the lady when I pickup. I said her face is red that she got it from my "drunken" shrimp. I need make sure she did not eat my shrimp before hand to me. She was shock in the moment and don't know to answer. I said I got her on speechless.   The overall service to pick is on target. I event got a chip and salsa to go along. The salsa is great. Cinco De Mayo have special performance from the band.

Two years ago the the I have attended this festival and they have a lot local business and local restaurants participating this event. Previously they held this event in Hindu Temple Cultural Center. This year they grew bigger and held it at George Steinbrenner Field. They have more businesses are participation the event. Parking is improving compared to Hindu Culture Center. The only thing was given out is Non AC second level baseball stadium.   This year winner for the food provided is bonefish shrimp Ceviche. The shrimp has a lot bounce which mean they are fresh. The second place is carrabbas mushrooms sauce. They are very good. This year food vendors are mostly chain restaurants. Restaurant such as bonefish, carrabbas, PDQ, wow that fresh, Publix, jersey mike, and more. The coupon are very sweet. Some give out the free whole pizza.

I have been to this mall for numerous time. I always like to visit this mall number of reasons. Sales, watch someone skate, enjoy the drink at restaurant. Also, they have direct parking access to second level of the mall.   It always take me minimum 40 minutes to finish the mall. They have the skate rink that I enjoy to watch while the the patron skate. Especially those who has skill. The anchor stores include Macy's, Dillard, JC Penny  and Sear which sometimes have bargained items.   Other specialty store like CC Boutique, Build a Bear Workshop, Morrow fine candy, Teavana are good to try. They have the Cobb cinema for enjoyment and Urgent Care in case you need it.   The food court and restaurant are good to try. I like the food court food sampling before you make up your mind. There is train in the mall for the children to ride.

Great architect building that tower the skyline of the French Quarter. This church is still holding the mass every Sunday. During the mass session, the tourists are not allowed to take picture.  The cathedral is burn down 1788 and rebuild in 1794. There are 12 people buried under this church after they died. They are reverent, military, trustee. Two of them are couple. The windows are staining glass display the Bible teaching. The building has two stories allow the believer to gather. The altar is magnificent when you take the first step in the building. The back of the cathedral is a giant display of organ pipe tube. The ceiling is painted with many picture and nicely done. It really creates a house of God for all people. The outside show the tower of three tier story and three towers.   We were in the cathedral at the morning with the temperature of 47 degree is an escape to the cold weather. A sanctuary that keep us warm and press on to the next destination. It is free and good to visit place.

Drive through is sloooooow. It take 3.5 minutes to move a car. If you cannot wait, just walk in to the counter is faster. I figure if you see more than 5 cars ahead of you, just walk in. This store clerk need to process a bit faster.   Food is good, just service is slow. I believe they can improve on this front. This store now receive a face lift. It was remodel to modern look. It should a new face resolution for this store  They take my order but have to wait for 3.5 minutes. The cooking process also need to speed up. I hope they can improve since they have new look.

The California taco pricing is well above many open air taco joint or food truck. However their taco also bigger than most of the taco joint. They do pack a lot of meat. Normally I need four taco to fill me up, but here just need three. In the sense it is about equal price.   I have the the chorizo with shrimp, Carne asada, and pastor. The best is the Pastor and the least like is the shrimp with chorizo. I wish their shrimp can grilled a little more. The pastor certainly has a lot of flavor. Each piece of meat is grilled. Each taco has two corn tortillas. They top with veggie with dice tomato. I also has a pineapple Jarritos drink. Good and cold in this hot weather.   Overall the experience is good. But if you want to try more taco choice, you have to paid more.

We have invited a family to try this new Filipino restaurant and we all excited. We reach there at Saturday 6:15 and we are the only second group of the customer. Later it filled up with another 6 table before we left the restaurant. They are not that busy. They also advertise you can watch the Floyd Mayweather and Manny Pacquiao 5/2/2015 fight there. Manny Pacquiao is Pilipino super lightweight boxer.   The waitress is kind to explain to us each dish and what materials are used.  We have started two appetizers. The chicken wing with adobo glaze and the chicken sisig lettuce wrap. We like the chicken sisig. I think if they add some sweet sauce, it will make this dish more attractive. The chicken wing is fried. They are nicely fried plainly. Then it adds the adobo glaze sauce. The chicken wing batter before fried can be adding some spice to enhance the flavor.   The dishes are beef toscilog, Crispy pata kare kare, mixed grill. The beef toscilog come with half cook egg that you can break the egg yolk and mix with the rice. The pan grill beef make this dish desirable. The crispy pata is the fried pig feet. The pig feet are the lower part of the leg. I prefer upper part which has more meat. The pig feet are fried and I like the other sauce instead of kare kare sauce.   The mixed grill is the squid, pork belly, chicken and eggplant. Among them I like the grilled eggplant. This is the most expansive dish in the menu $32. Three of us stomach did not receive the food well for this dish. We believe the squid is not the fresh material that causes this.   Base on Filipino food, the price is at the high side. Quality of material is not the best such as the squid. Service is slow and checks back frequently. Restaurant is well decorated. I think it is worth for a try and been there done that type of deal.

Jersey Mike's Sub is my favorite sandwich store. Because they are the only one that carry hot ham (cappacuolo). I have looking for many places and try to buy and slice myself but was not successful. The cappacuolo here is bit spicy and is in good taste. I always orders my sandwich just cappacuolo, lettuce, tomato, and the secret ingredient - bacon!!! I like to order them in wheat bread and spice up my sandwich Mike's way - oil, red vinaigrette, salt, pepper, and mike secret spice. No other thing added such as mayo. This is YUM.   The sub menu also has the club supreme, original Italian, roast beef and provolone, the super sub. Other than the sub I like above, I like the super sub which is No. 5 sub. Provolone, ham, prosciuttini and cappacuolo and I alway add bacon. This is the restaurant after I have greasy food the night before and I come here to redeem myself. Interesting to said I am redeem with two strip of bacons.   Other than the cold sub, they also have hot sub such as Steak Philly, big kahuna cheese steak, meat ball, chicken Parmesan, Reuben , chipotle. Lake many sub store start adding the frito chip to create crunchy feeling. I think this direction has ruined many year of tradition.

This travel center basically a truck stop and gas for many. It has Arby's and Popeyes in the building. They serve to patron and truckers who need food, gas, and shelter. It is located at Interstate 4 at Mango exit. They and the other truck stop draw a lot of truck traffic.   The price of the gas is just average. But some time they are most lowest price along I-4. They have the front pump for passengers car and the back pump for the truck. The truck has separated entrance which make it safe for passengers car.

Very nice park. It has wide area of green space near the water. Many events were hold here. Blues Festival is one of them. I would not stay at the apartment close to here due to loud music may escalate to the apartment.   The park is very nice. This is where the big fire work from the city and big holiday celebration location. It is nice to have it. It do have some parking at the back of the park. There is a dog park nearby which my yelp friend constantly bring his dog.   I would say take the 7th Ave is the easy access to this park.

I have been to this restaurant when they are at the old location. Since they move to this larger seating area area, I have been to this restaurant once. The area have a lot seats to accommodate big banquet.   Our regular dish that we have order in this place is the sea snail with basil sauce. This is the few places serve this snail that I know in Bay Area. The snails are cook with sweet brown sauce with basil and scallions. To eat it, performed the initial suck on the opening and let the meat come out a bit, remove the meat thin cover. Use the toothpick to pry it out and eat it. Our dish have about 57 snails in a order.   The restaurant was open in thanksgiving night and we enjoy our time here. The service is good. We also order the the west lake mince beef soup. The beef is process and very tender. The soup is thicken with egg white. It is a good soup.

The line for dinner is 45 minutes wait. Fortunately they are only one block away from the Canal Street where we can wait and watch the parade. They will assign you a buzzer. And the buzzer range is about 1 block.   This restaurant is recommended by our taxi driver. He has indicated the local love this place. Tonight we have order Crawfish étouffée and Seafood combo. The seafood combo is the fried shrimp, catfish and oyster. The coating is Louisiana bread coating with dry coat. The cat fish and the oyster is killer in this dish. The cat fish is fresh that do not smell fishy. The fish is soft and tender. The oyster in New Orleans is different and soft after fried. The chef did a very good job. Normal fried oyster is a bit rubbery but the chef here make it almost like raw oyster soft.   The pre-meal items came with the broil potatoes. The potatoes are inch in diameter. They broiled and coated with spicy salt spice that I could not guess what spice. It is good. The crawfish came with salad with sweet vinaigrette dressing. A bit sweet for me but is good.   The Crawfish étouffée is one of the New Orleans must try item other than Gumbo and Jambalaya. This is a gumbo soup base material with rice and crawfish. This crawfish is broil alive and the shell is removed. The crawfish then added to the soup base with rice. The dish has more than 30 crawfish tail. This is a good dish.

This Philippino restaurant has good potential. I like the food there because affordable and quick. If you decided for fast food that day, you might as well chose this restaurant. You will have combo meal less than $10.   We have two meat combo meal. My order is fried milk fish and the fried lechon. This are my two favorite dish. I like the milk fish because of the flavor. The lechon is the fried pork belly. It is crispy when I get it. My wife has the adobo chicken, lumpia and the rice noodle. This food are great. Especially the adobo chicken was cook nice and different from many adobo that I have taste in a good way.  We also have the halo halo. The drink have a lot of thing inside including different types of jelly and bean. Love the purple ice cream. It is fancy. The reason they are not 5 stars is all food are serve at tray and pick your combination. I hope they can cook by order at the spot to keep the food hot by order instead from the seating tray pick up order.

Carne is center located in the the heart Ybor. The restaurant is a historic building in Ybor. Many local people has pass by may not notice this is a historic building.   The interior is really nice. Do you know the owner parent dance in this hall before he invested and become the restaurant. The deco is really nice when you walk in the dinning hall.   The service here is on the point and fast since they have enough manpower. Do you know they run special before 7 pm. The special are the Prime Rib and Fish & Chip for $9.99. Good deal. We have ordered the prime rib and the Carne Hanger Steak Chimichurri.  The prime rib is big and thick. I like the juicy steak. The hanger steak is well marinated. The outside well brown and not charcoal. I like the burn a bit taste. The steak is perfect and soft.   Overall we have a good experience. No wow factor but solid restaurant.

Solid 4 stars and very close to 4.5 stars restaurant. I like the set up with new lay out of the restaurant. They have some car area. It is hip restaurant with good Korea style fried chicken. Very simple menu and easy selection.   They started with banchan with Korean appetizers. I like the banchan because they have good choices. I like fish cake, and dry small fish. We started with the house gimbap. It is Korean sushi roll. It come with 12 pieces. I have the Korean Style Fried Chicken. The sauce we choose is sweet and spicy with soy pepper on the side. Both sauce is good but the sweet spicy is better. My wife have the seafood bibimbap. It is delicious with crispy rice on the edge of stone bowl.   Overall is good. Service is also good. Food is good. Price is reasonable. Definitely a plate to be for meal or snack.

This is hot place for ramen in town. They are not the cheapest in town but good taste. The reservation can be setup or you have to wait for long time at restaurants. They do have the bar section to wait before you sit.   I have the champon ramen. This supposed to must try ramen. They are $16 is most expensive in the Bay Area. The soup base is good not the best in Bay Area. However, the taste is make up with the accompanying ginger tempura, fried sesame seed and other items make this soup better than most ramen restaurant. I have to said this is not the traditional way of ramen material for pork belly or grilled shrimp. However, it has good flavor. The pork belly do have the three part harmony (skin, fat, meat) cooking. In fact I like their way. The shrimp is great with good touch of marinated and grilled.   The reason they are 4 stars are as below: 1. I was there at the 5 pm starting the dinner service. The restaurant is empty and they decided call in group by group and take 15 minutes. Ridiculous!  They can go in all the first group to fill the restaurant and they choose not. 2. If you paid $16 dollars for they most like-able ramen, why they don't include all combination include the fermented egg, seaweed, bacon. This is top dollar bowl already. 3. If the price is the most pricy among the ramen restaurant, why we have to sit on stool. Put some comfortable chair please. This is America not Japan. Even in Japan they have seat with back support except the bar counter area.   This is not to put down a restaurant but a lesson and opinions for the restaurant to improve. Food is good. When the honeymoon period is over, they need to think how to get the customer for revisit. Food is 5 stars.

Just average. Food can be exciting but I think it is seasoning. It has enough spice but just not above the typical Greek fast food chain. I like the open seating after order. They bring the food to the table that make it easy.   I have the grill tilapia sandwich. The size of the fish is big. The blacken spice is not strong enough. The dill sauce has too much lemon with combination of caper. I would rather the caramelize the onion with caper that go well with the fish. Seem like the combination do not for into mixed flavor of the fish.   We also has the hummus with half pita fried and half non fried. I like this better. Overall the experience is good. Good interior decoration, service is nice and friendly. Taste of the food may need to rediscover through R&D to get a good hold of consumers preferred style.

I was surprised this grocery has some great Italian goods. I thought that this is just a regular grocery store. They carry some interesting grocery items not normally found. They do carry some international grocery items.   To start, their fresh produce has a lot of varieties. They got it from local market and bag it at the same day. It is also including the live herb that still in the pot. You can get those and pick the leaves and cook for fresh ingredients.   They have the home made chorizo with buy one and get one free. The home made Italian sausages are displayed in the climate control glass storage cabinets. The flavor includes thick cheese with parsley, mild sausage, kielbasa and more.   Fresh seafood and prepared seasoning seafood are on display. Giant scallops, fillets tilapia, peeled shrimp are beautifully displayed. Poultry, meat cut was there for your choice.   I like their ice cream. We have the hazel nut Italian ice cream that is heavenly good.

Walmart in this area is at the corner of the highway exit is easy to get to. In addition, they are kind in the independent property which has no close by business except Wawa. Its location make a good center to serve the Lutz and lake Magdalene.   This place has plenty of parking. I like easy access. The store is organized. The goods are well displayed and sign is clear and direct. Plenty of check out counter to help people paid. This Walmart has grocery, bakery, hot deli. It is convenient to make one stop location for housewives.  We were here to small area door mat and the veggies. Our experience on the checkout is pleasant. Only a little wait. It was close to valentine day and pink color everywhere. Including the flower, balloons, stuff toy and card. Very festive.

It is my wife often visit art stores. We got our fist custom frame from this store. We have special cut Chinese blessing word that need to be frame. We ask the store to provide see through frame and the edge of frame that is strong to hang without notice the hang line. They have achieved it.   After Christmas, they have the Christmas decorations on sale. It is good time after Christmas to look for bargain items for next year. They are many to choose from.   The art stores has plenty of silk flowers if you need to decorate your home. Of course they have frame department to help you which they did a good job to our custom frame. Wood work to be paint by yourself or the painting items you need are on display.   They also have small item such as color letter to design the house number. If you host a party and need a party favors, you may pick up thing or two.

Haus coffee has a fair price in coffee business. I alway think most of the coffee or tea place are overpriced. But Haus is fair on the coffee price.   The coffee house also has the pastry, breakfast, or sandwich in mixed. Those item do attract more customers to enjoy. Their corner store has outdoor seating if you bring a pet.   I was going to get one of the coffee but today they have the pumpkin spice special chai tea. I ask for a cold ice large cup. The chai have good taste. It is rare to get pumpkin spice. But we are close to holloween which has potentially offer this special.

Rick is located  in very seclusion area at the Hillsborough River. It is not too far from the Amateurwork. The river and marina  are good backdrop for the restaurant. The patio seating is good area for the view and enjoy live music. Rick is a sport bar restaurant with minimum TV which is ooze of the improvement that need to made.   We were here for a glass of beer with food. We started with the little neck clam. I like this dish a lot because of the quality and sauce. It is a dish to get if you visit.   Our entree is the coconut shrimp dinner and catfish basket. The coconut shrimp is butterfly and fried. It come with sweet sauce. The catfish coating is crunchy. Although the coating is not seasoning but still good for fish fry.   The service is good. Food come out quick.

Experience is good at cafe Ole. We were here during their grand reopening day. Certain tapas is only $5. They usually run this tapas on certain day and time for $5.95.   We have the Patatas con Chorizo, Banderillas, Calamares Fritos, Tortilla de Patatas and free Kobe beef slider. The Banderillas is grill skirt steak kabab in Chimichurri sauce. It is my favorite.  The fried calamari is big ring. The tortilla de Patatas is tradition food that they want to try. It is the Spanish potato omelet with alioli sauce. The also serve free Kobe slider free at the bar and they are good taste. We also added the mussel garlic, onion and basil mariana sauce.   The entree is the Churrasco A Laparrila. It come with potato and stir fry veggie. This dish is decent  at it asking price. Overall service is good. If you are soccer fan for Spanish football club, this is the place you don't want to miss. They are plenty of soccer fan here watching their game.

I was here to have a take out. I have this restaurant bookmark since my friends in yelp M&M has been here. The restaurant is well decorated with Bob Marley picture. They also has salt water fish tank.   I got the their two best saler in the menu. The oxtail and the jerk chicken. The oxtail was well sauce marinated into the bone. The tail is braised till the meat fall off the bone. The jerk chicken is marinated till enter the meat. Then it grilled to perfection. When you use your finger to eat the chicken, you still can smell the marinated sauce at your finger after you have finished the chicken. Each dish come with rice, stir fry veggies.   I also got their conch soup. It is a bit fishy but it is good. Love all the food here. Portion is big to feed the hungry person. Price is above the average Jamaican restaurant but the the portion measured up the price.

After the yelp event. I decided to give them a formal review by visiting them during lunch time. The place certainly is busy. I like the interior decoration during my first visit. It is certainly beautiful and pleasing on the repeat visit.   This time I got the classic dish with the sampler. The fish I got is the Jambalaya, Crawfish Pie and Chicken File Gumbo. Among three, the crawfish pie is the best. The pie is actually look like the pastry wrap with crawfish and veggies inside. The crust is very good and the flavor is good in the infill. The jambalaya may need a bit more Andouille sausage. I only see two cut pieces in it. The chicken file gumbo has the good gumbo base. Preferably the seafood gumbo.   Overall my visit is good. Service is good in the bar area. Food come out quick. I was able to finish my lunch less than 40 minutes.

They are busy consider in USF area for pawn shop. I would consider this place if you need somethings use and not cost a lot of money. We were here for a music instruments amps. However they don't have any.   The whole store has a lot of large speaker. A lot of use tools a If you have a housing project like lawn care, side pressure wash, power tool. They have them all. The bicycle is a bit old.   They even have a use boat for sales. I forgot to ask them do they list sale for the consignment item. Overall, they are the biggest store here. The item is a bit old, other than that they are good store.

My revisit was the best. We have a chance to take a photo with the executive chef of the restaurant. We like to thanks Jessica Boyd for setting up our company holiday party here. Definitely have a good time here. Service was excellent. And thanks to Chad Bash to allow us enter the reserved room earlier before our set time. Their special room can can seat 50 people easily and good for smaller wedding party too.   Tonight I try their different cocktail. Each one has their unique taste. My first one is the salted caramel martini, it is sweet with foam above. Second is the tall and sexy, definitely this tall glass attractive with beautiful waist look glass. If you are thirsty, this is the drink to go. The next is the Bourbon Barrel Aged Spice Sangria, this special make sangria which is great for accompanying the meat dish. The next is I believe scofflaw but not sure. The last is the Midnight Martini to wake me up with coffee drinks. It has good coffee in it. My friend enjoy the Black Widow and the Sacred Margarita. They even pull out a virgin Black Widow for a non alcohol soft drink. It was good for them. The margarita was the best among my friends because it come with fruit press for the drinks before pour. Unique. Some of my friends order the virgin pina colada and Daiquiri. They enjoy it.   Overall the good are great love the appetizers and main dish.

This library is one of my wife most visited. She come here for Ukulele jam. The community ukulele jam is popular here. This library is kind of New in Hillsborough compared to other libraries.   This library is kind of small. They do have the quiet room for study. The chairs are comfortable. Book circulation is average size. The interior is wide and nice. Movie DVD check out is free for all taxpayers.   Parking is available and they are easy access from Dale Mabry even though they are located on Manhattan. It is good for the south Tampa residents.

Liang is an old restaurant in New Tampa. I have been here several time but was not give them a review. The restaurant is popular by American Chinese Food. I mean better than normal take out but not authentic enough to call traditional Chinese food. Most dish is more into sweet side.   We have their lunch special orang chicken and black pepper beef. The orang chicken is their best dish. Good orange peel flavor. The accompanying can have a choice white rice, brown rice or fried rice. Their fried rice is a better choice. It also come with a choice of soup and we got the egg drop. The pepper beef is just like most take out Chinese food. Good beef.   One thing for sure they did it correctly is their packaging. It is air tight and not spilling out. Good container system. The restaurant is about 3.75 stars. It can survive for long time certainty has it client tail.

I have been to this Wawa many time when I on my way to my badminton game to west side of Progress Blvd. this Wawa has good price in the Riverview area. It has plenty gas pump when there is many car pull in. The only thing I don't like is single roll gas pumps.   It has Wawa drinks for $1.99 special. The convenience store and sub restaurants is great for grab something and go. Area is clean.

We love our restaurant street at old height. This restaurant I have bookmark for some time. I love the creative chef went out their own and have their independent restaurant.
