This business owner did a good job for themselves. We were here on Friday night late after 8 pm. There were seats in this restaurant. The seating area is limited. Very nice clean bathroom.   Tonight we order three small plate. The escargot, the sear blue fin tuna, and the mussel. The escargot is seat on the bread and pour in wine sauce. It make it perfect when they are soak. The escargot is in good size and they about 10 pieces. Sauce is about the right touch for the escargot. The mussel come with creamy sauce. It is a good dish to pickup not over power the material.   I like the tuna the best. This a blue fin tuna in belly section. It is a bit fatter and rich in taste. They are likely seared top with a bit soy sauce with fragrant  taste and lay over a special chili sauce.   The price for the small plate is good. The price of the large plate in about the medium to high side. Not much of seating area but good enough for the night.

Yelping #1300. This one go to the local restaurant that has very good potential.   Ebisu is new and up coming Sushi restaurant. 8/5 will be their anniversary. They have special for the night. The celebration included live band, special dish, freebies and discount.   We arrived one day before their anniversary. We got here a little after 5 pm. We were the second group of the day. This place is popular after we have sit down. Many have followed. The menu did not has an spectacular wording to attract you. We have order the early bird special. The special is classic roll buy one get one half off. We have order the spicy tuna, negihama yellow tail, unakyu eel cucumber, Mexican fried shrimp avocado. This roll are fresh and well prepared.   We also order the Salmon Oyako Don - salmon sashimi with salmon roe and rice. The salmon was very fatty and good. We also got the special of the day, the fatty tuna sashimi. Wow. What a good piece of tuna. Very rich and nice.   The reason they are true 5 stars is because their quality of the fish is top grade in compare to many Japanese restaurant. It definitely worth the money.

I was here when they were different restaurant. I can believe the new owner change this place for good. The food is looking more interesting. They still kept it as wine bar. The seating is more open. Their food has Asian fusion and some french influence.   We were immediately seat. After order, we noticed several table has not received their food yet. I kind expecting a wait. If the food is good, I don't mind waiting. We have order the charred octopus and Tuscan mussels. The wait is about 25 minutes. However, it worth the wait. The chef do have some skill. The Tuscan mussels is cook at Saffron Tomato Broth. It good with the company grilled bread to dip. The best is the chargrilled octopus. I like the end piece of of the tentacles. It has the most flavor. This octopus was marinated good. I like the octopus ink that was cook at below. Well done dish.   The service is good. The speed of the food delivery need to be faster.

Coachman Park is Clearwater most celebrate park. It locate next to the Clearwater Memorial Causeway. This bridge become the monument of the park and pleasant to look at. The July Fourth celebration is huge here. It drawn thousands of people in this park and the security is step up for the event goer.   Clearwater Pierce Street Market also drawn people gather in this area. Music venue is often conduct here. It is good city park make the Clearwater to celebrate. The park is at the Harbor Bluff Water Front. They are shield from the Gulf Mexico. Which is make the water taxi from the beach to the city is very smooth accessible. The water taxi also connect the Clearwater Marine Aquarium from the famous Winter dolphin. If you feel not to drive more, you can park there and take the water taxi then take the trolley back to aquarium. You can enjoy the water ride.   I love to come to this place to enjoy my time with friends. Many concert hold here. Enjoy the open sky and the music is a treat

Yelping #1800. This go to the local restaurant has great interior.   I was here for a solo dinner. I found a place at the bar with great atmosphere. Almost every spots are occupied. The bar has a nice decoration hanging on a T cross beam. I know the owner did not mean it to be sacred flowers on the cross but I think is perfect.   I start with their signature cocktails. The black widow. It is a silver tequila, agave nectar, blackberry, lime juice and a leave of fresh basil. It do have enough alcohol for the tequila. The blackberry accompanied well. It is a good drink.   The entree is the Hawaii Delmonico. It is angus ribeye marinated in the pineapple and sweet soy. It is Hawaiian thing. I ask the steak to be medium rare. I was hoping they glaze without over burn because it is sweet. The chef did a good job not just prepared to the order, it caramelized the entire steak. It is great to have it.   My night is perfect. The bar service is very attentive. I like pre-meal item. The bread with chili bell oil sauce is well balanced. If you think about special occasions with manageable budget, this is a great place to celebrate your occasion.

Authentic Cuisine #60. Mexican dessert.   This dessert store is one of the kind. I was surprised to bump into it when I shop at this plaza. It has minimum 50 different dessert items that you can choose. The make up of the dessert is eye pleasing.   I started with cucumber soft drinks to quench my thirst. The cucumber water was fresh and nice. We got esquite as salty dessert. It is the corn and cheese. It is warm and nice. I got the strawberry Fresada. It has chili powder, strawberry slice, some kind Mexican candy. The drink has strawberry smoothie. It is typical interesting drink.   We also got the popsicle. It has fresh food. Many choices of popsicle. They also has churros ice cream. They also carry tapas like shrimp cocktail in Mexican style. One thing for sure. Your experience here will be one of the kind. It is not like your typical dessert that you normally have.

Decent restaurant at the island. The outside sitting area can view the boat dock. You can reach here with the boat or car. The restaurant has modern look interior design. The bar area connect inside and outside with circular bar.   We have order the lunch menu with lobster roll, salad, and grilled grouper sandwich. The lobster roll looks good with three bun height roll. The grouper come with one side. I have the french fried as a side. The grouper is firm and fresh but the grilled technique need to be improved. It need slightly burn to bring out the meat taste.   The food came out in very quick time. They must have good kitchen help. I like this way. The service is very good compared to many restaurant. The management of this restaurant is reach the customers goal.

Sarge is very close the University of Tampa. They are in the food court sharing with three other restaurants. With their location close to the university, they got a lot of college student visits.   We got the smokehouse club. The meat do pile up like mountain. This sandwich has the pork, chicken and brisket. It top with bacon strips and the claw slaw. The bacon is not quite crispy. Meat is a bit dry. The sandwich can better if they improve on it. Price is matching the amount of food was given.

This restaurant is like Philippino cuisine with upscale dining. This restaurant located at clubhouse of the tennis club. It is surrounded by 17 tennis court. Mainly serving the people who play tennis here. It is kind of tuck away from main street.   The restaurant is well set up. Restaurant name is Match Point Grilled. It also call Karma coffee. I was confused at first when I walk into the restaurant. We ordered Kare Kare. This dish serve with traditional oxtail. It come with rice. The quantity of oxtail is less and not matching the price listed. The other dish we have is the Beef Afritada. It is tomato base stew. This dish give a little more beef. It is come with rice.   We feel the price list are not measure up the food that serve. Food is a bit less of the taste. Service is good. Atmosphere is great. It is kind been there done that restaurant.

Near Pinellas Park for economic food. It is a Mexican place but has some good enough tacos. Space is very small. Not much of seat but it has the good food.   I have the Lamb, steak and pastor tacos. They are tasty and quick. It take me less than 30 minutes from order to finished the food and paying. It is fast paced food compared to any fast food restaurant. Price is reasonable and average among the taco joint.   Service is good and precise. They do have the tamales, steak, grilled shrimp or fried whole fish if you want to spend a little more.

We think we had been to La Pequena until a friend told me that it not their main restaurant. We actually went to the express. The one that have water mill at the front is the express.  The actual restaurant is actually on the right of the plaza in the same location. This time we get to the right main restaurant. The menu here is definitely different and plentiful to select.   We have order the salmon special and their beef soup. The food portions are huge. Material is well prepared. Value is definitely there. The salmon is grilled and top with mango sauce. The accompanying sides are rice tostone and fried yucca. The fish is grilled to the way I like it. The beef soup is one of the best. This time we are asking the soup with grilled palomino steak. It has yucca and beef meat in tiny pieces.   When we eat there the next door has salsa music. We saw a lot waiter in and out. We walk across the building door and found the dancing room is part of the restaurant. Very nice. Fern need to be here. Now you eat, drink and play in one place.

J C has good Caribbean flavor with spicy twist. This restaurant opened during pandemic. It need local love to support them. The restaurant now only accept 14 customers at a time during pandemic. Limited seating. I got a to go order.   I got the jerk chicken and the oxtail. The jerk chicken has good spicy kick on it. The chicken skin is delicious. The marinated it into the bone. I like that way. The oxtail has thick soupy marinated outside. The meat is fall off the bone. Both dishes come with coconut flavor bean rice. It was delicious. They do have choices on salad or cook cabbage. I would suggest you go for the cabbage.   From order to pick up is about 15 minutes. Call ahead will be needed. The lunch menu only for weekday. The weekend price same as dinner which I said they are at the high side.

This is the Italian restaurant that we have try to walk in and we were turn away due to full reservation. But our second visit with reservation was seat immediately. I would highly recommend reservation for this restaurant. I saw many table at least has a bottle of wine. I also read some of the previous review, they allow bring alcohol without open cork fees.   We have a dish of the seafood linguini with wine sauce and a special of the day with stuff calamari e polenta. The linguini seafood wine sauce can feel a lot of wine in the sauce. However, my wife feel the seafood is a bit bad to her stomach and I also think the sauce is blend. The calamari with red sauce is excellent. I am not the fan of the crab stuffing but love the sauce and calamari.   It is mix feeling with the experience. It can be 3.5 stars easy. But not for tonight. Service is good but the kitchen need help to put the food out.

It is a local favorite Italian food. It is definitely one of the kind Italian food near Wesley Chapel. Very delicious and authentic. Family own and only store.   With that said. Let get inside the food. We started with the garlic knots. It has eight of them. It has garlic butter sauce. I would suggest take two of the knots out and look into bottom of the plate for garlic. That is the best part of these knots. You will need to dig to the garlic itself.   Our entrees is Cioppino. This is a seafood dish. This dish enough to feed minimum three may four. It is seafood combination with pasta in red tomato sauce. The dish is homemade Linguine with baby clam, mussels, shrimp and top with fried calamari. It is like appetizers on top of the meal. I would the shrimp is not bouncy fresh but good hard meat. I believe this is the area they can be easily improved. As a result they are not really solid 4 stars. Since they give a lot of food. It remains 4 stars.

Tonight experience is about 4 stars. We have a reservation on upstairs. The food is as good as last time I have remembered. After first plate 60% of the food is gone. I have enough but some of my friends went down the floor to get the food and they are kind of clean out. I would not call this as buffet. I only can call it as a feast.

Following Coty review and try this place out. Very Good Vietnamese sandwich cafe. It has the local flavor. It located almost like a little Vietnamese town. It near the Vietnamese supermarket.   Other than the sandwich, they also serve boba cold smoothie. I have the avocado slush. No bad at all. I also order the BBQ pork and the ham sandwich. The BBQ pork is typical char siew pork. But their own type BBQ sauce. It is ok.   Overall they are good taste. You can get everything under $10 for quick snack. Since is order fro counter, tip is up to you.

If need home cooking, this is your place. The restaurant chef prepare the meal from beginning. A lot of work. The dish that I have need a lot of time to prepare. I have the OX tail that was cook for long time to make it soft. It cook in the Caribbean spice and has a lot of Indian influence. The tail must be slow cook to make it separate from the bone. This dish accompanied with cabbage and the bean rice. You can have the choice of white rice.   I also have the flower drink - Sorrel. They prepared it and put in the cup and store in their refrigerators. Sweet treat. They have some other food please check it out. They also have fried fish. You can call ahead to have your fish prepare before you arrive. It will take some time to fried. The owner of the restaurant is very friendly. I like about this mom and pop shop.

About 3.5 stars. The drive through can be faster. It take some time to clear the line due to single window. The recent new addition is the smoke house chicken. This bourbon black pepper flavor. It was delicious especially the coating. Definitely you need to give a try for the new recipe.   The chicken skin is crispy. Brown sugar and pepper coated. It is a good delicious chicken with capture the juiciness. It come with gravy mash potatoes and a sweet top coated biscuit. I have not been to church chicken for long time. But this is a recipe to keep.

This is a Spain cuisine restaurant with music venue at weekend. You can book a private event. It is quite a busy booking. Sometimes the booking is a wedding rehearsal or baby shower.   The food of the restaurant is average for Spain cuisine. But I would say try their tapas. It is great to enjoy their tapas at the weekend and have some wine with live flamenco guitar music. They have the music every week end. Please check their calendar.   The reason they are four stars is they have the flamenco dance and dinner show on every month. The show team has three female dancers and one male dancer. Man oh man! They are good. Very move is a posture of art. The flamenco guitar add the twist of the show. It almost like a whole band. I would said this is the best flamenco show in the Bay Area.

May be the dish I have order didn't impress me. I have book mark this place for some time. I was having a high hope for it. Tuk Tuk is rickshaw in Thailand. So this is mobile food.    The menu show interesting selection. One thing catch my eyes is their crab fried rice. I got one of that. I also got their Thai ice tea. The Thai ice tea has strong enough tea in it. I like it the milk and tea mixed.   I have the crab fried in Thai hot. It does bring on the heat. But the dish did not impress me for several reasons. The rice is too watery. The tomato put in there actually damp the wetness of the dish. It is not a good combo. The crab meat it spread in thin pieces. It can be chunky. It has crab taste but not really crab meat taste. May be they use the blue crab instead of dungeons.   Services is average. The initial contact is a bit slow but the close up and paid is quick.

Good healthy choice. I would recommend this place. They are USF student and faculty favorite. The food is just like it Name. Fresh and good for you.   We have an office lunch and we have a group order of 8. I got the Power Bowl and the Ahi Tuna. The power bowl is saute'ed carrots, kale slaw, brown rice and quinoa mixed with almonds, raisins, goat cheese and homemade kale-basil pesto. I am ok with the kale basil pesto sauce. But the salad bowl is great because it has the pre mix sauce in it.   The Ahi tuna was seared correctly. I believe the outside is coated with spice that very close to all bay seasoning. The seafood is good since the tuna is sushi grade. If you feel like to cut down your protein, this is your good place. The eight orders we got was correct per the order.

Previously this location was occupied by the other taco food truck call El Charrito. Now it is new food truck for this place and also serve taco. I got here before the rain. Thanks goodness they have overhead cover to allow the customer to stay dry next the the food truck. It has about three table under the tent if you decide to eat there.   Today I have the steak, pastor, carnitas, and lengua taco. All tacos are $2 except lengua is $2.50. All taco come with 2 corn tortillas in case you break one and the other can be addition protection from the meat to fall apart. The pastor pork has a lot of flavor. It is the different way to marinate the pork I have seen for all my taco experience. The taco is tasty and good for snack or quick lunch. Food delivery is quick. Don't need to wait long.

This hospital is clean and good facilities. Usually at the January and March I have the high allergy sensitive with my breathing system. I usually take zertec 10 mg to prevent my running noise. But I still sneezing due to sensitive pollen condition. When I came to this hospital the sneezing stop. The hospital must has some kind of allergen filter system that allow me to breath better. I always joking about go away vacation from Florida or any part of United State during pollen season that save me suffering from pollen. But I think I found the place that close to home without pollen-the hospital. Ha!ha!    This hospital have great facilities. Their ER room is well staff with veteran nurses. The cardiac care unit (CCU) is great with modern equipment. Their ICU is not as beautiful as the CCU. The Peppin building has a nice entrance.  This is a great hospital to visit. Don't take vacation here, the room of all hospital is expensive compare to any hotel. :)

If you like coffee, hips, music, express yourself, listen to other, this may be your place. Every Monday they have blue jam then open mic. You can go express your self.   They have ton of coffee mix here. I would said the menu is thick. I am not sure I will able to finish all. They have coffee name after TV series like banshee, TV movie Beowulf, Queen Mary and more. This may be the only coffee place that my wife can drink the decafe and able to sleep at night past 12 pm.   Some night, you can practice joke telling to see it work. The place has very interesting furniture and chair. The center stage is locate very center in the shop. They also music live performance at some night. Pretty much every seat is good. There are book you can pick from the shelf. It is very strange coffee shop that is opened after 6 pm.

This is for the review strictly about the Poke. Obviously this market located 1 mile away from St Petersburg downtown. This restaurant is located at the neighborhood of Old Southeast, as a result, they call themselves the same name.   The grocery store's alcohol wine collection has a lot of choices. They do have a wall of soft drink and special drinks in the refrigerator. In the grocery store it has a few seat for anyone who wants to eat there.    For the poke, since they are situated on the non compete area, it becomes the local favorite. In compare to Tampa Bay Area, they are in the middle of the pack. This is due to competition store has unlimited choices in compare to three choices on the added on. The other place can mixed and match on the sauce. This place has pre set sauce with your choice to add into poke. I have to give them credit some of the sauce are home mixed that other place do not has it. Overall the quantity is just at average in compare other. Add on is so so not quit interesting.

Winn Dixie located convenient location near USF. Many students and local has shop this place. The grocery store is the anchor store of this plaza. It brings a lot of customers to visit. During the pandemic, shoppers wear mask to shop. I wish all grocery store to provide the disposable glove. This way they can touch the item and reshelf if they decide don't want it.   We visited close 10 before 5pm. But the hot daily already empty their selection. It is too early. I wonder they changed their store hour. Recently the are has a lot of looting. The item on the shelf is medium stock or reshelf. I feel their store is a bit let down. Beer section is a bit high price. The wine selection is average.   Other than that, the grocery store serve the local need.

About 4.5 stars restaurant. Close to 5. I like the food here. This restaurant really have a charm in Tampa Bay Area. A long history that survived for that long should have they secret of success. They do have one of the best court yards and party room.   They cuisine is Mexico St Miguel region food. I got the Enchiladas Miguel. This dish top with St Miguel Enchiladas sauce is really good. Not sure where they mixed this sauce. But is really good. The grilled beef is great beef and good marinated in the Enchiladas. I would definitely recommend this dish at lunch.   My wife have the Chile Relleno. This dish is interesting. It is Poblano Pepper fill with spicy pork. Basically you have to open up the pepper to see the spicy pork inside. Great presentation.   For the appetizers we have the ceviche. Mexican ceviche is different than most Latin ceviche. It is shrimp and scallops toss with avocado, olives, cilantro with their homemade cocktails sauce. It does not use lime. Very interesting.   Service just good. May be need more attentive. My waiter is too busy on other table. Sign of area need improvement.

Great food and good price. This is very much sum up the entire review. It is easy to give this restaurant a good review. The new restaurant do bring a lot good to the neighborhood especially for blue collar workers. If you need a good box food, I recommend this is the place. For me, I prefer to eat there because they just prepare fresh.   We started with the pork spring roll and chicken egg roll. These rolls are the complimentary from the restaurant. We added the charshu Bao. The spring and egg roll is freshly fried. Very good. The Bao has good steam bun. The price come with three Bao which has a lot of meat. Love the Bao and sauce on it.   We got the bulgogi and grilled pork noodle bowl. The bulgogi is the best. The steak of the bulgogi is soft and tender. Good to bite. The grilled pork has good seasoning. It is a bit different then most Vietnamese food but I like this way.   I like restaurants set the food in right price. This restaurant make it to the list. It is convenient to have the box during pandemic. If you cannot finished, you can carry it home.

This is Chicago style fried chicken and fish. One of the kind in Tampa Bay Area. It is located on Northview Hills neighborhood. Just 1/2 miles south of Hillsborough Avenue on N 34 street. The actual address an street is actually on the Orsborne Ave. next to beauty salon.   I would said call ahead and order. They fried their food after you have ordered it. It take at least 15 minutes wait. Worth a while to get the fresh fried food. We got the two pieces leg and thigh meal. The coating is special. You can request hard fried which mean longer. The chicken is juicy. I like the coating. That is something different.   Other than chicken, they have gizzards, catfish, basa, whiting, shrimp and nuggets. This choice has side items or you can choose their side items.

We were here for the burger week. My wife look up the burger week special and feel that Birch and Vine is best on the list. So we have decided to paid them visit.   The restaurant is part of the Birchwood hotel. The restaurant is at the ground floor. The interior design is beautiful with 6 partial circle booth. The wine display is impressive. At least thousand bottles of wine in temperature control room attached to the dining hall wall.   My wife got the burger week surf and turf. This burger top with big pieces of lobster and bottom with high grade burger beef patty. This is an impressive dish. I got the grill lamb chop. It was good flavor.   Overall they are measured up with chef skill on the food. If their service can be better, they probably 5 stars. The service is a bit slow. The ambiance is nice to have romantic dinner.

TBD is not to be determined. It is Tea Bowls and Desserts. Get it. This kind of Filipino food with boba tea and nice dessert. Certainly is worth a visit for your money. Imagine you can get a bowls with boba tea for $10. Not many place has that kind of price. If you order a bowls of food, the drinks is $2 extra. Each bowl roughly $8. Great deal.   My Friend Mark was here make me book mark this place. We got the chicken Adobo and the beef Kaldereta bowls. The chicken adobo has good flavor. Especially the rice is very good. My wife like it. The beef is no bad either. I would said for the price is good enough. We also order the combo with drinks. Only $2 extra. I got the Fancy Fruit Basket herbal tea with boba and added honey for sweetness. It is good and the boba is soft. My wife got the Berry Hibiscus tea with boba. I like that one too. Next definitely try their lychee dragon pearl tea. This is a ball shall Tea leave. Must be interesting to sip.   The owner was very friendly.

The first Bubba in Florida. It is sister company of Texas Roadhouse. But I think they are better than Texas Roadhouse and is a improvement. The best thing is affordable cocktails. $4 not bad at all. I got the midnight train and the Frozen All American Margarita. The midnight train is ok. But the Frozen American is wonderful. Next time I will try Long Island ice tea.   We have the Rib-Eye steak 12oz and Signature Ribeye Steak 14 oz. the regular ribeye just grilled but the signature is marinated. Both are really good because good quality meat. The signature ribeye is marinated in sweet sauce. It is excellent. We also good 12" pepperoni pizza and the raspberry chipotle wing. The pizza is ok but the wing is really good.    The only thing that need improvement is the reception. It need some work. When the table is available, they need to hurry up shorten the wait line. It just too much for reception to take phone order and lead to table. The service for the table is really good. They have enough people to handle the food delivery and tablE service.

Very new restaurant. I decided to try them on. The restaurant seating is about a little challenge. Inside the restaurant mostly high top except a few is normal level table. If you want to sit at normal level, you may want to choose the outside patio seating. Obviously they try to imitate the beer hall type atmosphere with high top seats but it will be challenging for lady with dress.   This restaurant is open about a month. They still did not get the kink out. The food wait is about 35 minutes. Waiting staff afraid to approach you since you are waiting for the food. We got the habanero wings and the short rib. The wing is actually Buffalo wing with honey ranch type dipping sauce. I am not impressed due to 8 wings for $11 and is just regular buffalo wing. I expect more for the price paid $1.5 a wing with tax. The name not measure up.   The short rib is a fan. I like it when they braised it or slow temperature long hour grilled. The out side was crispy and nice. This short rib top with sweet mushrooms sauce with cabbage and place over pancakes. This is a great dish.   Overall the service need to improve, the food waiting time need to cut down, may be grilled the wing with honey after the buffalo sauce was applied will make this wing worth $1.5 a piece. Happy hour half price weekday 2-7 is a plus.

It is about 3.5 stars. Yama is newly open. As a new restaurant, they will try to give something more to keep the customers come back. So far they are doing that now. At least keep a good quantity of the fish meat. While they doing that, it is the best time to visit.   The reason I have them 3.5 stars is due to one of the sushi give stomach problem. Overall they are very good. One comment for the sushi is the chef special roll have too many choices with imitation crab meat. I would suggest removing some crab and put fish meat or two types of fish meat.   I do like the crawfish hand roll, crazy California roll, dragon roll, king Kai roll, red dragon roll. The US 41 roll if they can change out the crab meat to fish will improve the roll a lot.

This a cafe and restaurant. This is different restaurant who has the similar name. We like to give it a try. They have good Cuban sandwich. Other than that, the Cuban cuisine is good here also. I would start to say this is very affordable restaurant. I can get meal same price like Mc Donald and is full cook meal. Go figure.  I have ordered the Vaca Frita with two side of sweet plantains and the collar white bean soup. The soup is really excellent. The plantains did not over burn. Perfectly prepared. I have order my Vaca Frita extra crispy which mean burn a bit. When the flank steak burn, it taste better.   Our time here is great. This was the second restaurant stop of the night. We are not really hungry but to see what they have. Good service. The only thing I can say is only one server entire night. I think is overloaded for her. But she got it and very good on handling it.

Cute restaurant with good sushi and ok Thai food. This sum the restaurant for the food. To me I would go for the sushi. Restaurant is not busy during lunch. But a lot of take out.   I have the Pad Kee Mao (drunken noodle) and my friend has the Pad Thai. I specify ask my noodle to to very dry which mean on the wok longer. But the kitchen doesn't do it. The waiter only tell may be next time I am here they will try again. But when is the next time. My friend like his pad Thai. We also have the Chirashi. The chirashi is better than than their Thai food. The sushi rice at the bottom was well marinated. The serve with nine pieces of sashimi and very thick cut. They masago and dry seaweed leave sprinkles over it.   Service is good. But I think the instructions to the kitchen can be better.

The food truck was sold to different owner. The current food truck place about a block north of old location. Since this is the new owner, please disregard the Yelp deal in Yelp website since the last owner did not take it down.   The only complaint I have is the wait for the food is 40 minutes. There were three people in front of me. But the wait is not good for just third order. This is the area they have to improve.   We may be the last person they honor the Yelp deal. The mofongo is excellent. Cannot say the same for the rest. I have the steak mofongo. The steak is average. However I would said the Tripleta meat is tasty. But my wife said she is thirsty after having the Tripleta sandwich. Not sure is the MSG or not.   This is 3.5 stars not 4 stars food truck. Price is decent for the item we have order.

La Dulce is interesting Mexican dessert store. Finally we have one like this kind dessert store in Tampa. I saw this kind of dessert store in Lakeland. They serve different kind of fresh fruit dessert. One thing they definitely can improve on is to put a picture of the item in menu. By reading most of it, I kind of lost in translation.   We got the mangonada. This fruit mix is common on many Mexican dessert store. This one just regular mangonada without enhancements. But still good. I got chocolate coated strawberry popsicles. I like the coating with coconut flakes. It is good to have during summer time. We also got sweet corn with cheese.   Overall is good. Not in great level. They do got a lot attention to local. They are at the side street of the MLK Blvd below the bridge.

4.5 stars restaurant is correct. This restaurant has been here for sometime. It has great Venezuela cuisine. This restaurant also has great acoustic sound system for the music they play.    The food here is in good portion. May be enough for second meal. We have the Parilla Mar Y Tierra (mix grilled) and Churrasco. The churrasco have the selection of two side. We have the bacon and chorizo. This side is big. The churrasco is also big size. The seasoning is good. I like my wife entrée better. She has the mix grilled. This is a value dish. You can try different marinated meat.   They serve different juices. I have the lulo. The service is good. The restaurant is not too busy after 8 pm. But they close at 9 pm. They are well hidden in the corner of the plaza. If you travel southbound Dale Mabry, start looking for it after the village inn.

To locates this taco place, you have to look at the back alley way. They do not have the store front facing the street side. It is within the Hillsborough Ave Farmers Market. It is open air taco place with a roof over the taco trailer. Good thing that many open air taco place do not have it is a place to wash your hand before handle the taco. They have the running water sink you can wash your hand.   We have ordered three tacos - Pastor, Carnitas, and the Steak taco. The best is the steak taco. It come with seasoning and pan grilled. The carnitas is tasty also. Their shredded pork was marinated. They have single corn tortillas which may break easily. The bottle opener affix the the trailer need to replace since it is rusted.   Overall our experience here is good. They have some room to improve. Their green hot sauce that go with the taco stand out.

Great beach for dog. Easy parking area. They have designated area for dog run free on the beach. Some jump into water to retreat the fetch items. Is is definitely a dog owner dream to swim with the dog.   We brought our grand dog there. He has his fun time there with other dog. Running, playing and resting on the beach. We have to take him to the water for him to swim back. He just need to shake and booties shake to get rid the water. This is the area the dog on the beach without leash. Which is very good for the dog outing.   We also take him to the dog park at the beach to run. The park has area designated to small or big dog. The park has hose to water down or wash away the body sea water. It is very convenient. Our dog enjoyed the the day on the beach and park and same as the human enjoy the day on the beach.

Poke LuLu has fresh seafood on poke and good quality. This restaurant is a vendor in the food court. During the weekend they got a lot of attention. Line build up during lunch time. The customer are here to get poke and boba drink.   We got their House Poke. If you like different protein with two or more, this preset bowl may be your choice. The poke has salmon, shrimp, and spicy tuna. Which make this bowl good combo. My with have create your own bowl. She pitch the eel. It come with two big pieces of eel. The bowl is bigger than the House poke and better price.   We like both of our poke. Good quality and quantity. We also got the Thai tea boba. It is tall and skinny cup. Which usually don't fit well with cup holder. But it look good. The drink is good.

This restaurant name like we need to eat like a cat and left the fish with bone and head. Fortunately, the chef is kind enough to fillet for all the customers. Personally, I like whole fish to eat and left only the bone. With that said, their brand is to have good seafood. I always have good respect for this restaurant.   We start with corn chowder with lump crabmeat. The chowder is great. However I would suggest sautéed the crab meat which will make this soup more superior.   Our entrée are the grilled red fish. This very good dish. It is not in the regular menu. Redfish is bit harder to catch. The meat definitely is nice and good. It is accompanied the string green bean and crawfish etouffee. This is very excellent dish.   Our next entrée is sirloin and crab cake. I like the crab cake but the sirloin is average. It come with two side and I have crab fried rice. Again, the crab meat need to include in the fried rice while they stir fry. Not added with broil lumb crab meat.   The service is great. It has seamless coordination.

This Thai restaurant you may not know about it until you have traveled to Seminole, Florida. They hide away in the plaza corner. My experience with them is not yet 5 stars. It is about 4.5 stats.   The restaurant has good Thai food. I was here with a friend. He got the dish not in the menu and not serve to the public. This dish is call Kapoon. It is noodle dish with intestinal, pig stomach, and many other ingredients. This is actually a Laos dish. You only have to be lucky enough to enjoy it.   I got a dish from the menu. I have shrimp in garlic sauce. It is a good sauce. The shrimp come in 7 total quantity. They are large. The entire dish is only $11 for the dinner price. Not bad at all. I also got a dish to go. The drunken noodles with shrimp. Again, the chef has a very good wok technique. Burn on the edge and maintain the wok high BTU oil burn technique. Love it.   My friend got the sticky rice with mango. This dish top with sesame seed and coconut milk. Look very good. I would give them the credit for good dish in reasonable price. Come and enjoy them.

This is 4.5 stars in my book. When I was first here for the next door restaurant and notice them. That time they still working on the building interior. Now seeing them doing well, it is encouraging business in Brandon. There will be wait if you are not there early. I was there on Sunday ahead the church crowd. There is already 20 minutes wait. We take the breakfast bar without wait.   We have the Dakota - it is flat iron steak with bread, toast and a side. I got the grit. The steak is delicious with the right seasoning. Steak was cook well and compliment to the chef skill. We also got the churro waffle. This dish come with 4 quarter pieces waffle with whip cream and caramel syrup. The waffle is crispy. A bit oily but is tasty. Very unique dish.   I saw many dish fly out the serving window. The quantity of the food and presentation of the food was really nice. Service is attentive. It is step of right direction for the new restaurant.

Authentic Cuisine # 58. Moroccan Cuisine.   First Moroccan food in Tampa Bay Area that I have. The Moroccan restaurant is located near USF area which has a lot of Muslim residents is good choice to support the restaurant. Their cuisine is unique. I will try this food here and will compare them when I travel to Morocco in two months.   We got the couscous with meat and veggies. This dish only serve at Friday and Sunday. It is a special dish. The dish cost is $16, I think this is a higher than average around this area with not much of meat. The couscous is amazing. The meat is so so. But the veggies is really good. May be I am hungry.   My wife got a traditional dish with chicken tagine. This chicken serve with olive sauce. The sauce is wonderful. I like this dish better. It serve with pita. The sauce and pita go together. Lovely dish.   Overall our experience is great. People are nice here. My recommendation is the chicken tagine.

It is about 3.5 stars. This is my third Liquid Nitrogen ice cream store I have visit. This one considering is on higher than average pricing. Many other store already including one topping in one price. Here topping is additional 65 cents.   I like liquid nitrogen ice cream because I can select any flavor or combination of the flavor to mixed the flavor that you have never thought off. We got the tiger blood and pistachio flavor mixed in. This is different ice cream that mad scientist can made.   I like it very much for the flavor. It is cool to see the liquid nitrogen smoke under the blue light. Make this alien encounter.

It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. This restaurant in my bookmark for a while. We finally make it here to try the restaurant. This restaurant is kind east meet west. They have Laos food, southeast Asian, Asian, Italian, Americans cuisine. I like the ideal of variety.   My wife have the grilled chicken with pasta. The chicken is marinated in satay sauce. It is a interesting combination with the Italian pasta. The chicken is well marinated into the meat. Great flavors.   My dish is the New Zealand Lamb chop with red wine mushroom sauce. It serve over asparagus fried rice. Another west meet east cuisine. The lamb chop is well cook and soft to bite. Mushroom sauce is nice to be add on.   The service is perfect, waiter is well train. Know the customer need and respond quickly. We have great time here.

Authentic Cuisine No 66. Mexican cuisine.   It you don't mind hole in the wall setting, this can be your place. This restaurant is driven by good pricing and authentic Mexican food. If you want Street food, this may be your place. The restaurant is located at gas station plaza. It has limited seating. The food is delicious.  We have the Birria Taco. It is overnight taco meat. Sound not attractive. But after the meat cook overnight, the marinated spice in it. Add the cheese, it is good to have. Very fulfilling. It come with a soup that I have never have before. I wonder what is that. Before the meal, they have the flautas chip with salsa. It is delicious. We also got the ceviche taco, buche and campacheno taco. The buche is pig stomach and the campacheno is the mixed of steak, chicken and pork taco. Very interesting.   Service is ok. The Mangonadas is great. It is a interesting street food.

This restaurant has good authentic use of Indian spice along with fresh ingredients to prepare the food. This very sum up of this review. It is close to 4.5 stars for the way they have prepared the food. I like is very much. The reason they are 4 stars is the quantity they have served in the dinner time. Their portion is small for the dinner. But some people just eat a lot of rice with curry sauce.   If I come to the buffet, I may have rate them 5 stars. We have the Fish Molee and the Beef Malabar Curry. The fish is Basa and fried first before the curry. Love the turmeric, green chili, ginger and coconut milk. This is a good dish to enjoy because the coconut curry is out of the wold.   The beef malabar is good spice. We east the meat and take the sauce home. It is still good to enjoy with the rice. The spice is deep touch with nice medium spicy curry.

Alvarez has a good affordable food. Highly recommended. This is actually their second store. It actually a good restaurant even they have second store. Many restaurant has second restaurant will not be able to keep up on the second place. I hope they continue to strive for the best for both store.   I got the steak quesadilla. Normally they don't serve steak quesadilla, they only serve ground beef quesadilla. Because of my request, they make a special steak quesadilla from chop steak. It was quite good. The other dish is ground beef burrito. It is fat burrito and big enough for hungry person. The last dish is the Plátanos Rellenos. It use sweet plantain as base. Top with cook ground beef, lettuce and Mexicano cheese. Delicious.   I order the dish then come back to pick up. It is still good when eat at home.

Post office may be past technology for communication since email, social media, web base advertising is very convenient. We like to support our post office as much as possible to keep the door open.   This post office has walk in counter for mailing, packaging, registered mail, money order and more. When the line get longer, the window of the counter open. There is automated counter outside that you can buy stamp and mail. This self service station is easy to use. It also have paid copy machine if you need a photo copy.   I hope this post office keep open and serve the people here.

Solid 4 stars restaurant. The restaurant located on the south of Bush very close to Bush and Armenia. It has good Peruvian stir fried. Stir fried technique here definitely has the Chinese cuisine secrets.   We have order the Anticicho de Corazon. The grilled beef heart. This is not the best in the bay but very close. One good thing is they give you a lot quantity in the dish. Definitely the quantity will be count into more stars. It come with two side. The Peruvian golden corn and the slice potatoes. It is the dish I would recommend.   Our second dish is Lomo Saltado. This typical Peruvian stir fried dish. It come with two side. We have order the yuca and the white rice. The stir fried technique is in high BTU wok like Chinese cuisine. It is one of the best in the bay.   Service here is attentive. It you looking for good Peruvian. This may be an option for you.

The museum is certainly established and has an old house and garden. Please plan at least 3 hours. One of other tip. They close early beginning November. Don't paid attention to the door entrance hour. It said close at 8 pm but actually close at 4 pm at November. I wish they can notify us before I bought the tickets at 2:30 pm. So check their schedule before buying the tickets.   The garden section is very nice. It cover wide area of walking. But each section has it beauty. I like it when the decorated for winter light. You can see extra things. The main old house is call the Lily house. It beautiful Lawn in front. It is picture worthy place.   The museum 3 good floor of art work. Unfortunately the time we have visit is only for one floor. The display has European, African, Asian, Americans, and contemporary art. Each floor may require minimum 45 minutes to finish. The art collection is wide range.

This 3.5 stars restaurant is correct from my fellow Yelper. It is above average for the rating. A few things I like about this restaurant is about their choices on the burger and services to bring the food and clean the table quick enough.  We have been here several time. But this is my first time order the Number 12 burger - The Ahi Tuna. I like their mixed of sauce that on the burger. It has the caramel soy sauce with a bit of sweetness on it. The fish is sushi grade with Panko crusted on the coating and lightly fried. It come with avocado which accommodate well in the burger. We also has the OMG burger number 10. It is double patty close to half pound meat. It has two big pieces of smoke bacon on top. Love it.   Food is good here. What make them no much competitive is price. Burger range from $7 to $10. Add other side can get you to $14. It is regular restaurant price. I still consider this is a fast food joint but not quite with twist of different in table service. I do like the Gourmet part of the burger.

I like a restaurant has optional by items section. This is a bakery and restaurant combo. Allow you to have a Bakery baked good and food. The seating space is limited. During the pandemic not many people are dining in anyhow. Most of the customers had to go orders.  We also have some takeout orders. We saw some bakeries displays on a glass container. It has a good cheese bake goods. We got some of them. One thing interesting is they sell the food by pieces. We got some Chicharrón, blood sausage, regular sausage, in and empanada.  They also serve some cooked meals like bistec, fry pork, Carne Asada. Overall Our experience is very good. Definitely come back for dinner.

This restaurant is a Thai restaurant that serve sushi. This restaurant locate near my office. This is a place if I have run for the next meeting after the lunch hour. At night time, live jazz music is performed here.   Today I have the garlic pepper squid and a cup if the tom yum soup. I always order Thai hot. It is really spicy - sweaty hot spicy. You have to be able to tolerance for hot food is you order Thai hot. I am use to it. To most American, the Thai restaurant medium hot mean very hot, mild mean ok hot. The tom yum soup have ingredient of scallop, shrimp, and squid. The tom yum style soup have the tamarind spice with sour and salty taste. It is perfect, for most people just order the regular so you can enjoy and taste the soup. If not it will be too hot.   The garlic pepper squid is a stir fry dish. The chef need to prepare the garlic sauce with high wok heat to create the burn of oil and the garlic to create the burn taste. This restaurant is ok on this skill. However, overburn create charcoal taste which you don't want. It is a battle of the risk of the chef not to under cook it or burn it.   I have sushi here before, I can said that I am not a fan of it.

Beirut Cafe was bookmarking forever. Because it was too far for me to reach. I am seldom come this way for food. It was a rare occasion I was here to try. The atmosphere of the restaurant is nice. They have two big table for larger parties. The restaurant capacity is not much, they do utilize the sidewalk sitting.   I like their sweet. It is definitely similar to middle eastern dessert. We got bird nest pistachio baklava.  Very similar to the one famous Hallab 1881 from Lebanon. Our main dish is the we have the chicken kabab. It is big dish. Since we have previous meal, we only order one dish. The chicken has good marinated spice. It has good grilled technique with maintaining the juicy of the meat.   We were there at 4 pm. I was going to select the big table because we know no one will come in that time. But they no allow me even no one in the restaurant. May be some leeway is best.

The pub is previously arepa restaurant location. Tonight the pub received a lot of patron due first preseason football games with Jamie Winston. A lot people come to watch Winston first day at Buc. His debut does bring some screaming fans into this pub.   I was looking if they serve food in this pub. When we asking for the menu, they said they only serve beer. This is original a pub set up. They do have a lot of TV and computerize music jukebox. The jukebox allows selecting the music and playing to all patrons. This is an Irish pub. With that said, Guinness definitely serves here.   One positive note is the girl at the bar said no food serve here but you can bring your own food to eat here. That is not bad. I see people order pizza and drink beer here. The outdoor sitting is like a beer garden. This is an interesting place that you can bring your own food and party here.

It is about 3.5 stars. A few things can be improved. Overall is a good restaurant. It is food truck standard in a building with control temperature. Chef has good skill.   I got the two meat large bowl with steak and chicken combo. The steak is the New York Strip meat. But it is thin slice meat. The bowl is bed with rice. The meat is cook over grilled with Korean BBQ sauce. I have added sunny side up egg. I also got spicy pork to go. I eat half over the restaurant and bring home other half. The food do not sit in my stomach well. I have to go to bathroom. I believe is the egg because I finished the egg in the restaurant. When I eat the remaining, it was good.   If I am there, I will go for the Bibimbap. Cafeteria style. Not much of service. I would prefer the steak to be dice than thin slice.

Today I am using their drive through for ordering. It was rain cat and dog. I am happy to see the kiosk order cover section at their drive through without get wet while order. It was without delay at the pick up window to paid and received the order.   I order the half chicken special. It was well cook with good marinated sauce. The marinated went to skin deep. But flavorful. The rice and bean also good to have. The order was well conducted. Food is good for the drive through and accurate with the order.

The nowait online is good to put your wait list before arrive to the restaurant. It definitely a good help to know when your table is ready. Even with nowait check in. They also loss our reservation. Fortunately they back check it when we were there and give us next available.   The restaurant is busy because they are the most affordable in Hyde Park. Many teenagers who live nearby are hang out at this place. This restaurant look like old dinner. It has the sixty look. You almost can feel the swing dance party is happen any time.   The food is average compare to many dinner. I guess that have so many customer due to their affordability. We have order the grilled grouper and Goody goody cheese burger pox. The burger is just average. The grouper is good size but they are pan grilled not flame grilled. The fry come with is soggy. This is not a good fry. I believe the fired oil was not change over time and make the French fry soggy.   Service is not there. Our waiter was missing for good period of time for our close up. Not sure is worth for the visit. However, been there done there.

The food compare to actual urban area of Tampa is budgetary. It is lesser than Tampa. It become affordable. This restaurant located at US 301 make it easy to access. Everything in historical downtown Zephyrhills is walking distance. So does this restaurant.   The menu is extensive and all items are under $10. The category divided to appetizer, combo plate, beef noodle, rice platter, fried rice, noodle bowls, egg noodle soup. The selection of protein included grilled pork, grilled shrimp, grilled chicken, grilled beef, fried fish, grilled pork chop, grilled fish and veggies. We got the today special fried frog leg. It come with 8 drum frog leg. This leg is massive. The coating and accompanying sauce are flavorful.   Our other dish is grilled pork chop rice. It has good enough seasoning. It come with rice, pickle veggies and spring roll. It has large enough portion for a person. Service is good and attentive. Seating is comfortable.

#600th review  I choose Thuy Cafe because it is a small business with cool food. I would said Pinellas Park area have too many good Vietnamese food. This is one of the unique noodles soup area. It is tiny not too many seats. But we were able to get a seat at the weekend after the Love of Tango.   I try their Bun Rieu Cua - Crab Cake Noodle Soup. This noodle soup have white crab cake, fried crab cake. Very nice soup base. The accompanying veggie is very well decorated with arrangement. This is my first time to have this soup. I have empty the whole bowl.   We also have other items such as the lemongrass grilled beef sandwich, wonton noodle soup, shrimp chip. By the way, they have 20 different sandwich to try. Some include vegetarian ham. Ham for vegetarians???!!!  Pinellas, you don't know you have pearl in your area. Please check them up.

Finally New Tampa has it own assembly chain open up. To me it is 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. They 4.5 stars due to their creativity of sauce. We have try their vinaigrette cilantros sauce and we like it. We also try their ginger citrus and coconut sweet potatoes sauce. I can said the sauce went through good R&D.   A few thing they can improve are the BBQ chicken and steak. I feel their steak do not worth for the upgrade unless I can order the medium rare steak and chop up. Steak is over done. However I have to tip my hat to the teriyaki chicken and spicy tuna. Their Brussels sprouts, mushroom and broccoli are favorable to add on. The base I would recommend the forbidden rice, noodle and cauliflower rice.   One other thing can improve on is to fill up the bowl. Don't let it 80% full.

Sam Ash music store should be look like regular music store. However, this music store is way different than any music store. You can see the roman column, vaulted ceiling, statutes, and beautiful chandelier. It is good environment for a music store. Classy look.  If you need a music equipment, you won't be less here. I have been here several time to visit of enjoy my strolling. The classical guitar room is great. Always see someone hold a guitar and play the music there. Free concert. Love the sound of it. The unique thing is they have the drum room with a hanging chandelier. Flex your muscle on the drum set and freely express yourself. Try it out to see what you make off.  The music store provide lesson for the young one and musician to be. Many parent waited at the learning center for their kid. Live performances have been done here. They have open mic night or music performance night too. Check their schedule. Come to check them out and check the next door player school of music.

Are we tired of most of the national chain coffee shop. It is nice to to have a chance in brand name. This local coffee shop located at downtown that serve northern part of the downtown area. They do Catering and provide sandwich and munch. The place is trendy. I like vibrant atmosphere.   Today I am going for the mocha ice coffee. It is a bit chocolatier but have all the mojo. Good tasty coffee. Just to let all you know, caffeine never affects me. Most of the time I drink coffee is for the flavor and pleasure. They do have good flavor.

The event is Holiday Light in the Garden for the fund raising for the Garden. Donations of $4 per adult is suggested for the fund raising. This lightning is in the Florida Botanical Garden. It cover quite a ground in the garden. It will require 1 hour to complete.   The event include different theme on each section. I have seen the rose garden, the Cupid love garden, butterflies garden, ginger bread cookies garden, flamingo garden. Go find out yourself and get lost in the garden.   The event has live music singing on the holiday theme. Santa station for pictures, snack station, chu chu train station display the toy train and more. The whole garden is pleasant to walk in the cool temperatures. Please remember which entrance you come into the garden. So go explore and enjoy a hot coco if too cold.

This is memorable night from The International Culinary School at The Art Institute of Tampa. This dinner no doubt is one of the best in the Bay now. The cost is low, the food is great, and we even get Chef Treatment. Tonight dinner is one that closer to my heart. The restaurant or the institute is naming as Tutored Chef and they only serves dinner on Thursday and Friday night from 6 pm to 8 pm. Please call 813-393-5395 for reservation.  The menu has ten items to select. Each item not more than $6.95. You also can try their special combination of the ten items from the menu with three to five course meals. The three courses is $13.95, four courses is $15.95, and five courses is $17.95. This is a steal and price buzzer. They are currently serving the spring menu. The summer menu will be start at July. I would encourage the patron go to support them. However, if you want to get the best cooking skill, come after four to six week later when they are familiar with their menu. That is when the food is goooooood. The food and the tip are going to the school. You can tip extra with cash and mention it is for the people who serve you. It is good for the student who serves you.   Tonight we have everything in the menu. The restaurant starts with crouton with herb dip and enhance flavor butter. Then follow by baked empanada with passion fruit and Cajun Spice for opening. We started with grilled asparagus in asparagus puree and bacon bit. This is a well presented dish and it is elegantly presented. The asparagus is well cook and go well with the Canadian type bacon. The second initial entrée is the Egg - it is soft broil fried egg serve over the Mushroom Ragout. When the egg is cut, the egg yolk is spilled over the mushroom. The mushroom is cook with wine sauce. When it mixed with the egg yolk, it has added the flavor. The egg is fried with crust and tasty to eat. The third initial dish is the soup du Jour. The soup is one of the student creations. Creamy soup is served with smoke bacon.   The main dish starts with the lamb - Chilled Grilled Leg of Lamb serve over the Israeli Couscous. It also has the touch of the Chimichurri sauce that makes the grilled lamb more desirable. The second main dish is shrimp - The shrimp is cook with Tarragon Tomato Relish and Chive Oil. It serves over the risotto. The taste is like old bay seasoning for the Maryland Crab. It goes well with the risotto. The third main dish is pork - They are two type pork is served here. Braise Smoked Pork Shanks and Sautéed Pork Tenderloin.  These are two different type of preparation. And both are good. It also serves with Potato Gratin, Baby Carrot, and snow peas. It is a balance meal. The fourth main dish is the beef - Slice Grilled Beef is place on top of the crouton and place on top of sweet Onion Marmalade. The onion is sautéed to soft and good for the mixed with the beef.  We close the night with Blueberry financier on blueberry sorbet and blueberry compote. It is pretty muffin cake over blue berry ice cream and syrup. We also have the Chocolate Marquis top with Ice Cream and roasted pistachios. Chocolate is same as mousse.   I was going to post this review for my 200 hundred reviews. But restaurant this good needs to be shared. I am thinking do a UYE on the end of July or begin of the august when the student chefs get familiar with the summer menu.

Very good burger place. It is very close to 4.5 stars. It has many choices. There are may choices of Black Angus burger. They have good list of burger.   The restaurant outside seating make it convenience for the dog owners in downtown area. Especially this restaurant is close to Curtis Hixon dog park. I got the glass of beer with burger. Good local beer. For the burger, I got the Franklin Street burger. This burger come with Kaiser Roll bun. I like the bun. The burger has angus beef patty, pull pork, smoke brisket, and bacon. Very complicated combination. By it work and very tasty. Excellent burger.   Service is good. The turn on light on the outside side so we don't eat at the dark. I also like the skinny fries. Very good fried.

This is the biggest Land and Sea I been to. The area is big. They carry a lot of items including the baked goods. Non to say they have a lot kind of seafood, their meat department has some good selection.   We were here at Friday searching for boneless beef short rib. We could not find this item in many grocery stores but Land and Sea carry it. When we visited this place they run the special on Friday. BOGO with one pound get one pound free for the short rib. Good deal. I would suggest checking up their special of the day. We also got the mini crab cake for good deal. Some of the special is reduce in price from their regular price.   They have pre-seasoning food too. You can take home and follow the label instructions to cook. It is convenient. If want some wild caught fish, they also carry it. This store not only carry meat and seafood, they also carry veggies for one stop shopping.

This place holding a lot of young people heart. I can see the average age who visited here is about 30 or below. Somehow this place feel young. The DJ play it music at the bar area. This may be the major attraction.   We were here for the taco week. It have some deal. But the taco is one of the best quality. We got the three blackened shrimp taco. It come with top as cabbage, pico, avocado, queso fresco, sour cream, sweet thai chili, and cilantro. The shrimp is blackened with southern style. The flavor is good and desirable.   The margarita is part of the deal with three taco. It is ok not to kill for. Overall our service is great. I would recommend if you come to downtown for light snack and drinks.

I was exiting to try a Puertorican Bistro. This place is small and not much of parking space. But there is a empty lot behind the building that you can park there. The plaza parking on the side of building is limited.   The restaurant has vibrant music. The music are nice and Latin flavor. I am not sure how it work so I walk to counter order and wait for my food. I have order the roasted penil. A Puerto Rico roast pork shoulder. I waited for my food for some time and the people who order the food after me already got their food. At least three tables. Finally some come to table ask me what I have ordered. They when back to the kitchen and comeback to me said they sold all the penil and they can offer me the beef stew combination. I got that.   Seem like the beef stew is over cook and when you press the meat it shatters to powder. They not the same as fresh cook beef cube.   Four mistakes on this restaurant. First mistake did not have a hostess and call themselves Bistro. Second inform the customers late about run out of food. Three, no make up or complimentary item for their mistakes. Fourth is offer a dish that is not popular. Seem like the item cannot sale on the night. This is done and done restaurant.

I was surprised my credit card company put this store as grocery. It the same way, they sell bread and sandwiches. Not sure the actual category need to be. We were here for their promotion of the buy one sandwich and get sourdough cinnamon bun free. The free bun is actually a sourdough material. Interesting.   We have two sandwiches. My wife have the Italian sandwich. She start Tampa Sandwich Bread. The selection she got is Italian that come with ham, salami, pepperoni. It is quit good. I have the BST which is come with bacon, tomato, and spinach. My bread is roasted red pepper. The sandwich is good.   We only need to wait a little while for the preparation. Not bad. I do like the sourdough cinnamon bun. It is quite interesting.

Very interesting brewery. Good thing they have a permanent food truck to keep door open during pandemic. The people who go there are very friendly. Their space is big enough to have many patrons. The put side seating have good setup with plenty of seat. I am not sure they allow dog on the outside. But worth a try.   The selection of beer is good. I like the Diddy. It is a German Pilsner. The selection includes other like Lager, Stout, Cider, sour beer, wheat beer, bock, IPA, and Ale.  It has good collection. The size is just good.

Cool Aussie restaurant. This may be the first one mom and pop restaurant in New Tampa. Saturday they have karaoke night. Friday live music. Tuesday half price wing. Thursday prime rib. Wednesday trivia night.   Their famous item is the meat pie and the sausage. But this two items they are wipe out by take out order. So we go for the Thai beef mango wrap and the fish and chip. The mango wrap is excellent. Good quality of chop beef in square. The sauce accompanying the wrap very well. The fish and chip is excellent. Very comparable to English versions. The fish is Australian sea bass. Good white fish.   I will be back for their prime rib and meat pie. So far I have good experiences with restaurant. We also got the chicken wombat wings to go. It is great wings.

It is a cute restaurant serving lunch and breakfast. Parking can be challenging if there is studio sessions next door. Even at regular weekends, the parking is full. They do have outdoor seating area if you bring the pet.   There is must try drink in restaurant. The horchata iced coffee is a must have. I like it for cooling summer hot day. We got two different flans. The salted caramel and the butterscotch flan. Both flans are delicious. We also got the Timba with guava dipping. The Timba is the fried cheese - Queso Blanco. This fried cheese and great to have.   The restaurant have many sandwiches. We were here after lunch for dessert. Food ordering was easy.

3.5 stars food truck. This is Puerto Rican food served here. They have mofongo, tostones o papitas. They have good wide selection. This food truck is kind of tuck away from the road. If miss the entrance, you may have to U turn.   We were here first time to buy a bowl of Carrucho. The marinated conch. It is big pieces. But we feel that taste like chicken. Not sure is the best since we are not best judge of the Puerto Rican cuisine.   When come to second visit, we got the pulpo. It is the octopus. This one is much better. It does come in good chop amount of the octopus. The marinated sauce accompanying well with octopus. Great small dish with wine at home with football games.   Overall is good. Definitely will go for the pulpo. Food here is a bit pricey for food truck.

It is vey small farmer market. It has some art and craft, food, service, clothing and specialty. It located at Centennial Park of Ybor City. It is at the corner of 9th Avenue and 19th St. Parking is easy along the street side. They have parking lot with the fees apply.   In the park they are some shaded area with roof cover. This area have a lot vendors and pleasant to walk. Across the street is Ybor City Museum State Park which make this Saturday Market a one stop visit. Among the vendors I like the vendor who sell the indoor plants. This indoor plant has multi color and easy to take care. Just a few spray and close the glass enclosure, the steam form on the glass and create natural indoor steam room.   There are some clothing, buttons vendors. It was very interesting. Some vendor sell gluten free cake. Not many vendor but have something to offer for everyone.

Zephyrhills start to has their own brewery. This one is located at downtown prime location. They have the outside beer garden and street view seat. Many people has use this advantage for the viewing of Christmas parade.  I have try their Belgium Blonde. This is light beer with good taste. The brewery is busy and the patrons are sharing the table with each other and have good conversations. They have table order service is you don't want to go to counter to get your beer.   The indoor is nice and well lid. Plenty of seat to host big party. I bring my food there while enjoying a glass.

The seafood is fresh here. There are plenty of traffic and people visited this place. We were there 7:30 pm and it was pack. There are many people call in. The phone ring is almost not off the hook. Good thing they have parking around the building. Tables and chairs are provided inside and court yard. There is heavy seafood smell in the building. If you don't like the smell, you can sit outside.   The seafood here is good price. Catfish or Basa fillet are $4.99 a lbs. they also offer fried seafood platter. We ordered the seafood platter include shrimp, scallops and clam. It is good deal with the entire box fill up till it hard to close the lid. The platter also includes fries and hush puppies. The seafood was fried with batter coating. For my experience, the coating is too thick and no added spice. It is kind of plain. You will need drink to go with the seafood. The positive of the platter is the shrimps are in good size.   This is a local favorite and many has visit. The food come out quick.

Solid 4 stars. It is because the cost vs value of the food. There a few positive thing about this place. The service is excellent. The store provide the complimentary brownie cake with coconut flakes. Love it. It good promotion to get the restaurant going.   We three taco combo. The taco is divided to classic and specialty. Any in the specialty taco add $0.50 each taco. We got the campechano, grilled grouper, and grilled shrimp tacos. I paid extra dollars for the specialty taco. Which worth it. The combo plate come with chip, salsa, and a drink. Not bad at all. My wife got the steak quesadilla. The steak is well grilled.   I would recommend the campechano and grilled shrimp tacos. It was delicious. Food come out quick with not much wait. Seating is limited but enough for the dine in conditions.

This restaurant use to be a different Vietnamese restaurant. The interior did not change. The traffic for the patron is good here at 5 pm. At least I see 5 table occupied.   I got the Hu Tieu. It is a seafood Hu Tieu. It has the squid, shrimp, fish ball, shrimp ball. This dish cost $7.50 for small. I have ask them to add the fish cake also. They have charge me extras $2. It is a 25 % mark up. It is a bit steep. The noodle is good and the seafood is fresh. I think the soup is a bit let down due to lack of flavor and the enhanced of fried onions and fried pork fat.  If they can stir fried the pork fat ant onion before adding the soup, it will enhance the taste.   Overall is good. Services is average. Nothing to boast about. It is been there done that deal. Pinellas Park has too many good Vietnamese food. It will be a good competition.

Rock and roll in food sum the restaurant. One of the founder is Gene who is KISS group. They restaurant is very popular at weekends. As a result, we pick a weekday to avoid the crowds. I like the set up with rock and roll music videos at the background. High ceilings open dining hall. Choices of inside or outside dining. Love the set up.   We start with the Mango Habanero wings. It come with 9 wings with $1.4 per wings is in the high price side. The wings did a good job with ghost pepper. My entree is the Blackened Redfish. This dish come with vegetables medley and rice. It top with crawfish sauce. Crawfish also taste good like Cajun. A very rare dish to have. My wife have the Carolina Slow Roasted Pork. The sauce is honey mustard sauce which is very similar to the BBQ we have when we travel to North Carolina. It come with steam veggies and we upgraded to sweet potatoes fried.   I like the happy hour drinks. I got the house Margaritas and it is big for me. Please keep it up. It is the reason customers coming back.

Interesting decorations and furniture for interior set up. I would said this is a people hang out place. I saw people play with their iPad or smart phone there. However, it did not give me a feeling of great atmosphere.   They do have two choices of adult only ice cream. I mean not in the film X rated movie. If you think about that is all you...haha. The adult only is alcohol content ice cream. You need to show the ID before you order. My ID is the grey hair :). I have ordered the pumpkin spice rumchata. The alcohol is actually from the rum.  I would said it is tasty.   The price is a bit in the high side. If I come back, I would try the porky delight and some of the menu items. They located approximately 2.7 miles from the exit of the I-75 and SR 60. Easy to find.

If you have two thousands people and need a lot rooms for classes, this is the place in St. Louis. I was here for a national steel conference. And the facility is perfect to accommodate so many people.   The exhibition hall is big to fit the steel cutting machine, demonstration and more with indoor hall. There also room to accommodate lunch and cocktails for many people. The hallway is wide with minimum 30 to 40 feet for registration, walking. Bathrooms can be found in many corner of the center for convenient.   The entrance has two locations with drive by drop off. One at the back of 7th street and the other at the other is at Washington Avenue.

Kay's Kitchen has new place. I use to go to their old place which only order from the window. The current location has improved a lot. The improvement are as below. They has seating area for the customers if they decide to dine in. At old location many customers order and eat at the car. Second, the food preparation time cut to half. Old kitchen need a long wait if customers in front of you.   We track down their new restaurant location and finally we have a visit. Before you visit, you need know a few thing. First they cook the food when you order. They are not like other fast food fried the chicken and sit on the rack until customers order it. As a result the food is fresh and delicious. So, you need some patience to wait for them to cook your food. But you can order ahead by phone to cut down your wait time. Second, if you dine in, you need to wear non expensive clothing, because the food smell will stick on you. No leather accessories because it will stick at the leather and difficult to remove.   I like Kay's chicken because they prepare it fresh. They use light coating not like other fast food have thick coating that you cannot feel the chicken. Their chicken is Chicago style which is rare in Tampa Bay Area. So go get your own.

This restaurant has good Thai taste. The only thing is they didn't turn the spicy heat up when I ask them for Thai hot. Overall they are good restaurant.   We start with the Kai Tod Had Yai the blacken chicken wing. The wing has some marinated spice. This is southern Thai dish. Blacken wings with deep fried. The spice is above average. It come enough wing to share.   The entrée are Grouper Chu Chee and curry pork. The curry pork dish is good. But the the Grouper Chu Chee is my flavor. The grouper was slightly fried with crispy coating. It top with their homemade curry. According to the menu is a mix of coconut milk and soy sauce. It is great and healthy fish to have.   During our visit, the traffic of the Christmas Day is low. But they may be the few restaurants that open for that day. The service is good and attentive.

It is about 4.25 stars. I like their new location in Tampa. I have been to their St. Pete location but this Tampa location is much better. I like the high ceilings open space. It brings value and comfort level to the customers. The ambiance and decoration is very nice. An open space with kitchen viewing available.   We got the Housemade Sausage and Roasted Pepper pizza. It is good size pizza. The ingredients is very nice. But the the cheese and ingredients are not spread to outer edge of pizza which creates a lot of crust area. This area they need improvement.   I also got the Wood Grilled Marinated Skirt Steak. This is my favorite steak. It has good qualities and quality of the skirt steak. It is marinated with sweet sauce. It was cook to requested temperature. It also come with broccolini and mash potatoes. I also like the herd green sauce the have on the steak. I hope they don't reduce the steak quantity in the future.   Service is good. Seating is comfortable, spacious and good lighting in compare to St Pete location.

For the Hillsborough county library I been to, this is my least impressive library. It has all the components of library. Book are correctly arrange.   They have kid section with computer equipment. As usual, you can get free dvd for home entertainment. This library have low ceiling to conserve the cooling bill good for the tax payer.

I was looking for something like boba drinks in at ample Terrace, however, there was none close by at Busch Blvd. so I look for juice nearby, the Frappe show up. I decided to give them a try while I wait for my sandwich to be made on other restaurant.   I got the mixed tropical fruits smoothies. The owner explains to me if they add bananas, it will change the taste. Infect the good taste. So I have it without bananas. I like the taste. Not only the quantity is there, taste is there, fruit is good, coooool off summer heat.   This place is a good option to have healthy drink as a meal. It does fill you up. The place is empty during lunch. I would recommend you to visit here. It will be worth a trip and get your money worth. So go cool off from summer heat.

Rare Ethnic Food 7  This is an annual get together Ramadan experience at a restaurant of choosing. This will be our second annual Ramadan buffet with the Yelp friends.
