Usually the buffet start at sundown which is 8:30 pm. Petra was choose for this year Ramadan buffet of the night. If the Yelper want to actually experience it just fast for one day and join the dinner buffet is more meaningful.   Petra put out a good feast. Total cost with tip and tax is about $20. It includes the drink, the buffet and the desserts. Yummy. Tonight we have the Lamb, grill chicken, fried fish, pita, three type of hummus, falafel, grape leave, lentil soup, Greek salad, and more. The lamb display is awesome. Feel like eating a horse, this will be the feast. The desert is great. Plenty to go around.  In this holy month, many has come to enjoy the buffet. The food is very good and a lot of choices. The drink include mint lemonade that very unique. I would join their buffet before is over. The feast is 4.5 stars.

I was eyes on this restaurant for long time. Every time I pass by there is a long line. Finally a weekday that has no much customers. I was able to walk in and order without waiting. I have it to go.   I order a palabok fiesta with one non spicy chicken joy. The palabok is rice clear noodle with shrimp, ground pork and egg. It is just an ok dish. The fried chicken joy is better. I also has the spaghetti with two spicy chicken joy. The spicy of the seasoning is actually skin deep. Spaghetti is average. The best among all is peach mango pie. This is their best dish. I would recommend this.   The order was prepared fast. I really don't like the packaging. It is paper box that is not secure. Especially the food is more heavy than the box can bear. This will be their set back and easy to spill when they not secure properly in the plastic bag with two three order.

My experience is base on the price they charge and the pasta available that day. That day they run out of many things, only two type of pasta available. We got pasta with meat sauce. The process is simple. The only advantage of this restaurant is make the fresh pasta.   The food is come with paper containers with pasta. Sometime can be messy to reach the last pasta at the bottom. Overall the taste is jus average. I don't see much advantages other than convenience. Price is high for the dish.

The Green Fairy Is our Mayor of Tampa Bob Buckhorn. He is the one who sprinkle the green dust all over the Curtis Hixon Park. Thanks to this event, we can enjoy the Saints Patrick Day with the city special touch. River O Green definitely brings people out and provide green river in the mixed celebrate green event.   The count down started 11:00 am from five. The police, vendor and coast guard boat join in for paint the Hillsborough River green. Green dye was drop from the back of boat engines. Soon entire river changed to bright green color. The US coast guard boat shooting the green water out to create green fountain in the middle of the river.   The entire park has vendor display their item including the food and drinks truck. The amphitheater has musical show on schedule. Kid running and so do the dog.

It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. This is the third revolution ice cream I been to. This one have a lot of space. They always carry good ice cream. Sometimes I think they are too creative on the name that I could not figure out what is the really the ice cream flavor.   Today I have the porky and the banana pudding. The porky is the vanilla ice cream with bacon. The ice cream is great. The bacon is good. The banana pudding is the one I like among the two.   They do have taste try. My wife always ask me why you buy the one that I did not try. I said to her I already try all other flavor definitely buy the one I did not try.

The memory and story of this is museum is told by our Bay Area Jews. It is close to our heart. These stories is definitely part of our living testimony for our residents here.   The museum is split by two part. The downstair mainly have the most telling to the holocaust incident during the German World War. Poland got hit hard then the most in Europe. There were 3 million Jewish population before the war. After the war, only 80,000 survived. It is a lot of killing and displacement of the Jewish people. It is a lesson of sad human race history. I hope it is never again in the world. I like the display of shoes and clothing, who died in the holocaust. There was s also memory for hero who save people and fight against the war.   The second floor is very much special edition to remember the great music producer Bill Graham. You can see the sixty how the music concert was done. Some great music was play then. The billboard has some interesting design. I was never guest Mick Jagger, Tina Turner, Madonna, and Bob Dylan were play the music in one concert. It is interesting.

Jin China is a fast food American style. I have been many Chinese fast foods and I never like any of it. However, this one is the most welcome among all Chinese fast food. My review is only base on the lunch.   I usually like to stop on the newly opened restaurant and decided to try this one. The lunch special is really worth the value. You are here not for the great taste of Chinese food but for the something quick and fresh. The special is $5.50 with lunch cook at the spot and a soft drink. Very good deal. I have the schezuan pork with fried rice. The veggies in the pork are crispy which mean very fresh. Like it that way. Some restaurants don't have the controls of the material. This restaurant is next to MD oriental market and they can get fresh produce immediately.    Please call ahead because needs 10 minutes to prepare.

If you looking for healthy food, Luv Fresh offer hot meal, Açaí Bowl, Wrap and Salad. It is good for food conscious customers. Their item is also good for the older generation. It has the smoothie too for quick diet.   We try this restaurant to see what they can offer. I think the restaurant is about 3.5 stars. We were here for the hot bowl. Since they provide a good quantity of food, I would said is a good start. I also like the variety of the grains and veggies that add into it. We have the Heart Healthy and Power Luv bowl. I like a good piece of salmon there. The power luv has goat cheese which I don't like. Goat cheese need to be optional because not all people like it.   A few things they can improve. A free water station will help. The food need to have more flavor. I think their food is too flavorless. Sauce should be a selection instead of pair with each bowl. Let customers choose the sauce. Square box is difficult to nix the food at corner of box. However I like the presentation of food in square box. Food has less salt or sweetness. Most customers like a better taste bud. I think they have potential. But they need to think how to compete in this area with the existing restaurant.

This is a 3.5 stars restaurant. It is not yet 4 stars. In compare to many Korean restaurants in Bay Area, I would said they have the most competitive price for their food. Although they are not cheap but is about a dollar to 2 dollars lower different in the Bay Area.   We have three dishes tonight. We start with Galbi the Korean grilled short rib. The dish is $23 with about 11 pieces of short rib. It was great marinated sauce to the bone. The second dish is the Eemyoonsoo the fried Atlanta Mackerel with lightly salted. This is a whole fish. The size is medium for $17. The edge and top was fried to crispy and crunch. A very good dish to go with beer or rice wine. The last dish is Dolsot Bibimbob. The rice serve in stone bowl. That make the rice burn to crispy at the stone touch edge. This dis has egg, veggies, beef. But I think it is less flavor. They need to work on this dish.   They are better than most Korean restaurants in Tampa. You still need to wait for the food for a while but the wait time is shorter than the Korean restaurants in Tampa. I still say they need to work on the speed to deliver the food to table. Don't let the customers wait too long. Service is typically as bad as most Korean restaurants.

We were expect bar food before we arrive at this place. The restaurant look like normal bar. Not many customers during weekdays. We look at the menu and feel the items are very interesting. Not many place serve hog fish, this is one of the few I can count.   I got the main dish as grilled blackened hog fish. It come with fried and the coleslaw. The portion of fish is big enough. Fish is fresh. It has good blackened taste.   Our appetizers are the the Irish Stew and Aran Island Shepherd's Pie. The Irish stew serve in the sourdough bread bowl. The stew meat was slow cook in red wine and Guinness beer. It is delicious. The Shepherd pie is different than most shepherd pie I have. It serve on potatoes skin.   As you can see, this is not you typical bar food. The chef has good skill. Definitely a different type of food with great restaurant standard. I will definitely come back for the hog fish.

New Culver with new building, new location, and new market. This will be a challenge to many culver store. It does bring easy comfort food to the area and next to the mall. I have been to 4 culver, it will be comparison among them.   We are here for buy one get one free ice cream. The coupon is sweet. I have the flavor of the day. It keeps changing every time we're here. The only comment I have is the ice cream melt very fast compared to other location of culver.

I like the new concept of this place. This is a place I going to revisit. This first pick your own ingredients pizza place. It is build your own. First choose the dough. You can have white, wheat, gluten free or Keto friendly crust. I am going for the wheat dough. The guy who made it very skill. He stretched and throws to the air spinning with further stretching to thin crust. It is a show.   Then you chose your sauce. You don't need to choose one sauce. I got the extra virgin olive oil then ask them to add the basil pesto. This is the first time I see pizza using basil pesto sauce. Unique. Next step is type of cheese. I am going to mozzarellas. Then the veggies, I pick the mushroom, sundry tomatoes, minced garlic, basil leaves, jalapeño and olive. First time also I see pizza add garlic. Then the meat. I got the sausage, pepperoni, meat ball, salami. That complete my master piece.   I also ask them to top with balsamic drizzle. Love it. I don't eat a lot of pizza. But I would recommend this pizza. You can add the combo with drink and chip of gelato or salad.

Cool name to start the sandwich store. Very systematic to select the sandwich that you want. First identified the name. Then the sandwich of your choice, next type bread, then sauce, last is ingredients include veggies.   I would said this sandwich store is in the middle of the pack. Because they are systematically layout, they are not flexible to change for their meat selection. For instance if I want just capicola ham only, I will not be able to buy that. I have to select the entire Italian cut including pepperoni, salami. The reason they give is each portion is precut and assembled. You will not be able to twist and change. If I want extra meat, you have to paid entire assembly.   The sandwich is good taste for Italian, the balsamic sauce is great. But I feel sandwich assembly is thin not wide enough. A meal combo is above $10. It is above medium price range.

This ice cream store opened during pandemic. That was the time that the pandemic just began. I glad that they still operate and serving the community. We wish they hang on the business and continue. Their story includes good ice cream flavor, sandwiches and empanadas.   The flavor is very interesting. It includes mint chocolate chip, mermaid (cotton Candy), beach bum ( coconut, caramel, chocolate and almond), sea salt kisses and more. My wife have the Santa Letter - it is a lot of stuff including brownie, mint and other stuff. It is interesting. I have the eggnog. I love the taste of seasonal flavors.   We got beef empanadas. It is good snack for the night. They fried the empanadas fresh from order. We did not go for the the Nutella empanadas. It must be interesting. May be next time we will try it. Overall the store allow taste try. Which is good for the customers.

The remote restaurant is rest at the middle of the rural area. Who can think this place is good and affordable in price. We were attract to the recent post in the talk by Nick S. for the highly decorate 5 star restaurant. We have to check this out tonight. The whole street is dark at that area except this restaurant. People line out at this place before their turn to order. The store front is small and we have a suspicious this is good?  The restaurant look like a hipster place. The setup is efficient  allow the patron to order and they give you a code to pick up the food. The sitting area is limited. They have some table at the outside of the building. Today we have the Austinite taco, west coast taco, and the Texas flood taco. This is translated as Carne Asada Beef, grilled shrimp, and beef brisket. All meat is grilled to perfection. The Austinite came with caramelized onion and avocado. The Texas Flood has the chipotle BBQ sauce. The meat is grilled and have a lot flavor. The beef and shrimp is marinated.   All taco is $4.25, the burrito is $9.50, wet buritto is $10.25 and bowl is $9.25. You can order each combination at above package. The salsa of the chip is great. This place is affordable for the price, good quality food, perfect seasoning and flavor. As a result I have give them 5 star for the so little price we pay. The biggest price is to pay the gas to get there.

Big area for dog park where the city set aside for downtown living. The area was fence for big dog and small dog. My friend come to this place a lot with his dog.   This park has a rule to keep it clean and safe. The rule such as dog owner clean up and vaccinated plate. It also said the dog must under voice comments train .

I can said this place is a potential restaurant for UYE or YUM. This restaurant have all the components that it needs to be great restaurant. The cuisine are Cuban and Ecuador for selection. Food is delicious here.   This place do not have the fancy setup but a caliente welcoming for the person who craving for good food. Food here is killer good. Encebollado de Pescado. This is an Ecuador seafood soup dish. It has the tuna in lemon base soup and onion. The onion take the edge of the sourness of the lemon. It come with green plantains. It is very flavorful.   The next dish we have is Lechon Asado. This is roasted pork leg with mojo flavor. This is an amazing dish when they got it right. The meat is juicy and the skin full of flavor. This disk accompanied with arroz Moro. Arroz Moro is black bean fried rice. It is the best one I have with mix of black bean.   Other than the main entrée, they have sandwiches, fresh juice or shake, appetizers and sides.  I have the fresh Mamey juice. This is the only place I know have this juice.

I always a fan for Jersey Mike. They are just few sandwich store has the capicola ham. This is a spicy ham that has some kick of spiciness in it. I usually have them add extra meat with the ham. Then top with lettuce and tomato. I have the mikes way spice including salt, pepper, red vinegar and oil. Lastly have them top with two strips of bacon. That will be my lunch.   Their sandwich is the best that I like. Although the local Cuban sandwich is great, but I pick over Jersey Mike's sandwich.   You can get a combo with drink and chip. I like their southern sweet tea. You can cumulate point for free sandwich with your home phone. The service is quick here. They also has numerous hot sub to select including the Philly Cheese Steak. This location is a bit small compare to the one that Bruce b Down near USF.

Boca mean mouth in Spanish. Which is the restaurant goal to create yummy food into mouth. The restaurant self parking is actually a block away on the west.   Today lunch we have order the 7-spice yellow fin tuna and cilantro Florida grouper sandwich. The grouper sandwich comes with lettuce tomato for the sandwich and the side is the French fried with Parmesan cheese. The grouper is fresh but the fish is smaller portion compare to typical grouper sandwich in Florida restaurant.   The 7-spices yellow fin tuna is impressive. They have seared the tuna outwardly. The inside raw tuna is dark red. The dark red color indicates the high grade tuna. The tuna spice is well balance with the seared outward meat. It came with two sides. The baby Bok Choy and black sticky rice. My mom use to cook the dark sticky rice in the process of porridge and add the coconut extract. The chef here cooks the black sticky rice with kimchi. The taste is very sophisticate. The Bok Choy was stir fry and grill it is good. The tuna actually go well with the sweet soy sauce reduction. I have asked for more since the sauce only drizzling a few on the plate.   This is urban herb concept restaurant. You can select you own vegetable that is display in the restaurant. Good concept, but I prefer they are in the control environment. I mean out of customer contact. Because you never know who actually sneeze on it.  Overall the service is good, but the lunch needs to serve faster. When we receive our food it takes close to 25 minutes. There is no pre-meal item like bread or munch.

I have a gift card can be use and we are happen to be close to this store. The Parking lot looks empty at 2:30 during that time. The store may be only three customers including us. May be this is the best time to shop since they are not busy.   This is the biggest and nicer ABC that I have been through. I like the high ceiling that make the store elegant. They have many sections like wine, beer, spirit, imports and more. I am surprised that they have a big section of the hand roll cigar section. The display is very nice. Some of them is our local hand roll cigar.   I use my gift card get some of the import beer and American brew. I got the Blonde Guinness the American Lager. The taste is average like regular American beer. Guinness usually has stouts which is very good when you age it. But this Blonde is just average. I was surprised that Guinness has a brewery in U.S. I also have the Innis and Gunn from Scotland.  This is the rum oak aged beer. This is very interesting beer for winer (wine enthusiastic) like me. The experience has oak flavor and in beer. Nice taste.   The beer price is average compare to other wine and spirits store. I like this store that is well presented, nice parking lot, clear label section.

Fishing Man's haven. My wife jokes about this place. She said this is a men's world. A lot of man here. It is a good place for single women; this is the land of opportunity that they can find the future boyfriend. Be the Fisher of Man! Funny, I kind of agree with her.    I have been to the biggest Bass Pro Shop in U.S. at Springfield Missouri with 500,000 square feet. I have seen the best of Pro Shop there. In comparison, this is a small one but it has the best need for outdoor activities. They are selling the larger item such as boat to waders. Any kind of fishing needs, they have the largest selection. They also have hunting, clothing, camping, shoe section.   I always get exciting about pro shop is the fresh water fish tank. The fish here is a bit tiny compare to other pro shop. The reason behind is they need to have room to grow.   Today is the day after the opening and they already run out the size of the waders I want. I am buying this wader for bridge inspection when I need to walk to shallow water bridge. I have to order online. I see they display better recreation boat in Missouri store and they are cheaper there. The Tahoe recreation boat here does not have nice color design. Not as attractive as other store. (I am not talking about fishing boat).   The hunting section is interesting. You can see gun display for hunting. You also can find the chair strap to tree trunk high up for bow and arrows hunting.   Overall I like this store. Same as all the Pro Shop, they have a restaurant section for the food. I was told by the server is an hour and 40 minutes wait at 6:30. We did not try it yet. The salt water tank is still under pH balance. No Fish. I will be back to try the restaurant later.

Bloody day in English expression is a bad day. However, we are in the Bloody Mary festival and the party is on. Thanks to a friend provide the tickets that we can attend this festival. We are excited to attend this event with a group of yelpers.   The event certainly have many vendors some of them try to impress, some doing the right thing and some just have plain Bloody Mary. The ticket include one free drinks and all sample. Music playing at the big stage and all the food trucks are hugging along the area. I like the setting in Curtis Hixon Park to hold the event with Hillsborough River in the Back Drop. I certainly have too many Bloody Mary in one day. I have tried them all and I like the Ella's, Datz, Acropolis, and Roux. Some of them are spicy for my wife.  At the end of the day I have wonderful time since we have a group went to this event. Love the event when you have a wonderful time. We went on the riverwalk with solo musician playing at the background.

Little restaurant and family own Peruvian cuisine has many local come here to enjoy the food. It has large enough influence that close to Chinese side of cooking in the menu.  I usually do not paid attention to those. However, they also have many choices in the menu in Peruvian side.   We have order the Ceviche de Pescado to start. It was good Ceviche with raw fish in lemon juice. Not too sour. Our entrees are the Bisteck a la Parrilla (Grilled Steak) and the Arroz con mariscos (Seafood in creole rice). The steak is just ok average. The seafood is something. It has the shrimp, squid, octopus, mussels. It is good when they are together.   Food is good and the service is on point. I have the cicha moranda for the drink. You can feel is home made not from the can. Good enough sweetness. I like this purple corn drink.

A dollar sandwich day is the time we visited them. It is a good deal during May 2 special sale. The sub list fro 1 to 6 has $1 sale during that day. Although they are filling but after two sub is enough.   The promotion is from 4pm to 8 pm  that day. I applaud to them even there is a sale, they did run out of material. The sales item include ham , tuna, roast beef, Italian, veggies sandwich. They also did slow down because of sales. The line build up to outside of the door with 20 to 30 people at the line but the wait is less than 10 minutes.   Roast beef is ok but the Italian sub is bit above averages. This is about 3.5 stars. But because they did not deny people at the door or make you wait, I gave them additional half star round up. The people behind the counter always smiling. Good customer service.

Fuku is very nicely cute restaurant. The owners are the chef and manager husband and wife team. This restaurant has some characters that is pleasant to gather here. We have a group of 7 was easily seated comfortable.   Our food is came out rather quick. We have a spicy ramen to share. I like miso soup base ramen here. It is not too salty. The ramen is cook perfectly. The garnish is nice and they have fish cake in this ramen other than thin slice of pork. We have order the spicy tuna, sashimi and sushi combination, shumai, and the softshell crab bento box. Some good some average.   I like my experience here, the food is good value in downtown area. The service is good. I like this mom and pop shop that show the local color. This is good restaurant to have in this area.

Happy hour time with friends in this location. We meet up after work to celebrate. Certainly this Winghouse is the hottest location in Bay Area.   Tonight is a special night gathering. While we wait for all the friends, I have order a bluemoon. They do not carry Coppertail. Bluemoon is good and cold. We brought a cake to celebrate and the waitress is nice to but it out for us. I have order a smoke BBQ grill wing and two pork chop. The chop is a bit over cook and dry. The chef do not have skill to seal the juice. It accompanied with broccoli and mushrooms gravy with mash potatoes. Food did not impress me.   The more need to be improved in this winghouse. Table need to be clean, food need to improve and the parking need to be available.

Good sushi can be found here. The lunch special give you few buck different compare to dinner. With that said, their sushi price is reasonable also at dinner. I have book mark this place due several of my fellow Yelper friends check in.   They have good interior work pleasant to customers. We were here for lunch. The items we have try are spicy tuna, lobster roll, jaguar roll, hibachi combination with selection of salmon and scallops. Their sushi chef prepared correctly. Spicy tuna has good mixed of ingredients and taste. This is my first time with the fried eel roll - Jaguar roll. It is good to try it. The lobster roll has real lobster inside.   The hibachi combo is good way to enjoy. The scallops are sea scallops compared to most of the places give you bay scallops. The salmon was sear with outside crispy. The combo come with fried rice, noodle, veggies, ginger salad and soup.   Service is good. Sushi rice a bit soft.

Unexpected boat dock with a restaurant next to it. It is a favorite place for many boaters if they dock this place for a drink or dinner. I have to warn you this place close at 8 pm and they may be run out of food to serve after 7 pm. Come early.   This place is pack when we arrive at 6:10 pm. We lucky to share a table with the other couples while watching the sunset. We order the oyster and a moment later the waiter tell us they run out. They were generous to give us a corn fritters on the house. The fritters is very nice with chunky meat of clam. It is very good. We order blackened grouper platter. They are very thick and blackened well.   The food is good, unfortunately they run out their catch and have no much things for your choice. It is nice place to watch sunset if you are here before 6 pm. Great dock for boater with direct access.

I have night work last night and I am free to lunch anyway today. We choose to come to this Koizi location instead of the Tampa Palm location. The chef here is better than the Tampa Palm Koizi. They must learn their lesson from the older Koizi. The restaurant is bigger and the food comes out faster.   At Tampa Palm the line and wait is longer. Here I was seated immediately. Like it. Interior is well decorated and spacious. We have order many thing from the menu. This is our first time we order the QQ ball-Chicken and Beef grounded ball. It serves with sweet sauce. I like their habachi with Sirloin. The meat is soft and tender.   We also have the Mt. Fuji Roll looks like lava flows from the top. I always order my favorite spicy tuna roll. It did not disappoint me. The rainbow roll interior crab meat is marinated with flavor. Compare to Bay Area endless sushi, Koizi has better flavor.

Cold Stone was our second choice tonight since other desert place is long line due to graduation. But we happy to be here with no line. They have out side sitting but the night is cold to sit outside.   Cold Stone Is a decent ice cream store. The R & D of the ice cream did very good job to create the standard ice cream flavor. Good choice of ingredients for your selection to be mixed. The ice cream certainly mix it correctly over the frozen stone on the counter. Clerks very friendly on this this store they also very polite.   I have the banana caramel. It has nut and bananas in the mixed. The only downside is melt quickly after mixed. Probably the cold Stone counter need to have the the temperature drop to the desired cold or chilled. However, it doesn't hide the great flavor.

Great restaurant. Lately they did not gets lot of traffic during lunch. It is easy to get seat if you have big party.  The food is good. They have a lot of promotion. Please visit their web site and sign up. They will send you deal such 1/2 price wine.

We were going to a different restaurant but the other restaurant is stopping the thali plate. As result I am chose this restaurant that mention by one of my friend.   I am a fan for the Biryani rice that cooks properly. They are too many recipes for the Biryani rice. I like the one with saffron and screw pine. This rice need to slowly cook. Today not many restaurants have the time to cook it over long period of time. Actually the longer you cook, the spice embedded deeper.   The Biryani rice here is above average, not on the top. But they are one of the items that I like in this buffet. The buffet is $9.95. It is a good deal when you have the chicken and the goat dish in the selection.  If you like meat dish, they have more selection compare to most Indian buffet are gear to the veggie material.   The restaurant is good. The buffet never runs out. The food of the buffet is ready before 12 noon. Like this place. I will be back.

Jackson Square. Artist! Artist! Artist!  There are many artists show case their creation around the square. If you love art, you almost can spend hours to talk to each artist of their way of create each piece. The art there is from contemporary to statute art. Each creation tells their own story and they are hanging on the iron fence.   The Jackson square is a park and garden. It got the name from the bronze statue that at the center of the square which display the general Andrew Jackson who won the battle of New Orleans in 1812. The statue shows Andrew Jackson tipping the hat while the hose rise in two feet. A sign of winning for the Battle of New Orleans.   This square surround by famous land mark such as Cathedral of St. Louis, Cafe du Monde, Cabildo, and the amphi theater. Many performances such Jazz Festival, Dragon master showcase have happened in this open air theater. This is an famous square that attract of the most tourist.

I am excited to try this restaurant. I like to try this hype restaurant with $$$$ for sometime. I hope for top dollar with very good experience. You have a choice to valet for $5 when you are arriving or looking for empty parking in the lot.   We were planning to try the happy hour before our show in the performance art center. After we have sit down, the hostess tell us the happy hour item is at the bar area or lounge. But they let us sit at the dinning room for happy happy hour item. We have waited them to bring the menu. Later the waiter has come to ask us again then we wait again. We could have gone to lunge area and be done with it.   We have ordered the lamb lollipop, lobster roll, and the charbroiled oyster. The lamb come in three big pieces with good quantity. The oyster is only three pieces a bit less. The lobster roll I have better elsewhere. The taste did not wow me.   The ending to pay the bill is quick no wait. I was expecting a lot from this restaurant but did not get the value we paid. Good restaurant but they can be great.

Food is ok. Selection of menu is very little. Fine restaurant at dinner serve with paper napkin for the price we paid is not upscale. Server is friendly. The price do not include dinner roll or bread. No much salad selection. Very limited.   There should be a lot to offer if they charging a lot of money. Not good with family but good for couple.  I am disappointed for price paid and there is no table cloth service. We were surprised that there is no espresso available after meal. I was more surprise when the waiter refer us to the near by coffee shop if we need the espresso. The rule of restaurant usually don't refer the customer to other food franchise or location.

1-21-2017 was the first day of business opening. This will be their third store in Tampa area. We were just in time when we walk in there and no customers after the parade. Immediately after our order, the store was jam pack.   Popsicle is suddenly back to fashionable ice cream. Hyppo has many flavors to choose. They have many fruits flavor. I already like the jack fruit. But that night I chose the pistachio coconut with a dip in chocolate. I never have a popsicle dip in chocolate before. The chocolate form a thin crust that make it more interesting. I like the flavor.   The sitting area is small. I like the window sitting. The wall painting is nice with "There are so many ways to eat a pop".  The hours is friendly to about 10 pm on week day and 11 pm at weekend.

Tonight drop a star. Food is good but service is below average. Before I order, I have mentioned we have a concert to catch and need the service and food in hurry. We order a nibble before the concert. We sit on the bar also for this reason to get in and out quick.   I have ordered the Mesquite Grill Oyster Rockefeller. The food come out in 10 minutes. Which is good. But when we close out the bill, the bar tender is dragging the feet. We ask the check and he acknowledged it but he keep circle around get the thing for other customers. Seem like he forget.   I would said the are few things need to improved. The speed of serving, no hesitation on looking a sit for customers, veggie on the table need to be cover.

Some of my Yelpiest friends have their regular visit this place a lot. The ice cream store give out the dog treat and the outside sitting is suitable for the dog.   Some Bruster's Real Ice Cream has inside sitting, but this one is all outside sitting only. It is great during May and November when the weather is mild. Florida has too hot sun that beat up the pavement which preserve the heat will not play well for the outside sitting. The ice cream melts faster if you are not hurry. As a result I got my ice cream and sit in the car to enjoy it longer. Other reason is fighting with mosquito while you eating the ice cream outdoor. Other than that, I like the Bruster's Ice Cream.   Bruster's ice cream has many offers. Sometime they have buy one waffle cone get one free, Flag Day $1 ice cream, coupon to purchase, frequent visit punch card and more. Please check their web site for the offer.  Don't get me wrong, this is a good ice cream joint. I visit a lot to this place then any other place.

This is the Volvo dealer I have my car service and buy the next car. I have to drive 45 minutes to this dealer if I want my car service. It is far from my home but why I like them. The service here is great compare to all other service that I have received from different dealer. I have been to Toyota, Mazda, Ford, Honda dealer but none have come close to the service here.   The good thing of the dealer is by appointment and makes your life easier. I always get the free loaner car (newer model Volvo) from them while I have my car service. After the service, they have my car wash and vacuum. It is a treatment. Every time close to my service, I receive the coupon of 15% discount. They are very proactive. Another good thing is Volvo is made such that service only need to be done every 7500 mile compare to most car is done at 3000 mile. Each year I only need 2 services for each year.   I bought my next car replacement here also. I waited for the internet special for the pre-own car sales. I normally buy the second hand car less than 30,000 miles and less than 2 years old. With the internet special, I got my car 50% from original MSRP price. Good price. I paid only $20,000. I always paid for additional manufacturer bumper to bumper cover up to 7 years and 100,000 miles. It only cost $1600 for this cover. As a result I bought a car that has more coverage (30,000 mile additional cover) than most cars. It has the luxury package such as BLIS, leather seat, moon roof, rear seat climate, road hazard and more. I believe they are general better than buying a new car. You can check their car fax with no accident.  Now they have the eco boast car that is gasoline with 37 mpg. Please check them out. The other Volvo dealer may not offer the same even they are in Bay Area.

When get to this Mall visit, it was second mall of the day. I was still full since we have two restaurant run before it. May be it is time to get something sweet and wait for my wife shopping. You Say When Yogurt Shoppe is the best choice for my sweet run of the night.   I did not go for the Yogurt because their smoothies is calling my name. The first is to choose type of healthy drink you want then is the flavor. I have chosen the mango banana smoothie. The smoothie is thick. The flavor is average. Even it is a small size but the sixteen ounce is good enough for me to last my wait.   This shop has yogurt with at least seven flavor for your choice. May be next time I will get the Yogurt. The service is good. The wait is short because it is almost closing hour.

In a Taiwan, there are many tea places with boba or specialty drink. However this place is unique due to the substitution of boba to fruit.   We were attracting by the picture some of the yelper posted for the drink with fruit. When we arrive, we notice they have yogurt by ounces and big list of specialty drink. We have tasted some of the yogurt and they are in good flavor. For specialty drinks they are break into six categories - fresh brew organic drink, fruit tea, ice milk tea, fruit smoothie, frappe, and hot latte. I am in the fruit drink and going for the Tutti Fruti - green tea with fruits. The tea is very sweet. The nice thing is the chop the fruit with dice size so you can suck through the straw.   The second drink we have is the mango strawberry smoothie. The smoothie has the chop up fruit. Personally, I prefer boba over fruit.   The preparation of the drink takes too long. They need to speed up. Overall, it is good experience.

The BBQ place located in a rough neighborhood. If you want find a good food and don't mind the place, this can be your adventure. King BBQ just off Armenia and I-275. There no place to sit. It is a to go place.   You may not experience the full menu. It is what they are cooking at that day. Today they just have the regular rib and the chicken. The price is good for the meat you get. I got half slab regular ribs for $13. It fill the entire box. The middle low part of the rib was grilled to crispy and not burn. It is very tasty. They do have the BBQ sauce selection with mild, mixed or hot. I have them put the sauce on the side. Since this is full size rib not baby back, the half slab look big.    The BBQ store is walk in and the grille just in front of you. You can see what you order. They will chop it for you for easy bite.

I have been to this restaurant several time. I like the outback at this particular location due to their service, material control, chef skill are top of their own chain restaurant. Tonight is special new year eve night. My wife call ahead for on system reservation. When we get there, there are already a lot of people waiting. The hoster said it need 1.5 hour of wait. We tell them our reservation and we waited for 20 minutes.   We sat down at 6:15 and the line is still building up after we have left at 7:40 pm. We came here today is not about the new year eve. It is about the Wednesday special 3 course meal $12 and up. It came with soup or salad and desert at entree price. I have chicken totier soup with 12 oz prime rib and my wife have the Parmesan chicken. The  totier soup is tomato base with spicy flavor and chicken chunk. The cheese melt in the soup make the spoon feed with dragging line of cheese from the bowl. The prime rib is an open grilled cooking and it is about a inch thick. It marinate with pepper corn and salt. They grilled to folk tender medium rare. It came with grill asparagus. My wife Parmesan chicken have the cheese on top and lite spice of garlic and salt. This make the Parmesan crispy when it oven baked. The crispy crush make the food more flavor to eat.   The overall service tonight is a bit slow due to crowded condition. The line still build up.

Nice set up for the store front. I also notice they also have the food truck. They post the location they running their food at the face book page. If you want to track them, please go to their face book page. Tonight their food truck is running to tampa general hospital.   The set up of the business is order on the counter and they will bring out the food. This a mix of cafeteria style and table service. They do have different source at the counter. If you like add spicy to your food, they have banana hot source and other kind source. As a food crazier, I like their banana hot source.   It is good place for lunch and dinner. Their lunch and dinner is the same price and they are very reasonable. We have lumpia, sisig, tocsilog, and mango turon. Three courses dinner run $32 for two. That is sweet. The food came with no vegetable attached is the only down site. The y may be can improve on this area by balance the nutrition of the meal by adding some stir fried vege. Their sisig and tocsilog are mainly meat dish with rice. The restaurant mainly serve the pork dish. Their food is close to philipino street food.

There are two BBQ near this exist of I-75. This one is only 0.6 mile from I-75. I am thinking to give a try this afternoon. This restaurant have unique selection of the rib. St. Louis style with dry rubbed; sticky bone is St. Louis style with caramelized; meaty back rib is tradition with selection of oversize meaty area of rib; of course there is traditional back rib.   I have the tradition baby back with sweet potatoes fried and BBQ baked bean. The full rack of the rib with one side is $11.99 and two sides is $13.49. What a price. Enough said, time to get your hand dirty. The best part to eat and enjoy the rib is by hand. The rib is dry rubbed and top with hickory smoke BBQ source. The meat juicy and pink. Because this is a dry rubbed, the meat is tendency to stick with bone a little bit.   With the yelp help, I was able to find this place. Thanks for those who have yelp before me. The rib at my plate is more than 12" long. Mmmmm!  This good.

I want some snack after the exercise. It is also the football Monday night. So I decided something quick with wings. I think Kentucky fried chicken may be a good choice.   Recently they have the $10 bucket with a choice of fried chicken, popcorn chicken or wings. I have selected the wings. The drive through is easy since there was no one in front of me. I got my order in two minutes. Nothing better than that.   The wings are fried correctly. Occasionally the have thick crust. The wings is a bit small compared to many wing place. I have 12 wings for $10 and with tax is about $0.90 per wing. It is average cost. In compared to I have Dry Rub wing for $0.80. I would said this is a three stars.

This is one of the old running restaurants close to 100 years old. It has been an honor and part of the history to dine in this restaurant. We have made the reservation through the YELP App that through the open table. When we arrive our reservation is in place and we we're sit immediately. I like the reservation system in YELP.  Tonight we have order the Escargots En Casserole, Oysters Arnaud, Turtle Soup, Pompano David and Assorted Green. The first course is the Escargots En Casserole. The dish comes with six mini cup of escargots top with mini croissant. Each ceramic cup has the garlic herb and Pernod. I like to take out the pastry and dip in the garlic herb and top with the snail. It is good. The second course is the Oysters Arnaud. It bears the name of the restaurant due to the famous five pieces oyster prepare in five different ways. The first piece of the half shell prepare with shrimp, mushroom, green onion, herb and season in white wine sauce. The second piece is top with bacon, pimento, green onion and pepper. The third piece is top with artichoke hearts, garlic, fresh Parmigiano Reggiano and in the extra-virgin olive oil. The four piece is essence of Creole in eggplant and andouille sausage. The final piece is actually the Oyster Rockefeller with spinach and bacon and a touch of Pernod. These five pieces are great to eat experience the taste around the world. Got to have them when you visit the restaurant!!  Our main course starts with turtle soup. This is unique dish that serve by many plantation near New Orleans. It has the game meat of the snapping turtle. It prepare in Creole sauce at tomato base. Our Assorted Green includes the hearts of Palm, butter lettuces, Arugula, Raddicchio and top with the duck crump crackling. It is serves with the Creole Mustard Vinaigrette dressing. Yum !! Pompano David is the fish that grilled with skin on fillet. It brushed with extra-virgin olive, lemon, garlic and fresh herb. The waitress was nice enough to split the order to two for the fish and green for each of us.   We have closed our night with a dessert The Banana Foster for two. The waiter will cook this dish in front of you. They start melt the butter, then they added the cinnamon and brown sugar and make the brown sauce. The exciting park is they flamed at table side with banana liqueur and dark rum. Banana is added to the sauce to cook and serve over the French Vanilla ice cream. This has end the evening perfectly. The waiter and waitress have an excellent service. They are quick to act and pick up the crump on the table. I have never seen a service like this. I would award six stars.  The up stair of the restaurant display the historic dresses from Mardi Gras at the pass. Please do not miss this opportunity if you visit this restaurant. They are locate at the stair next to the restroom up floor.

Butcher or BBQ. Both. I like BBQ side better. Their menu has included slice brisket, pull pork, chicken, St. Louis rib, kicking Wang (wing). Other than the typical menu, they also have chicken in biscuits, Korean Philly, burger, fried bologna sandwich. One thing catch my that I did not order is their side item watermelon salad. May be next time.   I got the brisket a la carte. The brisket is juicy and carry very minor fat to make it tender and juicy. The minor fat is the best way for the brisket to be grilled. The meat is well marinated. May be I will try their burn end next time. This dish serve with choice of BBQ sauce. I got the spicy honey and sweet BBQ sauce. Both are good.   The only downside is you have to wait there for your food to be made. I would prefer some system to inform the customers when the food is ready for pickup.

This seafood place do not have table to eat in the store. Mainly you have to order to go. If you thinking a picnic or lunch to go, this is a good place for seafood items. This isn't hole in the wall place but in a rough neighborhood.   When you walk into the store, the live blue crab is crawling in the glass counter display container. It shows you they cook these crab live. They have live seafood and the fresh catch of the day. The choice of seafood is a lot. Blue crab is their special. It can come with garlic butter or deep fried with coating. They also have fried scallops, Asian Cajun style live cook crawfish, fried shrimp and more.   We have the captain trio $10.99 - fried blue crab, shrimp and fish. If you substitute the fish to grouper add $2. The deep fried shrimp is very good. This dish also give two big pieces of fish, 4 blue crabs. Out of the four blue crabs, 3 of them have a very good blue crab with very tender smooth meat. I think this dish is the best value. However their best seller is the garlic butter blue crab.

Previous I have miss the UYE that Anna has. As a result I have book mark this place for trying. If you like popsicle this place offer many flavor.  It is located right on the Centro YBOR first floor. Easy to find. There was many patron have their popsicle there. The flavor is crazy. It include jalapeño, persimmon, jackfruit, carrot ginger, mamey, cucumber and more. These are the flavor that you may not think off. Very strange.   I have jackfruit and it has strong good jackfruit flavor. That was making them successful. My wife has a watermelon hibiscus. It is a bit watery. Very minor hibiscus taste and more to watermelon taste.   The popsicle price is in the high side. But I don't mind if they did a good job. The restroom in the store is for the customers.

To America - the Mexico style street vendor is here. This is very unique ice cream store that can be found in Tampa Bay. Most of the food and drink here are home made.  They made their own ice cream with various flavor. Most of the names of ice cream are in Spanish. Who care, they just need to be delicious. They also have ice cream in the stick or Popsicle. You can see the real fruit sticking out. Again, they have many flavors. Each one is in very reasonable pricing. In the store they also have the specialty drink. Non alcohol. But it is similar to street sweet treat in Mexico. I have sample for the pinacoloda, mango, tuna. Tuna drink??? It is actually cactus drink. In Mexico they call it tuna. Strange name. The drink is two dollars each.   The store items are affordable below $. It is great experience to go to ice treat store like this.

This music store we have visited if we are interested in a new music instrument. It has wide range selection. The most I like about this store is the clerk are very helpful compare to many music store. In compare with other Sam Ash in Bay Area, they are the better one.   We got our small scale base guitar here. The store has the tan color guitar on display. They has better color choice online. We were able to order online and test the floor sample if we like it. At the end we selected a shining blue color that we want. This guitar is light weight with smaller board and easy to be handle with smaller hand for the court control.   Price is at the medium. But ultimately the service we received is good and we were able to pick up from the store with no additional charges early than promised date.

This is a restaurant that hit and misses on their main menu dishes. Consistency is not there. The dim sum is consistent now compare to the period they run special. During special price period the dim sum is not in the right temperature. But currently, they do improve on their dim sum temperature.   The restaurant serves traditional Chinese dishes. Sometimes they are really good and sometime they are not measure to the standard. Today we are here for the dim sum. We have 8 people and we made our order and the first group of food came out in 5 minutes. Then the rest are following. Each item is at their right temperature. I like the most is the fried shrimp ball. The shrimp is ground and cornstarch and coated with slice wonton skin.   Since we have the big group, the bill is included the tip which make our life easy since they figure the tip for us. We over order a lot of item since only seven of us go for dim sum. Good dim sum number is 3, 4, 6, 8 or 9 people. 7 is an odd number out not easy to satisfy each one if you order less or you have to over order them.

They took an old Honduras restaurant space that was here before. They have the outside and little inside sitting. The inside AC area is only hold 10 people. But their outside sitting do have the bar area open for party. I did not go the bar AC area.   We got the Lechon Plate and the Pollo Asado Plate. This two plate has meat. Definitely like the lechon. It was well pack to the box for two go. It come with rice and bean, sweet plantain and red chili. I like lechon. Not sure they serve the skin. If they do, I will ask them to include it. The pollo on the other hand is just ok.   With that said. The wait is about 10 minutes at 3:30 pm. I wonder what will be the wait during lunch. However, they have take out call in availability, this will cut down the wait. The price and quantity is measured up. I would go for lechon.

Simply Pho has the right location to start the restaurant. The restaurant interior design is attractive and eye pleasing to customers. The restaurant have small capacity for the sitting, I can predicts they are going to get busy due to the affordable pricing and good food. Try it now while you can get sit easily.   Today we only try a very little section of the menu. The menu has two pages. They have offer the pho, Hu Tieu southern Vietnam noodle soup, stir fry noodle, vermicelli, fried rice, and the special. They also have variety of appetizers.   We have order the pork skin roll, pork sausage roll, roasted quails and southern Vietnam combination (Hu Tieu). The pork skin roll is wrapping like a fresh roll with peanuts and pork skin. This is a blend taste fresh roll. The pork sausage roll is also a fresh roll with charbroil pork sausage. The pork is well grilled and has a wonderful taste. I like this roll.   The roast quails are not the best in the Bay Area but they are excellent dish. The dish come with salt and pepper on the side which I think you can eat without it. The quail smell good and I always eat with my fingers.   The southern combination noodle soup is in clear broth. This is not pho but it is wonderful dish and very light. It is good for people who are in weight watching. The noodle is the medium size egg noodle. The soup come with combination seafood and slices pork.   Overall the experience is good. The service is good also. The waiter and waitress are still learning the menu. I will be back for the second page menu.

I like this restaurant a lot because they serve Philippino Street Food. This Asian fusion restaurant make a good stand in the loop neighborhood of St. Louis. I would recommend you give them a visit. I cannot a non Philippine chef can perform well on those cuisine. I did communicate with the chef and he has spent some time in Philippine.   Our first dish is the sisig taco and qwek qwek. The sisig is braise pork belly and shoulder. The qwek qwek is the quail eggs battered and fried. The put three in the skew. Very interesting food.   Our main dish is the Bicol Express. This dish is dice pork shoulder stew coconut milk and shrimp paste. The sauce very similar to adobo. Our second dish is the flying pig. I would recommend this dish. This dish has 12 hour braise pork and top with sriracha sauce. The best thing is the the 63 degree egg on top. Very good.   The restaurant is like cafeteria type. Order at counter and bring it to the table.

This is Vietnamese fast food in the mall. This is first of it kind. It you have to choose a mall fast food, I would go for the pho which is more healthy and easy. They are located next to the carousel in the mall.   They have quite a selection for the type of pho you like. It include the seafood or fish ball noodle soup. I have the meat ball and slice rare beef noodle soup. Soup is good. They may not be the best in the Bay Area but it is good enough for the mall.  They also carry different type of boba smoothie. I did not try their boba but my neighbor boba look very good.   The service is good. The sale person very patient explained to me each item. The only down side is each item is prepared in package. I like to mix and match which will make thing more interesting.

This food truck was at my eye sight for some time. I drove pass it for many time at that location and saw bright light next to the gas station. I have been here one late night but they close. Today was the perfect day to try.   I would say they are the best taco in USF area. It is number two best in my list. We have order the lengua, tripa, asada, al pastor. I love the lengua and tripa. They are good flavor. The steak (Asada) was well seasoning, I like their way burn the steak a bit to bring out the aroma of the steak. The pastor has deep seasoning. Most of the taco place only lightly seasoning not bring out the good of the taco. Here did a good job.   On my next return, I will surely try the Cabeza, chorizo, chicharon, and carnitas. Food is reasonable price. You can call the number to place your order ahead and pickup without waiting. They are fluent in English. Since it is affordable, I am not paid your taco.

This restaurant is in my list to visit after I have seen the Anthony Bourdain No Reservation CNN show. During the show, Anthony visited New Orleans after hurricane Katrina. It shows case the hard hit recover and the good southern food.   This restaurant can be reached by car or Taxi. This restaurant is busy sometime that the owner put a sign not to block the door during the high traffic. Today they did not have seafood. So we have order the famous fried chicken and the smothered veal. The veal came with gravy and bone in beef and a choice of side - the fried okra. The veal is braised to folk tender. The taste is amazing. The fried Chicken is the southern style. The side that we chose is the green bean gravy rice. The chicken is fried to crispy with paper thin coating. It is not like other thick coating fried chicken. The race green bean gravy is a bit spicy and it is family recipe that cannot get elsewhere. This is the side to try.  Willie Mae original owner is 93 years old and past this family business to her granddaughter. Now the kitchen and the restaurant is run by Mike the current owner husband. This restaurant attract of a lot tourist visit by Taxi. When I am there, I see at least three taxis unload their customer to the restaurant. This is the place to visit if you visit New Orleans.

Waffle, Fried Chicken, and Bacon. Great combination!!  How was the bacon was done. It hide between the waffle. The bacon are all pan seared to crispy then mixed between layer of waffle. It becomes waffle bacon. Amazing concept.   I have the trip RyRy Triple Threat waffle chicken and the Korean wings. The triple threat comes with three different RyRy signature chicken. The original, southern, and Korean chicken. These chicken pieces from the chicken breast and make in three different flavor. I like all of them with variety in one order. It also come with choices of syrup. I got the sriracha syrup with some spiciness in the taste. Great combination.   The Korean wing I have it non breaded. You can have the option to breaded the wings. The Korean sauce on the wings is great. It has tiny ginger in the sauce and make it sophisticated. All orders need to be waited. Table is limited if you decide to eat there.

Record, CD, Book. What a combination. It is close the USF where you find your music in the pass. This kind store is getting harder to find. Although this not the future technology, but it has a goodie of the old song that you never think of.   The store is very cute. Sometime they have live show or music. If you need a LP, they have plenty. Book every way. Store like this alway have a coffee shop inside. I have the Mexican Mocha. It is a spicy coffee. Mmmm. SPICY.   They also have Japanese Yama Coffee. This coffee suppose to be the high caffeine coffee for Japanese. The distillery is display on the side. Funny looking.

This is about 4.5 stars restaurant. Iron Oak has good skill BBQ. Especially the smoke technique. I like their BBQ. This is a BBQ sport bar. You love to have the local breweries beer here.   We started with the devil eggs. This devil egg come in three pieces with bacon on top. My entree is the Porker. This is a half pound beef patty with pull pork and crispy bacon on top. BACON!!!! It stack up with fried onions and claw slaw on top. Try to fit it into your mouth.   The best is their smoked chicken wings. These wing is smoked till the skin are crispy. They sell by weight. They have good seasoning. Each wing is about $1.20. I would recommend this dish.   The service is great. Very attentive. The price is at medium to high side. It has open air seating with TV.

During the pandemic, the store observed the CDC guideline. Face mask is required. They set up the paid screen and information screen 6 feet from the clerk desk if you buy the appliance. Service need to be improved. When we reach the sale area of appliances, only one agent helping, and he said just go to the front to get another agent to help since he is helping other customers. We did but the new agent did not show up. We wait till the current agent finishes with the current customer and continue. This area they need improvement.   I like to give the high mark on the delivery system they have. They will give you the progress of the delivery, such as agent delivery assigned, appliance on the trucks route, and final call they will be here in half hour. Their delivery agent is very professional.  I got my LG refrigerator that at their store with open box item. It was good deal to check out any open box item.

For weekday lunch. The selection is great. You also can make your own pasta. Choose the pasta type, choose the protein, and choose the sauce. I can said that they have great chef technique. It won't be able to go wrong.   The lunch special is less than half of the dinner price. It great for the business people have lunch here with quick order and get out in 40 minutes. Food is extremely good. You are paid more than value, great food and great flavor.   We have chef Complimentary tomato sauce over toasted bread. Our entree are Grouper Rosso and Prosciutto Linguine. Both dishes are excellent. The Grouper Rosso grouper is blackened over fettuccine. The fettuccine is serve on creamy basil tomato sauce. It includes the mushroom and scallions. Great combination.   The best dish is the Prosciutto Linguine. The Prosciutto and the fried garlic make great combination. The Prosciutto release the cure meat flavor into the dish make this dish desirable. Lovely dish.

Tree house is very hip. But it do not have my vote. There are several reasons that they are two stars in my book. First, service is too slow. We have to wait for long time to be serve, get a drink and pay out. Second, the hostess has table but have us wait for 20 minutes for seat. They seat people who come later a lot faster after we are seated. Third, food is not rememberable or not at it best.   We order the chicken waffle and fried chicken. This two item is not impressed. Seem the food is warm which mean it has been seat on the counter sometimes. The waffle is just ok. The fried chicken just average. I am guessing they do well is many young people like it. Seem like Sunday brunch is good goR them. But for me this is been there done that deal.

I am in agree with CoreLife healthy living food. It is a good concept to start the restaurant. This restaurant is wide open seating. One good thing to sell their food is to have many special drinks. These drinks have all you can drink. They are many choices which includes apple green tea I like. Some of the tea is with honey and some with no sugar. Non caffeinated is the fruit punch.   For the entree I got the grass fed steak plate and tuna poke rice bowl. The steak is grilled there and keep warm in the oven. I do not like the steak medium well. I rather they cook to order since they have some one there to grilled the steak all time. The poke is just average. One good thing is their side. They have purple rice that I like. Other than that, the rest of protein seasoning is average.   This is order from counter and bring your food to table. Not much of service. Some table still can see cup ring left by previous customer.

There thing they did a good job for the customers. Their drinks is one of good things. The restaurant has contemporary comfort look. I like the wide area with game available to be use by the customers. Seat is comfortable.   I have honey dew with Aiyu Jelly. I would they are the first that have this. This is a summer drink to cool down at Taiwan. Aiyu is made from dried fig fruit seed. This place are the first I know use Aiyu jelly. The tea is fragrant and nice. My wife has the the butterfly tea. All tea come in large size. It was great for the price paid.   We also got the bah mi. It is good also. We like this store with new type jelly.

Review # 2700, this review milestone go to Local Italian Restaurant to recognize their new efforts during pandemic.   The restaurant take over previous Italian restaurant which has been here for some time. The new owner creates the attractive menu. What you need to ask is their special. They do have separate chef special seafood items of the night other than the menu. I also like the bigger dining room with compare to old restaurants. The ventilation also improved from old setup.   We start the night with the fried calamari. The coating has a special flavor with seasoning. The dipping marinara sauce is fresh and different. I love it. Ingredients must be good condition to have the good sauce.   My wife have the chicken parmigiana with spaghettini with pink sauce. The chicken is breaded with marinated coating. It was crispy and tasty with cheese and marinara sauce. The pink sauce also interesting. My dish is a signature of the restaurant. I have the sacchettini with added grilled shrimp. This is the first time I try sacchettini. It is dumping stuff with pear and mozzarella. Then it cook in Gorgonzola Sauce. It is heavenly good. Highly recommend this dish if you have never have this Italian dish before.   Overall the service and food is good. A VERY excellent Italian Restaurant. Please ask if you can bring your own wine.

We were here for the dinner happy hour before 6:30. The place do not have a good access if you come from the east of Bearss Ave. we eventually got to the place with a lot of turn. The plaza have plenty of parking space if you need to get to the restaurant.   I would they about 4.5 stars restaurant. For the happy hour dinner, definitely 5 stars. We got one of the top seller Lama rolls. It is flame torch over the salmon and wrap with spicy tuna. It is good. Their happy hour roll are the best. We got seven rolls. We spicy tuna, bagel, Mexican, yellow tail, eel, tuna, and crispy salmon. I like all of them, especially the eel, spicy tuna, crispy salmon and yellow tail are the best.   The service is great. The waiter is realizing we don't like cream cheese and it was not add into it. The sushi rice is the best. Great sushi rice in Carrollwood. I would said they are the best happy hour sushi I like.

Awesome display. The lego artist Nathan Sawaya has creations that drawn many to see. He is lawyer with free time to expressing himself in the aft form. Many pieces that were displayed are very creative. This exhibition was sponsored by Vinik Family Foundation. A big thank to them to bring such a caliber artist to the city.   The art not just mimic the ancient famous paintings, it has our daily life movement in 2D or 3D art format. In fact, some of the art cannot even tell it is made from lego after you have snap the photo of those creation. The photo just look real. I like the eye position art, in some angle you could not see it but other angle completely show up with surprising picture.   The photographer superimposed with lego art is awesome with pictures. It is out of the world. It has the beauty for the right things. Such as a man using the lego umbrella in the rain, a lady in front of the ticket box office with her dress disintegrated.   Tip - go there every month since they swap out the art time to time. The art will be displayed for 3 months. Seem like each month they change out a few pieces. Weekend expect long line. There is parking at the entrance under the bridge.

This is classic restaurant in Tampa when my wife told me. They reason they classify as classic is they been in Tampa Bay for a long time. They main reason they survive for so long is due to their regular customers. There is a reason why people keep coming back. The reason are quantity of food and affordable to many.   We have chop BBQ pork sandwich. I this this is their best seller because the chop pork and house sauce make this dish savory. We also has two meat combo. This dish I consider is a value dish. We got baby back rib and chicken. It come with 4 bone rib and quarter chicken in good price. I like they provide the BBQ sauce in warm condition which not sit on the table and condensed. This may be their selling point for the regular who coming back.

I saw many low rating reviews about this place. Since I have not visited this place, I like to give them a try. I saw many low rating review during first month of the opening. I hope they have improved when I visit them.  We have ordered shrimp and lobster chowder and signature salad to start. The chowder is creamy with small size shrimp that cook for long time. It blend well with the lobster and potatoes inside. The signature salad got good dressing. The most intriguing is the honey walnut with strawberry.   Our main entrée are the Grilled Lamb Chop and Flat Iron Steak. I would not recommend flat iron steak since this steak have a lot of tendon. It difficult to bite. A lot of cutting to remove make smaller piece. The lamb chop is nicely decorated. The only complaint is they cook these lamb chop to almost well done which I ask for medium. I also asking for sauce to be on the side which they didn't do.    Overall service is attentive. Chef skill on mixing the spice is An "A". But grilled technique need small improvement.

I have been here shopping, watch movies, food court, restaurant watching Kentucky Derby. You name it. It is comfortable Mall. Many sitting area. Very convenient for the shopper companion that not shop a lot and found a seat to rest and people watching.   This mall has high end, technology, clothing, specialty store. It make interesting to shop. Usually I finish my shopping early and I spent remaining time wait for other to finish. I can relax on the food court or the seats on middle of the walkway. This mall is climate control and enclosed the entire mall make the shopper like me relax and wait.   They have few restaurants with bar make thing easy to spent time here. You can have a few drinks while waiting. I like Red Robin and the BJ are good choices to past the time. In the food court bubbleology is interesting drink to try.

This crab shack has been there for long time. I like the seasoning that put on the crab. They serve live blue crab cook in the spot. Since cook it from live, the crab is fresh. I got 6 large crabs under $17. A lot of meat. Unfortunately one of the crab missing the crawl. If not because of that, I may have give them 5 stars for crab along.   This shack really doesn't have a good place to sit and eat. Basically is a take out place. The day I have visited, they have 10 blue crab crawl for $3. They can cook crab by fried or steam garlic. The price varies due to the size of your choice.   They serve other seafood which I may not able to said anything about it since I only like their blue crab. They have oyster, shrimp, clam strip, crab cake, devil crab, wings, snow crab, fish, gumbo, corn dog. Any how. Go for the blue crab.

I would said this is the best Philippino restaurant in the Bay Area. It is a mix with grocery store and the restaurant. I can see the problem of this restaurant is the response time to the customer. We sit down for 10 minutes before anyone come to ask what I need. In fact, there was no one out at the front for good 10 minutes. We help ourself for the menu.   We got our orders immediately once we have someone come to our table. The food came out very quick. We order the Binagoongang Baboy - pork with shrimp paste. It you are not use to shrimp paste do not try this dish. I like this dish since the pork are well braise and soft. If they cook this dish with hot chili, it will be much better.   Our second dish is the most popular dish of the restaurant. It is Da-Long-Tocilog combo. It is a breakfast dish that serve all day. It has fried pickle fish, cure pork meat, pork sausage serve with garlic fried rice and fried egg. This is a very good dish.   The food is 4 stars, but the service and attentive of the store front is 2.5 stars. So 3 stars for the restaurant. Do I come back. Yes, for the combo breakfast dish that was not serve else where. It has better menu compare to the Bay Area Philippino food restaurants.

Very nice setup. I like the open area of this restaurant. I have been to same location and Spot Sushi is the third restaurant who hold as a restaurant in the same address. I like the menu they serve. They are part Halong Bay restaurant group.   We started with Bo Bia Spring Roll. This is fresh roll with Chinese sausage, egg, jicama. Jicama is widely de in Malaysia street food. This is rare occasions I see they se it here. That is the main reason they call Bo Bia. We added the appetizers Dynamite Mussels. It is chop mussels with mixed in imitation crab salad and baked together. It is interesting dish too.   Our entree are the spot pho and the Hu Tieu Thap Cam - combination noodle. The pho is good. It more authentic soup base with heavy herb smell. I like this way better than like beef bone soup. The Hu Tieu has good combo of meat and seafood in the bowl. I like that one too.   Overall service is good. Social distancing was provided on each table.

This restaurant is tiny. If you decide to come here for lunch, may need to come early for two reasons. Limited seat and wait time. The chef cook each dish on the wok separately. I like this delicate service for each dish. As a result, it take time if someone is ahead of you. May be take out is the best choice.   I got the drunken noodle. This dish was stir fry in high BTU wok. Slight edge burn which the correct way to cook this dish. It come with egg chicken, broccoli and bell pepper. It was delicious. The only thing I would said not spicy enough since I have ask for Thai hot.   Dish is affordable. Not much of service because the entire restaurant is run by two people. Very limited seat. Less than 20 seats.

Finally we have Poke place that can pick the side items you like to add on. Orlando has this build your own and 4 steps process assembling about 5 year ago. Tampa simply behind the schedule.   U pick have advantages and disadvantages. You may need to have some chef know the flavor and ingredients skill. First pick your base. Rice, brown rice, veggie, chip. Second pick your protein tuna, salmon, chicken, octopus, crab salad. Third pick your ingredients. Fourths pick your sauces and last pick your topping. If you pick the wrong thing, it is your fault. No body to blame.   Overall l like to have this U pick restaurant. A few things the restaurant can improve is to have the ingredients and sauce mixed before join the poke bowl. If you have the plain protein, that also can join the mixed up.

John Pass Village offer tourists attraction for the vacationer to visit. The boardwalk offer nice evening stroll. The fishing boat come back with their catch. The fish clean is one of the major attraction when the fishermen with the skill knife fillet the fish. While they cut off the un wanted section, the remain was through into the Bay. There was a lot of pelican waiting to collect the remain and cut off section of the fish.   A long the boardwalk, many restaurant was there. You can book the fishing trip here. Or you can get the dolphin watch. You also can rent the wave runner.   The bad side- the high parking fee discourages the local to visit. Why we waste tax money for making this place good but it charges you a lot on parking. The restaurant also did not make a good deal of it. Because of the tourist spot, their price is normally high. As a result, the village has narrow to only tourist.

Rene is one of the great food truck in Tampa. For the Taco Truck, they are at top of my list. Great food and creative. Now they are located next to across Southern brewery empty lot area. You may want to call ahead before your visit to see if they open. They were at Dale Mabry before. The current location is more permanent.   We have three different taco to try. We have the Chile Relleno, Carne Asada, Pork Barbacoa. The one taco that very interesting and recommended is the Chile Relleno. This jalapeño stuffed ground beef and fried. This is the first time I have taco this way. The carne Asada was delicious compared to many steak taco.  Overall the taco are excellent. Flavor is definitely good. They also have other type like grilled butter squash, pork belly, steak bacon, spicy shrimp and oyster mushroom. These menu is great and think out of box.

English Tavern, Queen Guard, Lion, and Englishmen. You can find all this thing here. This is my second visit. I still love the ambiences. It feel like pub in England. I can bet you any premier league soccer game must be fill up.   I am here for their special came ridge wings. Those are the great wing to have. It is bake, then grilled.  The marinated sauce is awesome. 10 wings for $13. Each wing is about $1.3. It is at the high side in price. But still love it.

Authentic Ethnic Street Food 72. Shawarma   Interesting street food that now I can said happen in Tampa. Very good authentic shawarma. I have travel to Jordan, UAE, Morocco, and Egypt, this shawarma is very close to the way Jordan has prepared.   We got one beef and one chicken shawarma. If you want extra meat, you can have a choice to choose a different price. The wrap skin is very delicious. Recommend to eat there to get full experience. If you have to eat at the car, do so. Eat at first complete prepared is the key.

The restaurant service is good. The server paid good attention to our table. She also have knowledge of the menu and daily special. The restaurant is at prime location at the mall entrance. They got very good customer base. The restaurant is 80% pack in the early dinner hour.   We got two items from happy hour, we have the oysters and the medium neck clam. Both dishes was fresh and delicious. My wife have fish and chips. The fish is in good large piece. It also has crispy coating. It is good dish with the fries. I have the crab cake. I think the crab cake is below average. I think it has too much dough than crab meat. It do come with string beans and rice. The side dish is a choice from menu.   Overall experience is good. It is about 3.5 stars. I still think if their menu can be re-engineering with attractive dish in use seasoning, cook method, or flavor, they will do very well.

Definitely need reservation for this restaurant. Even with reservation, the wait still take 30 minutes for party of seven. This is the area I think they need improvement. Imagine you don't have reservations and it is weekend.   The previous restaurant also Korean BBQ. But I like the current Korean BBQ better. I like they have conveyor belt with food push out. Now you can select what is pleasing to eye. The marinated meat need to be order. For the BBQ, I agree on some of the reviewer comments that it is more to Chinese Korean influences marinated sauce. But who care. It is still good.   You also can enjoy the hot pot with BBQ combo. The hot pot has great selection. Including the fresh blue crab. The crab was clean very well. Good cleaning technique without sand trap.   Service is good. As I said to the BBQ before. Don't bring any leather cloth or purse to the restaurant. It is a big smoke house. The food smell will stick the leather good. Wear easy walk clothes. Because after you eat, all the food smell will stick to your body including the cloth.

I think this is a 4.5 stars restaurant. Somehow the yelp only shows 3.5 stars. Maybe our experience is great during our visit. The reason they have 4 stars instead of round up 5 stars is due to their dessert a bit of let down. The poppy seed cake can be more moist to make the entire experience better.   We were here for the restaurant week. We started with the watermelon tomato gazpacho and Michell House Salad. The gazpacho is an excellent dish here. I definitely recommend not to miss this dish.
