The house salad has a good sweet not overpowering dressing. It is well balance.   Our entree are the seared salmon vegetable couscous and the shrimp and crab Linguine. The salmon was well fried with skin attached. It top over couscous roasted shiitake mushroom on the pea purée. Mmmmm. Sound good right. The Linguine is not bad either. It has a lot of large shrimp and lobster meat. Snot dish sit well in my stomach.   As I said, lemon poppy seed pound cake did not do well. But the mini sharkfin pie is good enough. Service is excellent for our visit.

My first take of the pub is great gathering place in Tampa Palm area. Generally it has good seating area. Most chair is high top. May be a bit difficult for the ladies with dress. This pub not populated with TV. It can be more but enough for each corner.   This pub food and drink price a generally a dollar more than the other pub. The wings after tax is about $1.3x per wing. Average wing price at USF and New tampa is about $1.00. As a result, we expect to be spectacular. I have blacken wing. The wing is fried correctly. The blackened spice is not so. I think can be improved. I wonder if they have grilled stove. If they do the grilled will add flavor into it. That can be improved easily.   I like new business because they really bring value to the community. In the same time, they need to be reasonable. I know they invest a lot in a business. So far they have the customers and it is time to correct.

It is about 3.5 stars. This new boba place is at the same place of previous ice cream place. They have roll ice cream and the boba drink. Selection of menu is quite good. But the price after the topping is in the high side. Which I would said it is in the high side in compare to many boba places.   I got the 35 degree special smoothies. The choices include the Thai tea, coffee, coconut, almond, matcha, and taro. This is first time I see Thai tea smoothie. It is good but not sure it measures to the price. After adding the seventy cents topping make this drink almost $7. It better be good for that price. I think the smoothie is just good and middle of the pack quality.   Overall is good. If they can have the combo drink to attract more customers is better. May be change the method a bit especially they pickup this store from previous ice cream store. They do have soy milk and almond milk selection.

Excellent service, food and good atmosphere. This Noble Crust was strategic located in Carrollwood area. The selection of the plaza for this restaurant is perfect. In this plaza, they are the only restaurant. Which mean perfect for parking spot since no other restaurant compete for car parking during the night. I can easily find a space to park in compare to many other restaurant which I have circular the area for parking.   The place in trendy. I like the modern decoration.   Service: the waitress know how to compliment the dress or shoes of the customers make lady customers feel they did the right thing. This added pleasures does go a long way.   QC: I have observed the kitchen head chef QC every dish come out. This make the consistency of the food. I would said that is a big step to make sure the food come out correctly.   Kitchen: the new Noble Crust does have full equip big kitchen. It make all the food fly out without too much to wait. This is the reason why they are successful in this location.   Food: we have the bistro steak, FGBLT, and the PEI mussel. The steak is cook to the temperature we have asked. It is good size of steak. It top over collars green with southern twist. The accompanying mash potato top with drizzle balsamic vinegar and green aioli. I like the steak top with green apple chimichuri. Very unique. The FGBLT is lay the fried green tomato as a base and layer with pimento cheese. Final touch top with glazed pork belly. The presentation is very nice. However the pork belly harmony is not there. I would said they need to work on the skin fat and meat combination. It need to be melt at your tongue instead a very chewy piece. I like the PEI mussel. It is cook with saffron broth. Most of the mussel I have either butter wine sauce or tomato red sauce. I like the way they have it with the southern twist with added andouille sausage.   Overall, they are very good job with competitive price. It make me to revisit. Truly 5 stars restaurant with the right price. Not perfect. But close enough.

I would give them a fair average restaurant. With that said, they did a good job during pandemic period. They put napkin dispenser for you get a piece napkin to open the door without contact. The food are paid online and no touching in the store to exchange payment. Food is put on the table as barrier from kitchen. Base on your order and name you can pickup your order.   I order the broccoli beef, Kung Pao chicken, mushroom chicken, fried rice, noodle. The broccoli beef I barely see the beef. I do got a lot of the broccoli. The Kung Pao chicken is better. At least 50 to 50 meat and veggies. The mushroom chicken meat is less veggies is more. All dish has a lot of sauce. Which mean the chef wok a little less and has a lot of water sauce.   Overall experience is good. The online order need to be pick up in the store instead of drive throu

Great establishment for the new restaurant. Food is very affordable here and better value than any fast food chain. It does bring a lot option for the local residents if you want some things to go and eat it elsewhere. This restaurant provides the Vietnamese cuisine option. I would have many take out from here if I decided not to cook.   We were here to have the grilled chicken rice bowl and vermicelli grilled beef. I like the food is easy assembly's and fast delivery. I did not try the bah mi yet. Base on their grilled meat technique. The chicken is nice and juicy. The beef marinated a bit light. All meat marinated into the deeper side of the meat. The serving temperature is warm not steaming hot. This is the area may be they need to work on. I like the fried spring roll. It is about 3.5 stars restaurant.

They sell smart items or advance invented items. Most of the items look very futuristic. The design is well thought out. I would said their store actually divided to pleasure, daily comfort, interest, and decoration.   Pleasure included the massage chair, massage equipment, easy listening headphones, VR goggles,  wine aberration. This item is great enjoyment when you using it. Some of the massage chairs can rotate your position to face up.   Daily Comfort including different pillows, dog floor mat, nap blankets, memory foam slipper, travel pillow. Some of the pillow maintained the cool temperature and good for warm weather.   Interest include toy, drone, change able magnet ball, remote car, talking football, smart garden. This items spot the interest of many. I alway like their drone section. The newest drone can fly, drive or dive in the water. Amazing.   Decoration included digital fan match your picture, cordless Christmas light, led starburst light, lighted pillow, decorative floor mat.   Check them out. They may have something you need.

This is only place sell go cup wine for Armature Works. Many has come here for cup of wine. When I was sitting there, at least 8 customers has come to get their wine. Popular place. I think they are more successful than the one at McDill.   The steak is good amount for the price paid. We have the sirloin steak. The steak was cook very well to the asking temperature. Meat quality is super. I would said like it. Now day at Armature can be easy spend that much of money per dish why not a good piece of steak.   The food is good. I would give them better than average.

This newly added restaurant. They are new restaurant that in Amberly Drive. Their menu is not ready when I first visit. I decided to have takeout and try their food. When I was there, they still decorating the restaurant. They are doing some final touch.   They do have 4 pages of the menus. They do recommend a few dish is must try. I did not go for it. I leave it to next time. I got the Apollo Fish. It is a dry curry fish. Good number of pieces. I like the curry. I was able to select the spiciness of the curry I choose medium because my wife cannot take the most spicy.   I would try a few dish that is must try as suggested next time. This include the Chef Dadang Dosa, Desi Lovers Curry Leaf Chicken. I also try the chef special curry goat and chicken Manchuria.

I like the different style of food is being served in Tampa. This fruit juice bar is one of the kind. It is part of Columbian daily street fruit juice. There two Columbia Mango I know off. This is one of them. I like this one better because they able to customize the drinks and fruit you want. In compare to boba drinks, this mango mix fruit juice combo is more naturally done. It is healthy.   I got mango mixed and custom myself. I have mango noodle, mango leche, condensed milk and ice cream. Very nice. I ask them to prepare in the sweeten side. You can ask for sour drinks. The mango leche is from green mango frozen into drinks. Very refreshing. I also ask them pick the sweet mango which is great combo.   The service is great here. The people who do mixer are very friendly. I will be back to experience their other fruit combo.

I like CVS because they really serve the community in need. They has good pharmacy center that you can email the prescription and they fill it up for you. I can pick up any daily use items if I need it especially when I travel.   The have the photo section that you can develop your digital photo for hard copy. When come to season holiday, they have the items from Christmas, Halloween, St Patrick, valentines and more. It has convenient items such as tooth brush or shampoo. This store has print out coupon station for item you have seen discounts. This is very convenient.

His bakery cafe and sandwich store is local favorite. We were in the area and try something for my book mark. The interesting item will be the the Tomato pie. But we did not go for it.   We have the carrot cake. The cake is moist and good. I would said they have good dessert. It includes the banana cream pie, red velvet cake and more. There are some good sandwiches post by other including the Cuban sandwich. May be you want to try it.   Overall is I good. I would call it average.

This is a unique bakery. This is a Puerto Rican bakery. They do have sandwiches, flan, dessert, pastry and more. The place is busy. May be you feel like in the Puerto Rico.   There is one item you may not want to miss. The Bozcocho Mojaito cake. This syrup almond cake. The cake is moist and delicious. I would recommend that you buy that without leaving. We got other pastry. They are good. Very similar to typical Hispanic pastry.   We also got the tamarind juice. The juice is solution to thirsty day. I would said the pastries are looking delicious.

It is solid 4 stars fruit juice place. They have many things to offer. Including the the corn with cheese. This typical South American street food. They can many fresh juice. Including milk shake. They also has fresh fruit cut with sprinkles Mexican dice on top.   The only thing is this food truck located at low income apartments parking lot. You don't feel save at night. But for day time is good. There a lot people hang out there. But it is ok.   I got the Mango Papaya fruit juice. They are make from real fruit not powder. For price of Starbucks, I got a hoot 24 oz drink. Better deal than any place. I highly recommend their juice.

This Krispy Krabs location will be the closest to me. I use to go to Largo to get their crab. Now they located at Temple Terrace is about 15 minutes away. The new location is a food truck. They seem like building a building next to it. Hopefully this will be their permanent location.   As always, I got six fried crab. The crab size is medium big. The crab was fresh. Sometimes they don't have crab due the crab is too small and not worth to sell to customers. Now is the season. Some of the crab have egg. I like to eat them when watching a game at TV and enjoy my finger food slowly. My wife have garlic no 1 order with snow crab. Other than snow crab, it has the shrimp, sausage, potatoes and corn. She like it.   Overall the order is good. They will show the crab before they pack it. The timing from call to order as promised time. Please allow 25 minutes to call ahead.

I would said this is 3.5 stars restaurant. It is not a four stars restaurant to my opinion. Since we don't have 1/2 star, four stars was given.   We select the Christmas for our visit at the hour of their opening of the door. This will take out the crowed conditions for serving and the busy kitchen situation. This will give them a fare review.   We have order the two appetizer- the Roti and the Pla Muek Yang. The roti is two round roti cut in eight pieces. It has the Malaysian roti taste. Although this may be from packaged factory made but was pan fried perfectly. I like the curry dipping.   Pla Muek Yang aka grilled squid. It marinated in curry or Cumming. It is flame grilled and you can see the grilled mark. The only complaint it the dish come out cold. Seem like sit a bit before it was brought out. It serves with sweet sauce. It is about three squid cut in ring.   Our entrees order is disaster. It take three rejections before we got our order. There are three items they don't carry yet. But I did not count against them on this review. I have order the Phat Chinese Broccoli and pork belly and they have given me Asian BBQ pork and Pork Belly  noodle. I did not ask them to change since it look interesting. We also added the spicy chicken seafood noodle.   The Asian noodle soup base is very interesting and different. I believe the ingredients was not the same as described in the menu. The spicy chicken noodle are very close to Thai street noddle but in the sweet side. This two dishes is just ok.   Food is about 3.5 rating; service is about 4.0 and the kitchen crew is about 3 ratings. I believe the kitchen should not have any excuse because there only three customers when we were there. They should not busy and should handle the food better.

During the Coronavirus period, I would said they good efficient way to pick up your order. You just need to give up the your assign order number and paid. The pick up promises time was correct with no delay. Pay one one side of the door and pick up on their other.   We got the seafood with crawfish and Manila clam. The size of the clam and crawfish is big enough. The mr and Mrs crab sauce is Cajun enough to the meat of the clam. It is well spice and bring a lot of flavors. It was in the plastic bag so you can shake it more to get to the seafood.   Overall seafood is great. Definitely go for the Manila clam again.

This Carrabba's is in the middle of the pack of the Carrabba's chain I have been to. Somehow the Carrabba's is average on the steak. But they are very good on the appetizer. I like their appetizer the best in compare to their main entrée.   The service is on point today. Very nice attentive service that we have received. The serve also good on pushing the sales on other dishes and dessert. Carrabba's are generally generous on the portion of food. We always stuff coming out of the restaurant.   Let talk about the food. We got the mussel with white wine butter sauce. The sauce is perfect. The mussel are the best among the Carrabba's chain. They know how to clean and cook it soft without overcook them.   The entrée of the bone in ribeye was cook to the temperature. Unfortunately their Steak skill need to be improved. But they are better than the average restaurant. The meat need to completely cook but left the inward red on medium rare. They are more to medium. The meat has more tendon attached to it and tough to bite on certain portions.   Overall we still like it.

I am glad someone wrote this review ahead of me. To my knowledge, the restaurant has intention to serve the community especially during pandemic. I hope they survive this business tough time. With that said, I will say my actual experience for the restaurant. We have order the lunch special to go.   Food: we got the bulgogi and short rib lunch special. In compare to the Bay Area they are in the middle of the pack. They are the about the average. Meat taste good. The small dish is a bit less desirable. Quantity is ok for lunch. It do not make me jump out of chair say wow but serve the purpose.   I would said this place is about 3.5 star. Food is good enough but the price seem like in the high side. Decoration is bit run down. But it is the beginning of the restaurant. For the demographic of this neighborhood will be a challenge for this restaurant with higher price. With the ambiance not attractive also may be a challenge in the future. I hope they doing well.

Do you find the gossip about this restaurant and about the food. This is what is mean for the restaurant name (Chismis) in Filipino language. Their food is worth gossiping. It definitely worth to talk about it on yelp.   I have been want to try their food since they have open here. They have simple menu. The three entrees are chicken, pork belly or sausage. My friend got the chicken adobo. He said the cook like his mom cooking but with different way. I try a piece. It is ok. I have the pork belly humba. The pork belly is braise with sweet soy sauce. The skin and fat is soft. It go well with the rice with drizzle fried onion and garlic.    What catch my eye is the lumpia egg roll. This stinks like lumpia is about 1 feet long. Fun to eat. It come with sweet chili sauce to dip. I also got the calamansi. It is a lemon drink. Quite expensive.

It is actually 4.5 stars rating. Since no half stars round up to 5. Shave ice with flavor is originated from Taiwan. I like the store did create some new and it is their own way. The shaved ice is smooth with nice design. Love the interior with dine in partition separation.   We start with charcoal waffle with two choices of topping. I like this one to try. The charcoal waffle is unique. Our topping is the ice cream and the egg pudding. It is item to share. We also got the Lilac Lily shaved ice. The choices we have is taro flavor shaved ice. This item come with the chewy boba, grass jelly, red bean, gram crackers, condensed milk. It is sweet with sweet. The quantity is good to share.   Overall our experience is great. Shave ice have good combination. Love the waffle.

Chef Li open for takeout during pandemic. I happen to drove pass by and decided to give them a try since they got high mark from Christina review. The is close to sit down but available on take out.   We order the grilled beef on the stick. I think this is the best value and best dish. They come in order of 4 or 8. It is go well with the red wine. The chef special shrimp and scallops, bird nest are are almost the same sauce. Except one serve over the fried bowl tortilla. It look pretty. The schezchuan tofu is a great dish. I got the small portion. The beef chow fun is tasty to have. I would recommend this dish also.   Chef Li is basically a take out store Chinese food. The level of cooking is above than the average takeout place. Food and dishes is affordable.

Great place to have breakfast at the Nook. We were here for other thing but see this place open and decided to join the crowd for brunch. The place is bid. The hostess has beautiful mask.   My wife has the 6oz grilled strip steak and I have the the  Atlantic wild caught haddock. The strip steak is almost like New York strip. Is well prepared and come with two side. My wife got the tot and the fried okra. The Sr trip is easy to chew and cut.   I like the grilled haddock. Not many place serve this kind of fish. This place is one of them. I got the veggies beef soup as the side. It is wonderful. We also got one of the day special with strawberry French toast. I think this dis is just ok and below average.   Service is good. Food come out quick enough. The restaurant space is big to seat big party.

Umu is 4.5 stars restaurant in my book. Not yet 5 stars. Their food is good enough to attract more customers to repeat. The decoration is contemporary with dining and sushi bar seating arrangement. I usually go for the sushi bar because I like to see what they made for sushi.   This restaurant did serve omakase and Umukase. The omakase is $75. Six courses. The umukase is unlimited until you say stop. These two need reservations for the chef to prepare the and obtain the ingredients.   I got the lunch special since I am in the neighborhood. I got the salmon misoyaki. This is Bento box with salmon prepare in miso topping. Salmon was cook to caramelize outwardly. I like the side. The stir fry veggies with slightly burn outside. They also goyaza in ponzu sauce. It also come with two pieces of sweet tamago. Great box for lunch.   The lunch special has two roll for $10. It is good. I got the spider and yellowtail scallions roll. I like they prepare the soft shell crab has a lot of crab meat. Services is good.

One good tip. 5:00 pm to 6:00 pm is happy hour. Many item reduce 3 dollars. Drinks also good prices during that time. This newly open restaurant has good and ok App. You will be the judge. I was surprised that at 5:16 pm, this place is pack already. So get there early if you want to try their happy hour.   We started with the devil Egg and philly flatbread. I would recommend the devil Egg. The topping with the fried candies pork belly is delicious. The philly flatbread need work. The meat of shaved ribeye is too little. It need to be more for that price. We added the Fabio's meatballs. This one comes with grits. The last dish we have is the Italian Steak. This is the New York strip cut. The steak is cook to asking temperature. If this dish come with broccolini will be better. But I also like the asparagus.   The drink I have is the cotton Candy cosmo. It is good show. I give them an "A" for the food come out really quick. Good kitchen work.

One of my favorite BBQ place for babyback rib. Rib City just like it advertised. I love the ribs here. This restaurant is local state chain. It actually started at Ft. Myers. Then they open one in Brandon and then they move it to St. Petersburg.   If you come here, ribs is the dish you are ordering. The baby back is grilled with BBQ sweet sauce over the flames. Most of the BBQ place is grilled then splash the BBQ sauce on top. Here the grilled with the BBQ sauce with it together.   The meat is fall off the bone. The meal come with the two sides item. We usually ask for the fry and BBQ baked bean. They have special time to time for the full rack of the rib.   The decorations and slogans are hilarious. I alway enjoy a good laugh with their writing. Service is good.

After three visit, I like to give a fair review for this place. Panda hut is has some characters when you walk in. It has the mama panda leading the kids panda welcome you with the bamboo. You can catch a lot of Pokemon there. Be aware of some Pokemon there.   About the restaurant, they have inconsistency of food preparation for time time to time. Out of the three visit, two was very successful. As a result, they have 4 stars.   My experience there for the food is good. I like the most is the Salt Crisp Chicken. This dish is cook with five spice. If they use some deep fried basil leave, this dish will be a lot better. Second dish I like is the beef Jianbing, it is the beef pancakes with sauce inside. Don't forget the Peruvian Apple Herb dessert.   If you like the very spicy stuff, go for the seafood hot bowl. It make the steam come out your head. Overall service is good.

This is my neighborhood gas station that has easy access. It offers convenient store, Taco Bell and gas. The Taco Bell open 24 hours. The price of the gas is at the mean of national average. The gas station has car wash. It is well lighted at night. The convenient store and Taco Bell are not connected.

Haven has been in my bookmark for sometime. Most of my friends been here has good time here. Mainly wine and cheese. But the happy hour is the most attractive. They have two parking area. If not street parking nearby is good too.   The happy hour has great deal. People come early during this time to enjoy couple of wine or cocktails. The line is already build at entrance to be open during Friday night. Happy hour is for bar, lounge, and outside.   We started with the Duck Confit Taco. The skins is different for the taco. Good enough. The second dish is the chargrills oyster. I like this dish. Somehow the oil in the oyster make this dish taste very good. The third dish is the grilled Shishito Pepper. With a bit sea salt oil and grilled over open flame is great for the wine and cocktails. Our board dish is charcuterie board with different ham. This is perfect dish with the slide cure ham. Our last dish is the chorizo fritter. Great ball fried with chorizo inside.   Service is great at the bar. The server is very alert. I have cocktails. Both cocktails is welcoming.

The loft is an interesting restaurant. A farm house turn restaurant on the northwest of Indianapolis. They host the farm tour during the day. And they have an ice cream bar. Because they call themselves a creamery and restaurant. The flavor of ice cream is also interesting. They have the regular vanilla and chocolate. But they have something you may not think of like cantaloupe lime and s'mores.   We were here for the dinner. The ingredients selection from their farm or organic material. We got the bison noodle. It is bison short rib cook wine sauce. It taste like German Bavarian cuisine. The short rib is fork tender. It is the porcini rutabaga on it. I like this dish with dark  Scottish ale.   Our second dish is a Great Lake Walleye. I have never have this fish before. You can said it has the firmness like grouper but taste like bass. The way they cook it with roasted with the skin. It has kielbasa potato pierogies. This make my favorite dish. Very unique at it on way.   Services is good. Attentive. The price is high side but the experience make up for it.

This Quickly is the same join from Orlando. The one thing I like for this boba place in Orlando is their poke. Unfortunately they don't have it. Hopefully one day they started the poke.   This place has good chicken nuggets. You got to try them if you are visiting this place. Boba is ok. I have try their special Bah Mi. It is decent not the most excellent but good enough. They also carry a crawfish Bah Mi. This is the items I would try. Not many place have this item.   For the dessert, we have ordered the mochi waffle. This is something new I have not have before. It is chewy mochi base. It accompanied with condensed milk and sugar powder.   This restaurant drink place, it kind of self serve. Order from counter. They will bring the food to table.

Gelato place at Palm Harbor bring joy to the kid of the neighborhood. I hope New Tampa has one of the mom and pop gelato store one day. Coolside has a special beerlato that I did not try. I will try that next time.   Today we have three of the flavors. All three flavors was very nice. Before you are ordering, you can try their specialty flavors. The server was nice enough for any cup size, he can fill as many flavors he can. We got the small cup, and he was able to fill with three flavors. This is a plus to attract customers to come back.   Other than gelato and beer, they serve coffee too. It is as advertised fine Italian ice cream.

The four stars was given for their ambience. There two antiques ford was lifted high like are repairing at garage at the bar. Gas pump is everywhere. It is interesting to eat there. I have to give them they have good burger.   We were here for the restaurant week. You probably save $5 on the restaurant week menu. We like pretzel. They are fresh from oven. The buffalo chicken dip is average but the chip is crispy.   We have the Brisket Ranchero Roaster. It is burger top with brisket and bourbon bbq sauce. It has fried onions make it crispy. The accompanying tot is good. We close out with milk shake and the famous funnel cake. I like funnel cake with the white chocolate dip.   The service was good. The table setting for six is comfortable. Enough room from each other. I would said don't forget to visit the restroom. The ambience in the restroom is great.

If you want something prepared when you just order, this is the place. Many ingredients is original. Food are cook fresh on the spot. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars not yet 5 stars.   This is a cute German restaurant. I like the decoration. You will notice the front is German like different from all other store front. We got the schnitzel. Since we did the progressive lunch. We only order this dish. For the price you paid, it is will worth the food. It come with two pieces of schnitzel. Top with mushroom sauce on top. The crust coating was crispy. I think mAy need a seasoning coating. Other than that. They are good.   The service is excellent. You got the up close personal service. They also serve the German beer to wash the food down. It is good restaurant to try.

We have a very off night from this place. We have a group of four went to this place for the ramen. We hope to try some of the new and hot place in town. However, we do not have the good experience tonight.   We came to this place after the museum night at downtown. We arrive at 7:20 and one of friend family just finish and they let us have the table. Thanks to him that we have no waiting on the table. We put our order in for the food and we order the sake. The sake is a good deal. We have finished our sake and the appetizer has not arrived. It took them 1.25 hour to bring out the appetizer. Before the app is out, I told my friend we should walk out if the food did not come in one hour. However, we are eager to try this restaurant food and we stay and wait for the excitement of the food.   We waited close to 1.5 hour before our ramen came. We were wonder why it take so long. The food came and I immediately disappointed what we have longing for. The ramen is sticking together and the noodle is not separated. The meat may be cook extreme long time and the meat is easily broken into powder pieces. The soup is considering average on the miso base. I have better ramen in Tampa compare to this place. I not even need to compare to the standard in Japan that I have experience.   I had ramen in clear broth base, miso base, spicy base, and dry base before. The meat of other place is moist and good for the pork. The good ramen place has marinated egg in half broil. When you break the egg yolk, the yolk will spill into the broth and create another sensation. This place the yolk is complete cooked.   The output of this restaurant needs to be rethinking. In Japan, I have seen 50 bowls of ramen in 30 minutes but not in this place. I know this is art but also need to consider the wait of the customer. Lack of efficiency, technique, material. I am award 2 stars. Many rooms need improvement.

Very diverse Vietnamese food in Pinellas Park area. I have been to their original store. I was expecting the similarity of the food. But their menu have something different than the original store.   We have order the Chao Tom Cuon I don't know what it mean in Vietnamese. But it is a sugarcane warped grilled shrimp fresh roll. This is something different than many Vietnamese fresh roll. Good taste. They wrap very tight and firm with rice flour paper. My wife try it at home but never has this tight.   Our entrees are very interesting. We order the Cha Chien Trieu Chau. It is a mixture of shrimp, pork and mushroom wrap in wonton skin and deep fried into each ball. This is my first on this type of Vietnamese food.   The next dish is commonly serve in Vietnamese restaurant. It is fish caramelize in fish sauce with garlic and pork belly. But the use of fish is different. I like their fish.   The weekday dinner do not have many people. May be the store front look like unattractive falling paint entrance. May be repainted may make it different. Service is good since we are the only few who eat there.

The food has good taste as for food truck but they are not cheap. double Gustazo is popular at local. It has wait time to pick up the food due to a lot of order. The food truck has some seated area.   I got the the Carrucho with mofongo. The Carrucho is the conch. They processed the food very well. It have good number of conch. It come with a bit salad. The mofongo has good garlic mixed. It is delicious. Although is do not have the pork belly mixed in, but the taste is there.   The only thing is the price is a bit steep. Almost $20. It is almost restaurant price with good ambient. For food trucks his price is on the high side.

This the best home deco store I been to in Tampa. I have pass by this place many time. I saw other Yelper posted pictures are nice. I have decided to stop by to check them out.   The outward of the store is not the most attractive. However the goods they carry in the store are very good ideal for home interior design decorations. The interior designer may need to pay attention to this store if they helping their client for the room decorations. It also can be use for hotel, restaurant, or business to decorate their building.   The Christmas decorations is huge here. Many items were displayed for the season. Angel, trees, big red ribbons, cross, rain deer and frosty man. Other regular items l like like slogans for homes. Some are funny slogans.

Basically is a take out restaurant with computer order. There were a few tables to sit. No restroom facilities, only bottles water. It is designed for take out. Menu easy to read. Very simple.   We got the beef kimbap. This is like sushi roll with bulgogi beef. It has, egg, pickle veggies. Consider this is a large roll. We also got the spicy pork lunch box. It has fried pork dumplings, kimchi, rice and spicy pork. Food is good to have. For take out, they are good. For dine in probably need to consider the situation.

Somehow Lutz area has a lot of good BBQ. Recently station house has move to this plaza. It attracts a lot of local including us. Their store front is not ready yet but soon. I would said so many BBQ place and this one is top of my list in this area. A true 5 star. Wait until they fully open, they will be more famous. So far, they only serve take out.   They have three giant smoker. It is impressive. The converted old fire truck to one of the Mobile smoke house. You got to try their smoke rib and chicken. The smoke taste deep into the meat. The marinated of the rib has some fruity taste. Very good fall off the bone. Easy to eat. Must be cook for long time. I hope they maintain this quality. The chicken is juicy and nice. The best part are their creative sides. Their cowboys potatoes salad or cole slaw is very interesting. They are not your typical normal side. They have good mixed and taste.

Good promotion to healthy living. The iron girl has a lot of promotion from the local stores. Thanks to their support.   The store include Bee Cause - the jewelry for you shoe lace. Nature food patch for good supplement food and nature good. Go girl headband provide decorate head band of you choice. Fit to run has a discount on shoe. Some vendor has accessory for the run like wonder women and super girl out fit.   Today is just the expo. They are gear up for tomorrow 1/2 marathon. I am guessing our yelp friend Ashley may participate.

Crepe!!! My visit here was good. Order on the counter and they bring the food to you. Since I gone between meal, not many people there. It is actually pleasant and quite moments to around that time. The decoration is simple. They do have some wall unit sofa. The also have the stool high top section. Other than that, the outside sitting also available.   They serve salty, sweet, or breakfast crepe. Some of the lunch salty crepe is interesting. Please look at their special of the day which not in the menu. It may surprise you. Happy hour start 7 pm to close. Beer and wine half off.   I got the nutty joe. It is crepe fill with Nutella and Oreo cookies. It top with vanilla ice cream. It also come with a shot of espresso. It is good combination. I actually like the way they made their crepe. It is sweet with chewy condition.

The cinema has a lot slot for single movie. It make convenient for the time of arrival. If you miss one, there is another slot not too far away. The selection seat on half of the cinemas. The other half is just first come first serve. The selection seat is alway nicer with recliner seat with foot rest. Mostly for the newest movie.   I got the black panther for the night. Since this is mew movie. It has seat selection with recliner. Love the movie. Like the seat. Enjoy my time.  It has 20 cinemas that multiple movie choices. It locate in the mall easy for your teenage kid to watch the movie while you shopping.

I think they have not smooth out the kink of the cafe yet. I will give them a few week before you go again. This review do not reflect the kink that they try to smooth out. It is for their product, service and ambience.   Ding tea has small and regular size. Their small size really small. I would go for the regular size. The tea has little flavor. Not strong at all. The flavor not stand out. I have the brown sugar monster with milk tea. The brown sugar is just ok. Boba is regular not the the brown sugar boba. My wife have the Hokkaido Coffee.   You can choose the less ice, medium ice, or more ice. You also can have no ice. They also allow you to adjust the sugar level. This may be the only plus.

Great restaurant to go to at night. Even late at 9:20 before they close. The bar area has the live piano music. It is great if you on the business trip by yourself and seat on the piano bar.   I have the southern style shrimp and grit. The shrimp count is at the large size. The ingredient include chorizo ham and bacon. It make the taste interesting. I would said this is average value. I like the piano music at the bar. It make the time pass quicker while you eat and listen.   The signature margarita is average. The service of the bar is a bit slower due high volume customer during that time i. Overall is a good experience. I like the small plate menu at the happy hour. I will try that next time for the happy hour. I will be back.

Great restaurant in St. Louis. If you looking for local dry rub BBQ, this is the place. It is located at famous St. Louis The Loop neighborhood. Very close to Washington University.   The restaurant labeled themselves as Bourbon, Beer and BBQ. Definitely try the bourbon and BBQ. They have many selection on bourbon. I went for the local favorite. The Bird Dog. Great sense of smell.   For the BBQ. We have the Bestie Combo. It allows to choose 4 different meat. We got the rib, brisket, wings and pull pork. The rib is half slab. Dry rub seasoning with meat fall off the bone. The wing is the best. Don't misses it. Great slow smoke wings. Brisket and pull pork also well receipted. The combo come with two side and a mushroom shape bread call cheddar popover. Very interesting.   Our time here was great. Pricing is definitely better than Tampa. It is must visit restaurant.

We have a group visited at night. The food is set menu. We were exiting to come and enjoy. But my current experience will knock one star off my previous visit. I have order a crushed blackberry agave margarita it take long time to prepare. May be the waiter did not paid attention. I like the drink but the wait is too long.   I like the appetizers such as crispy calamari, spicy crispy shrimp and crab spinach artichoke dip. But the main entree and dessert disappointing. The entree I have is the shrimp and crab meat linguine. The shrimp is not bouncy enough. My friend has the sea bass. He like it. One of my friend doesn't go for the seafood because the set menu mainly farm raise fish. If he can get it from order menu may be better.   My dessert is ok but my friend dessert as carrot cake is not as good as he told me.

It is 4.5 stars in my book. The take out and bowl are good. There is not much market for what I see. They do have some items for sell but to classify as market is bit stretch. I do like their cook food. It was delicious.   I have miso salmon bowl and my wife have the Crispy Tori Katsu bowl. The miso salmon has large piece of grilled salmon. The technique for Grill was good. I like the edge with concentrate sauce. The miso is the sauce. This dish come with crispy Brussels sprouts, sweet potatoes and broccoli. The dish is well balanced. The crispy chicken katsu is coated with breading. It come with roasted carrots, sweet potatoes and broccoli. It serve with their house bull sauce.   Overall the taste is there, price is right for the bowl. Many people have take out. I would try their bull bowl next time with beef tip. Food was well prepared.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Being at downtown Tampa, it should be busy.  We were there at Friday around 11:30, this place only 35% fill. These should be easy for them to serve us. By the time we walk out at 12:15 pm. The place is full.   The lunch special is attractive. I saw the chicken chimichurri hash at lunch special menu is attractive. The dish serve in skillet with potatoes hash, grilled chicken, grilled onion and top with two egg of your choice. Sunny side up is definitely the best to break the egg yolk for the mixed of the hash. This dish also has the chimichurri sauce make this dish decorative.   For the energy, I have morning meditation drink. It is orange, lemon, turmeric, ginger, agave nectar, and beet. What a drink and nice presentation.   Service is a little let down at the end.  Food is good.

It is affordable restaurant in this area in compare to surrounding more expensive restaurants. It is definitely an outlet of food for the students in University of Tampa. Budget enough with a lot of variety. The selection includes poke bowl and noodle bowl.   We got the pork belly ramen. The ramen noodle was well prepared. It is well separated with chewy noodle string. The pork belly may be baked then pan seared and served. Soup base may be some bone and vegetable base. Overall is a good experience. Definitely worth the visit.

Since they open during pandemic, we only have take out. Finally we can sit down and eat. The place is pack on the day we have visited. People love crab here. Don't mind to get the hand dirty. They do provide glove and bib if you want to protect yourself.   The interior has many locations you can take pictures with including the giant crab. We got the combo C with a lot of good stuff in it. Snow crab, blue crab, shrimp, clam, sausage. We have the garlic butter this time. The seafood is great. We also have the appetizers of chicken wings and crab cake, the wing was good but the crab cake is not recommended. Is has a lot of dough in it. It is also like devil crab not is not devil crab.   Service once is engaged, it is fast. You may want to ask who is your server. Because sometimes they seat you on the open table which mean that table has not assigned a wait staff. As a result it is good to ask so you will not get delay of the beginning of the services.

Taco ringing again today. This one mobile phone ring. No- it is mobile truck. This truck is close to our area. My wife have gone to this place without me several times. I have to do it without her at lease one time. Today is the day.   It is a bit different to eat there than bring it home to eat. The taco is decent. I have the steak and the chorizo taco today. But I like their lengua and tripa taco. The metal tent is behind the truck. It provide covering from the sun and rain. Among all three ladies is there, one know how to speak English.   Their taco is to corn taco with pack of meat. Nice looking one. It come with small jalapeño and stir fried onion. Food is better than average but no wow factor. Good for snack like today.

Rare Ethnic Food #46  Syrian Cuisine.  I am going with the bad first. The the consistency of great food at everyday need to bring it to customer. With that said. Our experience with the restaurants for one day is fantastic. We were there Friday buffet. That is the only best day or what we call Prime Day.   The buffet set off day only Friday and Saturday from 1 pm to 6 pm. Friday we have visited is the best day compare to my friend went on the following day. The food at Saturday is not nearly good as to Friday buffet. The Friday buffet has Mansaf - a authentic Arab lamb dish. It was delicious. It also has bake and bbq chicken, beef, fried fish. Other than the main dish. They also have about 12 other choices including the eggplant. Food is great on Friday buffet. It worth the price and experience to try their food.   Since it is buffet, get all you can eat. We were stuff with food.

Star's Cut is my regular barbershop. I like their skill of men hair cut. They just take away right amount of hair and short enough not to make it stand up. Especially on the side of the head. I am using random barbers for my hair and they are come out more or less the same.   The wait time usually less than 5 minutes. Most of the time just walk right in and they are available on your arrival. The chair is comfortable throughout the entire hair cut. They are very careful on not letting the cut hair get in your dress. I always like their scissor cut. Trimmer on the edge. This show their skill. My hair cut usually finished less than 15 minutes.   I would recommend to use them for men hair cut. They do many style. USF student has discount. If you are senior citizen, they have special discounts. They do have punch card paid for 9 hair cut and the tenth is free.

It was great that I revisit the restaurant since we have a bad experience in the first time. A lot of things have been changed. We were here after late night movie.   A lot of improvement has been made. Food come out a lot faster. The noodle was prepared correctly not glue together. I have order the devil spicy ramen. It is spicy not super spicy. The soup is still salty. The egg need a bit work - over cook. The noodle need some sesame oil to make flavor better.   Overall is good. It is big improvement.

Rare Ethnic Food #53. Haitian cuisine.   I was hesitating about come here because the mixed reviews. After visited the restaurant, I found out the reason why. 50% of the food is fried here, it will be not great to have the take out. Eat there is the key. Because when you brought the food home, these food turn tougher. Especially the pork.   We started out appetizers as Salty Fish Pate. The pastry skin is very flaky and the salty fish is great. Our next appetizer is the Akra. This is malanga fritter with great coating with nice seasoning. Malanga is root veggies. It is interesting to be fried with coating.   We order the griot. It similar to chicharon in Spanish food. But the pork is seasoning before fried. Better than chicharon. It come with rice and bean and tostone. It also serve with spicy coleslaw and spicy red curry. This dish really need to be eat there. If not, the pork skin will be to tough to bite after you order to go and eat at home. You need to experience the crispy of just fried pork.   I also got the Tassot Kabrit. It is marinated fried goat. The bone in chop meat is delicious and soft. It was not tough. May be just fry or the chef have good technique.   Overall we like our food. A lot people order take out. Tip don't wear good clothes. Because you smell like fried food after eating. They need to improve the ventilation system.

The food truck is located at the same area of many food truck. I like the ideal with food truck center because this food truck may benefit from visitors to other food truck and order something from this food truck.   The total taco food truck is well set up. Not just the sit down place under cover, but also includes a hand wash station after finger food. It was convenient. We got two tacos. We have the cochinada mex which is a mixed of different types of meat. It was delicious. We also got the shrimp taco. Both taco is comfort and savory.   Food prepared was quick. The choices of taco is large. The price is medium. They also serve other stuff like fajitas, burritos, nachos, quesadilla, tortas.

Good hardware store. We need to support them occasionally. We like them to stay for the competition in the neighborhood. The store has big parking lot. If you want find products that most of the hardware store discontinued, ACE may be a good alternative.   I was looking for coil hose. The hose that bounced back after use. Easy to keep at your yard. Most hardware store requires mail order. But ACE still carrying it. I got to the store by checking at the internet for availability. It is good to have they have it without waiting. The 50 feet coil bounce back hose is useful.

This is about 3.5 stars. Since we don't have half stars, I round up to 4 stars for their cooking skill. Oro meaning gold. This food truck name is gold tacos.   Other than tacos, they have burritos, quesadilla, torta, flautas. The meat included steak, marinated pork (pastor), pork (carnitas), Mexican sausage, Pollo, Tripa, lengua. I have the steak, pastor, lengua and the trips tacos. I have to give them an A on tripa. Because you don't feel bitter on the tripa itself due to right amount burn cooking on this ingredients.   The only complaint is all the tacos are small compared to many tacos place I have been to. The wait time after order is about 10 minutes. It is acceptable. The marinated meat was well presented. The steak can be improved. Instead on cut the meat in strip, may dice in cube. This will be better.

4.5 stars is about right for this restaurant. I would have client power lunch or dinner here. It is because of the beautiful interior decoration. Great blinds curtains. Many crystal chandelier hang from ceilings. That is the reason they call this place Crystal Dining Room.   One thing is they lack of service people die to lack of customer. However, food is good in compare to many place and the price is good for the food and ambience. I would host the wedding reception here.   We have the New York Strip au Poivre. The steak is big enough and the sauce is great. The accompanying potatoes and asparagus was great. We also has the grilled salmon bed with rice, top with mango salsa. All the dish is great. The chef has great skill. All entree come with salad. I also like their dark n stormy cocktails.

During the lunch time, the restaurant serve express menu. They don't serve the full menu items for lunch. There were a lot customers during lunch hour. Callaloo is a southern cuisine. I have try their food before. For lunch, it is my first time.   Their express menu is very simple. They do have choices for appetizers, salad, sandwich and entrees. Total 13 choices. I got their southern fried chicken with waffle and fries. This dish is $10. It is good deal because they give you half of chicken, 1 whole waffle and scoop of sweet potatoes fries. It is a lot food. I have to pack my left over to take home. I like their waffle because they have herb mixed in it.   I also got their Crab and Callaloo stew. It has crab meat, okra and bacon. It has mixed vegetables in the stew. However, I think the stew is a bit salty. If come with bread can be better.   The service begin with slow service but pick up in the middle of service. I also like the decoration in the restaurant. Very modern and comfortable. This restaurant is about 3.5 stars in my book.

It is 3.5 stars restaurant. It is not 4 stars. The service is good, the ambient is excellent, the food is par, and the wait is par.   The restaurant does not take reservation. So you have to arrive and find out your fate. On the weekend is over hour to get in. However, they get your cell phone number and text you when the table is ready. Once they text you, you have 5 minutes to respond that you still want your table, then 5 minutes to show up. Which give you time to walk around the mall. If you need 10 minutes time to walk back. Don't respond immediately, response close to your 5 minutes is up.   The decorations is definitely eye catching. I like many of the ambient. It is beautiful. It is fiesta atmosphere. Seem like you seat on open air restaurant with stars hanging over you. Music is good volume and still able to make conversation at bar area.   The food is the main thing that they need to make the most improvement. Go from the bad to good. The taco are the area need to make the most improvement. We have order 4 tacos. The shrimp, blacken fish, cochinita (roast pork) and carne Asada (wood grilled steak). The pork is lack of flavor. The fish is dry and over cook, the shrimp is just broil and serve. The best is the steak that is a star. I would suggest control how the fish is cook. The pork may be need to marinate and cook in the thicker sauce and the shrimp grilled it before put it in the taco.   The entrée is the ceviche and the grilled chicken with mole chocolate sauce. I like both of the dish. It is not a wow but above average. I do like their table side guacamole. They have options for the spiciness and chunky of the avocado. I like the chip because they have spice on top and tasty then the most restaurant.   Overall is good experience. We have very good service. Our waiter is experience. I have read some of the reviews of my friend that some of the waiter are not up to the task. But our night was good may be it is weekend and they have the experience waiter.

This is about 2.5 stars restaurant locate in downtown Tampa. It is about American style Chinese food. Since the quantity and quality that provide on the food served, I round up to 3 stars since we are not able to give half stars.   If you craving for this type of the Chinese food. This may be your place. Price is at the medium. The food is similar to take out place Chinese food. But they have few house special dish. I was going to try their smoke duck. However, they didn't carry this dish that night. So we change our selection to lobster and shrimp dish and happy family dish. The lobster is deep fried to crispy and the shrimp is cook with hibachi sauce. It is almost like two dish in one combination. Lobster is fresh and so do the shrimp. The happy family is combination of the ingredients with shrimp, scallops, chicken and beef. Within that dish, the beef is the best.   I cannot tell the about the service since there is only two tables of customers. Chef skill and use of spice need big improvement. Ingredients are good.

It is a fast food joint. Order and paid at counter. Nothing fancy. Just like mall food. Except more personal touch with cooking after order. Seem like fried rice and noodle being pre-cook for assembly.   I hope for Bento to be here at Bay Area and now they are here which has not impress me. The best thing about this place is their bento box with many items and reasonable price. I would come back lack of time to eat but not for date night.   We got the Korean beef and the Katsu bento box. The Korean beef did not fare well. But the katsu is good. The string beans has no salt in the bento box. We also got the spicy tuna small with 4 pieces. This item is a bit expensive. However, it has good flavor.   We got the boba tea which is fun to have. Something I don't understand is when you paid and order at counter, the alway have a tip box to check for 18% to 20%. The only service is bring the food on table. That always doesn't make sense for cafeteria type food service industry.

This is an interesting pan Asian cuisine. I have try many, and many are about the same for pan Asian cuisine. This restaurant make a bit different than the most. Not just the food has variety in spice, creativity and presentation of the dish are very nice.  When the food look good, it achieve the eye candy effect.   Don't forget about the happy hour. It is real deal for good food. Please check my picture for when the happy hours. We started with spicy garlic edamame. I have not seen a chef use high BTU wok the edamame. It very nice and rich in flavor. The second dish is the gyaw-zah. I like the dumplings they make it nice and top with Asian straw mushrooms. The food taste has good balance. The next two dish is special Roll of the day and spicy tuna roll. This roll is big. The next dish is the velvety shrimp. It have lovely cream sauce and the shrimp is good size.   Our main dish are turmeric rice and the stuff cuttlefish. The rice is turmeric and serving in the clay bowl that heat up and make the rice crispy where they touch the edge. It top with grilled beef. I believe the beef has some lemon grass ingredients that make this grilled meat separated from other. The cuttlefish is stuff with ground pork and shrimp. It sauce up with tomato and scallions.   Overall our experience is great. I will be back for other items in the menu.

I have been to this place several time. I like it because of easy access. The flow of the drive through is good on some day, the other may be slow. During the COVID condition, this is good to have.   I went into the store the shield is up between clerk and customer for protection. The coffee is still good on this difficult time. I got the ice coffee with hazelnut flavor. I also like their sugar donuts.

I have been this place twice and we are enjoying every bit of it. I believe we found our Italian Ice in the county. I am not Italiano but love this place. Eat while you can before the weather turn too cold.   Jeremiah's Italian Ice has many varieties. Their trademark ice is scoop froggy frog. However I like the mango and sea salt caramel. Like other Italian ice place in some Tampa a layer Italian ice with a layer of soft serve. Jeremiah can pile 4 layers which a layer more than anyone can pile in Tampa. I have try that route.   I also have them do the ice only. The ice girl pile 4 layer and top one scoop of four favorite on top of four layer you have ask. It look colorful. The trick is to eat eat fast since they don't have soft serve in between. If it melt, the ice will mix together. But I like this way even freezing my brain. I have a few of them when I try this way. Take boon challenge!!!!!

The historical building remodel to Italian Restaurant. This Sicilian restaurant is the one I like in the Columbia Restaurant Group. It has the best menu and thought on the food. The restaurant follows the pandemic protocol. They ask the customers to wear mask if they are not seated.   We seat at the bar section with limited number of seat because the wait for table required 45 minutes. The customers who don't have a seat near the bar are reminded to wear the mask. Only the seated customers allow to order.   Before our meal is here, they serve the pre meal bread with good seasoning. I like those. My wife got the the Polpo Alla Griglia. It is sliced grilled octopus salad. The salad is ok. I got the Sea Bass Grigliata. It is Mediterranean grilled sea bass. They sea bass is big and grilled to good flavor. The accompanying eggplant capanota was very good. We like our food.   With high price item come greater expectations. The restaurant is about better than average. I would suggest you call ahead. Because they are really busy. The car parking is free in front of the restaurant between 21 and 22 street.

Late night or late dinner, this is the place open late. Dead Bob has a character for the bars. The price is insanely good for the food. I would said this a good place for gathering. The only thing I don't like is they don't have draft beer. The place is open air. So if some smoke outside, you can smell that.   We got big wave beer, lobster roll and honey glazed salmon for total of $20. The lobster roll is not the true lobster. The flavor is just ok. But for $8, it is acceptable. The honey glazed salmon is a lot better. The salmon was grilled crispy at both side of the fillet. The honey glazed is good.   The beer here can bargain if you buy the bucket. This is the best deal. Tuesday has special on big wave beer. The service is a bit let down. But you alway could wave down the person walk by to grab what you need. The bar is lively with a lot of TV for games night.

This holiday inn is at the center of the town. Very convenient. 15 minutes to downtown, 10 minutes to the loop, 25 minutes to Chesterfield Outlet. It is fare in price.   The facility need some up grade. The hallway definitely need some major renovation. Elevator is working. Parking garage is good and save. Out door parking is available. They do charge your parking. Not much. Less than $4 a day.   The room is good size. But the bathroom is tiny. Taking a shower is difficult to manipulate around the shower head. This is the area really need improvement. May be glass door instead of shower curtain.   It is walking distance to the Cathedral and the forest park. Very close to airport and The famous The Loop neighborhood for food and restaurant. Close to university of Washington.

New Venezuela food near USF. The food is under $10. It is affordable for the USF students. Along this plaza, they have the best contemporary interior design. The owner did paid attention to the student need.   We start with the fruit drinks Soursop. You can ask with milk or no milk to be added. I like it without milk because is a fruit juice.   The selection of menu include arepas with difference selection of meat, cachapa and patacon. Cachapa is the sweet corn arepas. We did not try it. But we did have the patacon. They are not like traditional patacon with one sheet of the flat plantain and multiple dip dish. They make it like sandwich. The plantain was use as two snap sandwich for the meat. The plantain was fried to crispy. It is good to have with the Venezuelan Cheese.   The restaurant is like cafeteria type order at the counter and bring it to your table.

I have been to here twice since the Bruce B Down Dairy Queen close the business. I like the location is  between the residential and commercial area. Its location was at the major street of Wesley Chapel.  I like about Dairy Queen is about the their blizzard. This item is their signature dessert. When they finish the mixed, they will turn the ice cream upside down to show the concrete featuring of how sticky is the mixed. They do have a lot of premixed features. Also you can choose the mixed by your own flavor.   My favorite mixed is the vanilla ice cream with heath bar and the cappuccino flavor. This is the best mixed I love to have. Time to time they have the seasoning mixed design blizzard. Sometimes they are very good. It is more important to choose the ingredients and the flavor to mixed. But sometimes will surprise you like the flavor that you have never attempted before.

This location use to be a good local American restaurant. Now it taken by the Vietnamese cuisine restaurant. The interior is beautiful and white. They also has the patio seating. We met a yelp friend here for dinner before the waffle event.   We started the dinner with roasted quails. They did very good job on quail. They did control the cooking technique to prevent the quail meat get too tough or over cook. We also order summer roll for the appetizers. The roll's shrimp is big and combo with shrimp and pork. I got the beef deluxe pho. It has everything of beef items. The pho is sweeter. I think is more gear for American taste but still maintain the Vietnamese flavor. My wife got the Bun Bo Hue. We feel like this soup are not measured up to the Vietnamese standard. My friend has the grilled pork bun. He likes the taste. We also order the snow pea tip veggies. It is just average.   Overall our experience is good. Price is in the high side. But at this location where not much of Vietnamese restaurant can be found is good for the business.

I passed by this restaurant due to my assignments near this location. As a result I got some takeout for my lunch. Their menu is very simple. I ordered the takeout through the phone. However the lady didn't understand what I want. They put on make up the item I want with shrimp as a protein. As a result I got my protein as chickens and pork.   I order two dishes, the first dish is drunken noodle with Thai hot. I feel that the noodles a little bit wet. They could cook it a little bit longer and dried noodles and make it a little burn the edge. The second dish is Yum beef. This dish is a little bit better, you have a flavor that I need for the salads with a beef.  The pick ups is on terms as what they promise me 15 minute to deliver. There was no way on the pick up. Overall the food is average. Quantity is good.

A very good boba and food restaurant. It is 5 stars. Annie is new a coming. Finally Brandon has good representation of boba place. I like the setup in the restaurant. Contemporary looks. I was there at 11 am at the opening, they already have a huge order in front of me. Can believe they are busy.   I got the taro coconut slush. I have Taro boba. It is interesting they carry a taro flavor boba. I like the ideal of showing the boba in the jug, the customers can have clear choices. They carry some interesting boba other than taro boba, such as matcha boba, aloe Vera. It is an A grade for boba choices. I also got Annie Favorite Cooling Tea. This tea has many item inside with one price. I recommend this drink.   For the food, we got the fried teriyaki chicken wings. It is delicious with the sauce. I also got the shrimp noodle and noodle bowl. The shrimp noodle is lo mein and grilled shrimp. Shrimp is big. The noodle bowl includes the shrimp and grilled pork. It is a good dish.   Since they are busy, may be call ahead is the best bet.

We know about this restaurant is because of their Taiwanese food. The outside look like Chinese fast food, but they serve Taiwanese cuisine also. If you want to order Taiwanese or the true Chinese food, you need to ask for the Chinese menu. Unfortunately this menu is in Chinese. So bring a friend can read the menu with you for your first adventure.   The day we were there they have a lot of the ingredients are unavailable. There some dish in the Chinese menu is not available due to missing ingredients. We have ordered the beef braise noodle soup, spicy stir fry chicken, and the spicy beef tendon. I like the most is the spicy chicken. This chicken cook it high BTU cook top. As a result it has burn oil taste that I like. The beef noodles soup still need some work. May be braise a bit longer. The soup base may be changed to bone base soup will be a lot better.   This is husband and wife service team restaurant. It has local who actually support this restaurant that like their food. The local support is important to keep the business running.

We need to give some love to this Caribbean restaurant. Yelp elite! We have new restaurant in Pinellas and not many review yet.   Caribbean Cuisine is a lot of marinate and it will not taste blend. They are so many choices here. But I have try their fish since I saw some one post it earlier. The posted fried red snapper look very good. We order the same thing. Since this market price, we have to ask how big is the fish and the price.   The given fish is huge and I am sharing with my wife. We order it as grilled option since it is more healthy. The fish will take 25 minutes to cook as the restaurant has warn us since it is grilled. The fish was marinated in Caribbean sauce and pan sear or "grilled" at hot plate. It is not open flame grilled. But it is good since there is no burn part.   Fish is fresh can be tell immediately. The meat did not fall apart and a good sign of fresh fish. I will come back to try some other items in the menu. The papaya juice is good too.

Pricy restaurant but is worthies for it name. When you walk into the restaurant, you can see their aged beef display at the restaurant front. Impressive. Most of time you will see the worker prepare the lamb chop in front of the aged beef. They shave off the unwanted fat from the ribs bone and ready for grilling.   Someone may ask me why steak predominate restaurant and eat the sea food. This restaurant may be the only one serve the African lobster. The price $65 provide two big tail and you can share one with your mate. This lobster tail is will preserve and fresh to deliver from Arica. The tail immediately came off from the shell and easy to eat. We also order the bearing sea king crab. The preparation is great. We enjoy our meal. Although it is expensive but is worth the money.    The only thing downside is not about the restaurant. Due to the restaurant locate in the casino, the gambler usually smoke in the casino. You have to pass through this area to get to the restaurant. The service is good. We always like to see our neighbor what they have ordered when we are in the high class restaurant.   The high roller or the winner is usually treat themselves a big steak. May be I should try them on my next visit.

Mi Bandera has been in my bookmark for sometime been want to try it. This was the second Columbian restaurant of the week. They definitely a solid 3 stars and above average.   Typical Columbian restaurant. I always like Columbian candy they give at the bill. Each restaurant has different candy so do this restaurant. We have the tripe soup, black sausage, churrasco Bandeja paisa. The tripe soup is ok. The churrasco is good flavor, the pork belly do not has salt, the sausage is average, it does give a good portion of food for good price. My wife want to try the black sausage which is blood sausage. It can be better with correct seasoning.   Our experience here is good. Nothing stand out but solid. The server know a bit English and enough to take your order. Even change the TV channel for you. Overall many Latin people eat there. Many have look at us and curious what we have order. They were surprised we know our order :)

Got tea is one of the few pioneer boboa drink restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. The tea cafe is open base on taiwanese cafe hangout place in Taiwan. The have served the variety slush, smoothies, milk drinks, coffee, green tea, or snow.   The menu did not stop at drink. They serve the traditional taiwanese street food. The dishes include five spice chicken, fried tofu, pot stickers, fried calamari.   The drinks that I use to get there are strawberry yogurt snow, papaya snow, mango snow and avocado snow. The mix of the flavor drink here is tasty and fragrance.  They also have new drink like mix of two flavors such banana/strawberry, avocado/coconut, strawberry/pineapple. All drink can add the boboa (tapioca pearl), grass jelly, mix jelly.   They also have the magazine, board game, Japanese or Asian comic book if you like to hang out. They have previously open late but the new hour close at 9 pm daily and 9:30 pm weekend. They no longer have late night hour. All drink is cap off with some Asian funny word on top if you know how to read chinese (it take 5 year to learn chinese, have someone to translate for you or you can collect the top and read them 5 year later after you have fluent with chinese. Good luck!!). Think about it 1/4 of the population of the world know how to speak in mandarin, you might want to pick up this skill.   If you added the boboa in the drinks, they have special wider diameter straw for you to reach the boboa at the bottom. Drink the boboa while it soft. They can be harden when it get colder from the snow.

The Old US mint shows how the money was print at the old day. The city of the New Orleans holds a importance location in the US history. They are located at the mouth of the Mississippi. This strategic location for trade and military control for the entire US. As a result, in the 1800's, they have mint the New Orleans dollars. They have show the mechanic to create the New Orleans dollar from flat piece of metal and cut into round shape. A press machine creates the image of the coin. They have dollar gold or silver coin. The silver coin is the most popular. But none is more importance than the New Orleans Morgan Dollar. They have display the seven Morgan Dollars. The Mint is part of the National Park and is free for the entry.   The upstairs of the museum has captured the history of New Orleans Jazz Festival. Various artists at different time have performed in New Orleans Jazz Festival. The artist is range from 1910 to current. They also restore a white Steinway piano that was destroy by Hurricane Katrina in the museum. This piano was play by Fat Domino in the past. Paul McCarty Fund has contributed to restore this famous piano.   The other upstairs room also displays the picture that capture the moment of the world. The moments has included Detroit Lion win the Baseball World Series, Syria's suicide bombing, Kiev conflict, Filipina flooding, Bangladesh building collapse capture two dead victim, hunting of lion in Africa, Afghan burn victim child receive in American home..........This is awesome display. I recommended visit this place when you come to New Orleans. It located at the end of the French market.

During the thanksgiving day, Cracker Barrel is the very few restaurant open. It make many family or travelers happy to fill their stomach during the holiday. Thanksgiving day always has to wait on the line if you going to here for lunch or dinner. We waited 25 minutes.   The store has plenty of items for you to look while you waiting. They even have the rocking chair in the front for the customers who wait. I like the conversation with my neighbors chair. They indicated to me they don't need to cook the and clean the turkey because the option they have in Cracker Barrel.   Today they run the special turkey platter with turkey, ham, sweet potatoes casserole, corn bread, stuffing, cherry sauce for $12.99. It including drink and pumpkin pie. It is a good meal. Love the turkey and the pumpkin pie. The pumpkin pie are freshly made not frozen before. It is silky smooth.   Service a bit slow during the holidays. But is acceptable.

We were here for the weeknight sushi special. They have $1 nigiri, $2 sushi and $3 dollar roll. This are good price. Once you add it together, you may spend up to $17 per person. However, you can try a lot of sushi and roll.   The experience is a mix. Some roll are good and some just average. I will not complain since the cost per roll is good pricing during weeknight happy hour. They run the special from 5 to 7 pm. Our waitress is super nice. She got our order in quickly at 6:10 pm when we sit down. We were able to get our second order after 30 minutes of eating. The waitress is very courteous to ask us if we like to get the third order 5 minutes before happy hours end.    They are some room can be improved for the happy hours sushi. The sushi rice flavor can be a bit tasty with correct mixing with sushi rice preparation. The fish meat can be a bit better quality. I have to complement their service is above the scale.

South Tampa is lucky to has such store. This place is too far for me. But my visit is a pleasant one. I would consider a people care serving grocery store.   The store offer craft beer sale, fresh produce, meat market, can goods and more. This store hold it own with very competitive pricing.   The love of the store is not about the groceries. It is about the deli section. The have all kind of sandwiches to select include the one I like now grilled sea bass sandwich. It is only $6.99 for regular size sandwich. Compare to the seafood restaurant next door, I pick the value, good food anytime in this store. Other sandwiches include Cuban, gyro, Italian, ropa veja and more. Come to check them out.   The have the hot deli in Cuban cuisine series. It include the roast pork and devil crab. Food here is good and convenient to housewife. I would visit them again if I am here.

Ha ya- karate chop. No it just the tea. It has some kick in it. No hand chop:)   Kung fu mean martial art in Chinese. When they use together with food mean their specialty food. I have been to this place 4 times and gather my conclusion of this place. The tea place is upscale. Nice sofa and seat. They have the regular tea mix. You can add toppings of your choice that is when they get you with up charge. The have good enough tea taste. Other than that. They have a lot of toppings or inclusion selection.   I have the pina colada with mango jelly. Not bad at all. We were here 35 minutes before it closed and we drink to the last minute. This will be the eat around 4th stops. We enjoy our moment with friend here.

I have been to this place twice. The food here is good. There is good grilled master behind the kitchen make the grilled chicken great. We have the two dishes for $10.99 with our coupon in the mail. It make the food very economical.   We have quarter grilled chicken and one tropical chop. For the chop, we selected the mojo pork. Both dishes are delicious. The chicken grilled perfectly with good marinate. We also have the fried yuca. The yuca is cut into cube. I like the cube better because the batter cover more area.   We did not try their drive through but the inside order is quick. There are plenty of parking spot at the facility. After eating, they pickup the dishes. What a service for the fast food. I can see I will be back. I always love their mojo base grilled chicken.

This store is very unique that has restaurant, ice cream, and veggie market. This is the first time I have seen a three component market. It has a beautiful back yard overlook the Pithlachascotee River. The Loquat Festival is holding their festivity at the beautiful location.   I have ordered the Reuben Sandwich during lunch. The Reuben sandwich is a hot sandwich composed of corned beef, Swiss cheese, and sauerkraut. The cheese is melt at the hot plate and they are melt perfectly. It comes with homemade coleslaw. The sandwich is great.   The ice cream section offers eight different flavors. It quenches the people in hot sun and cools them down while they enjoy their ice cream. The veggie market offer variety of vegetable including fruit. You can come here to have your lunch, enjoy your desert, and bring home the grocery in one shot. What a way to save time.   The backyard is wide open that you can enjoy a cup of coffee and walk to dock over the river. Relax in Florida sun over the tree shade. Heaven and earth.

Rare Ethnic Food 26  Pollos A La Brasas - Rotisserie Chicken. The word from Latin language explains it all. Their best dish that should not be miss. This place the food here is very affordable. It located off street from main road Hillsborough. If you come to shop at the Italian market next door, may be plan a visit.   This restaurant is mom and pop shop. Some of the customers said they move from other place. Their rotisserie chicken has good marinated spice. I would said it is one of the better one in Bay Area. The chicken is well marinated to the bone. It is tender and juicy. The accompanying is the white rice and fresh salad. If they can improve these two items, they may be able to sell better.   They do have some good looking dessert that we didn't try on this trip. It is definitely worth a shot.

Bubble or boba.  It is just a fight of the term. This new bubble tea place is located near food court entrance. The store is located at the center of the walkway.   The analogy is interesting like a mad scientist to create the experiment drink. Watch up the science of boba cooking. I have the special drink in the menu - rainbow ripple. The lady who make the tea forget to add the boba into it. I have added it later.
