What make this tea interesting is the presentation, I like their creation with rainbow sprinkles on top of the whip cream. This drink is strawberry base.   I like my wife drink a bit better. She has the cookie and cream. It add a real cookies and cream in the mixed of the drink. It is interesting rich drink. I cannot say for all other drink. But their special drink score a 4 stars. Price for the boba drink in Bay Area is at the high side.

I have been to this cafe several time and I decided to give them a review. The interior is all green since the name call green island. During the odd hour of 3:30 pm, there is a lot of high school student hang out. Other than drink, they also have sushi, salad, rice bowl, sweet toast.   For the main selection are the drink. They have ice tea, milk tea, smoothies, cold coffee. And they have add on like boba, jelly,  and fruit. For the ice tea, I like their Kumquat lemon ice tea and black tea. Today I have the avocado smoothies. I add boba into the smoothies. The boba need to be broil to soft and add the sugar water at the bottom of the smoothies. The avocado flavor was added into shave ice and ground together.   The pricing for the smoothies is average in the Bay Area. The drink is non fat and the calories is approximately 100 to 140 for smoothies.

It is a bit cold today. But I come prepare. I hope the parade people do not get sick in the cold weather. This children parade is non alcohol parade. Many young kid come out for the event. It has a good line up for the float.   One thing that I have learn from the parade is not to come out earlier. You alway can catch the parade near the end point 1.5 hour of the official start time. We were there at 4:30pm and the parade begin line has not reach us yet at the end line. The parade was officially start at 3:30 pm.   This year they have over 70 float. The kids who attend the event have high spirit to get the bead from the float. I was able to catch some and pass to the kid next to me. The best thing at the end line if they have many left over bead, they will throw you a beg. Shower of bead. You need to raise your hand above your head to protect your self. As Moses raise his hand to hold the sun not to set. Good luck.

Beads! Beads! Beads!  A lot of beads. It was raining beads. There are so many that some people neck full of it. After a while we are lost interest in the regular beads. Because we have to many. We want the special beads.   This parade is children's friendly. A lot kid have their time of their fun. The cutest get special treatment at the front row. I was stand minimum three rows back. I still get hit by beads. Hand need to up all time to protect yourself from getting hit by beads.   This is definitely one of the best Tampa Tradition. Pirate all over the place. Pirate ship fire the cannons. It was a fun day out with god weather. There were about 100 floats in display. Dancing, marching band and more. Love the people dress up as pirate.   Parking for the parade is a challenge. I do have a good spot to park close to the parade there are some food stands if you want to get some.

Anise may be the best offer for food in downtown area. It is very close to library, the park, performance art that make a very easy access and reach. The interior is modern and nice. It has a very nice bar area.    We were here after a yelp event since it is a walking distance. For Thursday night, they are still a lot of people after 9:30 pm. There is lively of this location. No wonder my friend like it here.  The food is good mix of Asian fusion, Mexican, and American favorite. I have tried the ramen bowl with pork belly. The soup base is pork bone base very close to the tonkutsu of Sapporo Japan.  This bowl is actually reinvented with the ingredient and change from traditional ramen bowl. The pork belly is fried to give more flavor to release to the soup. Usually fried pork belly soak the pork oil. When it mix up with liquid, it release the belly oil into the soup. Clever ideal. I like this bowl and I also prefer the the tradition pork belly. So this ramen has potential.   Overall the service is good. I like the atmosphere of the restaurant.

This is restaurant is about almost 4 stars. We were here for the friend celebration. I like the decorations inside the restaurant. Something unique and stand out. I like the big round light bulb with low intensity fuel. The bar has the decorations of veggies leaf which is stand out.   Food certainly has some good choice of seafood selection with seared, ceviche, deep fried and more. Our group of eight has share a lot of food on table. We start with table side guacamole. I would is  good fresh guacamole. Other apps include Guajillo Pork Belly, Plantain Empanadas, traditional snapper ceviche, ahi tuna ceviche, and special salad. I like the tuna and pork belly.   My main course is the Carne Asada. Steak was cook perfectly but small portion. But the chimichurri is at sour side compare to typical one. I like the accompanying arugula salad with bacon and fruit. We also to taste the fried whole snapper and the shrimp.   Overall the service is average good. I don't mind to be tag on large group mandatory tip. But 20% is a bit steep. Normally is 18%. Which mean you have not say if the service is bad. A half star deduction here.

Neighborhood Taco Bell for drink and snack. I have never use their food for meal. But I do like their select item over Mc Donald for snack.   I here mainly for the happiest hour soft drink. During 2pm to 5pm each day, the drink is a dollar. I usually get the Baja blast freeze. They do have other choice like the pomegranate water, other flavor of freeze. Taco Bell generally is healthy choice than Mc Donald in the fast food chain. I remember an old futuristic movie "Demolition Man" shows the only surviving franchise in the future is Taco Bell. The movie shows the people with healthy living and change society and the Taco Bell is the high class restaurant. Imagine that is all we eat in the future???  I also like their snack for the crunchy taco or the steak quesadilla. Love the steak quesadilla here. If they can only using just the Swiss cheese, I will know at their door often.

It was tough to decide this since I know Malaysian cuisine very well. I understand there are many spice cannot be obtained in America or in the conditions it was provided such as wet curry paste. However, it does not give the excuse to cut short the way it was prepared in Malaysia.   This restaurant name Kampong meaning the village in Malay. They do hope this is Malaysian village cuisine. Actually they are many way to cook the dish. Especially the Nyonya Cuisine - a mixed of Chinese and Malay cuisine by the the descendent of the mixed marriage. Laksa and Prawn Mee are the two good examples. Laksa and Penang laksa are very different. Penang laksa is not curry base. It suppose to be fish meat was ground in tiny piece with the laksa ingredients such as lemon grass. You may disagree with this restaurant serve with curry base.   The prawn mee are very close to my mom cooking. The soup base is make from shrimp head and shell. I like the sambal to be added to increase the taste. This is yet their best Malaysian dish. The Malaysian satay is still off since they are not grilled on the open flame. The wing marinate can be more strong curry taste. The last dish I try is the Nasi Lemak. This is typical Malaysian food with coconut rice. I don't like the beef to be sliced and cook in special sweet chili sambal sauce. The beef need to be in rendang gulai in cube. The dried little fish (Ikan billi) need to in this chili sauce.   I would said authentic enough in Tampa Bay Area. But not the best in US. Their first two page are the Malaysian cuisine mostly. Service is good. May be need to try more. 4 stars is a bit stretch at this point.

Pho Nhu Trang sound like follow the new trend. This is a good new restaurant to follow. Since I have been to Tampa, this location has went through many owners. You Saigon deli was once in this location. Now under the new owner. So if you looking for new restaurant, this may be the one.   We have try their pho and stir fried. We have order the Banh Bun Hue. The spicy noodle. We feel that the noodle is average. Somethings is lack off like pig blood. We also order the fried calamari. This dish is a wow factor. The coating is is crispy but not over coated. The coating also have spice in it and enhance the flavor for taste.   We saw our neighbor order the stir fried tofu. And it is look good. I would definitely recommend the stir fried items. For my next visit, I will try their stir fried menu. The service is good since the younger generation who serve us know the English well.

This is my third time here. I like unique of the restaurant with music venue. The restaurant is separated from the music venue. The music venue sometime is free but most of the time requires a small cover fees.  However, you can eat at the restaurant without attending the music venue and not charge with the fees.   The restaurant has a lot non typical food from the swamp or sea. They have the smoke mullet, fried gator tail, popcorn crawfish, beer boil shrimp, smoke fish dip.  The service is quick and so does the food come out.  The ambient is very interesting that the restaurant is constructed from a shack. The full menu offer a lot of seafood dish found in many restaurant. In season, they also have the stone crab.   Please check at their music calendar that is playing and the required cover fees. They also have special event held here call skipper dome for the entire music venue. They open late at night if you want a bite.

It was good to have experience with this festival. Although I did not got the VIP tickets, but it is good enough with lobster dinner. We were there when they just open. No line. Base on my friend yesterday experience the long line, I decided to go at the door open. It is good to be the first in the line on the ticket booth and second in the line to receive the lobster. The dinner is including one lobster, sweet corn, potatoes and the butter sauce. Since the lobster is flown in from Maine, its meat has not shrink like you get it from typical grocery store. It has a lot of meat. The lobsters we receive are just steam out of the batch. Since it is just from the sea, you can taste the sea salt. You don't need any butter or any seasoning. It is still steaming hot since it just finished steaming.   The event take place at beautiful Kapok. It was pleasantly sit on beautiful dinning hall. The event include a lot vendors. It is great to see them all. So, most importantly is to go on the second day at opening when no line. It is also because the staff know the routine and not as chaos as first day. We were in and out in 1 hours 15 minutes.

The Domina's pizza is actually located inside the gas station. I am not much a pizza lover, but if I have to chose the pizza chain domina is my choice. I like old thick crust pizza, I am not a fan of tin crust. If you have to pig out, please go all out with no reservation. At that point you have blown the calories count any how.   Tonight they have the $5 two topping deal large pizza. It is enough for me and my wife. We have order the pepperoni and bacon. I call in 10 minutes before my pickup and they are ready on time. The two topping deal only on the carry out. Please make a trip to nearby pizza place. The total come to $6. Great value.   They lay the pepperoni then the bacon on top. The pepperoni is great and crispy. With bacon on top the juice of bacon further cook the pepperoni to give extra crispy. The bacon is great in this sense. Everything go well with bacon.   Please catch the deal while they last.

This is about 4.5 star restaurant. We know about this type of cooking when we visited Taiwan 2005. The use of volcanic rock stone heat up over 700 degree and grilled the food is a healthy way of cooking. In Taiwan, the meat is marinated and cook over the stone. It is not much of difference than this restaurant.   The lunch of the restaurant offer a better deal in smaller portions for experience if you don't want to spend too much money. For $12 you can have the sirloin, shrimp or ahi Tuna with a side during lunch. Recently they run the special for $18include steak and shrimp.   They have butter on the side if you want to grilled your meat with it. This type of cooking requires fresh seafood of premium grade of steak. It is not recommend for pork or chicken.   The food is tasty. It may require some minimum cooking skill to enjoy it. So who can blame if the food did not cook well. It was great to see the method is introduced in US. The dinner item is medium range in price compare to any steak restaurant.

This restaurant use to be at Bruce B Down. Now it move to bigger and better place in Brandon. I love this restaurant in very beginning due to great food. When they move out of New Tampa/USF area, many thought it close the door. Not many actually know that they move to new location.   The new place is at least 4 time bigger than the old Takara. Now they have the patio seating. The interior is decorated very nicely. Now they are soft opening. They have added the lunch special that include the specialty burrito.   For me, I like the old Takara sushi. I like their torch salmon roll. This roll wrap in the seaweed with fried tempura shrimp and imitation crab meat. Top with cook salmon and torch with open flame. Then add the fried small chili or jalapeño. It bring the heat and grilled meat taste. Sushi to died for. 10 pieces for $11. Good deal.   Don't forget their old menu includes the vegetarian sushi. The one I like are funky monkey roll. The ramen is good also. You can finish with the bombs dessert. Fried banana springs roll on whip cream. Happy tummy happy day.

It was recommended by Yelp friend for good pho. As a result we ordered a big bowl of Pho Xe Lua the combination meat special. It is huge bowl of soup that have everything. You can share this bowl and order other items. Since I am not the Vietnamese, I cannot tell what is actually good Pho. Same go for many people depending on their preferences. Some like heavy smell, some like clearer soup base, some like beefing smell. So pick your own.    We also order the Bo Bia the vegetable roll with Chinese sausage. I like the sauce that comes with it. We also ordered the Hai Vi Kho To - simmered seafood with caramel sauce. I have this dish at many place. This restaurant have it a bit different. The sauce is not creamy but liquidity. Good balance of salt. This restaurant seem like family owned. Service is average. Next visit I will try their stuff chicken wing and salty lemonade with soda.

I would say this is a very nice women hospital. I happen to be here to visit a friend who delivers the baby here.   I went to their web site and noted this hospital is founded in 1993. This is rather new mid age hospital but have nice facilities that delicates to women only. It has 22 years history that brings a lot of experience compare to any 5 years old hospital in the Bay Area. The facility is clean and very contemporary look. They have a good breast cancer care facilities.   Compare to my first baby, the hospital now day charge everything. My friend have to paid for their baby class such as Lamar class, new born class, prenatal class, infant CPR. When I had the first baby this thing is free when my wife registers to the hospital to have baby. I cannot believe they charge you arm and leg for the later deliver room and board without any free class.  The room is very nice. I believe women check themselves here is almost like having vacation. They have single room facilities and they are very nice. My friends have the baby in the incubator with one room with one baby. Dad and mom can come to visit and hold them there.   The hospital has a lot of sun light come in. I don't like long hallway with room and no sun light. Don't take this is the vacation home because it is really expensive. Just kidding.

I was so look forward to try Blake Crab Cake. I like lump crab meat. Especially they serve Maryland style crab cake. The store is small compared to many restaurant. It is almost like take out. The list of the item was written at the board. I would said this will one of the unique store serve this type of cuisine.   We got the crab cake and the blue crab fingers claw. The crab cake is deep fry with flour. It does not look like lump crab look that the business picture. As a result, I think is a step down. When the flour and crab meat fried together is not the same just the crab lump meat alone. It will be different. The blue crab claw is delicious. But I think instead of old bay seasoning, the blacken claw is better.   The experience is just make the mark. Nothing fancy. Portion is a bit small. 5 oz crab cake for $12 is at the high side.

We were here due to the famous Muffuletta. If you come to New Orleans, you got to try their muffuletta. The General Store in this French Quarter serves the original Muffuletta. All the ingredients are imported. As a result you will need to get from this store. Line usually builds up to the door during the lunch time.   What is Muffuletta?  It is actually the Italian sandwich with bunch stuff in side. The half sandwich is enough to fill the grown man stomach. The lady just needs a quarter sandwiches only. It will be a challenge to eat a whole sandwich. The Muffuletta is served with Sicilian sesame bread. If you don't like the sesame, this will not be your sandwich. Usually you like it or you hate it. Very less people are in between. In between the bread are the layer of marinated olive salad, mortadella, salami, mozzarella, ham, and provolone.   The signature olive salad consists of olives diced with the celery, cauliflower and carrot. Again, if you don't like pickle marinate items, you may not like the sandwich. This is my first NOLA sandwich. Since the NOLA have a lot to offer, I am not sure I will be back.

After second visit. This restaurant is about average not just for Malaysian standards but also Asian food standards. We come here second time to determine  how many stars need to be. I have to agree with Mark and Brian for three stars.   This visit we have order the Beef Rendang, Hainanese Chicken, and Char Quey Teow. Below are the reasons they are average. The beef rendang is at right spice. However they are very mild in spice. They are not spicy. But if you request a spicy beef. They should be able to tone up or down on the spiciness of food by add additional step to prepare in the kitchen. This option was not available. The Hainanese Chicken suppose to be broil and chill in cold water with same process for many time to get the tenderness. But I think just broil once.   The Char Quey Teow should be dry out stir fry wok cooking. One positive note. All food has the Malaysian taste. It has good spice.

Our experience is great here for special Christmas menu. It can be 5 stars if not because the price in the high side. We have more expectations if the food alone is $90 per person. The service is excellent for the night. The waitress and waiter are busting the table and o'dourves very nicely.   We star the o'dourves of wood grilled mojiot gulf shrimp. This is a sugar cane slaw pineapple bbq sauce. The shrimp is good side. The marinated was well done. The other o'dourves is the short rib pierogi. This is fried pierogi with good meat. Great bite items.   The appetizers are the crispy calamari and Fig and Goat Cheese flatbread. The fig jam flatbread is nice. The calamari is fried. The dish come with shishito pepper. Nice touch.   Our main dish is the Grilled Golden Tilefish. This dish fish is grilled. It accompanied with parsnip purée and blister tomato. It was parsnip grind to smooth purée. The tomato was special make to cook the inside to juice. It also has the fennel watercress and small shrimp with sauce over the fish.   The final touch dessert are tiramisu and the pistachio blood orange cake. The tiramisu is almost like cake. The blood orange cake has little gold chocolate paper on top is eatable.

3.5 stars restaurant to my book. This new Rice Bean has been building their new hop for long time. Finally it opened for business. It does bring crowd in from the area. There are not much good mom and pop restaurant in the area to compete. They are really located at good spot for business.   We got the Churrasco and Bistec Empanado. The churrasco is the skirt steak. Their skirt steak cut like a strip with about 1" diameter and 7" long. I prefer to thin and at Falda cut which they don't carry. The marinated sauce is good. The steak is cook to medium not like my order medium rare. Overall is a good dish. The Bistec Empanado is breaded thin steak. The breaded coating has no taste. I have been many Latin restaurant have better coating than them.   One other thing. We walk into the restaurant and there was no line on Tuesday night. The hostess still saying we have to wait for ten minutes for table. I see there is open table. At the end we choose the bar instead of waiting. Service is not attentive. Many area of the restaurant need to improve. Service, hostess, food.

It is Chinese style Cajun crab. This store is along West Water Avenue. The place has some of my friends visited before. We visited at the month of August. It not the crawfish season. They don't have crawfish even though there are several dishes in the menu. They sub the crawfish with shrimp.   We got their snow crab and shrimp special. It come with pound of snow crab, 6 shrimp and Andouille sausage. We believe the crab was stir fry before they added the Cajun sauce. My wife like this style. It also have ear of corn and potatoes.   For the restaurant, it is a plus with they provide bib, glove, and crusher. After finger food, my finger still doesn't have Cajun spice smell because it was protected by the glove.

I thought I have reviewed this place. But when I check, I miss my review. So I use this visit to complete my review. I always like this bar because they have a lot TV screen that you can choose. There were plenty of TV with different channels that you can find the one channel that you like.   I have constantly see their promotions. Our recent visit have a chance to try their blacken snapper and the Ahi Tuna Poke bowl. I have specifically instruct to blacken with heavy spice. It didn't disappoint me. It was good enough spice to turn the snapper fillet spicy. I also like the accompanying mushrooms truffles oil french fry. It is delicious with the parsley. The Ahi tuna poke bowl has good enough sesame oil to enhance the taste. Instead of rice as starch, we has ask for the noodle.   We also order the coconut grouper finger first time. It turn out a good choice. Love the atmosphere and food. Service is good. If you come at off hours, they have more discount.

It is about 3.5 stars. To get to the front door of this restaurant is tricky. You need to go around to side of the building. I would said this restaurant are tone done the heavy taste of Vietnamese cuisine to make it more receptive for general population. The cuisine is still good and close to Vietnamese heritage.  We got the fried quail for appetizer. This dish is crispy and good marinated. The only thing about this dish is the  price do not fare well with other restaurants. They are in the high side.   The main entry we have the special combination Pho noodle and the vermicelli with grilled pork and shrimp. Both of the dish is delicious. As I mentioned they tone down the fish sauce to make it easier for they Americans born residents. I think this is a good move. Overall service is good.

The tea place is a bit low customers traffic on Sunday night. We were able to get our order in very quickly. I saw the have coffee, so I ask if they mix the yingyang tea a mix of coffee and tea. Their reply is they can do it but may not be good.   I kind agree with them about the yingyang tea. The tea has to be a red tea with dark roast coffee. I don't think they has it. So I order a Naga milk tea with boba. The tea is very flavorful. It has the good smell from the tea. The boba is actually soak in brown sugar and it is extra good taste.   Overall they are good. The price is in the high side.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Round up to 4. Bam has been open less than few months and up and coming. They move from other locations to here. The new space is nice and plenty of parking space. Their menu has combination special with their signature roll and two other typical roll. Their sushi category divided into cook, raw, or tempura.   I have order two of their signature roll. The Nambomb and the Sunburn. The Nambomb is real snow crab in fill. Not the imitation krab meat. The snow crab meat was mix and mash with creamy sauce. The it roll and top with tuna and salmon. I like the in fill snow crab meat. The Sunburn is roast beef top on the roll. The in fill is lobster meat. The only comment I made is they need to do something about the beef. Instead of roast beef, may be they can create their own beef is more attractive such as grilled beef.   Overall experience is good. The restaurant still young. Lunch before 2:30pm will have 15% off the meal every day.

I like our food here but not necessary we have best time. First the wait, the hostess tell us 10-15 minutes. It turn up another ten minutes. I walk around and found empty tables but they are not occupied by anyone. I went to check when is our turn, they lead me to the same empty table that I found 5 minutes ago. The seat is just below the AC vent. I can feel the drip of the water. They definitely need to check this vent on their off hour. Make sure water molecules is contained.   The only thing I like about this place is the service on the table and the food. Which is the most important. My wife has the Thai Coconut-Lime Chicken. It a bit lime heavy at the end. The best is the Hibachi Steak. It is the hunger steak with shiitake mushrooms in slice, caramel onion and sprout. It also included the wasabi mash potatoes and tempura asparagus. This steak is cook with the ginger sauce which is a good match.   Service is good over the dining time. Food come out the right time compare to my last visit. I would said the hostess need to paid attention to the empty table. Customers is less patient when exceed to the wait acknowledge time. The AC vent need to be clean and make not dripping water. Who know what dust has the water has collected.

During pandemic, Yamato considered has good customer traffic during difficult time. This has to thank to their simplicity of menu and more combo price dish. It is more attractive in compare to my first visit. The combo menu make it more affordable and the customer can try more items.   I got the Yamato Special. It has shrimp, chicken, and steak. The side dish includes fried rice, veggies, noodle, salad, soup. This is the first time I also bring home the left over. My wife have the steak and calamari combo. We like our food. I think the chef make it a bit too salty.   We always like the show. It includes the egg roll and toss. I also like the big fire in the beginning, ops check your eye brown after the show. Did it burn off. The volcano onion is classic. We enjoy the entertainment. As usual, this is seat close to the tepan cook top. Expect the food smell will stick to you. Just wear easy to wash. Cloth. Avoid bring and leather items such hand bag, clothing. The food smell will be difficult to remove from leather items.

Weather is perfect for the fresh market day. Don't miss out the good weather while they have the fresh market. It located directly under the memorial causeway. I would suggest come from Drew street. Than SR 60 after US 19. It is less traffic.   This market located at beautiful inner bay. I only want to mention one vendor. The Thai Gourmet Market. It serve a rice flat noodle dish. It locate on the pier if you want to look for it. The noodle is cook at the spot and your choice of meat. Today we have the roast duck. You can have a choice of grill pork or chicken. The additional meat to be add is $2. The dish include fried garlic and onion. It lay over the lecture and bean sprout. The sauce is amazing. So go try it yourself.   This fresh market happen every second and fourth Saturday. Please look it up.

Authentic Ethnic Food # 33  Finally we have very good Cuban Cuisine near Northeast Tampa. That cut a lot of my driving time if I am craving for this type cuisine. This place is close to the intersection Nebraska and Florida south of Publix. Plenty of parking at stand alone building. The exterior is not attractive but the interior is well decorated.   We have order the Completa Grande. This did content three different types of typical Cuban food. It has Ropa Vieja, Picadillo Habanero, and Lechon Asada. The Lechon is well braise with mojo sauce. The sides include rice, black bean, yuca and plantain. This is a good dish for to try if you want to find out what is Cuban cuisine. We also has the Alitas de Pollo. This is the marinated chicken wings with garlic mojo sauce. It is about $1 a wing.   Overall the experience is good. Like the food there. Definitely come back for their seafood chef selection.

I have not seen a wawa gas station has electric charge station. This one certainly has one. I saw a lot of local owner or traveler come here to charge up. They waited at the back of Station while the car is charged. Seem like a long benefit. I wonder they have to paid or free for the electric car. I glad that there is along the way charging station. The only inconvenience is the wait. It is make more sense to charge near the mall while they can shop and dine. But for Wawa is the first of the pioneering this project.   The wawa is generally cheaper gas than most. It has the gas in good pricing. Other than the gasoline, the sandwich and coffee are great here. The bathroom is some what clean.

Tampa General is vital for the whole Bay Area. Many special or trauma case are sent to here. They also have the burn center that very few hospitals has it. The hospital equip with many helicopters to serve the nearby counties. This put the hospital is a beacon not just the Bay Area.   We were here twice and have good impressions. They have good neurology center. With partner with USF health, they provide quite a good coverage in the academic side. When we were here visit a friend, we feel navigated to the maze to find their room. Each location is security guard with ID scan and visitors pass.   The only thing I don't understand is why the hospital located in the isolated island. It make access a bit difficult. However, I have to give for good view to Bay and the city.

Japanese food or good can be found in this store. Essential items also can be found here. This store is not big but have enough items for your need. Many packaging food is available.   The store owner is very friendly. She welcomes you with a warm smile. The ceramic section include bowl or tea set is nicely presented.   It also carry some munchies section. Porky is widely sold in the store. It do have some frozen section.

Not yet 5 stars. It is about 4.5 stars. Since no half star, 5 stars is given for good service. Umami server to sushi chef are very young in age. Don't be fool by the young age. Their new intention and recreation is very trendy.  Start with weakness. The sushi is a bit above average on the three rolls special. I have the spicy tuna, spicy white tuna mango, and cowboy rolls. The spicy tuna instead grind meat, I would prefer dice meat. The spicy white tuna mango is interesting. The cowboy roll is seared beef in sushi roll. All are creative. I think need to work on the flavor.   The bento box is amazing. The sashimi has very nice pieces of fish. They are very fresh and not fishy at all. The tempura bento also very nice. They have the best skill for tempura. A real Japanese technique is to glue each coating separately and creat needle type tempura look. If you see a smooth breaded coating, those are lazy type of cooking. He breading coating need to needle type. All bento box has very good fry rice. Love it.   In addition, the sashimi has fatty tuna, king salmon, madai, fluke. Those are more choices on special type of fish. This choice make them stand out from other sushi place.

If you are hungry and have less than $10 in your pockets, you may want to consider this place. The place is small, but it has street food written all over it. We came here for a memorial crawl. It is definitely a good stop for our stop.   We order the signature crazy Burrito. It has steak, seasoning pork, chorizo, rice, bean, guacamole. The size is crazy big. I mean really big. I love the taste. It is definitely a must have for the visit. I also got the fish and shrimp taco. Both of them is delicious. It come with many tail of shrimp.   Food come out quick enough. The order can be made on the table. We enjoy our time there. It has some Mexican hats lay around if you want a picture. The store is small. But is big enough for a group of eight of us.

Love it. Just outside of the food court at open area. Very visible if walk into the mall through the restaurant street and they located on the right hand side before the entrance.   We have the Mr. Mango Favorite Frappe. The is peel mango noodle, frozen mango juice, fresh mango chop and condensed milk. She started the condensed milk spread around the wall of the cup. Chop mango then add condensed milk. Add frozen mango juice then top with mango noodle and condensed milk. It is epic. Go get yourself one of that. You can add spicy spread if you like.   They do have Diablo Frappe it is street Mexican mango chop. Very spicy. May be try it next time.

It was great night to meet a group of yelp friend. This usually a test for waiter who actually can handle our group. The test was pass with a good standing. Our waiter was able to weather the storm of 10 people group.   We were there before the happy hour end. The happy hour drink is $3.5. The glass is small than the normal size but have good enough alcohol. At least is about 30% off on normal size. The choices include rum, tequila, or vodka and flavor.   I got some happy hour sushi with Tampa Roll and Shrimp tempura roll. This two rolls with good fish and shrimp. We also order the smoke fish dip and bacon burger slider. All this item is $5. Great for happy hour.   On the entree, I got the Kapalua Grill for $26. It has medley of grilled seafood. It has shrimp, scallops and crab cake. It also accompanied with potatoes cake and grilled asparagus. All have great flavor.

It is about 4.5 stars. Not 5 stars yet. Thanks to Rachel local yelper who is the pioneer to visit this store. After a year, the business is still doing well. There were a lot of customers while we visited this place.   I would suggest to go for the big Kahuna if you are hungry. It give you two proteins. I got the spicy tuna and large shrimp. The shrimp size is big also the spicy tuna is good size. We are happy the quantity they allow to add on. There are plenty selection. I got the masago, seaweed salad, fried corn and more. The add on is great. The base selection also a lot. I got the white rice and soba noodle.   One thing that can be improved is the their rice. Instead of white rice, sushi rice is better. It has more flavor when preparing correctly. Other than the add on, they also have large variety of sauce for selection. If you don't like to mixed your on bowl, you can get the premixed bowl.

Great space with moving fan sideway for ambience and function air mover. This new restaurant has inside and outside seating. Live music is playing at the outside seating. Same as the bar has half inside and outside seating. When you seat at the bar outside is not quite hot since they have the blow air next to bar.   When seat at the bar, we have good advantages like the immediate access to our bar tender and waitresses immediately. So we take it slow by order items one at the time.   We started with firecrackers shrimp. It is buttermilk coating fried to crispy. It come with sriracha aioli. It is crunchy with good dipping sauce. I also order the hibiscus margarita. I like they give you enough alcohol of Sauza. This is actually one of their signature drink there. It has hibiscus with sugarcanes juice. I also like the crystal brown sugar on the edge of glass.   We have order two main dish. The grill salmon on mixed greens on cheese tostadas. One improvement can be made is to place the tostadas to side to avoid lessen the crispness from dressing. The second dish is the skirt steak churrasco. First time brought out to us is over cook. Second time was good. Some how the chef need to know turn down the grill fire heat or turn the steak often. The manager did come out to apologize about the steak and give us credit.   Overall experience is good. Good management team to watch the floor. Waitress is alert to customers need.

I am excited finally to try out this restaurant. I have been many event that the restaurant involved in and try their food. Tuesday is good day to try since my friend said they have the prefix menu. Actually they have stop this offering long time ago.   The night is busy. I like their bar and kitchen is next to each other. The action in the kitchen was presented in front you when you just a few feet away. I like the action and coordination between chefs.   I start with lamb neck with over the dumplings top with salad. This dish meat was obtained from the neck area. The meat was braised me dumplings below is fried. The top salad was very delicious. The hot sauce below just accommodate well with the dish.   The second dish is risotto with lobster. The risotto was cook with lobster and wild mushrooms. The edge was green color by caramelize fennel and top with lemon fraiche. This hot, warm and cold section make this dish my favorite dish. Very interesting.   Overall close 4.5 stars. I think they can be better. I would said good restaurant.

Solid 4 stars. The word fun is sound of rice in Chinese. This make up their store name. Very good name. The poke is also fun to have also. They are kind tuck away from plaza. It is a bit difficult to get to.   First choose the base. They have something most of the poke place do not have it. Soba Noodle as a base. They do have other base like rice, salad, brown rice which no interest me. Second choose two protein. I got the tuna and salmon. Third 5 mixed in. I got the cucumber, cherry tomato, mango, pineapple and last with shiitake mushroom which not use by most poke place. They have the protein and mixed in combo with sauce and stir the mix before put in to the base. Good technique.   The topping selection has 4. I got crab meat, seaweed salad, octopus and masago. Considering this good topping. Food is a bit expensive but has good topping and base. I would make some changes with sesame seed, bonito flake and onion crip to free add on instead count as topping. This will give customers willing to come back because they got something extra.

Columbian restaurant that open not long ago. It was on the neighborhood paper. Decided to give them a try. At the front of the store, they display the Latin pastry and finger food and chicharon. It was beautifully displayed. We got some of their pastry. The pastry is definitely 5 stars item. I would love to buy their pastry again. Pastry are delicious. Love it.   For the entrees, we have the Carne A la Plancha. It single grilled steak. The other dish is the grilled skirt steak. I would said they are not the expert of the steak. The control of the steak temperature or marinated sauce is not there. The technique is average.   Service is good. Food come out quick. The table and seating is basic set in the restaurant. They have a few booth you can have more privacy.

This restaurant located at Riverview. It is a popular restaurant in the area. Lunch has many customers is a good sign. I would said this is 4.5 stars restaurant in my book not yet 5 stars. I round up the stars because they have the Jackfruit Smoothie that not many restaurant carry it. The smoothie is nice dessert.   I got the pork chop, shred pork, meat cake and fried egg and rice. Seem like this is a popular dish that many has order. The combo of this dish is twelve dollars but it has everything thing I need. Pork chop is delicious. Meat cake is a fan. I also has the shrimp fresh roll. The roll is big can be share and come in to two.   Service is good and attentive. If I am visiting again, I would try their chef special. Ban Bun Hue. It is tapioca noodle.

Typical day at the mall shopping and rose show. Usually my wife went to different store and we will meet at certain time after shopping. When she want extra time and I already finish my window shopping, I sit at a restaurant to have a drink and wait.   I know the heat playoff games is on and in the same time the Kentucky derby is on. I could not believe that Kentucky derby drawn a lot of fan to watch at the bar. 70% of TV monitor showing the derby. The customer next to me is from the Tampa downs jockey, and the left is older lady fan who are very interested at the derby.   I have order the strawberry lemon vojito - vodka, lemonade, mint and strawberry. It is a Long lost cousin of Mojito. Interesting. Ok mix drink. The bartender is very attentive. It is very interesting day at the bar that I am the only one watching the heat game and the rest of people watching the derby.

This ice cream shop is truly like by many. The stars will tell you so. It is not easy to find. But the local know where it located. You have go to the back of the plaza and wonder you are at the wrong place, but just right there, you found the ice cream shop.   They have many homemade ice cream. The flavor can be learn by many ice cream shop. I try all four flavors, and I like them all. I settled for two flavors. One is the loopy. It is with fruit loop and vodka fruit loop. You have to be 21 years old to try it. The other is the coconut blueberry. Both of them has wonderful taste.   My wife has chocolate bacon toffee. It sprinkled with candy bacon. BACON. Definitely people love the most in their food. It is gluten free also. The clerk is helpful and has knowledge about the ice cream flavor. This will help customers to make the decision.

This place has a change over for many Indian restaurant. Nice yellow spice curry is serving here. It is located next to gas station. Very strange place. Parking is very limited but no worry because the mall parking is just behind it.   Lunch buffet is the best to do here and get your value of the meal. We came in late for our lunch. But they are still serving buffet. It is alway best to go to buffet when they just open. The food just ready and has not been clear out.   When we were there, the food is a bit empty but they fill slowly by their kitchen. I like the tandoori chicken here. It is very good use of spice and perfectly grilled. Some tandoori have to many spice and make the outside of the chicken moist but this place is perfect.   The curry they serve is great. Good use of spice. It is great to enjoy the buffet here.

The lunch special is very affordable and attractive. It is great to have lunch here with less than $10 on weekday. I like restaurant has multiple TV with many angle and channels. That's why you call them sport bar. The drink has special every day including the happy hour 4 to 6 pm.   We got weekday lunch special with grilled salmon salad and grilled chicken Fettuccine. Both dish is big enough for lunch. The salmon come in the strips and perfectly grilled. The salad is great because they have good mixed of green. The Fettuccine sauce also good and the chicken is juicy.   You may want join their lunch time gold stars punch card. After 5 visit, you got $10 free on lunch. The service is great. From reception to service is very attentive. Our food come out quick too.

Since this place has low star. I am trying them out for their new smoothie. The time I went is 3 pm and not many of people. The place is a bit of small and have a few table.   I am trying up their new Avocolada. It is a mix of avocado, lime, coconut, spinach, kale, and pineapple. It is a good combination with smoothie ice. Taste is great. The drink was prepared in 5 min. Not bad for the price for the large size cup.   My experience here is ok may be is off hour.

Fast food in restaurant setting.   The restaurant is big with a lot of seating. When it was just open, it is almost like the attraction of the Brandon. It has nice deco in the interior. It still busy even now. Now is not like pack crazy.   I am just wants to get the experience of it. We have the fried halibut, grilled tuna sandwich and chocolate cake. The halibut do not impress me. It is a small sandwich compare to Burger King or McDonald fish sandwich. The grilled tuna is excellent with taste. The chocolate cake that day is not moist but it has the softness and good mix of cake.   Overall, they are average. They do have a lot help on kitchen. However, the food still take 10 minutes. Compare to many fast food, they are considered slow to deliver.

The outside look like a dump but the interior of this restaurant has some characters. The decorations include big hat, music instruments, a drunken Columbian sniper?  The dinning room has TV. They are Real Madrid soccer team supporter.   The food is more in affordable side compare to Bay Area Columbian restaurants. We are here with some Yelp friend. Steve E review has me book mark this place. If anything bad blame Steve. If it is good, I lead you into this place :).   I have order the churrasco, my wife got the seafood mofongo. One my friend got the traditional mix meat with rice - Bandeja Paisa. Churrasco is big pieces that I can share with my group. The mofongo is very nice. This is Columbia cuisine perform Puerto Rico food. However, they did a good job on the dish.   Food is good here. The margarita is average. Service is ok.

This WAWA is open not long ago. The price is reasonable. Since it is new in Brandon, there is a lot visitor. I like they have the larger screen for instructions. The display letter size in the screen also in larger font size. It is easy to ready for young and old. Especially for old people. I like the blue background screen to reduce the reflection of the sun.   It also has boat fuel. Since it is at it honeymoon period, the gas is cheaper. Now the nearby gas station also lower the price. Good for the consumer. It don't have right in and out to SR 60 but it has share use entrance.

No many Krispy Kreme left in Tampa Bay Area. Definitely not many hot now doughnuts store. I love hot now sign because it is just make it. The doughnut is fresh out from kitchen. The Dough is still warm and the sugar glaze just harden. Krispy Kreme offer that in their doughnut store.   I am here for their special coupon for a dozen glaze donuts for $5. Only the email sign up user have that coupon. It is good deal. I got the hot now freshly made donuts. It was so yummy and I have to open my box and eat them immediately. It definitely allows me to go for second donut after I have finished the first one.   This location is my first visit. I think the wait can be shortened since there is not many customers during 3 pm.

Tampa International Airport (TIA) is one of the busier airport but easy to access compare to many airport in the big city. The TSA airport security usually is fast compare to LA or Chicago. The current airport have six major gate with elevated monorail to take you to each destination. The design is a spur method which is from center point system to deliver in 6 concourses. It is not the line system like Atlanta which has to stop at each concourse at the time and delay you if you have the last concourse.   The TIA is getting a face lift. The are planning a major renovation for the international flight and larger airplane. Other than the international terminal, the master plan is planing a major $1 billion dollar project. The next time if you are in TIA, you will see some of the construction.   The airport also have the third floor shop, restaurant or hotel. The short term parking allow you to get direct access to main building. Parking for 30 minutes is free. The long term parking is good for a day trip if you have to leave your car behind. They have the remote parking for cost saving multi day trip parking. The remote cell phone parking is great if you waiting for the love one to be pickup without cost.

This sandwich is a historic sandwich store. Many my friends gave god review here. As a result, I have bookmarked this place 4 years ago. I am happy to be here.   I have the Cuban sandwich. It was great the sandwich was prepared very fast. I do ask the sandwich to be toasted. After first bite, I think the whole sandwich is sour compared to most of the Cuban sandwich I have. I think the pickle was put there with the pickle sauce was dip into it. The sandwich did not has the mojo pork. Not sure which version of Cuban sandwich is this. I would is Americano sandwich not Cuban.

Asiana Bistro mother restaurant is Thai Lanai. Basically this restaurant is Thai restaurant. The location across the hospital is a good attraction. However, this area is not much of residential area, very limited client tail. As a result they do close on early before actually night time.   We got the spicy noodle with shrimp. This is actually Thai drunken noodle. I did not ask them to spicy it. The noodle is a little bit wet when they serve. I like it dry wok condition. Nonetheless it is still good. Especially take home reheated. The second dish we have is green curry with chicken. This is good dish come with rice on the side.   Overall the food is more to sweet side. Service is good because we are the only dine in customer. We did see a lot of take out. May be this is weekday. I hope they can get more customers.

It is solid 4 stars restaurant. In fact very close to 4.5 stars. A restaurant now day need to bring their "A" game and specialty food to the table. This restaurant has bring it. It great to be the neighborhood restaurant near Cypress. This restaurant is cucina with meat market.   The Boozy Pig has good dish in the menu. We have many choices. We got the their Rocket Man and The Smoke Chicken Purtine. Rocket Man just like jet fuse. It is Wagyu Beef Pastrami with kimchi and melting cheese. It is a rocket fuse.   The Smoke Chicken Purtine go with fried and dripping cheese. It sprinkled with bacon. It is a good finger food. I would eat this dish first before the rocket man. Because rocket man has stronger taste will overpower the smoke chicken purtine.   The few things that keep them from my 5 stars is the side we got is braised collards is $4. A bit at expensive. Most dish come with side dish but here is added on.

It is great tuck away neighborhood restaurant. Gino do bring the taste to the table. It is good to see local restaurant make it because they have quite number of customers.  My meal come with soup and I have selected the conch chowder. This Italian chowder is different taste than normal chowder. It has different the flavor with similar creamy soup. I also like the bread before meal. I have order the blackened sirloin with gnocchi smoked Gouda cream sauce.  The steak was cook to order. The Gouda is place on top. It is interesting way to do it. Good quality steak.   My wife have the special of the day. Grilled steak salad. This is ok. However the portion is big enough. Service is excellent. Food come out good and good temperature. We think this is a good restaurant and we will be back.

I would have given them 5 stars if not just because of the wait. I would recommend this food truck for the great food. But you need to adjust for calling ahead or visit in the off hour (not meal time). They take their time to grill the meat and the wait time is long.  We got the combo meal with sirloin skewer come with two sides - white rice and the grilled veggies skewer. It also come with yucca flour with secret ingredients. Very nice. Got to get the yucca flour. We also got the grilled chicken and the grilled pork chop. My favorite amount three is the chicken because they grilled with technique preserves the juicy meat and marinated into the meat. I would any of this items are top restaurant quality. Love it.   The price is very affordable no wonder many people willingly to wait for their food to be grilled. If you want to have catering, they have the option to do so. Just hire them. This is better than any Brazilian grill meat restaurant.

Hibachi night. My wife have been to this restaurant many time and this is my first. I am usually not order the steak. I am usually order the seafood. The steak cook on the hot  steel plate is usually not as good open flame grilled.  Tonight we have started with onion mushroom soup and ginger salad- come with the meal. The fried onion soup is great but the ginger salad is so so. I think their ginger dressing is too little. To taste a good sushi chef you always order the spicy tuna as a test drive. The sushi came with whole piece cube tuna and slice cucumber. They have a bit of wasabi to make it a bit spicy. A true spicy tuna should be hand chop and dice into tiny pieces then add the sesame oil, raw quail egg, and spicy chili sauce. Then, they are mixed together and wrap in the seaweed wrap. This is true spicy tuna. I believe they have fail at this department.   Our entree is the calamari and tuna with shrimp. We have specified how they are cook. The tuna is seared the outside and the calamari needs to burn a little bit on the out side. The chef did a very good job on this dish not only preserve the good quality of the material and also well season for the hot steel plate cooking.   I would not recommend any sushi but highly recommend the hibachi. Be brave to order the calamari and try it. You will not disappointed. The service is good. As a result they deserve 4 star. If you come with your birthday ID and with a paid friend. The birthday entree is free. For the lady, do not need to wear expensive dress due to the food smoke may stick to your dress, hair and hand bag. You only dress for food. Be prepare wash your hair after visit due to food smoke may stick to your body. That is the price of hibachi.

This location is not comparable with the largo location. Every time I call, they don't have the blue crab. Somehow they need to remove from the menu. Although they don't have blue crab, I decided to paid them a visit to try other items in the menu.   I order a 15 fried shrimp and scallops special. The 15 shrimp is about $10 and the scallops is $5. The wait is the main problem for this store. I was informed about 15 minutes to 20 minutes wait. It end up the wait is 35 minutes. The size of the shrimp is tiny.   The taste is not nearly good. It is about same as frozen quality from supermarket. $16 total is in the high side for take out standard. A lot of improvement can be made for this store.

4.5 stars to my book. It is a good  smoke BBQ place. I would said their dry rub is similar to North Carolina BBQ. I am actually like that way. We were here at the Saturday afternoon and the place is kind of park due to street market is in session.    We have the three meat combo with two sides. We selected the brisket, blackened tilapia, and BBQ chicken. The brisket is tasty. I like the blackened seasoning on the fish. It was delicious   I would recommend the blackened tilapia. The chicken was amazing. The grilled technique is perfect.   Service can be a bit better. Overall I enjoyed my visit.

The restaurant last to this date has it own reason - good wok technique on noodle. This very much summarized the best of the restaurant. I have a takeout here and the order was done correctly. Currently the restaurant has social distancing for the customers who dine in there.   We order a garlic squid lunch special and the basil noodle with pork. It come with correct spiciness of the heat level. I have it Thai hot. The squid has good garlic sauce. It also good numbers pieces of the squid. The best is the noodle. It is done in the high BTU wok. The edge of noodle is slightly burn and create a good wok application to the noodle. I like that way they have wok it. It is delicious.   The pickup was at the promise time. No wait is needed. Utensils was included in the package and we just need open and enjoy it.

70 years history, it is not easy. This tell the story of this restaurant. It is definitely one of the best in Bay Area. After 70 years. It is definitely will do certain dish very best to serve the Tampa Bay. This is 4.5 stars restaurant to my book.   If you come here for the seafood, I would recommend a dish. Scrod Jason. This is special dish that they do well. Celebrating 35 years dish. This is a whitefish, top with wine, cheese, garlic, and bread crumbs. The topping is so special, flavorful, crispy, enjoyable. Such a good topping.   If you come here, you will notice most of the customers are white hair. It does have a grab for this group of people with older age. The service is great and attentive. It speak louder when the food is right.

I like the name of the restaurant. Immediately you know what kind of the restaurant you get into it. Even thought I am not an vegetarian, but the food they brought out in the dinning hall is well decorated. It very eye pleasing. Each dish presented well for the look and arrangements. I did not get a meal here but I did get the smoothie.  I got the mango dream smoothie. The smoothie has healthy stuff like Basil Nut Mylk, Vanilla Stevia, and mango. I go for more fun drinks than actual energy drink. They do carry some energy drinks such as powerhouse and jungle gym.   The smoothie is great and filling. The store also sell some supplemental food as superfoods. The meal side includes some choices of veggies burger, wrap and more. Overall is very solid store.

I have been here many time but never really give them a review. It is the home of mighty Lighting ice hockey team. It has brought joy and championship to the city. The arena is well equipped with ice rink. Definitely one of great ice arena in US.   Many concert and events have been hold here. I have been here for the circus, breast cancer run, friendly basketball game and more. I also been here for arena football game. I have been seat on upper level, lower section, and box. Each time I am here I was enjoy it. Because there is no column to block the view.   The only thing I always complain is their drink will charge you arm and leg. Not how many thousand percent profit mark up. The entrance and exit is well marked. I like the garage that just across the main square. These garage may be the most reasonable price for downtown.

Shula has good quality burger due to selection of the premium meat. If you want to leave your name in the restaurant, you can accept the 48 oz 48 minutes challenge. It is huge. They do pack the left over if you cannot finish.   We got the Swiss Mushroom Burger. I like the Swiss cheese than American cheese. It more chewy. The mushroom are developed from fresh mushroom with thick slice. Great when cheese melt on top. The burger is nice with entire package. We got meal and fried come with it. We also got the chocolate shake. I believe on Tuesday, the shake is only a dollar addition from meal plans. It great to have it.   Service is great. Restaurant has TV that I can watch the games while I am eating.

Hugh Flea Market. They charge $1 parking fees on top of collecting rent from each vendor. Not sure this will work properly. But they do get a lot of foot traffic each day. The entire market may need 2 hour to finish. They have variety. There are restroom stop at certain location.   The section includes the non cover area and cover area. The cover area has the good court. Many of the vendors from food court run by Asian. It has Vietnamese pho to American Breakfast.   The vendor include Wendy Closet which I think a great place to buy cloth for roll play. We got two blinker magnet cloth pin in the market.   The outside vendor has the farmers market. We got a box of mango with eight mango for great price. I do like to walk undercover. This is great for a sunny day.

I don't know I come to wrong time or the clerk do not take the order seriously. The coffee we got on the 16 OZ cup with half coffee fill and the rest is whip cream. That tell you what is missing out. This is about 2.5 stars coffee joint.   This store basically is below of the apartment. Many USF students live here. The store front is visible from 42nd street. But there is no parking spot. Basically this is Neighborhood store only for the people who live there. The people who is there have their own drinks. This tell me something wrong for the customers mind set.   There many things wrong here. To correct it is difficult. Now with not attractive coffee quantity and expensive cup of joe. I would said very hard to compete at all.

The park locates at the downtown of New Port Richey prime area. It has a beautiful timber jungle gym. The project is to attract young family with kid to an aging small town with a lot of elderly. This condition is part of many small towns in Florida.   Sims park offers the control environment to prevent kid go out the perimeter and allow the parent has a little supervision while the kid is playing in the playground. The castle like timber structure in the park offers slide, bridge, tunnel, swing set and many areas to explore. The kid here can play hide and seek. Love it while the parent can enjoy the quiet reading with their favorite book. The park is hugging along the Pithlachascotee River that brings water view to relax your mind. The park is also has a amphitheater for activity of the city.   The park has a drinking fountain with the lion statue open the mouth with water fountain inside it. When take a sip to the water is almost put your whole head in the lion mouth. Cute. Please check out my friend Nick head swallow by the Lion.

I was here Thursday night. The place have good crowd considering it located in community plaza. The bar area is empty and since I am eating a lone, might as well have the bar and watch football game.   They have the free lime margarita with purchased a meal. So I go for the free margaritas. Unfortunately they don't have margaritas. Since when a Mexican restaurant doesn't serve margaritas. May be only the food truck.   I got the seafood fajitas. Seem like the picture in yelp show this dish very intriguing. It has scallops, shrimp, mussels, crab meat and fish. This is the first time I have fajitas with crab meat. Very interesting. I actually like this dish. I like the seafood over caramelized onion. The taste is good. I like the fried bean and rice come with it. Except the salsa is too little. Food is 4 Stars.   The service is average. Waiters are arguing who to help. It will be ok for the common good. Food come out quick enough. The chip on the pre-meal smell like fried in the old oil pot.

This restaurant is part of the Yelp top 100 list in Tampa Bay Area. We decided to try it out on the lunch time.  Base on many reviewer writing, this restaurant is cook to your order and need to be patient. On the weekday lunch we went, the food come out quick enough.   The restaurant is very close to center Ybor. We seat by ourselves since the waiter was in the kitchen and not in scene. We get our own menu and we study it before the waiter came. I have ordered the Farfalle Pana e Pisseli - the bow tie pasta with peas and dice ham. The pasta is cook with Alfredo sauce. The ham is fresh cut and dice. They are very good. I have added the grilled shrimp for additional $5.50. The shrimp size is jumbo size and they come in five counts. The shrimp is broil and grilled.   The dish do not give me wow factor but they are good Italian dish. The Alfredo sauce is great and creamy, I don't like it too watery and this restaurant did it correctly. With added shrimps, my dish is total $16. Average deal. The service is good and the waiter is very consider for boxing the food and wrap with plastic wrap. I will be back to try some other dish in the menu.

The sprouts market here is clean and well stock. Every serving station clerk are helpful. Such as seafood, cheese, cure meat, and meat stations are easy access. I like the cooked food on this station. Especially the freshly prepared tuna poke for pick up and no cooking needed. We also get some cook shrimp, sushi and meat. It save for my wife to cook which give a restful day.   May be you want to cook for love one and you don't know how to marinated, they have marinated meat and seafood that can be add to your meal. Fruit are sweet, the veggies section constantly have water mist spray on veggies to keep top quality. I also like coffee section. You can grind coffee as you need. As a result you don't need to commit bulk load coffee bean not not fresh after opening.   The wine section is a bit tiny. May be this need to improve. Check out is quick with clerk are station there.

Sekushi has happy hour Monday to Friday 3 to 6 pm. We are on round two on progressive happy hour restaurant tour. This restaurant located in the International Plaza Mall. The bottom of the restaurant is the cover garage with direct access to the restaurant. Very convenient.   We got three sushi roll. We have spicy tuna, yellowtail jalapeño, and salmon avocado. All three roll are excellent. I like spicy tuna the most. The tuna seem like chop not ground. Which give the texture into it. I also like the yellowtail since it is fresh and the meat are not tiny. I would said they use quality fish. We also got shrimp tempura. It is also well made.   Overall the service is good. Definitely come back to try more item in the future.

I am glad that we have a Italian market near me at Wesley Chapel. The market do bring a lot business. Especially during the pandemic, a lot people cook at home. The Italian market provides convenient with ready to cook food, ready to heat food, or cook food for your table. This market is not tru 5 stars. But I really want them to survive, I rounded to 5 stars.   The sandwich list is extensive. The have specialty's, cold or hot sandwiches. The sandwich is big. You are basically can buy the sandwich and eat at their outdoor patio. We got the bomb and Moschella special Italian sandwich. The moschella special is different cure meat and veggies. I like the way they assembled it. The bomb is very close to the philly cheese steak sandwich. It has pickles veggies.   The ready to heat food including slice pork lion, crab cake grilled chicken, Wagyu steak and more. We like the crab cake. The Wagyu steak also good and tender. We got Marsala chickenpox heat at home too.   Overall the market have a lot to offer. There are many other sections we did not explore yet. But we will be back.

The Tampa Bay has an explosion on the poke restaurant. This poke is kind of close to town and country area. I like that most of the restaurant spread out the Tampa Bay Area. I like the building has high ceilings but.   Here you can have their preset menu with ingredients and sauce arranged or build your own. I got my base as sushi rice. I also got all ingredients except onion and edamame. I also added an add on seaweed salad dressing addition scoop of protein. It turn the add on and tax is close $15. It is at high side for poke. A assembly food is a bit high.   I would they are in the middle of the pack for poke. Reason below. Many place offer multi scoop proteins. Many of the added on is part of the deal with no additional cost. Some other place even mix the sauce, protein and ingredients before putting in the bowl. This extra step will help instead of putting the sauce drizzle on the top.

It is 3.5 stars restaurant. I am here to get the drink after exercise. I like boba so I check the are who has boba. This store is famous on poke. Not sure boba also good or not. I give them a try. I got the coffee slush. The slush is kind of watery. The boba is not the chewy type boba more like the jello. Also the boba has not flavor. One good thing is they have good coffee mixed in it.   For boba they are average. But I saw customers in front of me got the poke which has good mixed up. It look delicious. May be poke is the only thing to go here

My friend like Green Lemon for Tuesday Taco. I can see this is a hip place due to the atmosphere of the place. Many young people love this because affordable food with booze.   There are few things that the restaurant is just an average. Number one is wait for table. Number two is wait for the food. Number three is very tire server. Number four is in experience hostess. All this actually give them 2.5 stars. Wait for table is 45 minutes, wait for the food after order is 25 minutes, waitress is beat up and tired. Not sure how many table they have to take care. Hostess tell you 30 to 45 minutes wait is definitely 45 minutes. They need to clean up the table sooner and allow to clear the queue wait line. Since you have to wait for the food, it make wait line longer.   One thing they can improve dramatically is make sure each order come out quickly which will reduce the wait. It definitely effects the tip because of the wait and cause the waitress look tired and not happy. Kitchen crew definitely need to come out the food more efficient. Mexican food should be easy assembly and able to deliver quickly.

French restaurant before the beach at Fort Desoto. If you come at Sunday Brunch, please make reservations, they are fully booked most of the time. I have been here twice. I think I can give them a fair review. Their restaurant is at exclusive area and need toll if you from I-275.   My friend and me visited them during job assignment near the beach. We got daily special Hachis Parmentier. This is a special dish in French cook with ground beef and potato. Parmentier is French know as potatoes man. He promoted the potatoes in the local. This dish also very similar to shepherd pie in England.   The second dish La Vosgienne. This is a French crepe wrap with Prosciutto ham and top with sunny side up egg. It is brunch item. It quite good. I like it to be savory. I like this dish the most. The last dish is the Sandwich Parisen. This just a assembly item. No creativity. That is why they 4 stars. The bread is tough to bite.

Good gas station. Wawa did a good jog on the food and drink. This good gas station in this area and the price of the gas is very competitive. The wawa pump station is well designed with a lot of room for the vehicle to be move or flow. We got the gas here and enjoy a drink or two.   Sometime they have the Italian wedding soup is the best. You may want to look for the coupon which will lower the food price. Hoggie is most popular food around here.

The clerk reception is friendly and patience. They explained each sandwich to meat for the different of normal and double roast beef. Single is 3 oz and the double is 6 oz. clerk is knowledgeable about their products.   We got their special two sandwiches for six dollars deal. We have a roast beef and a spicy Greek gyro. The roast beef is thin slice like I use to like on Arby's. The lamb gyro is nice and well prepared. We also got their root beer float with special deal. They have a limited time offer for orange cream shake. I think this is their best product. I hope they can keep it on the menu.   Our experience was great. Restaurant is about 3.5 stars.

This restaurant don't even need to show the name at the restaurant location. The only sign on the front of the restaurant is PUB. You cannot imagine that was enough to attract a lot customers. The secret is the food was awesome and creative. Usually pub has less women customers. But this pub mostly women. That tell the food here is the main reason.   If you come here I recommend you to look at the chalk board outside before you enter. These are the chef special. They change so often. These items are the best. We have the three pig piggy. It is sandwich either three different way of pork. Grilled pork belly, fried pork, and ham. It was delicious. The fried coated pork is crispy. The side of potatoes tots also crispy.   Our second dish is the duck flatbread. It is another creative item. Who thought the grilled duck breast over the flatbread with mozzarella cheese and arugula. I like this dish. Only these season. It may not be next time.   It was great to open my 2400 series review with these pub that many people love. My wife usually don't like pub and this is an exception.

Today soft opening with everything 50% off. The drink is ready to serve. But not all the drink. The dessert also not ready yet. They still in job training for speed and operation. The store clerk fluent in English and Chinese language.   So far so good with drinks. We got the super fruit tea and the mango mango Pomelo slush. The have slush if you ask. The two items we have is the most complicated. Need time to prepare. I would said they about 4.5 star. We have Moge tea in Orlando Dr. Philip before. We don't like that location tea. But the Moge here did a good job. Even this is soft opening, the flavor, presentation and balanced of taste is there. That is the reason they have high praise.   My next visit may be tonight while run special. I would go with Creme brûlée milk tea. The mango pamelo slush was well done with cheese in the middle. It make easy to mixed. Love. I would recommend the mango pomelo.

This restaurant has high ratings. It is about 3.5 stars in my books. The reason they are in the rating is due to the wait time, run out of choices because of the food run out. These are the area they need to improve.   We got Swai Fish Dinner with green beans and cabbage. The fish was well fried. The coating was spice up with flavor. I like the fish with crispy coating. The side also good. The second dish we have is the rib tip with Candy yum and collard green. The candy yum is great. The rib tip is was well cook. Food is good. It has good flavor.

Very interesting healthy fast food join. They do carry vegan food. However I like some non vegan sections which is more interesting. I think the bowl here has good base for the selection. This includes many choices like cilantro noodle, Asian sweet potatoes noodle (recommended), forbidden black rice, Tuscan zucchini and more.   We got two bowl. Our protein is spicy Thai shrimp and mojo pull pork. The shrimp is up charge with 8 shrimps provided. I also creamy garlic sauce and eel sauce. The topping also good. Our selection is good combo, it is not watery. Good mixture.   Seem like assembling line is well train and in the fast track. Food has good taste. Love it.

For the food truck. Their food is is a bit expensive in compare to actual restaurants with seating in air conditioning dining room. Food is good quantity is enough. Wait time to pickup the food is bearable.   We got the adobo pork with lumpia. They do give enough adobo pork. Pork has good flavor and less sour in compare to many adobo restaurants. I actually like it that way. The lumpia was crispy fried. It was delicious. We also got one of the dessert that we never have it before. We have the Filipino cannoli with ube filling. The purple ube filing is unique. Definitely is a must try.   Overall our food is great. Love the food truck. Very close to 4 stars but not yet.

Moreno is the "sweet" haven for people of Brandon. An idea place for small snack on the sweet, big bite on lunch sandwich, or the hot deli dinner. Can you find it all in the bakery store. It is Moreno.   We were here one time after 7 and they close. We only can wave our hand to the worker inside the store. Finally we are able to experience firsthand in the store about their food and sweet by come a bit early before 7pm. The display is look like the tour of around the sweet from cookies to cake. The selection is a lot for single store. Very impressive.  The bakery also has Spanish hot deli for dine in or take out. They have Ox tail, mojo pork, bake chicken, lamb and more. It is an affordable for lunch box to go. They also can make the sandwich to your order. The best seller is the Cuban sandwich.   Moreno serves the community well. However they close at 7 pm. Please go early.

This an average Roll ice cream store. I have better on other places. With that said. I have to give them credit on the only one in New Tampa right now which we don't need to drive too far to have one.   This is only base in the roll ice cream. They have many item such crepe choco Coro new item and Acai. This items was not reviewed. Base on their roll ice cream, the selection is good. But the toppings is little. The charge is high.   We have the on snow in the assembly menu. The toppings are chocolate roll cookies and top with coconut flakes. The ice cream is creamy than other roll ice cream. Which is a good thing. I only don't like the pricing and so little toppings. Overall experience is good. I would give them at average among the same business. However, I do want to try their crepe. It look interesting.

I have been eating their food very often. However, I have never review them. Our company lunch meeting often order from this place. Some time is good and some time is off. This is about 3.5 star restaurant in my book.   Today I have the calamari and Tazza Istanbul Shrimp. I have order the appetizer of the calamari is for me to chew while keep me awake during the lunch seminar. It is working. Although it is not the best fried calamari, but it didn't cost that much either. The Tazza Istanbul Shrimp have a good Turkish sauce to go with it. It accompanied well within the rice. The shrimp size is about 36 count per pound. It is not the big size. Food is ok.   They offer very complete menu and many choices. Start with appetizer, salad, soup, sandwich, wrap, seafood, platter, burger, and their specialty.

This Thai place is local favorite. A lot of take out. Not many dine in customer. The wait for take out is 20 minutes. We also got the take out. This restaurant is located on last corner building plaza.   We got the Cashew Nut chicken. The sauce and ingredients is there. Good wok technique. We also got the Penang curry pork. Sauce is good. Ok curry. The only thing I would said is the quantity is small compared to many Thai restaurants. I would not suggest this restaurant if you really hungry.    Overall is the food is ok. Just average restaurant among the Thai restaurants I have visited.

They move to this new location and got visual ability from Armenia Avenue. It is bigger place with seat down in the dining or outdoor with the food truck.  The rotisserie is budget meal in compare to local rotisserie for whole chicken. It is good deal. The marinated and grilled technique complimented the the exterior grilled skin. It is great to have. The meat is juicy after grilled. I like the herb use on the skin. Chicken is good size to share. Other than the chicken, they also carry a lot of types of shake.   Overall it is good. Service is good. Food is good.

My Malaysian friend has told me about this restaurant about the Malaysian food is modify to American version. I have to confirm how close they are on their cuisine. It take me one year to reach this place since I have book mark it.   I have opportunity to travel to this area for my vehicle maintenance and decided to try them out. We have the beef rendang, chicken stay, and fried Koay Teow. The rendang gulai need a bit sauce. It need to be a bit wet conditions sauce. The yellow ginger is good but need to be a bit heavy spice. The stay is not close. It not close the Malay satay or Penang satay. The satay need a bit sweet.
