The Koay Teow is the best dish but compare to the street vendor in Malaysia, the is a lot room to improve. I agree with my friend their Malaysian food is American in style. It is made to the local favorite but not Malaysian liking. This is a been there done that deal for me.

Authentic Ethnic Food No. 48 Thai Cuisine.  Thai Mama is an excellent food truck who serve very good Thai street food. I like they move their food truck to the new location and look cleaner. It is better access rather middle of no way from previous location.   The food is ver good and very street vendor like food. We got the steam pork dumplings, as an appetizer which is good. The dish I like the most is the drunken noodles. This dish you actually need them to make it spicy level they like to eat. Because the call drunken in spicy chili. The other dish I like is Pad See Ew. This dish they cook dark soy sauce. But I like they way they prepared the veggies in the noodle.   We have ventured to try their Panang Curry. It is coconut milk curry and it is very good. The other dish we try is their special glass noodle with pork. I am said this is average dish.   Since this is food truck, you can call earlier for your order. They are out door dining so wear proper cloth for the weather that day.

This is one of the kind breakfast place. We like the restaurant because is local flavor. The outside seating is good but if someone smokes, may be inside is better. The host is very friendly. We were able to tell we don't like the seat beginning.   Make sure you ask for the daily special. It is always interesting. We have the country fried steak and chocolate pecan French toast. These are the special of the day. The country fried steak top with meat gravy. It also come with hash browns and two eggs. It also has mable toast. The French toast topping is very special with chocolate pecan overlay. Good sweet breakfast to begin the day.   Service is good. I believe they are very good on their food for breakfast and lunch. Coffee is great.

I have been here so many time. But My currently experience indicated their food does improve a bit. The side dish items is getting better. At least is better and desirable to eat. I like their bacon Mac and cheese and grilled zucchini. Currently they have improved in the side but still need to work on the main entrée.   Today we have the Ruby Tuesday buy one get one free. It is good deal. I got the bourbon pork chop. This chop come in one inches thick. The chop is good on preparing the meat and cook through. The bourbon sauce is average. However I don't mind it since pay half of the price. I wonder the customers pay full price without offer certificates. Are they happy about it.   The hostess was courteous. We were seat immediately without any wait. The waiter also good in spirit and make this place alive.

This restaurant do have the vibe to serve the Italian food. Their menu is constantly evolving on the availability of ingredients. This is very interesting Italian restaurant. I would suggest early dinning or reservation. Reservation is strongly suggested. Please call ahead before come here.   The food serve of the day is written on the kitchen door in Italian. It give a chance for the waitress to explain to you what the dish make off. We start with insalata di Trota. This is Smoke Trout salad with orange dressing. This dish is delicious. Our entrée are Ossobuco Di Maiala and Seafood Pasta. The seafood pasta is just so so. It does has squid, little neck clam, shrimp, and fillet snapper. Big portion. The ossobuco is Beef shoulder braise in good sauce. It come with home made pasta.   This restaurant total has 7 table of three. Maximum capacity of 21. AC need to be a bit stronger since kitchen and dinning hall are connected. I like the ideal allowing customers to bring their own alcohol or wine. It make dinning pleasant.

The Saturday organic market is slow stroke relaxing location. Meeting the farmer, pickup a few organic items, listen to the live music, enjoy the vege product.   I like their vege burger that cook with extreme spice mixing. You will not know this is a vege burger by the time you have finish. I have the rasta burger with avocado. We enjoy our burger and the live music from the local artists.   It is country, gypsies, farmer mixed. A little corner of the metropolitan that set a side for down to earth place.

It is about 3.5 stars. Not 4 stars yet. Restaurant is popular during weekends. We did call ahead for reservations. Parking to the garage is free first 2 hours. Not required validation to the parking ticket.   We started with octopus salad. This salad has fried cauliflower, gigante beans, olives. It top with ricotta salata cheese and Calabrian hot sauce on the side. I like the octopus and I love the fried cauliflower. My wife entree is Naduja Meatballs pasta. It serve with tomato sauce and spaghetti. I think this dish is not impressive for the price that they label. It can be different on sauce or something. My entree is good. I have the the duck confit with pici pasta. This have good creamy sauce.  Our experience is good. Service is attentive. Food come in right time. Value vs price may need measures up on entree. Appetizers is good.

Fish Bol is new and trendy in the Pinellas Park. I agree with Em reviews lately. Her review make my visit to the restaurant. A Japanese restaurant has sushi and Ramen. There one appetizer I will try next time. Escolar Tataki. I will try it on my next visit.   This time we started at crabby steak roll. This roll is the most expensive in the menu. Better be good. The result did not disappoint us. It is seared steak on top of the roll with truffle salad. The inside is actual snow crab meat. Yummy.   We have the ramen bowl. It has crispy pork belly, porch egg, shiitake mushroom. The only I like to said is they do give a lot of ramen noodles compared the ramen I have eat. I would said keep it up. It is a selling point.   We have the tonkatsu chicken. It is fried chicken with sweet sauce. It come with sunny side up egg, sunomono cucumber, kimchi. Good dish to be.   Our service is excellent. The waitress is knowledgeable.

Review # 2800. Rare Authentic Dessert - 68. This one go to local dessert store service Middle East food.   We were attracted by their Turkish Delight. We first know about this dessert from Narnia movie The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe when they tasted this dessert. The Turkish delight is amazing. Not too sweet but have good chewy and flavorful with or without nut. Not only the dessert is imported, they delicious and fresh.   We have several dessert. They cost is by weight. We got 1.25 pounds of dessert. It includes the hazel nut and cream, chocolate expresso, banana, and more. I love those strength looking dessert. All of them is delicious. The also has the dessert cookie with pistachio that I experienced in Jordan. They also carry different types of nuts. The chocolate selection also good from Europe.

Newly open restaurant on the Groove. They have lunch specials now from Monday to Saturday. Seldom you will see Saturday lunch special. Enjoy it while they still last. The lunch special is included soup and salad. I like the onion flakes soup. The ginger salad has a lot yellow sauce.   Our lunch dish is the shrimp tempura. We got 4 shrimps tempura, yum, zucchini, onion tempura. The tempura is ok. But I like the shrimp extension to to tip of tempura. We also got three roll combo lunch. It is spicy tuna, spicy mango shrimp, and eel avocado. I like all of them. The mango shrimp is interesting. Because is half cooked shrimp with mango.   The food come out fast because we are the last table at late lunch. No one ahead of us. I also like the technique of sushi roll with little rice outwardly with very thin layer.

It is a bout 3.5 stars. Definitely a credit for quantity of food and quality of food. The food may just need to tone down the salt level on meat seasoning. Especially the carne Asada.   We got the carne Asada for the entree. Mexican is a bit different than Columbian. Their meat a bit thicker. The seasoning is on the salty side. The pre fried bean is good and soft. But I like their rice better. My wife have the Enchiladas de pollo. I like the chili sauce. Deep dark red chili sauce is the best. I will recommend this dish.   The restaurant is nice inside and outside seating. It is great place for snack especially Tuesday taco. Buy three get one free. I saw many customers is USF student. It is good place to hang out. I like their salsa to begin with chips.

Very close to 4.5 stars rating. I have call ahead for take out since I am near the location for my project. So I plan to pick up some food here to take home. They tell me need 25 minutes. So I show up 6 minutes early and the food is already ready. During the pandemic, they have their restaurant as 50% sit in capacity.   I got my food home at 57 minutes. It is still taste very good. We got the salt and pepper seafood combo. They have great salt garlic taste. The second dish is the Singapore rice noodle. I like the high BTU wok technique on this dish. The third dish is the spicy fish fillet with eggplant. The sweet minor spicy sauce is well done. I like this dish. The last dish is walnut shrimp. The shrimp was fried and cook in sweet white sticky sauce. This East meet West technique is great.   Overall we enjoy it very much. Definitely recommend this restaurant.

The dessert look Paris item but not for the Banh Mi. The restaurant look nice and bright lay out. Social distancing is observed. One thing I like most is their pate chaud. This item look like Cuban pastry but with oriental seasoning meat in fill. It is delicious. The pastry crust also very good. I recommend this dish.   The drink is good because they give close 20 drink. Price wise is about $.50 cheaper than most. I got the coconut slush with grass jelly. The grass jelly was did a good job. Soft and jelly.   The banh mi is below average. The bun was to tough to bite. I think it need to be toasted for easy bite. Seem like the bun was sit there some time. We got the special combination banh mi and grilled pork banh mi. One compliment can give is the grey paste did a good job. The meat for special and grilled pork are just average.

Rock is a dive bar and they are cool. The bar doesn't serve food. They only have drink. But they do allow food to bring in if you like.   All the tables are very small. Most of the table can sit to max of 5. If you have a group of 10, some of your party needs to be stand. This is a full bar with mini mix drink menu.   Today we have the Taste of Asia allow us to bring freshly prepared food to the bar from food truck. We have order drinks and the bar tender or bouncer pickup the empty bottles or glass.   They also have the live music at open patio. No drink passes the check point to the food truck area. You have to drink in the bar or patio. The event make the bar crowed and brink a lot business for bar.   We enjoy our time here due to many of us know each other from yelp. Our party cannot be better with this group.

We like to thank a yelp friend give us a groupon to try this place. I have been book mark this place since their opening. I am excited and looking forward to try the new restaurant.   Positive note: the service is great at this place. Since they just opening, all furniture and deco is rather new. It is interesting to see new restaurant is on their feet. The order is easy to spot on for the selection. Food came with good quantity in some.   The food: we have order the three different front of the menu. The bento box for the cooking skills; the sushi for the technique; and the ramen to compare to the rest of ramen place.   The bento box is average. The salmon can be seasoning and pan seared and burn a bit to get the crispy of the fish meat. The goyaza is tasty. The sushi roll is just the average with no wow factor. The sushi rice can be better prepared with better taste. The fish is low quality or cut in bad technique. Cannot tell too much but not impressed by it. One positive is the ramen. The miso soup base is flavored. They are the restaurant gave the most charshu pork in the Bay Area. The noodle of the ramen is a bit too soft, this can be easily improved.   I would said I have been here and check off. Good for people in short duration of the lunch time.

This is the store to buy something that is easy install by yourself. Such as wind shield wiper, car light bulb, battery, seat cover, bug cover. I will not say for the same such as break pad, electrical system, and engine part.   I am here for the light bulb and battery before. The car head light bulb is easy to change out unless it has a defect on the assembly. Changing the car light bulb can be found in the owner menu. I also have been here for the car battery replacement. They also offer the installation of the battery with part purchase from them. It is very convenience for me just to use their service with proper installation.   Car repair can be easy confused if you try to repair yourself. I would not recommend you to buy part from them and install yourself or install by other. Once the part cannot fit and is open box, it will create problem for return it. If you buy and let someone install, most car shop will not allow it because of the warranty issue by the repair shop.   I have no bad experience with them. The service is a bit slow.

I have been to the Cheesecake a few time. Now officially give them a review. Sometimes I come here for dinner and sometimes is just the cheesecake. It easy to access since they are not too far from the parking lot.   The visit from the past is distance memory. But I will say about our current visit is easy just for the cheesecake. There were so many cheesecake to choose from. I was debating to have the tiramisu cheesecake, Chris outrageous cheesecake, mango key lime cheesecake. I went for the tiramisu. It was really good. Because the cheesecake are extremely fresh, I refuse to have them in the 4 degree overnight. I eat it all and left nothing.   Service is quick to order. They have added a flower whips Creme on the side. The box is special made for that condition.

The wait for the shuttle getting longer since I have use them for past 8 years. One thing that they have been doing is taking the nearby hotel passenger from airport and prolong the the drop off time to the parking lot since they have drop them off first. I am disappointed with their current business model.  I have make a comment to their employee. And they not willing to admit the customer is right for the delay pick up and drop off. They are getting the shouting match with you. Their attitude from my last parking has turn me away. I am recommending other parking area.  If the pickup include the nearby hotel guest fill up the van, you have to wait for second van. Longer the wait time where they did not tell you.

Company christmas party today and take place at StarShip Dinner Cruise. Today cruise include the holiday boat parade at David island. We have 32 people on board this ship and occupied 4 tables. The boarding is 4:30 pm and the boat light parade is at 7 pm. The boarding went perfect.   Since this is company party, the drink is on the company. Our table order the a bottle of Kenwood Pinot noir from Russian River of Sonoma county. The server went on the whole ship inventory search and cannot find the wine on the menu.   This dinner cruise actually has a buffet style food. Today buffet menu include roast beef, Roast Boneless Chicken Breast Stuffed with Spinach & Sun Dried Tomatoes, finished with a Pesto Cream Sauce, Fillet of Salmon with a Dill Cream Sauce, Bowtie Pasta with Mushrooms. The food is good and tasty.   After the first plate, the wine have not arrive yet. We asking the server again. 15 minutes later they bring a Pinot noir with mascot. This is actually a dresser wine. At that time we are go with it. The server need to be trained how the wine work and pairing to the food. You don't pair desert wine with the food. As a result we treat it as a desert wine.   The dinner is completed and I look for the desert table. All desert is gone and it take them another 15 minute to bring the new one. As a result I ask the server go to the kitchen to bring the one I like.   The highlight of the night is after the dinner there is an upper deck dance floor and viewing area for the holiday boat parade.   Overall I am not satisfy with the service. They could come to me quickly and tell me they run out of wine in the beginning. With the desert run out of choice and the wine situation I am giving 2.5 star. Since the yelp do not have half star, I give them 3 star due to the DJ on the deck and smooth sail.

This is the first Chinese supermarket I have visited when I was in Tampa for a visit at 1988. At then, we call this area chinatown of Tampa. But is never took off to become the Chinatown. Din ho hold a good history to serve the Chinese community then and now.   This grocery store has Chinese BBQ. When I was in Gainesville, I am very often come here for their roast duck. The have many fruit items including the frozen durian and durian ice cream. Other ingredients include the lemon grass can be found here for Southeast Asia cuisine.   Seafood, special pork cut, pig kidney can be found here. There was many brand of Chinese can good such as lychee, Logan, braise meat are on display. My favorite are the snack aisle. I usually get the shrimp chop or fried.   This store is old. I would one thing is to to remodel to attract more customers. Many people who buy here are old customers.

Blind goat have the offer many local start beer. Why call the name blind goat. Is it a one eye jack of completely blind. It just the goat have sun glasses. Sound like too much drinking. But it is all good fun.   This is a cute place. They do have the happy hour from 4 to 7 pm. The price start at $3 to $5 for the happy hour. They also have food also. I would said  small place with big package. They also serve food along the way of drink. They do have some signature cocktails that is good. I have not order the food yet. I will try it one day.   They not just serve food and drink. They also have little game such as shuffle board and darts. They open very late at weekend. Weekday close at midnight. Other than beer and cocktails, they are very limited on wine.

This church is lively and the sanctuary has good acoustic sound. We were here for the Duke University Chorale performance and they are have it at the right place. Thank to church hosting and provide sleeping housing assignment to the students.   The campus is large. It has multiple buildings. Parking is plenty since they have multiple lot. The campus occupied entire block. The building architecture design is pleasant. The people who serve there is friendly. Good church to be in Hyde park.

Food is 5 stars. No doubt.   The restaurant just have the soft open. I would said give them a few week to familiar with the serving routine. It is still a chaos now. Beautiful interior design as a desirable to sit down and enjoy. Service is still need to improve.   You know if a restaurant will make it or not by just tasting the food. This is the restaurant I will repeat in the future. Food is very reasonable price and easy to select - may be not - it has huge selection. I love it. It make me to come back for more. They have good food presentation. Nicely decorated. Fast food chain of America, watch out, I can eat better food here.   We start with our entrees with Thinh An Special Noodle Soup and the Hue Style Beef Noodle Soup. I like the Thinh An Noodle. It has the clear noodle soup with seafood in it. Very good soup. My wife have spicy hue style beef noodle. Good but I like the special better. Then we move to the grille pork summer roll -  the appetizer. It is good.   Our desert is what I search for some time. Hong Kong Waffle. They call it egg puff waffle. The waffle is puffy and crispy. Right baking. It come with two scoop of ice cream and two topping. I have the mango and coconut ice cream with assorted mochi and the blue berry mochi. Delicious.   Advice for the new comer. Come early at dinner before they are busy, get all the order in earlier. For the owner, I think open late and closing late is better. Breakfast usually don't get much sale. Usually people get one item and leave. Dinner people tendency to order more and get more sale. I will update on next visit.

This is very interesting restaurant I have try today. The outside of the restaurant look like a fast food building. The glass is all tinted that you are not able to look inside. You may think the restaurant is run down and close down. The lighted open sign behind the heavy tinted windows is very hard to spot. With one door lock, you will think that the business is close down by the outward looking and lack of car parking outside. Since you cannot see inside due to tint window you may thought the restaurant is close. If they lock the door please call them to check and have them open the door. I usually don't write that much about the outward look of the restaurant. This is just to let you know don't walk away from good food inside.   The amazing dish of this restaurant is the Biryani plate. It is combination Indian food with a lot of items. From curry, rice, sweet to Nan. You will get a full variety of food in beautiful spice cooking. I have this dish in one of the Indian restaurant in Miami before. This is a better option from any Indian restaurant with all-you-eat. This restaurant actually prepared the food well with correct balance of spice.   Today we have open our lunch with an appetizer-dried pepper chicken. This dish is prepared with different dried pepper. The chicken is deep fry and cook with saffron spice. The dry pepper is added per customer liking for the spiciness. I like it to be spicy because the spicy is not just for the hot and spicy but for the enhancement as a seasoning. This is a very great dish and I am recommended this dish and spicy up the dish and drink a lot of water. One way to neutralize the spiciness is to eat it with rice. You can add the rice for $2 extra.   Our entree is the mix platters. It has three different grilled chicken made in tandoori. Thus dish required time to wait since this is the dish needs time to make it there. You will require additional 20 minutes wait. The combination chickens are traditional tandoori chicken, Hariyari kebab, and Malai kebab. The tandoori is the slow cook yogurts and Indian spice. The Hariyari is grilled with marinated mint, garlic, and green chillies. The Malai is grilled with marinated cardamom, cream and mild Indian spice. The cardamom is India green seed spice. Now, are you hungry???? Come to try it yourself.   The kebab dish is just the kebab with no carb accompanying like Nan or Rice. If they can balance the meal to include rice or nan and vege, this will be a better attractive dish. As a result, we have to add the carb on the side.  A recommendation for the restaurant is to remove the tinted window and allow customers to see inside the restaurant. Paint the outside to make it attractive. Provide carb or vege balance meal on kebab dish.

Yes!!! Yelper who are not here is missing out. Definitely agree with 5 star rating. This is a very cute restaurant and has a lot to offer. The set up is contemporary with main color in lemon green. The facility is small but full function. During the lunch time, the tables will be occupied early. So come a bit early.   I am only there once. I have already fall in love to this restaurant. I not sure they have same menu each day. They do have special every day. They have been opened since December. It is actually one of my clients told me about this restaurant since he knows I am yelping. I saw Mel and Mark review there. I decide to give them a try.   All right, let's talk about food. This is a Dominican Republic cuisine with a lot of twist. It looks like cafeteria style for you to pick the food. Their specialty is the Mongu. What actually Mongu. It smash plantain and made it like mash potato. But it is plantain base. You will not see it in the food tray as the display. You need to request them to get it from the kitchen.   I did not go with the traditional two items special. I just pick a bit each from the tray. Today special is crab meat top on the salmon. The salmon is marinated and oven bakes. It creates the crispy crab meat when the crumb is cook. This is good. The oxtail is braised with sweet sauce. The oxtail meat can be pickup by the folk. The marinated sauce went into the bone. I was sucking to the bone pick up the last bit. It is that good. The third item is the paella with seafood -- clam, mussel, shrimp, and more. Good paella. A lot of food in one plate.   The bath room is clean and well up keep, the people are friendly, the food is GREAT, the price is affordable. They deserve to be pad at the back. As the student of the class has said- easy A. This will begin my 300 review.

On the way to the lunch in Valrico, we saw a Latin supermarket sign that was mention by my friend long time ago. It is a hidden gem in Valrico. The supermarket located just off the SR 60.   Many of the service people may not able to communicate in English (Espanol only). By the way, I have stay in Miami for 11 years as little Spanish I know I can survive. This small matter doesn't affect me. The best language is body language. We were able to ask them to pick the food by pound in different container. I believe you also can do it too. My universal language is finger. Pointing and number  count to ten is the most I can do - haha.   The supermarket has the hot deli section to buy food by pound, sandwich assembly, salad, marinated seafood, fried whole fish, dessert and more. They also have regular grocery sections with seafood, meat, veggie and fruit. The different cut of meat can be found here. By the way, when you check in here, the  yelp complimentary 10% discount coupon with check in, they will not honor.   The supermarket also has cell phone sales, hair cut and fast food box service. This is rather interesting place like I am actual back to the Miami.

The Ambulatory Surgery Center is an out patients surgery or checkup clinic. I was there a year ago to have my medical checkup. This location is just across from USF golf course.   I saw a lot of one day procedure patients either for their checkup or minor surgery. This is rather less expensive than the hospital for small procedure without admit to hospital. The Center equip with surgery room for eye sight correction, colonoscopy, and more. They have anesthetist on site and they will knock you out unconsciously while they perform the surgery or video scoping. You feel like a sweet dream after you are out. After you are awake, the procedure is done.   You probably will be not in control for a moment before the drug of anesthesia is passed. The doctor may advice you not to drive for a day while you recovered.   The center is clean. The nurses are more experienced on the job. It is an expensive 3 hours nap during the small procedure.

We were stop here before the the Yelp CMYE. Since the CYME will only have snack and we decided to eat here. There is a lot customer in and out here I hope it will be good. Unfortunately, there is no fireworks for this pho place.   I order the Pho Viet Northern Combination. The server brought out the soup but he insists the soup is not our table while we should be the next group to get the noodle soup. He could not find the order is belong to us and he set our soup noodle in the empty table. The manager then verified and brought the soup at our table. Very confusing. By this time our rare beef in the soup is cook through. The soup is in the sweet side. The shrimp is fresh and bouncy.   Because they are not located in the pho hub, they have no competition. They can survive the business because far away from the hub. It would not be able to survive if it is located at the Dale Mabry or Pinellas Pho hub. The soup is average. Not the top notch. I could have given them two star because they mixed up the order.

Under new management or owner change. The price do not deflect on the menu. You will need to ask for the actual price. Food getting spicier of the way I like. Goat Biryani is good except the goat meat is only 4 pieces.

Around this community, this is American style Chinese food. We have the house special crispy fish and Yu-Shang four treasures. The food is fresh, if you like the authentic Chinese food, this is not the restaurant. Food quantity is sufficient. The set up of the restaurant is modern compare to typical Chinese restaurant.   Price is acceptable. The food did not give me a wow factor. Service is above average.

This is my third time I am here. If you need a serious spaghetti dish, this is the place. They will give you large quantity of food to fill your stomach and take home. The entree comes with soup. Usually they have two kinds of soups a day for you to choose. If you signup the member list, they usually send a free meal coupon for your birthday.   I am usually here for one dish. It is not in the entree. It is in the appetizer. You probably guess why appetizer for main meal. Hungry people will not be hungry if you know what I have order. The appetizer is is the Sicilian Sampler. You can chose three of the selected items to form your appetizer plate. It include Toasted Ravioli, Mozzarella Fritta, Fried Zucchini, Calamari, Stuffed Mushrooms or Classic Bruschetta. You can see there are plenty to choose tailor to what you want. This is good dish and affordable.   My wife has the spaghetti meatballs with complimentary soup. Her dish is classic. Don't get the red tomatoes sauce spill to you dress. Difficult to get off for washing.   Overall they are good. Service is great.

Rare Ethnic Food #29  The Chakana has good Peruvian food that very similar to what I have when we visited Peru. The restaurant logo symbol as Inca Cross that show deep connection to Peru ancient secret. The golden ear or Peruvian corns are the secret.   When we arrived, we saw a unique building at the corner. The interior is all white with BB King special portraits. Furniture is interesting. It give your an dinning experience in heaven with all white. I just wonder if you also wear white outfits and you will be at the lost world :).   During the lunch we have the Ceviche and the grilled chicken. Their lunch special is reasonable. The grilled chicken come with Peruvian green sauce spaghetti with fried potatoes at bottom. The spaghetti is just like we have in Peru. Chicken is well grilled with good marinate. The Ceviche is fresh and good lime. Peruvian like to make Ceviche at the order. Never overnight.   Service is good since not many during lunch time.

Tampa Museum of Art has variety of art display from time to time. The current museum is built no long ago in 2010 at new location next to the Hillsborough River. This museum is build like electronic music jewel box with music selection panel like the concrete stool at Curtis Hixon Park. It lighted at night like someone select a piece of music and plays it.   This museum has some of its own collection and student display. They have display of feature artist from time to time. Today we have a chance to enjoy a famous American Artist Norman Rockwell. Mr. Rockwell 1894 - 1978 is a famous illustration artist. He calls himself reporter in present event but the media call him "people's painter". He paints the cartoon for the post but he is famous pairing people. One of the famous portraits is John F Kennedy. It represents famous face of America.   Many American collect his art which call the American Chronicle of Norman Rockwell. This is one of the true artists in America that worth for collection.  Time to to they host event with special performance from live band, dance, or art form monologue. This special occasion is fun to attend.

This my family goes to restaurant and we are frequently here. The food is consistence through out my visits. Other than pho, rice and vermicelli dishes, the have the chef specialty dinner dish. I like the fried frog leg with salt and pepper, cube filet mignon, stuff squid.   Today we have order the combination pho, fried frog leg with salt and pepper and a rainbow drink. The food came out very quick and the service is good. This restaurant always fills with people no matter what time you go.   The pho soup is not the best in the Bay Area but it good enough. The Beef Combination Noodle Soup or pho is come with Sliced Beef, Flank, Brisket, Tendon, Tripe and Beef Meatball. It served with bean sprouts, basil leaves, lime, and hot peppers, topped scallions and onion. There is a lot items to find in the soup and try to get them out. This a good dish when you catching cold or just to eat.   The frog leg is deep fried and marinated in salt and pepper. It serves with a sweet sauce on the side. The leg is very crispy and the deep fried enhance the flavor.   We also order a pre-meal drink. The rainbow drink. This drink is very colorful and pleasing to the eyes. It has the Red bean, yellow bean and green jelly, topped with Coconut cream and crushed ice. You have to mix it before you drink or spoon feed.    I like this restaurant overall.  This is my kid favorite restaurant due to their fried rice. We will be back for many times.

The grilled is almost like the fast food restaurant but cook to your order. There is limited service in this restaurant. You will need to order at the counter and find a seat after your ordering and they will bring the food.   The restaurant is a typical sandwich cook to order. The selection starts at Philly cheese steak to hot pressed sandwich. They also have the Black Angus burgers for your selection. Lunch time is a line. I am not sure they take order over phone. The dinner and lunch have the same menu. We were here for the dinner. We have order the Cajun Chicken Cordon Bleu and the Uncle Muzzies   Mufaletta. The chicken is well season with Cajun spice and top with Capicola ham. The sandwich is yummy and the chicken is half breast. They are juicy since they seal the juice of the breast inside. The Muzzies Mufaletta is the similar name to the general store in the New Orleans that sells the Mufaletta. The different of the mufaletta here is there are hot pressed. The sandwich includes smoke ham, genoa salami and provolone cheese with green olive in Cuban bread. What a strange combination. The sandwich is not bad but they are not as good as the New Orleans.  Overall the restaurant is good. I did not try their burger since they are rated number 1 in New Tampa. May be next time I should try that.
Recent experience with the new management has gone down a notch. The price of the menu is not as the price you paid.

The BBQ joint located the Tampa Bypass Canal Park that with boat ramp. Many people who launch their boat there for fishing may stop by for lunch.   The outside is look little house in the prairie in the old TV series. The inside sitting has upper and lower section. Today I have order the combo. I have the pull pork and the rib. The rib is dry rub. It is tasty. The pull pork may need some seasoning. It comes with two sides and I have BBQ smoke corn and the fried okra. The okra is amazing. But the corn is ok.  I am not the fan for their BBQ sauce. Seem like they need some work on the sauce. It also comes with cornbread that is soft and moist.   The customer is most old good local boy. This is where they like to hang out for lunch. The price for my meal is $14 including tip and drink. Not bad for the price. It gives a lot of food and it is good when you are hungry. Good quality is fair. Like the dry rub BBQ.

Friday night happy hour at 5:30 is good. Easy to get a sit without reservation. However, one thing you need to know Friday night happy hour has a lot of people visit this place. Even they have eight sushi chef, it will take 30 minutes to deliver the food from order. So if you are in hurry, Friday happy hour may not be a good ideal.   The restaurant certainly a big step out from the old location. The open space concept and decorations is definitely a 5 stars rating. Out seating has small waterfall and fire place create many good atmosphere. They also has a private room for 20 people that is well decorated.   Food on happy hour may not speak the same language. Although they are good value but the taste is just not measured up. Only the gators roll and eel roll measure up. The rest of the roll taste the same. Good sushi grade fish. I would go for the nigiri or sashimi. I think they are still rushing on the roll preparation.

The Ramadan month is a fasting month according the observance of Quran. It usually last 30 or 29 days due to the visual sightings of the crescent moon. During this month, the Muslim eats only after sunset.   Greenland Restaurant during this month serves the special buffet after 8:30 pm. The restaurant will not start the buffet until sunset per the observance.  The buffet certainly is great since many of the believers have been fasting for the daytime. The restaurant will fill up quickly and please come 15 minutes early to get a seat. Tonight the buffet include two different hummus, lentil soup, tomato base soup with Arabian spice, Arabian salad, bidet, fruit salad, yellow rice, grill chicken, roasted whole lamb and more. Yum. Got to try it before is over.   The lamb is certainly my favor. The lamb meat is well prepared and you cannot smell the lamb smell. The season is will balance. I also like the tomato base soup of the night.

We have been to this restaurant many time but did not give them a review. Love this place since the food is very close to teowchiew cuisine. People from teowchiew eat flat noodle soup at street vender. They normally serve with ground pork meat chunk, fish ball, slice pork, scallion, vege and fermented salty vege.   Today we have order the combo grill. It come with grilled pork, grilled meat ball, shrimp in sugar cane, lettuce, half slice cucumber, bean sprout, fried onion, cilantro, fried garlic, pickle carrot, thin angle hair pasta, rice flour skin, and a bowl of hot water to soften the rice flour skin. The meat and vege then can be wrap in the rice flour skin like the roll. They accompany with fish sauce to dip or use the tomato base chili sauce. We also have the deep fried pork large intestine. This is delicacy dish that eat it as crispy with sweet sauce. They marinate the intestine before deep fried. The outward is crispy and the inward is soft. Yummy.   The main dish is the dried scallop fried rice.  We have try many place for dry scallop fried rice. This is not the best but it is tasty enough. You can taste the high heat wok oil and create the scallop enhance taste in the rice which make this elegant. Second dish is the prince mushroom- Agaricus augustus the real name. This dish is only seasonable. If you lucky at the right time they may have it. It is a yellow mushroom when you slice them. They can be cook with beef slice or shrimp. The mushroom slice look like abalone and feel like abalone but is a vege.   Overall service is great tonight. They have large group there to celebrate Chinese New Year. Fortunately we have our order in before them.

This is tiny park at the tip of City of Dunedin. At the end of the Main Street Dunedin, you will find this park easily. This park has not much to offer other than green space and water view. The Krewe of Pygmalion is a young Krewe establish at 2000. The name Pygmalion is derived from Greek mythology sculpture. The Krewe parade is started near the Audubon Park. There is King and Queen Float that give out special bead medallion. Their floats are beautiful to display to public. They elephant, purple swan, Jesuit, The Greek Statues, Butterfly, Baby catching the Bug, Mermaid, and The Secret Heart. All this floats has people throwing the beads to the spectator. The best offend is the best defend. Basically you have to raise your hand up to protect yourself from getting hit by the beads. You will not know where and when the beads arrive. As a result, raising your hand can block the beads hit your face and catch it at the mid air. The bead throwers are crazy. Our hotel has to put out the beads recycle bin for the excess amount of beads that you don't want to carry home. The Canal street center aisle is the great area to catch both side of the parade if you want shower of beads. I say again shower of beads. It is insane amount of beads if you are in that aisle. The long lost snow ice cream now serve at snowman. They currently running 50% off any snow ice (shave ice). Snowman now serve roll ice cream, shave ice, bubble waffles, hot dog ice cream. Greenland is a great Mediterranean restaurant around the USF area. There are many Middle East restaurant around the USF but I like this one the most. 1. Service faster, 2. Organic is the name of the game. They have organic food, veggies, fruit around the entire store. F you go to their web side, they have the daily special, recipes and events for the all people. This is a well build facility. When they open the new building, our badminton club is already playing here. They have two gyms and the badminton court was plan into it set up. Wing Stop has a good dry rub wings. I had ordered many of their wings in the past and did not find the love of it until the current visit. The Louisiana Dry Rub is the best that they have. Rare Ethnic Food No. 20  Haitian cuisine is unique in certain way. I am guessing they probably start with what they can find in the island. The store is at the east side of the N Florida Ave. you won't be able to miss it with Red Color Store front. The restaurant is just open and they are more into Korean food with New American twist. Two fold bike is great unique bicycle store. The owner of the store is very helpful and keen to show how the bike work. Good idea.

Very interesting restaurant in the Lutz area. This is considering very good restaurant around this area. The seafood is fresh, good quantities, and affordable price.   Tonight is the Thursday night and they have two special. Kid eats free and prime rib special. We arrived at 7 pm and the prime rib already sold out. We cannot beat retiree around that area that comes early. Just kidding.   We start our night with the steamer. Nick is the experts in this area. He shows us how to eat it. The steamer is steam to cook first. The outer black skin need to undress from the clam body. Then it is clean in the broth or beer. Then dip into to butter and enjoy by eating it. Some has added pepper and lemon after clean it. This is a very adventurous item in the menu.   I have the fried sea scallop and fried whole snapper. The snapper come with the batter coating outside. When come to whole fried fish, you want to make sure the meat inside is cook. This restaurant did it correctly. The only thing is the coating is tasteless. I prefer it to be season. However the fish is fresh and good. For fresh seafood, you do not require too much seasoning.   The fried scallop is very tasty because the coating was seasoning with flavor. When you break the scallop, the meat of the scallop is like a string which means the freshness of the food.   Overall the seafood is fresh, the portion is very generous, and the service is great.

Feel lucky with nice restaurant, may be can win big while eating. Circa 1925 restaurant located inside the Derby Lane on top of Poker Lounge. It has the theater seating outlook the dog track. I would said if you get sick and tired of Chinese buffet that serve you low grade buffet at dinner, this may be your best choice with good quality material selection. The reason they are 5 stars is due the quality of the buffet, the service to the table, the attentive  to the buffet table, and nice derby lane to look at. No. 400th review. This is a UYE worthy restaurant. You know it is a good restaurant when you take the first bite. Good restaurant for people who are really hungry. The restaurant is very generous in the amount of food provided. You will have enough meal to go on your empty stomach. It open up the dining hall with good set up. Although it said on the front is Vietnamese Cuisine, but it has Chinese dim sum dishes. We have a few to try in the list. The picture in the menu make it easy to select.   We order the stuff egg plant, Pork dumplings, fried taro cake, and beef tripe. All of them have good dim sum technique to prepared. We also order a black bean sauce baby Clams to try their stir fry skill. It is also very good. Overall they are solid dim sum restaurant. I like the food. Service is good also for the night. I recommend to try their dim sum.

The Royal Street and Bourbon Street are parallel to each other. It is one street south of the Famous Bourbon Street. The Bourbon Street is closed to traffic at night and the Royal Street is closed to vehicular traffic at daytime. Bourbon is a drinking and adult entertainment street. The Royal Street is the opposite.   The Royal Street has a lot of art Gallery. It includes the Lisa Victoria Art Gallery. This is a court yard gallery with various local artist display their master piece. The night that we have visited have 13 artists display their work. I like Kevin Thayer art. The eye of the women in the painting is attractive. He use the water spray technique that is unique that drip along the paint to create the look.   The Royal Street is not just the art gallery. The jewel of the street is the street music performance. You will encounter various musicians in different form. You account a pianist play the blue or jazz; Cajun boys in their outback clothing with washboard, spoon, banjos, bucket as drum and a singer well sang; New Orleans jazz band display their funky move while playing the music; someone just sing the old hymn. The best group that we have encounter is a pair up of the electrical violin and the classical acoustic guitar. Both of them accompany each other and have their own solo to showcase their best part.   I like the romantic night stroll at Royal Street compare the crazy party in Bourbon Street.

Rare Ethnic Food #40  Poke Rose is a fusion Hawaiian food located in the Hall on Franklin. I can think off some of my friends will like this because they are pescatarian diet. The selection is very simple. They have several choice of poke. The poke make off Ahi tuna, cobia, and salmon.   I would suggest you come at Saturday or Sunday brunch time Fromm 11:00 am to 5:00 pm. They have additional selection for brunch menu not normally serve.  We got the poke raw with three different raw fish. It come with tamarind curry sauce. It has snow pea, cauliflower rice, cucumber and kimchi. This is my first time try cauliflower rice. Is energy food. I ok with it but my wife love it.   I also got the brunch menu with citrus Ahi tuna poke with pork belly. I like this one better. The pork belly was perfectly fried with right amount of fat and meat. Crunchy and salty. Good mixture. I like citrus sauce over the tamarind curry sauce. The mushrooms was nice and the porch egg was great to break over the poke.

I thought this restaurant tucked away in Tampa may not a good show. But it proof me wrong and they are indeed good food in south Tampa. They have some skill since they survived that long. If you do go there, I recommend a boba drink as Okinawa with brown sugar slush. This slush is rich in flavor. The price a bit higher but they give you large cup which make up the price you paid.   We got pork belly pho noodle soup. The pork belly was glaze and in good taste. The mixture of the entire bowl was balanced and good. The Singapore Sling is actually Singapore rice noodle. If you go to Singapore, Singapore Sling is actually a national alcohol drink done in Singapore. It is not noodle. However, the name can be use for noodle. It come with stir fried shrimp. It has good curry on it.   Our experience here is nice. We do not need to wait for long on food. In fact the drink take longer than food.

Mandy probably the most competitive in price for the restaurant on their shopping plaza. Food not the top notch but decent for the price you have paid. The take out I have has big portions to be able to share. It Latin cuisine with Cuban background was great for the patrons.   We have the roast pork for to go. My wife saw the pork skin and ask if we could have some, it was added bonus when they give us the big piece. If the roast pig skin saw by Philippine residents, it will be gone first. Although I am not Philippine, but I like it because they crispy  and nice. My dish come with rice. The rice may need a bit work to completely cook. We also has plantain which is sweet and tasty.   Overall the food is good. Who can complaint about the affordable price. We have to come back to try other items they have serve.

Tea Lounge is gourmet dessert drink. They have good selection of the mixed drink. You also can see your drink on the wall TV screen display. It will show you the different type of drink before you order. Those drinks are very colorful. The next section is an ice cream place. Both in the same store.   My first drink is the tea lounge special. It has variety of jelly, boba, tapioca. I like the sweet coconut milk make the drink mixed well. I also got their daily special - Durian Extreme. This drink top with durian ice cream. Durian is very strong taste if you are not really get use to it. I like durian because I am from Southeast Asia. This drink also has the herbal jelly, longan, avocado, and basil seed.   Overall the drink is good. The price is a bit high. Over $7 with tax. It is good with the hot weather we have in Florida.

The restaurant move to new place. It is a little smaller than the old place. I think the food may be take a step back. Not quite impressed. Not sure much to said. I wish they could be better. They are 3.5 stars in my book.

The classic historic building where Bernini Italian Restaurant display some the historic value of the YBOR. We set this night to check it out first time. The interior dinning hall is a beautiful setting with two story high ceiling make the open space very pleasant. They also have the up stair siting which increase the capacity of the restaurant. They have bar with TV for the single dinner or people who wait for the table. Atmosphere is great.  We have started with the Beef Carpaccio. The thin slice of the beef to be pick up and set on the white truffle and a touch of balsamic vinegar. This is delicious. Our entrée are Blacken Atlantic Salmon and Crispy Duck. The salmon serves with spinach and zucchini. I like the lemon butter sauce that accompany the vege. the salmon grill with blacken at top of the salmon that make the taste desirable. Some improvement can be made on how to prepare the blacken side. Like the beef can be cooked for well-medium-rare, the blacken also can be prepared lite spicy-medium-black spicy. This can give the customer a choice of their familiar taste. The crispy duck is definite the go to dish. The duck is debone to only three bone left -wing, two leg bone. This make the dinner easy to consume. The dish serves with mash potato and the duck top with the gravy. The skin is very crispy that make the name of the dish. The duck meat is great and softly prepare. I have try crispy duck with orange sweet sauce, five spice crispy duck, pekin duck. But duck with gravy is first time. We end our evening with champagne raspberry sorbetto. The sorbet is great. By pulling the champagne on top of the sorbet that create the bubble sensation of the taste. The dinner end with creative dessert is making the dinning perfect.  Today we came before 7 PM and they have the entrée for the half price. It is a steal. Even after 7 PM, they are also good due to the amount of the food was given. The quality and quantity surely make the chart. The service is perfect for the night. Certainly will be back. They deserve the five star rating for tonight. The half pricing make it to the top.

This may be the best Carrabba's chain restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. There are number reasons they are good. The skill chef, attentive serving staff, wide seating area with good decorations.   I have here for event and also come here to eat in person. I like their chef because they paid attention to the detail for the food. We started with the mussel in white wine butter sauce. The mussels was clean and not have any sand particle. The chef has good skill to cook this dish that the mussel meat just tender and soft. I have seen many chef has over cook the mussel but the here is very good touch.   The entrée are 6 oz sirloin and the shrimp and scallops linguine alla vodka. This sirloin was well prepared to the temperature I have ordered. The seafood linguine was well prepared. I like the large shrimp and large sea scallops. Good selection on the material. The dish make excellent mark.

After the fireworks in Coachman Park, we were going to the Cleveland street for additional party to allow disperse of traffic jam. We pass by the restaurant that Rachel has suggested earlier and we decided to try.   This is a Puerto Rican restaurant has some traditional and fusion of its country cuisine. I was not hungry so I have the coconut creme brûlée and skirt steak turnover. I saw Fern has the special chicken roulade - chicken breast wrap in bacon, chorizo, sweet plantain and cream cheese look very yummy.   I was surprise that the turnover skirt steak is chop not ground. It makes the turnover fantastic good. The creme brûlée is not the normal one. It is more to flan base with minor caramelize sugar over it and top with coconut flake. This is one of the unique creme brûlée I have taste. You can skip all dinner but don't skip the dessert.   We have fun in this restaurant and Fern bust some move of the salsa at the stage. The stage use for performance at special event they host, live music was play here. It was fun as the slogan said "I won't be impressed with technology until I can download food". Dream on. May be one day will happen.

During the Coronavirus period, this fast food chain did take good precautions on serving the customers. They have the food on the tray and delivery to you without contact.   I got the strawberry Fanta ice. This is my first time has it. It only a dollar for the promotion. It is fun to have. I have never have the impossible whopper. They also have in on sale two for $6. The burger is really good. I cannot believe it is no meat. Way to go. It has all the grilled flavor. The chicken fried is my favorite. I got the meal deal with French fried with coupon for $3. My entire meal just $10. What a steal.   The drive through is quick without a hitch. I would give them an A.

This newly open restaurant was posted a drink from my friend which very attractive. I decided to visit it within a week from her post. The restaurant has a stage for the musicians. It has music entertainment, bar and food. Please check on their Facebook page for show schedule. Some day includes salsa and swing dancing if you want shake off you hip.   The food we order have some Peruvian and some Columbian cuisine. We started with Leche de Tigre - raw fish and cook shrimp in lime juice. The raw fish is in bit and small pieces. I will prefer it to be dice. Or slice. Shrimp is cocktail size.   Our entrée are Bandeja Paisa Colombiana. This dish has many items. It includes grilled steak, fried Pork Belly, sausage, fried egg, rice, fried beam, fried sweet plantain. It is parade of food. Great taste for each items. Our second dish is Pescado A Lo Macho - fried filet fish as a base and with sautéed shrimp, octopus, squid, and mussel in seafood broth tomato base sauce. I like the sophisticated cooking. It make it interesting.   They have army of wait staff. Easy to get attention. Their staff can speak clear English which make easy to order. Food is good, service is good, great experience.

I have been to many Cold Stone, this is the best Cold Stone that I have visited. During the ice cream day, the line is long. But it move very fast. Because the manager was there and the rest of the wait staff paid good attention. That will be the biggest difference that I see compare to others location.   During the ice cream day, the promotion is buy one get one free. We were at the line but it take only 10 minutes to get to our turn. I have the cotton candy and the coffee ice cream. My mixed topping is heath bar. It work out well. The ice cream is great.   I saw the manager help clean up the table, pick up the trash, clean the counter. No wonder this store is presentable. It make the customers want to come back. I also like the set up which make the order much easy when they have two counter to paid the ice cream.

This is URBAN restaurant series with southern cuisine. I have hit all URBAN restaurants in one day except the deli. This one is somehow unique because they are in a modified garage to restaurant. The seating included bar, outside Shuffle board and the regular restaurant inside seating.  Urban Comfort has good southern food selection. We got the chicken waffles. The dish come with two pieces southern fried chicken. You can add two more pieces for additional $4. It serve over Belgium waffle with power sugar on top. The chicken are well marinated. I have not seen a marinated sauce go deep into the meat. It is delicious.   This restaurant is solid 4 stars. It is not 3.5 stars make 4 stars. Service is good. While we were there we got the free 5 oz beer by Yelp checking. I have selected the coconut milk stout. It has good coffee flavor and burn smoke flavor. The stout is good to enjoy.

If look for late night dinner at weekends, this is one of the restaurant has full kitchen menu until 1 am. We were here late 11 pm dinner. This place has more people when we finish our dinner. I was surprised more would came late night.   We got the Korean Japchae. This is glass noodle vegetable dish with shiitake mushroom. The sauce is right. The sesame oil is fragrance enough. It is good dish. We also got the beef bulgogi. This dish is a bit let down compare to my first visit. Because they beef quality has a lot tendon. Tough to bite.   Overall we have a good night here. Service attentive is a bit behind. I have to flag down waiter or waitress to get attention.

The update review is due to the recent visit. This time I bring a friend with me. Due my good experience on the last visit, I like to repeat it again. This time we ordered the appetizer. The food come out quick.   We got the Lemon Chili Tuna Tar Tar. I like the decorations and presentation. This dish included the tuna tartare with 4 additional accompanying to share. It has kimchi cucumber, papaya relish, toast coconut, radish. It come with 4 strip of crackers. Before I start, I can smell very fishy on the tuna. We didn't suspect anything. It was a mistake that we eat it without question. We all have food poisoning that day.   I think they need to check the quality and freshness of the ingredients. It was a bad experience.

I like this fast food and beer concept. This open air concept is something new and interesting. The do have a garage type area for seating. At least this area has roof over it. This is a place to hang out for late night.   The place has a lot different types of games on the ground. It is great to see that in the amenities of the restaurant. You can try different games and they are great. It is almost like cruise ship games area.   The food selection is great. I would said Asian fusion yet can be Mexican or American cuisine. We got the chicken wings. This wing is almost like fried and bake. The coating is Malaysian Chili Paste. This paste is very similar to shrimp paste. Then top with fried garlic. Perfect touch. We also got grouper tostada. It interesting to have it. Not much memorable like the wing.   Overall we like the concept with beer. A great hang out place. One thing to improve is tone down the speaker volume in the garage seating area. I understand they need to be loud for the people hear over the open area but not at the confine area.

I have been here several time but never give them a review. One thing I like the most about this restaurant is their lunch special and honey butter bun. The honey butter bun is delicious and is complimentary item before the meal with cinnamon butter. The lunch special has attractive pricing and affordable.   We were here for their MLK special. I got the sirloin steak with rice and chili. The steak was grilled to temperature requested. It is juicy. The chili is really nice with ground meat. We have the half rack pork rib as appetizer. It is folk tender and fall off the bone. My wife have the country fried steak. The coating is seasoning with spice and crispy. Good size piece of meat.   Our service is good. Food come on time. Not much of wait. During pandemic, they seat groups in every 15 minutes.

Ok fast food for seafood. Definitely better than many seafood fast food restaurant. It is a stand alone building with drive thru access. The restaurant good combo meal. Many selection on the menu. It include pasta, sandwich, seafood, salad, chicken, gyro and dessert.   I got the seafood combo with tilapia. You can select grilled or fried. I have it grilled. The fish is good. Good piece. I added 10 fried shrimp. The shrimps are big. This is a good combo. It come with fry.   Overall is a good experience. If I need something quick, I will come back for the seafood.

Finally St. Pete has a good enough poke. I like Chai Mixology has serve poke, wings, and boba tea. It is cute store at central avenue.   They serve poke that you can do your own or you can get one that pre set for you. We go for their best seller pre set - Mixology Poke. This is salmon and Tuna as protein. Including the seaweed and ginger. I like they add extra sauce on the side if you needed. Also extra salsa. The fish is firm and the piece was cut big. They were generous on the protein to create happy customers. Good strategy. Now day we have so many poke place open. This will be good sign for better and more protein.   The store clerk was very friendly. Definitely will visit them on next time I am in the neighborhood. Enough poke to fill the stomach. I will try their boba next time.

Seminole Height has a new star restaurant. It has feature cuisine that is close to Asian Fusion. I have book mark this place 5 months and like to try someday. This place use to be a New Orlean Cuisine restaurant. The current restaurant has very good use of the porch for additional seats.   The restaurant has open bar. Cocktails and full bar is available. We have the Kalbi Lamb and the Misoyaki Salmon. The lamb is a bit over cook out side that make the meat a bit harden. This dish more into the sour side. Good seasoning but need to improve the grilled technique. The French and the Lebanese grilled lamb technique are the best. The salmon has good purée to go with it. The corn is well cook with the right taste over the purée. The salmon skin is the best. It is crispy and delightful.   Our appetizer is the Oxtail Poutine. It is braise tail meat over the potato tot. It top with sunny side up egg. This dish was presented in the deep bowl. If it come on the flat plate, the presentation will be improved for the desire of the dish.   Service is good. This restaurant is about 3.5 stars. Since there is no 1/2 stars. 4 stars is good. It also has vegetarian menu.

This bar is at old Seminole Height. Very interesting place. It is our second stop tonight for chicken wing which I have read about in yelp. I am surprised that they close at 10 pm at Friday night. Their business hours is short.   This bar is almost like gas station converted. The outside has high roof open air seating for large group. The inside is more like small table big enough for 4 people a group.   We have order the Parmesan wing and a Weihenstephaner Pilsner - a German brew. They also have other import draft beer from England and Ireland. Good selection for the beer. The beer is great. The chicken wing is fried and top with some sauce with Parmesan. Is tasty.   Overall experience is good. Pricing is affordable.

We are at downtown concert and selecting this restaurant before the show. The restaurant is about 80% full due to near by convention. We were quickly seated and order. The wait for the food is not that bad. It is roughly 17 minutes and gives us enough time to finish and walk to Straz Center. If you have show in Tampa Theater, the restaurant will be obvious choice since they are just next to it.   We have the Panang Curry and the house specialty Crab Fried Rice. Panang curry is more to sweet side that salty side. The protein is Pork lay over the stir fry veggies with curry sauce. This dish is average. The Crab fried rice $17 and I expected it to be good. I am not how they cook it. The rice are not separated. A good fried is stir fried the rice and veggies separately than add together at the end. First make the rice separated with stir fried sauce and oil. I would said their technique is I can do better at my home.   The service is good because we get to our concert on time like we plan. The ambient is nicely decorated.

This southern restaurant has majority customers is African Americans. If you there that much of people, it must be good. They do have lounge area next door. I like restaurant section to enjoy the food. They have southern food. The price was reasonable at the mark.   We have rock the boat. This dish is smoke and seared Triple Tail fish. The blackened is spicy. But I like it. It accompanying the collard green and Gouda grit. I like the collard green. Very southern. Our second dish is the Never Too Much. This is the southern steak with frite. It is Kansas Strip steak. The steak is well marinated and grilled correctly to order. The bbq sauce is nice to dip. Good pink center. Meat quality is good. The sunny side up egg is good with egg yolk spill over the steak. I would recommend this dish.   Service is ok. But the food is good. Definitely one of the restaurant will be back for their fried chicken and oxtail. Cocktails look good.

I would said this is an old folks restaurant. The reason I said it because of the way they cook the food. Mostly broil and less sodium. It is an Greek restaurant with many history in Bay Area.   They an not advertised rack of lamb. Only ask and you shall have it. It is not in the menu. We did not go for it since we are getting the early bird special. We have the broil octopus and the broil dole fish. The octopus is not grilled. If the grilled it will be much better. It is serve with sour sauce. The sole fish is only broil with stir fry veggies. I think all dish lack of salt or seasoning. Great for senior people.   Service is good at restaurant. May be the happy hour is less people.

I would said this BBQ place brought to Progress Energy Village a meaty place for community. It is not the budget BBQ place. Price is a bit high among all the BBQ place I have been to. However, they do have a good tasty BBQ.   We got the three bone rib with chicken and two sides. The rib has good seasoning and moist meat. Well seasoning to the bone. The meat also separated from the bone which good technique. The BBQ chicken is well smoked flavor. Juicy enough for it.   The collard green and rice are the good side. I would suggest more attractive side that is different than most BBQ place will make them unique. So far they just among the BBQ place and nothing special.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant to my rating. Not yet 4 star.  Haiku has the most beautiful girl in the block during diner time. I have not seen concentrate location in restaurants attract young girl to dine. I am guessing the convenience and outdoor seating is a plus.   We were here for second round progressive happy hour. The menu for the food is great. I think the customers base is due good cocktails. I start with mango chili chicken wings. Not bad. Not the best but it do above average. The second dish is duck Bao bun. I think it need some improvement on the meat preparation. Tempura shrimp was next dish. But it really need some work on this dish. The tempura need to be corrected. The best dish is the sushi of day. Dynamite sushi. It is taste good and interesting.   Our dessert is the matcha tres leche. I like this dessert. It is done well. Service is very good. Very attentive.

Cool place with outdoor seating and some game board for customers. A lot customers come here for burger because so far there was not a burger place is decent enough except this one at this area. This place is good after sun is set and the weather is better with cooler conditions.   I have the shroom burger. This is a marinated burger patty. It has some spice in it. I think their patty is cook through. Meat is good with marinated. Mushroom on top was sautéed. Good flavor. The mushroom is the best part of the burger. Fried is normal. The bun is good.   Judging the price to the food value, this is 3.5 stars. Patty can be bigger. The burger is expansive for food truck and outdoor seating. For the amount of money many, we are expecting more from the food.

The fresh market located at Corey Avenue between Boca Ciega Drive and Gulf Blvd.  the two block area have local vendor put up their tent and conduct their Sunday market sales.  Today I have try the beff Wellington pie. The pie prepare by a vendor call Savory Pocket. The pie crush is crispy and layers. Perfectly bake. The beef is braise with potato and other vege. The source of the pie make you want to go for second.   This market has less organic vege which is disappointed me. We have visited the fried vege vendor. They have fried beat, carrot, okra and more.   The November market have lesser vendor than the peak time. The parking is easy at this area.

Interesting restaurant for middle eastern food in buffet. It almost feel family run restaurant with some help of food serving. We were sit immediately with our choice.   They have veggies side, hot food and dessert. The babaganoush is delicious. The veggie is mix well with olive oil. They have pickles okra and purple olive to open your appetite. They also have eggplant in curry type of sauce.   The hot food include grill tomatoes, grill chicken, grill ground beef, falafel, basmati rice with seasoning. The have good enough selection just enough but not in the wow factor.   Service is good. The owner came to our table to check out and find out if we like it. The waiter is attentive. If they include the seekh kabab will be nice. Food is simple and ok.

Visited on the Mother's Day weekend. It also has the height market. This is new thing they have on their lot. We welcome the new ideal. The Southern Brewing has their special cup on sale that day. If fill the cup, the beer will be 50 cents cheaper on each filling.   The brewery is unique in it own way. I have been here several time and not give them a review yet. I like the decoration like warehouse with brewing materials on the floor. They have dark, sour, light and hoppy beer. Price is like typical local craft beer in the area.   Today I have special frosting drinks with alcohol. Very interesting. Great for the hot day and cool to your core.

I am having easy day off. As a result, we chose a restaurant with lunch special during weekdays only. This restaurant has been in the Bay Area for a year and I saw Anna M. has carry out from this sushi restaurant to watch the movie at home. We decided to try her cinema sushi bite.   This is actually mixed of Korean and Japanese sushi restaurant. Our lunch special is perfect here. We have ordered the Kahlbee lunch box. It came with 4 pieces of California rolls, 3 pieces of sushi (tuna, salmon, and white fish), vegetables tempura, white rice and the main item Kahlbee - the Korean BBQ with short rib. I have been eating many lunch box special with California roll. This one has some Masago (fish egg) on top and makes it nicer. The Korean BBQ is grilled to perfect. The meat is tenderized and they not over grill to charcoal. Perfect meat seasoning.   We also order the lunch special for additional two rolls with total less than $10. The spicy crunchy tuna and Unakyu Roll (eel roll in eel sauce). I prefer the seaweed to be wrapped outside than inside. The reason is the roll receives crunchy seaweed on the outside than soak and wet to be wrapped inside. The crunch tuna is delicious. They make good use of tiny pieces of tempura chips. Some use the crunchy noodle but I like this restaurant use the tempura chip is more authentic.   The service is good. The restaurant did give us a special with 3 small Korean appetizers - Kimchi, fish cake, and egg cake. I love them all especially the fish cake. I would recommend for the lunch special and you can try variety of food with affordable price. I also like the combination of Korean food and sushi.

I like this dog park especially in the morning. Many dog owners show up. Parking can be a challenge because this is an boat ramps too to launch the kayak. If the parking is full, you can park across the in the big park and walk across the Laurel Street.   The park has big dog and small dog area. My grand dog is in the middle which can go to both park. There are some shade umbrellas for dog master to wait for their dog to play. Plenty of space and is bigger than the dog run in Curtis Hixon park. Active area in the morning because your four leg friend can meet other four leg friends.   Be prepared to bring tower to dry your dog if you want to keep them dry afterward.

3.5 stars is about right. The taco here is more expensive than typical taco place. But I the same time, they do use the better ingredients. The restaurant has inside and outside seating. It convenient for dog owners to be have seat on outside.   We got the steak and shrimp taco meal. It come with side of rice and fried bean. The side was delicious. The steak was well marinated. For the quantity of food is good enough for lunch portion. The service is great. Better than I expected. Definitely a good area to have drink and taco.

If you count the value, traditional, authentic, good dining at dinner, I would said 5 stars for this restaurant. I have been to this restaurant 5 year ago and it does not give me an impression of good Vietnamese cuisine.   I have read many of my friend review about the pho, it is not the best. Why we revisit. I saw Joel review on the vegan food and decide to try it again. After I have read their menu, we discover the dishes that not normally serve in Pinellas Park Vietnamese hub. You need to navigate to their house special. Tonight we have a dish that we have try in Hanoi and did not see anyone doing it. The chargrilled fish. It is the grill fish "Thang Long" style. The fish is marinated with turmeric and baby dill. This dish we found at the street of old town Hanoi. Now we know they have it.   We also order the autumn roll with fresh roll on grill ground pork. Interesting. We order the the authentic happy pancake with large rice crepe with pork, shrimp and bean sprout. It is very unique. The other dish include traditional Central Vietnam Rice Noodle. This is special noodle of the central Vietnam. That how it got the name.   Overall they are good. I would suggest if you are here, don't try the pho for once. But try their house special menu.

The store has been renovated since my last visit many years ago. This store turn out very nice for inside and outside during night time. Well decorated lighting. It is still did not improve on the rating. Since they much improved form the last time, I commenced they deserved to have 4 stars.   We walk in the store 10 day after Halloween, I am ask if they have the pumpkin flavor. They went to back to check and found the pumpkins spice for the blizzard. I have asking them to add the heath bar Chocolate. Thank to them I still have a chance to try pumpkin blizzard. My wife has candy canes chill chocolate blizzard which is holiday flavor. Not bad. The blizzard is sticky but I think is still watery.   I like new interior with high definition tv. I watch partial of the NBA there. Overall service is great.

It is about 3.5 stars. Since the food is almost the same pricing than fast food, I would recommend this place rather than fast food. Ming Ming has many low budget sushi combo. I can see why the young people love to visit.   We got the number one combo. It have sixteen pieces of sushi and 5 pieces of sashimi. Very good deal. For under $10. We also got the spicy crawfish roll. Both sushi are good. But not a fan for the sashimi. We also got two boba. A coconut and a honey dew. I think this can be skip for the reason the boba is not sweet boba.   Food come out quick. Service is medium. Food is average but for the price less than fast food is good choice.

Yelping 2400 -- Rare Ethnic Cuisine 59, Haitian Cuisine.   Although they receive five star, they are actually 4.5 stars in my book. This restaurant is a take out place. Not sitting area or dine in. I was wanting to try this restaurant when they just open. I want to be the first review but some one beat me to it.  I got the goat in the sauce. This is goat with creole sauce. The goat is a bit smelly which mean the process do not include like soak in the milk to soften the smell. But the dish is still good. The second dish is the griot -- it is fried pork. This is popular item of the list. They have good fried systems. All dish come with rice and fried plantain. The rice have a choice of white rice and bean, mixed rice and bean or black rice. I would recommend the black rice. The black rice is actually their specialty. It is a mushroom rice. Very delicious.   You need to be a little patient to come to this place. Because they cook all food right there. So it requires 15 minutes wait minimum from order.

It is about 3.5 stars for this restaurant. The best thing is their rib and the good combo plate price. May be when I visit is late before they are closing, the meat just average. I would said this is a neighborhood restaurant.   We got two combo of three items for $16 each. The price is fair for dinner. My plate is the sausage, rib, and the brisket. My two side is the baked bean and parsley potatoes. The meat is just average. The rib is the best. I like side parley potatoes. Other plates is with rib, chop pork and chicken. All item is just average. The meat is more to original taste. They encourage you to use the BBQ sauce with the meat.   Services are good. We were able to finish at 40 minutes. The lunch special is worth for a visit. If you like BBQ. This is good option.

Authentic Cuisine #61, Moroccan Cuisine   We have been to Morocco and find this place is close to the cuisine we have tasted in Morocco. I like the Tanger sauce they have put over the rice. The use of spice is very similar. It is definitely a recommended restaurant to visit. The few things that I would comment on the restaurant. 1. Employees should use mask during pandemic. 2. Serve real plate instead of styrofoam box for the food if customers dine in. Other than that, they are great restaurant and good service to the local.   We order two plate from chef special. The first dish is the Le Carnivore. This is the grilled skew steak and chicken. The steak was process and good tender. The chicken has the marinated spice into the meat. The hummus is like soft like the silk. They must take time grind and prepare this hummus. The Morocco shlada or "salad" is well prepared. Love it. Our second dish is the mermaid. This is grilled salmon and skew shrimp. This seafood combo dish. The shrimp is large and the fish is good.   Our appetizer is one of the best falafel. The coating is fried to crispy.
