The inside is still green. Similar to the falafel in Morocco. The spice in falafel is very flavorful. Don't forget to order this appetizer.

Learn about the special offer of Brio. If not their regular menu is also good. One thing I like Brio they change menu over season. The have many to offer. But I like the most is their bar food.   I have slice beef bruschetta when I first visit the Brio. They very good. Over time I learn about their bar menu over certain happy hour. These menu items is less than half of the price. However the portion also reduced. I am ok with less item with less 40% I paid. We got the beef carpaccio and black pepper shrimp. The carpaccio has mustard aioli which make it great. The shrimp come is six pieces over bread and cream sauce. It has nice peppery taste.   We went at happy hour before closing which is 9 pm to 10 pm. Many of the staff is already tire. But this is the best time after movie for snack.

I have been One Family Korean restaurant long time ago. I use to like their grilled fish. Those were before my Yelp day. I coming back to check their new lunch special. This lunch special has some good value.   We got the Galbi and Bulgogi lunch box. The bulgogi (slice beef) is stir fry. It come with potatoes and broccoli salad, goyoza, kimchi, spicy pickle cucumber, California roll and white rice. The Galbi is the best. This is grilled short rib. I counted is about 10 pieces. Good marinated sauce. The short rib is delicious.   Service is good since it is only three tables when we visit. I like their lunch special. I will encourage you to try it too. It is delicious. They serve many other traditional Korean dish. Next time I will have the mackerel fish again.

I am happened to be near the Air Force Base, and we decided to visit this restaurant. Usually I don't make a trip here.  I decided to clear my book mark since I am here.   Big Ray Fish Camp has in my book mark for a while. I saw Nick and Tina review and wanted to visit this place. We have order their signature dish lobster corn dog and the blacken grouper sandwich. The lobster corn dog come with mince garlic cheese fried that is impressive. The lobster corn dog is special with a lot of the lobster meat. No cheap. I believe their fried  is more tasty than the lobster meat.   The grouper sandwich is just average. I have better than this place. Overall their price is at the high side. Not many of indoor seats. When iris rain outside, the seat is limited since the outside seating is wet. This place is busy. Good but no wow factor. This is a 3.5 stars restaurant.

It is about 4.5 stars. For assembly food, they did it very well. The use of material is great. The process of material also great. The assembly is really nice. This may be their success of the restaurant. They do have ice cream, waffles, milkshakes, energy drinks and more. It is a Restaurant not required vegetable oil. Healthy choices also in sweet side. Guilty pleasure.   We got the classic waffle. It has different chop and slide fruits. You can tell they process their fruit to sweetness (may be dipping syrup or sugar). So you will not find sour fruit. I like this way very well. That why you paid the money for assembly fruit and waffle. The topping and ingredients is harmony melt together.   Each plate they serve has some writing. We have our name on it.

Lolita has high rating. Food is good by reading the reviews. This restaurant open not long ago. It is local favorite. When we visited the restaurant, there was a lot of take out before us.   We got the carne Asada quesadilla, Birria taco, and grilled fish tacos. The carne Asada quesadilla is nice and well pack for the meat. The grilled fish is just ok. Feel the fish is tiny. The Birria taco is the best on quantity, quantity, and price. Recommended.   We also 24 oz special boba tea. This boba tea has earl grey tea with peach, strawberry, raspberry flavor. The popping boba is the pomegranate popping boba. It was delicious. Fist time has pomegranate boba.   Overall is good. The wait for the food is long. 30 minutes. Same as all walking customers to wait. If they can improve on kitchen speed, it will help.

The restaurant is the best of the Apollo Beach. This restaurant was recommended by three people when we indicated we want to visit the manatee viewing center. My son teacher when he has the math competition at East Bay High School, Our neighbor and Rachel M. This must be good restaurant to visit.   The restaurant has the harbor view that out look to the gulf. We were having the choice of the inside or outside seating. This time of the year with 74 degree outside temperature, the outside sitting is comfortable. Our waiter is quick on the feet to show us the favorite dish in the menu. We have order the Cajun Salmon and the Tuna Tokyo that was recommended by the waiter. The food came in about 15 minutes. My dish is the Cajun Salmon that come with rice and zucchini. The zucchini is stir fry and lightly grilled over the open flame. This is the technique of the chef uses stir fry with the right seasoning and grilled it to add the flavor of the open flame. The Cajun spice on the salmon is almost like the blacken preparation.  The fish is prepared superbly to dine. The Tuna Tokyo is delicious too. The Sashimi grade tuna is grilled outwardly and slice in the ¼" piece and spread over the rice and steam green bean. Most of the restaurant sear the tuna with peppercorn but this restaurant use the grilled technique for the tuna. The inside is still like sashimi and great to eat. This is a know how to handle the material and maintain the high grade for the taste. The tuna is drizzle with sweet wasabi sweet soy sauce. The balance of the drizzle sauce to be contacted with the freshly grilled outward meat make sense. Well done by the chef.  The lunch price is very reasonable for fine dining.  We were happy to be here to enjoy the great weather and accompany with great food. This is definite a place to go. We will be back for more. The service is good and quick. The host also seat us quick.

Another chain restaurant that has good chef in the kitchen. You can feel it when the food comes out. They also has Wednesday night special for limited time. They are running a $9.95 6 oz sirlion with fried and beer. Such a good deal.   I got special of the night. The selection of the meat has good quality. I have ask for medium rare. The outside is completely cook but the inside still see red less pink. This is very good skill from the chef. The middle of the did not feel cool too which make this well prepared over the grille.   I also got sheared Ahi tuna. This is favorite from this restaurant. I like that overlay over Asian dressing slaw. It has every good thing with about the appetizer. I would recommend this dish to start. Overall the bar is good but only one person in the bar area make the attentive service is lack off.

I have been to this Starbucks several time. But each time they just give me a so so impression. The reason behind is every time I am there the trash can is full, the table is dirty, the floor is not up to the standard. Seem like is a management problem. They need to tidy the store. I always seen a lot of them employees but did not see they actually care or clean the store.   The shaken tea with pineapple black tea is refreshing. It is better and cheaper than their coffee. They do have other drink like infusion lemonade and chai tea latte. They also has strawberry acai. I thinks they are branch out from just coffee.

The situation getting better. Some improvement has been made. Now they install the rain text messages system to warn you ahead if the gym is close during that day. It save a lot of time for people who drive long distance to play badminton here. The message send out a few day or week earlier which make individual planning better if the gym is closed. This is big improvement.

Rare Ethnic food #56. Filipino Cuisine.   Every time I pass by Sunday they close because it pass 3 pm. Finally I have a chance to visit during lunch time. It look like cafeteria with all the food show on the counter which you can pick and choose. But I would recommend the Boodle Fight.   What is boodle fight?  The Philippine military were serve a big pile of food in the middle of a really long table in a mess hall where every hungry soldier eats with their hands symbolizing of brotherhood and equality in the military. The "fight" is a symbolic grab the food and fight for it at the table.   We got a big plate of food combo. It is really great to dig in. The plates included the grilled chicken at the stick, roasted pig belly, shrimp, mango, vermicelli, cure egg, green bean, lumpia and more. Great dish to have and share. It is combination traditional food from Philippine.   Service is good. The place is tiny. Not much of seat. May be need to come early if you want to dine in.

Great food here. Especially if you have little money. You can enjoy a great meal. The restaurant was a Caribbean restaurant before. Now is tropical cuisine with a bit Caribbean taste. The restaurant is displayed with trays of food for your choice of combination.   I got a plate of Mofongo as a base and cucumber salad as side. My main dish are the oxtail. The oxtail is soft and fall of the bone. Very good. My friend dish is the king fish with rice. He like his dish because not many restaurant serve king fish.   This is the place to go if you want to get in and out for lunch in 30 minutes. This restaurant will be the best choice. We also got the guava juice for refreshing drink. Our experience is great. I will be back for their king fish. They also has dessert I have not try yet.

The restaurant open for sit down during pandemic. But I see a lot of take out on the take out table. I also got take out. The restaurant has patio seating since they are at the corner of the building.   We got the garlic pepper squid and Siam noodle. The garlic squid did cook the Thai hot that I was asking. It has good sauce. But the squid feel like previous frozen food and defrost and cook. The quality is not quite there. I also feel their wok technique is not there too. May be is off day. The Siam noodle is a bit better. However the noodle seem like not cook to high BTU burn edge. If the noodle done that way, I can do it at home.   This is about 2.5 stars restaurant. The items they can improve is improve their overnight food frozen technique and longer wok time to get the high BTU effect. My order was on time to pick up and they are ready.

Great come back for the facility manager. It is getting better. The communication is getting better for the sport team. They have more ideal to communicate to each weekly sport team. At least the badminton. Now with have the text message if the gym is use or rental for other entities. Our sport team players get notice in time. Especially the last minutes notice help not to drive a long distance to play.   Assignment for responsibility of the front desk also alert. Once the notice was given for the problem area, the items were taking care.

This Whole Food is located in the busy plaza. This plaza includes Target, Home Depot, Total Wine. The vehicular traffic is terrible. Very difficult plaza to visit. But I do like one thing, they have cover parking.   I was here to buy some ready to go food by pound and their premade food. I alway like whole food food by pound. But my visit was kind of disappointed because most of the trays are empty or low in quantities. The remaining food in the tray is not attractive. I do got some grilled veggies with squash, asparagus, book Chou and carrot. Those are good and bring to their spice table. You can add the bacon bite, sesame seed, oil, and many other type of spice. It add flavor.   I also got the sweet Thai chili beef, blacken salmon, and satay chicken. Those are their specialties items. Food are good on that combination.

Review # 2600 - this one go to Viet Kitchen.   I have come to this restaurant several time. The fist time we have visited, the AC did not work. By the second time we visited, the problem solved. I like local own restaurants who do well. It is true 5 stars restaurant due to the cuisine, technique and unique food.   We have try many dishes. The appetizer we have is roasted quail. This dish you need to call ahead to assure they have the dish at the time you visit. Because if they sold out that day, it will difficult for them to prepare for you because it need two hour marinated time. I like this dish very much. The salad dish we have is very unique. We have young jack fruit shrimp salad. I never thought use green jack fruit in salad. This my first I have it. I recommend this dish.   The main dishes we have a few good one. The first dish is the shaken beef or sautéed cube steak is delicious. I think the beef can be more shaken will be better. The second dish is the crab meat fried rice. This is great dish to have. You can feel the crab meat. The third dish is my favorite. It is the salt and pepper prawn. Those are big prawn. The shell is on. The last dish is the Caramelized fish fillet. It is king fish with good caramel sauce.   Overall we enjoy our night. It is delicious on all dishes.

This airport mostly low ceilings terminals nothing fancy about it. It is functioning as terminals to connect. My visit mainly is for terminals 2 which is only delicate to Southwest Airline only.   During arrival, it take a few turns to get to the exit and baggage claim. Design is not friendly for arrival. The luggage service take a while before it come out.   The departure is better. From the gate to security check is not a long line. Since it is delicate only to Southwest Airline, the security do not need to share the line with other airlines.   The concourse has many type typical store. Such as newsstand, kid world, and more. Restaurant is fast food and local breweries. Not bad. They have St. Louis Tap room. Local breweries.

French Quarter established around 1700 which is the older section in the city. It is celebrating 300 year in making. The tricentennial did bring a lot history including the Hurricane Katrina.   The quarter found in 1718 make exactly 300 years old. It make of the Jackson Square, Washington Artillery Park, French Market, Bourbon Street, Royal Street, St. Louis Cathedral, and more. This quarter is the most fun.   Many of the major Mardi Gras parades were happen here. The celebration brings it to the streets. It has a lot of french influence. Food is enormous and many choices. I would recommend creole, southern or fusion. In the quarter has several choices of restaurants. ACME, Mr B, Tableau, and more.   Horse carriage around the quarter or cafe Du Monde are famous activists.

This seafood market and restaurant is a interesting combination. You actually can buy the raw seafood there and cook it yourself. You also can ask them to cook it for you. This option combination is great for the customers.   The Seafood Select cook shrimp by pound, by number of shrimp or by their combination platter. It is convenient. Some time you feel like eating by the number of shrimp. 15 mid size shrimp for $7 is good deal. You also can get combination as a meal deal. The have fried or scampi. Their fried shrimp include powder spice over the fried shrimp. The only thing to improve is butterfly the shrimp and fried.   I also got fried scallops there. Their scallops is bigger than bay scallops. I also notice they has fried crab. I also think the have peel shrimp. So go check them out yourself.

Decent Louisiana cuisine in town. Very good use of Cajun spice. They are actually on the Bayou and matching the name of the restaurant. Very unique building with outside and inside seating. The are netting at outside seating but the door wide open. It help reduce the insect invasion.   The entrée included classic Louisiana dish. We got two app and an entree. First app is jambalaya bowl. The jambalaya is average to my opinion. The second app is fried frog leg. $10 you got three big pairs. It was one of the highlights. The frog leg is big and juicy. Very good quality. It go well with salt and pepper if you want to add them.   Our entrée is the Lagniappe - Crawfish etouffee and fried catfish. This did is great to serve over rice. This is a large dish. We were sharing with each other. I also got Abita Root Beer with sugar cane sweetening. This is Louisiana root beer.   Service is good because not many around when we have visit. I will definitely come back for some other items in the menu.

This not your typical pho place. The reason behind is they prepared according to their street side food vendors in Vietnam. If you come here, the pho soup base is very herbal taste. Typical American will not like it. But I love it.  I got the pho tai nam gan sach. It is combination beef noodle.  The four major meat ingredients are rare slice beef, flank marinated beef, tendon, beef tripe. Guess what, they don't use beef ball. The tendon and tripe cut method also different. The soup is darker colors with herbal taste. It is very good.   I also got two bah mi one with special cold cut and the other is grill pork. $3.50. Good deal than most.  The other dish I got is the vermicelli with grilled pork, shrimp, and egg roll. My wife like this dish.   The interior of the restaurant need work. However, the cost of the food make up the restaurant need for customers. The price is reasonable.

This is about 3.5 stars for restaurant but 4 stars for the meat market. The Mexican restaurant and grocery concept has been use in south Tampa. But for this area is the first. The reason they are 3.5 stars is their taco is not the cheapest. Food truck may be cheaper than them. In the same time, their overhead is higher too.   I got the tripe soup, carnitas, pastor, lengua, and barbacoa tacos. The taco come with meat and tortilla. One positive thing is they bring the onion and cilantro for you to add your own. They also supply the lime to squeeze in. The green and red sauce is provided. I like their tripe soup because they are cook to soft.   The meat choices is marinated and good for you to buy home and cook yourself. This is something new. They have the churrasco season with the spice. The price is great per pound since they did the work for you and ready to cook.

I have been to this pokeworks at least four time. I like their poke and they are one of the best poke around. During the pandemic, they take precautions for the food and customers. They allow you to come in or call in the order. They set the six feet boundary from the food counter. They did display each topping and protein with identification tag. So you can tell them what you want.   We got the regular bowl with two protein. Their choice of base is great because the have variety. I alway like their sushi rice and kale noodle as base. The protein selection also large. I like to get scallops and the ahi tuna. The other protein include spicy salmon, salmon, albacore tuna, shrimp, chicken, tofu. The beauty is their have the mixed in, sauce selection and protein together mixed up before the put on top of the base then add topping. This is good practice. The sauce you can select different type. I like poke sauce and Thai sweet chili.   Pokeworks has reward program. You might want to sign up.

#800 Review - Rare Ethnic Food 6 - Asian Fusion    Got Zen!!!! You will find your food zen here. I was in search for worthy 800 review and find this restaurant. I got my inner Zen to write it.   A successful business need to lean and mean. In other word is efficient and effective. We don't need a hostess for dead weight cost pass to the consumer. This restaurant do not specific has one but able to manage the reservation and scheduling. Does mean they don't have one but integrated the system in the waitress. They also don't need one floor manager which is effective. Not second hand sit around worker. Very efficient. Big applause to the restaurant with good business model.   The food. Mmmmm good. Very good and reasonable pricing. We have order the Szechwan Cracked Peppercorn and Garlic Steak and the Shrimp Lo Mein. The shrimp Lo Mein is good but the steak is better. The steak is NY Strip with their spice rub and finished on the grill. Then it the sauce with pan fry garlic is added on the steak. Well balance on the taste. Steak is cooked to your order.   The service is well train on the table side manner waitress. Pay attention to the detail of how to serve. Am I coming back- a big yes. I like to try their special night some time with Peking Duck Feast.

This is the restaurant I have book mark for a while. We did not visit them sooner because we are far away to reach. It take 45 minutes to get here. Not sure it will be good to try. Until we saw a Groupon that worth a while for a visit. We were not disappointed for our visit.   The main dish of the are the oven roasted duck breast and the pork osso buco. The chef do have some skill on cooking. The duck breast is seasoning and roast with crispy skin on top. The orange glazed was nicely accompanied the duck. The meat was lay over kale with bacon. The side is vegetable of the day stir fry Squash. This is a dish to order if you are here.  The second dish is the special of the night which may be work into menu. The osso buco is a shank meat with the center bone. It alway good to present this dish. The only thing the chef need to work on is sauce. Instead of tomato base sauce, use the wine or brown sugar sauce may be better for this dish. They are going to change it base on my conversation with the waiter.   There a dish that is popular that I have not try since they run out. The cider glazed pork belly. I will visit them next time on this dish. Let me know if you have try it. Service is good. Speed for food delivery is slow. It need to pick up. Don't let customers wait too long for food.

Saigon Bay has been my go to restaurant before my Yelping day. They have been upgraded their restaurant interior to better open look since my first visit in 2002. Food  is still good, they do have some royal customers to keep the restaurant open is a testimonial.   Today I have the grilled pork chop rice. It come with fried spring roll, rice and the pickle salad. The spring roll is crispy. The pork chop is marinated with sweet soy sauce. They have given two chop in the dish. Good quantity. Food is good.   I have added the avocado boba Yogurt. The taste is good and the boba is chewy. We have table of seven. The food come out quick. Even one dish was mistaken too spicy, the replacement dish was on the move quickly. Service is good. My guest enjoy their fish.

This Outback is just me dale of the pack of the all the Outback I have been to. However, I still like the way they prepare the food. The service is good and we were seated immediately during lunch time.   The food presentation and preparation are very good. The seared tuna is well seared outwardly and pink in the middle. The seasoning of the seared tuna has peppery taste in the way I like. The seared tuna was overlaid the delicious salad.   The sirloin steak come in the temperature I have ask. Warm rare center and complete cook outwardly. The grilled mark make extra burn taste into it.   We were in and out in 45 minutes just good for the lunch crowd who has less time to eat. The restaurant is clean and nice.  The only thing is need customers to visit. They have good food quality control which make it perfect to enjoy.

Sus Hi meaning sushi word was separated. During pandemic, only the Togo order is allow. They do have touch less system to be order online and pickup. It is convenient to operates their online system. The order was easy on their online platform. I got to chose many topping for my poke bowl.   I got build your own regular poke bowl. The regular is three proteins. Some protein required additional cost. The topping can choose 18 items. It is convenient to select. We got two different bowl. The protein we recommended are the tuna, grilled steak and shrimp tempura. You also can choose three different sauce. Sauce to be on top of the bowl or side can be selected.   I like the their beignets dessert. It taste like mochi. But it is great with condensed milk. The most I like is the pork dumplings. It has a good dipping sauce.   They serve the sushi burrito, mini nori, sushi roll. It is simple food. They are good is because they have good flavor.

We were here for a dinner. I was not having a high expectations to come to diner. However, they prove me wrong. This American diner definitely has it place in the soho area.   We got shrimp pop boy. It has 11 shrimps count and mid size shrimp. Good value. I also like the yellow sauce add on it. Our second dish is the De Rueben. This is roast corn beef in the sandwich. The Russian dressing with the grilled toasted bread made this dish savory. Great bite to have. We choose the cucumber salad on the side go well with the sandwich.   Our last dish is tuna taco. The tuna was seared. But I think is over seared to cook the inside too. However, the bowl was good to have. It has sprinkles some tortilla chip on top.   Our service is the best for the night. That the reason I said put them in the map of soho. The food came out quick. Our experience is good here.

This restaurant is hype at Lutz area. If you happen to visit Lutz, this is more affordable Italian restaurant with a lot to offer. Reservation is highly recommended because it alway full house in the restaurant.   We started with the garlic knots and salad. The salad has good dressing. The garlic knots is a bit dry until you discover the butter sauce at the bottom.   Our entree is the Nodina di Maiale. It is pork chop in honey mustard brandy sauce. It was delicious. It also accompanied with some veggies with artichoke and sun dried tomatoes. Our second entree is the Mare e Monti. Surf and turf. It has the scallops, shrimp and veal in lemon butter sauce.   Our service is attentive. The price for the food is affordable. Atmosphere is good but I think the seating is a bit tight.

I have been to La Teresita  Restaurant several time. This restaurant is a Cuban charm in Bay Area. You can be restaurant or cafe side. The also has the bakery and cafe next to it for overflow.   Food here is affordable. You can enjoy a steak for less than ten dollars. The serving speed is fast and you don't have to wait long and the food is ready. We have the steak Palomilla Steak and the Thursday special Pescado a la Marinera. They give you a big piece of grill steak. If you ask medium rare, they usually mid well because this steak is thin.   The Pescado a la Marinera is grilled fish in tomato sauce with little shrimp and veggies. Fish is good. Come with two choices of side.   Food here is reasonable but taste is just average among the Hispanic restaurant. If you like budget and fast, this will be your place.

This ice cream replaces another ice cream store here before. Due to pandemic, they only allow take out. You can go in the store to see what you like and look at the ice cream you like. They have several selection. Currently they run a buy one get milk shake before 6pm. They also serve the ice cream sandwich. It is using cookie as sandwich. I saw many post their sandwich and look delicious.   I am here for their waffle puff. I think it is the best deal here. I got three scoop of ice cream. We got the rum raisin. The ice cream has rich rum flavor. The next scoop is the black cherry. I got the good cherry chunk. The last scoop is the mocha caramel crunch. It has good dark chocolate candy. The waffle puff is great. It is good puff   The entire thing is big enough to share. The puff is like a ball. Easily separate with ice cream. Mmmmm. It is good.

Nice set up for the place. However, missing customers. Need a serious advertising or offer to attract customers. I like the decorations and they are on their class. I think it is a discouragement for older people try to get to the top of the stair step. I wonder there is elevator to help.   We enjoy our time there. There is some good dish and some average dish. We order the shredded duck and chimichurri steak frites. The shredded duck is average. It is crispy but I think I don't feel I am eating duck because is probably fried to crispy. The duck taste is cover.   The chimichurri steak is well cook to my order. It is good piece of meat. The outside was well marinated. The accompanying frites is very good. The trick is to ask them to separate the meat from the frites so it is not soak my the meat juice and stay crispy.   Service is a bit slow. It can be instantaneous. Overal experience is good.

This review is getting below their service and and miscommunication to any club play. We were show up and surprised to inform us the badminton court can be kick out if the rain come to outside pickle ball tournaments. We have to make room for their competition if it rain. This decision make because it may rain and the badminton club will be sacrificed to make room.   They could have informed us not to come. Poor management on the center not to inform us ahead. Some of us travel 45 minutes to get here. Which is a waste. I don't like the ideal they can kick us out anytime. I rather inform us the center is use that day and cancel us instead of give us the unreasonable explanation.

Yelping 1600, Rare Ethnic Food 42, India Street Food.  This one go to local restaurant who is the up coming stars in the area. I glad that they do their food like they do it in India. No take a back step to naturalize to American taste. It is India street food and it suppose to be like it was done in India. Only one level of spiciness. If you cannot take it, do not come here. This is not your typical American Indian food. It is real to the conditions which cook in India.   With that said. I love the authenticity of the food. It is good spice. Marinated deep to the bone. We start with pani puri. It has shell crust outwardly and inwardly fill with cilantro, onion and tomato. This dish comes with the secret liquid to be pour into the opening of the crust. Then you enjoy the whole thing. It is out of body experience. I have the Apollo Fish. It is spicy and good. We also has the peppers chicken. It is very interesting to try it.   Their menu is extensive. Go find out yourself. The vegetarian side is amazing too. At lunch, they have this Tali plate that is intriguing. Don't forget they have variety desserts. They are delicious. My next visit is definitely try their biryani.

Tampa Bay Area bridges provide vital connection between the counties. Howard Franklin Bridge is the major connection with interstate system compare to Courtney Campbell and Gandy.   The Howard Franklin Bridge has seen with traffic backup for 25% of the service time. This due to the back up of Kennedy Blvd and the merge lane of the SR 60 to 275 connection. The FDOT is working on the major issue to smooth out the need of the people. A future toll system is planned for people who in hurry. The interchange on the malfunction junction will be corrected.   In the meantime, the bridge is nice to to drive on and enjoy the water view. If you hit the right time, the sunset can be seen in this bridge for full sun drop into the water horizon since it take 7 minutes to drive across. It has to be right time on the bridge which I post 1 picture I have experience the beauty.

Review # 2100 Authentic cuisine # 55. Fusion Venezuelan Cuisine   We have been here fist time but they close early. It is difficult to visit this restaurant during weekday and you are 30 miles away. Finally we have a chance to visit. The restaurant space is small. So either you have the take out or visit them at odd hour like 2 pm after lunch hour. Because they always jam pack.   Our first course is the 11 chick bowl. Great flavors. However I like the second dish with chick # 8 the Paisa. This arepa has fried egg, marinated beef, plantain, chorizo, avocado. Best combination. I like marinated beef inside. Great meal. Our last dish is sweet corn arepa with sautéed shrimp. The shrimp size is big and worth the money.   We got the cappuccino top cinnamon powder. Great thick drinks. The rating is 5 due to great pricing, great food, and tasty.

We have decided revisit again this food truck. They located very close to Hard Rock Casino. The food truck has it own lot next to the church.   This time we have the Carne Frita, Churrasco, and Bistec  Encebollado. The carne frita has good pork. Outside crispy and inside moist. It good dish to have. The Bistec Encebollado is like broil meat with onions. I am ok with that dish. The Churrasco is the best dish. It has good quality meat with marinated sauce. It is definitely a dish to get.   Food come out quick. Not much of wait. They know who we are and make the announcement in English so we know is our turn.

A Korean bar and restaurant that interesting mixed. They have inside and outside seating. We did seat at the bar area to see all the action in the restaurant. We notice the chef is not Korean and they did a good job.   We started with kimchi pancake. Normal Korean restaurant serve this dis in pie shape. They charge to triangle piece. I actually like their method because easy to bite and enable to fried on all corner of the pancake. My next dish is the beef bulgogi. This sizzling dish has good marinated sauce. I also like the banchan that go with it. It they can expand the number of banchan will be better.   Service is ok. On point. The food is impressive. It is good concept to have small menu but do well on it.

The five stars rating is real per the yelper rated this restaurant. It is very easy to locate this restaurant because it is located at round about on the Central Avenue. They serve from noodle dish to sushi stack. Don't miss their lunch special. It is a steal.   The lunch special has selection from one protein to 3 protein. Protein range from sashimi to chicken katsu. The side included sushi roll to house salad.   We start with onigiri with spicy tuna and salmon avocado. I like the flavor mixed in. Our next dish tapas sample for two. This tapas dish include tempura shrimp and veggies, seaweed salad, squid salad, chicken pot stickers. Very much sample the appetizers. Our last dish is duck ramen soup. It is quite unique. The roasted duck lay on top of the ramen. The soup base is excellent and tasty. Definitely recommend this dish.   This restaurant service is good. Definitely will visit again. It is also reasonable in price.

This food truck caught our attention due to Puerto Rican cuisine. They have some interesting selection. They have some thing that nobody has it it's called trifongo. It is a combination of three different types of plantain smash together. I am highly recommend it to try this trifongo.   Overall the menu includes shrimp, octopus, steak, chicken. If you'd like to have the combinations I would suggest try the matador. We got the trifongo, pulpo octopus, and the plantain steak sandwich. The plantain steak sandwich is excellent. This sandwich wrap with plantain skin. The steak is well prepared. The octopus also very good. Unfortunately I have a piece of bad octopus and cause my stomach ache. The trifongo is delicious.   This food truck definitely is about 4.5 stars. Unfortunately I cannot give them that due to one bad octopus. However, I am still recommending this food truck for the unique food experience. Especially the killer frape that they serve.

We have a grand dog who visiting us and we are looking for dog beach. Thanks to Rachel for letting us know the beaches accepting dog. The state park has an designated area for dog on beach without leash. We have been to the Honeymoon Island several time but never been to pet beach.   The pet beach will be the first turn out from Causeway Blvd to main beach then make a left to ward the hurricane pass at the end of the parking. You will find a path to pet beach (Tip no1). The sign on the state park do not clearly mark the pet beach. There are plenty of room for pet to roam free at this beach. It extends to the hurricane pass. The beach is shallow, we can walk a long distance from the beach and the water is only a waist height. Since I have been here before. I know the beach has a lot of stone and shells. Wear the water shoes is a plus (tip no 2). This way you can protect yourself.   The facility near the entrance pet beach path has a dog wash station to rinse off the salt water for your pet. There is no human shower near here. For people wash or rinse off, you need to get to the first turn to the main beach (tip no 3). There you rinse off the salt water. The entrance to the state park has a fees to enter. But I think it is worth with facilities after beach day.

Great to see many Yelper gather and enjoy the fun time together. Thanks to TJ organize it. It was fun to see who like it, who cannot stand the smell or who cannot take the durian straight.   Durian is king of the fruit in Asia. It look very pointy at outside. To open it, find the point of crust tip and hit it the ground to crack it open slightly. Than you can peel break it. Or use screw driver penetrate to the tip and pry it open.   Some said this fruit look like the poop and some said is a golden nuggets. This fruit is either you like it or stay away of it. When fruit ripe correctly, it has an alcohol sweet taste. The sweetness is one of the kind that you cannot imagine.   If you have durian at home, the people who visited your home will know that since the aroma of the smell will occupy the air space of your home. When the gardener or planter walk under the durian tree, they need to wear a helmet. The ripe durian actually fall to ground and that is the signed ready to eat. You don't pick durian from the tree. You wait until it fall to ground.

I write this review base on the first encounter of the restaurant. 3.5 stars is about right for the first experience. The restaurant has unique way of Thai and Mexican cuisine. The also has some fusion of the two cuisine dish. I only have the experience on the Thai side. I will update when I try their fusion dish.   This restaurant can heat it up the chili spiciness since they have the use of Mexican chili. If you like spicy food, look no further. It is sweaty hot. It also can go up a level to numb your lip.   I have the basil spicy calamari. I have order the Thai hot. It did not disappoint me. This dish is wet sauce compare to some with dry sauce. It has good flavor. My friend ordered the fried rice. I think it need a bit hot oil burn and stir fried.   Overall we like our time there. I like their watermelon boba. Close out is good and service is good.

Cool cold place. This center will be the largest in the Southeast United State. Man, women and children put on the skate to try the new ice rink. I was there the second day of opening. The restaurant is not ready yet. Public skate is started.   The facility has four big ice rinks and one small skill set rinks. One of the big ice rink (Rink D) has 400 seat for audiences. This not typical mall skating rink which is not gear for ice hockey. The big rinks are equipped to NHL standards.   Tip. Since they just open, all the figure skate rentals shoes are stiff on the fabric. Because all the rental skates are new and the fabric has not been worn and expanded. I have to go two shoe sizes up to feel comfortable.   The best deal is to find four people go with you. Family pack of 4 with skate rentals is $40. Good deal. Addition people after that is $10.   Some of the dry court actually can convert to basketball. They have indicated curling will be part of the facility and this will be introduced to the public. Excited. Never done curling before.

We meet up friend here and try the sushi. Seem like all their waitresses are Siam. They are creative enough to attract customer for their sushi.   They have out side sitting. It good for this time of year. We sit out side and we were able to see what people eating inside the dinning hall. Some of the table so close that only separate by grass window.   This restaurant is Asian fusion with Thai and sushi. I have order the spicy tuna and Bahamas roll. The spicy tuna can be improved to make it dice cube to be more firm on the fish meat. The Bahamas roll is great. It is baked chop scallop with sherrard imitation crab meat over California roll. It is tasty for this roll. The sushi is added the eel sauce and make it more pleasant.   The service average. There people smoking for little time than it was distinguished. We are glad that he did it.

Some fresh ideas. Hand roll ice cream has become popular and now in YBOR. I like the effort to keep the whole store in black light. When the customers walk in, the light already do the trick. Many has left their chalk memory at the wall that is cool color under the black light.   We have ordered the one topping and the liquid nitrogen freeze sweets roll. They have three topping for about 8 dollars. But the one topping is about $5. I like the liquid nitrogen freeze items. This is not child play item. Because the liquid nitrogen can be hazardous if you did not handle carefully. They have written instructions how to dip and eat eat the frozen food. They also have to rule about handling and disposing the liquid nitrogen.   Overall I think this is a hip place to try. Like the black light. It make you cool.

The sculpture garden display many modern arts. This is an open air garden has a lot of landscape.  The artist name and the name of each piece were presented on a stainless steel display plate. This garden is free to the public. The garden is part of the City Park and close to New Orleans museum of Art.  The art express in many way. There is giant safety pin overhang 15 feet in the air. It makes a Kodak moment snap shot. There is a Famous LOVE cut out art and we did not miss the opportunity to take a photo shot. The art pieces include a three side dog with different color, bronze statues with shooting arrow, the ladder to window in mid air, walking man bronze statues, wood branch shape to horse, seal with human hand. This art range from expression, ideal, imagination, Greek, South America native......  There are some moving art that is electric power in ever changing shape. The pieces that I like are the standing man holding a repeated squad man on top. The other one are the round hole silver piece with a strange man face reflect at the end of the hole.

The desert room is just a stroll from the Mykonos restaurant. It is easy walk and they have a few table on the outside and mostly inside.   The display was wonderful and they have all kind of cake, baklava, chocolate item, cheese cake. Many to choose from. You almost want to have each of every one. Then you become a pig out. Fortunately we already have dinner, and we just want to have a taste. We order a chocolate blanket with chocolate mousse. The blanket is make from dark chocolate. Chocolate very likable thing especially my wife.   The pricing is just right but a bit high. The out side sitting can be people watching or people watching what you have. The minutes we sat there has attract some tourist going to the store to buy the desert. We kind of outdoor advertising.

This is about 3.5 stars restaurant in my opinion. They are above average. Some dish is good and some may need to work on. But I applause their attitude to create new dishes on their special of the night.   I was surprised the restaurant has good interior and seat. We were their fist customers when they just began to open on Monday. They usually close on Monday. We have order the chicken biryanis and the Mutton Masala with rice and naan. The biryanis to me need more heavy spice. Chicken may need more seasoning. On the other hand, the Mutton or goat meat is excellent. Masala is a mixed of many spice and create the base. It may varied from different restaurant due to the mystery of the spice use. But I can said I love this dish. The naan is blend. Not sure they make it by themselves.   In order to attract more people, I think they need to change the way of business. They need to change the plastic ware for the plate and utensils to better presentable serving ware. Disposable ware shouldn't be used for the dine in condition.

We were here for a Groupon deal dinner. We have $40 deal with four people. If you have Groupon, you need to show the waiter early. He will explain what you can do which is not in the fine print. If you have two people deal meaning two Main dishes while 4 people is 4 main dishes. That way you don't just spend only $40 on app and two dish. This is important if you have Groupon and not disagree at the end.   This restaurant have very good Indian spice curry. There are some curry I never have try it before. We have lamb curry. The curry is red in compare to many restaurant is yellow curry. The lamb is Braise for some time and is folk tender. The second dish is the Chicken Do Pyaza. This is another curry with onion, ginger and garlic. I cannot make out what kind of Indian base spice. The third dish is the Garlic Tandoori Shrimp. I think the meat is not bouncy enough may be due to grilled in the oven for long time. This dish is too sour which I think it will be better without the lemon. The fourth dish is the chicken tikka. This roasted marinated chicken. I couldn't tell how much different than chicken tandoori.   Overall is good. Not really wow. But definitely good curry. I wish their grilled item is less lemon and allow taste of the marinated spice. It was good experience. If you order the tandoori dish, please be prepared to wear clothing easy to wash. Because the grilled smoke will stick to your clothes.

Rare Ethnic Food 35  I have been to many Columbian and Venezuelan restaurant but never come across a Latin BBQ restaurant. In it own BBQ way, this is unique to experience it.  You can fill your stomach under $10.    We have three dishes here. The De Carne Desmechada (Ropa Veja), Patacon, and the Pincho De Pollo. The Patacon is traditional dish of Columbia, the Patacon here is top with grilled chicken, Pork rinds. I say it is just ok. The reason I am here is to try their The De Carne Desmechada. They use two fried tostones with one on top and the other at bottom for a sandwich. The infill is Ropa veja which cook very well to accommodate the Latin style sandwich. Very tasty. We also have the Pincho with chicken kabab. It think it can use better seasoning.   Overall experience is good. I definitely come back to try some other item in the menu.

The Court of the Two Sister is the start of the Krewe of Cork. This is one of the unique Mardi Gras Krewe. The parade takes the Royal Street and Bourbon Street through the French Quarter. This is one of the five parades in French Quarter. The parade theme is about the Vino. This is a wine parade route. People pouring wine along the route and drink the wine along the route. The beads are flying everywhere. You are not sure where the beads coming from. Along the route they have two story balconies building that people throwing the beads. The parade participants are also throwing the beads. Beads.........  This parade route people are dress in the French high society costume, they holding a glass of wine at one hand and throwing beads at the other hand. Sometime the parade participant women want the men to flash the chest in order to award the special bead to them. This is very interesting. I was having a opportunity to take picture with two young ladies with naked body painted art. I have seen this in the Freemont parade at Seattle with naked painted art parade but not expect in the Mardi Gras at Bourbon Street. I am guessing anything can be happen. What happen in New Orleans Stay in New Orleans.

Fun event !!!  This Gasp with a lot talented artists for dancer, monologue, and singer. They has put up a show that is very interesting.   Gasp. Gasparilla Fringe Festival has two level of entrance ticket. The VIP include 4 drink and a tapas. The four drinks I have include bourbon with ginger ale, rum with ginger ale, and crane berry with bourbon as experience. The drink is great and easy to access.   The tapas is not impressive. I thought if Mise En Place involve, it should be good. Not so. We have BBQ pull pork, chicken vegetable rice.  I wish they can strength this section for VIP.   The shows are awesome. The modern dance include African dance, belly dancing, lyric dance. The monologue include the Tampa history in the funny way. We also have the puppet show in fringe details. The outside include the pole dance and the band. The singing is awesome. Include Broadway, Birdcage Show and more.   I would say the show put the on the top.

Birthday party, family get together, or just pure fun for night out. This is family oriented play zone. Kid friendly and "Adult Safe". Safe on the money :)  A lot of games and good for the young one. Not sure this is for the teen. Probably 12 and under is good. Food is serve here for the party. Party setup is available. They do have bowling and pool table to keep the adult interesting if you wait for your young one.   Rock climbing, miniature golf, giant connect 4 and all can be found in one place. Food stand is available. There is bumper car in this area. Certainly want to try. I wonder it is good for adult too. But check it out.

I know about this place since I have pass by the brewery a lot when I visit my job site. I have been wanting to visit it for a long time. We have farewell gathering at the brewery to send off one of our own elite. I was thankful having this opportunity to visit.   It will be fun to visit with a group of friend. There was many of us that make this trip for the farewell party. The AC area is a bit small but it have a lot of tables. After a long stand chatting, it good to find a chair to sit. The brewery has many boards games or fun games while you drink you beer. We have pick up the Jinga. The back of the brewery is non AC area also has larger item games.   This was my first visit and I go for the flight. They allow you to do as many beer you like on the flight and each glass is $2. I have selected the Cascade Amber, Nitro Shooter Brown, Berliner Weisse and the Lowball Session IPA. I like the Cascade Amber and the Lowball.   The atmosphere here is relaxing. We saw some brew bus make a stop here.

Bartaco is upscale taco place. This restaurant is better than the City of St. Pete upscale taco restaurants. They serve better taco if you consider upscale taco.   The atmosphere of the restaurant is good. Since this place is rather new, the restaurant gets a lot of traffic. They do not take reservations but will take name down 45 minutes before arrival. However, the early call in not really work since they have too many customers.   What I mean upscale taco place is the sit down restaurant place with creative taco preparation. They are some affordable taco places with typical taco preparation in the Bay Area; as a result I am not compared to that.   Most of the taco is $2.5 or $3.5 a piece. I have ordered the Baja Fish, Pork Belly, Spicy Chorizo, Fried Oyster, Curry Shrimp, Sesame Ribeye, and Duck Taco. I like the oyster, duck and pork belly tacos.   The service is great in the beginning but it takes too much time to close up for the check. I like them for quick snack in the future. I don't like the outside seating with tiny stool. I wish they can use the sofa.

I like this cafe has the unique character. The cafe display many local artists painting creation. The pieces that are display have a lot imagination.  If you like it, you can acquire it to take it home.   We were there late in the evening. 30 minutes before closing. But we were able to sneak in for the last half hours. By then all the dessert is gone. I got a quiche and request to heat it up. The quiche "Keesh" is nice and good. I have look at their menu and they have affordable price small dish or sandwich. Their breakfast menu is also attractive.   The selections of the latte are many in the coffee and tea menu. The only thing I don't like is the location of the restaurant in the crabby neighborhood. However, the area is getting makeover such as river walk and waterworks.  Open mic of the Thursday night is interesting. People performed and singing and playing music instruments.

Opening night. A lot of excitement. Free food until 9 pm tonight 11-6-2014. They have a 40 feet long of buffet table as a feast for the open night. They have cuisine of Indian, Chinese, Thai, Arabian.  The opening night party include belly dancer, hoopla hoop dancing. If you are not here, you are missing out. This restaurant locate below the  Ramada hotel.   They restaurant menu include Kosher Meat. Catering and banquet is available. The food is excellent. The goat curry is cook perfectly. There is a long line of people on the buffet opening night. I also have the tandoori chicken. It is serve at the hot platform. I have a lot food and entertainment and it is free at opening night.   They have outside sitting and full bar. Cannot said enough. This is a party. Great party.

This restaurant use to be Lee Roy Selmon BBQ. Now it is Glory Days. It is sport bar. I was surprised that not many watch the opening ceremony of the Olympic in this bar.   I have call ahead for a pickup food. I got the 12 pieces dry chicken wings. It accompanied the tangy  buffalo sauce. These wings is seasoning and drizzle with spice. The wing is not bad but do not have wow factor. It is about $1.10 per wing. Average in pricing. However it come with celery and ranch sauce. It has some value in it.   The take out should be on time when you call and you got the pick up time. They told the food should be ready in 20 to 25 minutes. And I show up at 30 minutes and still have to wait for another 13 minutes. This need to improve for the take out process.

I enjoy my time in Grey Salt with friend and family. This restaurant is newly added restaurant with beautiful interior design. All the interior decoration has a smooth line of comfort. Compare to many restaurants in hard rock, I will chose this restaurant for the best of value if you paid for the food your own without gambling complementary of the hotel.   Is the food in grey area. Certainly not. In fact, it is a good use of salt with the mixture of ingredients. Tonight we start our night with the appetizers and soup. We have the roasted octopus with two large tentacles. They were roasted a bit charcoal but they are marinated nicely. It serves over the garlic roasted small potatoes. The second appetizer is the roasted oysters lay over the crouton. The oysters was top with garlic and parsley then roasted. Yum yum. The soup of the day have some of the oysters and crunchy enhance item. It serves over bean base creamy soup over the light chili oil. It is a nice soup to have.   My entrée is the wood grilled prime skirt steak. The skirt steak is almost like churrasco but is has good balance of seasoning. The meat is soft and tender. It top over ash roasted carrots. This is very good carrots. If you going to order the extra side, the carrot is the one to choose.   Since the octopus is a bit charcoal on the exterior, the restaurant is nice enough to give us complementary desserts. I have the creme catalania which very similar to creme brûlée. The difference is instead torch the sugar of the top with open flame, they use heat iron mold to caramelized the sugar. You can request the chef to demonstrate how the caramelize is done. It is quite a show.   Overall this restaurant is 4.5 stars. The half stars is due to some of the main entree is not a wow factor. Since the service is very good and attentive, they deserve 5 stars. If you like to have a nice dinner but not over price, this will be good choice.

I have been to Mise en Place pass three time. I have not write a review because I was not a Yelp member then. For the pass three time, I enjoy the food there but there was long time ago.   Now I have revisited this place after our light party at HCC. As a result, I decided not going with the main dish. So I have two appetizers small dishes. I have the pork belly and the fried quail. Before the dish come out, there was a complimentary dish with crab meat with sauce at bottom. This is truly a good dish. The seared pork bell came out fist. Since this is first course, I think it should be quickly. But it take some time. Fortunately we already have food at elsewhere. The dish came out and the chef is clever to separate the skin from the pork belly. The skin is deep fried and the remaining is seared. It taste like Chinese crispy pork. Not impress. The bean olive oil purée is good.   The second dish is fried quail. This dish is disappointed. The quail is deep fried. But the batter is tasteless. I have to use the salt and pepper to make it more flavor. It serve over the waffle and some ketchup like sauce.   The service is ok. I think it can be a bit faster. The food delivery need to way more faster. Not sure will be back.

Good music, good weather and the most are good food. I am enjoying this festival with a strong Cuban emphasis. This is more into the Latin cuisine then just Cuban food. I have seen Puerto Rican food there. This year Cuban sandwich winners are Aloha food truck (third place), the Floridian (second place), and the no 1 winner is Trias. Their secrets ingredient is salami.   The Cuban community here is strong and they do hold this festival every year. Latin music playing at the background and people enjoy their afternoon off with family.   We have try Sergio's Cuban sandwich from Miami. The line to get the sandwich is long. It takes me 30 minutes to line up to order. The price is cheap with whole sandwich for $7. I could have just order 10 of them and sell $10 to the people line up at the back. The drinks stand that next to the hot the benefits for the people who are in the line. The sandwich is ok. I have tasted better Cuban sandwich at Miami with better mojo pork.   We also order the grilled steak meat from one of the food stand. It was juicy and nice. My wife gets the Puerto Rican food. It has the blood sausage, pig stomach soup, and bacalao fried dough. I like the fried bacalao and the pig stomach. It cooks with yellow bean base. Those are savory.   Love the festival. The organizer pull a lot of heart include donation to the homeless to assemble the longest Cuban sandwich.

This is the oldest market in the country that founded 1791. Although they are not like ancient time but it offers a lot souvenir, food, hand craft, art, jewelry, drink, restaurant for the tourist. This is a fun place to be if you are looking for bargain souvenir. If you like the vender street food, this is a place to be.   The market is open air market. Please be aware of the temperature since it is close to Mississippi River and will catch a lot of wind drift in cold weather. The restroom is pack with tourist during the Mardi Gras season. I would advise you to take the restroom at old US Mint. When they are open, they have the cleaner restroom for the ladies. It is just across the street at the end of market. No line!!!!!   The vendor of art varies from many things. It ranges from clothing to front car display plate. During Mardi Gras season, the venders also located open sky concrete pad area. There are fantastic hand craft.  Please try their street food like fried cone or roast cone. These may be a must try item and they located at Mother Nature's Cupboard. Some of the venders sell crepe on the order, oyster and crawfish. Looking for special artist item such as one of the artists can bend the wire in different color to make a ring that can fit your exact ring finger size. My wife got a Mardi Gras color ring that is very unique.    Some of the venders show up after 10 am. And that is the time the tourist show up also.

This Cuban restaurant close to Apollo Beach is one of the high ratings restaurant in the area. We like to check out if it live the rating as many Yelpers have posted. It was interesting to see so many businesses in this area once I drove off the I-75.   We have order the baby churrasco and the Cuban wannabe. The churrasco may be need a bit less lemon or no lemon. Let the customers added by themselves. I ask for medium rare, it comes medium. Meat quality is average.   My friend Cuban sandwich or Cuban wannabe is very good. Crispy and tasty. Sandwich here is good.   Service is ok. But the water cup is empty never refill. This area can be worked on. Price for lunch is reasonable medium range. Table may need to be replaced. Close out is good. Since one good dish and one below average dish with below level service is about 3 star. Average.

Bob Ice Cream and Gelato is truly rising star in the ice cream world. They are convenient located at Brandon Centre South strip mall. If come to Aldi shopping, you can visit this neighbor store. Pickup your favorite sweet treat.   The have 20 flavors ice cream and 24 flavors gelato. They also have shakes or malts. Their ice cream is no measured by scoops. It is measured by the size of cup. Price is very reasonable and affordable. You can test taste the flavor before you buy.   They pack the cup with mountain full of ice cream. As a result is more than you can bear. They also allow you to have multi flavors in one cup. I have medium size of cup and I have asked three flavors in this cup.   The interior deco is contemporary with couches or chair. Dog is allow in the store. This lovely place to chat and stay over.

Yogurt Mountain is great place to spend some time with your friend and they close half later than most of the yogurt store during weekday.  This store locates at Dale Mabry.   After dinner with a group of friend, we decided to have some desert. When we finish our dinner, it is already 9 PM. We search for many desert stores and most of them are close at 10 PM at week day. It means we only have less than 30 minute to enjoy the desert after we get there. We finally found one that will close at 10:30 which give us some time to chat.   We have arrive, we were handed the sample cup to try the flavor in store. This is paid by ounce store. You mix of partition each flavor. They are plenty to chose and we have chosen the watermelon and the pomegranate flavor. Our toping is the blue berry pop. The yogurt is very pleasant for the hot day. Our friend who brought the selfie stick took a picture with the store server with our group. It was fun night.  Somehow the yogurt store along the Dale Mabry is cheaper than the yogurt store of Bruce B down. This store server is friendly and the decoration is warming. I may be back when I have a chance to visit Dale Mabry Carrollwood area.

I has been want to try this chain for some time. This is Greek and seafood place. I was in hurry and saw them on the street. I have checked them out on the Yelp and feel it is good for a try.   The food order is delivered at average wait time since I ask my fish to be grilled. I have order seafood platter special. It come with choice fried or grilled on shrimp and fish. I have selected the fish grilled and fried shrimp. It come with French fries. The fish is not open flame grilled, it is cook over the hot plate. It does have good flavor. The fried shrimps have spice in the coating. It is pleasant to eat. Although they are not as seafood market fresh, but they are good enough.   The platter come with drink for $10.99. Average deal. It is quick and easy to dine in the restaurant.

Casa Mexicana = Supertaco.   Supertaco is actually part of the restaurant - Casa   Mexicana. I was there at 6:00 pm and they get all the ingredients to their taco truck. I just don't understand why they park their truck outside of the restaurant and sale the same type of taco. In fact the restaurant taco is $1.75 and the truck is $2.50 per taco. Guess what, I choose over roof with air condition in the restaurant. It come with free chip before the food come.   The taco is good. I like the carne Asada. The pastor has piece of grill pineapple on the top is the best taco.   Overall they are good, I like they have the salsa on the all you can take corner to load your taco. The have music jewel box for the selected music. Seem like they may have the dance party if they clear the table in the middle.

The Vine provides inside and outside sitting. We were here with friends after the Flight Festival since they are close at 2 in the morning. But the main menu kitchen close at 10:30. They have live music performed in the bar area. It is close to old folk songs.   We were sitting outside and fortunately no one is smoking that night. The Vine is a wine bar and restaurant. The inside provide live music for customers who enjoy a glass of their choice. It is very spacious restaurant in north Dale Mabry.  We have ordered the braised short rib and the grilled chop veal. The veal is with bone and it is one inch thick. The meat is cook to the order. There is some tendon near the bone area. The short rib is braise and it is in red wine sauce. I think they need to braised it a bit longer for folk tender. The sauce can be caramelized a little bit to make it nicer to appreciate.   Overall the restaurant is great to enjoy with good service. The restaurant is well decorated except they have a share rest room with the restaurant next door.

I have a chance to visit this tavern with group of yelp friend for a UYE. I have been book mark this location for some time. This is good tavern with nice set up. This restaurant bar is converted from a corner house. It has unique set up for interior decoration. The outside and inside seating is comfy.   Not many bar serve good food. This is one of good food bar. They cover the restaurant and the bar food well. You can order dinner for a nice eat out or snacks for bar items.   This bar do have good selection of wine to choose from different country. It also has many local brewery favorite include several I like such as Coppertail. They also have the stout selection. Unfortunately they don't have Guinness.   It has vegan options such as mushrooms hotpot, roast acorn squash, veggies burger. I would said got to try it yourself.

This is a two day long festival that was organized by multicultural or society. The events are fun and interesting. This event was organized along the the Tampa River Walk. There are several city parks were utilized and form several events along the walks.  The parks included Curtis Hixon, Waterworks, MacDill, Cotanchobee, Staz, and the Sail Pavilion.   The biggest events were hosted at the Curtis Hixon park. It has wiener dog derby, hot dog festival, hot air ballon glow, numerous artists song performance. This year due to dry conditions of the ground, the fireworks was canceled. The concert is still good by the artist. Pepping host the VIP tent that very close to the orchestra concert stage.    The crowd show up in number. Thanks to the city for organizing the such a very people event. It has everyone enjoy the free time.

We were near the St. Pete downtown and my colleagues suggest the red Mesa for lunch. I was here before and I was having dinner last time. This is the first time I having lunch.   The location is convenient for the downtown St. Pete. They have the outside and inside sitting area. Today is heavy pollen time with the oaks tree is blooming, sitting out is not a good idea. The setting is very modern. It may be a good place lunch bite get on the way to work. The food came out quick for this restaurant during lunch time.   I have order three taco. The duck, steak, and ahi tuna taco. The ahi tuna is seared and mix with green, wasabi and soy sauce. I feel that the tuna is not well season. They did not seared long enough to allow fish burn taste. The steak taco is mixed with Rajas and jack cheese. I am not a fan. The duck taco duck is orange duck. By adding the goat cheese, it destroys the beauty taste of the duck orange sauce. Sometime thing should not mixed together and this one of the example.   Acoustic guitar live music was performed here. Overall the serving is great and the food came out fast make they deserve 3 star.

The restaurant is interesting with the radio remote controller on the table. You can catch any tv screen and tune to that channel for the remote radio to listen in. Unfortunately our radio is too low on volume even we turn to the maximum.   Tuesday the restaurant have daily special on the half slab on $9.99. However, I am going for the different special with rib and pull pork for $12.99. This is more worth than the daily special. With additional $3 you got extra meat and orange claw slaw. The rib is good. The pull pork is ok. Overall they are good portion for hungry person like me. Compare to many baby back rip, the are in the medium. No wow factor. May be the Cuisine R&D can improve this.   Service is good and quick. I like their Skinny Acai Cucumber Spritzer. It is tasty for the cocktail.

This CVS is the closest location to my home. They services is implacable. The store front is well lit and same for the parking lot.   The store aisle is well organized and easy to locate. Some time I have my picture develop here. They have quick deli station for milk and juice. When come to Halloween, it decorated with the candies you like. I like to but the after sale of good candies after the valentine day. All great candies after Valentine Day are minimum 50% off.   This section is why they deserve 5 stars. The pharmacy is the best in this area. The people in the pharmacy are super friendly. When you sick, you are happy to see a friendly face. The pharmacist is very knowledgeable. I remember every time he handed the RX to me, he always explains to me number pills need, after of before the meal, what should not go with pills, best time to take it, any of my questions. This extra mile they have done. When you have indicated to the Doctor office where your regular pharmacy is, they will put the order in that pharmacy. I always got call from the CVS pharmacy when my RX is ready. I don't need to wait at the pharmacy. If I wonder around that area, they always ask if I need help.  The friendliness store makes the neighborhood tighter. They have taken the extra mile.

Stay healthy better quality of life, this is a place to be. Even I not that conscious about the choice of material or ingredients of food, I shop at this place some time.   The Earth Origins Market sound correctly and earthy for the product they have carry. From the organic produce to organic raise meat selections, provide variety of value food. It has all natural cookies- Mmmm yum. It has selection of salad bar if you just has one person portion for a night.   The hot deli has good choice if you decide not to cook. For ice cream- ice cream? It has the talent I gelato. Not many place sell this this ice cream. The place is not packed in the morning and easy to shop. It almost like has the whole place for yourself.   The fresh produce is great, the organic powder for cooking is better. It close to the beach and good for the vacationers stay at the hotel with kitchen want to cook themselves.

Buya will be easy to miss while you walking on the sidewalk of central Avenue. If you not look up to the sign, you will pass by thinking this is a bar. This is an interesting place that this store have special to offer.   In the cold night with temperatures in the low 60, it is good to have a bowl of noodles soup. We saw the menu has some fusion Japanese ramen. It is creative. We order a bowl of Oxtail ramen to share. The waitress is kind enough to bring two small bowl for us. It not cheap but big enough to share if you like.   The oxtail is braise then pan fried the outside to crispy. The soup is pork base but very different from tonkusu. The ingredients include two types of mushrooms. Soup with veggies and meat in very good harmony way. If you talking about soul of the cuisine, it has one.   Service is good and attentive. They at least has good comfortable chair compared to some restaurant we have in Seminole heights.

It is a small market. Easy walk on and finish less than half hour. The parking is simple on the roadside on the Main Street or side street. It is about half of blocks on the 4th Avenue of City of Safety Harbor. Close to the Gazebo. The Facebook page show the schedule of the farmers market if you want to be sure they hold one at that weekend.   The farmers market is lacking of many farmers display. Only one veggies farmer vendor. There are no food vendors at all. A lot of small item artist display. One good thing is there are a lot trees to provide cover on the street.

This is a fancy mall in the Bay Area. The mall is all enclose in the AC except the restaurant section. It has good selection of national recognized restaurant chains. Some of the restaurants are Cheese Cake Factory, Capitol Grille, Brio Tuscan Grill, California Pizza Kitchen.  The stores inside the mall include Apple Store I have frequent visit and learn new stuff. My wife likes the H&M. However, H&M report they have lost revenue in U.S. nationwide. She like this store due to the design is from Europe. I have time myself nonstop walking from one end to other end in 10 minutes walk. That is count from Nordstrom to Apple Store.   I don't like the parking lot arrangement for this mall. Most malls have inner loop and outer loop. This mall cut off each section and only allows going to each section by outer loop. This is very inconvenient.

Cute little store along the central avenue. I have seen this place because my Yelp friend review. I cannot believe they are at the $ category. As a result I have try them out.   Their price is at affordable range. Majority of the items are under $10. But I go for the most expensive in the menu. The mix grilled. It has chicken, steak and kefta (ground lamb). The dish come with basmati rice and two sides. We go for grilled veggies and the babaghanoush. You can feel chunks egg plant in the babaghanoush. We also add the falafel. The dish comes with good presentation. The steak is the best among all three types of meat. All meat was grilled very well not burn.   It is almost like cafeteria style order at the counter and food bring to the table. Service is good.

This will be marked my end of double digit review (review 99). I will start my review by simply saying::great restaurant. Every time we pass by there is a line outside. The wait for dinner is 1 hour average. They don't take reservation. The best way to get to the restaurant is during their opening and during parade. We have found a trick to get to this restaurant. YELP has indicated the restaurant open at 11:00 am, they are actually open at 10:30. I am using this advantage to beat the crowd by 10 minutes to get a seat.      Today lunch we have ordered the chargrilled oysters, fried crab craw, fried crawfish tail. The chargrilled oysters are season with garlic and salted and cook over the open flame. After you have eaten the oyster, you can dip the bread into the half shell to pick up the remaining seasoning sauce on the shell. Mmmm it is very good. The oysters here are better than the one we have in Florida. They are fresh and big. Somehow the swamp water breeds a better oyster. The fried crawfish tail is great to go with the beer. The fried blue crab craws are much better in this case. It is heavenly good. We were joking may be order to go order and sell with double price for the people who are waiting hour in line.   Since they are open for lunch at 10:30 am, it is consider brunch. You actually can skip the breakfast at Cafe du Monde and come here for better food experience. I have pick this restaurant to be one of the best in New Orleans to close my double digit review.

We like this pawn shop because you can have some good deal here. We were here for the music instrument. We are looking for the amplified and the base electric guitar. We found one Music Man base guitar with five strings. We have check online for the model and price. It is about the range that we want to paid for the use base guitar.   Clerk is friendly, easy to talk about. The guitar is well keep. We actually call ahead before we come. They were welling to provide a picture for us to look at it before our physical visit.   The store has motorcycle like ninja Kawasaki. Gun. Good amount of hand gun. Tools and more. Music instrument include guitar and amplified.

I come here a lot. This time come at 7:45 am, it is empty and easy to walk around. They usually has front clerk to greet people and answer the question. But the morning, the still try to get to the station. No one greet you or tell you where the aisle you can find your item.   I like the parking space in front of the shop. There are plenty of space to park including extra space for pick up at the front. I was here to pick up a few item for measuring devices. I got the 25 tape measure with special finger stopper. It has an ability to suspend 8 feet without breaking the tape. I also wheel measurements device allow longer distance measuring.   At the electrical department I pick up couple items. The electrical test pen for voltage and the test pen for metal to see if high electricity was connected. Those are good device to have before working on the street light pole and ensure no electricity on the outward metal.   Overall I still like it. Some time they goods are disorganized. Most of the time they are in good order.

Hillsborough system library that located at Carolwood. This library frequently host event to entertain the guess and library patrons. Book is alway on the move and circulation.   The facility has glass enclosure room for children and storytelling. It has small meeting rooms for program, tutoring, or quiet study. It has a big conference room for special programs. We were there for a special program of toy piano festival. The demonstrators play and very baby babies piano. They show case the upright and grand toy piano.   If you know about the library hive program, they sophisticated computer class. It has hand on special learning. Wifi is available but is slow. Good comfort area to sit and enjoy your reading. Do you know they have teen SAT club. This club can help your kid in preparation of SAT. They also has DVD you can bring hoe if you enjoy the movie.

Sunset is gold at 360 roof top. When the weather has a clear day, the roof top viewing is great. This bar is located on top of the Hotel Zamora. I like St. Pete for one of the reasons due to many roof top bar. 360 is one of them.   If you come to restaurant or bar the valet is free. There is no street side parking near by. You will require to take two set of elevator to go to this bar. The bar has comfortable seating with couch over the roof top. It provide 180 degrees view on one end beach front view and the other 180 degrees view on the bay side view.   The bar is very busy during the sunset hour. You can find more quite space at the bayside view. They also have the round couch to hold your party. Please check their calendar for special event and live entertainment. Happy hour and half price app are also available.

Tapas. Drink. Spanish Food. Place to hang out in classy way. This is the place.   The Vizcaya is just like it name Tapas Bar Restaurant. The ambients display with a color full toro art at the entrance and some charcoal bull painting. It also has the toro bull fighters dress that is very colorful. It mimics the bull fighting in Spain. The dinning hall set up is very nice. Live piano music are at one of the night.    We have ordered the Zarzuela de Mariscos and North Atlantic Lemon Sole with Jumbo Lump Crabmeat as entrees and Cazuelita de Conejo as tapas or appetizer.
