The appetizer is a braise rabbit meat in wine sauce. Like sauce very much. The Zarzuela is mix of seafood with fish, shrimp and scallops over rice with seafood sauce. Very similar to Puerto Rican mafungo seafood base sauce. The sole is top with tomato base crab meat. This dish may be can improve by pan seared the sole with light marinated spice. I have sole in Spain and they can prepare the sole better.   Overall it is very good experience. Like the pre-meal bread dipping sauce.

This Bluegreen resort is fun place to be. This resort cover ground is big. You may get lost in the resort but you don't need to get out since the can provide anything you need.   This is first time I have seen a resort with bar crawl fun exploring. They are over ten bars in the resort. Almost every corner has one. They even have 5 bar and 5 tapas deal too. Please check it out.   This resort have several sections and building. You need to know where you are. The amenities include put put golf, oversized chest set, paddle boat, outpost hotel, touch tank, konk children center, pet play zone, pirate island.... Let play. On top of that, the owner of the time share has the pass for the water slide, shark riding, surfboard riding. That not include the swimming pool, sauna, hot tub, whirl pool, beach cabana, beach access, beach volleyball, tennis court, water sports.   Food can range from Pizza Hut to candle light dinner in established restaurant. Activities after another one that can occupy your stay there. We enjoy live music at daytime next to the pool.

May be the most affordable restaurant Chinese restaurant in the casino. The only thing I don't really get is the seating is really limited at this area. If you have a lot of demand, why not give up some space. I am guessing each gambling table is worth more than a person seat at the somehow fast food bar.   They have many good reviews. It because their BBQ dish. Some of the BBQ items is from off site and bring it into the restaurant. However they do have good flavor. The BBQ items included roast duck, BBQ pork, crispy pork. This item mixed with rice in duck sauce and make a good simple meal.   I have order the oxtail noodle. This is actually the most expensive dish. Since it is their prepare meal. I really want to try their actual cooking skill. The meat is separated from the bone. The soup is almost like beef stew soup. This dish is not special enough to worth for the price you paid. I have better.   This is about 3.5 stars restaurant but not quite there. However, I do give them the first consideration instead of casino food court.

The location of the restaurant as part of the city water park make the unique setting. The backdrop sunset can be better to tell the story of restaurant.   We arrive at the restaurant at Sunday night 5:50 pm and the wait line is already require 50 minutes of wait. We decide to sit at the oyster bar and have our dinner. The menu is interesting. To start we have the pulpo carpaccio - shave octopus with spicy source. While we were sitting there, there are worker open the oyster. After we have finish the octopus while waiting for the entree, we decided to order the oyster. I ask the worker can we select the oyster for the charbroil. They allow me to select. I have select the bigger and nicer oyster and the send to the kitchen to cook.   The oyster is definitely the best dish of the appetizer. For the entree we have order the Florida Pompano and the Chief red Eagle Duck. The duck is ok and they try to imitate the French cuisine Duck O' lean. The pompano is tasty however the fish is not salty enough. I believe they can be better. For our entree we have wait for 30 minutes after the appetizer was finish. The time to wait is too long.   Our fellow elite yelp member is overrated this restaurant. The price range is expensive but the food is  mediocre. The only dish that impress me is the charbroil oyster. If you notice, half of the entree menu items are open grill cooking not stir fry or pan sear. This tell you the skill of the chef and their capability.

I would this store is good for any starter with their beginner guitar. You can find it below $500. May to start your own guitar garage band. They many type of guitars. Electrical guitar with acoustic or base. Their guitar has classical and ukulele. Other than guitar, they have the key board, amplified, semi hollow, foot change.   The store clerk is helpful, they have special on sale and give away on the drawing if you sign up with your email. Other items they carry are stage use light, mic, sequencing light, electrical paddle, speaker and more. It show you can be one person band or multi people band. They also have guitar lessons. They carry item is not top of the line but definitely have what you want or they can order for you. The store space is big. You can try out their instruments at sound proof room.

This restaurant book mark for a while. I heard good good thing about them. The lunch special is affordable for the people. For short lunch, basically you can in and out the restaurant in 50 minutes. Great for the office people who work here. There were several tables are regular customers and I noticed them because they know the waitress here.   I got the Yakitori to start. The yakitori is Japanese squid ball. The come with six balls. Good presentation and great taste.   I got the lunch special come with soup. They have only choice for soup or salad. Many Tampa sushi lunch come with both. Not sure their dinner accompanying both option.   I got spicy tuna and nitro eel. Each roll come at eight pieces. Good spicy tuna preparation and great marinated. So far the food is fresh. Good service.

I like Cake Girls mini cup cake. It has at least twenty flavor at any given day. They have mini cupcakes, wedding cake, cake all occasions, ice cream, regular size cupcakes, cake pop. They also has package deal.   We were here for their special mini cupcakes and the ice cream. I have two flavors ice cream with strawberry and dulce de leche. This ice cream is creamy. It has good flavor. For the cup cake, I like the French toast, banana split, dream side and s'more love.   The special includes the mini Monday - mini cup cake reduces price, two for Tuesday on ice cream, Friday four pack for $5. Wednesday and Thursday 3 pm to 5 pm is 10% off day. Those are good day if you visit. Since this is the only mini cupcakes not a chain franchise, the owner takes extra care of the business. It is up on quality for your visit.

This Wawa has is not the cheapest in the area. The gas station is clean. During my visit, many has visited this place. It has plenty gas pump to handle the rush traffic hour. They have free air to the vehicle tires. However, it is cover for out of service. Not sure when will it back.

City of Tampa is vibrant city. Especially for Yelpiest people. There are many Yelper in City of Tampa. I am one of them that Yelping this city now. Live it, love it, enjoy it.   The city has many good mayors in the past including the current one. They have make good use of tax money include city park, city festival, city walk. The newest park is the waterworks park which attracts a lot of visitors. The city also have a lot of festival held here including the Shakespeare, food truck rally, movie night. Not to mention, the Curtis Hixon park just completed the riverfest that draw thousands of visitors.   The city project includes world class river walk project that bind along the Hillsborough River with leisure walk that tie all the parks together. The city of Tampa have their area from downtown Tampa extended to the New Tampa area. This wide area of living has many good pocket to choose.   Food is vibrant. The Seminole Heights, Hype Park, Palma Ceia, Historic YBOR, Gandy and Soho are good pocket for food. The city really has a lot to offer. It depends on the people who live there that create the dynamics effect for the good of the community.

I have this restaurant book mark for a while. Finally I found a time to visit. The restaurant tuck away in a busy plaza. Parking always challenging here. The restaurant has inside and outside seating. I went straight to the bar since I am solo that day. The bar has good display of alcohol bottles.   The menu for the brunch hour is extensive. Selection is wide range. Base on the yelp picture, the steak and egg is popular. But one of the menu item changes my mind. I got the lobster omelette. This dish has lobster, provolone, tomato and wrapped in the egg. The side is potatoes hash. The lobster is three little lobster crawl. I wish it has some body meat for the price we paid.   The service is good. Food come out quick. But the food didn't sit well with the stomach. Something not quite correct about the freshness.

This restaurant has high ratings. However, I found that not match the experience I have there. I visited the restaurant after 8 pm. Still have table waiting for food and some people order the take out. Not too busy.   I have order the spicy drunken noodles with shrimp. I have specific order. I want my noodles dry which mean don't let the juice come out. I also order it to be Thai spicy hot. While I wait for the food, they do have special day combination or pre prix dish on holiday. Look interesting.   When my noodles come out, there are wet sauce every where. Which mean it was not on the wok too long. Because no burn mark at the noodles. The dish is medium spicy. Not even close one step below Thai hot. This too difficult to fixed. One good thing is they have good size fresh shrimp. I didn't ask for redone due to time.   This is been there done that.

Guy Harvey Outpost is part of the Tradewinds Resort. This resort is not link to the main building. It is about 900 feet with each other with a building in between of them.  The resort was name after a local artist Guy Harvey who draw the the local area marine wild life and fish. A lot of his drawings is on the wall or hang as a frame on the wall.   This resort has several restaurants and bars. Rumfish Grill is one of them. The back of the resort is open to beach with pool and hot tub. If you stay there, you can use the facilities in the main resort which is 900 feet away.   In the hotel they have the touch tank experience that allow you to touch the little see creature such as chocolate chip star fish. Sound yummy but nice little creature. They also has the tiny horseshoe crab with shell still soft. Other creatures are Hermit Crab, Sea Urchin, and Brittle Star.   Come experience your self if you visit the Rumfish Grill. We have a drink at night at the beach front and enjoy the acoustic guitarist performed.

About 3.5 Stars. This store is grocery and serving food restaurant. It is interesting combination. Many customers was here to have the food dine in. I got my food to go. Please allow 20 minutes to order ahead before pickup. They need to prepare the food.   We got the mixed grill. Cost is about $30. It is big enough for two people. In the mixed grill, accompanied rice, salad, and more. The meat has five types. These meats include shish kabab, chicken kabab, inegol kofte, Chicken gyro, lamb gyro. It was a lot of meat to have. Marinated sauce deep into the meat. Tasty for the food.   The pickup is smooth, the payment is minimum the touch less during pandemic. Server wear mask.

These one of the few healthy store around the soho area. For the New Year, everyone is conscious on the intake of the food. New Year resolution play the major part of the goal this year. Soho Juice can be a solution to your goal.   The have the healthy meal bowl that you can take home. Their juice program to clean your body also available. It has daily and weekly program. They are expensive. Not sure it worth the money. The product they carry include juice, meal, soft serve, Acai bowl, and more. I saw they have display gluten free, sugar free, allergy free, guilt free donut. Except they are not free of charge. Haha.   We got the swirl chocolate and vanilla. This is special chocolate make with nothing taste like chocolate. But it is healthy. Our topping is the blue majits. It is actually blue honey. The entire soft serve is flavorful. Love it. It do not carry food coloring which stain your lip. They are actually 4.5 stars in my book.

We were here after lunch. The restaurant is visible at main street. Parking is at the back of building. Not all parking available due to reserve parking of other businesses.   It is cute dessert restaurant. But I feel their price is at the high side. May be due to their location. We didn't try their drink items. We did get the waffle. We have the Kennedy Bubble waffle. It has the banana, strawberry, Nutella and coconut flakes. The bubble waffle is too soft and we feel waffle need to cook a bit longer for it to crispy. In compare to Bay Area bubble waffle, they are below average.   Wait was short to have the waffle ready. Just need a bit patience.

Rare Ethnic Food 30.   When they first open, I already book mark this place. I saw a lot of my Yelp friend has visited this place. Many good reviews on this place. I got to try it. It take me 7 months of wait to try this Portuguese restaurant. The wait is over, we are finally here. It take some convincing for long distance driving to reach here but no regrets.   We order the duck fat pork belly, Karaken A Luanda and the special of the day is blacken sword fish in grit. The duck fat pork belly  is three layers of happiness pork that put together. It use the duck fat braise the pork. The sauce is awesome. Karaken sounds like deep sea monsters. However, I am eating it:) it is octopus and escargot at tamarind sauce serve with bread crackers. This is the best dish.   The sword fish was perfectly blacken over the top to give the flavor. The bottom fillet was soft and good. It serve with grit and fried okra. This is a good entrée.   Service is superb. The ambience is ok. The down stairs has open mic if you want to try out.

This new Indian cuisine is located in the heart of Carrollwood. If you find Chili's, they are just next to it. They offer weekday lunch buffet for about $10 and weekend buffet $13. There is a lot Indian customers dine there when we were there.   We were there for the weekend buffet. It has good selection. If you are meat eaters, there will s a lot of choices. During the Saturday lunch buffet, they have goat, chicken and shrimp. The goat curry is fantastic. The tandoori chicken is marinated to the bone. It is quite tasty. The tempura shrimp may be with tikka sauce ( not sure ) is good.   Why three stars. A lot of improvement need to be made. 1. Services need to paid attention when customers water is empty. 2. Temperature of the food is at warm condition not temperature hot. 3. The food is too American. Not spicy enough. May be the spice need to improve a bit to make it stronger.

Newly open restaurant. Second day in business. Hip place with sushi bar. The surrounding has not fully open for business but this restaurant is ready. It is located at Causeway Blvd. it is easy to access from the I-75 exit SR 60 take Falkenburg South and right to Causeway and they are on the north side.   The building is new and the so do all the interior is new too. The menu price is at medium range. We started Tako Yaki. It come with 5 pieces to share. Good coating and round as you seen in Japan street food. We also has six pieces of yellowtail scallions sushi. Good enough meat. The Chicken Karage is crispy. Good coating. May be a little salty may help.   Our main course are the Kiwami Ramen - Tonkotsu Ramen. Good enough pieces of charshu. Very good porch egg with flavor. Their pork broth is at the light side. This is their style. I like the most is their Kiwami Torch. It is spicy king crab top with torch white tuna. Very flavorful.   Food come out quick. Service is good. I give them an A for just open and paid attention to detail. It is about 4.5 stars restaurant. Since the quantity is is less for ramen and chicken Karage, it is 4 stars.

Close to 3.5 stars restaurant. I applaud their good price for people who craving for sushi. Although they may not the best, but judging for the affordable, I will give them a repeat visit which most of the owner is asking for. A repeat customer.   This is close to cafeteria style with order at the counter and bring the food to the table. Their regular sushi is under $5. Specialty sushi is about $9. They have hibachi for your order.   I have order the appetizer as fried rock shrimp. This is good size of shrimp. Each piece is about a dollar. Our main entrées are the stir fry beef noodle, spicy tuna, volcano roll, and Hawaii roll. Spicy tuna roll stands out for the taste. Good flavor. The specialty roll are drop behind the good name.   I would try their lunch special if I am here. Better than fast food chain for the same amount of money.

This is the place they open up after they close the Water Avenue store. It has a lot improvement from old place. Parking getting better. Food control also getting better. Sitting is better, more room for customers. But one thing is they are competed with established local taco restaurant. They have huge menu allow them to have more choices than other. Hopefully will bring more customers.   I got the grilled grouper quesadilla. The grouper is blackened and grilled but I did not feel the flavor of blackened. It may need to be heavier spice. The quesadilla is average. My wife have the Carnitas burrito which is much better than my order. The carnitas was well marinated. They also pack a lot into the burrito with meat. It make the hungry people enjoy the meal.   Overall our experience is good. Improvement has been made.

It is adding a twist into this location. Today I found out they have added Token Ramen. Now we can call them street food of Asia. Kung Fu Tea already has the Taiwanese street food and drinks. Now by adding the ramen, they become my recommended visit restaurant.   This update review put the restaurant to 5 stars because they are only one I know for Kung fu tea has Ramen. The chef here already has good skill for the Taiwanese food in compare to many Kung fu tea I have visited. I like the lunch special and the chicken nuggets. Those are the best. Now they added the ramen. I got the tonkutsu broth ramen. The soup is thick. It is flavorful. Love it.   The area is big and accommodate a lot people including the patio seating. Service is good. I also like their boba drinks.

Rare Ethnic Food 43. Caribbean Smoke Jerk Cuisine.   Usually you will see Jerk BBQ chicken. The chicken mostly grilled. This one has a twist with Caribbean Smoke Jerk Chicken. The chicken is marinated with the special house sauce. The marinated is to the bone. It was greatly prepared. As a result, when they are out of food, they close for the remaining day. They also has Smoke Jerk Pork. Both items are very delicious. I like the chicken wing a lot. I would said you got to eat there. Because, when they just take out from the Smoker, the skin is still crispy. That why you need to eat at the table or in your car. DELICIOUS. Now with that said. Some time by luck, you can have their specialty rack of lamb. My goodness, those are amazing. Check out my picture.   Don't get disappointed if they close because they run out. I have actually try visiting this place three times before I actually got to try their food.

Great shave ice. Why....  it does not left the food color at you tongue. I like it very much. This store is about 4.5 stars not full 5 stars. If the service can have the smilies face to customers, probably 5 solid stars.   This is a food truck in front of the plaza parking lot. I like they take an effort to fence it and decorated with plant and straw like umbrellas. It is good effort. We got Hawaiian Rainbows with passion fruit ice cream. It is definitely good for the picture. The shave ice was pile on the cup. The best thing is the color fruit flavors syrup was pull to bottom of the cup. Some other place they don't give enough syrup and the bottom shave ice did not receive it. Not this place.   The passion fruit ice cream is unique. They have some other flavors I like to try next such as Allota Colada, Green Paradise, Onalicious.

The food here is cheaper than many Americans fast food. If you are going spend money in the McDonald might as well to check it out for the better choice other than Hamburger. For the same price you can get a meal for less than $8.   This is my first visit for the restaurant at the mall. I have visited many Panda Express at the Airport food court. Time to time they have the new product. Today they have the Peking Pork. It is boneless pork cover in Peking sauce after deep fried. It is delicious. The noodle may be need some work to make it less drier and boil it longer.   I like Strings beans with beef. Overall this good value. It has all the nutritional need. If you are hungry, you can choose more protein. The price just slightly expensive for you hungry stomach. Service is good.

It is about 3.5 stars. The restaurant is a fast food chain. It has seat in the restaurant if you decide to dine in. This my first time have Peck. I like the selection of the side. This restaurant combines the flame broil chicken with Mediterranean food. You can said this is a chicken place.   Somehow the chicken pieces are smaller. But the marinated sauce is into deep part of the meat. Good for the taste and likeness of the meat. The two side order we have is the collard greens and rice and bean. The collard greens was prepared well.   The mixture of side make the restaurant attractive. The order only take 5 minutes to wait. Not bad at all.

Grocery store??????? A pizza and beer restaurant is more like it. The name of the restaurant is base on historic grocery store was here. It do has some craft beer.   The pizza we order tonight is bring the noise. It has all kind of meat items such as bacon, pepperoni, sausages, meatballs, ham. The smaller pizza is 16" is good for 4 people. It also has fresh veggies ingredients to go with it. They claim the pizza is stone bake and suppose to be healthy pizza. We also add a bake chicken wings without the hot sauce. It has herb on top but is salt less.   This restaurant is about 3.5 stars for the food and performance. A few thing can be improved such as take home box should not be single plying cardboard. It should be pizza box. Because the oil of the pizza will sip below the box and oil your car seat. Weekend may need more help since many show up at the restaurant.

Rare Ethnic Food No. 21  If you have been to Asia night market especially Taiwan or China, you will find this type of food. I am glad that Temple Terrace has established this restaurant that have this capability. This is classified as a street food. They are savory and good snacks.   We are here for snack that is close 9:00pm. They have two type fried chicken. Fried chicken fingers or chicken row. You probably understand chicken fingers. Chicken row are fried bread chicken breast and cut into pieces. This is my favorite. The breaded coating is not normal flour. It is crispy and the Chinese spice is in it. They are very good taste.   They also have curry items. But I am interesting on their pig feet, cool tilapia, and the Szechuan Sweet pork rib. I may have to come back to try it.   I am excited to their price also. $3.89 for one whole box of chicken row. Very affordable. If you select the meal, you can ask the spring roll for the side and a soft drink come with it.

Chuy is new Tex Mex in the Wesley Chapel. They have the new building that design into their requested ambient. The interior decoration includes the Elvis 60 style set up. The space is beautiful. It is comfortable.   One best thing about this place is the price and food quantity. This I no doubt the generous restaurant we have seen in Wesley Chapel. A lot of items have good value.   For the taste is what they need to improve on. I feel they lack of taste. We got the steak fajitas. It come with 3 flour taco. It has guacamole, cheese, salsa, sour cream, rice, and caramel onion. The second dish is the combo special with taco and green enchilada.   Service is average. Food come out to the table on time. I did not try the drink. We don't need to wait for the table when we get to the restaurant.

Dickey BBQ is middle of the pack among the BBQ joints. If you have coupons, the deal is very sweet. Dickey grill and smoke the meat. It has different meat to offer. The best are the pull pork and brisket.   You can order plate (combination meat), sandwich, meat by 1/2 pound. The plate has good deal and you can choose two or three meat plate. It come with drink, two side and the price close to $12. You also can enjoy the soft serve for free. We got the burn end brisket and pull Pork. It was very good the day we have visited them. They were going to throw away the side fat and o ask them just put in my plate.   The BBQ franchise was established since 1941. This restaurant is young at Wesley Chapel. This was our third visit and it still good. I think they need to increase number employees since this area is just lack off.

This gas station has had 20 pumps. It is at least one available for the customers. Consider this is a plus. No wait is needed. The price is consider low in this area. Compared to entire Tampa Bay Area, their price is reasonable. The display price is credit or cash is same price which is I like.   The gas station is clean outside. The security cameras every where in their compound. Some of the cameras to the pump which make this area secure at night.

This is second Mellow Mushroom we have been to. Basically is pizza, calzone, burger, wing, and salad place. Really is nothing fancy. In compare to some of the wood fire pizza at nearby restaurant is just average.   We got their house special pizza. The meat is nothing special. The crust is too thick. We also got their wing.  But there are better wing place nearby. It is oven roasted. But the marinated is not impressive. House salad is good.   Service is better. May be this is only good thing about the restaurant.

This restaurant is tuck away and part of the plaza of gas service station. The restaurant has some inside seating area. During COVID-19 condition, dine in has not been allow.   We got one of the jerk shrimp skew and one of the jerk chicken. They did not have oxtail during my visit. Jerk shrimp will need a longer wait which they have told me. The jerk shrimp skews were grilled with jerk sauce, I like this appetizer. The jerk chicken was BBQ with right amount of jerk marinated seasoning. It is marinated to the bone.   Overall take out experience is good. Price is at the high side especially at Riverview area. Value to taste is about 3.5 stars.

It is strange to name the restaurant four brothers. I wonder which brother. They have southern, middle eastern, Italian, pastry. I wonder each brother are different in cultures. This concept is definitely well accepted.   Predominantly this is middle eastern food. We got the whole rusted chicken with two side. The chicken is marinated with yellow spice. It was split to half and grilled to perfection. I like the chicken with juicy meat. It is wonderful to eat. The side is amazing. We have dirty rice and baba ghanoush. The dirty rice has ground meat and sliced gizzards. Very interesting.   The gyro is good. Not particularly impressed. If I visit next time, I would try their grilled snapper. It look interesting. This restaurant is 4.5 stars. Because the price match the food given.

We were so happy to revisit the ramen place I like. I was look forward to try the seafood ramen and crispy duck ramen. The seat was easy and quick since they are not busy. Our food come out right time without too much of waiting. The food are presentable. All this are good.   Two minutes into the food we immediately find the noodle is not right. Some of the noodle are glued together. Seem like 5 Strings becomes one string. My wife noodle is very gooey. This is not acceptable. I think my noodle was sit for a while and my wife noodle was not processed correctly. In Asia, the noodle need to be broil and put in the cold water to cool off and the same time wash away the extra flour that attached to avoid gooey. This is the basic. I think their chef has not pay attention to our bowl and skip step. That cause the entire noodle are not good at all. If this happens in Asia, they will not be acceptable.   I think with each bowl we paid $16 a piece. It is not to any standard and not to the art of ramen. Not worth the money. Inconsistency does cause this restaurant to be changed my opinion of number one ramen in the Bay Area to I am not sure to revisit again. I have drove 38 mile just because I have the best experience on the first encounter. Now, I am not sure their future.

Rare Ethic Food 8  This is a 4.5 stars restaurant. Since Yelp do not has half star. They are 5 stars. I was wanted to come to this place for a long time. It was too far from New Tampa. I have heard good thing about this place from many of my yelp's friends.   The Korean cuisine here have some strong items are their best selling. We have Kimbap as appetizer. It is rice roll with meat, fish cake, sausage, veggie and more. It is good to start item.  We also has the bacon wrap scallop. This is the reason they have half star less. They have the bay scallop instead of sea scallop.   We have lunch special with Beef Galbi. This is their best seller. The short rib was cook perfectly. The selection on the rib is very soft and tender. Good balance of seasoning.   Overall service is very good. I would come back for their lunch with reasonable price.

It 4.5 stars not yet 5 stars. The reason they are good rating due to good pricing, good food, good ambient, and good service. It popular among the local.   We start with spicy crunchy roll and eel roll. It it decent with 8 pieces each. Fish is good. Spicy tuna also good. We also got one of the specialty roll. It is the scallops volcano. The bay scallops was on top. The inside is the crab tempura. We also got a bento box sushi. It has 4 pieces of fish sushi, California roll, goyoza, rice and salad.   Our experience here is great. Love the. We will be back.

Check point C mostly serve the Southwest Airline. When I arrive from the mono rail I always wait for center door to be opened instead of the side door open. The center door of the monorail is actually open for the people get into the train. The reason I use that door for quick access to the check point line and beat every one to the check point line.   Check point C may be the easy check point I have been to. They move faster than check point A E and B. May be I hit the check point with less people.

This place need both of your hands to work the food. Not work for food :). We happen to pass by and try this place. It is a crab place. Many have come to here get take out. For a crab place, you need time and patience for little meat. But I like it.   There is not many table in the restaurant. As a result their take out is popular. We got two snow crabs and 5 shrimp with garlic sauce. They do give a little more leg for us. The sauce really get inside the meat. Very juicy. The shrimp is fresh and easy peeling. It accompanied with potatoes and corn. The snow crab leg long enough and good chamber meat.   We do not need to wait long. Food is at the high range but worth the money.

This food truck live up their name as Gastrotruck. The Korean cuisine is exquisite. I have a chance to visit this truck due to festival. During the Tampa Japanese Summer Festival, their truck is one of the food truck show up.   Their menu is simple, Kaarage $10, Chicken Teriyaki $8, Okonomi Tot $10, and the Gyudon for $11. All this is actually Japanese street food. I am appreciate they try to change their cuisine just for the festival. In fact, those dishes is quite good and colorful display. We got the Kaarage. This dish is chicken marinated in sake and soy sauce then deep fried with coating. They are quite good. The accompanying slaw also good. What a treat. It come with 5 big pieces chicken.   The order to wait for the food is less than 5 minutes. They have enough man power for the food preparation.

The food deliver safety for the restaurant is an A grade. They have you order online and pay online without touching. The pickup also touch less because you roll down window of the passenger side for them to drop the food. The check in also touch less by said that you are here to pickup.   The Carside pickup simply doesn't work. I have put my order in the restaurant at 1pm for 4:40pm pickup. I arrive and check in at 4:39. I was assigned a parking spot for pickup to wait for them to take the food to deliver to the car. I was wait there till 5:07 pm for deliver the food to my car. 28 minutes wait at partial shade area. Some car doesn't even have shade area. For taking so long to wait for the food I thought they must be cook the food when you check in. It was not. It is warm food and seem like seating at the kitchen. Obviously the my early put in order was cook on time but the communication from check in to food delivery to car was not coordinated. I also see an customer who missing a sauce and they take about 10 minutes to get the missing sauce to him. The execution is a F.   With that said. Their grade could be D. But I give them C because the food still tasty.

Caffeine is an Internet cafe. Many of the customers hang out there with computer. May be school homework to work as group.  The cafe is comfortable. It has a nice set up. They serve some interesting signature ice coffee. I got the Ice Caramel Delite. It is $4.5 for about 12 oz. for ice coffee that size is considered on the high side for the price. Most ice coffee serve in 16 oz due to ice was added at 70% of entire cup. With 12 oz. you will have less coffee in it. 5 big sip and all gone.   The coffee is good taste. Especially the caramel in it at the bottom. It interesting to have that. The coffee is very concentrated which after the ice melt, I still like to drink on it.

Ethnic Cuisine # 65. Dominican Food.   This cafe is interesting. Less than $10 you can have your meal. Better than fast food choices. It is off Armenia side street. It is local cafe restaurant. They don't open at night and close after lunch service.   I was attracted by one of the picture post about the the Pernil pork shoulder. I said I got to try that. I got my lunch with that choice. They give me a good portion with their gravy. I also added the fried pork belly. The skin is crispy. My second dish was the king fish. I saw they have cold fish on display. They immediately offer me if I want a hot piece not the chill fish. They fried a big piece while I am waiting. All lunch come with rice and choice of side. I got the cucumber salad and the sweet plantain.   Food is delicious after 30 minutes drove home and eat. The store clerk was friendly. I like to try their juice and coffee next time. They do have sandwiches on the menu. But I like the display food.

I like the newest Grillsmith. It has very good open area in compare to many Grillsmith that I have been to. The decorations is nice and good atmosphere for dinner. Especially the restaurant week they have offer some good deal. The open dinning hall is pleasant to dine in. This location has a lot of TV which I watch my World Cup soccer games here.   Somehow because this is new, the manager and chef pay a good attention to the food. We started with Napa Valley Salad. The mixed of green is good. The wonderful of the salad come from the dressing and additional ingredients such as nut, raisin, and cheese. Our main course is marsala chicken and Cajun pasta. Both plates are excellent. The Marsala chicken can taste the wine sauce in the dish. Our final dessert is the chocolate decadence and key lime pie. Both are well decorated.   Service is good. Food come out very quick. We enjoy our time here.

The food stand just off exit number 17 of I-4. It is on the southeast side of the I-4. The store is selling some local farmers produce and imported fruit. We happen to pass by here before 6 pm and it still open. We decided to have a visit.   The local mango is great and juicy. We got some of that. We also got the live basil, mint, and other herb still in the pot. Their price is 2 time less than Walmart. Your money can stretch a lot when you buy your veggies and fruit here.   There are a lot of fresh different types tomato, veggies, and plants. You may want to consider a visit if you visit the Plant City.

Brand new restaurant. I saw Mark was there, spot I give them a try. This is probably the second store in the Tampa Bay Area. The restaurant is actually open now. As mark put the tip. The grand opening is 8/25. 1 to 5 pm they have the sample treat.   I am here earlier before the grand opening. I have try their fried calamari and the matcha red bean slush. The fried calamari is very close to Taiwanese style batter coating. The coating is crispy. The calamari is great to dip into the sweet sauce.   I like their matcha red bean slush because the red bean is savory. Matcha ice is well blend. It is great with the red bean. The food order came out quick enough for the take out.   The restaurant divided into two sections. One side for sit down restaurant and the other side for the take out express. Price is reasonable.

It is about 4.5 stars in my book. It does bring something fresh to the community. Is it an art, ice cream, or beautiful treat? All of that.   They have the gelato and ice cream section. I would go to the gelato because they are more interesting. We taste many flavor. I got the banana foster and bourbon gelato. This two flavors is excellent taste and not find elsewhere. Then you can choose the type of make up or just regular cone. For the experience, I would go for the makeup cone they have. We got the clown cone. This is with cotton candy. We take a part and eat those separately.   By the way, extra scoop is only a dollar more. The clown cone is $7 and extra scoop make it to the $8. Not cheap, but they give good quantity of gelato to make up the price.

This may be the low end H&M I have been to. I have been to so many of them but this one do not stand out. One positive note is they have cute baby section. The man and women section just simply not there.   This store occupies good amount area in the mall. It does carry men, women and children. The best is the children. There were number of discounts you can find start from $3, $5, $10, and $15. The store is clean and in order.

I am living at Tampa over 15 year and this oriental grocery store has been here longer than 15 years. At then, this is the most popular oriental grocery ever. Since the competition catch up with them, they no longer hold the jewels of Tampa Bay.   May be this place need a face lift or renovation. It feel old to walk into this store. I wonder are they the oldest or Din Ho is the oldest one. Cannot tell.   It still carry the needs for most of oriental cuisine material. Now they are more like a downtown grocery store for the Tampa Heights. It has meat, shrimp, fish in the fresh meat and seafood section.

This restaurant take over a legendary restaurant Arco Iris. Now it is Caribbean cuisine with Latin flavor. This cuisine just match it name. I like the mixed cuisine who can serve the community.   This restaurant is a cafeteria type food. You can select the food by looking at the tray they serve. God is warm. I prefer hot plate. However, the selection is great. It have variety from poultry to seafood. We have the oxtail with sweet plantain and tamal en cazuela cubano. Tamal en cazuela cubano is tamales are made by mixing savory cornmeal dough. It is special thing I first try. My wife have the goat curry with tostone and black bean rice. The goat is tender. Not dish meat item is a bit salty. Other than that. It is a good meal.   The price is affordable especially dinner time. The place has an uplifting with new furniture and nicer environment compared to last restaurant.

Let get the bad things I can said for this restaurant. It is the temperature of the BBQ meat. Mainly they are just warm. Not feel like from fire pit hot. With that said, everything is good.   The restaurant just newly opened and they are pack for line. They have table but just don't have enough waiter. So you wait.... we were lucky to have the bar area seat. It is much easy and you can watch what your neighbors eat.   We started with watermelon Paloma cocktails. It is great watermelon juice cocktails with tequila. Chili salt rim make it nice to lick off.   We have the Go-Chu-Jiang rib as a shareable. It come with three ribs. It is Korean BBQ sauce. For me this dish is just average. I would go for other items.   We got the Texas two step. 2 meat and 2 side. We got the beef brisket and the pork brisket. The beef brisket is definitely done very well. The pork brisket is just so so. The two side are purple slaw and the tri color purple potatoes salad. Both are good.   Service is really good at bar. Very personalized. Price is at the high side.

It has been a while I actually give 1 star on the review. This is my first time here and we don't have good impression but bad experience.   We have coupon that allow us to buy one master Peanutty Swirl and get one free. We like to experience the 1960 roller skate window serving like the movie. The experience turn out not worthy for the food.  We arrive at Sonic and park on the station of order. The button has been push to call for order but no one has response. I have my engine on and they only have one car on drive thought and one car on station. I can see a lot of the sonic people in the building but none has come out to take order. We turn off the engine and waited for a while. Florida summer is hot even with the window down. We decided use the drive through. The drive through is responded faster than the station parking. We put our order with buy one gets one free. The total come to $8.98 and the discount is $3.59. We told them the incorrect total and ask why the discount is not half. The coupon clearly state BOGO buy one get one free but they only give you 40% discount. The swirl was given to us but spoon was not given to us while we were disagreed with the final total.   Manager came out and said this is the price. I told my wife it is not worth to argue since the gas spend on waiting for the price correction is already paid for it. Spoon was finally given to us and we drove away.   If you look at the food they are like ordinary fast food. Mc Donald has enclosed AC space and why I have to wait in hot weather and eat in my car or spent the gas money to be cool and eat in the car. Doesn't make sense. The concept may be work on 60's but not with AC generation.   Overall coupon is not fully honor, not an AC dining, server stay in building cool themselves and ask the customer to wait, food is not the best or healthy in fast food, bad attitude server, wrong accounting, poor management. I am sadly given the one star.

The restaurant name is "the fisherman" does reflect the freshly catch of the sea on the menu. The menu extended from Mexican food to different kinds of shell fish. Restaurant like this, I would go for the seafood side. Their menu included pineapple stuff with seafood which I have not try yet.   What catch my eyes on the seafood is the fried whole Tilapia (Mojarra Frita). The dish presentation was very impressive. The fish size is almost two of my hand palm. It come with rice, crispy fries, and salad. The rice has added special pan fried item, very tasty. Fish is fresh and scored to fried. It is crispy whole fish. I like this way because I can see the fish eye for the freshness.   If you know how to eat the whole fish, I recommend you ordering that way. Service is great. Food come out without too much of wait. The table is very limited but enough for the customers who visited.

North Star Eatery is part of the collaboration restaurant of Hall on Franklin. The cuisine and style is Asian Fusion. It is mixture of food from different Asia corner. The food serve including Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese. The Vietnamese bah mi is in the high side in compare to many Vietnamese restaurant in Bay Area. But since have not try it yet not sure if the quality and taste is worth that price.   The Bao section is nice for the amount of the charge. I like fried shrimp Bao. It is crisply fried with crunchy coating. I also the the slaw that accompanied the assembly. It work well.   I would try their pork ramen. It look very on the picture. It my to do list. The Korean bento box and other sticky bun or Bao will be other good choice.

It is your burger spot. If you need good massive burger, here is the place. If you have less than $7 in your pocket, this is the place. If you want a good grilled burger with sizzling outward, this is the place.   You will be surprised the best of the burger is not burger. It is the grilled grouper sandwich. The grouper is slightly grilled with sweet smoky flavor sauce. There are big pieces of grouper. It is worth the money for the sandwich and is less than $7. Great price. The burger has come with bacon. You can double triple the bacon. It is good hearty food.   There are not many table there if you decide to eat there. Many of the customers have their food to go. There are a lot people waiting for their food since their pricing is better than the fast food join. Many local has ordered from there. Don't forget their donuts burger.

Average among the Kung Fu tea chain restaurant Bay Area plus Sarasota for the food. It is about 3.5 stars. Drink may be ok. I like the new space of the Kung Fu tea. Somehow this supposed to be open at Belcher and Ulmerton but take year to change to this location.   I got the ninja chicken to go. The box is half box with lettuce at the bottom. Quantity is only 13 pieces of chicken. Coating is not the best. No five spice seasoning. Chicken feel like processing meat. Not sure any good thing about the ninja chicken. Price for that many pieces is pricey.

Our experience is good here. I like the Florida Pink Shrimp butterfly cut and lightly batter. The coating has some flavor. Big shrimp too. The dinner is more expensive than the lunch. During the lunch, they have $9.99 special for the shrimp. I have pass by this million time when I leaving YBOR city, but never visited. I make this special trip for second restaurant to visit that night.   We have ordered the Pink Shrimp with spicy shrimp slaw and French fry. It has hush puppies to go with it. The shrimp is in good size. If you go with plater instead of basket, you will get more shrimp.   We also order the mangle clam - little neck clam. It cook in shallots chili butter melt. The sauce is great. This is my first time have this type of sauce. Very creative.   Service is good. Close out is good. Parking is available on street side or lot.

I was here to try their new items. KFC now have a lot different types of buckets deal. But I am here for their combo meal. I got their two pieces dark meat original fried chicken. The combo meal come with one side and drink. I still like their potatoes with gravy side item.   I have try their new product- Nashville Hot Chicken Strips. The Nashville hot is good hot. Chicken strips are crispy. I would love to have this dish. The last dish is the popcorn chicken nuggets box. This $10 deal is good for movie night. The chicken get bigger pieces than old popcorn chicken. It is a improvement.   During the pandemic, the drive through is one window with person handle the money and the food is one person. I think this is the area to improve. No mask is found on the person who at the drive through window

This is the second restaurant they have. The first one is at US 301. I think the one at US 301 has the edge over the latest one. The one at US 301 has king fish at Friday. This restaurant is more into typical Latin cuisine food.   The day I have visited they have the lechon, oxtail, and many more to choose. The entree cook in the spot including the the carne Asada. I got the oxtail, lechon and the chicken. It come with choice of the base like yellow rice, white rice, rice with bean and a side. For the side I have cabbage and the sweet plantain since I have two order. The portion of the food is great. It will feed the hungry man.   The restaurant has the sit down area. At least this restaurant has larger seating area than the first restaurant and it is a plus.

This taco place has many to offer. Start with fajitas, flautas, enchiladas. Follow by their quesadillas, burritos, chimichanga and more. The place has bar seat at the front and open area dining hall.   I am here for their taco. I got three tacos. The Asada, Barbacoa, and Lengua. I like the most is the Asada Steak taco. They have good seasoning. The barbacoa is a little plain for grill lamb meat. I also like the lengua - beef tongue. It is great when they grilled the lengua to crispy. The natural flavor is good enough with add a bit of salt. By the way, the Taco topping is assemble by your own. This is a plus for the customer to choose which topping he like the most. The way I like my taco is only add cilantro. May be a bit of salsa. That is all which able to preserve the natural flavor of the meat.   The service in this restaurant is attentive. The food came out quick. The only thing I would said is the chef may need to burn the outward meat a bit to bring out the burn taste.

For happy hour it is definitely a good experience. We were here at 5 pm and the place still empty. By 6 pm, it is pack with people. The happy hour is at the bar area.   I got the steak sandwich. This sandwich is worth the value. It is slice filet with fries. The steak was well cook to the temperature that was order. The quality of the steak is high. We also got the spicy shrimp. This dish is big shrimp fried in butterfly style. It is delicious. We have the seared ahi tuna last. The outward was seared. The tuna is dark red color. The number of pieces also enough.   Overall experience is good. Service is good in good restaurants. Food come out quick without much waiting. We enjoy our time here.

I like my time here. I would say this not a true 5 stars restaurant but very close to 4.5 stars. The place is cute. Two dining rooms setting. I was not going to have the high expectations. They have very good lunch special Monday to Friday. Approximately $9. Great deal.   I did not go for the lunch special and go straight to one of their best dish. The cuisine is very similar to Black Forrest Germany cuisine when I have visited the Germany. I got the Schweinshax'n (pork Shank). It come with sauerkraut and bread dumplings. The sauerkraut was excellent. The dumplings is interesting that come as a cake pieces.   The shank is braise and over roasted. They have lite seasoning outwardly. It is a big chunk. Great for hungry people. The pork sauce is great accompanied the bread dumplings and the pork shank.   While I visited there, many have order the lunch special. Definitely a go to menu for lunch.

It is about 4.5 stars for the food. You need to be patient because they need time to cook your order. Grilled meat need time to complete perfectly. If you don't want to wait, you can order ahead of time for pick up when you arrive. The wait is 20 minutes.   We have the Tostones Gauchos with picanha. The tostone has to with cheese, salsa with fry berries. The picanha was grilled perfectly with the order. The seasoning is there. Tostone are very crisply fried. We also got the half pound combo with two sides. The protein we have selected is the Lomo de Cerdo. The pork was grilled correctly. Love it. The two side includes cord and garlic rice. The garlic rice was well prepared with garlic fragrance.   Our experience here is perfect. Definitely recommend to revisit. Next time we want to try their Churrasco and other side.

Rare Ethnic Food No.12  This is the series of five rare ethnic food at every 100 review I have made. I have selected Byblos due to their unique decorations and the unique cuisine Lebanese Cuisine.  Middle Eastern food is alway heavy in spice, marinated technique, and grilled timing. Byblos has these technique in high standard. I have the lamb chop and my wife has a mixed grilled. The lamb is the bone in lamb that is well cut and perfectly grilled. The marinated spice is well deep into the meat. This dish is my favorite. My wife have the mixed grilled. They are good also. But after you have the lamb, you will feel the lamb is more superior than the sheik kabab.   The room is well decorated. Each room has it own character. The outside sitting include fire pit you can grilled you own. The interior include formal dining hall, bar area, private drape room.   The service is good during lunch time. The lunch is certainly more affordable, but the dinner portion is a lot larger.

Sunday brunch is seldom in my calendar. But I was available that day. The restaurant is very contemporary decorated. The bar open early in Sunday morning. Many of the Bucs fan were here for the drinks before heading to the stadium for the game.  The first brunch dish is the Low and Slow Smoked Wings. This wing may need to smoke longer to get smoky flavor in the meat. The taste is good with the orange marmalade sauce. The second dish is the Devil's Egg. This egg is batter and fried then fill with  bacon. Love this southern style.   Our main dish is the Southern BLT. The "B" standard for Pork belly in southern. This is Pork belly and fried green tomato burger. The house made sauce is delicious. The bun is craft beer bun. Very unique. Our final dish is the shrimp and grits. This dish has good size of shrimp. The grit was fried in triangles shape. Another creative dish and different way of cooking the grit. This is the dish to have in this restaurant.   Services is good. Although our table is take by the bat tender. The service still keep in normal condition. Because they have big team.

It has been on my bookmark place for a while. We think the best time to visit is lunch. When the price of the food is more measured up to food is served. I like it they are across to the parking garage which make it easy to park.   This restaurant chef do have good skill. The food that served is well thought out. Sauce and ingredients are well balanced to each other. We start with white asparagus soup. It has touch of aioli and bread crumb. It was good to have. My wife has the buttermilk fried chicken. The sesame bun that accompanied it has great taste. The honey sauce in the chicken is delicious.   My entrée is the salmon with curry cous cous. It also has the sautéed shiitake mushrooms and the Brussels sprouts. This dish is amazing.  The service is a bit slow. Our waiter did not check on us regularly. However, other waiter did come to pick the empty plate quickly.

Kona Grill is great especially the happy hours. They are offered good discount during happy hour. The interior is contemporary. Cuisine is most likely American and Sushi.   I started with happy hour drink old fashioned. It is ok. If they change a different sweeter bourbon, it may be better.  We got the chicken and shrimp lettuce wrap. I like they use a good lettuce. The chicken and shrimp meat was stir fried with good flavor. Great finger food. The next two are the crunchy spicy tuna and wave roll. This two sushi roll is my flavor here. We also got the chicken satay. It come 4 sticks. It overlay on the salad. It is good size of meat to share the plate. Our final dish is pepperoni flat bread. The pepperoni is huge circle. Total is 8 pieces.   Our time here is good. During the happy hour, the bar is full. Seem like everyone got the same ideas.

One of the treasures in St. Louis at The Loop Neighborhood is this Chinese restaurant. It is great to visit them if you are in St. Louis. They have boba tea and hand pull noodle. My wife like their hand pull noodle. I also like the boba or smoothie. I like the mung bean smoothie.  We begin the handmade wonton in chili oil. This dish dumplings is great. Love the chili oil and the wonton skin. Our second dish is their special beet dry handmade pan-fried lamb and cilantro dumplings. Just the name you already know this dish is special. I have not seen anyone serve this dish before. Because of the beet, the dumplings look red. Very interesting.   Our last dish is the Pepper Chitterlings. Great wok technique with soften chitterlings. Great dish to go with rice. I enjoy every bit. The service is great. The food come out quick. You can see the chef hand pull the noodle and make the dumplings.

This fast food chain is as it advertise star rating. Below average. I believe they don't know how to improve themselves.   Below are the suggest improvement.   1. Improve the response time to order at the drive through. The wait is too long for the drive through.   2. Improve the drive in condition. Be ready to come out to make the order.   3. The boneless wing is chicken breast. Don't like too much batter.  4. Improve staff training. If the customer pull to the window to paid, be ready to accept.   I not sure they will be able to improve since this issue has been long time base on past review from other yelper who comments on this store.

This restaurant is 3.5 stars in my book. It has the vibe of fast food concept. Food should be easy to order. Due two employees collecting money and assembling your in the evening hours, it will be a challenge if the line has 7 people. When one is assembled the phone order which mean down to one to take care of the front counter. Delay happens.   We have the carne Asada, pastor, carnitas, grilled mahi mahi tacos. The carne Asada is the best seller. A lot of people ordered it. The beef was cut into good size of beef cube. It has quantity even thought they charge over 3 dollars for a taco. Worth the money. The fish has good grilled mark. The other two just average. Overall is not a bad deal.   There are a lot of young people come to enjoy the dinner. I also like the guacamole with chip. It has good guacamole. The taco has unlimited toppings which make many return to revisit.

Saturday they also have lunch special. It will be good deal. I would suggest try them at lunch for under $10 dish. Great deal.   Benjarong is decorated very nicely inside. Actually not too many people here. I won't said they are authentic but they are good enough dish presented in menu. We have ordered the duck and salmon. The duck was deep fried with ginger sauce. I like this dish with good flavor. The second dish is the salmon in sweet chili sauce. The salmon come in good piece and they are pan seared before the chili sauce. This is a sweet dish may required more rice to go with it.   At menu come with pre-meal item of the soup of the day and the choice of salad or egg roll. I like the compliments pre-meal items. It make more enjoyable. Less than $25 lunch for two is a steal.

This may be the first poke spot in New Tampa Area. I am excited new business ideal to be build on the neighborhood. It is perfectly located at The Seven Oak large community entrance. It serve New Tampa and Wesley Chapel.   After so many poke place pop out in Bay Area, this one is in the middle. Reason as below. When you decided for the protein, they determined two or three scoop. The difference is $2. However the scoop they are using is extremely small than the ice cream scoop. In addition, they scoop up the fish and press against the wall. So you got half of the scoop. Not like scoop up the meat and let it fall scoop.   The add on is not impressive. Just like typical poke place. They premixed some of the protein like marinated tuna, spicy salmon, and spicy tuna. Ok enough selection. The sauce need to have some choice of oil base and ponzu sauce.   Thing l like is choose any topping except avocado for $1 extra.

This is our neighborhood Olive Garden. I have been to this place many time when my kid is young. He loves the Chicken Alfredo here. This Olive Garden at New Tampa is better than the Brandon and Bush location. It provides more quantities of food than the other two locations.   Tonight they have a promotion of 4 course meal from $14. The entree on the $14 is not attractive. As a result, my wife select the four course with Shrimp Alfredo entree $17.50. I have the rosemary garlic chicken that is not in the four course meal. The four course meal came with chicken meatball with tomato sauce. It is good. My meal came with a soup Zuppa Toscana.  I love this soup with fresh kale, Italian sausage and  slice potato. It is good when you dip your garlic bread and let it sit for a few second and allows the soup sock into the bread. Then you eat the socking bread. Yum. The rosemary garlic chicken is ok for it price. No wow factor.   Today I am disappointed on the service. They are slow. It almost want me to give them two stars. Base on the past experience, I give them 3 stars. They could have been 4 stars, unfortunate they do not earn that tonight.

The flooring company may be the best price. But you have to understand one cent of goods is one cent of quality. I would said it is about three and half star. Flooring selection is better deal than others with same thickness and mill of the plank. But if you have existing condition, they may not able to accommodate. Basically I said if you original concrete floor conditions has perfect elevation or you just need to change the carpet to plank, they are your people.   What they offer.  Some plank has life time warranty and some has limited warranty. They will offer to move large pieces furniture, installation, edging molding, and transition pieces.   What not offer.  Adjust due to existing condition, painting on molding.   The contractor followed the guideline of COVID if they are too close to you. They help moving the large furniture which is convenient to the home owner. They do have good selection. However the call back for punch list item to finish off take too long and wait. Overall their value of the plank is good quality. We install the Nuvelle 20 mils 5.5 mm thick luxury vinyl plank. Our color was the seaside pecan. I like the plank has minor texture and not cold when you step on during winter.   I would suggest any home owner before visit do their homework on the plank. You really don't want a plank holding at end edge and deflect a lot. Minimum mil need to be 12 mil and minimum thickness should be at least 5 mm. Most home bedroom is 5 mil surface and kitchen is 12 mil. Most commercial restaurants use 20 mil to avoid surface broken. I use the commercials grade. Pay a little more but easy maintain.   Overall we like work done at our house. It was easy clean on our floor now.

It is about 4.5 star. I like the choices of grains and assemble bowl. It is a restaurant known how to simplify the assembly line and items. It is easy to manage. However, I would like to have more protein choices.   The food here is delicious. The sauce is unique. However, they probably need to be adjusted generally liking and different from other. We got the salmon as our protein. The salmon was well cook with skins attached. Not many know how to cook salmon with skin. They probably one of the restaurant know how to cook it. The grain choice as base is nice.   One thing for sure to get repeat customers need to have variety. To get the customers interest and come back.

My second visit is pleasant. This time I am sit down have snack at dinner. I believe they are 4.5 stars restaurant not full 5 stars. Although I didn't try their ninja chicken nuggets again, but we do try fried calamari and the the black garlic ramen. They finally have the token ramen with newest ramen dish. Black garlic is one of the kind. It has the black sesame oil with black garlic on it. It is delicious. The calamari was fried very good with good coating.   The reason they are upgraded is I make a challenge to their boba team. I ask a drink that partial in the menu but not totally in the menu. They have winter Mellon milk tea. I ask if they can do the slush. They said they have not done that before. But they will try. End up it is good drink.

This Greenland is sister store with Greenland at Temple Terrace. I think their Temple Terrace location is better. They are very close to 3.5 stars in my book. The food is good. The decoration is basic.   The menu is very simple. Just enough to choose from. I got kabab that day. They have three different meat to choose. Beef, lamb, and chicken. Their meat is not actually open flame grilled. It may have grilled on flat steel plate. However, the marinated flavor is there. I got the lamb and beef. The lamb is actually best and tender. The beef is a bit over cook and become tougher to bite.  I like the baba ganoush. It go well with the pita bread. The rice is too wet. Can be a bit drier.   Overalls good value for $10.99. The food order at the counter and bring to your table. Quantity is enough for one person.

Every third Sunday night this place have the Blue Jam. If you like the blue music, this is the place you want to be. The Jam is continue and non stop for three hours from 6 to 9 pm at the third Sunday. They switch out the musician time to time but the music is non stop. You will hear the harmonica, saxophone, electrical guitar, electric piano solo in the middle of the song. Sometime they have the one line joke with the band at the back. What a fun night!!!!!  We have order the frog leg and the fried clam during the visit. This is a free spirit location. It is great to have the flow of music and the food in the same time. They also have the bar with TV every place. You have to multi tasking three time -- hear the music, eat the food, and watch the football playoff. What can be better than that. The frog leg skin is removed and deep fried with dried breading coating. The leg have a lot of meat and soft to eat. The chef did a good job not to over fried and maintain the crispy of the coating. The clam is also coat with dry breading. This breading is a bit different then the frog leg. This is butter milk breading and increase the flavor of the taste. Most of the time we are unable to feel the meat of the clam. However the chef in this restaurant put a good chunk of the clam meat that you can taste it. Some of the cook over fried the clam and become rubbery. The chef here did a good job that the clam meat is good enough to bite and break it.   The service is good. We find out that they also have band play 5 day a week. Please check their web site for schedule. We will definite back for more when they have the blue jam. The food price here is reasonable. The entertainment is free with encourage for tipping the musician.

Their everyday lunch special is the best deal. I give them an A for allow lunch special 7 day a week. The restaurant only allow takeout now. They protect themselves in the bubble wrap. In the sense they protect the customers by touch less.   We got the teriyaki salmon and the chicken katsu. The teriyaki salmon was well prepared. The sauce on it is good. I like the stir fry veggies. It was delicious. Portion is good enough for lunch. Cannot complain for the price we paid. My wife like their katsu. The chicken was fried well. She like sauce that go with it.   Overall it is good. We I'll try their Hawaiian BBQ next time.

The market is still have fresh produce and meat during pandemic. The only thing I would said is the the aisle may be make it single direction aisle until the restriction is relax.   Today I was luck to see they have the cotton candy grape. But that is not cheap. I don't mind the price as long as the grape has the cotton candy flavor. In fact they also sweet. I got the premium prosciutto. I have it thin slice. They help me as much as possible to thin the slice. I like it they separate each cut with paper.   I also got the MacMurray Pinot Noir. This 2016 has great fruity taste and also smooth medium body. I did not see much of this wine other alcohol store. This is from Russian River Valley which I like plus the good year of grape.   The entrance has a lot of orchids. It is a welcome sign for me to pulse and admire.

It good pizza store in Tampa. Although I am not a good pizza differentiator, but I do like their pizza. Their pizza has good ingredients topping. We got the meat lover and it has good meat such as sausage, pepperoni, bacon, ham and meatball. The sausage is slice peel cut sausage. It enhances the taste. Many topping here is not your typical pizza store use ingredients.   We got their specialty dish of the day. Baked Stuffed Shrimp with Crab Meat. The four big pieces of giant shrimp stuffed with a lot of crab meat. It come with garlic rice. This my first time have garlic rice. Very unique. It also come with mixed veggies. Price is affordable.   The only thing is this restaurant do not have rest room access at the seating area. Not sure they have the restroom. Did not ask. The seating room has one kind of smell. Not sure what is it. Other than that. They are great restaurant.

Kung fu tea still have good ramen, tea, and appetizers. I still like them. The reason they drop a star due the recent take I have. At least three time they have changed from generous to stingy. The pop corn chicken I have is less than half of box. Very little in compare to other place for the same price. If they continue this way, I might as well not to have take out at all.

My revisit was satisfied. They were running the $8.99 deal during the weekday 3 to 5 pm. I got the chicken piccata. The chicken is grilled. The sauce has piccata and lemon base. It is delicious. It come with slide zucchini top with bread crumbs.   Even thought the price is reduced, the service is top notch. The food also is great quality. They did not reduce the quality since the price of the dish was cut more than 40%. I have to tip my hat to the restaurant for such good quality.

This roll ice cream located close to Sundial St. Pete.  It is on the walking distance to the next street. Currently the Bay Area has over 30 Roll ice cream place. It is getting become an old business model. The business owners need to have something to attract customers. This store basically use unlimited toppings to get customers to repeat.   The Roll ice cream price is above the average of the Bay Area. If you add tax is very close to $7. This is a bit high. The residents tend to go to cheaper place. The ice cream here is ok. The choice of the toping is just ok. It will be hard sell to attract customers for this price other than tourists.

I like Sandra. It is about 4.5 stars. If you come here, I recommend to get at least one link of their homemade sausage. This item is must have. They do have a table on the outside and few table inside.   They do have combo meal, sandwiches, dinner plate and more. If you really want to try everything, they have built your own by pound or pieces. I like the build your own because I can try everything - pull pork, brisket, rib, chicken, catfish, sausage, rib and sides. The rib, chicken and brisket are delicious. The sausage is the best.   The price is moderate. It is worth the money because of the taste and experience. If you like southern BBQ, this is a good choice.

This is the second location in Tampa. It is Mediterranean grille. This is their fir stand alone building with drive through. It is good use for the Coronavirus period. It created the less contact condition.   We like their whole grilled chicken. The chicken is marinated with good spice. Chicken was butterfly opening to grilled. So it can completely grill inside the bone and outside surface. It also allow the marinated sauce with maximum exposure. The butterfly chicken is beautifully displayed. Our sides are the yellow rice and the baba ghanoush. All of them are delicious. The whole chicken is great deal all the time.   Drive through is not most easy for this kind of food due to complicated order. Wait will be needed.

Rare Ethnic Food 52. Ethiopian cuisine   It is close to 4.5 stars for my experience today. I kind agree some food need to tone up the spicy taste. However the spice and ingredients are there. With that said. Let me get into the experience.   Mitmita is actually meaning one of the Ethiopian Spice. It can be mixed and make many dish. I like the restaurant reflecting their true calling. The culture of food is use a piece of injera to pick up a bit of entree by hand and eat it. That is how it done to enjoy the different cuisine.   We have a group there can try different dishes. Injera is a crepe type sheet for pick up the food. The best dish is the Ye-doro Wat. This is a chicken dish with Ethiopian Ber-bere sauce. The sauce has so many ingredients. It is flavorful. We also order the  Kat Wat the chop beef with Ethiopian bbq sauce, Kitfo the lean beef is with the Mitmita sauce, Gored Gored the raw tenderloin beef with amaze sauce. Those are good dishes.   Afterward we have Ethiopian coffee with ceremony incense to celebrate special occasions. It was a great celebration. On the appetizers, we have the chicken, veggies, and beef sambusa. Very tasty. We have good time there.

Rare Ethnic Food #71. Tunisian Sweet.   It is about 4.5 stars. I were here several time and they close for irregular hour. And pandemic. Finally I got to visit their store and try something that rarely found in the Bay Area. Tunisian sweet is temptation delight for the Mediterranean people. It is a good item for for tea time and more. It a crazy good sweet food but not too sweet.   We have several interesting look sweet that is my first time try it. This sweet includes Chaba Kia shape like honeycomb and taste like rose water. Makroudh with dates infill item. Youyou like small sweet donut.  Ghrayba Hommos with hazelnut. The best is the pistachio cake. They are quite famous for that. Must try.   Overall the experience is good. I can see to get use to it. Definitely come back for some other items.

Bourbon street is regarded as a party street. It has a lot bars in this street. I wonder how many bars in this street. I also wonder if you drink from the first bar to last bar, if you can still stand on your two feet. If you a group of buddies, let see who who is last standing person.   Bourbon street is no regard as performance street during weekends. Most of the street performances artists is actually at Royals Street during the weekend. What is best for children to walk on this street. I would say before 8 pm which is before too many drunk people.  The street has restaurant, adult venue, live music and more. Recently the street is under major construction which make walking require additional careful. This is the Year New Orlean celebrating 300 year. This may not be right time for this construction so close to Mardi Gras.

New Italian ice place at New Tampa. We welcome new comer for giving more variety to New Tampa. Penguin has been in Tampa Bay for some time. Finally one opened in this area. The only thing I would said this is quite plaza compared to the plaza in front of movie theater. Hopefully this do not discount the visitor traffic.   I would skip the soft serve completely and go with the Italian ice only. They good selection on the ice flavors. Seem like the apple flavor is most of the people requested. We got the Frappuccino and the Rainbow. The Frappuccino has good coffee flavor. The rainbow is colorful with numerous flavors. It is fun to have.   The service is good. We got our ice cream quick.

It is about 4.5 stars. I like the atmosphere of the restaurant. The set up of the restaurant is very nice. They space is an triangle corner of the building. It make the restaurant long and big. The bar area is also long to accommodate more people. We were here for their happy hours. It was second stop of the progressive restaurant.   We start with devil egg. The dish come with three half egg. I ask if they can accommodate one half egg t make it four pieces and we will pay for extra pieces. The restaurant was not able to accommodate. I like their house cure salmon on the egg. We also got the eggplant meatball. The sauce is good. I like the bedding zucchini noodle below. We like the most is the bacon and blue salad. The romaine was grilled before serving. Love the sauce come with it.   Service is not in excellent area but definitely in good category. We enjoy the little time we have here.

Busch Gardens is not like it use to be. I think the old gardens is nicer. They use to have the safari Jeep ride instead we have to paid extra to get into the safari. Now the safari is a train ride through the animal area. The use to have two free beer gardens. Now just one. And the beer only limit to two small cup.   The show at Busch Gardens is still good. The animal show, singing show, popular Elmo show, ice skating show are attraction to the audiences. I like the cheetah run. They show a live cheetah at their top speed to go after the pray.   If you go near the Christmas time, they have the Christmas town. The entire park lit up at night. It is beautiful to see from the sky lift. I still like the bumper car ride. They now has some crazy roller coasters. It definitely shake your stomach and brain.

Very popular local restaurant. Saturday they have pack house when I pick up my food on takeout at 3 pm. Usually that time don't have too many people. Obviously this is a local favorite.  I have order the Bandeja Paisa. This is Columbia favorite combination dish. It has carne Asada, chicharron, sausage, egg. It is well round of meat. Love it. The pork belly was fried to crispy. Food is in good portions. The other dish we have ordered is Sobrebariga a La Plancha. It supposed to be the grilled top flank steak. But when I open at home is grilled pork lion. It is still taste good.   The entry come with complimentary dessert as a flan. It is delicious too. Other mixed up the order, the food is still good. Definitely worth a visit. If you order takeout, call ahead because they are busy.

Some gourmet burger place. But I don't feel gourmet much. I think their burger just average. The burger is small. If you are big hungry man, this may not be your place. The meal deal won't be able to feed you.   Shake Shack is a yuppie restaurant. The burger patty is press to flat and grilled to crispy. Is is different kind of burger preparation. I would definitely give them a A+ on the sauce add on especially the truffle burger. The fried onion is just a bit on their truffle burger. Overall their best burger is the truffle burger. Bacon avocado burger is ok. Definitely is a good mixture of material.   With the size of burger and price paid, it is in the expensive side. I think they need to do something about the size of burger. Especially the new business to attract repeat customers.

I like Mama Soul Food. It is definitely southern soul. It has been this location for long time. They are planning another location in Brandon. I was surprised the restaurant is full. It has good selection of traditional dish, BBQ, and something out of the box.   We started with catfish nuggets. It is fresh and delicious. I recommend you get this appetizer. The catfish nuggets was in good quantity. For the entree, we got the baked turkey wings. This is something new that we try. The wings were bake to very soft like jello type. Very good technique. We also have the hog maws dinner. The maw is refer to pig stomach. They prepare and clean it well. The braise sauce was great. It definitely has it unique way of cooking it. The side come with it also very good, especially the candy yum has the fragrance of smell.   Service is attentive, some come to have pickup. Parking is not the best but I got the side street parking.
