This Ding Tea location is better than the one in the Tampa Water Avenue. The tea is more flavorful. Milk tea taste good with the cream milk especially for laxative intolerant people.   I got the the Hokkaido Milk Tea with boba. The boba here is not the brown sugar chewy boba. It is more like the jello type. It is still good but I prefer chewing type. They do have choices for ice level. You can ask for less ice. The sugar level also can be requested. The flexibility make them attractive.   Overall it is good above average drink.

I like this food truck now has it permanent location. When they are in stable location, food also better. It is not difficult to find but the map direction may get you in wrong location. They are just south of river on the left if heading south.   We got the three skews kabab where on the menu said BBQ plater. The skewers includes lamb and the chicken. The marinated is good because it was juicy. Good technique. The seasoning also there for the meat.  The second dish is the Hamada Maqluba Mix. This is mix of chicken, lamb, veggies over rice. This is their favorite dish. Many customers order this.   Food will need to wait while they grilled the skewers. Price is reasonable for the food. I like it because it is still good when I take it home after 30 minutes.

Sata's Froyo is the new kid in the block. We were here after the dinner. They offer dessert in many way. Their major item are yogurt by pound with topping of many choices. The other items are pastry, muffin and cookie, hot coffee, ice coffee or tea.  I like their Sata Special, this is something that I have not tasted in other place. The special included carrot juice, orange juice or coffee with Froyo. I got one of this with Carrot Juice Froyo. It is carrot juice with premix special yogurt flavor. The taste is the best to have it. I would recommend to try their special because it is something that not many has offer in the Bay Area. I will try their orange juice or coffee Froyo on my return visit.   The yogurt has many good flavors to choose from. I like the rich yogurt flavor of cake, fruit, or cookies in compare to many yogurt place just a touch flavor. Go check them out while they offer 25% off till November 14. Check out their special.

Cool park for the kid and adults. Waterworks Park attracts young and old. Many bring kid to enjoy this park. It even has a fence area for our four leg friend to roam free.   The park is our current Tampa mayor Bob Buckhorn first completed city project. It is a combination of historic district development and current end of Tampa Riverwalk. The name match the intensity of the park. It has bunch of water elements playground for the kid to run through and big splash of the big bucket. As a adult, I think is is fun to do it too.   The park has a very high profile of restaurant Ulele and Rotary Club Pavilion. The pavilion is an outdoor amphitheater. The Tampa Shakespeare Festival was held here. During the food truck event, the pavilion has live music.

This place is pack at 4 pm. I cannot believe it. Imagine dinner time. A few good things about this restaurant is the reasonable price, good good, party atmosphere. The restaurant have some big screens TV. Imagine soccer games day in this restaurant. It may be only standing room only.   I quickly scan their menu. They have daily specials. For Sunday, it is beef tripe soup. I got one order of that. It come with two sides. I got rice and salad. The soup includes some meat and beef tripe. The soup is great with softening tripe. It go well with the rice.   My second dish is the carne asada in the lite side. This dish is not at it normal portion. The beef is average grade. Not the best. But the seasoning is there. It go well with the potato.   I also got the maracuya drink. This is the infuse coconut rum with passion fruit. I would said is not the one to try. Cost is high Taste is so so.

Green is almost like Asian fast food. This is set up like modern type restaurant and they can be a franchise chain. Food and ingredients is not complicated since they don't have beef tripe and pork tendon to prepare.   The green mint pho is typical Vietnamese combination pho without the two ingredients that I have mention. As a result, they are easier to assemble. They do have the pho at the right tone. My wife orders the grilled chicken and adds the grilled pork bun. It is extra cost to add the extra item of grilled meat. It come with mixed green pickle veggies and house sweet chilies sauce. I like her choice better since the grilled chicken is excellent. If they can create a good grilled meat with excellent marinate, I can imagine their Banh Mi must be good. I will try that next time.   We also have the boba with papaya and taro. They are good and they are at the average pricing. The service is good and fast. I would give them 4 stars since they have new concept.

A fast food joint in very nice color for the building. I have not seen a Pollo Tropical like this building color. Very Art Deco color. When you walk in the restaurant, the grilled was displayed on the side. The chicken is golden grilled. Look yummy.   We have take from this place before. They are a bit charcoal or burn. I decided to come in here and try. We have $10 coupon for whole chicken and two sides. Very good deal. The chicken is well cook this time. The comment I have for this place is the mojo marinate is too less. The marinate only skin deep compare to other pollo tropical. It need to go to the meat.   The service here is great and clean. Salsa can be obtained and taken at the salsa bar. I like the good deal. Order is quick. I like the color of the building.

Food is good, service is average, table is a bit sticky. That very said about this restaurant. We were here for weekend lunch. It is great to be watching football games. It has big screens tv and bunch of smaller tv surrounding the bar.   We got the fried mozzarella to start. Good mozzarella cheese. The dipping Mariana sauce is good. Our entrees are grilled shrimp with rice and broccoli. I like they blackened and grilled. Made one side crispy. The other dish we have is the sirloin steak. Good amount of steak and fries. Temperature is right as requested.   Overall the service is average. The table is a bit sticky may due to the detergent that spray. May be need a clean water to clear it.

The dessert is one of the kind in Tampa Bay Area. This is an nitrogen ice cream that I have never seen. It is different technique to freeze the liquid ice cream to final ice cream hardness. The use nitrogen liquid shot at the liquid ice cream with your flavor and ingredients add in. Then it frozen to what you want.   First choose your size. Regular or Large. You also can go with waffles or donut cones. This cone is freshly make there. Then choose your based - coffee, vanilla, chocolate, cotton candy and etc. then choose your mixed in. I like the heat bar.   We were here for their special donut cones. The cones is freshly baked. Then it cool with liquid nitrogen inwardly. The ice cream they make drop into the cone. It was great fun process to watch them make it. Next time I will try their waffles cone.

In the Bay Area, they are average in food. But in Brandon, they do have the best German food around that area. They do get a lot of local support especially their lunch special is attractive.  We got schnitzel Berlin and schnitzel Jaeger Art. Both are fried pork with sides. The Berlin Schnitzel is come with pepper corn sauce, red cabbage, bread dumplings. But I think the Schnitzel Jaeger Art is better. It is top with creamy mushroom sauce and spaetzle. However, both breaded pork are not crispy on coating. Taste is there, I feel they are in hurry to put pork out and not fried it longer. Coating also can be improved with more tasty spices in it.   Overall is good. Popular for lunch. Service is good.

Good food. Just out side of Apollo Beach Area. We were here for a job assignment. We could have gone to know place I like. But we decided to consult Yelp Rating and look for something new.   This restaurant just at west side of US 41 in the plaza. Not difficult to find. It has good ambient and nice decorations. Bar area is good if you want to hang out. The rest room sink shape like a fish is beautiful to look at.   We started with the blacken beef tip. The beef is tender and soft. It was a great bite appetizer. My lunch is grilled grouper sandwich. The fish is good size and fresh. The chef lightly seasoning the fish and grilled perfectly. It accompanied with french fried.  My friend has the Greek salad and he like the fresh salad.   Overall our experience were great. The service is good. Food delivery time is on point.

We were here for the burger week. We did not go for the shuffle board games. The shuffle board games is ten dollars per person. They do have good indoor shuffle board facilities. The restaurant dining area has few tables for food. We sit on bar for easy service. It is almost look like dive bar.   We got the only burger in the menu. The burger come with potato tots. The burger top with melted cheese. This burger is average. I also got the can of beer. The visit is nice. But I feel like this bar is neighborhood bar. This bar will not able to mixed complicated cocktails. They don't have mixologist. But for margaritas, they can mixed it for you. That pretty much of it.

Old school restaurant. They don't take credit card. However, they take check or cash. They also have no web side. This is a 4.5 stars restaurant since they don't take cash. However the food is good consider the good time per the name of the restaurant. Yelp don't have 4.5 stars. 5 stars is rated.   Food cost is in the high side. There is a value for the art of cooking. The sauce and culinary art is good. The meat is well prepared. Tonight we have dinner with friends and I have the New York Strip with special gravy sauce - spicy Madagascar green peppercorns sauce flame with cognac. It came with sautéed mushrooms, green bean, potatoes. The mushrooms is well cook and brown.  My wife have the duck with cherry sauce. This is their signature dish according to Nick grandma. The duck is well braise. I like it when the meat is separated from the bone easily. This dish accompanied with green bean and rice. Yum.   Service is great. Next time I will have the beer since they brew it since 1292.

The Brass Tap provides the people connection when they have good time to join together. The outdoor seating which is great to customers with dog. This time of year, the out side seating is nice.   After the snow parade, we found our fellow yelpers who attend the snow parade at Brass Tap. It is great to see them and Brass Tap provide an easy meeting point since they are actually at the entrance of the central Ybor. If you try to find through the GPS they will give you the wrong location. Brass Tap just at the right of the entrance of the Central Ybor.   The service is good. Usually the outside seating is easily get forgotten. However our waiter is very aware of us seating there and checking with us often. The beer and atmosphere is great there.

CopperFish is a fancy restaurant. Nice set up. When you make reservation, they call you back same day to confirm your reservation.  We went to this restaurant at Sunday Night and they are not busy. The reservation really not quite needed at Sunday.  No pre-meal items such as dip, bread, chip, or olive. We start our dinner with Crab Avocado Stack. This appetizer is well presented and well decorated. It drips with sweet base cilantro vinaigrette. They do give a lot of the lump crap.   The entrees are the fish and chips English food. The fish is grouper and we were allowed to change our chip to asparagus. The grouper is well made. Our second dish is Florida Black Grouper with brussel sprouts & mushroom hash, lobster essence. The brussel sprouts leaves are separated and stir fried with mushrooms and sweet potato hash. The lobster essence is just the orange color sauce. I cannot taste any lobster out of it. The grouper is pan seared.   The dishes are very simple, no sophisticate flavor. I wonder it do not worth the money for my opinion. If I come next time, I just go for the appetizers only. The service is too slow. It takes 15 minutes to wait for my check and I just want to get out of there.

The outdoor BBQ joint is quick and easy for the south Tampa resident. They have slow cook BBQ brisket that I like. It has the local unique flavor and technique.   It is hot to eat here during lunch time because the Florida sun is hot and humid in summer. I am sweated just to make my order. However, the food here is great. The meat must be over the flame for many hours. The brisket is chop with the outside marinated coating make the taste better.   We got the Brunswick soup. They are cook with brisket, corn, bean and tomatoes in sweet base soup. I like this soup because they are simple and good.   The brisket is about $8 a pound. It is the regular price in the market without cooking. I think they are very good deal. They also have some outdoor sitting at the back of building if you want to eat there.

I am trying out the jerk place I have never been too yet they are not too far from my house. This place is close to university. I have call in for my order. The pick up was no wait when I am arrived. The timing is good.   I am determined to find out the good wings place near me. Jerk Pit provided different season spice option. The grilled wings with marinated jerk spice is interesting. Wing is about $0.85 per wing with tax. The taste is average compared to many jerk chicken around the tampa. Wing is a little bit charcoal outwardly. However the marinated spice is into the meat.   The food is good. Delivery of the food is as promised. Solid restaurant.

This is a Indian food grocery store offer the ingredients and fresh produce. It is convenient for the people in Oldsmar area. Next to to PK play zone. May be your kid play at play zone while you are shopping.   It has tasting area for the item they sold. There are fresh vegetables on sale for cooking and they are nicely displayed. Simple grocery stores has item for typical Indian cuisine. This place is very clean.

Excellent center offer a lot free activities. They also have the art lesson too. The are many lesson can be obtained here. It include music, ceramics, language, yoga, acting and more.   This center is very lively. We have the west coast swing dance here. It was fun to mess up the step and get it right. The center provide a lesson to add the color to our community such as art classes. Meet your neighbors.   This center also host the 2nd Sunday fresh market. It call the north Tampa market. Fresh fruit and vegetables.

Average on the seat Average on the sound  Average on the temperature climate Average on the bathroom  Average on the food.   That sum of it. The seat is reclinable but need to push harder. As a result,it was up right all the time. Which mean the theater pack the seats to get more audiences.   Sound system is not 3D enough like back to front sound is moving. Other than loud it do nothing extraordinary. Temperature a bit cold. May need a light jacket. Bathroom is clean.   The emergency exit is will mark. Trailer is a bit long. Back support need to be better. This review is not for the vine bistro but for the regular theater below.

This is our neighborhood restaurant. It has full bar but seem like is not busy for Sunday.   This is rather inexpensive restaurant for dinner. If you have the coupon, you may get additional $5 discount for over $25 order.   Tonight we have steak and shrimp and the Vallarta tilapia. The steak is a low grade rib eyes but for the price $15 dollar is acceptable. The steak is grilled and come with the grilled shrimp. Food is fresh. The tilapia also flat plate pan fried and grilled instead of open fire grilled.   Food is good portion for a hungry night.

Best value for NOLA food.   Many of the menu item is fried but they are wonderful to try. I guess they got their name Crispy because the crispy fried items. This place is in my book mark for some time. Nick first go to this place without me. Now I come with him for the redemption.   Since this is our fourth restaurants to visit today, we order something good for munch. We have Cajun fried gizzards, crispy catfish, Orleans beignets, and seafood gumbo. The best is the gumbo. It has good taste here. If you are here, just order one without sharing. Have it all for yourself.   I like the catfish and the gizzards. The catfish was nicely batter and fried. The gizzards is soft and easy to eat. This is special item that not serve in normal item to many restaurants.   The owner of the restaurant is nice and she know her cuisine. If you are here your soul for seafood gumbo will be retained in this place. Good luck.

This is the rental car place I like to rent for business because I can park my car close and pickup the rental car. They has choice of car for you to choose if you rental before noon time since not many has pickup the car yet.   The people are friendly. Since I am silver member, I get car upgrade. The car is good working conditions and the wheel are properly align which is important for highway driving. Not all enterprise is the same but I like this one.

This place use to be very good. After I have check back, the concept has change a lot. The previous concept has the customer select the meat, vege and sauce on the tray. Now you have to chose from the selection sheet. Although it is better to preserve the material in refrigeration, but it miss a lot of the previous original ingredient. The old Sarte has the crispy sausage fresh roll that I have miss due to discontinue.   It still have the ice tea all you can drink.  It also maintain the Tom Yum Soup and Fresh Roll. The food is brought to table after you have line up order front the counter. I always select the Thai hot level that I love, if you try very hot please be careful about the burning tongue.     The service is good. The price is matching the quantities and quality of the food provided. The set up of the restaurant is modern look.

Finally a short distance to drive to this BBQ joint. I remember every time I make a trip to Orlando, I have the carry out from this smokehouse BBQ restaurant. Now I can sit and eat the food at the restaurant since they open one in tampa. It Is long wait but worthies for the wait.   Tonight (Friday night) is one of the longer restaurant hour night that they have until 9 pm. We arrive at 6:27pm and the wait line build up to sidewalk of the restaurant side. The wait on the line is 25 minute. The different of this restaurant is they built their sweet item at different side of the order line. This actually reduce the wait time compare to the one at winter park location. This is a improvement. While we were waiting on the line the server bring up the small ketchup cup size try item six shooter for the taste.   We have order the Santa Maria Tri-Tip Steak and Smoke Prime Rib. We have added the half pound signature brisket. The side are the collar green, corn, sweet potato smash, and the bacon wrap jalapeño. The taste did not change from the original restaurant (Fairbanks Winter Park). The prime rib is juicy and tender. The brisket is well seasoning that enter to the meat it self. I love their their side because they extra effort to process it. If you fist time here, you should start with their brisket.   If you come here to have a nice dinner, this is not the place. You should come here just for the food since your food is serve on top of paper on the tray. It is BBQ joint that you need to get down or chow down. Expecting line will build up to the door.

I notice this restaurant when one of the yelper comments she went to her family dinner. I saw some of the some of the picture she post is delicious. I have book mark it for next visit.   It is sad to see the plaza is empty. However the restaurant is the likely attraction in the plaza has most of the cars in front of the store. We have order two dishes of the menu. The waitress is friendly to take our order.   We have the fried pig intestine and the mixed mushroom with round eye beef. The intestine is deep fried then slice into pieces and come with sweet chili sauce. The outside is crispy and the inside is soft. This is a plain fried intestine. I prefer the marinated then fry because is more flavor. Mixed mushroom include straw mushroom and the Russian mushroom with slice round beef in strip. The beef did have a process to tenderize the meat to soften. This dish is cook with sweet soy base sauce.   In this area, it uses to have good Chinese restaurant. Lately many of the restaurants either is go backward to serve American style Chinese food or the main chef left. As a result it is consider this restaurant is decent among the Chinese restaurants.

This review has been delayed. I was not able decided on how many stars until now. This LA fitness is the newest in New Tampa. Definitely all exercise machine is new. Some equipment that seen in the signature facilities is founded here. For the equipments I give them 5 stars. For the service may be not. I was there on the grand opening day. If you are member, they kind of not really paid attention to you. If you new comer, you will treat like a celebrity. There is no investment to member. The air here is better than the one in the county line road at Wesley Chapel. The equipment is regularly clean. This is a plus. They need to think about how to have the member renew their membership. Need to listen to current members and services them correctly.

Very decent ramen place. The interior was nicely decorated to fit the customers comfort. The order started at the front door just like Japan Ramen restaurant. Buy your ramen at the machine and they will bring it out for you.  I like the decorations with the Japanese cartoon. One of the cartoons is if you bring your grandmother to the ramen place, there is a chance she will make the ramen cross stitch. Imagine that ramen sweater :).   We have order the tonkutsu ramen. It come with two pieces of pork belly, two half of porch egg, bamboo shoots and mushrooms. I like the pork belly pan fried to crispy before adding to the ramen. Soup is good. I think if they use a bit pork bone to make the soup thicker is nicer.   Overall our experience is pleasant. Love to come back to visit to try other item in the menu.

This my frequent lunch place. Today we have an office lunch at this restaurant at Christmas Eve. The reservation was very easy today since there is not much of customer. Most if the people is off today from work, as a result, it is easy to get reservation. Usually this place is pack with people at lunch time.   Today we have 11 people in a group. The waiter took our order in less 2.5 minute. I have order the garlic pepper squid with Thai hot. The lunch here is a combo with the soup and appetizer.  The soup is chicken rice clear soup. The chicken was marinate and process before it put on the soup. I always like chef to make an extra step of food process. As a result, the chicken is a bit salty when you separate from the soup but not overpower the soup taste. I usually don't like plain chicken that was not process. The chef here did a good job. The appetizer is the crab Rangoon (fried wanton skin wrap the ground pork). It came with see Thai chili dipping sauce.   The main course is the squid in Galicia pepper. I like they prepare the pepper burn in high heated oil with garlic. This make the flavor enhance and great to eat. The restaurant majority of the food including some sweetness to the taste except this dish and a few dish are salt base.   Overall the service is good and the food is good. If you have group, please call ahead before lunch. This place easy fill up.

This restaurant has some characteristics on the Thai cuisine. If you like very authentic taste, this restaurant has some. We like it because the material use on the dish is unique.  We have order the Tropical duck and grouper special for our entrees. We have the winter shrimp as appetizer. The winter shrimp is a good value. Most of the restaurant has this dish with one shrimp and tail. This restaurant has the whole roll fill with shrimps.   The tropical duck with the meat fried to crispy. It has tropical fruit such as pineapple and lychee. It make it interesting but not wow me. However, they are good enough dish. The dish that wow me is the special grouper. It has a root slice item and green string like the lemon grass flavor. I couldn't make up the name of the two items. But they just make this dish so unique.   I like the food of this store. Service is average.

We are here for a special occasion for a Friend Birthday UYE. I enjoy my time here with Yelpiest people in the private section. When the yelp people get together is always a mission to laugh and enjoy the food. Our birthday girl has a speech but we were unsuccessful to create for her a tear drop moment. Love to yelp and play together.   The restaurant is very accommodating for our event. We have over 30 peoples and we enjoy every moment of it. When we have order, we share the plate with the group. I have order the Hot and Crunchy Tuna Bowl and the Dynamite Crab Roll. The Tuna is seared and chop into pieces. The crunchy part is actually from the tempura batter onion. This dish actually can be improve if they have season the tuna with spice and seared and slice instead of chop cube. I like the bowl with brown rice. The Dynamite Crab Roll is included the Alaskan crab meat. I think the mango overtake the taste of the crab meat. I have a chance to try our friend share plate with Dino & Jimmy roll. This is Alaskan crab meat with tempura shrimp. I like this roll better than the Dynamite Crab roll. I also like my friend Kale salad. It is well season and correct dressing.   During the Sunday, all day happy hour price. Now, this a deal! I have the sangria with red wine. This is a giant glass. One glass is enough. Basically you have to drink some of the sangria before you pull the wine bottle out. Or it will be overspill. Love the drink here.

Stonewood is the restaurant when I am come home late from travel and order to go. I have been in the restaurant 5 different times and numerous to go orders. I like this restaurant because is close to my home.  The interior decoration is very nice. The seat is very spacious. There are a few dish that I like. The Grilled Lamb Chop, New York Strip, Oak Grilled Salmon, Clam Chowder with cram meat, rosemary Rack of Lamb, and their burger.   Tonight I have the New York Strip in medium rare with grill asparagus. The strip is perfectly grill with original meat taste. The asparagus is not too fiber and the stem is soft to eat. I also add a cup of clam chowder with crab meat. This is one of my favorite chowder. The crab meat can feel the lump pieces.   I usually call ahead 30 minutes if I have the Togo order. When I arrive, the food just completed in right timing.

It is my honor to introduce you the small business sandwich shop that is one of the top of my list.   I have read many reviews for this shop and learn about the abbreviation of SSSS for name this shop. You also can said it translated to Sophisticate, Satisfaction, Special and Stylish sandwich. This four words are truly represent the food serve there.  We are trying their new sandwich that is not in the menu yet. We have the Arcade. It is quarter pound seared Ahi Tuna on the pretzel bun. The tuna is well seared on the out side with toasted sesame seed. The sesame seed was prepared very nicely with crispy and crunchy. It top with marinated sea weed salad and sriracha mayo. This sandwich is a keeper can be considered in the regular menu. Very sophisticate and special. It also come with a choice of side for $10.99.   It you visit the shop, you will see the took picks on the ceiling. These took picks are the left over from sandwich. It becomes a transitional for this store. Service is friendly, food is good, price is right. They deserve to be 5 stars.

Yes. I like this wine bar restaurant. I have seen many of our fellow yelpers reviewed this restaurant and I have book mark them for some time. Finally, I have the chance is open up since the other restaurant close at 8 pm.  The restaurant does have a wine bar. I like their wine by the glass selection. You can buy the wine by ounce. They start with 3 ounces glass and you can add by the multiple of 3 ounces. The price will be added on until you can get a whole bottle. For me is perfect since my wife do not like alcohol and I can go with the food with how many ounce I need. The wine list seems like changing base on the availability.   Tonight we started with fried pita bread with the red bean paste and the calamari as appetizers. The pita is crispy and loves to use it to pick the paste. The calamari is normal but the sweet chili sauce makes it to the top. I like it with the caper and make this unique from other fried calamari.  We have the beef empanada and the lobster bisque. The beef empanada is so so. The Bisque is good but the lobster crump is too less.  Our entrée are the Lobster Risotto and the Grilled Salmon with green bean. The salmon is greatly grilled and top with tomato salsa. This is OK dish. The lobster risotto has six large shrimp in it. Again the lobster meat crump is too less.   Overall the meal for two with a glass of wine with tip is approximate $50 is not a bad deal. I may come back to visit some time when I finish my book mark. The tablet to call the service is useless. We have press it twice and nothing happening. Use the hand signal is the best.

If you like Octoberfest celebration, this is the place does it all year. Dancing, singing, step on the chair or table dancing, it is like festival time.   It has been some time I did the chicken dance. It is fun that try to get some year that I know I am little chicken. The night we visited here and I have done it. We did this on the visit to Munich HB. Their beer hall not just have the music and also have the show. The HB at St. Pete just have the music band.   The HB also participate in the St. Pete restaurant night. But the discount is not deep. Since this place is pack all time we decided come after 9pm. We were sit immediately. We have the Kartoffelsuppe-it is the Bavarian potato soup with sausage. Good soup for the fist course.   The second course is the schweinebraten - the Munich pork roast in beer sauce. Yum. The pork roasted with good flavor. The final course is the Apfelstrudel - the slice apple and slice dough tower on cold vanilla sauce. Make my tummy happy.   Overall the food is good and services is good. The cuisine is Bavarian is best among the German cooking. The beer is ok compare to the beer at Munich brew. I have the Octoberfest. Fun atmosphere and wonderful night.

This is one of the convenient properties of Bluegreen time share. The location located at the heart of New Orleans. It locates on Decatur near Canal Street. It is easy access to the French Quarter and the river walk area. The Mardi Gras parade is pass by the Canal street where we are two building behind the Canal street. We can push the door to see if the parade is arrived yet then go to the street to watch. During the cold weather, it good that you don't need wait on the street.   The lobby is well decorated. The entry is scanned access and the elevators also have the same system. Very secure. Nighttime guard is present if anything happen. The seven floors have sun deck. We have the one bedroom at the third floor. Since this is the historic building, our room have tiny window. This is the only down fall.   The building is easy access to nearby restaurant. It is a few block to Royal and Bourbon Street. You can party with drink and walk home to your building easily.

Just average ice cream store. Nothing special. Other than they conveniently located at Central Ave, St. Petersburg. It is easy walk distance for the downtown residents. Urban Creamery is part of URBAN local food chain. They have BBQ, southern food and deli. With ice cream add to their extended food variety that make them complete. Just need the appetizer restaurant complete the chain can offer.   We have the rum raisin and strawberry chocolate chip. Since the 12 oz is only 2.50 more than the 6 oz, we went for the Grande. The strawberry chocolate chip is just ok. I feel they are not creamy enough. Half to the Italian ice frozen texture. The rum raisin is better. The total is close to $7 for 4 scoops is kind in the high side.

Little market in the historic YBOR city. Very close to the Hillsborough Community College. There was many apparent near that location. It is at the Quarter Condominium. Just at Palm Ave and 19 Street. The apple map has them at opposite corner at wrong location. But is close to see it.   We were in search of Le' Ann's Cheesecake. They carry 4 flavors here. I have coffee cheesecake and my wife has the strawberry cheesecake. These cheesecake come in jar. The store carry many type of wine if you want a retail wine. They also has deli section that you can order the sandwiches. I have seen the black bean patty there for veggie burger assembly. Hmmm. Just wonder are they good.   The store Clark is very friendly. We were welcome by them and help by them. If you need somethings quick in YBOR, this may be you place.

The event is a success in the food court. A lot credit go to the organizer. This night, I believe over 300 people show up. They over 6 food truck there today. I wish it could have been more. The Asian cuisine is popular to the local.   The food truck include 2 Filipino trucks, one Thai truck, Korean, dumpling truck. All food is great if you order their specialty. The atmosphere is great. I have been to the first Friday event and not truck show up. But this is something for the taste of Asia. We have big group of yelpers show up and support this event. Thanks to Carlos Eat who are helping in this event.   Our group share the food across table. Food, drink and great time make up for the night. I would recommend come here for thier special truck event.

Like it! Like it! Like it!  I am a fan of the Coppertail free dive beer. The beer is very tasty and smell good with the wheat. This is one of the best craft beer in Bay Area.   Today we are here for the cinco de mayo food truck rally. When we arrived, there is only one truck that serve Cajun food. However the truck do not serve that, instead, they are serving taco.   Well! food is not happening. We decided to join the tour. The tour is $7 per person. This tour is the best value if you visit this brewery. It include two beer tasting and a glass of wine of your choice. I have the free dive. My wife does not drink so I have another glass of Thai spicy beer. Very interesting. The spiciness went deep down your throat. You can feel it.   The tour is very informative. The guide is very knowledgeable. He know these beer. If I am visit again, go for the tour.

This Krewe is name after the big Lake Pontchartrain. This is one of the daytime parades and has more action and good for the kid who cannot stay late at night. This is one of the parades I like since it just located two building from my resort. When we hear the music we know the parade is arrived.  Parents please check the progress of the parade if you decided to watch at the Canal Street. It usually takes about 2 hours to reach here since the parade is 4.5 miles before it reach the Canal Street.   The parade consist of dance school, Cajun Indian and Cowboy horse Riding Club, Tulane ROTC, High and Middle school marching band, flag team, cheer leader, private school team, Big Easy Roller Girls, Muff-A-Lottas, Academy school. Of course there is King and Queen Float and other Float for the beads. The parade comes with dune buggy, horses, tractor pull float, and pony. There people dress like black Cowboy and white Indian. I like the Muff-A-Lottas group of waitress dance with their serving tray.   This is the parade you can see far away when they approach. A tip is to find a spot where they turn and you can them far away. This is a parade I recommended for the children to enjoy since it is daytime not late at night. There big amount of bead were giving out make people rush for it. Although there is barricade along the route, I still see adult doing unthinkable thing let their kid over the barricade and pick up the beads that left at the middle of street that hard to get.  This dangerous and the float may injure the kid.

Hyde Park Village is almost like small community in the Bay Area that actually separate from the rest of America. You will not need to get out of village and you can get everything there.   Imagine that they 3 garages you can park your car. The businesses include Brooks Brothers, Tommy Bahama, papers store, dog toy, clothing, jewelry. There is a Bridal store for designer gown.   You also can become a member for the LA fitness for exercise. The village has the fresh market that you can get your groceries there. A lot to offer.   The restaurants in the village have great selection. It includes the wine bistro, Italian chop house, quick snack with creative taco and pastry store for breakfast. There is a "nature table" for quick bite.   All the stores or restaurants are in 5 minutes walking distance. There are some apartments or house surrounding the village.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. But not quite 3.5 stars. I would said it is at the healthy side of the menu. Service is great because the owner paid attention to the detail. I would said not much of Market according to the name of the restaurant.   It is preassembling food and heat up to serve. It has to be about the sauce and ingredients since the chef skill cannot be evaluated here. I like the choice of noodle. It include the sweet potatoes noodle that is rarely use. I order the duck sweet potatoes noodles. I have every ingredient or veggies to be included. I have it as Dry sauce. Duck is ok. I wonder the roast themselves or buy it ready from oriental market. If you want the soupy, it is additional $2.   I think their restaurant is at the middle compared to the one at Seminole Height and the Clearwater Fresh market noodle shop.

The restaurant use to be Indian buffet restaurant that I remember. Now is a Pakistani halal restaurant. The current restaurant is order by menu. The price is reasonable for kabab. The owner is always at the store front.   We have ordered Lamb sheek  kabab, Chicken biryanis, and the nan. The lamb is chop meat and marinated and grilled. It accompanied with onions and tomatoes. The meat is good taste. However I prefer lamb cube meat. The chicken biryanis rice is softer than many biryanis rice I have tried. The are 5 good pieces of chicken in it. The spice can be a bit stronger since I like heavy spice.   Overall the price is close to $10 each dish. There is not much of service. Only bottle water is serve here. You can order some hot drink. Restaurant is average.

Chief's Creole is just open a few months. They are located at the historical African American Heritage Trail. The restaurant itself contains a lot of history. You can request Mrs. B to give you a tour.   Today we have a chance to taste the sample of food from this restaurant from the Red Carpet to Royal Theater event. They are fried fritter, vegetable medley, bread pudding, and turkey wrap. The vegetable medley is stir fry with special seasoning and garlic. It is very yummy. The fried fritter cannot make up what is the material but they are good, this item is not in the menu. The best is the bread pudding. It is very good. I have not tried their actual menu yet. But they have good lunch and dinner menu. The lunch is less than $8.95 and their dinner menu is less than $15. I will certainly try them on if I near them next time. Their lunch menu includes shrimp po-boy and their dinner includes gumbo or jambalaya.   Please remember they are not open on Monday and Tuesday. Their restaurant is Creole Louisiana Style cuisine. Base on the tiny experience, I am given them 4 star. I will adjust my review when I have the dinner.

This is a USF center for advance health care state of the art building that receive patient. The parking garage is convenient connected next to center and has designated patient parking. The building is connected with sky bridge at second floor that allow pedestrian crossing over the street in cover over top. The state of art building cost USF $67 million to build. This is wold class building with intend for patient and learning center. This is not the USF medical school department where student having classes.   The center allows patient to consult with the specialty doctor. Specialties include: Orthopedics and Sports Medicine; Physical Therapy, Ear, Nose and Throat, Breast Health, Women's Health, Neurology, and Dermatology and Cutaneous Surgery. It has ambulatory surgery center with eight operating rooms and five endoscopy suites.  It also has diagnostic imaging center with MRI, CT, women's diagnostics with mammography, ultrasound and bone densitometry, fluoroscopy, basic X-ray, and nuclear medicine.   It has cafeteria and drug store Sweetbay Pharmacy conveniently located on the 1st floor. Great customer service. Occasionally you have to wait for the doctor if they have emergency case.  We have a chance to visit one of the specialty doctor here. The reception is super nice since they have to care for the internal illness patient. The doctor we see is knowledgeable on their medical back ground.

John Pass Village has a lot of restaurant. But I only bookmark this one. I have seen many great reviews here. So I decided to try. Parking need to paid. It doesn't matter is garage or street side parking.   This restaurant famous on the lobster roll. I would said the roll is below medium price. Which is value for the try. They claim it is New England style lobster roll. I found it a lot of butter. The meat is a mixed of the body and crawl. Which is supposed to be. Some other vendors serve this roll more into the crawl meat which I don't like it. But this restaurant is fair with body meat. They roll is well above average with a lot of meat.   I also have the grouper taco. I think the seasoning is way too salty. It come with two taco. I would skip it and get two lobster roll. The service is attentive. Food come out fast since most is premade.

Southern food with soul. You can describe this restaurant like this one. It has the southern flavor and most welcome for the south. I just wonder why don't they have one closer to the New Tampa Area.   This restaurant is pack on the Monday night. They serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner. At dinner they have a choice of blue plate special with one trip one plate. Pile as high as you want for hot or salad  table with $10.44. However, after you see the choice of buffet. You know one plate may not enough. You will go for the Market Plate with unlimited trip and plate plus dessert. Oh man! Oh man. A lot of choice of delicious food. The Market Plate is $14.47 per person. Best is the fried catfish.  The catfish is delicious. Don't forget the strawberry shortcake. The strawberry was marinated in syrup and very yummy good.

I come to Twennie home town but she has not review this place yet. I am surprised that I am reviewing ahead of her.   The Tasty Pho is a very comfortable place to be compared to many Vietnamese restaurant in the Bay Area. Modern looking interior decoration and nice to eat and hangout. I forgot to ask if they have the Wifi.   I have order the combination Tasty Beef Noodle pho and grilled shrimp sub Banh Mi Tom Nuong. The Tasty Beef Noodle is combination of slice beef, beef flank, beef ball, beef tripe and beef tendon. I like this noodle soup due to the tripe and tendon are big and whole piece. The soup has a bit of minty taste. The grill shrimp sub is sub is best one I have. The shrimp is include a bit black pepper and they are grill to perfection. The bun is toasted and crispy. Therefore they are easy to bite.   Overall the experience is great. Like the pho and Banh Mi. Services is great and the interior is great.

IKEA is my favorite furniture store 15 years ago. This Swedish company was originally open their door in America at 1985 in Philadelphia. I first bought their furniture at Houston IKEA when we have vacation there. Soon they open the market in Florida then Tampa.   IKEA provide nanny care while you are shopping. There also have their restaurant inside the store make shopping or lunch there easy. It is very convenient to many customers for easy strolling and look for the furniture.   The furniture is great for small apartment. There are many space saving ideal. I would said their furniture required a person can follow the instructions of assembling and time to put it together. Their furniture is good price. Since it requires assembly, some people just don't have the time. But I like it to make it my weekend project.   I would said their furniture are not great for house moving. Once it assembled, they just need to left it in place. Because once you move it too much, you will damage the furniture assembly Joint or connection. Their furniture do look great. And they are very contemporary and modern look.

This restaurant previously name Cilantro. It has changed its name to Dhaniya Drums Indian food. The new management started 2 months ago. The setting is the same but food has change a bit. They do have some chicken dish.   For the buffet, they have served the lollipop chicken and tandoori chicken. They also serve butter curry tofu, red curry with eggplants; their nan is getting better since they bring it to your table. They also have a lot selection on veggie dish. It also has soup, desert, salad, additional chili paste to increase spiciness. The cooking is more to American Tolerance. The taste is a bit sweet instead of spicy. The tandoori chicken has it flavor enter into the deeper part of the chicken. The lollipop chicken is great, but the hot plate only keeps it warm instead of hot. I like the curry eggplants. It go well with nan and the rice. The cost is under $10 for the buffet is considering good value.  I like their soup of the day. I could not make up the ingredient for the soup but it is good. I like the food to be spicier. At the chili paste to make it spicy is not the same to cook it spicy. This restaurant did not give me a return immediately for more. It is just a list for lunch if we have too many people in party that need to finish quicker then we will consider.

Good deal to start with. Every thing five below. I think their item is better than any dollar store. At least they last for some time. With that said. I saw many of the items is made from China. Who care, as long as it is safe and last for some time.   This is my first time walk in here since my wife is a regular. Since it is approaching Easter, a lot of Easter display item such as bunny and chocolate.   I like the electronic item. Selfie stick, color cell phone power cord and ear phones. What catch my eye is the LED wheel light. You just need affixed the mechanic to the tire pump tube. It will light in color when the bicycle is moving and spinning. It creat wonderful colors. Safe at night and look "fancy".   They also has cheap cell phone case. I am not sure they are impact resistant. I like their toy section including mechanical arm and the large bubbles maker.

This restaurant may be the lowest cost dinner in Hyde Park for delicates restaurant such as Piguant, Boca, and Timpano. The setting of the restaurant is very nice that you can have variety of wine by glass.   Tonight we begin with a pound of mussel. It serves with spicy coconut herb broth. The broth is a bit spicy compare to normal mussel in butter garlic wine sauce. I actually like their spicy herb sauce over the butter garlic wine sauce. The mussel is great. The appetizer also comes with two garlic cheese bread. It is yummy to dip into the sauce and eat it with the soak bread. Now you are feeling hungry to try it tomorrow.   The entrees are the 12 oz NY strip and duck breast. Both dish meat come out with warm temperatures. They can improve this issue for the accompany side dish. Seem like they are waiting for the side dish to finish and they have not put the meat in the heat lamp to keep it hot. The NY strip comes correctly with the way I have order it. I think they need to heat up the grill with higher BTU grill will make this dish better with slightly burn. The duck is a bit fat under the skin. Overall the meat is well season. The side dish is actually better than the main dish. The stir fry mix veggie is flavorful. Overall the dishes are well prepared except they need to keep up the temperature of the meat.   Base on the above experience, this restaurant is grade correctly with 3.5 stars. Since YELP doesn't have the half star, I am given them 4 stars. Service is great. Interior is great.

My church always hire this BBQ company to do the cookout at church special functions. I have been eating their food go many times but never visited their actual store. It was interesting to see they have two buildings. The north building is most of the people dine in. The north building is more like the overflow. They also have the outside seats. The takeout is at the back of the north building. Basically like curbside parking service.   Food is good. We have order the two meat special combo to go. We walk in the store instead of curbside service. The food come out quick less than three minutes. Record time. It is easy and straightforward. The baby back has a lot of meat. The chicken is great too. The collar green may need to add some bacon make it more tasty. But some can go without the bacon. We also have the sweet corn casserole. I like this item.

The facilities of the gym offer multi phase of exercise. You can work out yourself in the gym with the equipment, team sport, aerobic class, personal trainer. They also have swimming pool, sauna, locker room.   Not long ago they bought the life style gym and shut down the smaller life style gym. The member of the smaller gym now crowed to this location. Many of the good aerobic teacher left life style and the LA fitness organization, and only the mediocre teacher left. May be LA Fitness do not pay as well to the good gym teacher and they go to other gym. The crowed situation present a shortage of equipment. The class with 7.5 pound dun bar is run out the in the exercise class. Some of the member have to bring their own. I wonder why we paid so much and we have to bring our own exercise equipment. The swimming pool also get crowed. We have an experience that after they sale you the three year membership, they are changing their way of doing business to the bad side.   The morning class become too crowed which don't have not enough room to reach out your hand during the aerobic class. The big gym sometime has the AC shut off to save the facilities electric bill and cause the member suffer without air while exercising. The management need to listen to the client suggestion to improve the situation. What ever the sale group promise you doesn't work since their operation side decide how the gym run. You have to know their operation group is different than the sales group. You can complaint to the sale group but the operation group won't change the way of business operated. And their answer is corporate policy. This two group within the LA fitness need to be clean up how they really want to run the business.  I am disappointed to their current operation after 4.5 year with them. As a result a two star is awarded.

The word for this restaurant is NOLA cuisine. This restaurant simply the best in Tampa Bay Area for serving the NOLA cuisine. We love our time here. The service is a bit slow. But the food are excellent. This place has vibe. If you come before 11:00 am order a drink, the beignets is free go with the drink.   I like bar area. It has tight cool bar. This is a tiny place. The most you can seat inside is less than 40. Time to time they are pack. We have ordered beignets, Andouille Sausage, Red Grouper Bite, and the Seafood Gumbo. The beignets is just ok. But the rest of food are delicious. The red grouper is fresh and chunky. It accompanied with red cabbage slaw and sweet potatoes. This come with 4 different sauce. Yummy to try.   The Andouille Sausage is slice into 4 thin slice. Serves over red bean and Louisiana style rice. The red bean was grind to liquid and serve with whole bean. The sausage is pan grilled to let the taste exhaust outwardly. The seafood gumbo is insanely good. It has shrimp, scallops, Andouille Sausage, crab, grouper, okra, pea. The gumbo sauce take you out of your mind. If someone looking for Louisiana cuisine, I will certainly point this way.   Too good. So try yourself. Mike drop experience.

Our friend like to try shabu shabu and we pick this restaurant since they have closer one to our Chinese taste. We normally don't do shabu shabu is due to the assembly material can be obtained in any oriental market and cook it yourself.   What is shabu shabu. My family celebrating Chinese New Year with this cuisine because it can add anyone anytime by add additional material without involving heavy cooking. The New Year also fall in the winter time and they are cold outside and shabu shabu is the best part. There is a Chinese term for shabu shabu- hot pot. We actually have the charcoal in middle to broil the soup and heat up the pot. Now we have the electric broiler that not required charcoal and easy to control the temperature of the pot.   The material is easy. Just but the chicken and pork and remove the meat. The bone of the pork and chicken put into the soup and broil for the broth. This restaurant did not do that. All their soup is come in package of spice and added into the pot. They have the selection of the slice meat, meat or fish ball, dumpling, veggies, type noodles. They are not authentic since their soup is in package.   Eating the hot pot is topic the sauce correctly. The right sauce is important to dip on after you have broil your material. The service of the restaurant is slow. But they have each pot for each person. Something I don't understand is why they charge the soup to broil in addition to the material. I would suggest only charge when you want to upgrade the soup.

We went back to this restaurant since my boss have a good experience last time. This time we have a different experience. Seem like the restaurant change the owner or the chef has changed.   After the waiter took our order, the accompanying appetizer came out in different group time. We all have the same appetizer but they came out different time. Some of us have it and some have to wait.   The garlic squid that I have order is different from I used to get. They are not as perfect garlic sauce as I know. I hope they can improve.

The restaurant is pushing out the new menu with $9 dish in 9 minutes or free. We are the in their email list that allow us to buy one $9 menu and has the second one free. It is a steal and the promotion run to 3/1 with email coupon.   The new $9 menu has to order from the kitchen counter. The kitchen counter only operates from monad to Thursday. We have tried their pork belly chicken carbonara, prosciutto and chicken penne, brisket rigatoni, and diavola scaloppine. The one we like the most are pork belly chicken carbonara and prosciutto and chicken angel hair. After the order, they will give you a number and you can select any empty table.  By the way, you will not expect a lot table service.   Since the meal come out in 9 minutes, the whole dinner only need less than half hour. This is deigning for quick outlet and short time. You have to love the pasta dish in order to love this $9 meal. They also run the 7 minutes $7 lunch. It will be good with short time lunch break with restaurant entree. You will in and out the restaurant in 30 minutes. Thus it is the faster dinner ever.

For the lunch, they deserve the five stars. This is about 4.5 stars restaurant. This restaurant is new kid at the block at this southern Riverview. Restaurant location at Apple map is incorrect and I have reported them. The Yelp page was correctly show the restaurant location.   If you looking for value lunch, this is the place. I have their lunch special with maki lunch. The cost is $9. Two rolls with a choice of soup or salad. I got the spicy tuna and and salmon skin rolls. Both rolls come at 8 pieces. They are good size. I hope they keep it up.   I also go an app Mixed Tempura. It come with two tempura shrimp, four tempura veggies and one tempura broccoli. They have the best broccoli tempura which not over coating the broccoli. Very good technique. The dipping sauce bowl is big enough to accommodate the tempura pieces. Shrimp is great.   I don't need to wait for my food. I finish in less than 35 minutes for lunch. Good value entree and app for $15.

Mad scientist or creative chef. Do you have to decide the final outcome for the food lab. It is actually experiment food?  Mmmm. Let see the dinner out come. We have our company holiday dinner there with design menu. It is not cheap but very worth for the trip.   Our request menu is a four course night with starting the cold appetizers at the first plate. My wife have the almond coconut gazpacho - it is coconut rock shrimp with Fuji Apple salpicon in green curry oil. This a cold soup. The rock shrimp is nice and creative in the soup. The soup base is not normal gazpacho and is white. It is good. I have the avocado leaf seated yellow fin tuna. This is the best of the cold app. It come green mango salad, aji amarillo sorbet, fish sauce caramel and tamarind peanut crunch. It creative that the sorbet replace the wasabi and the fish sauce caramel replace the balsamic reduction sauce. Now you know why they call themselves food lab.   The second course are the hot appetizers. I have smoked maple glazed pork belly. It top with hoe cake, black eyed peas, green tomato chow-chow. Usually I don't care about hoe cake but sauce and other ingredients combine, it is great. The pork belly is cook perfectly. If you are not good chef, do not try this dish because it need three part meat harmony. My wife has Serrano ham zeppole. The slice hams were place on top of rosemary doughnuts with compressed melon, Saba and Parmesan snow. Interesting dish. The rosemary was deep fried to crispy with seasoning. I have not have it this way before.   Our third course are the main dishes. I have the red snapper a la plancha. It is fillets snapper with sautéed and glazed on top on avocado coconut grits, baby spinach, mergers marmalade, avocado chutney and mango harissa purée. This best main dish tonight the purée go very well with the fish. My wife has the painted hills short rib 'sancocho'. Usually the Caribbean sancocho is a mix of meat and veggies soup. This is an overhaul design for the short rib with boniato, yuca, sweet potato, and sweet corn, green plantain,avocado toss watercress, and cilantro sweet garlic juice. I only can said - it is good.   The final course is the sugar crusted butter cake or chocolate peanut butter bar. Both of them is great. I the butter cake because the cake form the caramelized sugar crust on all expose wall. The cake is syrup and is good.   The only thing is the food take a bit time to come out for the first dish. The rest are good. The service is great. The drink you have to refer to the pic since we don't know what they have created.

Great restaurant to be visited at Sunday. Because it has brunch menu. Their lunch menu look very good. Definitely come back for that in the future Sunday. I like the live music at the sidewalk and sidewalk seating.   We were here for the taco week. We got the spicy pork taco and Modelo beer. The taco was good to enjoy. The pork has some spicy in it with a kick. I would said American Spiciness. Not the Mexican spicy. The modelo only 3 dollars on that day is a steal.   We enjoy the atmosphere there. The waitress is alert and attentive to our need A+ for service.

This restaurant locate at downtown St. Pete close to the museum of fine art. Since this is a Thursday night with museum special deal after 5 pm ($5 per adult, normal $17), after museum, we decide to come to this restaurant.   The store front is a open bar. The time we were there is about six and they can sit you immediately. After 30 minutes, there is already a waiting line. Please come before six if you don't want to wait for sit. Bella already extend their sitting area with capacity, however if you are late, you will need to wait.  Among all the restaurant at downtown, they are the most reason in price for the food.   Today I order the menu with "secondi" category - marinated skirt steak and my wife order the grilled chicken pasta. The item in the "secondi" came with soup of the day or salad. This is better deal. The $22 skirt steak came with two side and a soup. Good deal. The soup of the day is minestrone sausage soup. It is bean base, dice tomatoes, dice carrot, and chop pasta in crush tomatoes base. I believe they have added the oregano and basil to enhance the flavor. It make the soup well balance and interesting.   The skirt steak is marinated with sweet sauce and serve with mash potatoes and grill broccolini. The broccolini is very impress. They broil, grill and stir fry in the process with garlic sauce with a hint of spicy chili. This make the food sophisticate. The skirt steak is grill to your order and slice to the bite size.   The whole proceed of serving is ok. It is slow in the beginning but it pick up at the end. The extend area may be good for company Christmas party. It deserve for full stars due to to chef cooking skill, service, clean bath room and good pricing.

Best of the Tampa Bay have many vendors display in one time. The different between the VIP and Regular ticket is the sitting. The VIP has assign sitting and the regular are fighting for the park bench of stair case. Event this big will take two hours to complete the tour for entire vendors. This event is sold out. I have the chance to party with my friend Nick throughout the walk of fame. We also meet up with Rachel, Fern, Katy, and Aleema, Nadine, and Jacob.  During the event, music is playing in three different stages. Food stand surround area tight and some have demonstrate cooking of the spot. There too many vendor and restaurant. I am only picked the one are the best of the night.  I am staring with the host of the place Maestro's at the Starz Center. They have many to offer with their staff chefs. I am sure they can create something new each day. The restaurants in my list tonight are Miguel's Mexican Grill, Queen of Sheba Ethiopian Restaurant, Aqua, Saddle Brook Resort, Chart House Tampa, WaterWorks Bar and Grill, Bar 700 Holidays Inn Westshore, Colombia Restaurant, and Timpano Chophouse. And my most favorite of the night is the Oyster Catcher. These are the restaurants in my list to visit. I like to thanks the Ducky's ladies took a picture with me and I may visit them one day. The only bad thing about this event is too many standing.   After 9:30 pm, most of the people is start staying away from the food and move to the party on the river front. Tonight is a bit hot but it does not stop us from dancing. Many ladies of the night challenge Nick for a dance off. Rachel also get to one of the stage and dance. What a fun night to be.

You home made? You want ice cream? You desserts? You want Cuban pastry? You want chocolate fountain? You to see Ely? Just come to visit. Let's home made ice cream is new business near Armenia.   Ely is very friendly. The first dollar was given by one of our yelp friend. The have the Cuban pastelitos with meat, guava, cheese and my favorite- the coconut. This Cuban pastry is crispy on the outside skin. They also has chocolate fountain for dipping.   The most important product is the ice cream. The home made ice cream is rich in milk. The flavor change every time. However, you will taste somethings that you have never tasted before.   They also have coffee, Cuban dessert like flan, señorita. Try some banana split or cake with ice cream. They are all good.

This 3.5 stars restaurant. Not yet 4 stars. I was debate to give them 3 or 4 stars. At the end the 4 stars weight in. A word of thought. This restaurant close to the epic of Vietnamese cuisine in Pinellas Park. They need to show the know how to survive and attract to the customers.   The restaurant menu is not exciting. Very much similar to the surrounding. The grill pork may need to improve. Not just from the season sauce but also the grilled technique.   I like the basil crispy chicken. That is the best dish. I like the five spice seasoning. We have the grilled pork vermicelli. The pork did not grille till the meat flavor come out. But the sauce in vermicelli is unique. The moonlight special is the steak and sunny side up egg. This dish is more American style. It is an attractive dish. The flavor is average.   We have the moonlight fruit drink and the lychee black tea. My wife like the black tea because is caffeine less with tea taste.

Good spice in the mixture of the Indian cuisine. That sum up the reviews of the restaurant. The only thing is this restaurant is located very far away and I cannot regularly visit them.  The lunch buffet is $9.99. It is all you can eat. The food spiciness is at medium range which my wife can take it. They have curry chicken, butter curry chicken, egg plant, biryanis, veggie spring roll, nan and more. One thing I like is their curry is good thick with a lot of spice. At the end, the have gulag ball for dessert. That is just to cool down the spiciness.   Overall is good experience. Like the food. I like them spicier. I do want to suggest to add the goat curry if they know how to do it. Unfortunately we didn't see any traditional tandoori chicken. This items can be added.

Rare Ethnic Food No. 27  Cajun style cuisine is a happy thought since I spend 3.5 years in Louisiana. It was interesting that Cajun people are mainly at Louisiana. Cajun has become part of special cuisine in Louisiana. Cajun creole style has many type.  This restaurant special in popboys with grilled and fried.    Their menu included blacken or fried shrimp, catfish, chicken, and fried oyster. They also has Alligator sausage that I have not try. After 3 pm, the Abita beer is dollar off. This restaurant close early. They don't open pass 6 pm and some of the day close at 4 pm.   Today I am going to mixed and match. I ordered the half grilled shrimp and half fried oyster popboy. The Cajun spice on the grilled shrimp is good. I also has the blacken catfish. It was good blacken with fresh catfish. I like the edge of the blacken catfish. It has the most flavor.   The wait of the food is good, no too long of wait. It is an open air restaurant. It great to enjoy at 70 degrees temperature day.

We have a holiday party there. We have 28 people attending. The reservation was confirmed about 5 months ago and the process is easy. The management team is on top of the menu select and securing the reservation.   I was excited for the dinner. Only downside is we have 28 people and only two waiters. The drink order was delay on some of my friends. The cocktail select is good. No frozen drink. Craft cocktail is only a few.   The appetizers include Nueske Bacon, Fried Calamari Strip, Mac Roll, and Tuna Tartare. The mac roll is mac in 4 cheese in wonton skin and top with mango chili sauce. I like the tuna tartare the best. The house salad with feta vinaigrette and balsamic is good.   The food delivery is great. It is on time. I have the rib eyes and my wife have the sea bass. Both dishes are excellent. The quality of meat for the ribeye is perfect. It accompanied with the caramel shallots. The sea bass was was likely seasoning and seared with the good flavor outwardly. The side includes 4 cheese mac, grilled asparagus and garlic smash potatoes. The selection asparagus may need to choose the thinner stem for softer section. Since the stem is large in diameter, the low end of stem is hard. A suggestion to chef is to remove hard stem section before serve.  The close out desert is average. The fried donut is ok. Overall the experience is good but no wow factor. It is solid restaurant for the American cuisine.

This is solid ice cream place at the heights. Consider many place not even have AC interior seating for ice cream joint, this is a luxury. They really has pick up most of review negative comments and make a good turn to good. I would give them a 5 stars on the improvement. Keep it up.   They very close to above the 4.5 stars. But not yet. Still they are move in the right direction. The flavor need to be a wow factor. So far they are close. But can be better. They need to know the best seller and may be a wow flavor. We have the Jolly green Apple and Mint want cookies flavor. Both of them are good. The green apple is a sorbet. It has very nice color. I like kiddy color very attractive. The apple flavor need to be a bit stronger. I like the mint cookie. It is interesting.   Our experience there is great. It is comfy to enjoy the ice cream there.

Mobile food truck most is some quick and easy assembling. But I have not seen a pho truck before. This is my first.   During the Generation Food truck event for the Taste of Asia the Pho Truck was there. I have a chance to try their pho. Their pho is bit different than other Vietnamese restaurant pho. It is a bit lighter and more into cilantro taste. The price charge is typical Vietnamese restaurant pricing. It is good to have good bowl when they close to your work or venue.   I have tried their sandwich with grilled pork, vermicelli with grilled pork and egg roll, and fresh roll. They are average. You walk to the back of the truck to see what the actions in the kitchen are. They are bunch of hard working people, two assembling food and one take order and deliver food. I would order the pho again if I see them. The line of the event for this truck is loooong. Good business when you see the line long.  After talking to my wife. I feel the pricing is in the high side.

I am ok with this place for quick bite. Grab a slice of pizza for snack or lunch. This place is busy after 8 pm. Seem like they have good business. I believe the price is affordable that drawn the crowd.   Many choice to the type of pizzas to chose. Each slice no more than $3.50. They do have some specialty pizza that you normally not seen at pizza fast food restaurant. I would said they are better than the pizza fast food. All pizzas were made and display. You pick the one you like and ask them to heat up. Heat up is good, I prefer the freshly cook since I am in the restaurant.   The place is popular, outside seating is available. It is fist come first seat situation. Just wait for someone the get off is easy since most people grab only a quick bite. Seat is available very soon. The problem is wait to get your table you have claim to clean up. Eventually it will be clean.

Craft Kafe is an interesting restaurant with many flavor. With the restaurant next door to organic grocery store, they can get the fresh ingredients immediately. You also can eat healthy here since they have organic items.   Definitely stop here for breakfast. I usually not a breakfast person but got to try their breakfast since many reviews indicate they are good. We have order an omelette and two coffees. I have the latte and my wife has cappuccino. I have ask them to decorate the cream in artist way and she did impressed me. Coffee is good and better than Starbucks.   The omelette we order is the craft omelette. It come with spinach, chicken sausage, mushrooms. It accompanied with hash browns and toss. It is quite tasty.   The cafe also have other item such as fresh squeezed juice, quiches, vegan pumpkin bread and more. If I pass by here again, I will check them out.

Frida bakery has mixed reviews from my friend. I like to find out myself for my own experience. The bakery serve lunch and breakfast. The breakfast included many item with bacon. The lunch also good. When I was there, many come in for the soup, I did not try that.   I got to pieces of their dessert for the my late snack. I have cassada torte and the carrot cake. The cassada torte has a cannoli place on top. The middle has two layers of cake and mousse and a layer of chocolate. The cake is moist and has syrup in it. It is tasty.   The carrot cake is good. It is top with carrot icing. Layer with cake cream. My experience here is good. No big wow factor. They have outside seating good for the current weather. I was serve quickly. Seem like the customers who eat there enjoy it.

Great ice cream place at Central Avenue St. Petersburg. We like it because of free topping anyway you like. You can get the topping you like with self serve condition. Only the this roll ice cream has it. The day we visited this place is 10 minutes to close. They still served us. There were more people came here after closing and they still serve the customers. This is a A plus for customers who show up late.   I got the cotton candy roll ice cream. The decoration includes the pink and blue cotton candy on top and a rainbow gummy bear over it. It look pretty. The roll ice cream is delicious. My wife got the King Samoa. This is a Nutella and caramel syrup. It has coconut flake and crackers in it. Lovely roll ice cream. My wife decorated with beautiful topping. It look attractive. It is five star because it worth the money here.

Very close to 4.5 stars restaurant. I like this sport bar serve Louisiana cuisine. This is good combination of bar and cuisine concept. It is one of the kind in Bay Area. It is the second restaurant like this I have visited.   I start with the drink of Blackberry Moonshine Swirl. It is beautiful drink with ice and alcohol. It fruity, ice, moonshine, like frozen margarita. Our main dish is blackened redfish. Not many restaurant have redfish. I have the blackened redfish double blackened. It come with sweet corn grit. I substituted the green bean with a cup of Duck and Andouille gumbo. Gumbo is delicious. My wife have the Crawfish Etouffee. The soup is not fish which tell you fresh enough.   The food experience is good. We end our night with beignets. They may need to work on this item. The inside is still dough soft. It need to raise the dough enough to get to the inside out crispy. Service is excellent and well train. Average working age is very young for the waiter and waitress. This bar has a lot big TV. Definitely match the name of sport bar.

The takeout place is in the gas station. You will pick the food and pay at the gas station counter. The daily specials show on the menu board. Each day they have different items. The food is cafeteria style on the tray. You just need to point and pick the item you need. They do have different sandwiches to select and prepare for you.   I got two devil Crab, two chicken empanadas, and one lunch combo. Today lunch combo they have grilled and fried pork rib. The rib is meat was process correctly and fall of the bone. The marinated spice also good. The side includes the congri rice, and the yellow bean soup. They are good combo.   The devil crab has use too much vinegar, if they can tone down or eliminate is better. Let the customers to add vinegar later. The best is the chicken empanadas. It is juicy and has good crust.

We were there at the grand open. This shop is part of multi progressive restaurant today. We hear a lot good thing about the donut shop. We were there about 5:20. I think it is about dinner time and only 3 group in font of us.   Operation- the line to order has two counter. Although the time we visit only one counter is open. The wait is good. Which mean they can handle biggest line. It going to be interesting to Key in the choice for the customers. If customers has 16 choice with two in the group, it take about 2 minutes to three for each group because of the decision. I would suggest put a big sign board with the changeable picture of the donut so they make quick decisions instead of look at paper menu then go to counter and see the actual donut change the decision. This may smooth out the line a bit. The changeable board allow flexibility if the donut change the topping. The wait of making the donut is good. I like the owner at coffee counter too.   The food- I gave an "A" on the donut and coffee. I like they have personalize the donut. I like the maple bacon and pineapple upside down donut. Who can deny the BACON. The donut is finger licking good. Coffee selection is good enough for the selection. I would said keep the same quality throughout the business duration. That will be the challenge.   I think it is good business model they have. They can change out the topping to keep the customers interested. I also like to challenge them not just the topping but change the dough type too. Keep up the good work make the donut on the spot and keep it fresh. Also, I would suggest to add an 8 pieces option for the customers.

It is 3.5 stars in my book. Since there is no half stars, I have given 4 stars. The reason there are 3.5 stars is the amount of food do not measure up to the price they charge. I think they are at the expensive side. Food is ok.   I check out this food truck because of the recommendation of a friend. They can be track at their face book page. The day we saw them were at the Brew Hub at Lakeland. We got the polish sampler. It has the Kielbasa - polish sausage, 4 meat pierogi, and Bigos - hunter stew. I like the hunter stew over the kielbasa. The pierogi topping  can be better. It was perfect food at brewery with beer to wash down. Overall is good but not memorable enough.

It was good to have a brewery so close to downtown and very close to waterworks park. You may think the parking is a problem but they have designated lot for the brewery across the street. Easy access.   This is a locally craft beer. They do have some interesting beer. Including kumquat and orange crush. These are the local fruit that make good use in the local brewery. Good thinking to represent the local. Do you know we have kumquat festival in Dade City.   Deja Moo Nitro has some exquisite taste for dark beer. The peanut butter Deja Moo is interesting. They have some beer I will try on next visit. They also has sour beer such as Sakura. There is a name of the beer call ginger mullet. Actually no ginger or mullet.   The deco is contemporary. So good art work. Mostly high top chair. You can order your food in to enjoy your beer.

It was nice the Tampa International Airport provided the cell phone lot to wait for your love one arrive without create congestion in the pick up line. Many airports need to learn from this option for any pick up.   You can wait in the lot until your love one pick up the luggages. It avoids circulate the airport situation and waste the gas by go around the airport. The airport was correctly not allowed stop and wait for your love one if they are not ready to pickup. With the construction almost done, the circulation is better now.   The cell phone lot has the arrival screen you can spot if the plane arrives on time. You wait for them to walk out the airport then they call your cell to pick up. The lot equips with restroom if you need to use it.

I like this Mill location in compare to the one in St Pete. This place is a lot larger with plenty of parking. It is important to have parking at soho area. As a result it is major plus.
