The new space also have large bar area. We were there for the happy hours. It was our fourth stops.   The happy hour menu is simple. But it is good enough to enjoy your time here. Our group order the Crispy Buffalo Brussels, Watermelon Bruschetta, and Swedish Meet Ball. I don't like the Brussels that much. May because it is Buffalo which involves sour vinegar. I like the Watermelon Bruschetta the most. It has good cheese with chop watermelon. The meat ball also good.   I like my drink with Basic Beach Cocktails. It is refreshing. Our bar tender has to serve on table to cover the late colleague and leave us not much of attentive service.

If you want to have good Southeast Asia Spice food, this is good restaurant to go to. I was visiting this restaurant ten years ago before my Yelp day. At then they just average restaurant, but now the menu extended and the food is good. Big improvement.   The owner is from Malaysia. They do have good Southeast Asian food. The Singapore thin rice noodle special has good curry spice like home. The spice is deep and relentless. The appetizer is the clam with black bean sauce. Each clam is big. The black bean sauce is right one. Most Chinese cooking using the sweet base black bean sauce but I like this restaurant in salt base.   Our special of the day is the butterfly Shrimp. The shrimp was butterfly wrap with bacon then mixed with scrambled egg and top with peanut. This dish is delicious. Since the menu was extended, it good to try them all.

Very close to 4.5 stars. Fish guy is my place if I pass by again. It is great seafood market and restaurant. Seafood is fresh and delicious. You cannot believe a side street of Holiday area has this great seafood restaurant. Local know about this place.   We start with 3-pepper crab soup. Plenty of crab meat. A bit spicy. Almost like Cajun style. We like this unique soup. We do have to send back the New England clam chowder. They taste a bit sour like vinegar. We also order a dozen of cedar key little neck. It is fresh sea taste. We t come with cocktail and butter dipping sauce.   Our main dish is the blackened grouper, shrimp and scallops. The scallops is sea giant scallops. Since we close to home of scalloping, it is big and great. The shrimp come in five pieces. The grouper is good quantity. I like the Cajun blackened they use. The other dish is lobster roll. This roll I am not recommended. It has the imitation crab meat and lobster meat. I rather they use full lobster.   Service is a bit slow. It also can be a lot more attentive. Other than that, it is great restaurant.

This good truck is about 3.5 stars. We were here after dinner and decided to try their food truck. Their taco has 4 selection- ground beef, chicken, pastor, and chorizo. The regular taco is $2.50. Is kind of above the average price.   I got the chorizo and the pastor. I feel their meat is chop to fine. It feel like very powdery. However, I do like their toppings. They will ask you want a Mexican way or US way. I got the Mexican way. It top with cheese and sour cream.   Tuesday, they have taco Tuesday for a dollar a piece. By then, it may be worth the price. Others than taco, they have quesadillas and burritos. May be that is better.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. The happy hour will have sushi a dollar cheaper than normal price on each roll. This is a old restaurant. Many of friend I have visited here. It is one of my long time bookmarks restaurant. Finally, we have a chance to visit.   We order three roll from happy hour. These rolls are Tampa, Mexican and Spider rolls. The Tampa roll basically is a fried white fish roll. One thing can improve on the fried roll is to add the eel sauce on top. Which they didn't do. The Mexican roll fried shrimp with masago on top. At least this is a good roll. The spider roll are the soft shell crab. Again they really need to put some eel sauce on top.   We also add a board special with spicy crawfish roll. This is interesting roll but do not live up the name. The crawfish is a bit fishy smell. May be it is not the season. Service is average. Can be improved.

Finally south Tampa has a good enough poke place. This place does the poke right. Why I said that. Because they take extra step to marinate your selected poke with add on separately. That way the poke is separate from the base and topping.   First chose your size. Figure out how many scoop and base you want. Second chose your base. The base includes brown rice, white rice, kale slaw, or power blend. Third chose your poke protein. I will definitely go with double tuna or tuna plus salmon. Then chose you mix-in sauce. This part can get tricky because whatever you chose is on you. I usually chose multiple sauces in sweet side and poke sauce which is a bit salty. I also like it to go with green onion and cilantro. I wish they can add the corn, edamame, cucumber in the mix-in. It will be better. Why include as topping.   The great thing of this place is the have many toppings with fruit items which I like. Price wise is above average. But the have good sauce choice at the end. If use multiple sauce at the mix-in section, you may want warn them ahead so they don't put the first sauce too much become unbalanced. Good luck for the mix-in. If you afraid you will fail on the sauce choice, try their pre set poke.

Rare Ethnic Food #54. Laos Cuisine.   My rating is 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. It is one of the kind food that you can find. This restaurant step up on the food presentation and taste. I am glad we have a Laos restaurant that can truly like by many. The restaurant took the old Memphis BBQ place.   Our first course is a complimentary from the restaurant. The chicken rice soup with fried wontons. It is good appetizers. The second course is the combination Par Kow Noi. This is choice 3 item combination with bananas leave fish, pork jerky, and the pork sausage. This great dish to have and try three different street food.   Our next dish is the Kow Poun Gai - Laos Noodle soup. This is tapioca noodle with chicken. It is delicious. Our last dish is the Frog Leg Khoua Pik. This is frog leg stir fry with Laos chili paste. I like this dish. We also have the Laos chili chicken wing. Those are really good.   Our experience here is great. Love the place. The only thing is the menu ingredients do not reflect what they serve. They only serve available ingredients. So sometimes you don't get all the ingredients they have mentioned in the menu.

This may be the third Indian restaurant take over at the same location. The big difference is the they have very good goat curry. The goat was braise properly to allow the meat tender. They mush cook this goat in good milk liquid to wash away the majority of goat smell. It turn out good including big pieces on the goat meat.   They have 16 items on the buffet Hot deli and additional item in Cold deli cart. Overall a good meat selection in this area. The veggies was nice to accommodate the buffet. I like they provide the nan when you request it. It freak loaf of nan go easy with the curry.   Dessert is nice and sweet. With Yelp check in you have one free drink. We got the mango lassi. It come with big glass in beer glass. The gulab jamun is soak correctly in syrup. Overall the service is good. But the waiter may need to be more when business pick up. So far so good.

I have book mark this place some time. Brett 5 stars has move up my schedule to visit. The mofongo is definitely recommended for this place. It actually match their name in high standard. During our visit, the number of customers is lack off I hope other will support them.   We got the mofongo. They prepared it very well. It has the pull pork in it and so do the fried pig skin. It is delicious the way they prepared it. The mofongo is soft. Next time I will try their different mofongo.   We have ask the palomilla to be grilled and top with caramel onion. The steak is big enough. Size and quantity make this dish affordable. The steak was grilled correctly. The salad is good. But the accompanying congri rice do not match the standard. You can find the non cook rice along side. Quality control need to be made in order to get high mark.   Service is normal. Food come out in good speed. Seem like one waitress for serving and one for bringing out the food.

This Sonny BBQ is better than the one at Busch Blvd. I mean they are better because the way to preserve the juiciness of the meat. We have been here before. But today is the the tax day special, and we decided to take the advantage. The tax day special is $6.99 for the St. Louise rib and two side all day during the tax day. Good deal.   Some of the Sonny prepared the over cook or dry, but not at this place. I also like their slice pork. Especially the all you can eat slice pork deal. If you are hungry enough, it is a good choice for you. Plenty of food for money.  This is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Thy service is good and the food delivery is less than 7 minutes. Very fast. May be is tax day and they already prepared this items ready to serve.

The gas station may the best deal in Riverview. It is located in the busiest intersections of US 301 and Bloomingdales Avenue. It is always 1 cent cheaper than it competitors.   The facility is clean and nice. Well lighted at night. Security camera on the side of building to catch and illegal activities. This is 20 pumps station make it easy for the customers. Frozen drink for 69 cents.

I think it is a solid four stars restaurant. Why I have three because the food did not sit well in my stomach. Other than that. They are solid 4 stars.   Engine No 9 is visible restaurant on the MLK. They have many famous burger type including the one with crawfish tail. I did not go for their strongholds. I got their entree item with Sriracha Salmon. This dish well presented. They have good pieces of salmon steak with skin. The salmon is seared. Top with bacon and onion rings. The bed is broccoli slaw with Thai chili sauce. It is very good. The presentation of the food is top the chart.   The service is excellent and attentive. The price for the food is reasonable. The atmosphere is bar type. I would like to try their crawfish burger next time.

HOT AND SPICY.   Happi Wok know how to turn up the heat for the dish. I mean real heat in the spiciness. Other than than their regular American menu, the have the Chinese menu for the Szechuan cuisine. Szechuan people in China eat really hot food. If you don't know how to order from Chinese menu, bring a friend that can read this menu.   I would recommend their beef noodle. This is best dish in this restaurant and it is dish no. 93 in the Chinese menu. It come with pickle veggie and cube beef. The soup base is a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.   We have the red pepper chicken (no 14), the the husband and wife beef lung and tripe (no 44) and the sweet vinegar rib (no 40). I like the pepper chicken.   Service is good. Food in good value. This is a gem for the Chinese USF student who live around there. If you want to try it out may be invite me.

Very close to 4.5 stars. It good Mexican restaurant. Very similar to St. Miguel Cuisine. A lot of spice may be from there too. The restaurant is small but has good quality food. Seating like now may be 20 person now due to pandemic.   We got the Chile Relleno - it is Pablano Pepper stuff with chicken and cheese. I think this is the cheapest Chile Relleno I have in Tampa. It come with rice and bean paste. It delicious. I also got the Carne Asada. The piece of steak was grilled and good piece size. The beef steak is good to have. I like their rice. Cook perfect softness.   I have the pick up order. The food was as promised time to pick up. It do not take much time to prepare.

Yelping 1100  My kid will paid for the dinner, why not select a good one. My kid also want to experience the local famous restaurant after he has moved away from home. Bern definitely is well know outside of Tampa that make him to choose this restaurant.   I have been to Bern for several occasions. One time is by my own and many time are power dinner with the clients. Since then, I have not been back for about five years. Since then, they value of the meal has changed to better. Before it, the side is paid as a la carte. Now they include as part of the meal. It make the value of the dinning improve.   We were seated at the Bronze Room. I like open room with bronze statues on the wall. It is elegantly decorated. We order the 14 oz chateaubriand for two and a chop steak. Each meal come with onion soup, salad with dressing of your choice, fried onions, zucchini and carrot. The French onion soup is amazing.   My steak was perfectly grilled. I would said if you come here, chateaubriand is the way to order your steak. No other place do better than here. The chop steak is well presented over the mash potatoes. I like the waiter prepare the whole potato to added all ingredients on it including the bacon bite.   After the dinner, it was a pleasure to visit their kitchen and the cellar. I saw many famous post of pictures are in this cellar. The dessert room is like a maze. We have the taste of the Bern with five Bern's signature desserts. I like the King Midas and the banana cheese pie.   Everything is good here. Service- check; food delivery - check; ingredients quality- check; ambient-check; taste-check; chef skill- check. 5 stars.

There are a lot of reviews for this restaurant. We were here because of popularity. Pappy started since 2008 and get a lot of attention Nationally. Food Network has rank them number 1 in US.   They are using Apple wood smoke with dry rub ribs. This rib cook for long time and you can see the rib meat fall off the bone. We got full slab with with sweet potatoes fry and the ear of corn. The sweet potatoes fry is crispy and good flavor. The rib is fantastic. Although is is most popular but not need to kill over it.   The restaurant move the line quick by taking order and the seating after order. The entrance is strange from the back. The service is good considering this is busy restaurant. They are not the best to my opinion but still very good in St. Louis.

Interesting healthy food and juice bar joint. Fit bowl have the superfood bowl which is good for your health. It also carry vegan items soft serve as a treat. Smoothie and coffee is part of the menu. This very much sum up what they serve.   I got the chocolate dip frozen banana with Freeze Dried Strawberry. It look interesting. The topping with freeze strawberry is delicious. It is a good treat after meal. The banana as they said is frozen. The chocolate dipping coating is icing on the cake. Great treat.

This is the first time I have visited this Lowe. The reason I visited here because the Lowe next to our home run out of water softener cleaner. This Lowe does not have it either.   Instead I went to buy the air filter for the AC unit and the weed killer. Lowe always have the high quality and high performance filter that can filter the air allergen. Especially for Floridian, we need this filter for spring blooming and September hays season.   The people work in Lowe is very helpful. They always ask if I find my items I need while I was at the aisle looking. They can point to good direction for the items I need.

If you looking for good fish, this place has call themselves best fish in town. In fact, they are right on they have promised. This restaurant is new and popular now. If you are no hungry go for their basket, if you really hungry, go for their dinner plate.  The place mainly fish and shrimp. The choices not just dinner or basket, it has the sandwiches poboy. The kid meal is budget for children. You also can get the family meal to go. Fish includes catfish, whiting, flounder, tilapia, Mahi mahi, haddock. Some fish choice has upgrade price. The shrimp is well prepared. At least the shrimp intestine was removed. They also good size big shrimp. The selection come with grilled, fried, blackened.   The food was order in counter and they bring it out to you. Price is reasonable for seafood. The seasoning is good for my grilled fish.

Korean Street food on sale. The restaurant is located inside the grocery. When the grocery close, the restaurant also close. As the result, the hour is odd.   Dosi meaning city and Rak meaning joy, pleasure or comfort. But when two word join together is pack meal or lunchbox. Very interesting. They do serve excellent lunchbox. I would recommend if you have less money with quick 3 combinations meal. Here is the place. We have been here twice. We got the bulgogi and the spicy pork pack meal. It come with fish cake and purple rice. The meat dish is cook at the order and fresh delicious.   Not much of service since this is a fast food place. Definitely better than most fast food for the same price. I would said better deal with meat and veggies.

Delta Airlines is improving from the previous time I have fly with them. Currently they advertise wider leg room. This is true compared to many airlines. I have to give them a compliment about more leg room. You also can purchase for more leg rooms if you like especially for longer flight. It more efficient to buy more leg room than pay double to triple for first class.   Currently the flight is on time. However, one thing I don't like is they combine with other airline to pack the entire plane. Sometimes you can see three Airlines combinations in one flight. It is packing tight. As a result they about 3.5 stars.

I have visited this place three time. This is my first review on it. My first visit was good about 4 stars. My last visit is the worst from my company party 2 stars. Base on this combination experience, it is set to three stars.   I believe Roy's has take a step back. When the food is not good, it will be no repeat customer. The reason as below. We start three appetizer crispy chicken spring rolls, Szechuan spice pork rib, and tempura crash Ahi Tuna roll. Among all three, only the tuna roll is good. The pork need major improvement. The meat not fall off the bone make this not a fine dinning experience. Obviously the rib was not slow cook longer allow meat to fall off.   The entrée are the fillet mignon and macadamia nut crust mahi mahi. I have to send the fillet back because the meat was not cooked to order. This can corrected by putting a indicated stick not to mixed up the order. The mahi-mahi is just simply not fresh enough. The meat not show good sign. The crust is not fully cover to the fish.   One good thing can said about this experience is the dessert. All other just ok.

Excellent haircut technique. Veterans salon technician. Newer haircut place. Not much of line to wait. That sum the haircut salon.   I was greeted by a smile. They take your personal contact information if you want to become a regular. I am asking for a scissor cut. This will test out their hair cutting technique. I have my cutting requirements provide to the technician and she did a very good job. I will be back.   The entire event only take 20 minutes and I am finished with the haircut.

Agree with Mark for the tasty food and fast service. I think it is more like 4.5 stars restaurant then actual 5 stars. I wonder why they have to be located at Soho area, why don't they locate near USF area to attract more students and the Busch Garden tourist. Soho already has so many restaurants, I think their pricing is good for the students.   I will start with their side selection. They have several selection I like. The roasted vegetables, braised white bean and Greek salad is good. For the Greek salad selection is free with kabab. Other combinations need to add $1.69. Tonight we have the steak and salmon kabab. Both of them is flavorful. The steak is in sweet marinated sauce. The reason they get half stars less due to the meat quality,  it is chewy. The salmon was perfect. It come with zucchini in the skew and the salmon juice dip into the zucchini and make it more sophisticated.   The price is right. I like they use the actual silver ware instead of plastic ware. The place is typical fast food. Definitely will be back.

SkyConnect is the rental car center facility for the Tampa Airport. This brand new facility host all the rental car companies. It has the multi level parking garage for different rental car companies.   The center also have the light monorail system connects airport terminals and the rental center. This monorail also stop at long term parking. Travel to the airport terminals with the monorail is adding 10 minutes which you need to account for after car return. Make sure you left enough to get to your flight.   I like the new rental car facility. The Avis return is at level 3. The only thing I don't like is the walk between the counter to the car is some distance. Also the exit and entrance to monorail is two different sides which make additional walk.

Great farm market to visit. It is clean and organized. This market is at US 92 best thing can happen to the people who pass by. It is definitely the choice for a good stop for dessert. This is the reason why we are here mostly. They have serve the tangerine soft serve. It is one of the kind. It also serve the shake. I didn't get it because it is 5 % milk. I cannot take that. I wish they have 2% or less milk. Unfortunately they don't have those options. They also got dole whip. I think if they can tone down the sour a bit will be better.   Other than the dessert, they have all kinds produce. If you get produce here will be very fresh because they are just in the farm area. Definitely good for daily grocery.   Social distancing is observing here. Will plan for people who sho here. Mask is just the county order.

This bakery serve a lot of sandwiches and pastry. The Hispanic bakery here is outstanding. The way they prepare the meat pie is fluffy on the crust and dry chicken in the inside. The crust is very good when you arrive before lunch time when they have very fresh items.   I have the chicken pie there and it is great. I also get the bread pudding and the chicken potato ball. They are just out of oven. They certainly many item to choose from including choripan, areguipe pastry, pan de coco, Guava Chicharron, wine cake. This name sound very tempting and good. So good have your personal cheat day. You don't tell, who will know.   Other than the bakery, they serve coffee, juice, breakfast item. Sound very good to start your morning routine. The people who serve there are very friendly and kind.

City buffet work for me since I not a buffet person. If you come here, go for dinner is better. More choices on food.   Food is fresh compare to many buffet place at this price range. Their weekend dinner is $13 with a soft drink. Hibachi grill with marinated steak cut or skew. Skew shrimp for hibachi. The crawfish is fresh enough and tail easily separated from the shell. It has snow crab and blue crab for your choice.   The hot food is above average on the serving. Considered this is very remote area and they can provide better quality food.   I like the manager on the floor keep this operation on target. Service is A+. Selection is good enough for the price range. We enjoy our time here.

This Indian restaurant has changed many owners. This one has open more than a year and we have not visited them until now. The interior has no t been change. One night when we come to the area for ice cream at 9:30pm. We smell a good Indian curry from this restaurant and decided we need to visit them next day.   Apparently the good food smell attracts us here. My wife have $1 off coupon and both of us spend for the buffet is 19.95 after tax. Even with a dollar more, it is still reasonable. The buffet has chicken and goat as meat. Many of the vegetables dishes. I like the goat curry. It cook to the point like Chinese beef Shane stew. Nevertheless, it do not has strong goat smell. The curry is in the mild side that suitable for many Americans that could not handle the spicy heat.   I like the food. However, I prefer to be more spicy. Service is good. Not too crowded. Plenty of food at the buffet. Good fresh nan.

3.5 stars to my book. 4 stars given. Press Box really has Tampa in the map. It is really local dive bar. Tuesday is the time to visit because theY have 75 cents wings. The food here is affordable. If you have yelp check in, you got the pint of beer free.   The bar have pool table, outside seating, juke box for music and more. Many are here is regular. The bar open to late 3 am in the morning. If you need a place to hang out late Aaron night, this may be your place. The bar is a bit rough although I did not see motor cycle rider here. We like the wing we have order. We got cajun dry rub and Parmesan wing. Both wing are great. We also got garlic butter wing. They are delicious  too.   Service at the bar is ok. Food come out quick even close to midnight.

It is good deal when you travel just yourself without any luggage. This airline will charge you every thing. Any select seat, luggage, carry on, travel insurance and more. I think they are more gear for short duration travel. If you have a same day business trip, this airline definitely a good deal.   This big yellow air bus is ok. The plane we took delay 30 minutes. But they did warn us about it. Many has bring their duffle bag or back pack. Just to avoid additional charges. But for a good non stop flight to Chicago is perfect.   Leg room is just ok. Random seat assignment is free but if you decided to seat close to exit more leg room, you may want to paid extra. The seat is a bit un comfortable due to non reclining seat. In the same time, the padding on the seat is thin. Not good for long hour travel.   Drink, snack or food is extra. When you paid the luggage service, you think you may get the luggage sooner. It end up we have to wait for 30 minutes. Overall experience is below par. But is I have a short trip, I may considering it.

A converted gas station to restaurant now is popular and hip place in Seminole Height. This restaurant is close to I-275 and easy to get to. Parking is available at the restaurant make it convenient to visit. It is a popular place for brunch and coffee. Night time it turn to gathering beer place.   I got the Cortado to start for coffee. It is thick espresso. This type of espresso is actually origin from Spain or Portugal. Then we have BBQ pork sandwich. I think their sandwich is average. However, I like their salad that accompanied it.   So far they have the right ideas for the hip place with garage seating and outside gas station seating. If they can add some gaming material will attract more people. Service is extremely good. Their waiter and waitress are well trained.

It is about 4.5 stars for my visit. Round up to 5 stars. We were here about the burger week. They are serving the Jamaican Me Crazy burger. Only this occasion they serve this kind of burger. This burger is top with grilled pineapple, applewood smoked bacon and mango purée. Very tasty. The patty of meat is grass-fed beef. The patty cooked to edge crispy and medium to center. Very good preparation on the grilled.   If I revisit again, I will try their salmon burger and mushroom and Swiss burger. These two burger will be in my future visit. I also like the burger cook on the order which make the burger really fresh.

It is beautiful pier. This pier has redone 8 time. 1929 the pier is called million dollar pier. It was build with casino with the six time rebuild with major construction. This pier was demolished 1967 due to deterioration. It was a major attraction.   1973 the city rebuilt with inverted pyramid. This design is definitely the icon of St. Pete for long time. It has restaurants, shop and aquarium. It attracts a lot of visit. 2013 the pier is close and make way to current pier.   The new pier was constructed and finished 2020. The improvements did create a square for people to gather. Fishing area with fish cutting board. Dual path way pier. I like some of the new features with a lot of green and open space. Tram service is free if you don't want to walk. A good day will attract a lot of people. Museum also can be found along the pier. Shops are located at the beginning of the pier.

Gong Cha seem like the one we saw at Gwinnett near Atlanta. The drink selection is similar too. This boba place is kind of new. Good tea taste. The boba is marinated in brown sugar.   We got the earl grey milk tea with 3js. The 3js stand for three jelly. The jelly are grass jelly, egg custard, and boba. We also got the brown sugar boba tea with almond milk. Both tea selection are excellent.

I was hype about the visit due to many good reviews. It must be good to visit them with all the good reviews. However our visit turn not to the best or to any tea house standard.   The outside is hippie look. I am guessing is live free and enjoy. There was many of patrons who are there already. The outside seating is popular due to current good weather. We have chosen the inside since the outside is full. Once enter the AC area, the grilled smell is over the place. It need good ventilation. Your clothes will be cover with food smell even after 2 hours.   We order the Kiwi Pear tea with sweeten and the Billy Chang sandwich. The sandwich is slice smoke beef brisket with strawberry jelly. We waited over 40 minutes for a sandwich to be cooked. The Kiwi Pear tea is very light in taste. Even the tea is not strong. However, it allows three refills.   Well, this restaurant is done and done. Been there. Not sure we get a lot out of it.

The super bowl night and we decide to sit at the bar side of the Bonefish Grilled.  The new added menu for the Bar Bites Menu has added another dimension for the order. The items start at $4 to $12. The bar bites menu have 8 selection and some of the selection have two different type of meat. The appetizer has 11 items to select. The combination of the bar menu and the appetizer create over twenty different selection. This is good business model with Tapas mentality that the bonefish management has provided the customer with more choice. It definite makes the top bar in this area. It will attract more customer in the future.  Tonight we started with the Lamb Lollipop hops. I have this dish at different Bonefish location and I want to make sure different chef can create this dish better. The lamb chop turns up better at this location. The meat is cook to perfect medium and have hint of salt to make the chop taste better without losing it meat taste. We have order the Lobster Street Taco. My wife like this dish and said it have big chunk of lobster meat and worth the $5 item. We have order a bowl of the corn chowder with crab meat. I will advice you order the bowl instead of the cup when you are hungry or two people in the party that can share this dish. The cup and bowl size only a $1 different and you get more on the bowl. We have gone to the appetizer menu and order the Filet Satay. This is new item in the appetizer. It is a center cut filet mignon in soy seasoning and serves with spicy mustard sauce in tomatoes, cucumber, onion.  The meat is tender and soft. The only down side is each pieces is small. However they are delicious. The next appetizer is Singapore Calamari. The calamari is lightly dry pepper breaded and deep fried. It serves sweet spicy sauce. They are crispy and we have left nothing on the plate because they are insane good. The last item is the coconut shrimp with sweet spicy sauce. The dish has six jumbo shrimp and coated with coconut flake. This is a good value dish and it is less than $9.   We are stuff after all the items. I forgot to mention the Sunday night have happy hours till 6:30. The wine is $3.25 a glass and the draft beer is a dollar. Can't beat that!!! Our server is super nice and attentive. As a result, tonight we are awarding this restaurant with 5 stars.

I was there around 4:30 pm on Sunday. The shelf for the pastry is almost empty. I bought the last guava pastry. The last pastry seem like very oily smell at my first bite. Not bad for the price just a bit over a dollar. The guava taste good.   This place is famous on their fabulous Cuban bread. It is long mean very long bread. Many come to here just to have that. It is good value. The entire store has no ac and good to raise the yeast.

If you come to this place, be prepared for slow food delivery. With the warning labels ahead, everything is good. Understand each dish is prepared and grilled at the spot, it will take time to prepare.   I have been here several time and got use to the slow delivery. The food is good and reasonable price. One thing you can avoid anyone by come here ahead of the crowd. I like their grilled meat. Especially their grilled lamb. They are very good here. If you want halal, they prepare that way. The accompanying sides are the salad and grilled tomato. The rice is the basmati and they are great. I also like their grilled chicken.   I would suggest order a cup of Persian tea. It can be sweetened by adding the sugar. Service here is slow so get your order in earlier. It also part of the groceries store, so check them out.

I have been to TPepin many time for events. Each time I have enjoy my time there. This hospitality center has large room that able to cover big event. Actually many big events have been hold in this location.   The TPepin has big parking space that may include 300 cars or more. Their room can accommodate up to 1000 people if needed. They have nice reception area with waterfall and fire. Their side walkway include pool table and shuffle board.   In the ballroom, they have high ceiling decorated lighting which is pleasant. The stage is available in the ballroom for any presentation or announcement. The also have to be side bar and kitchen bar if you decide an open bar with munchies items.   The bathroom is comfortable. They also has outside patio for any Open grilled item. I have been here several time, I believe it is also good for wedding or anniversary. Puff and Stuff actually has an office there if you need catering.

Review # 3100 - Philippine Bake shop.   This baked shop next to Jolibee. I wonder they are the same owner. They have something new in the Bay Area. The Filipino baked good. I like the sponge cake. They have many selections. I like the most is their original flavor butter Mamon.   They have mocha, ube, cheesy, and butter. They also has brownie. Their bake good includes slice of sponge cake like ube overload or mango supreme. Hot food includes the Palabok and arroz caldo. I have not try try this yet.   The clerk is very helpful. They explain everything to us. Price is a good in a bit high side. Each item we have are good.

After the Guitar Concert we have decided the Vietnamese restaurant is the one we want tonight. The first Vietnamese restaurant that we have selected is close on Sunday; as a result, we came to this restaurant. We have select this restaurant due to they serve one of the pho that I want to try at below review. The restaurant is easy access since they are close to I-75 exit. This is a neighborhood Pho restaurant.   The pho they served is a bit different then most of the Vietnamese restaurant. I believe they have added slice root material to make the pho taste with a bit of cinnamon. They serve the pho in large, medium regular and baby size. The baby size pho is $4.95. Tonight we have order the grilled pork chop, a baby pho with rare beef, tripe and tendon and the dish we were here for - Bun Bo Hue. The grilled pork chop is accompany with a grilled shrimp and fried shrimp roll. The grill pork chop is tasty but they are not cook through the bone. The meat near the bone is still rare. The grilled shrimp is great. Next time I will get the grilled pork (slice pork without bone) and shrimp. The baby pho is great with the rare slice beef. I love that pho. The main event is Bun Bo Hue - a popular rice vermicelli (they use egg noodle) dish prepared by simmering beef bone and beef shank. The broth has added chili oil for appetizing spicy taste. It also includes cubes of congealed pig blood and makes it delicacy to eat and enjoy. It has a choice of large or regular bowl size.   The service is good. The price is very affordable compare to the surrounding restaurant. I will come back for more.

This is a grocery restaurant with an interesting ideal. I know the grocery store with restaurant is not the new ideal but a grocery store with great Japanese goods and great restaurants is the first. I would said this is the restaurant to be.   You can order the food then shop while you wait for your food to be ready. We got a lot Japanese item which cannot be founded in Tampa. For the restaurant we order the chirashi. It is a rice with assorted sashimi tuna, salmon, octopus, unagi, ikura, egg, hokkigai, kanikama, white fish. Very delicious. Second dish we have is the tonkutsu ramen. This pork bone soup is nice and tasty. It has the roll pork belly. Next is my favorite with Cajun shrimp roll. The shrimp is soft shell. It is deep fried to a point the the head and tail is crispy to eat. Basically you cat the entire shrimp with shell and head. The roll is delicious with the Cajun sprinkles.   It is authentic Japanese food here with a twist.

This restaurant is category at average. It is close to 3.5 stars but not yet there. The restaurant is very close to MD oriental market. It is walking distance to next door. If they lack of any ingredients, very much can get it at oriental market.   I got the two rolls special. Tuna and fried white fish roll. The roll is not spectacular. Very basic. It does come with a choice of soup and salad. My wife has the Pork ramen. It has good charsiew Pork. It also included the fish cake. The soup base is a bit light. Most of the ramen has good bone base. This soup may need some thing like black sesame oil to enhance the flavor.   The only thing I like is the Kama. Kama is the grilled yellowtail collar. I like it. It is not best best I have for Kama. But good enough. The service is easy since not many customers.

This new Sake House is about 3.5 stars. Since we are here for their Happy Hour Special, I round up to 4 stars. The food is good with fresh fish. For price we paid during happy hour, I would said try their happy hour menu. Actually dinner special menu is no bad either. For same two rolls, with extra $2 from Happy Hour, you get salad and soup.   We have the happy hour 3 rolls. We have the Mango Roll. It is spicy tuna top with mango. The spicy tuna have a bit sesame oil to enhance the flavor. It can be more. The second roll is the snapper special. The inside is cucumber and top with slice snapper. The snapper is firm and bouncy. This is a sign of freshness. Our last roll is the Dynamite roll. This is yellowtail and tuna then deep fried.   All three roll is good. Can tell the service is good since we are at their early happy hour and only customer that time.

It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars. This is a place that young and beautiful gatherings place. Great to many young people participating the lunch. With University of Tampa next to it, many students eat here. I like this place because it has variety of shops in one place. They have bookstore, champagne bar, coffee bar, the shop, commerce club upstairs. Very interesting to host many variety.   We enjoy the restaurant area. For lunch, their food selection is flatbread, sandwiches, small plate, breakfast and salad. Simple but elegant. We got the steak sandwich and tomato prosciutto flatbread. The steak sandwich has a sauce along caramelize shallot in it make the tasty. The flat bread prosciutto is chop piece with pesto sauce which is delicious. Our experience is great. Definitely come in the future. Serve is average. Once the server engaged, we have good service.

Epicurean is soho area hotel that very close busy business district. The name is actually a Greek name from a philosopher. This philosopher believes in pleasure in good for the spirit. They emphasized relax not just on their spa retreat, but also their pool, garden, and fitness center.   We were here for a deer friend baby shower. We have the food from hotel restaurant brunch and the their dessert store. I may have to visit them in the future. The service we received is very nice. We started with their o'dour. Which is very good. I like the scallops and veggies roll. The entrée with the shrimp and grits has good flavor. Not as creole cuisine but it has it on touch. The macaroons was with multiple flavors that make it interesting.   I can see the hotel is in the right location. It is easy walking to many place. This is deep in the South Tampa Community. Which is not many hotel nearby here and make them stand out.

Very good lunch place. In addition, a good breakfast place. They start early and close before dinner. I would said this restaurant is definitely 4.5 stars restaurant. They located in a small plaza and may be they are the only restaurant. Which make the parking area basically for this restaurant since no compete restaurant.   I got the two pork chop. They actually has plenty of food because it come with two eggs, side of your choice and toast. I have my egg sunny side up. Seem like their egg are not regular egg because the yolk is more yellow. May be farm raise. I like the pork chop seasoning with a bit sweet. It look like Hawaiian style cooking. The chop is good grade because it has good fiber when you break the meat.   I would compliment the chef skill to Caramelize the pork chop. The service is excellent. It is definitely the destination for lunch and Breakfast.

The visit was pleasant. The restaurant is located in a very nice plaza and they are kind in the center attractions of the plaza. Parking is free but the plaza is a bit busy to share parking among all other businesses. This is a minus for the location for customers to find parking.   The interior is great pen space. Plenty of light to see what you eating. I likes the system order your food at counter and they bring it to the table. It is convenient for the customers.   I have ordered the tuna sandwich. I ask if the tuna is seared. And she acknowledged. However, they serve it fried with coating at outward of tuna. It is different than I was ask. Which is good with me. The tuna is just average because they probably fried from frozen.   I think their counter clerk need to know what they serve if a customer asking about the the food. Overall is good experience.

Finally I have visited the Brandon Quickly. This location has a lot of hospital customers. The drink is just above average Tampa boba cafes. I would recommend it. We were here for the boba and their hot food combo. I got the winter Mellon and rainbow jelly. It is good.   I also got the three fruit boba before. I like it. The combo has included the grilled pork rice. These combo meal and drink is good for the customers. The meal include the grilled pork, pickle veggies, braised egg. It is affordable combo meal with drink at one price.   Service is good.

I like Thali Plate. And this restaurant has it. Thali mainly South Indian food. It is a meal with multiple dishes. The biggest thali can consist of 45 dishes which is call Kutumb. We don't have it in Tampa. At least the Thalia here have 9 dishes. Considering it is big enough.   I order the non veggies thali. It has tandoori chicken, goat curry, chicken butter curry, chick pea curry, sweet rice pudding, mango lassi, rice, nan, and veggies. They have good take out box to contain this thali. I was surprised they have compartment to fill. I think the take home portion is smaller compared to eat it there. The mango lassi is good. I like the goat curry and the tandoori chicken.   The preparation will take minimum 30 minutes. So call ahead is a good ideal. The food is delicious but the portion for take out is small.

Crumbl Cookies is new kid in the block. It got a lot of attention. At least there is some line there. If you want to jump the line, just order from kiosk. There 8 stores in Florida. This is the first in Tampa Bay Area.   The cookie selection is simple. The flavor did change time to time. We got the peaches N' cream and milk chocolate chip. Both cookies are good. The peaches N' cream is serve chill. The cream is very good. The milk chocolate chip serve warm. It is also good when you eat it at parking lot.   Please remember there are two types of serving cookie. Chill or warm. You might want to know. The smaller cookie only for catering menu. Mostly the sugar cookie. They do have cream and drink if you like.

Wawa is very much go to gas station this day. They have good grade gas. The location near Wiregrass is clean and save. The place is well lighted. They have free tire pump with pressure gage. It is easy to know when you done with the preset tire pressure. The pump will beep you.   We were here for the gas and the Siptopia. Wawa is running the special on the drink. 16 oz drink only $2. Good deal. I got the peach banana smoothie with whip cream. We also got the chocolate cookie and cream Creamy smoothie. Those are very good. I also have their flurricanes. This is salt caramel with mixed of the crust cookie in it. Very interesting.  Go there before run out of promotion. The 24 oz only $3. Worth the money.

Meat Market have a good thought on the food and decoration of the dining hall. It is hip looking upscale dining experience with a few things to offer. We were on the first round of multi restaurants happy hour tour. Meat Market was our first stop and did not disappoint us. I like the out side seating, bar area and the dining hall. They do provide heat lamp if you sit close to outside.   I start with a Quatro Verde. This cocktail has illegal mezcal, ancho reyes, and basil. It is a good cocktail with great alcohol in it. It worth the money. The chef start with complimentary spicy corn. It was great to go with the alcohol drink. The appetizers we got is roasted escargot. Each chamber has at least two escargot which is why they charge high price to make up the value. The next appetizer is the wood grilled Churrasco and fries. The steak is good quality with good fries. This is most expensive item in the appetizers. I would expect better. But still good.   Overall the bar service started too slow. Need to pay attention to customer. After they engaged, everything is good.

Lakeside tea was at my book mark for long time. I have previous visited this place and not write a review. My wife has visited this place for lunch. I only visited this place for drink. The inside has good space for sit down and chat. That is the reason they are tea place.  I have the strawberry matcha with milk. It three colors drink look fantastic. I also has boba in it. The drink is thick and rich in flavor. I would consider is a good tea. This review do not include the food they have. May be next review.   The tea will require some time to make. Especially three ingredients. I like that they make the matcha tea from powder and use the small broom to mixed it before into the cup. It is thick in caffeine.

Yelping No. 2000!!!  Rare Ethnic Food # 50. Russian and Ukrainian cuisine.   This little restaurant just opens no long ago. I already like it very much. It is one of the kind in Tampa Bay Area. You have to experience it for it wonderful cuisine. The restaurant locates near USF which make sense for many Russian students study there. The day we have visited, not many customers. It need great word of mouth to spread a good news.   The menu is simple and delicious. The display in the restaurant is nice with Russian doll. They have the bakery good next to the counter. The only thing I would complain is the chair is too tight.   What is meaning of "Babushka". It mean triangular folded kerchief for head or it also mean grandmother. Many Russian doll has kerchief over it is part of long tradition. It also can mean your grandma kitchen. Take your pick.   Our first dish we have order is the Borscht. This is a famous soup with meat, sautéed veggies and beet root. The beet make the entire soup red color. The soup is great during winter. It top with the rosemary. The second dish is Blinchiki. This is a tradition wheat crepe wrap the meat inside. Very unique in many way.   Our third dish is the Russian dumplings. They have three different fillings inside the dumplings. The Lamb, Beef and Pork. We mixed the pork and beef with the soup base. I like the most is the pork. I would suggest order with soup options. The fourth dish is the Syrniki. This is a pancake made from cheese and wrap with meat options. I like this one too.   Our fifth and final dish is the Kotlety. It is three minced meat croquettes with a side. We have chose Russian brown rice  Overall our experience have exceed our expectations. It was marvelous meal we have at the dinner. It deserves a 5 stars attention. I would said you may need to change your taste bud when you come to this place. Many items is less sodium. But the taste still there. Russian like to use the sour cream. But I don't.

Finally Pinellas has shot chicken place. This place is better than the one in Tampa. This hot chicken place are having their own building and drive through. I would said they are not quite organized yet. The menu definitely will make the first timer scratch their head. Because the order need three steps. First choose type of chicken, then the heat or spicy, then the side. This usually take time to make one order. As a result, it is slow to order if only one register open. This need to change. It need minimum two registers all time until their customers know immediately what they want.   The food is cook to order. So you need to be patient and wait. It is worthy to wait because it is good. I like the coating, flavor, and good pieces of chicken. We have chicken & waffle and quarter dark. The waffle was well made. The strip is well marinated. I like my quarter dark better because it has great coating. I got the hot level.  It is good heat.

This is the second restaurant they have open. The space is a lot beautiful than the YBOR location. They have a small room for hosting a special function or event. The restaurant is well decorated. I like the new space.   We were here for their lunch special. Two roll with soup or salad is $11. It is a good deal. The restaurant is kind of empty. It need good promotion for the local Carrollwood to attract more customers. We got the two roll with Atlantic and Tokyo Rolls. The Atlantic roll is very nice. It is a Striped Bass with imitation crab meat and lemon slice. The lemon slice enhances the flavor. I would recommend this roll. The Tokyo roll has tuna and yellow tail mixed. The spicy sauce make it very nice.   Our next dish is the baked mussels. But I like this dish better at YBOR because they bake till crisp on the top. Nonetheless, it is good big pieces of mussels. We also got the tempura bento box. The tempura is not measured up because they just dip the wet batter and fried. They did not add the tempura while fried to make it hairy.   Overall is a good visit. Good service.

Brooklyn Water Bagel is 3.5 stars. The yelp review is on target. The 3 to 4 stars is all base on when they take the first bite on to go order. If the customer take the bite there will be close to 4 stars. If it is to go, it may not be the same experience.   I have the chorizo bagel. For the price is about at the high side. Like the scrabble egg in it. The chorizo is ok. Food is definitely a breakfast style. As a result they close at 3 pm. May be changed a bit here and there will bring them to better product.

I would said their food is more to sweet side. This is their second stores in Tampa. Their original store is near Riverview. I have visited that store in Riverview. I think this store is better. There was no one eat in during the lunch time. But when we are leaving there is a couple walk in.   My wife have the spicy drunken noodle with tone down heat. She have the chicken drunken noodle. The noodle is still wet. Not dry enough. But they do have a lot of quantity. Enough chicken meat.   I have the garlic pepper shrimp. This dish is $15 with 8 big shrimps. Shrimp size is great. They do come with Thai hot like I ask. Burning spicy. I would said their technique is in good categories not in great categories. I still like it. It is great to go with rice.   Service is great. I would recommend the server wear mask.

Not much to talk about during pandemic. Because the place become take out only. No dine experience now. But they do keep everything one direction. They keep the entrance in one direction and social distancing.   I have the dragon fruit mango lemonade. The drink is refreshing. They do get the drink correctly. Slightly need to wait. There was a lot of drive thru customers. My wife have the mocha frappuccino. It has a lot of chocolate in it. Rich chocolate flavor.

It was a great ideal a dog park under the bridge. It is good to have roof over the park. The bridge elevated so high which they dog owner don't feel cramp under the roof. It is wide open area that make good use for urban revitalization to the residents at Channelside.   The park has a big dog area to run. It is great place to play catch. It will challenge to owner to through the ball entire length of the park in diagonal of square park. The many drainage concrete drain pipe in the park to play hide and seek. They are many different height platforms for the dog to rest. You will love the dog to get exercise. Many area to run. The dog fountain to drink the water. Basically you can have dog picnic there.   We like to thanks the Tampa Hillsborough Expressway Authority to donate this area for the memorial of Deputy Kotfila. His memorial bring a lot good by serving the community.

This is my go to Wawa in Largo. I cannot believe I have not given them a review. The gas here is one of the lowest price who accepts credit card as cash price. I think all gas station should do it or post two price with one for cash and one for credit. That way save customers a trip if they decided not to pump.   This gas station has great number of pumps and with middle turn around. It also has ethanol boat fuel. It is great for any type of transportation. The convenience store is great with many things to sell. You can grab an hoggie or latte.

Osaka Sushi is new. I give an A for the interior decoration. It is very modernize and aesthetic pleasing. The selection of light and furniture match the beauty of the space they have.   They are running the happy hour sushi from Monday to Saturday. The special start at 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm. They have the $1 sushi, $2 sashimi, $3 roll. The sushi is good size and thin. We have quite a few such as surf clam, eel, masago, snapper, white tuna, tuna. All is fresh.   The roll is tasty. They include spicy tuna, spicy salmon, shrimp tempura, Boston, kamikazi roll. They are all good. The rice is cook correctly and season correctly. The only thing I can think off is the the process for spicy tuna roll. Instead of dice and chop, the fish meat is food process to ground meat.   The service is great. I don't know anyone is running the special in weekend except them. So enjoy while it last.

Good enough Mall. However the choke point is the entrance of the mall at SR 60. If you are seasoned shopper, you will not like this entrance. The less busy entrance is from the Causeway Blvd. this will be the tip if you want to shop here. Other entrance included the Lee Roy Salmon Expressway.   Once you are in the mall, it was comfort to walk anywhere. The mall it self is good. If you want to get your morning walk in control environment, it is a good choice. It will take 20 minutes round trip and you do not worry smell, car noises or safety.    It has multiple anchors store including Sear, Macy, Dillard, Dick Sporting good, JC Penny. Definitely has some bargains since they have been here long. Black Friday is always crazy on the parking. But we were lucky. I am not sure they have security cameras in the parking lot. If you shop a lot and decided to put the purchased items in the car, I would said move your car to next space so the thief will no know and thinking you are leaving already.

This is the fourth time I am here. This is the first time we have seen full restaurant capacity. Please reserve ahead to get good seat. Tonight is the first Saturday of the month and they have the flamenco show and is free to the diner. This is happen every first Saturday of the month. The show is perform by a husband and wife team. The beautiful flamenco is performed by his wife Esther Suarez. She wears a tradition flamenco dress with fire lighting foot step pounding to stage floor. The husband Victor Moreno performing the Spanish guitar and the Spanish song that attract our attention and pleasant to the ear. The combination of song and dance entertainment make the night unforgettable.    Tonight we have started with the appetizer we love the most the lamb chop and follow by the mussel. The lamb chop is prepared by cutting the meat to rib bone and grilled to the perfection. The ingredient do not have the lamb smell at all. It is bite size happiness. The mussel is cook in garlic wine sauce. I have finish the garlic sauce with the dip of dinner roll. Mmmm good.   Today we order a bottle Black Sheep French Cabernet Sauvignon $24 a good value same as whole sale price. We have pair with our entree tonight. We have the New York Strip steak with mushroom wine sauce. The meat is prepare with the perfect wine sauce that go with the grilled steak. It came with broccoli. The other entree is Banger and Mash. It is the the English Sausage and the mash potato. The English sausage is insane delicious. It is better than the German sausage. Tasty!!!  The mash potato is mix with garlic sauce and spice. It is good that we have nothing left in the plate.   This restaurant owner wife is the main chef. You will enjoy every creation of her dish. We close out the dinner with the dessert crumble. Sweet fruit in the crunchy topping and top with vanilla ice cream.   To night is perfect that we finish with the flamenco performance with live Spanish song. The flamenco dancer pound the floor and vibrate the noise and vibrate your heart. The slow motion of the flamenco dancer express the beautiful ancient art. The rhythm is great to go with the dance every move. Can said that better, you have to experience yourself by every first Saturday of the month.   Overall this is great place to be. Some family bring their children to experience the live show.

I like business owner make good classy decorations for the customers to enjoy. This Vietnamese restaurant has good decorations for date night and enjoy good Vietnamese cuisine. Price just right on the budget average customer and a good place to hang out.   They have bar area with high stool with TV. They also has main dinning hall. The special section are the four corner couch area where dating make nicer. Outside seating is more casual for people want to watch people.   We have ordered the Da Nang Style noodle and the Iron Pot. The Da Nang noodle included large flat noodle, shrimp, pork in Shrimp base soup. It is good soup which is very similar to Malaysian prawn me soup base. The difference is they are sweet side and the the Malaysian prawn mee is at the spicy and salty side.   The iron pot include shrimp, beef, chicken, eggplant, mushrooms and clear rice vermicelli. I like the iron pot to keep food warm all time even after half hour of eating.   The service is ok. Our waiter only take our order and disappear, but other waitress was available. Manager is very nice. The only thing of the downfall is not because of the restaurant. It is about the parking on the street is hard to find.

Rare Ethnic Food No. 14  A well represented Honduran restaurant in the Tampa Bay. Like Mark P has indicated, where is all the Yelper, no many has checkin and review. This small business is very good on their Honduran cuisine. Food is excellent. The look at the outside like a shack but it well established restaurant.   We have the Carne Asada and the beef stew. Don't think the beef stew is a small think. It is big bowl of soup with beef and bone. It also has plantain, yuca corn inside. The stew is very good flavor and come with rice. The carne asada come with grounded bean and fried plantain chip. The side is impressive. I have not has a good bean paste like this. The plantain chip is excellent. The seasoning of the chip is great.   The restaurant is like family own. The food is more like home cooking of Honduran. Service is good.

Usually pizza is not my first choice of selection for any dinner.  I prefer it to be lunch or something quick and get back to work. Wood Fire Pizza has prove me wrong.  We were here 9:30pm 30 minutes before they close. We call ahead to make sure they are open. Sometime some other restaurant close early if they don't have customers.   We have order the Big Sexy, Carnivore and Raquel. My friend tell me the Raquel is the margarita pizza -  in drink this is favorite order item in the bar. The Carnivore has a lot of meat items. I am meat lover. This is the pizza of my kind. The surprise come from the Big Sexy. The pizza really match the name. It is sexy of the taste, sexy of the look, and sexy to enjoy for this pizza. The taste is sophisticated consider the twist of ingredients that were in it.   We are thankful that the restaurant open late for us. The service is great may be we hit the right time. We got 10% off the large pizza with yelp check in.

Our revisit is great. The service and the waiter are very responsive. Tonight we have a chance to try variety of food. We already know this restaurant have good skill. But tonight they are better. We have finally try their Peking duck. This dish needs to be pre-ordered a day or two before you come here. They will not serve you this dish if you just walking to the restaurant.   What is really the Peking duck? In the Yuan dynasty many variety of the roast duck has been done. Until the Ming dynasty the Peking Roast Duck is fully developed. This dish is serve to many diplomats who visit China. Henry Kissinger may be the first diplomat from US who lay the road for Richard Nixon have the first invite on this dish.   This duck preparation is closely guarded recipes in Peking. For my limited understanding the duck is dressed with the sauce and hung dry for two days before it roast in the oven. This allows the sauce marinated into the skin and duck meat. Because it was hung dry the skin is easily separated. Our dish tonight have display the best skin and meat separation. Meat is very lean. It serve with bun with hoisin sauce and scallions. Yummy good.   Many will said may be Valrico may have good food but is too far to try their restaurant. I would said this is two of the restaurant in this area worth for a drive. I would suggest you pre-order the Peking duck before you come.

We were here to have the celebration of the birthday of a yelp friend. There are unique theme like steam engine, conductor, train depot, tanker car, on the track, boxcar. At least they use this theme in the food menu.   When we arrived, the 97X radio holding a promotion there and give away the concert ticket. Then there is a promotion from the Tito Vodka to give up shot in the beginning. Then Tito Vodka came over to our table to buy a round of drinks for everyone in the table. Thank you for such a generous gift.   Back to the restaurant and bar. The food was put in the order and our drink was not deliver for some time. I mean a long time. We realize this place don't have enough help to serve the table. Soon we realize the waitress probably serve the food and help on the kitchen to get our food in order.   I would said the service is bad but for the situation we saw, cannot blame on this condition. It is the miss management to be blame. I hope they get their act together.

Come here for a drink and checking this place out. Typical bar setup at soho area with one half facing the outside street and the other half facing inside the building.   We have not try their food. Can said too much about it. However the set up of the bar is nice. The have some selection of the local draft. The beer is in the high side on the happy hour price compare to south Tampa. They do have the foot ball bucket during the game time. They do have good selection of Pinot Noir.   The only thing I don't like are their complimentary valet parking. If I don't want them to park my car, I cannot park on their lot. I have look for street parking. Sometimes if don't plan and go to this place and you don't want valet, you cannot park there. I do like their service. However, overall cost of drink is a bit higher compare to normal bar.

The TECO (Tampa Electric Company) Manatee Viewing center is a place to be when the outside temperature high of the day is below 68 degree. There is when the manatees gather at the warm water. Florida Manatee which is the West Indian manatee is very gracious creature in the water. The Manatee is found at many natural spring that maintain 72 degree of the temperature water. The sailor from the old time has mistaken them as mermaid of the sea.  There is no surprise at this time of year, the manatees are gathering near the TECO power plans that discharge their cooling water into the gulf. TECO using the water to cool their power plants and discharge the high temperature water into the Big Bend Bay of the gulf. As a result the water near the power plants was raise to 78 degree that attracts the manatee to reside near the bay. Today we are seeing over 150 manatees that gather at this place by their nature instinct. Although there is requirement from the EPA restriction of the clean water and air discharge, TECO has used this opportunity for the public relation to provide a center of the refuge for the manatee and the curious tourist. With the combination of the volunteer and partner of the TECO, this is a place to be visited when you come to Tampa bay at the cooling time. Today we spot a baby manatee that scratches his face with it three nail fin which is very adorable. Who can ague to the face of the manatee when they look at you? You can see some of the manatee back was hit by the boater. This remind us at the no wake zone the boater needs to slow down and respect the animal.  The center has included the bay walk elevated above the Big Bend Bay. It also has the observation tower at the nature trail. The parking may be a challenge if you come late, and you have to park at the overflow lot is half miles away. Come before 10 am is the best time if you want to park your car closer.

This is a New Orleans cuisine restaurant. The place fill up quickly at 6:00 pm. If you try to bit the crown, come before 5:30 for Saturday dinning.   The interior design beautiful. They have beautiful ceiling, and I bet you not many people notice it. They also have a beautiful bar with top rate bourbon on the shelf. The bar is busy when we were there because a lot people waiting for their table.   Tonight we have the duck confit spring roll as a appetizer. The spring roll have more vege than the duck. Not a fan. The entree are the rabbit dumpling and the bayou bolognese. The rabbit is serve with cast iron braise pot. This technique help the food not to get burn or over cook. The bolognese is actually a wild boar sausage. The both entree is ok not a wild factor. However, the restaurant allow you to select a side such as fried oyster for only addition $7.   The service is good. I may have to be back to see other dish will give me a wow factor. The self parking is a challenge but the valet is available. This is a restaurant good for family or couple.

Right Around the Corner is like neighborhood bar. It is just right at the the west side of I-275 of central avenue. This bar is walking distance to close by neighborhood restaurants.   This bar is unique with some of the free video games. It also has the shuffle board. But the board may need maintenance. It slide to one side. Other game include foosball for two or four. Pool table is good when you have two with the drink.   The bar has eight different craft beer from local or out of state. They also has dollars beers. The price is reasonable. One thing can be suggested is the flight of beers. Allow customers to taste different beers.   Overall is very good. There are many bar there, but this bar may interest you for special price beer and fun games.

This restaurant located the rejuvenate area of the city of Temple Terrace. This area now is beautiful and pleasant. The Italian restaurant is locate at the south end of the plaza and park.   The restaurant have the wine by the ounce for the high end wine. This is new concept for the restaurant to push more sell when one people is dining. Today, we have appetizer as roughneck clam and the salmon and shrimp cream soup. The clam cook with Bianca Wine source and the most delight dish in the evening. The soup is salty even we have ask kitchen to redo it since it use the shrimp stock that very salty.   Our meal is a bargain coupon since they just open the restaurant. We have the two meals with salads is $19. We have the Caesar Salad and the meal is the pasta Bacco with sausage and the chicken wrap with ham. The sausage is good and tasty. The chicken wrap with ham is good but the source is ruin the dish. The grill vege that come with the chicken is great very flavor.   After we have finish out dinner, we have couple if Gelato. My wife have the mango and I have the pistachio flavor. They are very good.   I think this restaurant is try to figure out it identity. They seem like don't have set menu yet and they are try any cooking to see which item of the menu is the most welcome. I believe they can be very successful if the mixture of the taste is sophisticate and add some thing other Italian restaurant that was not done before.

Good coffee house in Seminole Height area. It has all the potential and groove to attract customers. Very nice setting inside. All the musical instruments are lay on the floor if you want freely express your artistic side.  The place is great to visit. It is part of the tourists spot to visit. The Cafe Borgia coffee is the signature drink for this store. It has the honey and orange blossom and top with orange peel. It has a choice of cold or hot coffee. The coffee certainly make a impact to the customer. We have order the cold and hot Cafe Borgia and concluded the hot is better due to smell of coffee.   I order a sconewhich for breakfast. The scone has bacon and cheese and is delicious. It come with two eggs with sunny side up. I like their way of the bacon was added. The service is very friendly.

I dedicates this review to my Yelp elite friend that just past this year. I have bookmark this place due Mike review a year ago. I finally have a chance to visit and this place find it very affordable. This review for Mike M and Arlene.   I know the restaurant is very close to my badminton gym. However, I was not able to visit after or before the games. I have to make a special trip for this restaurant. When arrive at this restaurant at 4:45, I was thinking we must be the first customer for the early arrival. I was surprised there were so many car in front already. Either I am really late or this is a popular place. Soon enough we founded out the early bird started from 2 to 5 pm daily. We beat the clock with 3 minutes to spare for the early bird. The early bird menu entrees are less than $9 except the steak dish for $14. What a steal. The people who dine there average age are at least 10 year older than me. I am just a young chicken when I was among them.   We have ordered the coco loco tilapia and stuffed tilapia. Then we look at their regular menu, we have order the Rockefeller oyster of six for $9. I also spot a before 6 pm margarita for $3. Our total include tax an tip is less than $35. Wow. This food may not excited you but it had a awesome value. Oysters is great when came out from the grilled. Love it. I like the shredder coconut on the tilapia. It come with two side. The stuff tilapia is not bad at all. Although it do not have the wow factor, it is fresh and good.   The margarita has full loaded alcohol. Usually if I got the discounted margarita, I fell dilute juice at the last melt drink. But the margarita here is strong. I will come to check them again since my wife also like it.

In search of taco, i decide to be this place since the other taco place is too busy. This place been in my bookmark for some time. This taco bus is the oldest in the Bay Area among all the taco bus. I thought they must has something special item from other taco bus. They did not.   They open very late to 4 am in the morning. If you cannot find a place to eat at late hours, this place may be open. A yellow bus is a order center. Then you can take your order number and they will bring the food to you.    The taco is below average from our current taco fever. They may need to improve since Tampa already has many mobile taco open and better. Meat seasoning need to step up. The meat juicy need to preserve when they serve. Overall, I would say this is a jewel in Tampa to symbolize the Tampa.

My favorite sandwich chain store. Definitely a Jersey taste. It is fresh, healthy, and good taste. I have been to many Jersey Mike sandwich stores include this one and they are not disappoint me.   As usual, I order something that most of the sandwich store do not have items. Only Jersey Mike has it. The capacola ham with bacon, lecture, tomato and Mike way. Mike way is oil, spice, red vinegar, and pepper. The ham is spicy ham with a minor kick on it. I like it this way.   The sandwich is prepared to my order. When you paid, set up phone number account with them. You can collect point along the way for a free sandwich in the future. I like their sweet tea which has the southern sweet. The combo include drink and chip. They also has hot sub such as the philly cheese steak.

Cool store with a cool down soft drink. This store sale a Godzilla types of soft drinks. It range from different countries. Minimum $2 as bottle. They have drink from Asia to end of world. I mean Asia that require 28 hours of flight.   Their soda range from cream soda to sweet green tea. Basically this drink is out standing. Try a bottle a day will take a lot of months to try them all. Then you forgot which one is your favorite.   Other than the soft drink, they have the munchies from giant kit Kat to hello kitty mush mellow. There are plenty to choose from. Good luck with your munchies.   They also have the one line funny sign. Such as "the boob are real but the smile are fake". Sign that have political joke or daily interest. The signs are eyes catching.

Nordstrom is one of the high end departments store. Time to time they have sales item that is worth a look. The service is very attentive because you can sale person everywhere. The lay out is comfortable display with space to roam. Not like other store with shoulder to shoulder condition when we have a lot of customers.   Their designer collection cloth is beautiful but in high prices range if you choose the designing clothes. They have online section you you want to shop at home. The store also has restaurant if you decided to shop here and dine here.

Mother day all the Tijuana Flat give free meal to all mother who visited. My child mom also got one free meal. This business model actually work and got many visitors of the night. It actually very thoughtful and they actually advertise their brand. Most of the family come to celebrate mother day at least 3 to 4 in a group. Some is more and actually bring business to the restaurant.   I have order the steak quesadilla with cheese only. No veggies. My wife have the steak chimichanga. Did you notice their steak is good quality. Not tendon at all. Food was cool to right temperature with the cheese melt inside the quesadilla. If they have the steak grilled, I think they will attract more customers with correct marinated grilled steak.   Overall. They are good food. Service is excellent. I did not try the grilled Mahi. May be next time.

I saw so many has post about the French Toast. As a result, we have ordered one to try. The toast is soft. Although they are all yellow out cover with scramble egg, I still cannot feel to much egg on the toast compare to the one I cook by my own.   We ordered a piece of the Pistachio cherry Tart. We were debate to get this tart or the Apricot Flan. We were glad have tart. It has rich enough pistachio top with cherry. It is one of the best tart I have and it is special.   I have the Egg Benedict for my close up. It come with choice of bacon or ham. I have pick the bacon. This is the best dish among the selection. The egg yolks is liquidity and the egg white just like jello. Now you know you have a good porch egg.   The service is good, but our waiter for get our water initially. After that, the rest is on track.

Bobacup is getting a bit slagging today. A few week ago I find out after 9 pm they don't cook the Hong Kong waffle and we turn away. Last night they completely remove from the menu. Don't understand it. Their reply is not popular item.   Now they serve crepes with fruit and whip cream. I have order the one with strawberry and banana. Not my liking. When they roll the crepe and try to pack in the fruit in cone shape. It doesn't work. I would rather they lay it flat fold three folds with the fruit inside. It turn out they give out their best product and go to somethings they are not good at.   Although the boba menu is still there, but the service with no smile, and the quality is not there. A drop of star from my previous review. I wonder some time what define their identity.

This will be the last restaurant to try during the St. Pete restaurant week. We call ahead today and they indicate no reservation is needed. Their outside sitting is very popular. The inside has plenty of room.   Our first courses are the ceviche and chicken stay skewers. The satay is the best dish tonight. It herb grilled with chilies sauce and peanut glazed. The ceviche is the mahi mahi in lime juice. It just ok compare to most of Peruvian restaurant.   To night they don't have duck leg so we order two grilled Cobia fish as second course. The Cobia is grill and top with pineapple salsa and avocado purée. I like the accompanying almond rice. Is is very tasty.   Our final courses are the cheesecake and the strawberry rhubarb pie. The crust of the pie is perfect. The cheesecake is most and good.   Overall the service is a bit slow. The reason they have 3 stars is no stand out dish. No wow factor and some seafood chain restaurant is better than them. The menu may need to improve to attract. For the price we paid, they may not be the best choice.

The name matches what they serve. Mr. Penguin definitely a cold serve. We are welcome the cold serve in Florida since we have hot weather most of the time.   I like thank Nick to show this place to us. We like their combination of the Italian ice with the soft serve ice cream. This combination is work for me. I have the vanilla soft serve with the bubble gum flavor Italian ice. They put them in layer. We actually can pick to flavors of Italian ice but I didn't do it since I like bubble gum flavor. The ice cream with the two type of mix calls gelati. I like Mr. Penguin creative bring other sensation to the community.   The soft serve can be vanilla, chocolate or the swirl of two flavors. The Italian ice has a lot to select. You can ask for the try out taste before you make your order. This place is dog friendly.
