My final farewell to the restaurant owner and chef for their retirement of this restaurant was last night dinner. After 21 year of long running, the Cafe European will close their restaurant. The last night of dinner will be 8/1/2015. After that it will be close  I met the new owners of the restaurant there too.  They have not decided what they going to do yet but will open a different restaurant. The new restaurant will be different than the existing restaurant.   Thanks to Suzy and Mike for choosing Tampa for 21 years. This is the restaurant I love and the farewell is last night dinner. They have one more night which is tonight. For 6 years we have get to know about their restaurant, we enjoy Suzy delicates chef skill. You will not find a British who can cook like this in town. The best dish is the Beef Wellington that with the puffy dough and seasoning red wine sauce and mushroom is the best in town. If you watch Gordon Ramsay Hell Kitchen show, he always test the young chef for this dish. Difficult dish to cook and make harmony of two worlds. I like their lamp chop appetizer is one of the best in town. Very consistent every time we're here.   I wish them very good journey of their break from restaurant business. Farewell my friends.

The taste is very familiar. It seems one of the Bistro restaurants in Tampa. May be one of the main chefs there open this restaurant? The restaurant is one hour to get there from my house. It is equivalent I drove to any Pinellas Park restaurants with same amount of time.   The restaurant locates deep in the plaza. I have to warn you the restaurant is new and the service may take long since they don't have enough servers. Good luck to call in for to go since they are busy taking the order in the floor.   Since they don't have enough server, I suggest you get the menu yourself is faster. I saw our neighbors waited 10 minutes to wait for the menu. Get your order in once they check on you.  We have order the ginger frog leg, grouper asparagus with wine sauce, duck raisin fried rice and the wet beef chow fun. I like their frog leg and their fried rice.   Since they just open and the service is not quite there yet, only 4 star for good food.  Good pricing.

Great Chinese restaurant. The old ABC was located at St. Pete and now the the owner move to this location not long ago. When they just first open I was not impress. Today they are really do a good job.   We have order a salt and pepper Whole Lobster and three dim sum dishes for dinner. The dim sum are shrimp stuff egg plant, leak steam dumpling and the beef tripe. The egg plant is well prepared since the skin is soft enough. Obviously the egg plant is deep fried with ground shrimp paste and hot plate grilled the surface and added the black beam sauce. If the chef did not prepare correctly the skin will be tough to bite through and you will end up leave the skin on the side. However this chef did correctly and is yum to consume.   Today feature is the the Lobster. They are running the special with each lobster $15. Can't beat this price. They can prepare ginger scallion, Hong Kong style with egg white, steam, salt and pepper....... You got to try it now while they are running the special. The way they have the lobster cut to 10 pieces. The first cut is remove head then the crawl. The body is cut to 6 pieces. They will deep fried and stir fry with salt, green scallion, onion and jalapeño. This dish you need to learn how to eat from the shell.   If you have group 4 or more, I recommend to order the fillet flounder. The fish meat fillet in cube and easy to eat. Many people don't know the fried side bone can be eaten. The side bone is taste like crunchy yum food. Please be sure to chew or crush before you swallow because some time you chose too close to the main bone that cannot be swallow.    Overall the service is good today. We have been back and will be back for more.

We have two malls in the close proximity near west shore. I like the West Shore Plaza better due to the bargain. Try to come at weekday instead of weekend to check out the bargain. What we call it slow day for business and they are trying to get rid of the inventory.  I like the mall lay out in square shape. When you start at the same corner and end up in the same location in one loop. I hate mall go to one end and have to walk back to the starting point to get your car. West Shore Plaza more has many stores to offer. I like the restaurant there with P.F Chang, Season 52, Maggiano's Little Italy, Mitchell Fish Market, and the recent open Besito.   The mall has three parking garages that allow for parking in the shade. It is easy access to the mall from and to I-275. It has four anchor stores - Macy, Dick Sport, Sears and JC Penny. Please go to their web site to look for deal at the time. They also have the AMC Theater with 14 screens. Please check them out.

Following Rachel many questions to the store clerk. I decided to take a picture of their menu for Rachel to study. It may require a PHD sturdy since they have ton of combination and topping selection. You think you have it all, not quite. As a statistical saying, I begin my quest with one Boba combination tonight. It is impossible and a tall task to try them all.   I have been to many boba places; this place is the faster from order to deliver. May be they use the industry ice shave machine. No matter what, they are quick to deliver. The location is very tactical to be close to USF to attract students. The pricing is affordable compare to many Boba place. Tonight I have the Mango Snow with Boba. The boba cooks very soft. The mango snow is fruitier flavor. Many place you can feel the artificial fruit flavor but this place improve it to good tasting.    Overall, I like their menu. A lot of speciality to try, fast service. One good trick, go there at 9 pm and sit out outside. Wait for the summer Bush Garden firework and enjoy a cup of boba. Cannot bit that with free firework with boba.

This is very nice hotel. Constantly is book for wedding, special anniversary celebration or meeting. They have the inside or outside gathering location for your choice. Include private garden for your outdoor for special function.   The waterfall pool is beautiful and private at the hotel location. Many people has stay in this hotel due to access convenient. It get right to the Vinoy park that have many function such as art festival or blue festival.   Every month they have special event with live music at their front court yard. Sometime is very interesting. The interior decoration is amazing. It has nice restaurant and bar. I would said this is a classic hotel in the heart of St. Pete. Easy walk to any restaurant of your choice.

Datz has few thing on their sleeve that attract the customer to come back. We were here at the Wednesday night, the place still pack at 9 pm. We have group of Yelpers gather here that night. The place is jam packed.   Datz label themselves as a pokegym. You can score point for your team when you check in here for Pokemon catch.   I have the beer with nitro  (forgot what name) and the Pork Shank Redemption. The beer come with right temperature not too chill but cold enough. The meal come out about correct timing. My dish is huge. It is a big Shank and decorated the Rosemary on top of the bone. It was braise properly with maple bourbon glaze out side. Very tasty on the exterior of the meat. Ii accompanied with the mash potatoes that make this dish filling.   We have good time there,  food is good, service is good. Close out and paid bill is quick.

With all the hype, I finally make it to this place with a group of yelp friend. This is the second capital taco that is open other than the original from the Land O Lake. I am fan for the original capital taco.  We arrive one hour before it close. The capital taco has strange hour. They close at 8 pm and it is early to my standards. So far they only open 3 day a week. They are planning to open more than 3 days a week.   I have order the west coast special with tiger shrimp my favorite at the original capital taco and the Johnny Reb. The shrimp is over cook. It is not bouncy. The Jonny Reb is a bit better. Somehow the food on second capital taco do not measure to their original store.   Other not positive note is they got this big space. However, the seating is too less. Why they want the customer to take it to go or wait on the table since they can have more table. Since they are in the corner store why not add some out door seating. The line is also long, I would said they can take the order on the line like Chick fillets.   There are many area they can improve. I hope my next visit they can improve.

Hillsborough Community College Culinary School "Gourmet Room" is getting it name with beautiful and sensual dining. This is the perfect academic and restaurant to close my 300th series review. Thanks to students and teacher who serve the good food. If you like to know the website to joint in, please go to Grace H review.   We have a pleasure to celebrate a friend be late birthday here. The setting is nice with beautiful art on the wall. It is a table cloth serving if you want to have a nice diner with your love one with very good cost. I would encourage put more tip money in the plate to support the scholarship for the school since they are not for profit. Come and try out their food since each week is different country until their semester ended of their serving.   Tonight we have the Greek theme since I miss the season opener last week. The first course is the Greek Salad and The Lentil Soup. The Greek salad is a classic dish in many Greek restaurant. I like the pita bread on top of the salad. It is crispy and top with few pieces of sea salt. The lentil soup is garnish with spinach. The flavor has a twist mixture of the fragrant of food.   The main course is the Pork Tenderloin serves with Orzo Pasta. The orzo pasta shape like rice cook with olive oil tomato with a bit basil leave. The pork tenderloin is seasoned and baked in oven. The exterior was well salt and the seasoning that went into the meat.  Then it is sliced and served to the customer.    My favorite is the dessert. Tonight it end with Baklava. I have eat many of baklava and never like it because many of them are sitting too long or wrap in the plastic before it serve. The different of this baklava is freshly prepared with crispy layers of crush. The infill of nuts are crispy and perfect to enjoy.   They still have four weeks left before the semester run out. Come and try the good cooking and support the students.

I went to gym in Largo (20 miles away from home) and found out I forgot my gym shoes. It is no way for me to go back and get it. I ask my friend which is the closer sport store I can get an emergency pair of shoes. They indicate to me there is no close by sport store. I should try the Largo mall which is 10 minutes away.    I found Famous Footwear in Largo Mall. They have the high top gym shoes that I need to protect me from high ankle roll. I bought an usable cotton cloth shoe and try out in the gym. But after few games of badminton, I feel paint at the toe.  I took the shoes I bought that day and return on the following week when I return to the gym. They clerk of the store allow me to exchange. They are very friendly and helpful. I got the next exchange pair that fit me. Now I put this pair in the car for emergency.

I was surprised the chef of this restaurant has some skill for handling the material. The foods are delicious to my standard. The live band is performed at their front porch at the week end.   We have order the Escargot Bourguignon, Porch Bouillabaisse and the Plain Ole Steak with au Poivre sauce. The escargot is a bit small size but it is still a very good deal. We got it for $5 happy hour. It came with aluminum six spots mold. The flavor of the herb and butter sauce did mix well with the escargot. We dip the bread into the butter sauce and it is delicious.   My wife has the Porch Bouillabaisse with mixed seafood. It is sauté with white wine, olive oil and clam broth. Mmmm good. It also comes with penne pasta with the broth. My steak entree come with mash potato and sautéed squash. The au Poivre sauce is brandy cream sauce with mushroom. The brandy adds the enhancement and sweetens the sauce and brown the mushroom. It is very very good. The steak is the top Sirlion season with kosher salt and fresh ground pepper. It makes the exterior of the meat crispy. The steak company very well with the au Poivre sauce. The steak is well pick from the market and they are very tender.   The restaurant certainly has the food with good pricing. The only thing they really need to improve is the interior. The table, chair, lamp, and interior need to have makeover. They are too old and some table side is sticky. The food is 5 stars but the interior only allow me to award 4 stars.

If you like to find you can be chef by knowing ingredients and spice, you can come to this place. You will know you can be chef immediately by choosing the right spice for your bowl. If it is not good, you will be the only one to be blamed :).   There are many choices for the ingredients. I like the mix of scallops, squid, steak, chicken, pepperoni for the meat. For the veggies, I select the mushrooms if going with sweet sauce or bean sprouts and water chest nut with salty sauce. The snow peas is great with both sauce.   Other ingredients will be the dice garlic and grind ginger. Add a bit pepper salt will be great. The selection spicy sauce is nice but you can add dried chili and jalapeño to make it more spicy. At the end I have ask them to add two egg. For the starch- the regular bowl have two choices. I select the udon and the pasta.   Service is great. Food came out hot from the kitchen. I always select seat that can see the kitchen because sometime they light up big fire ball for the show on their grill plate.

This restaurant open not long ago. We have coupon in our mail box as a result we set a day aside to try them out. They are very close to the movie theater and it is a good way to draw the crowd.   Their Menu is very simple. First choose a starch or veggies. Second select the proteins or type of meat. Third select the toppings then select the sauce. We have order the lamb kabobs with rice with all toppings and the sauce. This is good dish. Our second dish is chicken kabob with hummus. This is a better dish. Each dish is under $10. Dish portion is a bit small.   Compare to nearby middle eastern and Greek food, they are at the middle of the pack. Please prepare to wait since each order is grilled at the spot. You will need to be patience for this restaurant. They may need to improve they delivery method because the lunch crowd do not have that much of time to eat.

I like the mixture of this restaurant. I have been here several time and they have not disappoint me. The service is great and the owner of the restaurant paid attention to the customer. She get in sushi wrap if they are behind. She gets to the front serving the table if they need help in this area. I like mom and pop shop like this and the yelper need to support them to stay alive.   This is a restaurant that is great for vegan or regular eater customer. Most of of the people don't know there is a vegetarian menu. You have to ask for the vege menu that not shown often. In the vege menu they have a roll call the funky monkey roll. It is a bit sweet and go well spicy tuna roll. It neutralizes the spiciness. What is actually the Funky Monkey Roll??  This is a vegan dish and they are pretty good. It is Inari (sweet tofu skin), avocado, cucumber, daikon, and tempura banana, rolled in seaweed and rice, topped with mango and avocado. These are complicated combination and they are working well with each material.   I always use the spicy tuna roll as a judgment for the sushi chef skill. Some sushi chef likes to add chop of cucumber in the roll. This is incorrect and it is occupied the actual tuna space and reduce the amount of tuna provided. The correct way is to dice the tuna not ground and then add quail egg. Then add sesame oil, spicy chili, a bit salt and roll with the sushi rice. This roll not requires and soy sauce or wasabi and it is good enough to eat as it is. This restaurant did it A+.   I have order the Japanese Ramen with pork belly. They did not make me jump out the seat but is good enough to enjoy. Today I have order the Chashu Pork Belly Ramen - Served with chashu pork belly, pork pot stickers, boiled eggs, corn, scallions, naruto (pink spiral fish cake) and menma (pickled bamboo shoots)  We have close our lunch with a desert is big enough to share for 4 people. It is the Banana Bomb - Tempura fried banana & dark chocolate wrapped in spring roll skin served with vanilla ice cream & assorted sauces. The display is a wow factor and it also taste like a wow factor. Love it.  Thursday and Saturday night have dates night special. Please check their web site. If you check in with Yelp, you get a free shot of sake. The best is the sake came with flavor. I like the Fuji Apple flavor.

Great chicken with mojo marinated sauce. I always like Pollo Tropical chicken. The chicken is marinated through and through. The season spice when into the chicken deep inside. I love the skin with rich mojo spice. It was so good.   Sometime they run special item such as Tropichop. First step pick your meat - mojo pork, chicken pincho, Calypso Beef. Then add your base such as rice, lettuce or yellow rice. Then top with type of veggie, then added your sauce. Sound easy. This special is running now. I would go for typical grilled chicken with mojo spice.   We have good coupon two order for $10. Can beat it. The salsa and spicy sauce can be pick up on the sauce island. In fortunately there was no Pollo Tropical in new Tampa area. I have travel far to get it if I am craving for it.

This place is located very remotely. It got the space it need to hold large group. The kitchen and the order center are separated. Every time they take an order they when to back room to prepare it. It leave the front counter empty.   The smoothie they prepare is a bit in the sweet side. I think may be the juice they have is sweet. Overall the wait is short. I order the pomegranate plunge. It has good taste. Love the nature drink.

The SR 60 that connects the Pinellas and Hillsborough county is rename from Davis Causeway to Courtney Campbell Causeway in 1948. Mr Courtney Campbell is the proposer to beautify this Causeway and repair to the modern link to the two counties. His is a US house representative.   Today it serve one of the three connection bridge for the two counties. Currently, the FDOT just finished a bridge for a bike trail to link the counties. The bridge is currently narrow no shoulders. But along the Causeway, there are plenty of stop you can enjoy and park next to beach area. During the New Year's Eve, many has park there and watch the firework or do the fireworks themselves.   If you come in the right time, you can watch the sunset on the far side of Clearwater. The setting is beautiful. There are some boat ramp along the Causeway make water activities pleasant.

I cannot believe I am actually writing a review for Arby's. in all goodness, I do like their new product. The new pork belly sandwich has attracted me to be here. I have pork belly sandwich at BBQ place before. I just want to see how they fare with their new sandwich. It give you 2 slide of thick pork belly, crispy onions, and smoke cheddar cheese. This combination sound very good. The pork belly was cook harmony and it go well with the crispy onions. It create crunchy taste. The sauce is good. As I did not have lunch and have the late lunch everything taste good.   I was only one at three o'clock drive through. After paying, it still need to wait for 3 minutes to cook. The drive through lane need to be reconstructed in this location. A lot pot holes that cumulate the dirty water. May be make it more desirable for the drive through experience.

I have been many Old Navy store but none like this. This store interior set up is unique. This old navy has good front entrance wall set up. The store is two level but the second level is connected by switch back ramps. It becomes kid play ground to run around because of this set up.   The fitting room below the frost switch back to best use of the space. The decorations is unique to see. It is not normal typical old navy look.

In compare to the Oggi in David Island, I think this restaurant is on the average. First thing is about the demographic. The David Island has high average income than the lutz location. Same chicken dish may be able to sell at David Island for $22 a dish may not be affordable in Lutz. In a way this is BBQ countryside. Just chicken as protein may not be able to satisfy the customers come for a restaurant.   We got chicken Parmesan and Pistachio Chicken Cutlets Palermo Style. The Parmesan chicken is typical Parmesan I can else way for less price. It need to be spectacular for charging over $20. However, the Pistachio chicken is definitely worth the price because not typical restaurant has it. It has good crust and sauce. Very pleasant.   Service is below average in compare to the David Island store. Not many table is serving, but is a bit difficult to get hold of the waitress. May be this place is biggest and separated by a partition wall between the bar and dinning area. Seem like many waiters congregate on the bar area and not been able to see what happens to the dinning hall.

This actually 4.5 stars not yet 5 stars boba place. Since there is no half stars, the place is cool, I have give them 5 stars.   Chewy Boba originally from Orlando. This may be the first Chewy in Tampa. Although they did not carry special flavor like the Orlando Colonial chain, but they have some flavor I have no try before.   The decorated the place like the stars war movies Chewbacca character because it close to its name. The place has some videos games, board game, card game and more. You pretty much can spend a night there to play and talks.   I have been here twice. I got the winter Mellon boba tea and the Okinawa boba tea. Both of them is very good. I like the drink. They always add the boba to the bottoms or quarter level of the cup. There are plenty of boba to chew. I hope they keep this consistent. The tea is decent.

After dinner near the airport, we decided to look up the dessert store nearby. Mooberry seem like a good choice at this location. It actually closes to the Pho Quyen.   The store sells the yogurt by ounce. Like most of the yogurt store we were provided the sample cup for the flavor. Seem like the current yogurt store like to ha salt caramel flavor. This is the four yogurt store we have encounter in a month with this flavor.   The store lady in the front desk is nice and friendly. The only thing is if you buy below $5 and use the credit card there will be additional fees. Our group has seven and we occupied the 70% of the store chair. They do have the low elevation stool for sitting. It also has some outside sitting.   We did play card there and enjoy out time there. The yogurt is $0.45 per ounce.

When my friend want to try this restaurant as part of the Latin Crawls. I check yelp that they have only 2 stars rating. I was skeptical to visit this restaurant.  Well, I was visit as out of curiosity and experiences he culture. We have some Ecuadorian restaurant in the Bay Area. This restaurant is above the average.   One of the best dish will belong to one of my friends' order. He got the black clam rice. This dish I never have it before. It is quite unique in it own way. It is delicious.   I got the carne asada with red bean soup. The steak is average but it has enough quantities of meat. We also got the corviche de pescado fish in plantain filling. It is good enough experience. We also got the lulo drinks which is great.   Service is good for our big table. May be we come at the right moment when all the items were in the right place. They deserve 4 stars.

Great drive through. The wait is good but sometime they have hang out with customer and delay the deliver time for the drive through. I like to get the dollar menu during the happy hour time 2-5 pm. I have the Baja freeze and the spicy chicken crunch. The food is good for afternoon snack.  Try their cinnamon ball. Sweet Cream inside

In search of the taco place. I look up Dianna review and decide to try this place. You can said is unique place in the Bay Area with authentic Mexican food. I have not seen our recent taco crazy taco queen Kristal checkin to this place. I finally have a place to bit her to the punch.   It was surprise to me this place have good taco at very economical scale. I have three tacos and a margarita for total of $11. I have the steak, pastor and lamb. This is the first time I have the lamb taco. It is very different than other taco place. Very tasty. It come in chunk. Good in value for this taco.   The other two taco is not bad either. During the weekday including Friday, they run the two margaritas for $5 from 2:00 pm to 7:00 pm. Very good deal. With economical pricing, friendly serving, and good food, they deserve 5 stars.

Hillsborough Community College (HCC ) provide the student with less fees to achieve the Associate Degree. I am way pass re learning stage. But some of the program may interest me in the future when I am retired. I come to campus a lot not for learning but for the food and the student government center. Thanks to the school have this event that I can enjoy the college without Learning   HCC offer the culinary program. Each time the school have session, the HCC Gourmet room is open. We are the frequent visitor for this "restaurant". We can try the student skill with very good fees. $7 dollar per person. Man who can beat that. The cuisine range from French to Italian. Sometime they have the Ghana food. It is almost like 5 star restaurant and the service is really good. I always leave a good tips.   The other venue is we often attend their student government musical events. The last event is the famous Ekachai Jearakul. He is 1st Prize of the Guitar Foundation of America International Concert Artist Competition. He is a first oriental who want this ultimate prize in well recognize America. He is from Thailand and have good skill in the classical guitar. The student government did a good job to place very high standard concertos in every event. My high congratulation to a success student government.

My friends want to have clean diet lunch near the USF area. I was able to locate one since I have been to the first watch near USF.   My friend is a picky eater and he is not a vegan but he watches his diet carefully. It is challenging when one of your group people want a clean diet food. I only can think a few choices. We are great able to accommodate his need. I saw the first thing he has order is the kale tonic. It is kale, cucumber, lemon and Fuji Apple. Very healthy. No sugar added. The trick is always adding some type of fruit to sweeten it up. In this case is Fuji Apple. The lemon is to add the twist of the taste. Nice touch.   This afternoon I have the smoke Salmon and Roasted Vegetable Frittata. It has the roasted shallots and tomatoes in the egg that create the sensation of the taste. Good touch. It also has some chive in there to enhance the taste. It serves with ciabatta toast and sweet jam.   We have 5 people in our group but we are in and out the restaurant in 45 minutes. They are well prepare for the lunch crowd since their lunch time is short.

Rare Ethnic Food No. 19  Indian biryanis is an beautiful like Chinese fried rice.  Chinese use the soy sauce with other ingredients. The Indian biryanis is using the Indian spice mixed with meat. The liking of how biryanis taste is up to each individual. Some like heavy spice with hot chili and some like it mild with touch of spice.   The selection of biryanis here is a lot. Start with egg biryanis, boneless mutton, paneer veggies, Kheema, anthrax chicken, Avakai, ulavacharu and more. We have order regular chicken biryanis and Avakai biryanis. Tha avakai include mango pickle. Very interesting. I like it spicy hot. But if you feel is too hot, they have yogurt on the side.   Service is good, the biryanis is excellent. Good enough spice. My wife said it is to hot after 5 spoon full. Love to come back to try them all.

It is another good BBQ in Hillsborough County. This one located north of Mango. I like them because they have several good things happen to my visit. It is a food truck on the corner of CR 579 and US 92 Northwest corner.   This smoke BBQ has smoke mullet. Their smoke mullet maintaining juicy condition and easy to pick the whole fish meat. Because the debone most of the fish. We also got their smoke brisket sandwich. It is good marinated. I like the carry a bit fat to beautify the entire taste.   We got smoke rib which is also has meat fall off the bone. Easy to eat. The smoke chicken maintains it juicy meat. I have been to many smoke place but the meat is to dry. This place did a good job to keep the meat juicy.   The side turkey rice is my favorite. The wait is a bit long. But I don't mind.

Solid four stars restaurant due to value, taste and unique. It is a fast food. No they are cool to your order. The food is good middle eastern food.  We have order the mix grill and tilapia pita.   A lot people like to have the take out because it is easy. The only bad part I can find is the ventilation inside the restaurant. It need to ventilate more to keep the food smell out.   Now the the good part. The mixed grill is delicious. Lamb and chicken are grilled better here. The juice and moisture of the food is kept inside. That is the different between them and most of the middle eastern food.   The grilled tilapia is tasty. It has a lot of fish inside the pita. All this food come with the side of you choice. The pita is one choice and the mix plater is two choice. It is good experience here since the people are friendly.

I found this restaurant expensive for dinners. The dinner for two with drink, entrée, and appetizer is about $90. As the price is high the expectations also high.   The entrance of the restaurant is somewhat unique. It is a side hallway entrance to the courtyard and host greet you there. This restaurant was book fully at night and we decided to sit at the bar.   We started with chicken liver crostini. The liver was made into paste and spread over grilled toast. I like this dish because it is so southern. It was drizzle with dandelion vinegar. It add the taste to the liver.   Our entrées are the seared hunger steak and the LA shrimp and little neck clam. The seafood dish is good. But the hunger steak is a bit too vinegary. I like the yellow split pea purée. The steak was well medium rare. Very good. The steak dish all is good but the taste or sauce is not impressive.   Overall is good. The food come out in the right time. Not much to wait.

Bulla open door front basically is inviting setting for the prime Soho area. The bar setting is just like that. The bar area is busy. It is full of customers with one bar tender during weekday. I have waited at the bar area and not get my turn to serve and walk to the host to get a table to sit since sit down area has less people. It only happen at 6 pm that bar is more customers than the dining hall.   I got the Churrasco for my main dish. This dish come with Mahon Cheese Grit at the bed and top with sautéed veggies on top with the skirt steak in the middle. This is one way they presented. I would separate all three items instead of lay them over each other. This way I can taste different taste. This is a good dish to recommend. I also got the churro at the end with caramel and chocolate dipping sauce. The chef here has good skill for the Churrasco made the meat tender.   This is about 3.5 stars restaurant to my book. A few thing they can improve on. Since they have open air entrance, there is a lot food flight in the restaurant. It border me while I am eating. The bar area is too busy for just one person. May be need to look at how to improve the bar area when it is 80% capacity.

It is good solid 4 stars. Very close to 4.25 stars. I like the creative ideas to put waffle on stick. It is interesting. For the puffing waffle, it has been around for long time. But I like them to make to the order when you just order. It is fresh and nice.   We got crunchy berries pop. It is come with the berries, corn flakes, milk chocolate and more. The waffle is crunchy and crispy. Very nice. Sauce is good and harmony with the topping. We did try the puffing waffle before. It is good with ice cream.   Everything is good. But the price is in the high side to have this waffle. The value to taste is about 4 stars. But the waffle on the stick ideas is great.

Casa Tina is a unique restaurant located in downtown Dunedin. I have not try their food yet but I do love like the mixed drink here.   The restaurant has the nice decorations. It has a lot to look at includes the different design of the crucifix cross. They also has painting, art craving, wall mirrors and Mexican art. The also have the areal performance art sometime. So go enjoy it.   The bar has different type of the tequilas to mix in the margarita. They also has different year selection of tequilas with longer the year and less hangover.   You always can get a fruit juice mixed with tequila to create your own drink. My friend said that the food average, one day I will try it myself. The seating has the bar seat, booth, table or you can select the more comfortable seat at the couch.   Overall they are good. One thing they can improve is to have larger the mixed drink menu selection.

It must be the local favorite since it is high stars rating. However not work for season visitor like I am. It has good flavor. It is almost like food truck standard. I hope they can improve to restaurant dish. Add more item in the menu for attractive item.   I have the noodle that recommended by the restaurant. We arrive 8:30 pm and they said if we could finish by 9:00 pm because they are closing. The food came out quick. I would said the food is as the food truck standard even though they serve in the restaurant. I would said some food truck may be has better wok cooking technique than their dish.   Overall is a good experience. It is about 3.5 stars but they do have a lot of room to improve. Service is good. We finish our food at 8:55 and take the one not finish to go.

Rare Authentic Food No. 25  Thai cuisine in grocery store? This international grocery store has good Thai here. The restaurant dish order is located at the back and the seat at the front of the store. My first time experience was great. The second visit is average. I still like they have good wok technique.   We have Pad Kee Mao, Larb Beef, Pad Se-ew, green curry chicken and wonton soup. I like the most is Pad Kee Mao. This is a flat noodle dish stir fried in high BTU wok with some strange veggies I have never have before. It was good and dry. The noodle has good combo with egg and veggies.   The second visit red curry is the most interesting. We have good group and the food come out quick. The promotion in the Yelp allow one free drink with $15 purchase. The service is good. The food is great.

I think if the restaurant need to be competitive at International Plaza, they need to restructure their menu, pricing, drink, new dish. This is due to my recent visit and find their food not attractive. In fact, that can be tell from how many customers visited this restaurant.   We started with their Lobstah Tacos. We got the full menu 3 taco. Most of the meat is from the lobster crawl. I would not recommend use the tip meat at the crawl. They are powdery and not great. They need to mixed with body and crawl meat but remove the tip of the crawl meat.   Our second dish is seafood poke bowl. Their poke is not attractive at all. With the same price, there are many poke place do better than them. This dish need a lot of improvement. The third dish is the key west crab cake sandwich. This dish is a little better. But I would use fully dungeons crab meat. Mixed other item and become the crab cake is a bit low side to impress the customers.   Service is good. But I think they have many waiters stand around until the customers notified them.

This first time I have PF Chang as lunch. My previous visits mainly dinner time. They have the lunch menu which is different than the dinner. I like the dinner choices of dish. But the lunch menu offer something I have not try before. Our visit to mall give us the chance to visit the restaurant.   The space of the restaurant is nice and open. During the pandemic we were able to seat six feet apart. We order the fried we have shrimp hand made dumplings. They offer two types of finishes. You can choose the dumplings by steam or pan fried. I have not have a pan fried shrimp dumplings. We actually like the pan fried a lot.   We also got the northern style pork spare rib. This is another dish we don't have before. The rib marinated by dry rub spice. It was tender and off the bone. Good technique.   Overall our time there was very good. Lunch is way to go.

This Carrabba's do not open for lunch except weekend. In Temple Terrace, there are a lot of retirements people live nearby and they go to dinner early. As a result, the restaurant fills up quick before the actual dinner time. The best way is eat early or later.   I have been to this restaurant many times. They have run many special for introduce the new dishes. Tonight we are here for new dish for special price promotion. The dish is prosciutto wrap pork lion special for $10.90. Regular price is $14.49. The dish is pork loin wrap by prosciutto and top with sweet red wine sauce. It also comes with choice of pasta or veggie. We choose the angel hair pasta with garlic olive oil. The dish is great and well balance. I can say that I order that dish again if I come back. The entree comes with soup. I have chosen the Sicilian Chicken Soup.   Overall, our experience here is great and the service is on point.

Super 8 motel now carry the name of Wyndham chain. I would recommend to avoid this hotel. I have not many one star review. This hotel definitely deserves one.   1. The hotel has long over due renovation. The item they have is old. Furniture is old, carpet is old, edging and corner of the room has many hole.   2. The room floor and hallway are not clean. You see diet everywhere. I wonder how this house keeping do their job.   3. Bug can be found in the room. One of the bug crawl to the iPad we are reading and suddenly appear in front of the screen. My leg has bed bug bite.   4. The ice machine is old. Not sure it clean probably.   5. The room do not carry a hair dryer. Even call at the front desk and they simply said they don't provide it. This is the most serious of all. If you have lady partner travel with you in the winter time. The hair is not dry with catch serious cold next day.   6. Breakfast is very lack off and very little. Not sure how the run the hotel.   With that said. I would said extremely highly not recommend this hotel. The owner need to seriously consider how the manage and maintain this hotel.

This is a drive through coffee shop. You expect long car line during popular time such as after lunch hour, morning, some mid afternoon. The only improvement is they take order while you on the line. This will speed up the wait. All coffee will need order and make. We got the expresso toasted mush mellow as topping. The shake has good ice.   Drink is good. If they can use two percent milk is better. My wife got the Yoguccino shake. This is yogurt, ice cream and coffee. This interesting mixed. In addition we also add the lavender flavor into it.   Basically you can order a drink that no one have the flavor mixologist. It is base own your combine request. They also has the Italian soda which you can do the same thing.

This new location definitely have a lot of room for customers. Many customers are happy to have the bigger place than the original store. However one challenge is how you fill the restaurant in this remote area. It not close to university, major metropolitan area, at smaller sub division.   I can said that their tamales is getting better. We order a to go tamale but it is still taste very good at home. We have try their shrimp, fish and lengua taco. My wife like the lengua because they have prepared it to very soft easy to bite. For me, I think they need to pan fried one more time with spice to make it interesting to paid for the price. I don't like the fish taco which the fish is fried. I prefer it grill since this is high pricing taco. I like shrimp the best. It is definitely worth the money.   This is cafeteria style order at the counter. But the tip on the checkout ask medium to high percentage choice or custom tip. I really see the point if I walk to order for high tip situation.

This express place have some good wings. Other than wing, they also have the smoothie and combo of other comfort food. The comfort food include gyro, chicken sandwich, Philly cheese steak, cheeseburger, fried oyster.   The selection of smoothie include mango banana, strawberry, berries and more. I like their mango smoothie. It refreshing during the summer season.   The chicken wing include wet and dry coating. I like their Parmesan and lemon pepper dry chicken wing. I am not a wet coating wing guys. If you buy six wing is about a dollar a piece. If you buy 10 wing is $0.80 a piece. The cheapest is 100 wing with $0.75 a piece.   Their side include fried mushroom, fried okra, Conch fritter and more. Although they call themselves wing express, you still need to give them time to cook. But the wing is crispy and good.

The airline is getting better from my past experience. The line getting shorter for check because it is automated. The pre-check in also help since the confirmation help that you are traveling in 24 hour. I have selected my seat long before at booking. It secure where I want to seat.   The earlier boarding help customers to settle down in the cabin. It also help if everyone is already boarded and the take off can be earlier. I got my flight 30 early due to faster flight and fully boarded and ready to go. It is very efficient for my flight today. After boarding, when they have too many empty economic premium seat, they redistribution the seat and create many 2 person in 3 seat and flight more enjoyable.   The drink and snack serve on the plane. They dim the light entire flight because we have the evening 7 to 9 pm flight. It make relaxing during the flight.

New name under new change. The menu also change from previous Thai restaurant that was here. I kind miss the old restaurant. But I welcome the new restaurant. I think the menu getting larger. More choices. I like they have some signature dish is very intriguing. The dish included Tornado Soft Shell Crab, Chu Chee Duck, Siam Chicken, Nuah Nam Tom, Yum Seafood. This are some good dishes listed.   We have order the day special with soft shell crab and the Chu Chee Duck. Because they are still new in the area, the material of the food is very good quality and big. The soft shell crab come in two pieces with size larger than palm of my hand. The sauce is a bit sweet.   The duck was fried and top with Chu Chee curry sauce. The kaffir lime leaves has good flavor. The duck was deboned. It come with good amount of pieces. It is "A" on ingredients.

Irish bar and eatery. May a leprechaun there. Let me know if you spot one. Please find the pot of gold too.   James Joyce may be derived from famous persons in Ireland. But they do build a good bar at YBOR. We arrive at 6 pm and it is already some patrons already there for a glass of beer. Their tap include local, German , Irish beer. But the special of the day actually drawn us here today. It is very hard to find local restaurants serve broil live Crawfish. But this pub serve this dish. If you buy two beers, the Crawfish is $6.95. It is a deal. My wife went for the order and I enjoy the two beers.   I have the Carlsberg and the IPA. Both are good draft beer.  I have the Guinness Beef Stew and the the Scott Egg. The beef stew cook with Guinness Stout as one of the ingredients. The stew is delicious Ireland comfort food. The Scott Egg is amazing. It coat with ground sausage outwardly. Very interesting.   We enjoy our time there. Interesting bar.

This new health food supermarket may be the first at northeastern Tampa. Food is not cheap. Basically you need to be their mailing member to save some money. Once you are in their mailing list, you will receive some coupons to compete the price of regular supermarket.   I like several thing about this supermarket is their select your own quantity on several item. It is by bulk organic and natural food. It includes the grain, flour, bean and more. Base out your need daily and get it fresh. The deli section is just Ok. I know it is healthy food and the preparation on seasoning is light. I like heavy seasoning.   To regular shoppers who come here once or twice a week may be a bit expensive in compare to other supermarket. But if you everything healthy, is not a bad choice.

There are not many Boston Market Chicken in Tampa. This location may only one in Temple Terrace. I like the one in New Tampa and decided to try it on this location.   I think the rotisserie chicken may need some work. The marinated spice did not go enough to the bone. It is important to get the marinated spice into the meat. The other things is the chicken need to grilled a bit more to crispy the skin.  It is the crispy and tasty skin that make the name of the Boston Market. One thing they done very well is the maintenance of juicy meat. This may be due to their good technique.   I have the three pieces dark meat which is good enough for a meal. It come with two sides of your choice. I had the sweet potatoes yum and the mixed sautéed veggies. This is a good choice. Overall my experience is good.

Dunn River Fall and Park is a beautiful place in the northern Jamaica. The cascade of falls is the main attraction. This restaurant name after the beautiful place does represent the food and native cuisine. The restaurant has a lot seating and a stage for special events. Time to time they have special music event.   I am surprised they did not receive high mark. This may be the service is slow. Other than that. They are 5 stars to my book. The price of the food is very reasonable. You have to understand stand why they successful is because their good Island spice marinated to the meat.   I got jerk chicken that only cost $9. The chicken is marinated to the bone. Their spice is different than most of the Jamaican restaurant. This is their uniqueness. The lunch special during the weekdays is less than $6. They have good oxtail and jerk shrimp. Please check out their website for musical show.

The Greek goddess always have good healthy food. This Acropolis has been here for long time. But I was surprised to see a slow Friday lunch crowd. I have been to this place on weekday and they have more crowd.   We were early at 11:30 am. I have order blacken salmon salad special of the day and my wife got the grilled chicken wrap. It take more than the normal air time for the food to come out. The salmon was grilled to perfect but the blacken can be better. I like the salad dressing. The potatoes salad on top of the salad is creative. The grilled chicken can improve a bit better by marinated over night to enhance the flavor and add some salt.   The decorations of the restaurant is contemporary. However, the booth seat need a new leather refurbished. Service is slow.

This is the Krispy Creme that I have been visited frequently since the New Tampa location close many years ago. They have conveyor belt type of making the donuts in massive volume. The light for hot is almost lighted every time. Which mean they has fresh made donuts.   They have many types of donuts. But the one I like is the sugar donut. Not event the glaze donut. When they have the hot donut or freshly made donut, I like to ask them get them from the conveyor belt. Sometimes I ask for naked donut. I will at sugar crystal by myself.   During national donut day, this donut is free with one donut per person. Parking is not the most in this area. Very limited space. But drive through is available. They don't accept tip since there is camera behind the counter. Some one is monitor the employee behavior.

I always like Popeyes fried chicken. When first landed in this country, the place I went for college is Louisiana. That time I am not use to burger for my oriental taste. But Popeyes fried chicken is well accepted by my taste. Especially those spicy fried chicken.  I got the spicy chicken strip combo with popcorn shrimp. I like them spicy. The chicken strips are very nice and bread coated. The popcorn shrimp is just so so. I went with the combo. My order is close to nine pm. They already not brew any sweet tea. This store is a bit lazy not accommodate the customers need. I have if they have some on the drive through. They also out of sweet tea.   A southern food cannot provide sweet tea is not quite accommodating. Not wonder the rating is not high. Many of the waitresses know what I need but walk away from my request. I have been to some other Popeyes and they're not like that.

Drop two star. Simply just not up to the game. This time just not measured up from many front. The waitress who serve us take 7 minutes still did not pass the bowl for us to fill up the food. Not even come to our table to get order. We have to tell the secondary server to get us a bowl to start. We are veterans not required explanation. Not need to wait to pass us a bowl.   When we get to the food cart to fill the bowl to be cook, some ingredients are empty. The ingredients is just not as good as before. The squid must be in the freezer for long time. It is dry after cook. They use to have the bay scallops and it was removed from the ingredients.   The sauce table is just too massy. The sauce just drip all over the place. No one come to check or clean. During or dinner there, never see a floor manager come to check. Many hang out at the bar area and left the waitress to handle 5 tables in one time.   After dinner, the food did not sit well in stomach. What can I said. A lot let down in many front.

We have been to this bakery numerous time but none were at their anniversary. We finally came to their 105 year Anniversary celebration with rolling back 1912 price and item. It definitely a great success story for a store that has such history. I hope they can go for another 100 years.   We got the coconut macaroons, eclairs, brownie, and devil crab. The roll back price was very attractive. Many item very affordable. The total we paid is less than $6. I cannot believe it. I like everything we got. The coconut was moist. The brownies are delicious. Sometimes you can get not fresh devil crab. But not in this place. The crab cake was perfect and not smelly. Have a lot of crab meat. Eclair is a sticky situation. It is slimy and sticky good.   I alway like their Cuban pastry. Since it is anniversary celebration, I stay with their roll back item.  There were some other items we didn't get. But we did regret we did not get enough of the coconut macaroons. The celebration ballon and people line up make this event very festive.

Good gas station at the corner. Cash and credit is same price. 8 pumps total. It has a middle island for convenient store and people who paying cash. It is a simple typical gas station. 8 pump is enough to handle the traffic volume there.   The drive way is big enough for the circular driveway. Security cameras is mounted to pumps area and store entrance to protect the public. I would not have any problem to pump here at night.

Good restaurant. They have promising future. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars in my book. Not yet 5 stars. They have 5 dollar pho night. Service is good and attentive. We were here and find out many people waiting on the line try to get in. Very popular place. We were lucky to have two seat at the bar when two other just leaving.   I read all my friend review. Many have visited them a year or two years ago. You can see the most drop of the star is due to service. During our visit, the service is perfect and you can see improvement. The reason they are four stars now is their regular price is a bit in the high side in compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. That is the main reason not round up to 5 stars.   Food. The restaurant has good beef noodle soup. The sou is the best to my expectations in Bay Area. The papaya salad is one of the best. We also order the crispy duck and papaya tiger shrimp fresh roll. Their roll only come in one compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. But their roll is a lot bigger than other place to make up two quantities.   My experience is good. I will visit them when they have five dollars deal.

I have been here many time including when they did not sold the orange grove next door. Now the grove area becomes the small family home community. The grove have good selection on orange. Now not sure they got the orange. The time we have visited, they have the honey bell. But the price is about $1 a honey bell orange. It is kind of expensive.   They do have sugar cane soda if you look at the the refrigerator. They still carry many veggies items. I like that each items is clean and nicely displayed. They even have peel garlic if you want the convenience. I see huge carrot. It look like good food for horses. The also fresh portobello mushroom. Look big. You also can get some cactus to go and house indoors plants.

AJ is a cool store. They are close to the Raymond James Stadium. The store hour is very odd. No night hour or Sunday. As a result, no before or after Sunday football snack.   They have several sandwiches are already famous. We have order two of the famous sandwiches - Beer Braised Brisket and the Crunchy Chicken. Both of them are pressed sandwiches. That give the name of the store. The crunchy is fried chicken with coating. I like their spice up coating. It make this sandwich desirable. The beer braised brisket is soft and very good. I like the veggies go with it.   AJ are the two owners initials. They work well in coordination with each other. Food is good. Very close to 4.5 stars. Since is pressed system, it is a bit oily. But love the pressed food with this type of sandwich once a while.

After big explosion of opening, now the slow down is make sense if they worth for shop. Base of my opinion, they are more excited than the grocery next door. They have some organic produce offer. I like the ready to go and cook items. The seasoned meat and fish is easy to be selected and ready to cook. Is is easy for house wife to plan the meal of the day.   I got the JC Pie Pop ice cream. This item on sale and it is non GMO ingredients ice cream. Good flavor. I also have some hard crust almond for my movie night. The organic item included the fruits and veggies with timing sprinkle to keep the veggies moisture to the fresh. They also have the precut veggies ready to cook at home. Same some processing time.   Their organic juice or power juice are expensive for small bottles. Check is no line since it was 30 minutes to closed.

Keegan have been show on food network when Guy featured in one of his episodes. They have some item that Guy want to try. If you visit their restaurants, there is Guy signature poster in the restaurant.   The famous dishes include blackened grouper sandwich and charbroiled octopus. This two dishes are the best of the restaurants. I have ordered this two dishes to try. The blackened grouper come with mango chutney. The blackened is one of the kind. It is southern style spice. I like that better. The fish is in good portion.  The normal charbroiled octopus is about two tentacles. They give you 4 tentacles. The chargrilled is good but need to perfect it. The marinated spice is perfect but the grill technique need improvement to seal the tentacles juice.   The services are good. I like food. They have good quantities.

This is a market, convenient store, deli, food vendors, organic supermarket, or fast food has good offer for tourists or local residents are alike. It is many ideal stores in one market place. It is the grilled, wine bar, grocery, coffee bar, ice cream and bakery. It has many faces.   I have visited this place many times when I come to Sundial. This time I have order a turkey burger from the grill. It has pepper jack cheese, guacamole, aioli, pickle. This burger is $12. And do not come with side. Consider this is high side for the price. For the location and gourmet, the price is just for the median rating. Good burger not great. But you paid for the organic and experience.   I would said, I would not paid for daily eating here. Just once a while is fine.

This bridge is a symbol of all bridge in Florida. Skyway connect the two counties and provide the vital connections across the Tampa Bay. It is an awesome fan shaped cable with sail boat feature. The golden cable stay show the sunset color when drive on it.   The old was hit and damage during 1980. Many have died that day. The new bridge was completed at 1987. There is a movie Punisher was film here. It is actual at start of movie, Frank Castle stand at the mid main span and have panorama view of the bridge. This bridge symbolizes Tampa Bay.   If you take a cruise port of Tampa, it will pass under it. I remember my cruise to Mexico was just a few feet below the bridge. Awesome view.   This bridge is tall. During the high wind condition, the bridge was not safe to travel on due to tipping. Especially for the semi-trailer truck. The toll is collected from the traveler who using the bridge and fund the bridge maintenance.

It is not yet full 5 stars. It is about 4.5 stars in my book. The reason they are 4.5 stars is the value of the food vs the quality and taste of the food make the list above 4 stars. A reasonable price with decent food.   I started with the Guanabana Juice. It has great fruit smell. Mixed with 2% milk make this drink very desirable. We also has the shrimp empanada. This my first time with the shrimp infills. Very interesting. We got the Fish Fritter. The fish is salty fish. It is another interesting dish.   Our entree are the tilapia and steak mofongos. Tilapia is ok. The steak is better. The mofongo is good because they are cooking with pork material inside. The mofongo is better than other place I have tasted. Because it is soft and no dry - the key of good mofongo.   We end up with home made churros and coconut flan. Great balance of flavor. I will revisit them because they have reasonable price.

If you looking for good craft coffee and you have not have a lot of coffee budget, this is your place. I always advocate that our country cup of coffee is too expensive. It is about 400 percent profit. Especially for those big chain coffee shop. This local own coffee place is just the right price.   I have never seen food truck sell coffee and tea only until today. The coffee is great taste since they are fresh brew. If you need caffeine badly, you can go with espresso with double shot. They have cold brew and americano coffee. They also cafe con leche. The best part is to add the flavor into coffee. They have one flavor rarely seen. Lavender flavor. I would recommend that with fragrance smell. Other flavors include caramel, vanilla, hazelnut, mocha.   The tea includes chai latte, mango fruit tea, London fog, mocha ice tea and more. I would stop here again for coffee.

Great restaurant to be at Tampa Palm. We need restaurant like this in our area. I understand why many people visit this place. It is for good taste, ingredients conscious healthy living, good price. Ciccio do have all the qualities above.   We order three items to share. The first is the daily special island poke. This dish has seared rare tuna, blacken pineapple, edamame, mango over the sticky rice. Nice combination with sweet ginger sauce. It is good dish. The only thing I don't like is chop up seared Tuna. I will prefer is slice and better presentation with slice.   Our second dish is Thai Grilled Steak Bowl. It has lettuce, cilantro, mango, carrots, fried wonton skin. I like the grilled steak. I don't like the hard raw carrot. It doesn't go with the dish.   Our third dish is Spicy Thai chicken. I like this dish because it has mushrooms and stir fried noodle. The stir fried is good. Although it is American style but is still quite good.

The cheaper gas in Carrollwood. This Thorntons is not easy to access if you are on opposite site of Linebaugh. Since there is no left turn, you have to go straight and make a u-turn. This may be the reason they are 4 cents cheaper than most gas station around there.   They have 20 pumps for gas. So there not much of waiting. There is plenty of room to maneuver you car around the pump station. The convenience store has hotdog, cold or hot drinks, quick snack and more. The outside of the building has security camera in case anything happens around the pump stations.

It is Christmas and you can get snow flakes at this place. In fact, you can eat them. This is a lot different than shave ice or fluffy shave ice. Somehow they able to create this snow flakes in the cup for your enjoyment. This is not the flakes they collect while it snow. Not happen in Tampa anyway.   This store also has drink and some other munchies stuff. But the famous is snow flakes dessert. We have the mango and kiwi. The small portion flakes is $3.89. I like the mango toppings better because it has better blend with the flakes. I feel the kiwi lost the flavor. If you order the big bowl, you can have two kinds of fruit toppings. Each flake includes the topping and the sweet red bean paste.   No wait since they just open not long ago. I like the new ideal especially come to street food from Asia.

Largo Central Park provide many events. This is community revitalization for the residents within the city and abroad. Recently we visited the park holiday light stroll. This is fun and free to public. I saw as far as Sun city retirees come to visit. The park is lighted with many Christmas light. It attracted young and old. The marry go around and the giant wheel added the excitement.   The park has many events. It included the central railway with small train on certain calendar events and it is free to family to ride on the miniature train. Donation can be suggested to ride. They have movie in the park to drawn crown. Some of the features included the beauty and the beast and cars 3.   The park has special event such as thirsty third Friday. Special guest performance. The Chinese New Year has event in the park 2018. Stay tune for this event.

During the Yelp restaurant week, this restaurant is top of my list to visit. It was great incentive to visit the restaurant during the Yelp Restaurants Week. The place is trendy. This is my first dinner to actually eat at David Island.   We have Pollo Al Forno w/ Lemons and Pollo Margherita. The Pollo Al Forno w/ Lemons is roast chicken with Italian herb. When the menu said with lemon, it actually with lemon Italian tomato base sauce. If I know it ahead I may change my mind because I don't like sour food. Nonetheless, the chicken is great. I think the potatoes can be smaller pieces for all the herb. The chicken Margherita was a great dish. It has all bell and whistle for the farm to table item. The chicken is pounded and breaded with right crust. It sauce is amazing. I would definitely go for this dish. Very pleasant to enjoy this dish.   The service is great. The only thing for the restaurant is not much choice on the protein side. Only chicken, sausage, meat ball. It will be difficult to grab hold on the the customers to visit from out side of David Island. Don't get me wrong, this is good restaurant.

Gateway Arch and Old Courthouse is belong to US park service. The arch and courthouse are located at the prime location of the city. It is gateway to welcome the boater from mighty Mississippi River. This gateway symbolizes St. Louis is the city of all float.   The Arch Gate and the courthouse is align. It is perpendicular to the Mississippi River. The arch has tram to the top. They sold combo tickets with the river cruise and the movie. You can it as individual ticket when you don't have much time. The arch room of the top is limited room. You can see the entire city. The arch is 630 feet tall monument and open in 1965. President is not allow to the arch because of security reason except president president Eisenhower.   The courthouse is built mid 1800. The dome is like church cathedral. It is beautiful building. A lot of civil right cases were ague here.

Local restaurant serve Caribbean style food. The setup like a bar restaurant. There were a lot of people during the lunch time for the out side seating and the bar area during weekends lunch time. Seem like business is doing well.   I come here for the take out order. During lunch, the lunch menu daily special is a bit cheaper than dinner. I got the jerk chicken and the jerk salmon. Both of them have option of two choices of side. I got the coconut rice, black bean, sautéed veggies, mash sweet potatoes. The side was interesting. However the meat seasoning is more into American flavor than the island flavor. This a lot mild to suitable the local people taste.   The wait for the take out is about 18 minutes after order. They did offer me water while I wait. The responsive of the waiter is on point.

I have been using this store for 7 years. We use them for the professional print, overnight rush print, larger print (biggest than 11x 17 paper), poster print.   My company has an account with them and it is easy to use. Sometime we have Orlando branch office email the marketing material to Pro Copy and we can pick up the print at next day. The nice thing about this store is they open 24 hours. I can go there at midnight to get my print done. USF student can have special 10% discount when they present the photo ID. I also learn that they promote the "green" printing.   I have good experience there. The staff is very friendly. They always deliver on schedule. They have nice color printing and edge cutting. The only thing I would said is they printing cost is in the high side of many copy center. But if you like professional treatment, this is the place.

We were curious after Whole Food bought by Amazon if the grocery store lowered their price. The price of the food are still remains the same. This store location is some what unique because it located in mall compound but not link to mall interior way.   I found the cotton candy grape here. The cotton candy grape is $4 a pound. The food here is high grade. I like ready to cook food at the meat area. Many choices of marinated meat either ready to grilled or cook.  I found lion fish for sales. There are many smoke fish including salmon Keta candy, hot smoke lion fish, smoke garlic herb sea bass, smoke shrimp. Those look good.   The cheese section is amazing and plenty of good cheese to select. They dry noodle by bulk which is convenient for small portions meal. The hot deli section is huge. It is good by pound. I got two pieces of chimichurri steak. I like mochi section that you can pick up by pieces. This is something new to me.

This is the second Moonlight in the Pinellas Park. They open less than a month. The have the buy one get the second drink for 50% off until end of August. Not much time left for the promotion.   The new Moonlight is about the same size of the first one. They several seating area. Only two people working on the drink. You may have to wait if the line in front of you have large order. They also serve finger food and simple meal plate for hot food.   I got two smoothies with boba. The smoothies is $4.5 each and added boba is $0.59. Event with 50% off, I have to paid $8. I got the lavender and the taro smoothies with honey boba. The drinks are very nicely made. The boba amount is good quantity not the huge quantity. May be $0.59 for added on is a bit steep.

One of the few oriental grocery that open during pandemic. Mainly Vietnamese customers are visiting this store. Most food are also gear for Vietnamese food. The store is kind of strange. It link to jewelry store next door.   The items are not as complete compare to larger grocery store. But is it convenient for the local to pick up item they need. Aisle is a bit narrow to save space for more good to display. The munchies aisle is limited. I could not find the items I like.   Selection of item is good enough for you to cook a meal.

I like this seafood and bar restaurant because they have reasonable price their dish. The restaurant has good amount inside seating and more seat at outside. They do have TV when there is game time. Cuisine type is American and Cajun.   We were having a chance to try their special of the day. The sautéed mussels for $8. This diss come with good number of PEI mussels. It is sautéed in garlic tomato. Very nice sauce to go with bread for dipping.   We also order the pop boy with fried oyster. It come with fried. The pop boy is big. It has 8 giant oyster. Good size. Seafood we have try is fresh. The beer is $2.5. Good buy.   Our experience is good with the services. The food also comes out right on time. It was not busy on 11:30 am in the morning. Not wait for the table. Food has good quality.

Nikkei try to be a restaurant at the center of the outlet mall. The location is perfect to attract good attention. It is located across Nike outlet. There is waiter stand outside to show the menu. I would said they are a good stand in the mall.  We got the fish ceviche. They give average number of fish. The ceviche is fresh. It has Peruvian corn. It is a bit sour due to lime. We also got the octopus salad. This dish I did not see many place serve this dish before. The octopus is decent.   For the amount of food given and the location, I think their prices are in the high side. It will be a difficult to compare the a sit down restaurant at surrounding of the mall. But if you want something different. Here is the place in the mall.

I have been to many burger join, the smashburger is the first. I was excited to try out some new burger. They carry burger, chicken, salad and shake. Very simple menu. They have options to order online and they also have options to create your own sandwich.   I got the Swiss Truffle Mushroom. The burger is juicy and seem like cook with butter. It is definitely moist and great mushroom cream sauce. The charge above $7 a burger. Pricy. The bun and burger is tinny. It is like burger junior. For the price, I may not want this burger.   The open late till 10 pm. Not many customers during that time. I only have wait 5 minutes for them to cook. The meal is add additional 5 bucks. I decided not to. The whole combo may be difficult to attract customers. But their side is good choice. It include grilled Brussels sprouts.

I love downtown. But most of the time is difficult to find great food with reasonable price. Fusion Bowl has solved many lunch office workers with affordable price. The location also is prime location next to county office building.   I was surprised we able to find a "great" drink place with decent food. The drink. I have the mixed berry with condensed milk with coffee jelly. This is great drink. This drink has many berry type and herb. We also has a good lavender drink and mango drink. All these drinks were good. But the mixed berry is the best.   I got the beef noodle pho, lemon chicken fresh roll and grilled pork bowl. I said they are decent and acceptable. The quantity enough for lunch and better than fast food.  Lemon chicken is good to start.   The store owner was friendly. I like this small business. They have a lot customer visiting during Sunday lunch. Imagine weekday afternoon.

Interesting poke place. Before I start, there is one thing the restaurant need to improve immediately. It is the ventilation inside the restaurant. The food smell in the restaurant is heavy. It will stick to the cloth you wear after you eat in there. The situation need to improve because the hot summer many customers want to eat in the restaurant.   We have the crab corn dog. It is a lot of rice. Not much of the crab salad. But it is unique. The salmon donut also another interesting food. The rice shape as donut. The slice salmon was lay on top. The sauce is nice. I think this is worth the try because it is unique.   The service is good. Food come out quick.

The bakery items here is good. I would said is about 3.5 stars for many Latin bakeries that I have been to. Don't come before the closing time because many hot items sold out.  Their popular items are devil crab, empanadas, stuff potatoes, meat pie, chorizo rolls, and sausage rolls. These items is $2.49 or $2.99 each. They also serve sandwiches including Cuban sandwich. The coffee includes cafe conleche, expresso, cappuccino, mocha, flavor latte. All these drinks are good.   Breakfast can found here. As cheaper as Cuban toast to breakfast bowl. The breakfast bowl has 3 eggs, 2 meats and 2 veggies. There is plenty to share. I got the coconut turnover and coconut macaroons. The pastry is fresh and crunchy. Price is above the average in the Bay Area. Other than that. All is good.

This is my second time back to the grocery store and my first review. 80% of the store is the grocery store. If you like some Pinoy cuisine ingredients, look no further. You can get it here.   I am here actually for their 20% of store space. They have back alley kitchen restaurant. They do have two tables. I got the lechon and halo-halo. Unfortunately the lechon grill is not what I imagine roast pig. But is similar to Chinese crispy pork. However I like their dipping sauce. The brown sweet sauce is complimented the crispy pork.   The halo-halo is definitely an item to have. They have many ingredients below with ice cream on top. Great drink for summer. Sweet and savory. I like their purple grain. It is enjoyable bite in the drink.   One thing to improve is the store only one person. When you have long line in front of you might as well go to other restaurant. Because the wait is long. For my next visit, I like to try their Daing Fish fried.

I like this bay looking restaurant. It is on the water. They have plenty of waiter and waitress. The time we have visited were Sunday lunch time at 11:00 am. It is a bit cold seat at the outside next to water for December. This is our first restaurant for progressive lunch.   I got the grilled grouper sandwich with pretzels bun. The side we have the coconut rice. It was great. The grouper is fresh. They do give good pieces of grouper. We also has the lobster roll with sweet potatoes. The sweet potatoes were crunchy. The lobster is chunky and has less mayonnaise which show more lobster meat in the rolls. I like this way better.   Our service is good. Food come out quick. We were able to finish our meal and paid less than 50 minutes.

Yelping 2300. Rare Bay Area Museum Number 57.   The regular price to visit the museum is $15 per adult. It is well worth the money. The membership is $100 a year and two is $150. During the membership drive, the discount is 50%.   This museum has items that are eye popping moment. The museum featured wonderful pieces of glass sculptures creation. I have been to Venice and look at the Murano glass, but this museum glad is measured up to the standard and some of the creativity is exceed them.   There is one that has infinite window with triangle glass reflection. It is endless. Some has series of wings like the Phoenix. One of the piece has the glass fibers form the sculpture. Like tail of the whale. One ball capture the flower with thousands bee surrounds it. One of the piece painted, shatter, then reassemble.   These arts are beautiful. The color is vibrant. The shape like a women. The imagination take you to different dimension. After your visit, you can imagine more. So imagine you will be back for more.

New poke place near channelside. It is at the lower floor of the apartments complex. The parking can select the parking garage. The visitors parking is free. You may have to take the elevator of the residential apartment to downstairs since the parking is at third floor.   We were there at the grand opening. They do have celebrations on the grand opening. It I has the prize drawing for the visit. It also has special on the poke. I got the two protein bowl. The protein includes shrimp, spicy tuna, ahi tuna, salmon, tofu and more I got the ahi tuna and shrimp. The add in has a lot option. They also have the up charge item such as avocado.   The poke is right quantity. It is good for enough for a hungry person. It has a lot choices. I like they mixed sauce and poke then add to the meat.

We were here during lunch time and the restaurant is busy. Seem like they doing well. We avoid the wait of table a straight to bar area. Only three people surround the bar. Later we saw our bar tender also serve the table at bar area. We realize they serve more than the bar only. However, they do have two bar tender for this area and did not slow down the service. At night time they have four bar tenders.   We put our order in and request to be hurry since we have meeting elsewhere. We have order the Baby Back Rib and my friend order the Brick Chicken. The Baby Back meat fall off the bone. You can use the folks to pick up the meat. My friend like the brick chicken. We also order an appetizer Roasted Wing. These wings were dry rub with good marinated sauce. It is drum wing prepare like popcorn. Great to have.   We were in and out in 45 minutes. Not bad. The waiter paid attention to detail like serving to your right. Bring a hot wet tower with lemon if you use your finger for the food to clean your hand. This is about 4.5 stars restaurant. Half stars different is I think their food is a bit expensive but it does measure for the price.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. The food is simple. Nothing special. However, the price is reasonable. Especially for dinner. This newly open restaurant has open seating and contemporary design interior. It is pleasant to visit.   The restaurant does not provide any bread or pre-meal items compared to many Italian restaurants nearby. It may be due to their reasonable price. We got the Vongole pasta. It come with seven clams, spaghetti with white wine and garlic clam sauce. Hint, I did not feel much of wine sauce. I like this dish because it is light. Great for older customers who don't like heavy sodium or sauce. The second dish we have is the Lemon Butter Salmon. This dish has pan sear salmon. Again, it is very light.   We feel the dish is very much we can prepare ourselves. Nothing special. The reasonable price make up the worth of visit.

The Pint and Brew is a unique bar near the county line of Hillsborough and Pinellas. It is serving the people of Dunedin, Tarpon Spring, and Oldsmar. Sometimes they have guitar jam there.   The bar offer many type of beer and have a good collection of local Brewer. Tonight is pumpkin smash night. All beer are adding the pumpkin spice or pumpkin flavor. The beer has some twist.  This is actually good for dark beer. It enhance the flavor.  I have order the Southern Tier and it is quite a taste after they add pumpkin flavor.   The bar is very lively.
